name: Go to Victoria Peak to watch the sunrise
description: At 4 a.m., the first alarm of the New Year went off. I gently woke my husband Mingzai and the children. Xuanxuan turned over and sat up at once, but Xinxin was reluctant to get up, so I coaxed her out of bed with the fairy tale about "seeing the first little sun of the New Year from the mountaintop." I quickly helped the children put on their warm, windproof jackets and checked the backpack: it contained a thermos full of hot water, a Sony mirrorless camera, a stack of wish cards, and colored markers. Mingzai was responsible for carrying the tripod and a small telescope. Before setting off, the four of us did a simple 5-minute joint-stretch routine in the living room. At 4:15, Mingzai drove off in our private car, and I sat in the front passenger seat, quietly chatting about the sunrise forecast and our New Year wishes. The children soon fell asleep again in the back seat. We went through the Cross-Harbour Tunnel onto Hong Kong Island and arrived at the open-air parking lot near the Peak Tram station about 25 minutes later, at 4:41. From the parking lot we walked about 15 minutes, woke the children, and reached the Sky Terrace at Peak Tower. There were already quite a few tourists on the viewing platform. I held Xinxin, Mingzai held Xuanxuan's hand, and we found a good spot with a wide view. Along the way, I used my phone to take a few photos of the Victoria Harbour night view in the dawn light.
location: Peak Tower Observation Deck, 118 Peak Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waiting for Sunrise and Making New Year Wishes
description: Waiting quietly on the viewing platform for the sunrise. I took out my camera and phone and photographed the Victoria Harbour night scene and the distant skyline gradually brightening from multiple angles. Xuanxuan looked curiously at the distant mountains through binoculars, and Xinxin pointed at the twinkling lights in the distance and said excitedly, "So beautiful!" At 6:05 a.m., the first ray of sunshine of the new year broke through the clouds right on schedule, and the whole Victoria Harbour was bathed in warm light; the whole family cheered. I took out the wish cards, and each of the four of us wrote down our New Year wishes: I wrote "promotion to deputy manager, sub-2 half marathon," Ming added "keep my own pace," Xuanxuan drew a car, and Xinxin drew a heart. Then we solemnly hung the wish cards on the wishing wall and asked a kind tourist to take a precious family photo for us.
location: Peak Tower Observation Deck, 118 Peak Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Heading back down the mountain
description: Around 6:30 after sunrise, the crowds began to grow. To avoid the downhill rush, we took the Peak Tram down. On the tram, I quietly explained to the children how the tram uses cables and tracks to climb the slope. After reaching the foot, we quickly got the car and drove back to Kowloon City District. The children, tired from waking early and full of excitement, soon fell deeply asleep again in the back seat. Ming and I quietly talked about our work and family arrangements for the first day of the new year.
location: From the Peak Tram Station in the Central and Western District of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to the Whampoa Garden residential estate in Kowloon City District.

name: Returned home to help with breakfast and shared the family breakfast
description: After arriving home, I changed into loungewear, washed my hands, and went to the kitchen to help. My mother Chen Meiling had already gotten up early to prepare New Year's Day breakfast: Hong Kong-style silk-stocking milk tea, fried eggs, pineapple buns, and steamed Chinese sausage. As I arranged the plates, I imported the photos from my camera to my iPad. At breakfast, all six of us sat around the table. I excitedly shared the Peak wish card, Ming laughed and explained the words he had added, and the children waved their hands describing the 'salted egg yolk' sunrise. I sent the photos to the 'Yu Family' WeChat group and received lots of likes and good wishes.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tidying up the house and chatting with mother.
description: After breakfast, I helped my mother clear the dishes and tidy the living room. Then I sat on the sofa and talked with her about my work plans for the new year: I planned to focus on developing high-net-worth clients, push the team's performance to the next level, and prepare for the promotion interview. My mother, while knitting a sweater, told me not to work too hard, to take care of my health, and that health is the most important thing.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family yoga and meditation relaxation
description: At 9:45, I spread out my yoga mat in the living room and did about 45 minutes of self-practice. I focused on a few gentle stretching poses to relax the tight muscles in my legs and lower back after the early morning hike, along with core strength poses, and ended with 10 minutes of meditation. With each breath, I felt relaxed in body and mind, infusing calm energy into the new day.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leisurely stroll around the neighborhood
description: At 10:30, I changed into casual athletic shoes and took Xuanxuan and Xinxin downstairs. Xuanxuan sped ahead on a scooter, and Xinxin followed on her small balance bike. I walked slowly along the garden paths in the residential compound, observing the plants still lush green in winter, nodding to neighbors who were also playing with their children, and feeling the peaceful beauty of the community on a holiday morning.
location: Inside Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch, reading, and midday rest
description: Helped mother prepare lunch: steamed sea bass, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, and lotus root and pork rib soup. After the meal, Ming took the children to wash their hands and rinse their mouths, while I cleared the dishes and wiped the table. At 12:30, I returned to the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, and read Insurance Marketing magazine for 20 minutes to learn about the latest market cases and customer psychology. Then I set an alarm and took a half-hour nap to store up energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pour-over coffee and online socializing
description: After getting up at 13:30, I took out my new pour-over coffee equipment, weighed 15 grams of coffee beans according to the tutorial, ground them to a medium-fine grind, wet the filter paper, poured water in stages, and patiently waited for the drip. When I tasted the first cup, it was slightly bitter with a sweet aftertaste and rich aroma—success! Excitedly, I took photos from multiple angles to record it. I carefully laid out the photos and posted them on Moments with the caption: "New attempt: pour-over coffee, starting a wonderful afternoon in 2025!" Soon I received likes and comments. I switched to a private WeChat chat with my best friend Huang Wenhui to discuss our New Year plans in depth: she planned to obtain the CFP certificate, and I shared my goals of promotion and a half marathon. We also agreed to go to OCT Loft in Shenzhen for coffee next weekend.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child handicrafts and personal Cantonese embroidery
description: At 3:45 p.m., I accompanied Xinxin in the living room making ultra-light clay crafts and taught her to mold a "Little New Year Fortune Bucket." She did a good job following along. Xuanxuan sat quietly on the sofa reading a dinosaur encyclopedia, and I occasionally taught him to recognize new Chinese characters. At 4:45 p.m., I returned to the workbench in the bedroom and focused on embroidering a small ornament called "Gold and Jade Full Hall," using gold thread as the main color, accented with deep blue and purple-red silk thread, stitching goldfish scales stitch by stitch, immersed in the peace and satisfaction of handcraft.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Help with dinner and family dinner
description: After finishing the embroidery, I went to the kitchen to help my mother prepare the New Year's Day dinner: white cut chicken, stir-fried Chinese broccoli, and lotus root and pork rib soup that had been simmered in advance. I helped wash vegetables, chop scallions, and set out bowls and chopsticks, and the two of us chatted about family matters while working. At 6:45 pm, the whole family sat around the table to enjoy dinner. At the table, Mingzai brought up the funny stories of the children skateboarding in the neighborhood, drawing bursts of laughter. My father, Yu Guoqiang, even made a rare remark: 'New year, new spirit—the most important thing is for the whole family to be together.' The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family leisure time after the meal.
description: After dinner, Mingzai and I cleared the table and washed the dishes. Then the four of us curled up on the living room sofa and watched the Disney animated film Coco on the screen via casting. The children snuggled beside us, eating fruit and watching with great relish, and laughter never stopped.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with homework and bedtime stories
description: After the movie, I first took Xuanxuan to the study and helped him preview the new lesson 'Watching the Tide'. Then I went to Xinxin's room and told her bedtime stories: the brave little rabbit outwitting the big bad wolf, and the classic 'The Little Engine That Could'. After listening, Xinxin closed her eyes contentedly with a smile on her lips.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple’s balcony night talk and planning
description: After putting the children to sleep, Ming Zai and I brewed some pre-Qingming Longjing tea on the balcony while the evening breeze blew gently. We quietly reviewed the perfect day: from the awe of the sunrise at the hilltop to the warm dinner, every detail was full of happiness. Ming Zai said it was the happiest New Year's Day he had ever spent. I took out my phone notepad and shared my New Year work goals (promotion, team performance growth) and personal plans (break 2 hours in a half marathon, learn 10 new dishes). Ming Zai encouraged me to go at my own pace and said he would always support me.
location: Balcony at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up, gratitude journal, and bedtime
description: Back in the master bedroom, she washed up and changed into comfortable pajamas. Leaning against the headboard, she wrote her New Year's Day gratitude journal: grateful for her family's safety and health, watching the first ray of sunshine of the new year together, eating the reunion dinner, successfully making pour-over coffee, and having a heart-to-heart talk with her best friend. She felt calm and fulfilled inside. Before turning off the light, she quietly went to the children's room to tuck in Xuanxuan and Xinxin and kissed their foreheads. Returning to her room, she exchanged goodnights with Mingzai and fell asleep peacefully, full of good expectations for the new year.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: Woke up at 7, did not go for a morning run, and went to the study in her pajamas to organize the materials for the New Year kickoff meeting, reviewing successful cases and the PPT framework. Then she woke up Xuanxuan and Xinxin, helped Xinxin pick out clothes, and reminded Xuanxuan to check his schoolbag. Mother Chen Meiling had already steamed char siu bao, and Zhang Weiming cooked congee. During breakfast, she drank Hong Kong-style milk tea and ate char siu bao while doing a final check of the PPT outline, silently repeating the key lines. Zhang Weiming and Xuanxuan discussed the math test, Xinxin mentioned that she needed to bring a little turtle for tomorrow's kindergarten sharing day, and Yu Xiaowei promised to prepare it in the evening.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take Xinxin to kindergarten.
description: Put on a beige casual blazer, carried a commuter bag, and walked with Xinxin for about 38 minutes to Kowloon City Kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin asked whether the little turtle liked flowers, and Yu Xiaowei answered with a smile. When they arrived at the kindergarten gate, she kissed Xinxin on the forehead, said goodbye, promised to prepare the little turtle in the evening, and left after watching her enter the school.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Took the East Rail Line to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Island Line, arriving at Wan Chai Station about 30 minutes later. On the way, wore earphones and listened to piano music to relax, silently reviewing the framework of the sharing script.
location: Hung Hom MTR Station to Wan Chai MTR Station

name: Arrive at the office, prepare for, and attend the meeting
description: Swiped her card to enter the office at AIA Tower, chatted with colleague Su Lishan about interesting New Year's Day anecdotes. Then went to her workstation, put down her bag, took her iPad and presentation clicker to the main conference room to check the equipment. At 10 o'clock, the New Year business kickoff meeting began on time. Regional director Liang Zhenhua reviewed the 2024 achievements and laid out the strategy for the first quarter of 2025. At 10:45, Yu Xiaowei went on stage to share successful cases, combining data clearly and pragmatically, and received positive feedback.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Had lunch with Su Lishan and walked back to the company.
description: After the meeting, went to the Shui On Centre café with Su Lishan for lunch and ordered chicken salad and coffee. Spreading out the notebook, we analyzed one by one the 20 high-net-worth clients being focused on in the first quarter, discussed adjusting follow-up frequency and referral wording based on the client lifecycle, agreed on a joint visit plan, and arranged to meet again next week. After the meal, we walked back along Gloucester Road to the AIA Building, enjoying the afternoon sunshine. Shanshan went to visit clients.
location: Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, and 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Following up with clients and planning at the office
description: Back at my desk, I organized the morning meeting notes and made a work list. Incorporating the strategy shared by Su Lishan, I produced the 'Q1 Customer Relationship Deepening Execution Table'. I logged into the company system to filter customers whose policies are nearing maturity, recorded their contact information and coverage gaps, and planned to start phone follow-ups next Monday. I handled work emails and sent New Year greeting messages to two long-standing clients.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 138 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, office workstation

name: Handle administrative matters and client inquiries
description: Handled company administrative forms and browsed the latest product update notices. Received a call from long-time client Mrs. Liu asking about increasing her critical illness insurance coverage, patiently answered her questions, and made an appointment to discuss details at the café downstairs from her office next Tuesday afternoon. Looked out at the dusk street scene in Wan Chai, tidied the desk, and got ready to leave work.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 138 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, office workstation

name: Running into Mrs. Liu During the Commute Home
description: After saying goodbye to Su Lishan, who was still working overtime, she walked to Wan Chai MTR Station. After getting on the train and sitting down, she ran into Mrs. Liu. Mrs. Liu mentioned that her eldest son would be going abroad next year and wanted to consult about education insurance. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully, noted the needs in her phone memo, told her she would bring a few plans and discuss them in person another day, and happily exchanged schedule information. She got off the train when it arrived at Hung Hom Station.
location: Wan Chai MTR station to Hung Hom MTR station

name: Home interaction, parent-child yoga, and dinner
description: After arriving home, she hugged her mother first, watched cartoons with Xinxin, and promised to prepare a little turtle. Xuanxuan rushed out to report 85 points on his math test, and Yu Xiaowei praised him. Before dinner, she played a parent-child yoga video and did Tree Pose, Butterfly Leg Flapping, and other moves with Xuanxuan and Xinxin, with laughter all the way. Her mother Chen Meiling had prepared home-style dishes such as steamed grouper and stir-fried choy sum with garlic. During dinner, Yu Xiaowei shared the good news of the successful launch meeting. Her father Yu Guoqiang reminded her to stay humble and guard against pride. Zhang Weiming suggested going to Sai Kung for seafood on the weekend, and her mother said she could help take care of the children so that she could go to Shenzhen with Wenhui on Saturday.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with homework and playing with the children
description: After dinner, I helped Xuanxuan go over the wrong answers on his math test and explained the complex word problems by drawing line segment diagrams. Then I accompanied Xinxin on the play mat in the living room to build with LEGO, making a castle with a little turtle living in it. In a spare moment, I went to the balcony to clean the glass tank, added aquatic plants and pebbles, and prepared the little turtle that Xinxin needs to bring to kindergarten tomorrow, placing it at the entrance.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Traditional Cantonese embroidery time
description: After the children were taken by Zhang Weiming to read picture books, Yu Xiaowei sat on the sofa, took out her embroidery frame and needle and thread, and began embroidering the outline of a ginkgo leaf. She tried the newly learned rolling stitch technique to make the leaf vein lines more dimensional and smooth. As she concentrated, she felt inner peace. Her phone showed a voice message from Huang Wenhui about the weekend schedule, and she planned to reply later.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Coaxing Xinxin to sleep
description: Putting down the embroidery frame, she walked into Xinxin's bedroom; Xinxin had already changed into her sleep sack. Yu Xiaowei lay down beside her, held her close, and told an adapted version of The Little Turtle's Dream. By the time the little turtle bravely realized its dream, Xinxin had already fallen asleep with steady breathing.
location: Xinxin's bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's balcony night chat.
description: After settling the children down, I drank chrysanthemum tea with Zhang Weiming on the balcony rattan chairs. We shared the client maintenance plan made with Su Lishan that afternoon and the matter of bumping into Mrs. Liu on the commute. Zhang Weiming also shared the day's small achievements at work. We talked about our 2025 wishes: Hua Ge said that if the quarterly target is met, he could be nominated for promotion to deputy manager, and he is also seriously preparing for the half marathon. Zhang Weiming expressed belief and support; the stars in the night sky were sparse, but my heart was full of light.
location: Balcony, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Write gratitude journal and prepare for tomorrow.
description: Back in the study, she wrote down three small things to be grateful for in her notebook: the recognition she received when sharing at the kickoff meeting, her mother's solid support, and the healing chat with Mingzai. Then she prepared the clothes to wear tomorrow morning and checked again whether the lid of the glass tank holding the little turtle was leaking.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: Turn off mobile data and set the alarm for 6:45 tomorrow morning. Drift into a peaceful sleep with a sense of fulfillment and contentment.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation, breakfast, and family interaction
description: Yu Xiaowei was woken by the alarm at 7:00. Following the pre-race tapering principle, she did not go for a morning run. After a quick wash, she walked to the entrance in her loungewear, opened her race kit and double-checked her running shoes, bib number, energy gels, salt tablets, sports watch, and spare top. Then her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared breakfast: hot Hong Kong-style milk tea, whole wheat bread, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. As Yu Xiaowei ate breakfast, she listened to her mother talk about what she had seen at the market. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin woke up and joined them. Yu Xiaowei picked her up and fed her a small piece of bread, and the daughter cheered her on in her childish voice. The whole morning passed in a warm family atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.

On the way, she reminded her daughter to listen to the teachers in the kindergarten, and at the school gate she watched her enter.
location: From Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to company
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei walked 5 minutes to Hung Hom MTR Station, took the East Rail Line to Admiralty Station, transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station, walked about 6 minutes after exiting, and finally arrived at the AIA Building office in Wan Chai at 8:45.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from Hung Hom Station in Kowloon City District to Wan Chai Station in Wan Chai District (MTR East Rail Line and Island Line), ending at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District

First, she looked up the file of Mrs. Liu, whom she had encountered the day before, and noted her children's education insurance needs. Then she organized client records from the past year and selected a priority client list for Q1. From it, she chose three clients with strong intent, sent New Year greetings and customized product information via WeChat, and called two of them, successfully scheduling meetings for next Wednesday and Thursday.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch and walk with colleagues
description: At noon, her colleague Su Lishan arrived right on time, and the two went to Biaoji Wonton Noodle House together. Accompanied by Su Lishan, Yu Xiaowei ordered wonton noodles in clear broth as a light pre-race meal. The two talked about Su Lishan's weekend hiking plan, Yu Xiaowei shared her half-marathon pacing strategy, and Su Lishan encouraged her to stay calm. After lunch, Yu Xiaowei strolled slowly along the streets of Wan Chai. Looking at the comfortable 16-18 degrees Celsius on an overcast day, she felt satisfied about the race. Passing a newsstand, she bought a sports magazine and planned to read the pre-race mental advice in the evening. She returned to the company after a walk of about 15 minutes.
location: 119 Wan Chai Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: Biaoji Wonton Noodles (Wan Chai Road) and surrounding streets

name: Afternoon office work and wrapping up for the day.

After finishing the work, she leaned back in her chair and rested with her eyes closed for five minutes, took deep breaths, and imagined herself steadily cutting through the wind on the racecourse the next day. At 16:15, she started to tidy up her desk: cleared the desktop, turned off the computer, filed the documents, nodded to her colleagues, picked up her handbag and race pack, and left work early at 16:30.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother for a bit and went to the room to give her son a hug. To avoid eating too much at dinner and affecting her rest, she simply ate a bowl of tomato and egg noodle soup with small wontons cooked by her mother, light and comforting. While eating the noodles, she listened to her son talk about funny things at school, enjoying the warmth of family.

location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Her husband laid out her coat and running shoes by the door for the next morning. After turning off the lights, she tried hard to fall asleep. Although her thoughts kept reviewing her pace strategy, she persisted in closing her eyes and breathing deeply, and finally drifted into light sleep before 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early rising and family weekend breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally. After a quick wash, she prepared the weekend breakfast with her mother Chen Meiling: fried sunny-side-up eggs, toasted bread, and milk. At 7:15, the whole family sat down to enjoy breakfast and chatted about daily life. Yu Xiaowei mentioned that she would take her daughter to a place that might have a surprise in the afternoon, and her husband Zhang Weiming asked about tomorrow's assembly time.
location: Home, Unit C, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: After finishing the registration, Yu Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat in the living room and did a 45-minute gentle yoga stretching session, focusing on the hips, hamstrings, and back, with abdominal breathing, to store up energy for tomorrow's half marathon. location: Home, Unit C, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

location: Home kitchen and dining room, Flat C, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Midday break and getting ready to go out.

The daughter excitedly spun around in the living room. Yu Xiaowei checked the dance school's address and appointment information again and got ready to go out.
location: Home, Unit C, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
