description: At 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took Xinxin and walked from home to Whampoa Station. They took the MTR Kwun Tong Line, transferred at Yau Ma Tei, arrived at Lok Fu Station about 20 minutes later, then walked 10 minutes and reached the Elite Ballet Academy at 168 Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong at 13:50.
location: Elite Ballet Academy, 168 Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Daughter tries a ballet introductory class
description: At 2 p.m., the trial class started on time. Through the classroom glass window, Yu Xiaowei watched her daughter following the teacher and imitating little swan movements, earnest and happy. After class, she talked with the teacher, who praised Xinxin's musicality and flexibility.
location: Elite Ballet Academy classroom, 168 Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sign up for the ballet course on the spot and collect the gear
description: After the trial class, Yu Xiaowei decided to sign up. She confirmed the regular class time of every Saturday from 9:00-9:45 a.m. at the front desk, filled out the registration form, paid the first month's tuition plus the fees for the practice outfit and dance shoes by credit card, signed the agreement, and received the receipt along with a set of pink practice clothes and white soft-soled dance shoes. Her daughter hugged the new dance shoes and couldn't put them down.

participant.name: Administrative staff at a dance academy

location: Front desk, Elite Ballet Academy, 168 Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: On the way home
description: Yu Xiaowei, holding her daughter’s hand, took the MTR from the dance academy back to Whampoa Garden. On the way, she texted her husband to tell him the registration was successful, while her daughter excitedly shared the dance moves she had just learned.
location: Along the MTR route from Kowloon Tong to Whampoa

name: Sharing the good news of the ballet enrollment with family
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowei and Xinxin announced the good news to the family. The son applauded for his sister, and the mother smiled and said, "Xinxin will be a little swan from now on." Xinxin put on her ballet shoes on the spot and spun on tiptoe in the living room. Yu Xiaowei captured the warm moment and shared it in the family WeChat group.
location: Living room at home, Flat C, 15/F, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went to Victoria Park to collect the marathon race pack
description: After the sharing session, Yu Xiaowei went alone to Victoria Park to collect the race pack. She took the MTR from Whampoa, transferred at Yau Ma Tei and Admiralty to the Island Line, and arrived at the Standard Chartered Marathon race pack collection point at Victoria Park after about a 10-minute walk.
location: Standard Chartered Marathon race pack pickup point, Victoria Park, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pick up marathon supplies and consult the coach.
description: The venue was crowded. Yu Xiaowei smoothly collected her bib, timing chip, event T-shirt, and race guide using her ID card, and carefully checked that everything was correct. She then consulted coach Zhao Zhiming via WhatsApp voice about pacing strategy. The coach reminded her, "Hold back your pace in the first half."
location: Standard Chartered Marathon race pack pickup point, Victoria Park, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Experiencing the race course atmosphere and relaxing in the park
description: After collecting her race kit, Yu Xiaowei walked along the park track to soak in the atmosphere of the start and finish points. Seeing fellow runners checking in and taking photos, she felt eager with anticipation. She sat on a bench, drank water, took deep breaths, and browsed photos of the "Home Sweet Home Tea Restaurant" event shared by the mothers' group on her phone, mentally preparing for tomorrow's race.
location: Victoria Park, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home
description: At 7:15 p.m., Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Causeway Bay back to Whampoa Garden, taking about 30 minutes in total.
location: Along the MTR from Causeway Bay to Whampoa

name: Sharing dinner with family
description: At nearly 8 p.m., she returned home. Her mother and husband had already prepared dinner: steamed grouper, garlic broccoli, and white cut chicken. At the table, Yu Xiaowei shared what she had seen at Victoria Park and her goal for tomorrow's race. Her family cheered her on, and her son said he would bring the kids to wait for her at the finish line.
location: Dining room at home, Flat C, 15/F, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Video call with running buddy Shen Peiwen
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her running partner Shen Peiwen via video. They talked about race preparation, nerves, and expectations, confirmed tomorrow's meeting spot at the start (under the third big tree on the left side of the finish area) and the secret signal, and encouraged each other. Yu Xiaowei felt reassured.
location: Home, Unit C, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime family interaction, organizing race gear, and going to sleep
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowei confirmed with her husband that he would take care of the children tomorrow and pick her up at the finish line. She checked her son's weekend homework and listened to him talk about interesting things at school, then read her daughter the story "My Little Pony" to help her fall asleep. Then she went back to the bedroom, pinned the race number onto her race T-shirt, checked her running shoes, energy gels, and other items, and packed her race bag. After that, she did 10 minutes of bedtime meditation, focusing on her breathing and clearing her mind. At 22:15, she changed into her nightgown and lay down. Her husband whispered, "Good luck tomorrow," and she smiled, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Home, Unit C, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-race preparation and breakfast
description: She woke up at exactly 5 in the morning and washed up quietly. Her husband Zhang Weiming had already prepared pre-race supplies: bananas, whole-wheat bread, and warm water. While eating breakfast, she did 10 minutes of gentle stretching and pre-race meditation, feeling her muscle state, adjusting her breathing, with her heart rate steady at around 60 bpm.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Walking to the subway station
description: After checking her belongings, she said goodbye to her family and confirmed the meet-up point in the finish area. She put on her jacket, picked up her sports bag, and walked along the internal paths of the residential area to MTR Whampoa Station. The sky was just beginning to lighten, the air was fresh, and she listened to her pre-race playlist through earphones, feeling calm with a hint of excitement.
location: Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to MTR Whampoa Station

name: MTR commute to the starting point.
description: From Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, transferred within the station to the Tsuen Wan Line toward Central and went to Tsim Sha Tsui Station, about 12 minutes in total. There were not many passengers in the car, so she closed her eyes to rest and adjusted her breathing rhythm.
location: MTR Kwun Tong Line from Whampoa Station, transfer at Mong Kok Station to Tsuen Wan Line to Tsim Sha Tsui Station

name: Warm-up at the starting point and meeting up with friends
description: Arrived at Exit E of Tsim Sha Tsui Station; the race area was already brightly lit. In the designated warm-up zone, jogged until lightly sweating and performed a full dynamic stretching routine. Met good friend Shen Peiwen beside the third palm tree on the Avenue of Stars; they happily high-fived, cheered each other on, and checked their equipment. Used a selfie stick to take a photo with the dazzling lights of Victoria Harbour in the background, posted it to the running group with the caption “Dreams take off!” Then entered Zone E and waited for the 7:00 start.
location: Avenue of Stars, Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (the section opposite the Hong Kong Cultural Centre)

name: Half marathon race
description: At 7:00 sharp, the race started with the gun. She kept a steady pace of exactly 5:35 per kilometer. Along the way, she hydrated at the water stations on Shanghai Street and West Kowloon Highway. At around the 14-kilometer mark (Kowloon Bay section), she heard her husband and children cheering with a sign reading 'Go, Mom!' She gave them a thumbs up and ran with even firmer strides. Finally, she crossed the finish line at Victoria Park with a time of 1 hour 58 minutes 47 seconds, successfully achieving her 'sub-2' goal.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from the Avenue of Stars starting point in Tsim Sha Tsui, via West Kowloon Highway, Tsing Kwai Highway, Kowloon Bay, and Island Eastern Corridor, to the Victoria Park end point in Causeway Bay.

name: Finish-line family celebration and post-race recovery.
description: After collecting the finisher's medal and doing a quick refuel, she met her family under the agreed tree. Her daughter Xinxin threw herself into a hug, and her father Yu Guoqiang patted her shoulder in praise. They rested on a bench beside the jogging trail, relaxed with a slow walk, and shared stories about the race and how she felt during the sprint. Her husband Zhang Weiming took a photo of Yu Xiaowei with her medal on his phone and posted it to the family group.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Causeway Bay, next to the large tree on the left side of the Victoria Park finish area.

name: Client interaction and heading to the parking lot
description: While resting, she checked her phone and saw a congratulatory message from client Wang Qiming: "Congratulations, Sister Wei, on breaking 2! There's a Shenzhen cross-border insurance sharing session in March. Come and take a look if you're free?" Yu Xiaowei's eyes lit up, and she immediately replied: "Thank you, Mr. Wang! I'm very interested. I've noted it down. Let's discuss it in detail next week!" After replying, she walked 5 minutes with her family to the parking lot on Tung Lo Wan Road, and Zhang Weiming drove the family car back to Kowloon City.
location: From Victoria Park, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to the car park on Tung Lo Wan Road

name: Home core recovery and cleaning
description: After returning home, she immediately carried out a recovery routine: 15 minutes of targeted static stretching for the lower body, and applied ice packs to her knees and ankles. Then she showered, changed into comfortable loungewear, and drank a glass of milk with whey protein to replenish her nutrition.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Family rest and nutritional replenishment.
description: Leaning on the living room sofa to rest, her mother Chen Meiling handed her a bowl of steaming hot fig and pear soup. While drinking the soup, she used her phone to select race photos for a Moments post, with the caption: "Sub-2 achieved! Thanks to everyone who supported me, especially my Ming, the kids, and Mom and Dad!"
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Celebration lunch
description: They dined at He Ji Seafood Restaurant, which was very close to home. Zhang Weiming had made a reservation in advance. The lunch was light and nutritious, including steamed coral grouper, blanched shrimp, baby cabbage in superior broth, and the shrimp dumplings Xinxin had ordered. Everyone toasted with tea instead of wine to celebrate Yu Xiaowei's achievement. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, talked about the races he ran when he was young, and the atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Heji Seafood Restaurant, 222 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-dinner rest and parent-child time.
description: Back home, I lay on the sofa and took a short nap for about 30 minutes. Then I played with LEGO bricks with my daughter Xinxin and built a “medal display stand” to hold today’s medal. After that, I read her two picture books, Guess How Much I Love You and The Very Hungry Caterpillar.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Organize running data and physical fitness assessment
description: In the study, she opened the tablet and synced data from her Garmin Forerunner 245 running watch to the Garmin Connect app, marking key points (such as speeding up in Kowloon Bay). She found her previous physical examination report, combined the race data with the indicators, and used Pages to create a "2025 Spring Training Physical Fitness Assessment Form", highlighting race takeaways and areas for improvement, preparing detailed materials for tomorrow's meeting with Coach Zhao.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Video call with bestie and LEGO craft time.
description: She video-called her best friend Lin Jiaxin to share the competition details and joy. Jiaxin screamed with excitement on the other end, and they agreed to meet for tea next week to celebrate. After hanging up, she saw her son Xuanxuan building a LEGO Technic Porsche race car in the living room, so she went over to study the instructions with him and enjoy some parent-child time. At the same time, she took out her embroidery hoop and continued finishing the unfinished peony petals, while her father read the newspaper nearby and they chatted briefly about the competition and the plans for tomorrow.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Helping in the kitchen and interacting with family.
description: Mother was going to make corn fish fillet and tomato potato soup. Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen to help pick vegetables and cut tomatoes, and her husband Zhang Weiming was responsible for frying the fish pieces. Their daughter Xinxin sang nearby while helping put the washed vegetables into a basket. The whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Family dinner
description: Six people sat around the dining table enjoying a hot family dinner. The conversation never stopped; they brought up the funny incidents from the morning run again. Zhang Weiming shared the video he had taken of Yu Xiaowei running in Kowloon Bay, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Homework tutoring and Cantonese embroidery practice
description: I helped my son Xuanxuan finish his math and Chinese homework and listened to him tell brain teasers. Then I played the “who laughs first” game with my daughter Xinxin. Afterward, under the soft light in the living room, I practiced Cantonese embroidery and finished the last few stitches of the peony petals. The piece was beginning to take shape, and I planned to take it to the community centre tomorrow for Teacher Wu’s comments.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Prepared meeting materials and washed up for the evening.
description: After chatting with family about race highlights, I returned to the study and printed out the newly made "Spring Training Fitness Assessment Form" and Coach Zhao's contact information, and put them into the commuter bag. Then I washed my face, brushed my teeth, changed into silk pajamas, and applied a hydrating mask to help post-race skin recovery.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: Leaning against the headboard and wearing earphones, she followed the Calm app for a 5-minute guided meditation to clear her mind. She put down her phone and felt a sense of fulfillment and calm from the inside out. She turned off the light and lay down on time, ending a full and glorious day, and drifted into a sweet dream.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat A

name: Getting up in the morning, breakfast, and taking her daughter to school.
description: At 7 a.m., Yu Xiaowei woke up to the alarm and felt that the soreness in her thigh muscles had eased. She unrolled her yoga mat and did cat-cow and downward-dog poses to wake up her body. Then she went to the living room, hugged her mother Chen Meiling, who was preparing breakfast, and said good morning. At 7:30, she helped bring the steamed barbecue pork buns and eggs to the table and poured herself a big glass of warm water. Next, she helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin put on her school uniform and combed her hair. At 7:50, the mother and daughter walked to Kowloon City Kindergarten with an umbrella, arriving before 8. Yu Xiaowei kissed her daughter on the forehead and walked her through the school gate.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Go to the fitness center to meet with a coach and develop a spring exercise and nutrition plan.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei walked to Whampoa Fitness Centre, messaging her running buddy Shen Peiwen on her phone along the way. She arrived at 8:15 and met her coach Zhao Zhiming, then went into the consultation room. She handed the coach the Spring Training Physical Fitness Assessment Form and her medical checkup report. The coach analyzed her Standard Chartered Half Marathon pace, heart rate, body fat percentage and other data, and together they worked out a 12-week training plan that included running three times a week, yoga twice a week, and strength training twice a week, with an emphasis on high-quality protein and fruit and vegetable intake. They discussed specific movements such as Bulgarian split squats and bent-over rows, and Yu Xiaowei took notes in her phone memo.
location: Whampoa Fitness Centre, 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Return home to change clothes and commute to the AIA Building in Wan Chai.
description: After saying goodbye to the coach, Yu Xiaowei walked home, took a quick shower, changed into her work outfit, packed her documents and computer into her bag, and took a char siu bao as breakfast. She left at 9:50, walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, switched to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then changed to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to client Wang Qiming to congratulate him and discuss the March Shenzhen exchange meeting, and replied to two clients' emails about insurance policy renewals.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Focused on work in the morning
description: Arrived at the office at 10:40, first went to the break room to pour hot tea. Returned to my desk, turned on the computer, and saved the electronic version of the spring training plan into a folder. At 11:30, colleague Su Lishan came over to chat and shared photos of competition medals. Afterwards, focused on handling urgent client emails and began organizing materials for client Wang Qiming.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan walked to the coffee shop at Shui On Centre. They each ordered lunch; Yu Xiaowei ordered a smoked salmon avocado salad and a hot Americano. They shared the joy of running the marathon yesterday and the details of today’s meeting with the coach, and Su Lishan also shared a case from a client visit. After eating, they bought a few things at the nearby Mannings.
location: Shui On Centre Cafe, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Afternoon focused on work, client communication, and wrapping up
description: At 1 p.m., she returned to the office and first handled the medical insurance underwriting follow-up emails. Then she focused on organizing client Wang Qiming's materials, including insurance application records, claims history, and communication minutes, arranged into files along a timeline, and looked up background materials for the March Shenzhen financial conference. At 3 o'clock she received an existing client and helped him complete the procedures for changing the beneficiary, answering his questions. At 4 o'clock, to get some fresh air, Yu Xiaowei walked with her laptop to the Shui On Centre café, and while drinking hot lemon honey, listed this week's to-dos: call Wang Qiming on Tuesday, follow up on a potential client's medical checkup on Wednesday, and attend the team weekly meeting on Friday. At 4:30, after finishing the drink, she packed up her documents and returned to the office. Using the last half hour, she compressed and packaged Wang Qiming's materials and drafted an email to send the next day. Then she cleaned up her workstation and shut down the computer.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: After-work commute and family reunion
description: Left the office on time at 5:00, put on earphones to play jazz music, took the MTR from Wan Chai Station via Admiralty and Mong Kok to Whampoa Station, and walked home. During the commute, she reviewed her training plan and key client points. She arrived home at 5:50, smelled the aroma of soup from the kitchen, and her mother Chen Meiling was preparing dinner. After changing into home clothes, Yu Xiaowei hugged her daughter Xinxin. Her husband Zhang Weiming and son Xuanxuan had also just arrived home. She talked with her mother about her feelings from the coaching session, and her husband suggested having a lighter dinner when he heard.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Recovery stretching and core strength training, and shower
description: Spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of full-body recovery stretching, focusing on relaxing the front and back of the thighs and the buttocks. After a 5-minute rest, started core strength training according to the coach's instructions: 3 sets of planks (45 seconds each), 3 sets of glute bridges (12 reps each), and 3 sets of bodyweight squats (15 reps each), focusing on engaging the core. After the workout, she was sweating heavily, went into the bathroom to take a hot shower to relax her muscles, and changed into comfortable pajamas.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family dinner and spring plan sharing
description: The whole family sat around the table. The dinner was deliberately adjusted to be light and healthy: steamed grass carp, garlic stir-fried broccoli, and tomato, tofu, and beef soup. Yu Xiaowei shared the spring training nutrition plan developed by her coach, emphasizing eating more dark green vegetables and high-quality protein. Her mother said she would go to the market tomorrow to buy broccoli and chicken breast, and her husband volunteered to learn how to make vegetable and fruit juice, trying it out on the weekend.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Evening parent-child interaction and Cantonese embroidery time.
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei first went upstairs to check her son Xuanxuan's math homework and corrected two wrong problems. Then she went downstairs to accompany her daughter Xinxin, who showed her a newly drawn picture of the Victoria Park group photo. Yu Xiaowei listened carefully and praised her. At 8:50 p.m., she told Xinxin two stories from “Different Carmela” to help her fall asleep. At 9:10 p.m., the children were asleep. Yu Xiaowei took out her Cantonese embroidery hoop and quietly embroidered peonies for half an hour, enjoying the calm.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Late-night talk between husband and wife, preparations for tomorrow, and relaxation before bed
description: At 9:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei put down her embroidery and leaned against the headboard to chat with her husband Zhang Weiming, sharing about his work and discussing going to Shenzhen to look at air conditioners over the weekend and taking the children to a country park. After chatting for about 20 minutes, she got up, washed up, did her skincare, hung up tomorrow's commute outfit, and gathered her keys, Octopus card, and work ID. At 10:00 p.m. she got back into bed and read a few pages of a women's physical and mental health book to relax. At 10:15 p.m., she turned off the light, set the alarm for 7:00 a.m., felt fulfilled, and fell asleep to the sound of rain.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning family interaction, taking daughter to school, and talking with a client
description: At 7 a.m., Yu Xiaowei woke to the sound of her alarm. It was cloudy outside, with a temperature of 17-20°C. She first hugged her mother Chen Meiling, who was busy in the kitchen, then returned to the bedroom and briefly discussed the day’s arrangements with her husband Zhang Weiming, who had just woken up. She then woke her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin and helped them wash up and get dressed. While the family ate the breakfast her mother had prepared (congee, fried eggs, and char siu buns), Yu Xiaowei checked her phone’s memo app to confirm her work priorities: call Wang Qiming, organize Mrs. Chen’s materials and contact her, and complete the spring training plan. After breakfast, she organized her commuter bag and put all the documents for Mrs. Chen’s education savings rider into a document pouch. At 8 a.m., she took her daughter’s hand and walked her to Kowloon City Kindergarten, telling her a story about a little white rabbit along the way. They arrived at the kindergarten at 8:12. After watching her daughter led into the classroom by her teacher, she called her long-time client Wang Qiming at the school gate and, in a professional and warm tone, confirmed the details for attending the March Shenzhen cross-border insurance sharing session. The call lasted about 8 minutes and was efficient and smooth.
location: From home (Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region) to Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: MTR commute and handling online affairs
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowei walked about 5 minutes to MTR Hung Hom Station, swiped her card through the gate at 8:25, and took the East Rail Line to Admiralty Station. During the roughly 35-minute ride, she took out her phone to handle online tasks: first she replied in the internal system to a client's inquiry about the accident insurance claims process, then opened the insurance product learning app and used the fragmented time to listen to a short lesson on the latest changes to savings insurance regulations. She arrived at Admiralty Station at 9:00, smoothly transferred to the Island Line, and reached Wan Chai Station at 9:05.
location: MTR East Rail Line and Island Line (Hung Hom Station to Wan Chai Station), Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk to the office, buy coffee, and do morning preparations
description: Exiting Wan Chai Station from Exit A2, Yu Xiaowei walked about five minutes to AIA Building. Passing the Convention Plaza convenience store (1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District), she went in to buy a sugar-free hot latte and a whole-wheat biscuit as an energy boost. At 9:15 she swiped her card to enter AIA Building, went to her workstation, put down her things, and while turning on her computer, chatted with her early-arriving colleague Su Lishan, asking how her weekend had been. She then quickly tidied her desk and opened her email and customer management systems.
location: From the Convention Plaza convenience store (1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region) to AIA Building (1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Organize client files and call Mrs. Chen to confirm tomorrow's visit
description: Yu Xiaowei first spent 10 minutes handling several work emails and double-checked the information of her client Mrs. Chan to ensure all data and documents were accurate. At 9:35, she called Mrs. Chan using the landline, greeted her health and family in the tone of a familiar friend, confirmed the visit to Mrs. Chan's home in Taikoo Shing at 10 o'clock the next morning, and briefly explained the core advantages of the education savings rider. The call was pleasant, and Mrs. Chan welcomed the visit. After hanging up, Yu Xiaowei marked it on her calendar and organized the visit materials into her pending work briefcase.
location: AIA Building office (No. 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Morning client follow-up and administrative tasks.
description: Yu Xiaowei began handling her routine work. She first sorted out the needs analysis forms for several new clients, preliminarily matched product plans based on earlier communication, then updated the contact information in client files and replied to internal staff's inquiries about underwriting progress. At 11:00, she called a potential client, Mr. Lam, briefly greeted him, and arranged to discuss annuity insurance in detail next Thursday afternoon at the café in Shui On Centre near the company. From 11:30 to 12:15, she processed several reimbursement forms within the team and browsed the company's latest marketing materials.
location: AIA Building office (No. 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Lunch with colleague Su Lishan.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan walked about 13 minutes to the New Hennessy Café near the company. The two each ordered the set meal (Yu Xiaowei chose curry pork chop rice, and Su Lishan ordered satay beef instant noodles). They chatted about light topics while eating. Su Lishan shared the progress of the corporate group order she had been following up on, and Yu Xiaowei mentioned how smoothly it had gone contacting Mrs. Chen and Wang Qiming. They also exchanged weekend plans, and Yu Xiaowei mentioned her initial idea of spending the weekend with her family in Shenzhen. After finishing their meal at 13:10, they walked back to the office.
location: New Hennessy Café (6 O'Brien Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Adjusted and wrote the spring training plan in the afternoon
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei first did a few minutes of shoulder and neck stretching to shake off drowsiness and made a cup of lemon water. At 13:25, she created a new Word document and began the afternoon's dedicated task. Based on the details of her discussion with coach Zhao Zhiming and her notes in her phone memo, she organized the 12-week spring training plan into a written document, including the weekly training schedule (alternating running, yoga, and strength training), daily protein and carbohydrate intake suggestions, a reminder for the April road race registration, and race goals. When finished, she carefully proofread it, converted it to PDF, sent it to the coach via WeChat for confirmation, and saved a copy to her phone memo.
location: AIA Building office (No. 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Work wrap-up and preparation for tomorrow.
description: Yu Xiaowei reorganized Mrs. Chen's documents and placed them in the briefcase she would bring tomorrow. At 15:30, she called her client Mrs. Liu to remind her to bring her physical examination report on Monday and come to the company to discuss the new medical insurance plan. At 16:00, she started tidying her desk and filing documents. At 16:30, she sorted out the key tasks for the next day: visiting Mrs. Chen at 10 a.m., following up with Mrs. Liu in the afternoon, and noting Friday's internal team meeting. At 17:00, she turned off the computer, packed up her personal items, and got ready to leave work.
location: AIA Building office (No. 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Commuting home on the MTR after work
description: Yu Xiaowei left the office, walked to MTR Wan Chai Station, took the Island Line, and transferred to the East Rail Line at Admiralty Station toward Hung Hom Station. On the train, she did not handle work; instead, she put on earphones and listened to light music, shifting her mind and body from work mode to family mode. The train arrived at Hung Hom Station at 17:40. She walked about 15 minutes and returned home at Whampoa Garden at 17:45.
location: MTR Island Line and East Rail Line (Wan Chai Station to Hung Hom Station), Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Arrive home and reunite with family
description: As she pushed open the door, Yu Xiaowei smelled the aroma of her mother Chen Meiling cooking in the kitchen. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin heard the door and ran over from the living room, hugging her and calling her mom. She happily crouched down to hug her daughter and asked what she had learned at kindergarten. Her mother saw her return and smiled, telling her to get ready for dinner.
location: Home (328 Prince Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Relaxed family dinner
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming picked up their son Zhang Zixuan from school and came home, and the family sat around the dining table. Her mother had carefully prepared dishes such as steamed grouper and garlic stir-fried choy sum. During dinner, everyone shared the day's fun moments: her son proudly said he got full marks in math class, her daughter showed her painting, and Yu Xiaowei and her husband also exchanged small updates about their work. The atmosphere was warm and happy.
location: Home (328 Prince Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Evening homework tutoring and parent-child reading.
description: After dinner, her husband took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes, while Yu Xiaowei checked her son's math homework. She found he was stuck on the approach to a word problem, so she patiently guided him step by step until he fully understood. After finishing homework at 7:40 p.m., she went to the living room to accompany her daughter. They cuddled together on the sofa while she read her newly borrowed picture book, Little Rabbit and the Moon, to her daughter in a lively voice, finishing the whole story.
location: Home (328 Prince Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Evening Pilates and strength training
description: After the children went back to their rooms, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in the living room and followed a Keep video for a 30-minute mat Pilates session, focusing on strengthening the core muscles and hip stability. Sweat dampened the ends of her hair, but her body felt refreshed. Then she took out a 2 kg weight band and a small resistance band and completed a 5-minute beginner strength workout: 3 sets of weighted glute bridges and 4 sets of resistance band clamshells. She recorded the workout data with Keep.
location: Home (328 Prince Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Showering and late-night conversation between the couple
description: After exercising, Yu Xiaowei took a quick shower, changed into pajamas, and returned to the bedroom. Her husband was already in bed looking at his phone. She leaned beside him and shared how her day felt: the communication with Wang Qiming went smoothly, the spring training plan was fully organized, and everything was on track. Her husband smiled, comforted her, and patted her hand. The two chatted a bit more about their initial ideas for going to Shenzhen on the weekend, then said goodnight to each other.
location: Home (328 Prince Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Cantonese embroidery, skincare, and going to sleep
description: After her husband went to sleep first, Yu Xiaowei turned on the bedside lamp, took out her Cantonese embroidery to repair a nearly completed peony petal, and enjoyed the quiet time with each stitch. At 21:45 she put down the embroidery hoop and did her nighttime skincare: washing her face, applying toner, and applying night cream. Then she picked up One Hundred Years of Solitude and read a few pages, enjoying a peaceful moment of her own. At 22:00 she put down the book, set the alarm, and closed her eyes with satisfaction to fall asleep. Her weight was 54.9 kg, and her mood was relaxed.
location: Home (328 Prince Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Early in the morning, Yu Xiaowei got up briskly and first did some simple stretching by the living room window to wake up her body. Her mother Chen Meiling was already in the kitchen preparing breakfast, and the aroma drifted over. Xiaowei smiled and praised her, then went to wake up her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin, helped Xinxin put on her school uniform, and urged Xuanxuan to hurry up. The whole family then enjoyed the steaming hot century egg and lean pork congee, fried eggs, and pineapple buns that her mother had prepared. While drinking hot milk tea, Xiaowei checked Xuanxuan's schoolbag and reminded him to hand in the reply slip, while Xinxin excitedly shared a new nursery rhyme from kindergarten. Xiaowei watched the time and reminded everyone to speed up and get ready to go out.
location: At home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei held her daughter Zhang Yuxin's hand and walked from Whampoa Garden to the Kowloon City kindergarten. Along the way, Xinxin was especially happy and said she wanted to share the new stickers Mommy had bought with her classmates. Arriving at the kindergarten gate, Xiaowei squatted down and gave Xinxin a hug, watching her walk into the school campus, bouncing along with her little backpack, feeling very warm inside.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Commuting to the company.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei walked about eight minutes to MTR Hung Hom Station and took the train toward Admiralty to Wan Chai. The carriage was not too crowded. She took out her phone to double-check the information of client Mrs. Chen she was going to visit that day, silently rehearsed the presentation in her mind, and prepared for the upcoming meeting.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China, MTR Hung Hom Station to Wan Chai Station

name: Company check-in preparation and departure to the client's home
description: After arriving at the AIA Building office at 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Yu Xiaowei put down her handbag at her desk and made a cup of black tea. She ran into her colleague Su Lishan, who was eating breakfast, and they briefly talked about the day's arrangements. Shanshan asked with concern whether she was nervous; Xiaowei said she was fully prepared. She then turned on her computer for a final check, left the office early, walked to Wan Chai Station, took the MTR to Tai Koo Station, and on the train took one last look at the presentation file on her iPad to get into professional mode.
location: Office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China, and MTR from Wan Chai Station to Tai Koo Station

name: Visited the client Mrs. Chen and successfully closed the deal
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived on time at Mrs. Chen's home in Kam Din Terrace, Taikoo Shing. Mrs. Chen greeted her warmly, and the two first chatted about the recent lives of Mrs. Chen's two children, putting everyone at ease. Xiaowei then opened her iPad and explained in detail the education savings rider customized for Mrs. Chen, using the latest tuition figures from HKU and CUHK to demonstrate the savings growth effect and flexible education fund withdrawal plans, and patiently explained the premium waiver clause and the company's past dividend fulfillment rates, easing Mrs. Chen's worries about risks during the payment period. After nearly an hour of careful communication, Mrs. Chen finally signed with satisfaction. After signing, Xiaowei helped verify the details, completed the electronic signing and first premium transfer, issued a receipt on the spot, annotated the key terms one by one, and told Mrs. Chen to contact her anytime if she had questions. Mrs. Chen, touched, presented her with a box of Hokkaido White Lover chocolate. Xiaowei thanked her sincerely and left with a strong sense of achievement.
location: Mrs. Chen's home, Block X, Floor X, Kin Tai Terrace, Taikoo Shing, 8 Taikoo Shing Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Commute back to the office
description: After successfully closing the deal, Yu Xiaowei walked about 5 minutes from Taikoo Shing to Tai Koo Station and happily took the MTR back to Wan Chai. During the ride, she quickly jotted down key interview points in her phone memo app for later follow-up reports.
location: Hong Kong SAR, China, MTR from Tai Koo Station to Wan Chai Station

name: Lunch and entering insurance policies into the system.
description: Yu Xiaowei didn't go straight back to the company. Instead, she first went to Biaoji Wonton Noodles and packed a portion of fresh shrimp wonton noodles and vegetables, then returned to her office in the AIA Building. While eating lunch, she opened the company system and carefully entered Mrs. Chan's policy information item by item. When she saw that the system showed the insurance application had been submitted and was expected to take effect within about 2 hours, she let out a long sigh of relief. The first deal of the 2025 opening sales campaign was officially closed.
location: Mark’s Wonton Noodles at 119 Wan Chai Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China, and the office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road

name: Organize document filing and plan the afternoon.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei put Mrs. Chen's paper documents into a new client file folder and filed them away. In the CRM system, she noted in detail that the client's need was an education fund for her children and marked that critical illness upgrade could be followed up on later. Then she opened the file of the new client Huang Zhiqiang (Mr. Huang) — a potential client recommended by Mrs. Chen. Considering that the original plan was to visit him on the afternoon of January 10, she decided to send a carefully prepared email first so as to give Mr. Huang a professional, non-intrusive impression.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Email new client Huang Sheng
description: Yu Xiaowei spent 15 minutes writing a professional, well-phrased email thanking Mrs. Chen for her recommendation, introducing herself concisely, attaching the company profile and an electronic business card, and suggesting a phone call or in-person visit at 3 p.m. on Friday, January 10, asking if Huang Zhiqiang would be available. After sending the email, she also sent a similarly polite reminder message via WhatsApp as a backup.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Handle administrative tasks and share the good news with colleagues.
description: After handling the backlog of emails and client inquiries, Yu Xiaowei couldn't resist sharing the details of the signed contract with her colleague Su Lishan. Shanshan excitedly patted her shoulder and congratulated her, insisting that she treat them to a meal. Xiaowei laughed and agreed, then continued updating the CRM system and planning the next day's work schedule. During this time, she also ordered a takeout coffee for herself as a reward.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Afternoon tea break and socializing
description: Su Lishan took Yu Xiaowei to the Shui On Centre Café downstairs to celebrate. Xiaowei ordered a latte and shared with Shanshan the takeaways from today's client meetings, especially how to win over clients with data. The two then talked about weekend plans. Xiaowei asked Shanshan whether she wanted to join next Sunday's half-marathon training run, and Shanshan said she would consider it.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Return to the office and continue working.
description: After returning to her desk, Yu Xiaowei focused on the remaining work: drafted a memo for reminding client Mrs. Liu about her medical check-up next Monday, sorted out the list of clients to visit tomorrow afternoon, and put together a content outline for visiting Mr. Huang next Friday, efficiently completing the afternoon's planning and preparation.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: After-work commute
description: Punched out on time at 17:00, Yu Xiaowei walked to Wan Chai Station in a relaxed mood and took the MTR back to Whampoa Garden. During the ride, she put on her earphones and listened to soothing Cantonese songs, and the excitement of the day gradually settled into a fulfilling calm.
location: From MTR Wan Chai Station to Hung Hom Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Return home to share the good news and participate in dinner preparation.
description: Pushing open the door, the aroma of food greeted her. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin was the first to run over and hug Yu Xiaowei's legs, and her son Zhang Zixuan also poked his head out of the room. Xiaowei picked up Xinxin and loudly announced that she had signed a big deal today. Her mother, Chen Meiling, happily decided in the kitchen to add a dish for dinner—ginger and scallion stir-fried crab. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, also rarely looked up from his newspaper and nodded with a smile. Xiaowei shared the chocolate given by Mrs. Chen with the children, and the home was filled with laughter. Then she changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen to help her mother, washing and cutting vegetables while describing in detail the meeting with Mrs. Chen. Her mother listened with great pleasure. The dining table was already set with signature dishes such as soy sauce chicken, char siu, and blanched choy sum.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Family celebration dinner
description: Zhang Weiming also came home from work, and the dinner atmosphere was warm and lively. Her mother served green radish and carrot pork bone soup. Ming opened a treasured bottle of red wine to celebrate Xiaowei's successful career, and the children presented a drawing of a supermom. The whole family raised their glasses to toast Xiaowei. She took a small sip of red wine and, in a slight buzz, felt thoroughly happy and moved.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, home dining room.

name: Parent-child time: helping with homework and reading picture books.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei first helped her son Zhang Zixuan finish his math homework, patiently explaining fraction division. When he solved a difficult problem, she patted his head to encourage him. Then she bathed her daughter Zhang Yuxin, carried her to bed, read her “Guess How Much I Love You”, and Xinxin soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China: the son's room and the daughter's room.

name: Late-night conversation between husband and wife
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei carried a glass of warm water to the balcony, where her husband Zhang Weiming was standing looking at the night view. The two leaned side by side on the railing and chatted softly. Xiaowei thanked her husband for his continued support of the family, and Mingzai said he fully supported her. They talked about the details of the signed deal and also planned to take the family to a country park on the weekend.
location: Balcony at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Personal relaxation: Cantonese embroidery and washing up
description: Back in the living room, Yu Xiaowei took out the peony Cantonese embroidery frame she had been working on for more than half a month, and under the desk lamp she embroidered attentively for half an hour. Stitch by stitch, the day's busyness and joy slowly settled, and her mind returned to calm. After finishing, she went to the bathroom contentedly to shower and do her skincare routine.
location: The living room and bathroom at home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: Lying in bed, Yu Xiaowei picked up One Hundred Years of Solitude from the nightstand and flipped through a few pages. Although the day had been fulfilling, she still felt a little excited, and her thoughts drifted to tomorrow and the weekend. She put down the book, turned off the light, and took deep breaths to calm herself before soon falling into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Waking up, morning family interaction, and breakfast
description: She woke up at 7:00 on the dot, drank a glass of warm water, and noticed the sky outside was gloomy. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was already up; the aroma of pork bone soup with green radish and carrot wafted from the kitchen, and she had a bowl to warm herself up. She then woke her daughter Zhang Yuxin and son Zhang Zixuan, helped Xinxin tie her hair, and reminded Xuanxuan to check his schoolbag. On the balcony, she confirmed the drop-off and pick-up arrangement with her husband Zhang Weiming, who was hanging out the laundry: he would take Xuanxuan to school, and she would take Xinxin to kindergarten. For breakfast, her mother brought out fried eggs, toast, and fresh milk. As she ate, she replied to her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng’s message from last night, confirming that he would return to Hong Kong next Wednesday and agreeing to have tea on the weekend. After eating, she checked the drawing the children had made on the refrigerator to celebrate the signed deal, and felt warm at heart. She packed her commuting bag with proposal materials, business cards, and product brochures.
location: Home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 12 Whampoa Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Take daughter to school and walk to Lok Fu MTR Station
description: Holding her daughter Xinxin's hand, she walked to Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten. On the way, she bought her a box of blueberries at a convenience store. At the school gate, she crouched down to adjust Xinxin's collar and told her to eat well and take a nap today. After watching the teacher lead her into the classroom, she took a photo of the flower beds at the entrance and sent it to the family group. Then she left the kindergarten and walked along Junction Road for about 20 minutes to Lok Fu MTR station. On the way, she used her phone to reply to client Mrs. Liu's WeChat message, reminding her to submit her medical examination report at the clinic before 10:30 next Monday, and confirmed the time.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, and en route to Lok Fu MTR Station.

name: Commute to the office by MTR
description: She entered at Lok Fu Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok East Station, then transferred to the East Rail Line to Wan Chai Station. The train was crowded, so she stood by the door, put on earphones, and listened to light music while silently going over the framework of the critical illness insurance plan she would present to her client today. After exiting the station, she walked to AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, and bought a hot Americano at the convenience store downstairs (Convention Plaza Convenience Store).
location: From Hong Kong's Lok Fu MTR Station to Wan Chai MTR Station, East Rail Line.

name: Focused on tailoring a critical illness insurance plan.
description: Arrived at the 20th-floor office of AIA Building, turned on the computer, pulled up the information of client Chen Meiling, who signed the contract yesterday, and sorted out her thoughts on family protection. In the system, retrieved client Mr. Huang's needs questionnaire, family income structure, and existing policy data; used Excel to build a premium calculation model; referred to the company's latest critical illness product brochure; and gradually refined a personalized proposal: an annual premium of HK$15,000, covering 5 child-specific diseases, with an additional premium waiver clause. Around 11:30, printed out a draft of the proposal and marked three details to be confirmed, such as the premium payment term options, with a red pen, and took a photo as a reminder.
location: Office, 20th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Midday break, lunch with colleagues, and walk back
description: Work came to a pause for the moment. She got up, went to the pantry to add hot water, ate two pieces of soda crackers she had brought, and stretched her neck and shoulders. Colleague Su Lishan sent a message inviting her to lunch. The two walked 5 minutes to New Shanghai Kitchen Roast Meat Shop at 139 Wan Chai Road and ordered roast goose with BBQ pork rice, a plate of choy sum, and two bowls of daily soup. During the meal, Su Lishan shared communication tips for following up on family policies, such as using 'protect the main breadwinner first' as an entry point. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes and agreed to try a class at the newly opened 'Pure Yoga' near the office next week. After lunch, they strolled back to the office, passing a newly opened bakery called 'Wheat Bakery' on Lockhart Road. Su Lishan said she wanted to try it on the weekend, and Yu Xiaowei smiled and made a note. Back in the office, she rinsed her mouth and prepared for the afternoon's work.
location: The 20th-floor pantry of AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, and the roast meat shop New Shanghai Kitchen, 139 Wan Chai Road

name: Afternoon work: refine proposals and communicate with clients
description: After sitting back down, she opened the proposal file from the morning and, based on Mr. Huang's situation, added a detailed calculation for a “premium waiver clause,” along with insurance recommendations and precautions. Around 15:00, she received a screenshot of the medical check-up appointment from client Mrs. Liu. She replied to confirm receipt and reminded her to check her personal information before submitting. Afterwards, she prepared the document package for tomorrow's visit to Mr. Huang, including the formal proposal, insurance application form, business card, and a handwritten thank-you card template.
location: Office, 20th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Rest before the end of the workday and preparation for the commute.
description: After completing the core work, she got up to get water, walked to the window to look out at the Wan Chai street scene, and let her eyes rest for a moment. Returning to her seat, she tidied the files on her desk, put tomorrow's material pack into a kraft paper bag, and stuck a note reading 'Visit Mr. Huang on January 10.' She saw the good-morning message from her close friend Lin Jiaxin on her phone and replied with a heart emoji. Then she packed her commuter bag, left the office right at 17:00, and walked to Wan Chai MTR station while messaging her husband to let him know she was off work and might be home late in the evening.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, and the entrance to Wan Chai MTR Station

name: Commuted home on the MTR.
description: At Wan Chai Station, she took the East Rail line to Hung Hom Station. Sitting in her seat, she opened the "Run Bar" WeChat official account, saved a few shoulder-and-neck relaxation stretches, and replied to her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's WeChat, arranging to go for dim sum at "Yu Yan" at 10 a.m. next Saturday.
location: MTR East Rail line from Wan Chai MTR Station to Hung Hom MTR Station, Hong Kong

name: Rest at home, family interaction, and dinner
description: After arriving home, she changed into home clothes and saw her daughter Xinxin playing with building blocks on the play mat and her son Xuanxuan doing homework at the dining table. After greeting her mother, she picked up Xuanxuan's exercise book to check it, found a slip in a math problem, and patiently guided him to correct it. Her husband Zhang Weiming was preparing cold dishes in the kitchen; she walked over, hugged him from behind, and softly said he was the one working hard tonight. The whole family sat around the table to eat. Her mother had made dried-vegetable pork bone soup, stir-fried celery with lily bulbs, and steamed fish. Halfway through the meal, the phone rang. It was from Xuanxuan's homeroom teacher, Teacher Chen. She went to the balcony to answer and learned that the school had issued a last-minute notice for a parent-teacher meeting at 7:00 tonight to arrange end-of-term activities, requiring a parent to attend. After agreeing, she walked back to the table, explained the situation, quickly finished eating, and reminded her husband to take the children to wash up and read picture books after dinner.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (12 Whampoa Street).

name: Get ready and leave for the parent-teacher meeting.
description: Put on a light jacket, check that the phone has enough battery, briefly tell her husband to remember to have Xinxin brush her teeth before bed and that she would check Xuanxuan's homework before going to sleep, kiss both children on the foreheads, and leave. At the entrance to the residential complex, she hailed a taxi and told the driver to go to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, about a 12-minute ride. Sitting in the back seat browsing her Moments feed, she liked the lunch photo Su Lishan had posted and replied with a drooling emoji, silently noting that the materials for visiting Mr. Huang tomorrow were ready.
location: On the way from the Whampoa Garden residential estate in Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School

name: Attended the parent-teacher meeting for her son's class.
description: Entered the third-grade classroom on the third floor of Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and checked in, then sat down in her son Xuanxuan's seat. The homeroom teacher, Ms. Chen, first announced the end-of-term activity arrangements (January 15 campus open day, January 20 class party), then focused on feedback about the children's study habits this semester and suggestions for the winter vacation. She took careful notes. After the meeting, she had a brief one-on-one exchange with Ms. Chen about Xuanxuan's concentration in class, and Ms. Chen suggested encouraging him more to raise his hand and speak up.
location: Grade 3 classroom, 3rd floor, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, 7 Suffolk Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: After the parent-teacher meeting, took a taxi home and talked with family.
description: The parent-teacher meeting ended around 8:15. After saying goodbye to a few mothers she knew well, she took another taxi back to Hung Hom from the school gate, a ride of about 10 minutes. When she got to the building, she stopped by the convenience store and bought a box of plain yogurt. When she walked in, her daughter had already changed into pajamas and was curled up in her husband's arms watching cartoons. She asked and learned that Xuanxuan had finished his homework and Xinxin had brushed her teeth. She kissed both children, then told Xinxin a short story, Little Bear Looks for Honey.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and the living room of the home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom (12 Whampoa Street)

name: Evening stretching and relaxation
description: Changed into yoga clothes, spread the yoga mat in the living room, opened the 15-minute relaxation sequence on her phone, including neck and shoulder stretches, hamstring stretches, and Cat-Cow pose. She did the moves while breathing deeply and felt the fatigue of the whole day slowly melt away. Afterward, she drank the carton of plain yogurt and noted in her phone memo, “Today's stretching done.”
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate (12 Whampoa Street), Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Prepared the materials pack for tomorrow's visits
description: From the kraft paper bag, she took out all the materials for tomorrow's visit to Mr. Huang, and rechecked the proposal, insurance application form, product brochure, and business cards. She wrote a short thank-you card to Mr. Huang and tucked it into the first page of the proposal, thanking him for his trust. Then she put the document folder into her commuter bag, confirmed she would not forget it when going out tomorrow, and also replied to the family policy communication template link sent by Su Lishan, expressing thanks.
location: Study at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 12 Whampoa Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Evening conversation with husband and family communication
description: She found her husband Zhang Weiming getting some air on the bedroom balcony. They sat down side by side, sharing the sense of fulfillment from today's progress on the plan and complaining about how the impromptu parent-teacher meeting had disrupted the rhythm. Her husband comforted her, expressed full support, and also mentioned that he would join the morning tea with her younger brother next week. They briefly confirmed the time of their daughter's ballet class on Saturday (9:00–9:45 a.m.) and agreed to head straight to Shenzhen after class.
location: Home bedroom balcony, Whampoa Garden residential estate (12 Whampoa Street), Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Washing up and idle WeChat voice chat.
description: While washing up, she sent a voice message to her close friend Lin Jiaxin, sharing the progress of the customized plan for Mr. Huang today and how cute her daughter's drawing was, and asking if she was free to get together on the weekend. She brushed her teeth, applied skincare products, changed into pajamas, and set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate (12 Whampoa Street), Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Before-bed review and reading
description: Leaning against the headboard, she flipped through a couple of pages of One Hundred Years of Solitude, but drowsiness came over her and she closed the book. Reflecting on today: work made new progress, the family had a good soup, and she attended the child's parent-teacher conference... She felt fulfilled and warm inside. She turned off the light and fell asleep within about 10 minutes, sleeping peacefully.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate (12 Whampoa Street), Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6:50 in the morning the alarm went off. She did cat and child stretches in bed to wake up her body. Then she went to the living room mirror to check her complexion, drank warm lemon honey water, put on her sports watch, and quietly left the house so as not to disturb her sleeping family.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Morning run and breakfast grocery shopping
description: Jogged in the residential estate garden for 35 minutes at a pace of about 6:20/km, enjoying the cool morning air. After the run, dropped by New Shanghai Kitchen on the way, used the mobile app membership points to redeem a pineapple bun and iced milk tea, and paid out of pocket to pack fresh shrimp rice rolls as breakfast for her mother.
location: New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese restaurant at 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Returned home, washed up, and helped with family
description: After handing breakfast to her mother, she took a quick shower and changed into professional attire: a light blue shirt with dark gray trousers, and applied light makeup. Her husband Zhang Weiming had already prepared their son Xuanxuan's schoolbag and checked their daughter Xinxin's ballet costume. She braided Xinxin's hair while using a WeChat voice message to remind her client Mrs. Liu to bring her medical check-up report next Monday so that she could draft a preliminary plan.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Take her daughter to kindergarten.
description: Her husband drove their son to primary school, while Yu Xiaowei walked hand in hand with Xinxin to kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin shared a story she liked. At the school gate, she chatted with the homeroom teacher, Teacher Li, about how Xinxin had been adjusting recently, and replied to a message from her son’s homeroom teacher about concentration issues, saying that she had discussed it with her husband and would fully cooperate.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute to company

name: Refining the savings and insurance plan

She created a new folder named '2025 Family Finance' on her computer and recorded the resolutions discussed tonight item by item: she made a new monthly savings plan table and set a reminder to execute the HKD 8,000 automatic transfer starting from February; in her to-do list she wrote 'Next Monday (January 20): organize insurance policy documents and discuss products with colleagues,' and set a reminder.
location: Study room, Unit B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: After completing all the desk work, Yu Xiaowei felt stiffness in her neck, shoulders, and hips. She laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of Hatha yoga, focusing on relaxing her spine and relieving soreness in her hips and legs, including poses such as Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, and Child's Pose. When she finished, her body and mind felt stretched and relaxed.
location: Living room, Flat B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Afterwards, she lay in bed with her husband Zhang Weiming and recapped the day's events, especially Brother Hua's hint about a promotion. Mingzai held her hand and said, 'You did really well, I'll support you.' This made Yu Xiaowei feel very reassured. She also noted her mood in her phone memo and decided to start thinking about small Lunar New Year gifts for clients tomorrow, perhaps customizing red envelopes with Cantonese embroidery elements.

name: Waking up, morning routine, and family breakfast.
description: Yu Xiaowei was woken by her alarm. She first checked the weather (cloudy with fog, 15-18°C) and recorded her weight as 54.6 kg, then browsed work group messages and client messages, confirming there were no urgent matters. After a quick wash, she went to the dining room, where Mom had prepared plain congee, rice rolls, and scrambled eggs. While eating breakfast, she chatted with Dad, who was reading the newspaper, about the finance meeting last night. The atmosphere was relaxed.

Then she split the school run with her husband Weiming: Weiming drove Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, while she walked Xinxin, holding her hand, to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten. After hugging goodbye at the kindergarten gate, she walked 3 minutes to Sung Wong Toi MTR Station.

name: Commuting to the office
description: Took the MTR from Sung Wong Toi station to Wan Chai. Despite the crowded carriage, Yu Xiaowei put on her earphones and browsed financial news and industry updates. About 35 minutes later she arrived at Wan Chai station, then walked about 10 minutes along Gloucester Road to reach the AIA Building office.
location: From Sung Wong Toi MTR Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Wan Chai MTR Station, Wan Chai District, then walk to AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District

description: After arriving at the office, Yu Xiaowei confirmed that client Mr. Huang's critical illness insurance policy had taken effect, printed the confirmation letter, and prepared to send it; after checking Mrs. Chen's education insurance contract, she arranged courier delivery. She then made quarterly phone follow-up calls to two long-term clients, one of whom mentioned wanting to arrange insurance for his newborn grandson. She recorded the needs in detail and scheduled a detailed discussion for next week.

description: Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan went to the yoga studio in Shui On Centre and completed a 45-minute vinyasa flow yoga session focused on opening the hips and shoulders and back, feeling relaxed in body and mind. After class, the two had a quick lunch at the cha chaan teng downstairs, ordering satay beef instant noodles. While eating, they discussed the possibility of Yu Xiaowei being promoted to regional deputy manager. Su Lishan shared her experience and encouraged her to go for it. After lunch, Yu Xiaowei replied to her husband Weiming on WeChat, confirming that she would buy vegetables after work, and Su Lishan returned to the office first.
location: Yoga studio and basement Hong Kong-style café inside Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon office work and conference call
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei organized the materials for the next day's visit to the boss of the trading company, and called Guo Junwei, an actuarial colleague at the Guangzhou branch. She spent 15 minutes confirming the actuarial logic of a new product regarding coverage scope and cash value growth, in preparation for discussing it with her husband in the evening. Then she handled the remaining emails, gave her supervisor Liang Zhenhua a brief work report, and explained that she would leave early.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Return trip and supermarket shopping
description: At 15:00, she left the office on time, walked to Wan Chai Station, took the MTR to Hung Hom Station, and then walked to the Whampoa New Town shopping mall. At ParknShop supermarket, she quickly bought watercress, tomatoes, and lemons according to her mother's list, then walked home.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Wan Chai MTR Station to Kowloon City District, Hung Hom MTR Station, and ParknShop supermarket at the Whampoa New Town shopping mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District

name: Finishing the Cantonese embroidery Peony Painting
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei made a cup of tea and sat down in the study. She took out the nearly finished 'Peony' embroidery and, comparing it with the original draft, used a fine needle to patiently repair the edges of the petals. After finishing, she took a photo, ready to send it to Teacher Wu to ask about the next step in color matching.
