description: Yu Xiaowei went to the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables and set the tableware. Weiming picked Xuanxuan up from school, and her father picked up Xinxin. She listened to Xuanxuan talk about the funny moments in his math quiz and to Xinxin sing the nursery rhyme she had just learned. The family shared her mother's signature roast meat platter and watercress soup. The atmosphere at the table was warm; she praised Xuanxuan for his improvement on the quiz and fed Xinxin her favorite char siu. After dinner, she helped Xuanxuan finish his homework and signed it, told Xinxin, after her bath, the story of "The Little Mermaid," and then cleaned up the table and dishes with Weiming.
location: Home kitchen, dining room, and living room in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Refine the insurance adjustment plan with her husband.
description: After the children went to bed, Yu Xiaowei and Wei Ming sat at the desk in the bedroom, took out the new product materials and all policy documents, and analyzed them item by item together with their previous notes. Wei Ming calculated the cash flows and rates of return of different options, and finally sorted out three adjustments: increasing Wei Ming's savings life insurance, adding critical illness coverage for Xinxin, and optimizing the education fund plan. They also compiled five questions to consult Bank Manager Li over the weekend.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening personal time and going to bed
description: After taking a quick shower, Yu Xiaowei set aside tomorrow's commute jacket and Xinxin's craft homework in their proper places. Then she did core activation exercises such as planks and glute bridges on her yoga mat in the bedroom. Resting by the bed, she checked the weekend LSD route that Shen Peiwen had shared in the running group, and sent a photo of the Peony Painting to Teacher Wu to ask for advice on color matching. Then she put down her phone, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning Hatha yoga stretching
description: After drinking a glass of warm water on an empty stomach, Yu Xiaowei began a 10-minute Hatha yoga stretch on the bedroom carpet. She practiced a simplified Sun Salutation sequence, focusing on breath and postures, and completed forward fold, plank, cobra, and other poses. Her body gradually loosened up, her mind awakened with the morning light, and she stored up energy for a busy day.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Getting the children ready for school and coordinating duties with her husband.
description: Xiaowei tiptoed into the children's room and checked her son Zhang Zixuan's schoolbag to make sure homework and water bottle were neatly in place, as well as her daughter Zhang Yuxin's kindergarten supplies—change of clothes and small towel. In the kitchen she had a brief conversation with her husband Zhang Weiming: she would be home all day today; Weiming would take Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and pick him up after school; her mother Chen Meiling would walk Xinxin to kindergarten at 8:30. She thanked her husband for his support and reminded him to watch out for the light rain on the way.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Xiaowei enjoyed breakfast with her mother Chen Meiling and father Yu Guoqiang at the restaurant. Her mother prepared Hong Kong-style milk tea, fried eggs, and cereal. While eating, they talked about today's plan — after finishing the Cantonese embroidery, she would go to Sham Shui Po to visit Teacher Wu. Her father reminded her that it might rain in the afternoon, and Xiaowei noted "bring an umbrella" and "ask Manager Li 5 questions on the weekend" in her phone memo.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Finished the Yue embroidery Peony Painting, took photos, and tidied up tools.
description: Xiaowei spread the Cantonese embroidery Peony Painting on the study desk for final finishing. After putting on her thimble, she carefully checked the stitching of every petal and leaf in natural light. At the two loose stitches where the main peony petals met the leaves, she reinforced them with fine, dense stitches, and used matte-colored thread to add layering to the center of the stamens, making the whole peony more three-dimensional and full. After finishing around 10:45, she moved to the balcony in natural light and photographed the embroidery from multiple angles—front, oblique, and close-up details—with her phone. She then carefully placed the work into a dedicated embroidery storage bag, returned to the study, tidied the needle and thread box, trimmed thread ends, wiped down the embroidery hoop, and cleaned the scraps and thread bits from the tabletop. Finally, she sent a photo of the storage bag to the family group chat with the message: "After a month, my 'treasure' is finished! I'm going to the teacher's this afternoon."
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Homemade light lunch and briefly handling work messages
description: Xiaowei took the washed lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers out of the fridge, cut them into pieces, mixed them with vinaigrette to make a vegetable salad, and paired it with sliced chicken breast that had been pre-roasted last night and warmed up this morning. While eating, she opened WeChat on her phone and quickly scanned work group messages: her colleague Su Lishan sent a photo of a healthy meal, and she replied, "Same light meal"; a client, Mrs. Chen, left a message thanking her for the contract sent yesterday, and she replied, "You're welcome, feel free to contact me anytime if you have questions." After a quick look, she continued enjoying her lunch, strictly following her spring light-diet plan.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Visit Teacher Wu Xiuying
description: Xiaowei changed into a dark gray knit top and casual pants, took her embroidered bag featuring "Peony," notebook, and umbrella, and left home at 12:20. She walked to Whampoa Station, took the MTR Tuen Ma Line to Ho Man Tin Station, transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Prince Edward Station, and then walked to Wu Xiuying's Cantonese embroidery studio on Lai Chi Kok Road. She showed Teacher Wu the completed "Peony" piece. Teacher Wu put on her reading glasses and examined it carefully, praising the dense stitching of the flower stamens and the natural transitions, especially the three-dimensional texture of the leaf veins, but pointed out that the color where the leaf bottoms joined the flower stem was too dark and suggested touching it up with a slightly brighter light ochre. Xiaowei carefully recorded the suggestions. The two exchanged ideas about composition and color for about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Teacher Wu also showed her new work "Lotus Pond Delight" and shared its concept. Xiaowei felt inspired and agreed to come back and study at the beginning of next month.
location: Wu Xiuying Guangdong Embroidery Studio, Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong SAR (near Po Fung Building)

name: On the way back, stopped at the supermarket to buy fresh produce.
description: After saying goodbye to Teacher Wu, Xiaowei bought two fresh egg tarts downstairs from the studio to bring home as an afternoon snack for the children. She took the Kwun Tong Line from Prince Edward Station to Ho Man Tin Station, then walked to ParknShop in Whampoa Square. Along the way, a light rain began to fall, so she put up her umbrella. At the supermarket, she picked out fresh asparagus, broccoli, strawberries, and lemons, and bought a bag of organic pasta for the weekend family meals. After checkout, she carried her shopping bags and walked home.
location: ParknShop, The Whampoa Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to rest and helped her mother prepare dinner ingredients
description: After Xiaowei got home, she put the fruits and vegetables into the refrigerator by category, placed the egg tarts on the dining table, told her mother they could be the children's afternoon tea, and hung up the embroidered bag with the Peony Painting to keep it from being crushed. After a short rest, her mother came back from the market with a sea bass and half a chicken. Xiaowei tied on an apron and started helping: she broke the broccoli into small florets, rinsed the asparagus, and cut it into diagonal pieces; her mother cleaned the scales and innards of the fish. The mother and daughter chatted about everyday things while they worked. Her mother mentioned that Xuan Xuan had been a bit careless with his math homework, so Xiaowei decided to go over it with him in the evening. She also asked if they could make steamed sea bass, and her mother readily agreed, so she helped by cutting ginger into slivers and chopping scallions.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Family leisure and returning home with the children.
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming picked up Xuanxuan and also brought Xinxin back (the mother had already picked her up earlier). The whole family rested in the living room. Xiaowei brought out strawberries and egg tarts as snacks for the children and asked Xuanxuan about school; he excitedly mentioned the relay race in physical education class. Xinxin ran over with the Swan Lake picture book and pulled her mother to read it together. Xiaowei fed Xinxin strawberries while listening to the children chatter, feeling warm inside.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: Xiaowei returned to the kitchen to continue preparing the meal: her mother was in charge of steaming the sea bass and stir-frying the chicken, while she stir-fried broccoli and garlic asparagus, and cut lemon into the soup to make a clear asparagus and lemon soup. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, took the initiative to set out the bowls and chopsticks. Dinner included steamed sea bass, white cut chicken, garlic broccoli, stir-fried asparagus, and lemon clear soup. At the table, Xiaowei announced that the "Peony Painting" was finished and had been praised by her teacher. Weiming raised a toast to congratulate her. Xuanxuan proactively shared a difficult problem he had solved in math class and was praised by his father; Xinxin begged her mother to tell a ballet story, and Xiaowei smiled and agreed, hinting that there would be a surprise on the weekend. The whole family enjoyed a harmonious atmosphere.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Accompany Xuanxuan with homework and check the math assignment
description: After dinner, Xiaowei cleared the dishes and handed them to her mother, then took Xuanxuan to the study. She first checked that all homework was complete, then focused on the math workbook. She found that the units in a multiplication word problem were written incorrectly. Instead of scolding him, she patiently guided Xuanxuan to read the problem again. Xuanxuan found and corrected the mistake himself. She also spot-checked the mistake notebook from previous days, confirmed that he had mastered the solution, and encouraged him: 'Tomorrow is the midterm exam. Getting everything you know right is already progress.'
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Told Xinxin the story of "Swan Lake"
description: After washing up, Xiaowei changed into pajamas and sat by Xinxin's bed. Holding the Swan Lake picture book, Xinxin begged her mother to tell the story of The White Swan. Xiaowei turned the pages and imitated different characters, telling the story of the prince and Odette in a gentle voice. Xinxin was fascinated and asked whether they could go see real swans dance on the weekend. Xiaowei nodded in confirmation, then kissed Xinxin's forehead, turned off the light, and coaxed her to sleep. Around 20:15, Xinxin fell asleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

She sent a photo of "Peony Painting" to share her joy in visiting their teacher. After observing closely, He Meiling praised the elegant color scheme and suggested collaborating on a Year of the Tiger theme in the second half of the year, pairing tigers with auspicious clouds and bamboo leaves. The two discussed the tiger fur stitch technique in depth, including silk thread color mixing and silk-like finishing, and agreed to connect again next Wednesday to discuss the line draft.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Buy online tickets for the ballet Swan Lake performance.
description: Xiaowei opened the Hong Kong Cultural Centre website, searched for the performance of Swan Lake by the Russian Ballet on Saturday, January 18, chose the 3 PM show, and selected four consecutive seats in the middle of the third row from the seating chart, at HK$650 each, for a total of HK$2,600. After confirming the time and seats with her husband Zhang Weiming, she completed the payment, took a screenshot of the successful ticket purchase page, and sent it to the family group chat with the message: "Saturday 3 PM, Cultural Centre! Pay attention to the departure time." She then saved the ticket collection QR code to her phone album.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Discuss weekend plans with her husband.
description: Xiaowei and Weiming briefly discussed weekend plans: on Saturday afternoon, after the whole family had an early lunch, they would take a taxi to the Hong Kong Cultural Centre at around 14:00 to watch ballet; on Sunday, Weiming would take Xuanxuan to Sha Tin for cycling, while Xiaowei would go running by herself in the morning and on the way stop by the bank to consult Manager Li about the insurance adjustment plan (5 questions already saved in her memo). Weiming expressed support and reminded her that there might still be light rain over the weekend. The two also talked about Xuanxuan's recent progress in math and felt very gratified.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Evening washing up, relaxation, and going to bed

She applied eye cream and moisturizer, then brushed her teeth, spread her yoga mat on the bedroom carpet for a 5-minute bedtime yoga routine: first Butterfly Pose to open her hips, then lying on her back with both knees dropped to one side for a reclined twist, one minute on each side, and finally Child's Pose with arms extended forward, eyes closed, focusing on breathing and feeling the stretch in her lower back and spine. Reviewing her fulfilling day—her embroidery finished, the teacher's approval, the children's homework going smoothly, and tickets already bought for the weekend activity—she felt content. She lay back on the bed, scrolled her phone to check the route to Swan Lake, and messaged her good friend Shen Peiwen on WeChat: "Ballet on Saturday afternoon; how about a morning run next week?" She confirmed tomorrow morning's alarm at 6:45, put her phone on silent, and was asleep with the lights off before 23:00.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Flat B

name: Morning yoga and strength training

She then completed 3 sets of modified planks and 15 glute bridges, avoiding further muscle fatigue, and prepared for the day's activities.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Around 7:10, she gently called her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin to get up, checked their schoolbags, textbooks, water bottles, and homework, reminded Xuanxuan that he had a quiz next week, and encouraged him to go to bed early. Her husband Zhang Weiming also shared the tasks.

On the way, Xinxin excitedly mentioned seeing Swan Lake on the weekend. After watching her enter the school gate, Xiaowei turned and walked back to the estate to take the MTR.

She called her client Mrs. Chen to confirm the renewal payment arrangement for the education insurance and answer questions about dividends, then organized and filed the client materials left unfinished yesterday. In the pantry, she ran into her colleague Su Lishan, and they briefly exchanged thoughts about being promoted to regional deputy manager and encouraged each other.

Her mother readily agreed and laughingly wished them a good time.

location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

After the meal, they walked for a few minutes before returning to the office.

They shared recent worries and funny stories, teased and encouraged each other, and kept laughing.

At 17:45, Xiaowei arrived on time at the agreed main entrance and met up with her husband Zhang Weiming, who had just gotten off work and looked slightly tired but had gentle eyes. After a brief hug, Zhang Weiming naturally took the shopping bags.

During the meal, Zhang Weiming encouraged Xiaowei to make a push for promotion to deputy manager and shared his recent work situation. Xiaowei talked about Xinxin's love for ballet skirts and Xuanxuan's progress on tests. The two also planned next month's financial arrangements and finalized the meeting time and dinner place for watching Swan Lake tomorrow.

They walked side by side, enjoyed the night view, and recalled their dating scenes there. Zhang Weiming once again promised to arrange at least one date just for the two of them each month. Xiaowei suggested that after returning home tomorrow evening, they should together invite Manager Li from the bank to consult on the details of the insurance adjustment plan.

On the way, Xiaowei checked her phone and confirmed a message from her mother saying, "The children are settled in," which made her feel much more at ease.
