name: Family time after returning home
description: After arriving home, her mother Chen Meiling was still waiting in the living room. Xiaowei sincerely thanked her for her hard work and showed her the ballet dress she had bought for Xinxin; her mother was full of praise. Then Xiaowei tiptoed into the children's bedroom, checked on them as they slept soundly, and tucked in the corners of their blankets. Afterward, she and Zhang Weiming returned to the master bedroom. Lying in bed, they quietly savored the day and discussed plans for dinner after watching the ballet tomorrow.
location: Home living room and bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Xiaowei took a quick shower, did her routine skincare, and ironed the shirt Zhang Weiming would wear tomorrow. Lying in bed, she set tomorrow morning's alarm on her phone and checked the weekend weather forecast.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to bed and rest
description: After turning off the lights, Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming exchanged a few quiet words in the dark, sharing the most touching moments of the evening. In a happy, contented mood and with anticipation for the next day's performance, they gradually fell asleep and were sound asleep before 23:00.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning recovery run.
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her running shoes and sportswear, set out from her home in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, jogged along Prince Edward Road West to Kowloon Tsai Park and then turned back, completing 5 kilometers at an easy recovery-run pace, keeping the pace at about 6 minutes/km to help relieve muscle tightness after the half marathon. After the run, she rehydrated at the drinking fountain at the park entrance and walked home.
location: The area around Prince Edward Road West and Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family interaction and grooming preparations.
description: After showering, Yu Xiaowei changed into a professional suit, drank a glass of warm water, and ate half a banana to replenish energy. She reminded her daughter Zhang Yuxin, who had just gotten up, to rest early because they would be watching ballet at the Cultural Center tonight. She also discussed the dinner arrangements with her mother Chen Meiling, telling her that she would take the children out to celebrate tonight and asking her not to prepare dinner.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Metro commute and listening to an insurance podcast
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR East Rail Line from Hung Hom Station to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she put on her earphones and listened to an insurance industry podcast, replaying the latest interpretation of the Greater Bay Area insurance interconnection policy. She noted down a few key points to use in tomorrow's training cases.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, MTR East Rail line and Island line train compartments (from Hung Hom Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Morning office work: renewal processing and client follow-up calls
description: After arriving at the AIA Building office in Wan Chai, Yu Xiaowei first logged into the computer system to process renewal procedures for three client education insurance policies. She then proactively called an existing client, Mrs. Chen, for a quarterly policy follow-up, confirming that she was very satisfied with the children's education plan configured last month, and carefully noted her inquiry about withdrawal methods. After the call, she organized Mrs. Chen's needs into a memo and planned to prepare a detailed cash flow presentation for her next week.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch chat with colleague Su Lishan.
description: Yu Xiaowei had lunch with her colleague Su Lishan at the café in Shui On Centre near the office, ordering the signature pineapple bun and iced lemon tea. While eating, they talked about weekend plans. Shanshan mentioned she would take her daughter to the park for a picnic, and Yu Xiaowei shared an amusing story about her date with her husband Zhang Weiming at the Avenue of Stars the night before. The two chatted and laughed about how each of them got along with their husbands and their parenting tips.
location: Shop 103, 1st Floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work: document processing and client contact
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei handled the paperwork left over from the morning and put together a concise list of advantages for cross-border medical insurance. At 14:00, she contacted Shenzhen client Wang Qiming via WeChat voice call as scheduled, introduced the core advantages of AIA cross-border medical insurance, and invited him to talk in detail if he had the chance to come to Hong Kong after the Spring Festival. The call was short, but it successfully planted a seed of impression in his mind.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare tomorrow's training materials.
description: Yu Xiaowei downloaded the latest policy document on the Greater Bay Area insurance interconnectivity from the company's internal system, and printed out the product brochure for cross-border medical insurance. She highlighted key coverage items and the claims process in the brochure with a fluorescent marker, then placed it in a dedicated folder and neatly put it in the side pocket of the briefcase she would take tomorrow.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Before leaving work, tidying up and confirming the meeting point with her mother.
description: After tidying up her desk, Yu Xiaowei confirmed on Line the meeting time to watch the ballet with her family tonight. She then sent a message to her mother, Chen Meiling, reminding her to leave home at 4 p.m., take the children, and wait at Exit E of Tsim Sha Tsui MTR Station, where they would all set off together for the Cultural Centre. She packed her personal belongings and prepared to leave work early.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting by MTR and meeting family at Tsim Sha Tsui Station
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Tsim Sha Tsui Station and met her mother Chen Meiling, son Zhang Zixuan, and daughter Zhang Yuxin at Exit E. Her mother had brought the children from home (Zixuan had already finished school, and Xinxin had been picked up from kindergarten), along with Xuanxuan's school uniform jacket. After a quick tidy-up, the family prepared to head to the Hong Kong Cultural Centre.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, Tsim Sha Tsui Station Exit E

name: Watched the ballet Swan Lake
description: A family of five (Yu Xiaowei, husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, daughter Zhang Yuxin, and mother Chen Meiling) watched the ballet Swan Lake at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre. Yu Xiaowei sat next to her daughter Xinxin, who wore the light pink ballet tutu bought yesterday, eyes shining. During intermission, the whole family took a group photo in the lobby. Xuanxuan said he did not quite understand it but thought the music was beautiful. At the end of the performance, the audience burst into thunderous applause.
location: Grand Theatre, Hong Kong Cultural Centre, 10 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Celebration dinner at Nara Thai Restaurant, Harbour City
description: After the performance, the family walked to the Nara Thai restaurant in Harbour City for dinner. Weiming had booked a table a day in advance. Yu Xiaowei and Weiming ordered kids' meals for the children and Khao Soi for their mother. During the meal, everyone excitedly discussed the ballet excerpts from earlier, and Xinxin imitated a swan flapping its wings from her seat, making the whole family laugh heartily.
location: Nara Thai Restaurant, Harbour City, 3-27 Canton Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home, help the children with their homework, and read with them
description: Took a taxi from Harbour City back home to Whampoa Garden. After arriving, Yu Xiaowei first accompanied her son Zhang Zixuan into the study and helped him finish his math homework, focusing on checking several unit-conversion problems, and encouraged him to do his best on Monday's quiz. Then she sat on the living room floor with her daughter Zhang Yuxin and read the picture book The Ballerina together. Xinxin excitedly imitated the actions in the book of putting her hair up in a bun and standing on tiptoe.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Family leisure time together in the living room.
description: She placed the dim sum brought back from the Cultural Centre on the coffee table. Her husband Wei Ming turned on the TV, and the children watched cartoons for a while while eating the snacks. Yu Xiaowei sat beside them, looking at her loving family, and felt extremely content inside.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pack tomorrow's items and prepare running gear
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, packed the things her daughter Xinxin would need the next day (picture books, hair clips, etc.), and checked that the Cultural Centre ticket stub was still in her bag. Then she laid out her running clothes and sports water bottle for the next morning on the nightstand.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Relaxing yin yoga practice before bed
description: Yu Xiaowei unrolled her yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of bedtime yin yoga, focusing on pigeon pose and child's pose to deeply relax her hips and lower back, relieving the tension from this morning's run and long periods of sitting. Throughout the session, she used deep abdominal breathing, letting her body and mind gradually settle.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Talking with her husband before bed.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming leaned against the headboard chatting. Weiming talked about funny moments at work during the day, while Xiaowei shared rumors that there might be internal organizational adjustments at her company. Her husband squeezed her hand, comforted her to focus on the present and just do the work in front of her well. The two briefly discussed what time to get up tomorrow morning and decided that Weiming would be responsible for waking the children.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, bed in the bedroom

name: Going to bed
description: After turning off the light, Yu Xiaowei, feeling that the day had been full and satisfying, quickly fell asleep with wonderful memories of today's splendid performance of 'Swan Lake'.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: The 6:45 alarm went off. Since she had gone to bed a bit late last night, she stayed in bed for 5 minutes. After getting up, Yu Xiaowei did a few simple yoga stretches on the bedroom floor (cat-cow pose, downward-facing dog) to wake up her body and feel the quiet of the early morning. Outside the window was a gray overcast day, and the indoor light was soft.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (master bedroom)

name: Check family and work messages.
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowei picked up her phone and quickly scanned the family group chat messages (her mother sent a voice message saying that breakfast today would include shrimp dumplings), confirmed the schedule and meeting room for today's cross-border insurance training (Training Room, 15/F, AIA Building). She also replied to a few WeChat messages from last night from client Mrs. Chen about policy renewal.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (master bedroom)

name: Family breakfast time
description: Mother Chen Meiling had prepared breakfast: shrimp dumplings, plain congee, scrambled eggs, and pan-fried rice noodle rolls. The whole family sat around the dining table. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming discussed the day's arrangements—he had to work overtime today, and she had training all day. She told her son Zhang Zixuan to do his homework properly at home and not to keep playing on the tablet. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin excitedly showed off her newly bought pink ballet shoes and said she would wear them today to show the teacher at Liang Yujie Dance Academy.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room/dining room)

name: Preview and preparation before the training.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei went to her study and opened her laptop. She focused on reviewing the core materials in the company's internal knowledge base on “Interpretation of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Insurance Connectivity 2.0 Policy” and “Newly Launched Cross-Border Medical and Education Fund Combination Products.” She jotted down a few key policy points and possible questions in her notebook, preparing to ask them during today's training.
location: Study room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to ballet class.
description: At 8:30, Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin carry her ballet bag, brought along her water bottle and change of clothes, and drove from home to Liang Yujie Dance Academy on Sung Wong Toi Road. On the way, Zhang Yuxin talked again about the black swan's fouetté turns she loved most when watching Swan Lake the night before, and hummed the melody of Dance of the Little Swans. Yu Xiaowei smiled and encouraged her to study hard so she could dance as beautifully as the older girls one day.
location: On the drive from Whampoa Garden residential estate to Leung Yuk Kiu Dance Academy (Sung Wong Toi Road), Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to class and hand over to her mother.
description: She arrived at the dance academy at 8:45. Zhang Yuxin changed into her dance shoes and happily went in for class. Yu Xiaowei watched through the glass outside the classroom for a while as she did leg stretches to warm up. At about 9:10, her mother, Chen Meiling, arrived at the agreed time. Yu Xiaowei handed her mother Zhang Yuxin's water bottle and spare jacket, confirmed again that her mother would pick her up after class (at 10:00), and then set off for the company.
location: Liang Yujie Dance Academy, Sung Wong Toi Road, Ma Tau Chung, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the office
description: After finishing the handover with her mother, Yu Xiaowei drove from Sung Wong Toi Road, via the Eastern Harbour Crossing, to the AIA Building on Stubbs Road in Wan Chai District. Given that weekend morning traffic is smoother than on weekdays, she expected the drive to take about 25 minutes. In the car, she used Bluetooth earphones to listen to a previously downloaded industry podcast about 'tax planning and insurance allocation for high-net-worth clients in mainland China.'
location: Driving from Kowloon City District to Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (via the Eastern Harbour Crossing)

name: Cross-border insurance business training (morning session)
description: Arrived at the company at exactly 10:00, signed in, and took a seat. The training was led by product experts from headquarters, with rich content: in the morning, they focused on the details of the new Greater Bay Area insurance interconnection policy, compliance points for cross-border capital flows, and the claims process and mainland hospital network coverage of the newly launched "cross-border medical insurance." Yu Xiaowei listened attentively throughout and took detailed notes.
location: Training room, 15/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Training lunch and discussion with colleagues
description: During the training lunch break, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan walked to the coffee shop at Shui On Centre (about 15 minutes on foot). They ordered sandwiches and Hong Kong-style milk tea. Over the meal, they discussed how to approach clients with the new product, drawing on their own cases. Su Lishan mentioned that a client doing business in Shenzhen was particularly interested in an education fund, so the two analyzed together how to build the product advantages learned that day into their sales talk. They agreed to organize the training highlights together next week.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai.

name: Cross-border insurance business training (afternoon session)
description: The afternoon training focused on the product design highlights of the "Education Fund Plan", including the savings dividend structure and the policyholder's premium waiver clause. The instructor used numerous case studies to explain sales scripts. During the interactive session, Yu Xiaowei raised her hand and asked: "For the recently adjusted mainland CRS policy, how should we explain to Hong Kong clients holding mainland assets the tax and exchange rate effects on the newly launched education fund product?" She received a detailed answer from the instructor.
location: Training room, 15/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: End of training and return home
description: The training ended on time at 4 p.m. After packing up her materials and saying goodbye to the instructor and colleagues, Yu Xiaowei drove from the company, through the Cross-Harbour Tunnel, back to Whampoa Garden residential estate in Hung Hom, Kowloon. On the way, she reflected on the day's gains and planned how to arrange family activities in the evening, continuing the artistic resonance from watching Swan Lake the night before.
location: Driving from Wan Chai District to Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (via the Cross-Harbour Tunnel)

name: Pick up daughter and spend time with son
description: When she got home, her mother Chen Meiling had already picked up Zhang Yuxin from the dance academy, and her son Zhang Zixuan had also finished most of his homework. Yu Xiaowei first asked Zhang Yuxin how class went. Her daughter demonstrated a newly learned “arabesque” pose (standing on one leg, extending the other leg backward, with arms extended), and proudly said the teacher praised her. Then Yu Xiaowei sat next to Zhang Zixuan, checked his math homework, and corrected a small mistake in unit conversion.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Family dinner and communication.
description: Her husband, Zhang Weiming, also came home after working overtime at the company. Her mother, Chen Meiling, made a home-style beef hot pot that the whole family loves, with rich ingredients. The atmosphere at the dinner table was warm. Yu Xiaowei shared what she had gained from today's training, especially the new developments in Greater Bay Area insurance policy, and Zhang Weiming talked about small matters from his workday. Everyone agreed on the evening family activity: revisiting the photos and videos from last night's performance and planning the next family cultural trip together.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room/dining room)

name: Family Culture Night: Revisiting Art and Planning the Future
description: After dinner, the whole family gathered in the living room. Yu Xiaowei opened her tablet and cast to the TV the photos and videos of Swan Lake she had taken at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre last night (January 17). As they watched, they recalled that wonderful evening. Zhang Yuxin was especially excited and improvised a ballet move on the living room floor, making everyone laugh heartily. Then Yu Xiaowei took out her laptop, opened the official websites of the Hong Kong Museum of Art and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, and browsed information on recent exhibitions and concerts with Zhang Weiming. They initially selected a family activity for next weekend—visiting the "Dunhuang Art Exhibition" at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui. The children were all looking forward to it.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Putting the children to bed and tidying up.
description: After the event, Yu Xiaowei urged the children to go wash up. Zhang Yuxin was still excited, so she promised her daughter that tomorrow she would help her draw a design for the ballet tutu skirt, and only then coaxed her into bed. She helped Zhang Zixuan pack the textbooks and homework he would need tomorrow, and reminded him to memorize Monday's English vocabulary. After that, she tidied up the living room and put the children's scattered toys back in place.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (children's room / living room)

name: Relaxing with a foot soak and personal reflection
description: Once everything was quiet, Yu Xiaowei boiled a pot of hot water for herself, poured it into her foot-soaking bucket, and added a few drops of soothing lavender essential oil. While soaking her feet, she took out today's training notes, quickly used her laptop to compile an electronic summary of the key points, added her own practical reflections, and sent it to her colleague Su Lishan via WeChat so they could review it together next Monday.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate (master bathroom/bedroom)

name: Bedtime yoga
description: On the bed, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat and did a few simple yin yoga poses, such as butterfly pose and child's pose, to relax her hips and back and relieve the fatigue of a day of sitting and driving. At the same time, she reviewed the day's work and family life and felt very grounded.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (master bedroom)

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming also finished his work. The two lay in bed and chatted for a while. Zhang Weiming shared a difficult air-conditioning repair problem he had encountered at work, and Yu Xiaowei planned for him and the children to take a walk or ride bikes along the waterfront promenade next Sunday afternoon. This plain but warm moment made her feel very content.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (master bedroom)

name: Fell asleep.
description: Carrying the aftertaste of a fulfilling and wonderful day, and the anticipation of next weekend's family day, Yu Xiaowei turned off the light and prepared for bed. She felt especially content, slept soundly, and stored up energy for the next morning's marathon training.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (master bed)

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30 a.m. feeling refreshed. Went to the kitchen first to pour a glass of warm water, then did 10 minutes of yin yoga warm-up on the yoga mat in the living room to relax the shoulders, neck, and spine. After that, changed into running gear, checked the weather and running partner messages on her phone, grabbed a water bottle, and got ready to head out.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning run of 10 km with running buddy Shen Peiwen
description: Walked about 15 minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park and met running friend Shen Peiwen at 7 o'clock sharp. Jogged 10 km along the park running track, keeping the pace at 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. While running, Peiwen shared her plan to take her family to Taiwan for the Spring Festival, and Yu Xiaowei also mentioned rumors about the company's organizational restructuring and what she had gained from yesterday's training. After the run, they did 5 minutes of stretching. Peiwen left first, and Yu Xiaowei walked home.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Morning run followed by shower and family breakfast
description: Back home, she immediately showered to wash off the sweat, changed into comfortable loungewear, and put her running gear into the washing machine. Her mother Chen Meiling had already cooked white congee, fried eggs, and char siu buns. The family sat around the table together. Yu Xiaowei picked up a fried egg for her daughter Xinxin, and her husband Weiming helped his son Xuanxuan serve congee. Yu Xiaowei announced that she would take the children to Kowloon Park in the afternoon, and the two kids cheered with joy. Her mother asked whether she needed help preparing Lunar New Year goods before the Spring Festival, and Xiaowei said they could discuss it in the afternoon.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Putting away seasonal clothes with her mother and discovering old photos.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei and her mother opened the master bedroom wardrobe and the storage room and began sorting clothes for the change of season. They put aside two large bags of children's clothes that had been outgrown and a few old tops of Yu Xiaowei's, packed them up, and planned to contact a charity to donate them. During the process, they came across an old photo album. Seeing pictures of herself with her parents as a child, the mother and daughter sat on the bed and recalled the past, talking about her grandmother's old home and Yu Xiaowei's participation in a recitation contest, and sighing that time really flies. Yu Xiaowei took photos of a few old pictures with her phone and sent them to the family group chat.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Help mother prepare lunch and handle miscellaneous chores.
description: After putting the clothes away, she went to the kitchen to help her mother prepare lunch. She reheated the morning's barbecue pork buns and congee and stir-fried a plate of seasonal vegetables. During lunch, she took the opportunity to reply to two clients' WeChat messages about policy renewals and spent 10 minutes browsing insurance industry news. After the meal, her mother went to feed the cat, and Yu Xiaowei was in charge of clearing the dishes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch break and family free time
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for 30 minutes. Her husband Weiming was looking at his phone in the bedroom, and the children were playing in the living room—Xuanxuan building with LEGO and Xinxin drawing. At 13:15, Yu Xiaowei got up and began preparing the supplies for the afternoon outing: snacks, a water bottle, a sun hat, children's wet wipes, her phone, and a power bank.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: The whole family set off for Kowloon Park
description: At 1:15 p.m., the family of four set out from Whampoa Garden, walked about 10 minutes to Hung Hom Station, took the Tuen Ma Line to East Tsim Sha Tsui Station, then walked about 5 minutes to arrive at Kowloon Park. Along the way, Xuanxuan excitedly asked whether there was a slide in the park, while Xinxin hummed a song holding her father's hand.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanied the children playing in Kowloon Park
description: After arriving at the park, Xuanxuan and Xinxin ran straight to the playground, playing on the slide, swings, and climbing frame. Yu Xiaowei and Weiming divided the work. Yu Xiaowei sat on a nearby bench, watching the children while reading articles about cross-border insurance policies on her phone, noting in particular the policy characteristics of mainland clients such as Wang Qiming and Huang Sheng, and outlining a rough framework for the March sharing session. At the same time, she took a few candid shots of the children's smiling faces and sent them to the family group chat. Weiming played with the children and occasionally handed Yu Xiaowei a bottle of water.
location: Kowloon Park, 22 Austin Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: On the way home
description: Left the park at 4 p.m., walked back along the same route to Tsim Sha Tsui East Station, took the Tuen Ma Line back to Hung Hom Station, and then walked home to Whampoa Garden. On the train, Xuanxuan was a bit drowsy, while Xinxin was still excitedly talking about what she had seen at the park.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Yau Tsim Mong District - Kowloon Park

name: Her husband cooked dinner while Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter.
description: After arriving home, Weiming took the initiative to cook, stir-frying broccoli with garlic and tomato scrambled eggs, while his mother was in charge of cooking rice. Yu Xiaowei helped Xinxin bathe and change into pajamas, and handed Xuanxuan some water. In the kitchen, Weiming asked whether to buy rice cakes before Chinese New Year, and Yu Xiaowei said let's see next week.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: The whole family had dinner together and chatted about Spring Festival plans.
description: The family sits around the dining table, and Weiming serves the food. At the table, Yu Xiaowei suggests buying new clothes for the children for Spring Festival, and her mother mentions preparing red envelopes for New Year visits. Yu Xiaowei then discusses the Spring Festival budget with Weiming, and they decide to cut back on dining out and shopping expenses, but keep the red envelope cost. Xuanxuan asks if they can go to Disneyland, and Yu Xiaowei says they need to consider the budget. After dinner, she clears the dishes with her mother.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Evening family interaction
description: After dinner, the whole family moved to the living room. Xuanxuan drew on the iPad, Xinxin watched cartoons, and Yu Xiaowei and Weiming discussed the refrigerator at home needing repair. Her mother fed the cat and went back to her room to rest, and her father read the newspaper on the balcony. Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to reply to a client's WeChat inquiry.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Organize insurance cases and industry reports in the study
description: At 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowei entered the study, opened her laptop and the training materials from yesterday. She copied key excerpts of cross-border insurance client cases (such as the policy features of mainland clients Wang Qiming and Huang Sheng, and the impact of CRS policy) into her notebook, and initially sketched the framework for the March sharing session (comparison of Greater Bay Area policies, trends in cross-border medical insurance). She also browsed an article from an insurance industry WeChat official account and recorded several key points.
location: Study in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Discussing the Spring Festival spending budget with her husband
description: At 9 PM, Yu Xiaowei went to the bedroom and discussed the Spring Festival spending budget face-to-face with Weiming. They looked through the family ledger, reviewed the recent savings progress, and decided to cut down on dining out and shopping expenses in the last two weeks of January, while keeping the red envelope expenses (about 2,000 HKD) and the family dinner expenditure. Weiming suggested buying fewer new clothes before the Spring Festival, and Yu Xiaowei agreed. After reaching a consensus, she noted the key points in the memo on her phone.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, bedroom, 6 Tak Hong Street

name: Evening skincare and getting ready for bed.
description: Before going to bed, she did a simple skincare routine (cleansing and moisturizing) and changed into pajamas. She checked tomorrow's (Monday) weather and work schedule, confirmed there were no special meetings, and set the alarm. She put today's notebook with case notes back into her bag and checked the children's supplies for school the next day (her mother had already prepared them in advance).
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Chatted with my husband at night and fell asleep peacefully.
description: After lying down, she chatted softly with Wei Ming for a while. He talked about funny things he had seen children doing in the park today, and Yu Xiaowei shared her feelings about sorting through old photos. They discussed finding time next week to visit her mother-in-law (in Kwun Tong), and decided that on the weekend Wei Ming would be responsible for taking the children to their extracurricular classes. Around 10:30 p.m., they said goodnight, turned off the lights, and went to sleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, bedroom, 6 Tak Hong Street

name: Waking up and morning yoga.
description: The alarm went off at 6:30 a.m., and it was drizzling outside. After getting up, Yu Xiaowei glanced at the scale, which showed 55.0 kg, then changed into her workout gear. She decided to start the new day with indoor yoga, so she spread out her yoga mat in the living room and followed soothing music from her phone for a 25-minute vinyasa flow practice, focusing on the connection between breath and postures to relax her body and mind.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Showering and buying breakfast
description: After yoga, Yu Xiaowei took a hot shower in the home bathroom and then changed into work attire. While the family was still getting ready, she hurried downstairs to the tea restaurant in the residential complex and bought hot pineapple buns and egg waffles, intending to add something special to the children's breakfast.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: At 7:25, the whole family sat around having breakfast. Son Xuanxuan complained that the math homework was difficult, and daughter Xinxin gestured about what she was going to draw today. Husband Weiming said he was on the morning shift and might not be able to pick up Xuanxuan from school, so Yu Xiaowei promised to get off work as early as possible. Her mother asked what to have for dinner, and she said she might be back late. Her father reminded her to take an umbrella when going out today, and she smiled and said she had already used it. After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei held an umbrella and walked Xinxin, who had put on her little raincoat, 15 minutes to the kindergarten. On the way, she and her daughter agreed that she would check her painting in the evening, and she said a gentle goodbye at the kindergarten gate.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Commute to company
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei entered Hung Hom MTR Station at 8:15 and took the MTR East Rail line to Wan Chai. The carriage was not too crowded, so she used the time to send a WhatsApp message to client Mr. Huang confirming the afternoon meeting time. She felt a little relieved after he replied OK. After arriving at Wan Chai Station, she exited and walked to the company, buying a hot yuenyeung at a convenience store on the way.
location: AIA Building (1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Weekly team meeting
description: At 9:00 on the dot, Yu Xiaowei swiped her card into the AIA Building and ran into a few colleagues in the elevator, exchanging small talk. The team weekly meeting started on time in the 15th-floor conference room, hosted by Brother Hua. He talked about last week's performance and this week's goals, without mentioning the organizational restructuring. The atmosphere in the meeting room was subtle; colleagues who usually joked around were quiet. When it was Yu Xiaowei's turn to report, she methodically introduced last week's signings and mentioned that Mr. Huang's policy review was scheduled for the afternoon. Brother Hua nodded in approval.
location: Meeting Room, 15th Floor, AIA Building (1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Morning work: handle cross-border medical insurance list and client follow-up
description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei returned to her workstation to work on the cross-border medical insurance checklist document that was left unfinished last week. She contacted Guo Junwei, an actuary colleague at the Guangzhou branch, via WeChat to ask about details for coordinating with a mainland medical insurance catalog. He replied quickly and promised to send the updated rate table at noon. She focused on reviewing the product terms and data, and gradually calmed down. During that time, she also sent a quarterly care message to another client, checked the policy documents, blank forms, and pens needed for the afternoon visit to Mr. Huang, and reviewed the riders on the accidental medical insurance to make sure she could clearly answer the client's questions.
location: Workstation on the 15th floor of AIA Building (1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Lunch Break Socializing and Hearing Rumors
description: At noon, colleague Su Lishan invited Yu Xiaowei to sit down at the Shui On Centre cafe downstairs from the office. After each ordered a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea, Su Lishan lowered her voice and revealed that her elder sister worked as an assistant in the HR department at headquarters. She had heard that the company planned to restructure sales regions after the Chinese New Year, and the existing teams might be broken up. Yu Xiaowei's heart tightened at the news, but she pulled herself together and advised Su Lishan not to spread it around yet and to wait and see.
location: Shui On Centre Café (Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Quick lunch
description: After finishing her talk with Su Lishan, Yu Xiaowei went to eat alone. Remembering that she had to visit clients in the Eastern District of Hong Kong Island in the afternoon, she chose to take the MTR back to Hung Hom and ordered a bowl of shredded pork and preserved mustard greens noodles at the New Shanghai Kitchen, a Chinese restaurant not far from home. While dining alone, she kept turning over the company restructuring news she had heard at noon, feeling somewhat unsettled.
location: New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant (7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, Hong Kong)

name: Commute and client visits
description: After a quick lunch, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Hung Hom Station, changed to the East Rail Line at Mong Kok East Station to Admiralty, then transferred to the Island Line and arrived at Tai Koo Station. The whole journey took about 30 minutes. On the way, she repeatedly rehearsed the policy terms she was going to explain and her additional recommendation for accidental medical insurance, and updated her key communication points in her phone's memo app. Before 2 p.m., she arrived on time at Mr. Huang's flat at Kornhill and carefully conducted an annual policy review for him, explaining the terms one by one. Based on Mr. Huang's recent activities, she suggested adding an accidental medical insurance rider and clearly explained the coverage and premium. After listening carefully, Mr. Huang said he needed to discuss it with his wife before deciding. Yu Xiaowei said she understood, agreed to follow up next week, and left a product leaflet.
location: Mr. Huang's residence at Kornhill Garden (Kornhill Garden, 2 Kornhill Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Return trip and emotional snacking.
description: After leaving Mr. Huang’s house, Yu Xiaowei stood under the eaves at the side of the street for a few seconds, listening to the rain and trying to relax her tense nerves. On the way back, she took the MTR. When transferring at Wan Chai Station, she habitually walked into the convenience store at Convention Plaza and bought a bag of potato chips and a box of chocolate bars. Although this went against her principle of eating light, the rumors of company restructuring she had heard during the day made her restless, and the sweet-and-salty taste seemed to temporarily suppress her anxiety. She ate while walking and stuffed the remaining snacks into her bag.
location: Convention Plaza Convenience Store (1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Return to company to handle wrap-up work
description: At 3:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei returned to her workstation at AIA Building. She organized the notes from this afternoon's client meeting and entered them into the system, marked as "follow up next week." Then she checked the rate sheet email sent by Guo Junwei at noon and, after confirming it was correct, downloaded and archived it.
location: Workstation on the 15th floor of AIA Building (1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Shopping after work and going home
description: Yu Xiaowei left work early and took the MTR from Wan Chai back to Hung Hom. At the ParkNShop in the Whampoa New World shopping mall, she bought fresh choy sum, an onion, and a few tomatoes—ingredients her mother might use in the evening. After shopping, she walked five minutes back to her home at Whampoa Garden.
location: ParknShop at Whampoa New World Mall (No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Arriving home, handover, and time with the children
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei put the vegetables in the kitchen. Her mother Chen Meiling was preparing dinner. Seeing that she didn't look well, she quietly handed her a cup of hot tea and patted her shoulder, saying, "Take things slowly with work." Yu Xiaowei felt a warm glow. At 5 p.m., her daughter Xinxin had already come home from school and ran over showing off a doodle she had drawn. Yu Xiaowei forced a smile and praised her for using nice colors, then played puzzles with her on the floor for ten minutes. Nearby, her son Xuanxuan was doing homework. She walked over, patted his head, and told him to take a break.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: At 6 p.m., her husband Weiming came home from work and the whole family had dinner together. Yu Xiaowei didn't have much appetite, but she still sat with the family. Weiming noticed she was distracted and asked what was wrong. She only said lightly that it was a small matter at work and nothing was wrong. She silently picked at some choy sum, and the atmosphere was somewhat oppressive.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying the child through bedtime washing and reading picture books.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter Xinxin and then read an ocean-themed picture book with her. Her son Xuanxuan finished the remaining math homework on his own, and she checked it and signed it.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal yoga
description: After the children were settled, Yu Xiaowei changed into yoga clothes and laid out her yoga mat in the living room. Instead of going to the gym or running outdoors as usual, she chose a soothing yin yoga session to release the day's stress. She did a few gentle twists and stretches, trying to breathe the anxiety out with every breath, and her emotions gradually calmed.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Working in the study: recording ideas for team optimization
description: After yoga, her mood was a bit more stable. Yu Xiaowei walked into the study, closed the door, and opened a document on her computer. She turned the company restructuring rumors she had heard during the day into an actionable plan, writing down ideas such as splitting the current fifteen-person team into three specialized groups (high-end medical, savings and retirement, risk management), adding a mentoring system for new employees, and setting up dedicated teams for different client segments. She wrote for nearly an hour, filling page after page with items. Although she still felt anxious inside, she at least regained some sense of control.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After saving the document, Yu Xiaowei closed her laptop, went to the bathroom, carefully did her skincare routine and washed up, and changed into pajamas. She lay down in bed; the sound of rain outside the window gradually faded. Closing her eyes, she reflected on the day and reminded herself that no matter how the outside world changes, the most important thing is to do her own part well. At 10:30 p.m., she turned off the bedside lamp and gradually fell asleep listening to the sporadic rain.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga, personal preparation, and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 6:45. It was a sunny day, but she was preoccupied with the company rumor. After getting up, she did 15 minutes of gentle Hatha yoga in the living room, then took a shower, dried her hair, and put on a smart commuting outfit. Then she went to the kitchen to help her mother prepare breakfast, setting fried eggs, ham, and toast on the table and pouring milk. She woke Xuanxuan and Xinxin and urged them to wash up and have breakfast together. She reminded Xuanxuan to bring his science craft materials today, and her husband said he would drop the children off at school on his way to his early shift.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Commute to company
description: My husband set off first with the two children to take them to school. I put on my commuter bag, walked 3 minutes to Sung Wong Toi station, and took the MTR (Kwun Tong line, transferring to Tsuen Wan line, about 40 minutes) to Wan Chai station. On the train, I browsed insurance industry news on my phone and texted Su Lishan to finalize meeting at the café in Shui On Centre at 12:00 noon.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, MTR section from Sung Wong Toi Station in Kowloon City District to Wan Chai Station in Wan Chai District.

name: Buying milk tea and getting ready at work.
description: After exiting Wan Chai Station, I stopped by the café at Shui On Centre on the way and bought a hot Hong Kong-style milk tea to go. Then I swiped my card to enter the office at AIA Building and sat down at my workstation. I turned on the computer, logged into the system, checked morning emails and internal messaging software, and organized the client materials that needed priority attention today—the comprehensive family insurance plan for Mrs. Chen.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning office work and keeping an eye on internal messages
description: Sitting at her desk, she focused on checking the coverage terms and premium rates in Mrs. Chen's proposal. From time to time, she glanced at the company's internal communication group and listened to colleagues' conversations, trying to pick up any news about a 'sales territory restructuring.' Around 10 o'clock she went to the pantry to get water and ran into a few colleagues whispering, but they stopped when she approached. A feeling of unease rose in her heart, and she decided to find Brother Hua to ask for clarification in the afternoon.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch exchange with colleague Su Lishan.
description: At 12 o'clock, I went downstairs to the café at Shui On Centre, where Su Lishan had already saved seats. The two of us ordered a light meal and chatted over lunch. I cautiously asked about rumors of a team reorganization; Shanshan said she had heard some talk too, but no concrete plan had been decided, and advised me not to scare myself—if I was really worried, I should just ask Brother Hua directly.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Refine the proposal and prepare materials for the meeting.
description: After lunch, she returned to the office and, using the time before the afternoon shift, made careful additions to the appendix materials for Mrs. Chan's proposal (company background introduction and past claims cases), and organized a progress list of several key clients she had recently handled as a "door opener" for the afternoon talk with Brother Hua.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepared for and held a meeting with supervisor Liang Zhenhua.
description: At 3 o'clock sharp, I knocked on Brother Hua's office door with the prepared client progress list. I first reported on the follow-up status of several key clients, including Mrs. Chan, emphasized the renewal rate and progress toward new policy targets, and asked some professional questions. Seeing that the atmosphere was good, I lowered my voice and tactfully asked about any news regarding the sales territory adjustment. Liang Zhenhua thought for a moment and told me that the company was indeed in the discussion stage, but the official direction had not been decided. He told me to stay calm, focus on my current performance, and let the results speak for themselves. He encouraged me, saying that the company would not treat hardworking people unfairly. I felt a little relieved, but not completely at ease.
location: Office of Liang Zhenhua, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing Meeting Minutes and Handling Work
description: After the conversation, she returned to her desk and immediately recorded the key points from the meeting with Brother Hua, especially the core reminder to “focus on performance”. Then she sent the preliminary version of Mrs. Chen's proposal to her for preview, and left a message to arrange a face-to-face meeting next week to explain the plan details. After that, she prepared to leave work early.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Left work early to commute and buy groceries.
description: Packed up and left the office early. On the way home by metro, she called her husband Zhang Weiming and talked about the conversation with Brother Hua and her anxiety about promotion. Her husband patiently comforted her, saying he would take care of the children in the evening so she could rest. After arriving at Whampoa Station, she stopped by the ParknShop at the Whampoa New World shopping mall (No. 6 Tak Hong Street) on the way, buying pork ribs, choy sum, and fresh lemons.
location: Wonder World Shopping Centre, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to spend time with the children
description: After arriving home, she greeted her mother and put the groceries in the kitchen. She saw Xuanxuan doing homework in the living room and Xinxin playing with building blocks. She checked Xuanxuan's homework progress, found he was stuck on several math problems, and sat down to guide him through them. Afterwards, she built a small castle with Xinxin using the building blocks, and Xinxin giggled happily.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Assisted with meal preparation and family dinner
description: When my husband came home from work, he took over the "relay baton" of helping the children with their homework, and I went into the kitchen to help my mother, washing and cutting vegetables. During dinner, the whole family sat together. My mother had made pork rib soup and stir-fried choy sum. Everyone ate and chatted, while the children chattered about fun things at school. The home was filled with a warm atmosphere.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Help her son with his science craft homework.
description: After dinner, I accompanied Xuanxuan in the study to finish the science craft homework—making a simple wind vane. Xuanxuan took out cardstock, a straw, pins, and scissors. While explaining how a wind vane works, I guided him in cutting paper pieces for the arrow and tail, and fixing them to the straw with a pin. The finished wind vane spun when blown. Xuanxuan clapped excitedly. Watching him so focused and happy, I temporarily put work worries aside.
location: Study in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR.

name: Giving her daughter a bath and putting her to sleep
description: After taking Xuanxuan back to his room and having her husband tell him a story, I went to the bathroom to give Xinxin a bath. I ran warm water and washed her hair and body. While playing with bubbles, she told me about playing 'house' at kindergarten. After her bath, I changed her into pajamas, carried her to bed, read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You twice, planted a goodnight kiss on her forehead, and watched her peaceful sleeping face.
location: Bathroom and children's room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tidy up the living room to prepare for exercise.
description: After the children had all fallen asleep, she returned to the living room, put the toys and homework books on the coffee table back in their places, and gave the dining table a quick wipe. Then she took the yoga mat out of the cabinet, laid it out in the open area of the living room, went to the bedroom to change into workout clothes and sneakers, and got ready for the upcoming strength training.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Evening strength training
description: Opened the mobile fitness app and started a 20-minute bodyweight strength workout: squats 3 sets x 15 reps, lunges 12 reps per side, and planks 1 minute x 3 sets. Focused on breathing and muscle engagement; sweat soaked my clothes. After finishing, did a few minutes of stretching and felt my shoulders, neck, and back were nicely relieved.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Shower and skincare routine.
description: After finishing strength training, she went into the bathroom to take a hot shower and wash away the fatigue. After coming out, she blew her hair dry and followed her evening skincare routine: essence, eye cream, and night cream. After changing into comfortable cotton pajamas, she completely relaxed.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Review industry information and reflection notes before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, she scrolled through insurance industry forums and professional WeChat public accounts on her phone, focusing on analysis articles about optimization trends for insurance sales teams in the Greater Bay Area. Finding them enlightening, she shared the links to her work group chat and saved them to her favorites. Then she took out her notebook from the bedside table and wrote down today's reflection: "After talking with Brother Hua, although things are not clear yet, I have steadied my mind. What matters is returning to business and letting performance speak." She then listed tomorrow's plan: follow up on Mrs. Chen's feedback on the proposal and prepare the materials she would need for meeting Mr. Huang next week.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Made hot lemon honey and got ready for bed
description: After finishing writing the notes, I made myself a cup of hot lemon honey, sipping it slowly while closing my eyes to let my thoughts settle. After drinking it, I brushed my teeth again and got ready to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Falling asleep
description: Although Brother Hua's words reassured me a little, the uncertainty of the future still lingered in my mind. I tossed and turned in bed, repeatedly pondering today's conversation and possible changes, and only fell asleep with difficulty late in the night.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Get up and have breakfast with family
description: The morning alarm rang. Yu Xiaowei got up, washed up briefly, changed into comfortable home clothes, and walked into the dining room. Her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared white congee, fried eggs, and barbecue pork buns. Yu Xiaowei confirmed with her husband Zhang Weiming that he would drive their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, while she helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin finish her milk, put a carton of Vita Soy Milk into her son's schoolbag, and reminded him to drink water. The family chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was warm. Yu Xiaowei tried to leave her work anxiety at the door.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk daughter to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her sneakers, shouldered her commuter bag, held her daughter Zhang Yuxin, who was wearing a pink school uniform, by one hand, and carried the trash downstairs with the other. She walked about 10 minutes from Whampoa Garden to Kowloon City Kindergarten, nodded with a smile at the teacher on duty, squatted down to fix her daughter's collar, kissed her little face and said "See you this afternoon," then watched her daughter skip into the campus.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commuting to work and gathering information
description: After walking about 8 minutes from the kindergarten to Sung Wong Toi Station, she took the MTR to Wan Chai Station. On the train, Yu Xiaowei put on earphones and quickly browsed insurance industry WeChat official accounts and news apps, keeping an eye on Greater Bay Area policy updates. After exiting the station, she went to the café at Shui On Centre on the way and ordered a cup of Hong Kong-style hot milk tea to refresh herself. She arrived at the office in the AIA Building at around 8:25, clocked in, took her seat, and prepared to start the day's work.
location: From Sung Wong Toi Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Wan Chai Station, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, via the Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, and arriving at the AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District.

name: Morning: handling client matters and dynamic monitoring
description: Yu Xiaowei turned on her computer in her office at AIA Building, refreshed the company's internal emails and bulletin board every half hour, and found no official announcement. She then focused on client matters: first checking the policy information of her long-time client Mrs. Chen in the whole system, confirming it was correct before submitting a beneficiary information change request; then calling potential client Mrs. Li, introducing herself in a gentle and professional tone, and agreeing to meet after the New Year to discuss retirement planning in detail. In between, she found time to sort out the list of clients she planned to visit next week.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Downstairs lunch and information exchange.
description: Around 11:45, Yu Xiaowei proactively sent a message to her colleague Su Lishan, arranging to meet at the café in Shui On Centre. She ordered a signature sandwich set, and the two chatted while eating. Yu Xiaowei casually mentioned, "I heard there's some movement in District Three recently." Su Lishan lowered her voice and shared a rumor she had heard during lunch in the marketing department, saying that she "saw a new staffing reassignment form." Yu Xiaowei quickly noted down the keyword "District Three merger" on her phone.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Noon seaside walk
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei did not go straight back to the office. Instead, she walked alone for about 5 minutes to the Golden Bauhinia Square waterfront promenade near her company. With the sea breeze gently blowing, she walked to the railing, took a few deep breaths, and looked at the sparkling sea, letting her mind temporarily withdraw from the cluttered information and enjoy a precious moment of blankness.
location: Waterfront promenade at Golden Bauhinia Square, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work and information integration
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei reorganized the rumors she had gathered in the morning, client phone records, and next week's plans, and entered them into her work log. At 3 p.m., she opened an online document and sorted the scattered leads into a brief personal memo, noting: "Rumor: possible merger of the three districts; source: Marketing Department; time: lunch on January 22." Although her mood was still unsettled, she had learned to live with uncertainty and pulled her attention back to the work she could control.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Visit Teacher Wu in Sham Shui Po
description: Yu Xiaowei finished her current work ahead of time, walked from the AIA Building to Wan Chai Station, took the MTR to Sham Shui Po Station, and then walked about 8 minutes to Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio on Lai Chi Kok Road. Pushing the door open, the familiar scent of sandalwood and silk threads instantly relaxed her tense nerves. She took out the embroidered fabric for the 'Peace' hanging ornament and asked Teacher Wu for guidance on the stitching. While demonstrating, Wu chatted with her about the past, and the half-hour exchange was especially healing.
location: Wu Xiuying's Cantonese Embroidery Studio, near 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute after work and supermarket shopping
description: After saying goodbye to Teacher Wu, Yu Xiaowei deliberately took a detour to a nearby roast meat shop and bought a portion of char siu. Then she walked to Sham Shui Po Station, took the MTR to Hung Hom Station, and walked to the Whampoa New World shopping mall. Around 17:15, she arrived at ParknShop inside the mall and quickly bought fresh choy sum, a bag of oranges, and a box of blueberries her daughter likes. At checkout, she also picked up two cans of beer her husband likes.
location: From the roast meat shop in Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong SAR, to Sham Shui Po Station, transfer to the MTR to Hung Hom Station, then to ParknShop at Whampoa Plaza, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District.

name: Arrived home, completed handover, and prepared dinner.
description: Carrying shopping bags, Yu Xiaowei walked into her home at Whampoa Garden, where her mother, Chen Meiling, was busy in the kitchen. She put down her things, chatted briefly with her mother about work, then went to the living room to watch her son Zhang Zixuan do his homework, patiently explaining a unit issue in a math problem. Afterward, she went into the kitchen to help her mother wash and chop vegetables. Mother and daughter chatted about everyday things as they worked, filling the air with a warm, homely atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and living room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, and Yu Xiaowei set out roast meats and a few side dishes; the whole family sat around the table. She served food to the children and clinked beer glasses with Weiming. They chatted about Xuanxuan's science class at school, Xinxin's paintings, and the plan to visit her mother-in-law in Kwun Tong on the weekend. By the end of the meal, Yu Xiaowei was smiling more, and her inner restlessness was softened by the family's laughter.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Playing with the cat and looking through family photos
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei changed into comfortable loungewear, spread a soft mat on the living room floor, took out a cat teaser wand, and called softly, "Mimi." The cat immediately darted out from under the sofa, leaping and pawing at the tip of the wand, looking adorably clumsy, and she couldn't help laughing. The fifteen minutes of interaction completely released her stress. Afterward, she held the cat on her lap and, with the other hand, scrolled through her phone's photo album to look back at family day photos, feeling filled with peace.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Put the children to bed and complete personal washing.
description: Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter Zhang Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, and read her a picture book from the Little Rabbit Tom series by her bed. After she fell asleep, she gently closed the door behind her. Then she went back to her own room, took a hot shower, and changed into pajamas.
location: Children's room and bathroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Bedtime meditation and emotional clearing.
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside night light. She sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed, closed her eyes, and began 15 minutes of mindful meditation. She focused on each breath, clearing away today's emotional fragments — the morning anxiety, the lunchtime speculation, the afternoon relaxation, and the evening warmth. As she exhaled, it seemed those uneasinesses drifted away with her breath.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

When they said goodnight, she remarked that although today had been tiring, the house was finally clean, and her husband agreed. At 22:30, she checked the next day's weather, set the alarm, and checked that the lights were off. At 22:45, she went to sleep with the satisfaction of wrapping things up before the new year.
location: Bedroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sleeping in and weighing on the weekend
description: On a weekend morning, Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally in the bedroom as sunlight streamed in. She got up and weighed herself on the electronic scale, which showed 55.3 kg. Satisfied, she noted the number and began a new day.
location: Bedroom, Flat B, 12/F, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leisurely family breakfast and praising the children
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowei walked to the living room, where her mother Chen Meiling had prepared rice noodle rolls, steamed pork ribs, and hot tea. The family sat around the table. She praised her son Zhang Zixuan for tidying up his room and complimented her daughter Zhang Yuxin's painting for being full of childlike charm, deciding to hang it on the refrigerator. The breakfast atmosphere was warm.
location: Living room and dining room, Unit B, 12th Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and checking winter vacation homework.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math winter vacation homework in the living room and guided him to correct his errors in fraction calculations. Then she accompanied her daughter Zhang Yuxin in the study, looking through picture books and explaining them. During this time, she confirmed that the Cantonese embroidery handkerchief gift was wrapped, and checked the shopping list again for items like coconut juice rice cakes and turnip cakes, preparing for the afternoon shopping.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block 5, 12th Floor, Flat B, living room and study

name: Assisted with meal preparation and family lunch
description: Yu Xiaowei helped her mother Chen Meiling prepare lunch in the kitchen, blanching vegetables and slicing roast pork. As they chatted, they mentioned going to Mong Kok Market early in the afternoon. At noon the whole family sat down to enjoy lunch. Her husband Zhang Weiming asked about the afternoon plans, and Yu Xiaowei said she planned to meet Jiaxin at two, return home at four to pick up her mother, and then go together to Mong Kok Market for New Year shopping.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Flat B, 12th Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Heading out to the coffee shop.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei changed into a casual jacket and sneakers in the master bedroom, and checked the gift, wallet, phone, and keys in her handbag. At 13:30 she set off from home, walking along the streets and lanes of Whampoa Garden toward Prince Edward Road West, enjoying the leisurely weekend afternoon, and arrived at Little House Coffee about 20 minutes later.
location: Flat B, 12th Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the route on foot to Little House Coffee at 114 Prince Edward Road West.

name: Going to a coffee date with a close friend
description: Yu Xiaowei met her close friend Lin Jiaxin at a coffee shop, ordered a hot latte, and gave her a Cantonese embroidered handkerchief as a gift; Lin Jiaxin gave back a wooden aromatherapy gift box. The two chatted happily about family anecdotes. Lin Jiaxin shared about her husband's promotion, while Yu Xiaowei talked about her children's recent situation and next week's planned discussion with new client Wang Qiming about the medical insurance plan, and they finalized the details of taking the children to Disneyland together on February 15.
location: Little House Coffee, 114 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Go home to pick up mother and head to Mong Kok Street Market
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Jiaxin, Yu Xiaowei walked home and arrived at Whampoa Garden about 20 minutes later, where her mother Chen Meiling was waiting in the living room. She changed into a pair of flat shoes and walked with her mother to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, and walked from Exit E2 to the entrance of Mong Kok Market. Both were carrying large eco-friendly shopping bags.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the entrance to Mong Kok Market in the area of Mong Kok Road and Fa Yuen Street, Yau Tsim Mong District

name: Big New Year shopping trip.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother were shopping for Chinese New Year goods at Mong Kok Market. They bought coconut rice cakes and turnip cake at the dried goods section, Chinese sausages at the cured meat stall, and carefully selected dried shiitake mushrooms and black moss. Yu Xiaowei picked peach blossoms and gladioli at the flower stall, and finally bought red envelopes at the stationery shop. Her mother also bought chives and scallions. The shopping cost about 4,200 Hong Kong dollars. Although Yu Xiaowei felt it was over budget, seeing her mother satisfied made it worthwhile. Mother and daughter returned home fully loaded.
location: Mong Kok Market in the area around Mong Kok Road and Fa Yuen Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Taking a taxi home.
description: After shopping, Yu Xiaowei hailed a taxi at the market exit, and mother and daughter put the New Year goods in the trunk. After getting in the car, her mother praised how well the gladiolus flowers were blooming. About 12 minutes later, they arrived downstairs at their Whampoa Garden home. Yu Xiaowei paid the fare and carried the shopping bags upstairs with her mother.
location: Took a taxi from Mong Kok Market, Yau Tsim Mong District, to Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District

name: Organizing New Year goods and flower arranging
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowei and her mother sorted and stored the New Year goods. Rice cakes and turnip cakes were placed in fresh-keeping boxes; Chinese sausages and shiitake mushrooms were refrigerated; and hair moss was sealed and stored in a dry place. Then the two arranged peach blossom and gladiolus in vases, with her daughter Zhang Yuxin helping to pass the scissors. The home was filled with the flavor of the New Year.
location: Living room and kitchen, Flat B, 12th Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with dinner preparation and waiting for her husband to come home
description: Yu Xiaowei helped her mother prepare dinner in the kitchen, washing rice and cooking it, chopping minced garlic and scallion segments. Her father Yu Guoqiang was reading the newspaper in the living room, her son was doing homework, and her daughter was doing a puzzle. She kept an eye on the time, waiting for her husband Zhang Weiming to come home from work.
location: Kitchen and living room, Flat B, 12/F, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and proactive communication about New Year shopping expenses.
description: Zhang Weiming returned home, and the whole family enjoyed the hearty dinner his mother had cooked. During the meal, Zhang Weiming found that the grocery shopping had gone over budget. Yu Xiaowei proactively admitted that she had not been restrained enough, and discussed with her husband making up for it by drawing from the family entertainment budget and cutting the two-week plan to eat out. The two understood each other, and the atmosphere became harmonious again.
location: Dining room, Flat B, 12/F, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Cleared the dining table and had a short family rest.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei washed the dishes and wiped down the stove with her mother. Then she poured a glass of warm water and rested in the living room, browsing the photos of peach blossoms and gladioli she had taken in the afternoon, feeling pleased.
location: Living room and kitchen, Unit B, 12th Floor, Tower 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Browsing industry reports in the study
description: Yu Xiaowei went into the study, used her laptop to download and read the Greater Bay Area insurance quarterly report, marked key cross-border policy growth data, reviewed policy forecasts, considered the impact on high-end medical and savings insurance, organized materials, and distilled three key points as the outline for the sharing session. During this time, she also checked the time on her phone.
