location: Study, Flat B, 12th Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Nighttime washing, bedtime chat, and going to sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei took a shower in the master bathroom and changed into pajamas. Then she went to her son's room, listened to him talk about what he had learned about the universe in science class, and encouraged him. After that, she told her daughter a bedtime story and coaxed her to sleep. Finally, she returned to the master bedroom, briefly exchanged thoughts about the day with her husband Zhang Weiming, said goodnight to each other, turned off the lights, and went to bed, feeling fulfilled and content.
location: Master bathroom, children's bedroom, and master bedroom, Flat B, 12th Floor, Tower 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting Up and Morning Preparation
description: Woken up on time by the 6:30 alarm, she quietly turned off her phone, caught a glimpse of her husband and the morning light outside the window, washed up without making a sound, followed a refreshing skincare routine, and changed into a freshly ironed black pantsuit, getting ready for the last working day before the new year.
location: Flat B, 15th Floor, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and preparations to leave.
description: Her mother, Chen Meiling, was busy in the kitchen, and her husband Zhang Weiming was helping the children get dressed. On the dining table were white congee, fried eggs, and barbecued pork buns. Yu Xiaowei ate breakfast quickly, checked the children's schoolbags and water bottles, and reminded her husband to take the family to the flower market at 6 p.m. sharp.
location: Flat B, 15th Floor, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Driving the children to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove her private car, first taking her son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. At the school gate she reminded him to go straight home after school; then she drove 10 minutes to take her daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten, handed her personally to the teacher, and returned.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (2C Oxford Road) and Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street)

name: Commuting to work
description: Parked the car back in the community parking lot, walked to Whampoa MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station, and after exiting the station walked 8 minutes to AIA Building at 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Preparations for resuming work and New Year greetings to colleagues
description: Arrived at her desk, put down her bag, and made coffee. In the break room, she met colleague Guo Junwei, and they exchanged New Year greetings and talked about holiday plans. Back at her seat, she saw Su Lishan, and they wished each other Happy New Year. The office had a relaxed festive atmosphere.
location: Office on the 35th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Handling pre-holiday office work.
description: Processed the last few policy changes, verified beneficiary information for client Mrs. Wong, and sent a confirmation email. At 11 a.m., she received a call from Mrs. Wong, patiently answered her questions about annuity cash value, and gave New Year greetings.
location: Office on the 35th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Had a small get-together with colleagues to exchange New Year greetings.
description: Before the lunch break, had a small gathering by the window with Su Lishan, exchanged New Year greetings, and agreed to share insights from the Shenzhen sharing session on the first working day after the holiday.
location: Office on the 35th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Lunch and client call
description: Walked to Biao Ji Wonton Noodles and ordered the signature wonton noodles and iced milk tea. While eating, I received a WeChat message from a client, Ms. Li. I replied by voice message while eating, answering her questions about the policy loan and wishing her a happy New Year.
location: Biu Kee Wonton Noodles, 119 Wan Chai Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Formulate a career adjustment plan.
description: Back in the office, she focused on organizing her career transition document, listing her personal strengths, target positions, skills to improve, and key points for communicating with supervisor Liang Zhenhua. After finishing, she encrypted and saved it on the company computer and transferred a backup to her personal email, feeling a sense of relief.
location: Office on the 35th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Handled client appointments and email replies.
description: Replied to two client emails, and for a client who wanted to ask about savings insurance, scheduled a meeting at the company for 3 p.m. on the second working day after the holiday.
location: Office on the 35th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Tidied up the workstation and left early for the holiday.
description: Cleaned the desk, organized files, shut down the computer, and put a 'fortune' character sticker on the cubicle partition. With her bag on her shoulder, she said goodbye one by one to colleagues who were still working overtime, wishing each other a Happy New Year and good fortune.
location: Office on the 35th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Commute home and shop for Chinese New Year flowers
description: Walked to Wan Chai MTR Station, took the Island Line and transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to return to Whampoa. After exiting the station, stopped by a corner flower shop on the way to buy three pussy willow branches, planning to decorate the entryway, then walked back to Whampoa Garden.
location: Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Go home to rest and prepare to visit the flower market.
description: When she got home, her mother had already picked up her daughter from school. Yu Xiaowei put down her things, changed into a red casual jacket, and checked her son's homework. Her mother urged her to get ready to go downstairs to meet her father, and she responded with a smile.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: A family visit to the Lunar New Year flower market.
description: The family of six walked to the Lunar New Year flower market on Hau Wong Road, Kowloon City. Father Yu Guoqiang told the children that kumquats symbolize good luck and good fortune, and narcissus symbolizes reunion. Yu Xiaowei bought two pots of narcissus and a peach blossom branch; her husband Zhang Weiming chose gladioli; the children ran around excitedly carrying lantern toys.
location: Lunar New Year Flower Market on Hau Wong Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family dinner and arranging New Year flowers
description: After returning home from the flower market, her mother, Chen Meiling, quickly prepared dinner. Yu Xiaowei, together with her father and husband, trimmed and arranged the new flowers: narcissus beside the TV cabinet, gladioli and pussy willow in a vase at the entrance, and peach blossoms in one corner of the balcony.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Vase broken and emergency handling
description: As everyone was admiring the freshly arranged flowers, their son Zhang Zixuan, helping to pass the old blue-and-white porcelain vase, accidentally tripped on the carpet and the vase shattered. Yu Xiaowei immediately checked whether the child was hurt. After confirming that he was fine, she pretended to be angry but then burst out laughing, and cleaned up the pieces together with her husband Zhang Weiming.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Making the outline for the sharing session
description: She went into the study, spread out the whiteboard paper, and sketched the framework of the sharing session: opening icebreaker, Greater Bay Area policy section, product system section, customer case section, and interactive Q&A. She highlighted the case point “combining Hong Kong medical care with mainland demand,” took a photo, and saved it to her phone.
location: Study room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Parent-child time
description: First go to the daughter's room to read The Little Prince with her and coax her to sleep; then go to the son's room to remind him to check the new clothes he will wear tomorrow, give him a goodnight kiss, and tell him to go to bed early.
location: Children's room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Chatting with mother
description: In the living room, chatted with mother Chen Meiling about the menu and ingredient preparation for tomorrow's Chinese New Year's Eve dinner, said you've worked hard to her, and suggested dining out on the first day of the new year to let her rest. Mother smiled and nodded.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Back in the bedroom, she washed up carefully and applied a hydrating facial mask. Lying in bed, she browsed tomorrow's weather and the family group chat on her phone, feeling cheerful. She went to bed at 23:10 and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction from wrapping up her work and anticipation for the Spring Festival.
location: Bedroom in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning wash-up and preparation
description: At exactly seven o'clock, the alarm went off on time. I turned over and switched off my phone. Since the company had already started its New Year holiday, I didn't need to rush like usual. After a quick wash, I deliberately changed into smart sportswear — I was going to the street market later and wanted to travel light. I tied my hair back in front of the mirror, mentally planning today's menu and training ingredients, with the lightheartedness and anticipation unique to Chinese New Year's Eve.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Buying breakfast, sharing a family breakfast, and assigning tasks
description: Before going out, I greeted my mother Chen Meiling, who had just gotten up, and said I was going to buy breakfast. After a three-minute walk, I arrived at the Jinmaifang Bakery at the entrance to the neighborhood. The uncle there saw me and said with a smile, 'Xiaowei, today is New Year's Eve, so we've got to eat well!' I bought four freshly baked pineapple buns with butter and two egg tarts, and also got a sugar-free steamed bun for my father, who was avoiding sugar. At the Hong Kong-style milk tea stall next door, I ordered two cups of hot milk tea and two cups of hot lemon honey to go. Then I carried two full bags home. Back home, the whole family was already seated at the table, and my mother had made white congee. I shared out the breakfast: I gave my daughter Xinxin half a pineapple bun with butter, and my son Xuanxuan took a whole one himself. While sipping milk tea at the table, I said to my husband Ming, 'Honey, after you finish breakfast, cross the harbor to Kwun Tong to pick up Grandma, and when we get back, we'll prepare together.' Ming nodded and agreed, 'Okay, I'll leave around 10:30 and walk to Whampoa Station to take the MTR.' Then I told my father and mother, 'Dad, help wash the vegetables in a little while; Mom, you're the chief commander, and I'll help out!' Everyone chatted and laughed, and the home was filled with the lively, festive atmosphere of the holiday.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went to the wet market and supermarket to buy high-protein ingredients and daily necessities.
description: After breakfast, I went back to my room and picked up the eco-friendly shopping bag I had prepared, and specially put a small roll of food storage bags and label paper in the inner pocket—this was for portioning frozen ingredients, making it easy to grab them during training after the holiday. I checked my wallet and phone, and after confirming there was still balance on my Octopus card, I put on a cap and left. After walking about 12 minutes, I arrived at the bustling Hau Wong Road market. On the morning of Chinese New Year's Eve, the market was full of bargaining and vendors' shouts. I knew exactly where to go and headed straight to Hui Kee fish stall, my usual stop: "Boss, is the salmon fillet good today?" I picked a thick-cut salmon fillet weighing about two pounds. Then I bought three skinless chicken breasts at the poultry stall next door and specially asked the boss to chop them into small pieces so I could vacuum-seal them directly at home. Then I turned to the vegetable stall and bought two large heads of broccoli, a bag of fresh eggs, and a small bundle of scallions. The whole process took about an hour, and I pushed my small cart, fully loaded. After leaving the market, I went to the nearby ParknShop supermarket as a side trip, found Greek yogurt in the imported food section, and grabbed two large tubs; then picked a pack of unsweetened instant oats from the cereal shelf. At checkout, I scanned my phone for membership points and saved more than ten yuan. After that, I dragged my loaded cart back to Whampoa Garden along the familiar streets. On the way, I saw many shops had put up Spring Festival couplets and "fortune" characters—a strong festive atmosphere.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hau Wong Road Market and ParknShop (Hau Wong Road Branch)

name: Portioning and organizing ingredients, helping with housework, arranging New Year flowers, and supervising children's homework
description: After returning home, my mother was already busy in the kitchen, soaking hair moss and dried oysters. I took off my coat, washed my hands, and immediately started handling the ingredients I had bought. I wrapped the salmon fillets in plastic wrap, one portion per meal, and put them into sealed bags. The chicken breast was divided into two portions—one for today's spicy diced chicken, and the other to be packed and frozen. I washed the broccoli and eggs and put them in the refrigerator crisper drawer. Then I used label paper to write "Salmon fillet - 0128", "Chicken breast (for competition prep)" and so on, and stuck them neatly onto the portion bags. Seeing this, my mother laughed: "You really are organized. You make eating a meal sound like going to work." I smiled and replied, "Mom, I have a race after the holiday, so I have to keep my diet under control!" After that, I walked out of the kitchen and saw the previous day's New Year flower wrapping paper and the children's paintbrushes still piled on the living room coffee table. I took out the narcissus and peach blossoms I had bought yesterday from the storage cabinet and adjusted their positions. Then I called the children over and urged them to do their homework. I sat beside them, opened Xuanxuan's math homework book, and checked it, while reminding Xinxin to practice two lines of calligraphy.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family worked together to prepare the Lunar New Year's Eve dinner
description: At about 12:30, my husband Zhang Weiming brought back my mother-in-law, Li Shufen. As soon as she came in, my mother-in-law rolled up her sleeves and said she would help too. The kitchen immediately became lively. My mother was in charge, deftly preparing the double roast meat platter; my father sat on a small stool quietly washing vegetables; Mingzai was in charge of setting the table, laying out the red tablecloth and arranging the bowls and chopsticks; the children were nearby helping fold dumpling wrappers. I was in charge of cutting the cured meats and making the sauce. Suddenly, while I was slicing lotus root, my hand slipped, and the blade grazed my left index finger; beads of blood immediately welled up. I let out a soft cry. My mother quickly put down the spatula, took a band-aid from the first-aid kit, and wrapped it for me, saying she had told me to be careful. I smiled and said it was fine; seeing blood was a good omen, and red fortune was on its way. After the band-aid was on, I put on disposable gloves and continued mixing the dumpling filling. My mother-in-law and my mother then started wrapping dumplings—my mother-in-law made the traditional gold-ingot shape, while my mother's dumplings had neat, even pleats. The kitchen was very busy, but full of warmth and teamwork.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Changed clothes and rested, prepared offerings, and held the Lunar New Year's Eve ancestral worship ceremony.
description: With all the preparations basically complete, Mother said we could take a break and get ready for the feast. I took the children back to the room and changed them into the bright red new clothes prepared earlier. Xuanxuan wore a Chinese-style Tang jacket, Xinxin wore a red dress, and I also changed into a neat red sweater. After a short rest, Father took out the incense candles and paper ingots he had prepared, and Mother neatly arranged a plate of oranges, a plate of sesame balls, and a plate of roast pork on the shrine. I was responsible for carrying the steamed whole fish, black moss with dried oysters, and the freshly cooked wonton noodles up to the altar one by one. Mingzai lit the incense and candles, and the whole living room was filled with a devout and warm atmosphere. At 4:30 p.m., Father led all of us, in order of seniority, to offer incense and bow before the shrine. Father murmured softly, asking the ancestors to bless the whole family with peace, the children with academic progress, and everything to go smoothly. I made a silent wish: I hoped my family would be healthy, and that in the new year my career would advance further and my marathon results would improve. The children also imitated the bows with earnest expressions.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunar New Year's Eve reunion dinner
description: After paying respects to the ancestors, the last few dishes were quickly brought out. My mother steamed a grouper and also brought out the black moss and dried oyster casserole. I helped chop the roast meat combination into pieces and arrange them on a plate, then poured sauce over it. Mingzai carried the steaming wonton noodles to the table. The whole table was packed full and full of red and festive colors, with fragrance wafting everywhere. At exactly six o'clock, Mingzai turned on the dining room lights, and the whole family sat around the round table. As the one who typically handled external matters, I first picked up a piece of char siu and put it into my mother-in-law's bowl: 'Grandma, thank you for making the trip out specially today.' My mother smiled and invited everyone to eat. As we ate, we chatted. My father told funny stories about his New Year memories from when he was young, making the children giggle. Mingzai suddenly raised his glass and said to me, 'Honey, you've contributed so much to this family this year—working, taking care of the kids, and running the marathon as well. Thank you!' I was a little embarrassed and raised my glass in return. Then my mother-in-law and my mother laughing took out the red envelopes they had prepared long ago and handed them to Xuanxuan and Xinxin: 'Happy New Year! Good grades, and grow up fast and healthy!' The children took the envelopes and answered sweetly: 'Thank you, Grandma! Thank you, Granny!' The whole home was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Strolled along the waterfront promenade to watch the Chinese New Year's Eve fireworks
description: After the New Year's Eve dinner, I suggested going out for a walk to help digest the food. Everyone changed shoes and walked together toward the Hung Hom Promenade behind the estate. The view there was open, and quite a few neighbors had already gathered. As night fell, crackling sounds came from the distance. Suddenly, a golden firework burst in the sky, followed by red and blue ones, decorating the night sky over Victoria Harbour with dazzling colors. The children clapped and screamed excitedly. My father leaned on the railing, beaming with smiles. I nestled against Ming, feeling that this moment was incredibly peaceful, full of reunion and happiness.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Hung Hom Waterfront Promenade, Kowloon City District

name: Gathered around the stove watching the Spring Festival Gala and replying to New Year greetings.
description: After staying in the garden for about half an hour, we felt a bit cold and went home. My mother turned on the TV and switched to the Spring Festival Gala on CCTV. The family sat together on the sofa, cracking sunflower seeds, eating candy, and peeling tangerines while watching skits and listening to songs. During the commercial breaks, I took out my phone, quickly browsed Moments and a few social groups, replied to several important New Year greetings, and sent customized New Year messages to clients abroad. During that time, I received New Year greetings from my colleague Su Lishan and briefly chatted with her about the New Year's Eve dinner.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Staying up for the New Year, exchanging blessings, and making bedtime preparations
description: The children were running low on energy, their eyelids were drooping, but they still insisted on staying up to see the midnight fireworks. Ming took them to wash up first. I chatted with my parents and my mother-in-law for a while, and heard my mother remark that this year's New Year's Eve dinner was livelier than in previous years and that everyone was very happy. I leaned back on the sofa, scrolling through the family photos and firework pictures I had taken on my phone today. As midnight approached, the children were woken up and walked yawning to the balcony. From the distance came the countdown: "Three, two, one!" In that instant, even more splendid fireworks rose in the distant night sky. Everyone cheered: "Happy New Year!" I turned and hugged Ming, whispering in his ear, "Honey, thank you. Let's keep working hard together in the new year." Ming hugged me tightly back. Then I took the prepared red envelopes out of my handbag and handed them to the children: "Be good, hold on to these. In the new year, you must be obedient." Having received their red envelopes, the children lost a bit more of their sleepiness. After the New Year's Eve vigil ended, the adults began to clean up. Ming put the dishes into the kitchen, and I helped pack the leftover food into plastic containers and put them in the fridge. My mother and mother-in-law said their backs were a bit sore, so I had them rest first. After washing my hands, I wiped down the dining table with Ming and swept the fruit peels and scraps off the coffee table. Afterwards, I went into the bathroom, washed my face with hot water, and put on a facial mask, feeling that the fatigue of the whole day had eased considerably. After changing into my pajamas and lying on the bed, I picked up my phone and jotted down a brief note in the memo: "New Year's Eve: the whole family safe and sound, eating well and sleeping well. Happy New Year." Then I turned on my side, looked at the faint lingering glow of fireworks in the distance outside the window, and with a warm heart, full of gratitude and expectation, slowly closed my eyes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family preparation and breakfast.
description: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowei was awakened by the morning light in her bedroom. She checked the small cut on her left index finger from the previous day's vegetable cutting and found it was fine. She then put on a crimson Chinese-style padded jacket, carefully applied makeup, and prepared a small bag full of red envelopes, setting aside enough 20-yuan new bills for her mother-in-law, neighbors, and relatives. Afterward, the family gathered in the dining room. Her mother, Chen Meiling, served steaming hot vegetarian noodles for the first day of the Lunar New Year. The broth was made with shiitake mushrooms, day lily flowers, and tofu, light and delicious. While serving noodles to the children, Yu Xiaowei told them about the custom of eating vegetarian food on Lunar New Year's Day to signify purity and peace. Under her reassurance, her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin obediently finished their bowls. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei handed out red envelopes to the children, and Xuanxuan excitedly thanked her.
location: Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (bedroom and dining room)

name: Set off for Wong Tai Sin Temple
description: Yu Xiaowei checked her belongings again, made sure she had enough red envelopes, told her son Xuanxuan to stay close to his father, and instructed her husband Mingzai to keep an eye on their daughter Xinxin. Then the whole family of six set off by private car, with Mingzai driving, from Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District to Wong Tai Sin Temple. On the morning of the first day of the Lunar New Year, traffic on the road surged, and the streets were decorated with lanterns and banners, full of festive atmosphere. In the car, Yu Xiaowei told the children about the history of Wong Tai Sin Temple and the etiquette of drawing fortune lots. Xuanxuan was full of curiosity. After about 45 minutes of slow driving, they arrived at the parking lot beside the temple.
location: On the way from the garage of Whampoa Garden residential estate in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple in Wong Tai Sin District.

name: New Year prayer at Wong Tai Sin Temple
description: The family arrived at the crowded Wong Tai Sin Temple, thick with incense smoke, and squeezed to the front of the main hall to offer incense devoutly. Yu Xiaowei silently prayed for her family's health and successful careers. She then queued to draw a fortune stick and got a medium-fortune lot. The fortune teller interpreted it as "Sow in spring, reap in autumn; don't rush, don't fret; only by waiting patiently will you get good results." Yu Xiaowei looked thoughtful. When she stood up, she ran into her high school classmate Wang Zhiyuan. The two exchanged New Year wishes in surprise, swapped red envelopes, and agreed to meet for dim sum after the holiday. The children were a bit bored, so Yu Xiaowei comforted them and took them to see the bronze statues in the temple.
location: Main Hall and fortune-stick area, Wong Tai Sin Temple, Wong Tai Sin District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Buy dim sum and head to mother-in-law's home
description: After leaving Wong Tai Sin Temple, Ming drove to Kowloon City. Yu Xiaowei got out and went to the familiar Qi Xiang Bakery, where she queued to buy freshly baked egg tarts, wife cakes, and two boxes of the signature walnut cookies as gifts. The children, sitting in the car, could smell the baked goods and were eager to eat. The family then continued by car along Prince Edward Road East, turned onto Kwun Tong Road, and headed for Kwun Tong District. About 30 minutes later, they arrived on Hong Ning Road. Ming parked in the visitor parking space at Golden Bridge Mansion. Yu Xiaowei carried the pastries, and the whole family took the elevator upstairs.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, at Qixiang Bakery on Fuk Lo Tsun Road, Kowloon City District, and then on the way to Kam Kiu Mansion, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District.

name: Lunar New Year visit and lunch at mother-in-law's home
description: As the elevator doors opened, laughter and cheerful voices came out. My mother-in-law Li Shufen, wearing a brand-new deep red padded jacket, greeted them with a beaming smile. Yu Xiaowei and Mingzai wished her a happy New Year, good health, and vigorous energy, and the children also offered blessings. Yu Xiaowei handed over red envelopes and snacks, and her mother-in-law was grinning from ear to ear. Neighbors Mrs. Zhang and Uncle Liu came by to pay New Year calls, and her mother-in-law proudly introduced Yu Xiaowei as a top insurance professional. Lunch was the traditional New Year dishes her mother-in-law had made by hand: turnip cake, fried taro shrimp, fried sesame balls, fried egg crisps, and hair seaweed, dried oyster, and pork trotter soup. Urged on by the warm hospitality, Yu Xiaowei ate several pieces of turnip cake.
location: Residence of mother-in-law Li Shufen, Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leisure time: listening to Lunar New Year customs and playing downstairs.
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother-in-law in the living room. Her mother-in-law brought out homemade salted citrus to make tea and talked about the New Year customs in the New Territories when she was young, such as 'selling laziness' and 'lighting lanterns'. Yu Xiaowei listened with great interest. The children clamored to go downstairs to play, so Mingzai took Xuanxuan and Xinxin to the garden downstairs to play on the slide and chase around with the other children. Yu Xiaowei watched them through the window and smiled with relief, while keeping an eye on the time and planning to leave and go home before 16:00.
location: The living room and the garden downstairs at her mother-in-law's home, Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Said goodbye to mother-in-law and returned home
description: Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her mother-in-law reluctantly, and her mother-in-law pressed a bag of homemade turnip cakes into her hands to take home. The family drove back to Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District. On the way, Yu Xiaowei received a WeChat message from her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng confirming that he would arrive at West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station at 10:00 tomorrow. She immediately replied with 'Got it, see you tomorrow!'
location: On the way from Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home to rest and plan tomorrow's reception
description: Returning home, the children immediately turned on the TV to watch cartoons. Yu Xiaowei took off her coat, changed into loungewear, and put the turnip cake and snacks her mother-in-law had given her into the fridge. Feeling tired, she rested on the sofa for a while, drinking the warm water her mother handed her and mentally planning tomorrow's hosting details. Then she discussed tomorrow's arrangements with her husband Mingzai: confirmed that her younger brother Xiaofeng would arrive at 10 o'clock, planned to leave at 9:30 for West Kowloon Station, have yum cha at noon at New Star Seafood Restaurant in Whampoa New Town, and take her younger brother's family for a walk along the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade in the afternoon. Mingzai suggested calling ahead to book a table, and the two finally settled on the plan.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Simple dinner and casual chat with family
description: At dinner time, her mother Chen Meiling reheated the turnip cake and crispy egg pastries that her mother-in-law had given at noon, stir-fried a plate of greens, and cooked plain congee. After the family had a simple dinner, Yu Xiaowei and Mingzai continued discussing the details of tomorrow, such as whether to take the younger brother's family to the Tsim Sha Tsui Avenue of Stars or the Peak first. The children played with newly bought toys in the living room, and the whole scene was warm and peaceful.
location: Dining room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Watch Lunar New Year programs and reply to New Year greetings
description: The family huddled together on the sofa watching TVB's Chinese New Year special program, with songs, dances, skits, and artist interviews appearing in turn. Xuanxuan laughed heartily, and Xinxin snuggled in Yu Xiaowei's arms. While watching the show, Yu Xiaowei replied to friends' New Year greetings on her phone. Seeing the message from her brother Xiaofeng asking to confirm arrival time, she simply replied with the home address so he could take a taxi.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bathing the child and preparing for bedtime
description: Yu Xiaowei first gave her daughter Xinxin a hot bath and helped her put on cute dinosaur pajamas. Then Mingzai gave her son Xuanxuan a bath. Yu Xiaowei told a bedtime story about the “Nian Beast” beside the children’s beds and reminded them that their uncle would come tomorrow and they should be polite little hosts. The children nodded obediently.
location: Bathroom and children's room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime personal tidying and rest
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, checked her phone to make sure tomorrow's alarm was set, and lay in bed reviewing the fulfilling day. Though busy, she felt content and happy inside. She said softly to Mingzai, who was also getting ready for bed, Happy New Year. You will have to do the driving again tomorrow. Mingzai responded. The two turned off the lights and went to sleep, drifting off with beautiful hopes for the new year.
location: Master bedroom, Block 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning health check and family breakfast
description: After getting up in the morning, Yu Xiaowei stepped on the scale and recorded 55.7 kg, and checked that the wound on her left index finger had fully healed, feeling relaxed. Then, her mother Chen Meiling had prepared turnip cake, BBQ pork buns, and Pu'er tea for breakfast. Yu Xiaowei asked her son Zhang Zixuan whether the sign for picking up at the station was done. Zhang Zixuan took out the hand-drawn sign reading "Welcome Uncle Xiaofeng" that he had carefully made the night before. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin also playfully asked to hold the sign together. The family atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare to pick someone up and drive to West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station
description: Yu Xiaowei helped the two children put on festive red Tang suits and checked her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's WeChat messages again to confirm that high-speed train G6385 would arrive at 10:00. After the family prepared items such as a station pickup sign and red packets, her husband Zhang Weiming drove the family car. Yu Xiaowei sat in the passenger seat, the children sat in the back, and they played New Year songs all the way to West Kowloon Station, about a 20-minute drive.
location: While driving from Kowloon City District to Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Picking up relatives at West Kowloon Station and reuniting with them.
description: Yu Xiaowei's family of four waited in the arrival hall holding a welcome sign, with Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin each holding one side—a warm scene. Yu Xiaowei noticed an elderly man carrying heavy luggage and took the initiative to help. Around 10:00, Yu Xiaofeng, Chen Sufen, and Yu Xiaojie appeared on time. The children waved the sign excitedly. Everyone hugged and greeted one another, exchanged red envelopes and New Year wishes. Her younger brother also handed over Longjing tea leaves and a children's jigsaw puzzle brought from Shenzhen as gifts.
location: Arrival Hall, Level B3, Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, Austin Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drive back to Whampoa Garden and have a family reunion to catch up.
description: On the way back, Yu Xiaofeng sat in the front passenger seat to chat easily with Yu Xiaowei, sharing the New Year atmosphere in Shenzhen. After arriving home, the family gathered with their parents and exchanged New Year greetings. Chen Meiling prepared tea snacks such as turnip cake and sesame balls. The adults enjoyed tea and caught up, while the children played with the remote-controlled car brought by Yu Xiaojie. Yu Xiaowei privately asked about her younger brother's recent situation, and Yu Xiaofeng voluntarily offered to share part of the hotel expenses for the Japan trip, which deeply moved Yu Xiaowei.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family yum cha gathering at New Star Seafood Restaurant
description: Yu Xiaowei suggested going to the nearby Xinxing Seafood Hot Pot Restaurant (Keronglou Branch) for yum cha, and the whole family walked there. They ordered classic dim sum such as shrimp dumplings, rice noodle rolls, siu mai, BBQ pork buns, and spring rolls. Everyone chatted about everything; her younger brother and Zhang Weiming had a lively conversation, and the children competed for the fried spring rolls. When the bill came, her brother rushed to pay, but Yu Xiaowei insisted on treating everyone as the host. The atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: New Star Seafood Hot Pot Restaurant (Kerong House), Man Tai Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-dinner walk and a short rest at home
description: The whole family walked back to Whampoa Garden from the restaurant. Yu Xiaowei showed her younger brother and his family the estate’s Spring Festival decorations, and the children played on the slide in the playground. After getting home, the adults rested briefly while the children played in the toy room. Yu Xiaowei quietly moved the old sports equipment she planned to sort through in the evening (dumbbells, yoga mat, running shoes) to the door for later.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate and surrounding areas

name: Rest briefly and take a taxi to the Victoria Park Lunar New Year flower market
description: Yu Xiaowei reminded everyone to change into sports shoes and helped the children put on non-slip shoes. Zhang Weiming called two Ubers on his phone: one carried Yu Xiaowei, Chen Meiling, and the two children; the other carried Yu Guoqiang and Yu Xiaofeng's family. The drive took about 15 minutes, and the two families met near Victoria Park at 14:30, ready to browse the Lunar New Year market.
location: Inside a taxi from Kowloon City District to Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Strolling through the Victoria Park Lunar New Year Flower Market
description: The Lunar New Year market was packed with people and filled with the fragrance of flowers. Yu Xiaowei bought small pinwheels for the children, picked out pussy willow for herself, and her mother Chen Meiling bought a pot of narcissus. During this time, Yu Xiaofeng again pulled Yu Xiaowei aside and insisted on sharing the hotel costs for the Japan trip. Moved, Yu Xiaowei held her younger brother's hand and thanked him. The whole family chatted and laughed, returning home fully loaded.
location: Lunar New Year Fair, Victoria Park, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home and helping with dinner preparations
description: The family took a taxi back to Whampoa Garden. In the car, Yu Xiaowei sent a WeChat message to her running friend Shen Peiwen saying she was starting to organize her gear for the new year of running. After arriving home, she went into the kitchen to help her mother and her younger brother's wife prepare family dishes such as stir-fried crab with ginger and scallion and soy sauce chicken. She was especially careful when cutting ginger into thin strips and reminded her mother to use less oil and salt for a healthy diet. In the living room, Zhang Weiming and Yu Xiaofeng watched the news while the children did puzzles together.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm family dinner.
description: The whole family sat around the table enjoying a hearty dinner. Yu Xiaowei toasted with tea instead of wine to thank her younger brother's family for gathering, her parents for their hard work, and her husband for his efforts. During the meal, everyone shared funny stories and laughed merrily. Yu Xiaowei casually mentioned to her brother the idea of the two families going to Japan together during the summer vacation. After dinner, her parents cleared the dishes, and Yu Xiaowei and her sister-in-law cut fruit. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-dinner parent-child activities and board game preparation
description: The children played with new puzzles and pinwheels in the living room, while the adults sat around chatting. Yu Xiaowei played a rerun of the Spring Festival Gala as background audio and brought out the board games Monopoly and UNO to get ready. Meanwhile, she went to the kitchen to brew pu'er tea and opened the storage room door for ventilation, preparing to organize sports equipment later.
location: Living room and kitchen in the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Fun Board Game Night
description: Yu Xiaowei served as the banker. Zhang Weiming and Yu Xiaofeng kept bantering with each other, and everyone clapped and cheered when Chen Sufen drew a Chance card. Mother Chen Meiling watched for a while before going back to her room to rest, and Zhang Weiming took the children to the room to watch cartoons. After Monopoly ended, Yu Xiaofeng won, and then everyone played UNO for another half an hour, with a lively and enthusiastic atmosphere.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing workout gear rekindled fitness enthusiasm.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked alone to the storage room, took out the 5 kg dumbbells and yoga mat and wiped them carefully, and checked the soles of her running shoes, finding little wear. She took photos of her workout gear and sent them to her running partner Shen Peiwen, expressing her intention to start running again after the New Year. Shen Peiwen immediately replied with encouragement. Then she laid the yoga mat flat, took a photo, and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption "Second day of the New Year, finding my athletic spirit again", visible only to close friends.
location: Near the storage room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Washing up, relaxing, and online socializing
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the master bedroom and soaked her feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue. While scrolling through Moments, she found that her running photos had received quite a few likes, including from colleague Su Lishan and clients. She casually replied to several New Year greeting messages. Her husband Zhang Weiming then also came into the room to wash up.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparations and a cozy good night's sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei reminded Zhang Weiming to arrange the children's interest classes the next day, checked the weather, and put down her phone. The couple talked about the joy of the family reunion that day and felt fulfilled and satisfied. After the lights were turned off at 23:30, Yu Xiaowei thought about how touched she was that her younger brother had shared the travel expenses. With gratitude and good expectations for the new year, she fell into a deep sleep at 23:50.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally. Outside the window it was cloudy but warm and comfortable. To welcome the last day of the holiday, while her family was still resting, she got up, washed up, changed clothes, put on her quick-dry sportswear and running shoes, grabbed her running belt and water bottle, and got ready for her morning run.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Easy morning run
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from home to the Hung Hom Promenade. After a simple warm-up, she jogged 3 km along the waterfront promenade at a steady pace of 7:10 min/km. Along the way, she smiled and greeted neighbors who were exercising. After the run, she stretched by the railing at the viewing platform for 5 minutes, took a photo and sent it to her running buddy Shen Peiwen, and then walked home.
location: Hung Hom Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home, washed up, and helped prepare for morning tea.
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei greeted her mother and helped her boil water to make tea, while separately they prepared their going-out items: she put her phone, red envelopes, and other things into her crossbody bag, helped the children sort out their fleece jackets, and checked the luggage. During this time, the neighbor auntie called to pay New Year greetings, and they chatted briefly.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family went to a restaurant for morning tea to see off my younger brother.
description: The family walked to Xinxing Seafood Restaurant, booked a booth, and ordered Tieguanyin tea and dim sum such as shrimp dumplings and siu mai. During the meal, the children shared funny stories and the adults chatted about return-to-work plans. The younger brother's family would return to Shenzhen in the afternoon, and Yu Xiaowei offered to help call a car to Hung Hom Station.
location: New Star Seafood Restaurant, Basement 1, Whampoa Square, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Seeing off my younger brother's family at Hung Hom Station
description: After yum cha, the group walked to Whampoa Station and took the East Rail line one stop to Hung Hom Station. Yu Xiaowei helped her younger brother push his luggage to the gate, hugged her brother and sister-in-law goodbye, and told her nephew to study hard. After watching them go through the gates, she walked back to Whampoa Garden with her parents, comforting her mother along the way.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom Station concourse

name: Returning Home to Rest and Organize the Guest Room
description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother cleaned up the guest room where her younger brother's family had slept. They folded quilts, removed pillowcases, collected dirty sheets and towels, and sorted the toys. They started the washing machine to wash the bedding. During a break, they drank salted lemon water and chatted about how her younger brother was doing.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family rest and preparation
description: After washing and hanging the bed sheets, Yu Xiaowei went to the living room. Her father was watching horse racing, her husband was helping their son build LEGO, and her daughter was drawing a family portrait. Yu Xiaowei praised her daughter and joined in. She replied to clients' New Year greetings on WeChat and listed in her notepad the items to bring for the afternoon trip to Sham Shui Po.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Simple lunch
description: Mother took out the dim sum packed from morning tea, and served it with pumpkin, millet, and multigrain porridge, roast pork, and lettuce. The whole family sat around the table to eat. After the meal, Mother cleared the dishes. Yu Xiaowei asked her husband to play chess with her father, then went back to her room and changed into a red sweater.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took the children to rest and prepared items for going out
description: After changing clothes, Yu Xiaowei let her child take a half-hour nap, then packed her small backpack with a change of clothes, a water bottle, and wet wipes, and put her running shoes on the balcony to air. She told her daughter the story of a sika deer paying New Year visits, and during that time received a reply from her running buddy Shen Peiwen, and they encouraged each other.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take a ride to my best friend's home in Sham Shui Po
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her backpack, took her children by the hand and left home, walked to Whampoa Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line, got out at Sham Shui Po Station Exit B2, walked past Pei Ho Street to buy walnut cookies as a gift, and then arrived at Changfa Building.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, to Cheong Fat Building, 8 Fuk Wing Street, Sham Shui Po District, via MTR Whampoa Station, Mong Kok Station, and Sham Shui Po Station.

name: New Year's greetings and baking fun with best friend Lin Jiaxin.
description: Jiaxin warmly welcomed us and brought out New Year snacks such as fried laughing-date pastries and sugar rings. The child played with Jiaxin's daughter while the two women sat on the sofa chatting about red envelope amounts, running for weight loss, and Cantonese embroidery tips. In the afternoon, on a whim, they made black tea cookies; Jiaxin mistook salt for sugar, making the dough salty and bitter. The two of them laughed at the failure and thoroughly enjoyed themselves.
location: Flat B, 12th Floor, Cheong Fat Building, 8 Fuk Wing Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took her leave and returned to Whampoa Garden.
description: Yu Xiaowei packs up her things. The children say goodbye reluctantly, and after thanking Jiaxin for her hospitality, she takes her son and daughter back on the same route by subway. On the way, she buys fish balls for her son at a convenience store, while her daughter has a rice bowl cake. They feel happy.
location: From Cheong Fat Building, 8 Fuk Wing Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, via Sham Shui Po Station, Mong Kok Station, and Ho Man Tin Station.

name: Return home to rest and organize belongings
description: When she got home, Zhang Weiming opened the door; he had already reheated the dinner dishes her mother had left. Yu Xiaowei hung up her coat, washed her hands, drank some water, and sat down to rest for a while. She sent Jiaxin a message joking about the 'salted fish cookies,' and Jiaxin immediately replied with a crying-laughing emoji.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: The family of five sat around the dinner table. The mother reheated the beef brisket pot and turnip cake and steamed Chinese sausages. The children shared games they played at Jiaxin's house, and the daughter drew a ‘Fried Cookie Monster.’ Yu Xiaowei helped serve the children food. After dinner, her husband washed the dishes while she went into the kitchen to cut fruit.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family walk along the waterfront promenade
description: Yu Xiaowei suggested that the whole family put on jackets and go for a walk. The daughter rode a bicycle, the son rode a scooter, and the couple followed side by side, enjoying the night view of Victoria Harbour. The children picked up seashells. The walk took about 40 minutes, and they talked about the next day's school arrangements.
location: Hung Hom Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Help the children shower and tell them bedtime stories
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowei ran warm water to bathe her daughter while her husband washed their son. After putting her daughter in pajamas and blow-drying her hair, she read the picture book The Story of the Spring Festival, and the child listened with great interest. Then she tucked in the quilt and turned off the light, and her daughter softly whispered New Year wishes.
location: Flat A, 6/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal relaxation and errands
description: Yu Xiaowei took a shower and did her skincare routine, applied a face mask, played soft music out loud, brewed chamomile tea, and after changing into loungewear, she used her tablet in the living room to edit today's walking photos, sent them to the family group chat, and checked the items she needed for work the next day, such as her employee badge and makeup bag.
location: Master bedroom and living room, Flat A, 6th Floor, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Check tomorrow's return-to-work arrangements and set the alarm.
description: At her bedroom desk, Yu Xiaowei opened the calendar on her phone and confirmed that tomorrow, the fourth day of the Lunar New Year, work had resumed, with an internal meeting at 9:00. She used a map app to predict travel time, planned to leave at 7:25, and expected to arrive at the AIA Building in Wan Chai at 8:15. She organized the customer follow-up and policy underwriting checklists, and set alarms for 7:00 and 7:05.
location: At the desk in the bedroom, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Relaxing in bed and organizing thoughts
description: Yu Xiaowei lay in bed, first chatted with her mother and reminded her father to take his blood pressure medication, then sent Lin Jiaxin a WeChat message teasing about the 'salt incident', and they exchanged goodnights. Then she checked Moments and liked a photo-text post from the third day of the New Year. When she learned that her sister-in-law had arrived home safely, she felt at ease. She turned off her phone, reviewed the warm moments of the day, and gained peace for the next day's work.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: Yu Xiaowei felt drowsy, took a few deep breaths, relaxed her muscles, calmed her mind, and gradually fell asleep, saving energy for work the next morning.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time and shopping preparations
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning and chatted with her husband Zhang Weiming about the plans for today's reunion with her younger brother's family. Seeing the thin morning light outside the window, she felt at ease. Then she got out of bed, spread the yoga mat by the living room window, and did a 10-minute full-body stretch, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and back. After that, she went into the kitchen, where her mother Chen Meiling had already brewed hot pu-erh tea. While drinking tea, she discussed the day's menu with her mother and decided on steamed grouper, turnip cake, white cut chicken, and cherries. Then she returned to the bedroom, changed into a comfortable hoodie and running shoes, and quickly recorded her shopping list on her phone: seafood, fruit, New Year goods, and kumquat and silver willow branches. She also checked her phone messages, replied to the New Year greetings in the AIA work group, and reminded her colleagues about tomorrow's return-to-work arrangements.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walked to the fresh fruit shop on Hau Wong Road to buy fruit and Lunar New Year goods.
description: Carrying reusable shopping bags and a trolley, she set off with her mother and husband from Whampoa Garden, walking through a lively old neighborhood toward Hau Wong Road. On the way, she chatted with her mother about the traffic for her younger brother Xiaofeng's family returning to Hong Kong from Shenzhen, and her husband mentioned that the MTR East Rail Line was operating normally, so the trip should go smoothly. As the sunlight grew brighter, they passed a cha chaan teng that had already opened, with the aroma of pineapple buns and milk tea wafting out. After arriving at 66 Fresh Fruit Store, they picked three large boxes of organic strawberries and a bag of cherries at the fruit stall. Her mother then weighed out half a catty of shredded squid, a pack of sweet egg pastries, and peanut candy at the dried goods stall next door. They lingered from stall to stall and returned fully loaded.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 66 Hau Wong Road, fresh fruit shop

name: Went to Mong Kok Flower Market to buy additional New Year flowers.
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming drove, taking Yu Xiaowei and her mother to Mong Kok Flower Market. There was little traffic on the way, so they arrived quickly. The market was bustling with people and full of spring atmosphere. The three walked into a familiar shop. Yu Xiaowei picked a potted kumquat tree and three bundles of silver willow branches; her mother liked a bunch of pink gladioli and said they would go well with the narcissus at home. While bargaining, Yu Xiaowei also took photos to send to her younger brother and friends. After paying, her husband helped carry the items and carefully loaded the New Year flowers into the trunk.
location: Flower Market Road, Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home and organize the purchased items
description: Drove back home to Whampoa Garden from Mong Kok Flower Market. After arriving, divided up the tidying: Mother washed the fruit they had bought and put it in a fruit basket; Yu Xiaowei put dried goods such as shredded squid into the snack cabinet and lightly wiped the living room vases and ornaments to prepare for the later decoration.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Decorating the home and preparing to welcome her younger brother and his family
description: Her mother began preparing the slow-cooked soup and steamed fish. Yu Xiaowei arranged the New Year flowers in the living room: a kumquat tree placed beside the TV cabinet, silver willow branches in a tall vase by the corner, and gladiolus and narcissus set together. The living room instantly felt full of spring. Her husband Zhang Weiming helped move furniture to make space. Her father Yu Guoqiang came back from playing chess outside and happily mentioned that her younger brother would arrive at noon. After the decoration was done, Yu Xiaowei took a panoramic photo and sent it to the family WeChat group. Her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin ran over to ask when their uncle would arrive, and Yu Xiaowei smiled and reassured them.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take a short break and handle work messages
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, she drank a glass of warm water, took out her phone, quickly replied to several clients' New Year greeting messages, and confirmed with Shen Peiwen and others in the running group chat that they would resume their morning run tomorrow, agreeing to meet at 6:30 tomorrow morning at the Hung Hom waterfront.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Younger brother's family arrives, family reunion dinner and conversation
description: The doorbell rang. Yu Xiaowei hurried to open the door and welcome her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and his family—her brother was carrying her little nephew, and her sister-in-law was holding their elder daughter's hand, laughter and chatter filling the doorway. She gave everyone a red envelope, and her brother returned red packets to Xuanxuan and Xinxin. Her mother came out of the kitchen to greet them warmly, and her husband put the Shenzhen specialty rice cakes her brother had brought into the refrigerator. Then the family reunion dinner cooked by her mother officially began: steamed grouper, white-cut chicken, stir-fried Chinese broccoli, braised beef brisket, turnip cake, and a platter of cherries and strawberries. The whole family sat around the table; the elders were the first to pick up their chopsticks, and the children helped themselves to their favorite dishes. During the meal, her brother talked about his life in Shenzhen and switching jobs last year to become an Internet project manager. Her father asked about his income, and Xiaowei smoothed things over. Her brother also asked about her insurance career in Hong Kong, and she smiled and said she was researching insurtech on the mainland. The atmosphere was lively and warm.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Younger brother shared insurtech in mainland China; we had an in-depth exchange and learning session.
description: After the meal, everyone moved to the living room. Her younger brother took out his phone and proactively shared mainland insurance technology. He opened an app from a mainland insurance company and demonstrated the intelligent underwriting process on the spot: after uploading a medical examination report, AI automatically identified risk points and gave underwriting suggestions; he also showed the online claims function, where taking photos and uploading medical documents allowed the system to complete the review within a short time. Yu Xiaowei listened intently, took the phone to examine the interface carefully, and from time to time asked questions about customer privacy and security and the applicability of the technology in Hong Kong. Her brother patiently explained technical details such as big-data risk control and blockchain evidence storage. Meanwhile, her mother brought hot tea and dried squid strips, and her sister-in-law also added her own experiences with mobile payment and electronic medical records in mainland hospitals. When the exchange ended, Yu Xiaowei marveled that she should study it seriously, and even hoped to cooperate with her brother to develop new business.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Clearing the dining table and playing with the children
description: After her mother and sister-in-law finished cleaning up the tableware, Yu Xiaowei suggested they rest, and she walked to the balcony to accompany the two children. Xuanxuan and Xinxin were playing with building blocks. Yu Xiaowei sat down and built a 'space base' with them, adding their respective LEGO pieces, having a great time. She also took a few group photos, and the children laughed happily when they saw the pictures.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family leisure and rest time.
description: Leaving the children in her husband's care, Yu Xiaowei sat on the sofa, drank a glass of warm water, and closed her eyes to rest for 10 minutes. Her younger brother chatted with her father in the living room about international news; her mother and sister-in-law sorted out New Year goods in the kitchen; her husband continued playing with building blocks with the two children in the room. The family enjoyed a brief and warm moment of relaxation.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Saw off my younger brother's family.
description: As the afternoon grew late, her younger brother's family prepared to return to Shenzhen. The whole family saw them off at the entrance of the residential complex downstairs. Yu Xiaowei held her little nephew and gave him a kiss, telling him to be good and say goodbye to his cousins. After exchanging red envelopes, her brother waved and said they would get together again next time. Watching their car drive away, Yu Xiaowei felt both emotional and warm. Back inside, the house suddenly fell quiet, and the children leaned against her.
location: Entrance to Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon free time and rest
description: After going back inside, Yu Xiaowei first helped her mother put away the remaining ingredients, then went to her room and turned on the computer. Taking advantage of the quiet moment, she organized the key points of the insurtech demo her brother had shown into her notebook. During that time, she received a call from her running buddy Shen Peiwen to confirm the next morning's run time. She replied that she'd meet her at the Hung Hom waterfront at 6:30 a.m. After spending about 40 minutes organizing, she stood up and stretched her shoulders. The family cat jumped lightly onto the desk and rubbed against her hand. She smiled, stroked the cat, and playfully teased it for a few minutes.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Simple family dinner.
description: Mother used the fresh shrimp bought in the morning to make shrimp scrambled eggs, stir-fried pea sprouts, and a pot of rice porridge, with dried squid strips as a side dish. The whole family sat together to eat. Father mentioned winning a game of chess today; the kids raced to see who would finish first; the atmosphere was relaxed. Yu Xiaowei and her husband talked about returning to work tomorrow, and her husband joked that he would take her and the children to school before going to work.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time: building LEGO and drawing
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei washed the strawberries she had bought in the morning and placed them by the coffee table. Xuanxuan took out his newly bought space-themed Lego and said he wanted to build a rocket model; Xinxin got out crayons and drew a picture, depicting the younger brother’s family together this afternoon. She sat among the children, helping Xuanxuan find pieces while praising Xinxin for drawing so vividly, capturing the little nephew in the younger brother’s arms lifelike. Her husband took photos beside them. These 40 minutes let her completely relax and temporarily put down work.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening Work and Study: Submitting Underwriting Cases and Organizing InsurTech Notes
description: While the children and her husband went to take a shower, Yu Xiaowei returned to the study and turned on the computer. She first logged into the AIA system, checked and submitted three insurance policies for underwriting one by one: Mrs. Chen's education insurance, Mr. Wang's critical illness insurance, and Miss Zhou's savings insurance. After submission, the system showed "Underwriting in progress." She then organized the to-do list for returning to work tomorrow, writing down "9:00 internal meeting (need to follow up on meeting minutes)," "14:30 phone follow-up with Mrs. Chen," and "organize insurtech materials for a briefing." Next, she replied to client Mrs. Chen's New Year greetings, attached a photo of today's flower scenery, and arranged to meet next week. After that, she spent more than two hours thoroughly reviewing the insurtech content her brother had shared and wrote down three action items in her notebook: proactively invite colleague Su Lishan to lunch next Monday for a chat, research cross-border insurance regulatory policies between Mainland China and Hong Kong, and prepare a 30-minute sharing outline to propose a sharing session to Regional Director Liang Zhenhua. During this time, the cat jumped onto the desk twice asking for pets. Each time she stopped to play with it for a few minutes before continuing.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family interaction, writing a gratitude journal, and planning tomorrow.
description: She left the study and returned to the master bedroom, where her husband was already lying in bed and asked if she was tired. As she wrote in her gratitude journal, she remarked how fulfilling the day had been, especially the content shared by her younger brother, which was very inspiring. The journal recorded three things to be grateful for: her younger brother's family had reunited safely, her mother had prepared a sumptuous New Year meal, and she herself had explored a new direction. After writing, she opened her phone and set tomorrow's alarm back to 6:00, confirming that after taking the children to school in the morning she would go to the company. Her husband urged her to rest early, and she responded, okay.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei went into the bathroom to wash up, applied warm water to her face, and put on hand cream. Back in bed, she checked that her work phone was on silent and that the insurance system was logged in properly, and mentally ran through tomorrow's schedule: dropping off the kids, an online meeting, and client follow-ups. The possibility of cross-border business still lingered in her mind, but drowsiness gradually set in. Her husband said goodnight, and she softly replied. The cat nestled against the foot of the bed, and she fell asleep peacefully with a smile on her lips.
location: Whampoa Garden residence, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning routine and departure
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up at her home in Whampoa Garden at 7:30 in the morning, did full-body stretches to wake up her body, changed into a fluorescent green quick-dry T-shirt and black sports pants, and put on her sports watch. She went to the living room, drank warm water, and enjoyed the view of the Hung Hom Promenade outside the window. Then she sat on the living room sofa, quickly checked her phone, confirmed that her running friend Shen Peiwen had already set off, and after replying to WeChat, she took her keys and phone, left home, and walked to the Hung Hom Promenade.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 7, 6th Floor, Flat A

name: Morning run and return home
description: Yu Xiaowei met her running partner Shen Peiwen along the Hung Hom Waterfront Promenade. After warming up for five minutes, they started their morning run at a pace of about 7:30 per kilometer, covering 5 kilometers while chatting and sharing stories about the Spring Festival. After the run, they stretched on a seaside bench and enjoyed the view of Victoria Harbour. She then walked back to her home in Whampoa Garden. In the living room, she drank water and wiped off sweat, saw her husband Zhang Weiming playing with Lego with the children, and her mother Chen Meiling preparing breakfast, and felt the warmth of family.
location: Hung Hom Waterfront Promenade and Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning home tidying and family interaction.
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into casual home clothes and, together with her mother Chen Meiling, tidied up the spring couplets and New Year paintings in the living room, sorting and arranging the New Year goods onto plates. She also stripped and washed the bed sheets and duvet covers from the guest room where her younger brother had stayed, and vacuumed the floor, while humming New Year songs and chatting with her mother about insurance technology in mainland China. In between, she playfully teased her husband, who was building LEGO with the children. Her husband Zhang Weiming praised her for looking energetic, and Yu Xiaowei responded that the morning jog had been comfortable.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 7, 6th Floor, Flat A

name: Family activities and schoolwork check
description: After taking a shower and changing into clean loungewear, Yu Xiaowei helped her son Zhang Zixuan check his winter vacation homework in the study, patiently correcting calculation errors in the math word problems and explaining the logic. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin was drawing a picture of “a family of four running on the waterfront promenade” nearby, and Yu Xiaowei praised and encouraged her.
location: Study, Flat A, 6/F, Tower 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family Lunch and the "Sending Off Poverty" Ritual
description: The whole family sat together for lunch. Mother Chen Meiling steamed turnip cake, braised beef brisket, and stir-fried choy sum. Yu Xiaowei chatted with her husband about the morning run, mentioning the traditional 'sending off poverty' custom on the fifth day of the New Year, and planned to throw away the sorted trash before going out in the afternoon. Mother reminded her to keep warm at the afternoon class reunion.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 7, 6/F, Flat A, dining room

name: Preparing for the children and family rest
description: Yu Xiaowei gave her son and daughter hot baths and changed them into festive Tang suits. She then reminded her husband that there was chicken and corn soup in the fridge that he could heat up for the children. Then she returned to the master bedroom and began preparing for the afternoon class reunion.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Flat A, 6/F, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare for the class reunion.
description: Yu Xiaowei spent half an hour in the master bedroom putting on light makeup, choosing a beige cardigan, pearl earrings, and dark blue straight-leg trousers, which made her look gentle and elegant. She put the pre-prepared family portrait and two boxes of traditional egg rolls as gifts into her tote bag, then stood in front of the dressing mirror to tidy herself up.
location: Master bedroom, Unit A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Before departure: "sending away poverty" and confirmation
description: Yu Xiaowei took the Spring Festival decoration waste and old newspapers she had sorted out in the morning to the door and threw them away, completing the custom of sending off poverty. Back in the living room, she drank some water and checked the items in her bag (wallet, phone, keys, makeup bag, gifts). Her husband Zhang Weiming reminded her that it was almost time to leave and that the bus stop was a few minutes' walk away. Yu Xiaowei nodded in agreement.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 7, 6th Floor, Flat A

name: Took a bus to Mong Kok.
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her beige trench coat and walked alone for 8 minutes to the Prince Edward Road West bus stop, then took KMB Route 1A toward Mong Kok. There were not many passengers on the bus, so she found a seat, took out her phone to reply to New Year greetings in work group chats, and reviewed the list of clients she needed to follow up on when work resumed the next day.
location: KMB Route 1A from Prince Edward Road West bus stop, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District.

name: Leisurely shopping and heading to Xinghui Hotel
description: After arriving in Mong Kok, Yu Xiaowei strolled along Flower Market Road. After the Chinese New Year, the flower market still had discounted festive flowers. She admired the moth orchids and felt the spring atmosphere. At a Taiwanese-style drink shop, she bought a hot lemon honey drink, sat by the window watching the street scene, and browsed the morning run photos on her phone. She then walked to the vicinity of Star Glory Hotel to confirm the location, and after a 4-minute walk arrived at Star Glory Hotel at 17:30.
location: Near Starlight Hotel at 578 Nathan Road and Flower Market Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: High school classmates' Chinese New Year dinner and farewell
description: Gathered happily with six old classmates including Zhou Minyi, He Junjie, and Wang Zhiyuan in a private room on the second floor of Xinghui Hotel. Zhou Minyi shared the demand in Shenzhen's finance circle for Hong Kong high-end medical and savings insurance, suggested Yu Xiaowei expand her cross-border business, and promised to introduce potential clients. Yu Xiaowei showed a family photo and earned Zhou Minyi's envy. He Junjie complained about the impact of new energy vehicles on showroom foot traffic. Yu Xiaowei jotted down key points while dining. After the meal, she gave egg roll gifts to Zhou Minyi and He Junjie. When the gathering ended, everyone said goodbye at the hotel entrance. Yu Xiaowei hugged Zhou Minyi, agreed to meet in Shenzhen next month, and gently comforted He Junjie, saying 'Transformation is an opportunity.'
location: Private room on the second floor and entrance of Starlight Hotel, 578 Nathan Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the bus home
