description: Yu Xiaowei took KMB Route 1A from Mong Kok bus stop back to Prince Edward Road West stop in Kowloon City District (near Whampoa Garden). On the bus, she texted her husband that she was almost home, and recalled the information from the gathering, formulating her follow-up plan after returning to work.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from Mong Kok bus stop in Yau Tsim Mong District to Prince Edward Road West bus stop in Kowloon City District, KMB Route 1A

name: Home, late-night conversation with my husband
description: Yu Xiaowei returned home to Whampoa Garden, where the children had already been coaxed to sleep by her mother. In the living room, she and her husband Zhang Weiming each poured a glass of warm water and talked about what they had gained from the class reunion. She described in detail Zhou Minyi's client resources in Shenzhen and He Junjie's predicament. Zhang Weiming also lamented that his air-conditioning repair industry is facing the impact of new technology. Yu Xiaowei held her husband's hand and said they would find a way together.
location: Living room of Unit A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night review and pre-sleep journaling
description: Yu Xiaowei went to the study and used the memo app on her phone to record the evening's takeaways item by item: 1) follow up on the potential client in Shenzhen recommended by Zhou Minyi regarding their need for high-end medical and savings insurance; 2) pay attention to the impact of substitute technology on her husband's industry; 3) remind herself not to take the industry situation lightly. After finishing, she washed up and changed into cotton pajamas.
location: Study, Flat A, 6/F, Tower 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Social replies and preparation for returning to work
description: Yu Xiaowei lay in bed and sent a thank-you WeChat message to Zhou Minyi, saying that she planned to arrange the Shenzhen trip after handling the underwriting next week. Then she browsed the New Year return-to-work notice in the work group, confirmed the three policies that needed follow-up tomorrow, and set her phone alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning.
location: Bedroom, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery exchange and hobby activities
description: Yu Xiaowei opened the 'Cantonese Embroidery Stitch Exchange Group' and saw a photo of her embroidery friend He Meiling's work 'Cantonese Embroidered Koi'. She admired it and exchanged thoughts. She privately messaged He Meiling, planning to contact Teacher Wu Xiuying next week to consult about new composition techniques.
location: Bedroom, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and bedtime yoga
description: Yu Xiaowei quietly walked into the children's room and told her son and daughter, who were still awake, a shortened version of The Legend of the Nian Monster, reminding them that school was about to start and they needed to settle down. After the story, she tucked them in, kissed their foreheads, and said goodnight. Then she unrolled her yoga mat in the living room and did a gentle 15-minute yin yoga stretch to relax her body.
location: Children's room and living room at Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and restful sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off most of the lights at home, leaving only the bedside night light, drank half a glass of water, and after checking that there were no new messages on her phone, set it to silent. She double-checked the 7:00 a.m. alarm for the next morning, lay down, savored the experiences of the day, felt fulfilled, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga, breakfast preparation, and waking up the children
description: Get up at 7:00 in the morning and do 20 minutes of yoga alone in the living room to relax. Then prepare a simple breakfast such as oatmeal, communicate with her husband Zhang Weiming to ask him to take her mother-in-law back to Kwun Tong in the afternoon, and pack the tote bag for work the next day. At 7:45, together with her mother Chen Meiling, wake up the son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin, help the children get dressed, and after the family is ready, they prepare to go out to buy groceries.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Went to Kowloon City Market to buy ingredients
description: Walked to Whampoa Garden bus stop and took Bus 12A to Kowloon City Market. At the market, I bought spinach, carrots, sea bass, chicken breast, snow fungus, and sweet and bitter apricot kernels according to the shopping list. Along the way, I taught the kids to recognize vegetables and bought longans to fulfill my daughter's wish. My mother praised me for being thoughtful, and then we took the bus home together.
location: Kowloon City Market, 102 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Organizing grocery shopping and household chores.
description: Back home, she sorted and stored the purchased ingredients with her mother, putting vegetables and dried goods in their places and fish and meat in the freezer. After taking the children to wash their hands, she had them play with puzzles while she used the vacuum cleaner to remove cat hair from the living room.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family morning tea break and chat
description: My mother cut up apples and longan, and the family sat in the living room eating fruit and chatting. I talked with my husband about tomorrow's work arrangements and reminded him to take my mother-in-law back to Kwun Tong in the afternoon. The children played with building blocks nearby, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Cuiyang Court, Block 3, living room at home.

name: Personal break and checking work emails
description: After changing back into her loungewear, she opened the windows for ventilation, went to the study, checked work emails on her phone, confirmed tomorrow's work schedule, and wrote a memo in her notebook: "Spring Nutrition Plan".
location: Home study, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother cooked minced chicken and corn soup over rice, stir-fried choy sum, and chilled fresh sea bass. The whole family sat around the table for lunch. Xuanxuan told funny stories from school, Xinxin played with a plastic plate, and laughter and cheerful chatter never stopped.
location: Dining room at home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and tidying up the room
description: After the meal, she put the children down for their naps, telling her daughter stories until both fell asleep. Then she put the dried goods and snacks bought before noon into storage bins, took down the Spring Festival decorations, and restored the living room to neatness.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Develop a family nutrition menu for the first week
description: In the study, she planned a week of menus from February 3 to 9 based on the health app and family doctor's advice, listing breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks in detail, then posted the list on the kitchen memo board. Her husband passed by and teased her admiringly, saying it was full of ritual.
location: Home study and kitchen, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Rest and light work planning
description: After briefly relaxing in the living room watching TV, I went into the study and used the computer to create a new document to record work ideas. Regarding the needs of a Shenzhen client mentioned by my friend Zhou Minyi, I organized the cross-border insurance business and recent underwriting priorities, saved the file, and added notes.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Parent-child Cantonese embroidery craft and afternoon snacks
description: In the living room, she did Cantonese embroidery collage with the children and taught her daughter to cast on and knit a little rabbit. The family cat suddenly got into the yarn and tangled it up, making her daughter cry. She comforted her and guided her through it again, and they finally finished a crooked but adorable piece. Xuanxuan helped pass needles and thread from the side. Then the whole family enjoyed apples and longan.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Cuiyang Court, Block 3, living room at home.

name: Handle insurance underwriting work
description: While the children were playing games, she logged into the AIA system in the study to handle underwriting for three policies: she called a client to confirm information and then revised the savings plan, successfully submitted Mrs. Li's medical insurance, and after checking, submitted Mr. Wang's whole life insurance, then notified the clients one by one via WhatsApp.
location: Home study, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: Prepared snow fungus soup with lean pork and south/north apricot kernels; her mother helped cut the meat, and she discussed with her husband the plan to take her mother-in-law later. In the evening she boiled snow fungus and red date sweet soup for the whole family, then they shared a light dinner of steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and other dishes. Her husband cleaned up the dishes after the meal.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Saw off mother-in-law and tidied up the house.
description: Her husband drove his mother Li Shufen back to her home in Kwun Tong, while she saw them off with the children and handed over gifts. Afterwards, she put the air conditioner repair tools in the living room back into the storage room, keeping the home tidy.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Parent-child interaction and homework tutoring
description: Played with LEGO bricks with the children, then checked Xuanxuan's winter vacation homework, helped correct two wrong answers, and while also drawing a little rabbit with Xinxin, enjoyed the evening family time.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Cuiyang Court, Block 3, living room at home.

name: Bathing her daughter.
description: In the bathroom, she ran a bath for her daughter. They played with bath toys and sang nursery rhymes together. After the bath, she dried her daughter, put her in pajamas, and listened to her happily talk about today’s craft projects.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Chui Yeung Court, Block 3, bathroom at home

name: Parent-child reading and husband returning home
description: Sat on the living room carpet holding Xinxin, with Xuanxuan snuggled beside, reading the picture books Guess How Much I Love You and Spring Festival stories, making the children laugh with exaggerated gestures. After seeing her mother-in-law home, her husband joined in and listened; the family atmosphere was warm.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Cuiyang Court, Block 3, living room at home.

name: Putting the kids to sleep.
description: Take the children back to the children's room, tuck them in, and kiss their foreheads to say goodnight. The husband joins in, then turns off the light and quietly leaves the room.
location: Children's room at home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Evening personal arrangements and work preparation
description: After the children fell asleep, she soaked her feet in warm water in the living room, went to the study to confirm tomorrow's team meeting, replied to her friend Zhou Minyi's WeChat message about cross-border insurance, agreed to meet in Shenzhen late this month, and finally set the alarm for the next day.
location: At home, Block 3, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Pre-bed skincare and going to sleep
description: She removed her makeup, washed her face, and applied a face mask, then recorded the fulfilling day in her diary. Afterward, she got into bed, briefly chatted with her husband about the next day's plans, said goodnight to each other, turned off the light, and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Cuiyang Court, Block 3, home bedroom

name: Morning preparations and waking my son up to head out.
description: I woke up naturally at 7:15 in the morning, changed into workout clothes, washed up, and drank some water. I went to my son's room, woke him up, and encouraged him to go out and play football together; then I helped him pack his backpack with water and a sweat towel. I had a brief exchange with my husband to let him know the morning arrangements, and then took my son out.
location: At home in Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden residential estate)

name: Walk to the park and enjoy parent-child football time.
description: Holding hands with my son, we walked about fifteen minutes along Tak Hong Street and other streets to Kowloon Tsai Park. On the No. 2 artificial turf pitch in the park, I taught my son to pass and trap the ball with the inside of his foot for football practice. name: Online meeting and writing client visit plans
description: At 10:30, she held an online meeting with team colleagues, sharing the case of Boss Zhao and insights, discussing the division of work for next week's high-potential client visit plan, and emphasizing teamwork. After the meeting, starting at 11:30, she refined the two-week visit plan for 20 high-potential clients, optimizing visit routes according to client areas, professional backgrounds, and needs, and marking core recommended products and key talking points.
location: AIA Building office (AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region).

name: Had lunch with colleague Su Lishan and discussed a beauty plan.
description: At 12:00 noon, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan went to the cafe at Shui On Centre near the office for lunch. Su Lishan brought pineapple buns and milk tea, and the two chatted while eating. Su Lishan introduced the newly opened beauty salon “Huanbai Beauty Studio” and suggested buying a monthly membership card together for weekly beauty treatments after work on Fridays. Yu Xiaowei thought it was a good idea, so they checked online reviews on their phones; the ratings were high and reviews were positive, and they immediately decided to try it tonight.
location: Shui On Centre Café (Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Lunch break and beauty treatment schedule planning
description: At 13:15, returned to the office, double-checked tonight's route to Causeway Bay and the beauty salon appointment information, and set a reminder on her phone. Closed her eyes and rested for 15 minutes to regain energy.
location: AIA Building office (AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region).

name: Afternoon client follow-up and policy organization
description: Starting at 14:00, call potential clients to introduce wealth management plans, then contact Manager Li Guodong of HSBC via the internal messaging tool to confirm next month's recurring investment plan deduction date and amount, ensuring the family financial plan runs smoothly. At 15:00, open the internal system to check the policy information of clients whose policies are about to expire and update remarks, and browse financial news and market updates to prepare talking points. At 16:00, organize the day's follow-up records, back up files, write down Monday's to-do items, confirm with Su Lishan to meet at Wan Chai Station after work, and pack up her handbag to get ready to leave.
location: AIA Building office (AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region).

name: Took the MTR to Causeway Bay with colleagues.
description: At 16:30, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan met on the platform at Wan Chai Station and took the Island Line together to Causeway Bay. They chatted on the train, with Su Lishan sharing amusing stories about her son's school, and arrived amid laughter.
location: MTR from Wan Chai Station to Causeway Bay Station

name: Beauty treatment experience in Causeway Bay and purchase of a monthly pass.
description: At 17:15, they arrived at the "Radiant Beauty Studio" on Russell Street in Causeway Bay. The environment was comfortable. They each experienced a 45-minute deep cleansing and collagen regeneration treatment. The beautician's technique was professional, and their skin became hydrated and radiant, with shoulders and neck relaxed. At 18:30, the session ended. Together they purchased a monthly couple's care card, with each paying HK$1,200 per month, confirmed the next appointment for the same time next Friday, and joined the studio's member group.
location: Huanbai Beauty Studio (No. XX, Russell Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Take the subway home.
description: After saying goodbye to Su Lishan, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR alone from Causeway Bay Station, transferred to the Island Line at Admiralty Station, then to the Kwun Tong Line at Yau Ma Tei Station, and got off at Whampoa Station. She walked back to Whampoa Garden, sending a message in the family group chat along the way saying she would be home around eight. Her husband replied with a smiley face.
location: MTR Causeway Bay Station to Whampoa Station, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and helping make soup
description: Arrived home at 19:45 and smelled the aroma of soup. After changing into loungewear, I went into the kitchen to help my mother slice ginger. My mother, Chen Meiling, watched the heat while telling an amusing story about my father, Yu Guoqiang, winning a chess game in the park. When the soup was ready, I ladled a bowl and tasted it; my fatigue melted away. Then the whole family sat around to have dinner, listening to the kids share funny stories from school, enjoying the warmth of family.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child bonding and family time
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei checked Xuanxuan's math homework and helped with the word-problem mistakes; she played Ludo with Xinxin and promised to take her to the park to fly kites on the weekend; her husband Zhang Weiming cleared away the dishes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, replying to running friends, and going to sleep
description: At 21:10, she urged the children to wash up. Yu Xiaowei went to Xinxin's room and found the new drawing her daughter had made, Mommy and Me, and put it on the living room bulletin board. She went back to the master bedroom to shower and wash her face. At 21:50, after cleansing her face with facial cleanser, she applied a moisturizing mask, replied to her running buddy Shen Peiwen's WeChat messages, and arranged to meet at the entrance of the Hung Hom Promenade at 6:30 the next Monday morning for a morning run; they also chatted for ten minutes about recovery training insights. At 22:20, she removed the mask, applied night cream, wrote a short diary entry about the beauty experience and family warmth, set the 6:00 alarm for Monday, confirmed her running gear was ready, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting up, washing up, and weighing himself
description: When the morning alarm rang, Yu Xiaowei turned it off, lingered in bed briefly, then got up. Habitually, she weighed herself and was satisfied to see her weight remained at 55.7 kg. While washing up in the bathroom, she carefully checked her skin and was pleased to find it still hydrated after yesterday's treatment. The whole process took place in her own bedroom and bathroom.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and daily planning
description: Yu Xiaowei came into the living room, and her husband Zhang Weiming had prepared breakfast: fried egg toast, milk, and fruit. While eating, she checked today's weather on her phone (cloudy with sunny intervals, 18-21) and confirmed the traffic conditions for taking the children to school. She also reminded her husband to pick up the children early in the evening and go to the stationery store together, and told him that she would prepare the things for tomorrow's trip to Ocean Park in the evening.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the children to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove to first take her son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, and at the school gate she told him to wait for Dad to pick him up after school. Then she took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten, helped her put on her backpack, kissed her forehead, and said she would take her to buy a mechanical pencil in the evening. After watching her daughter walk happily through the school gate, she left.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Tin Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School; Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City Kindergarten

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove back to the Whampoa Garden parking lot, walked to a nearby bus stop, and took a bus to Wan Chai. There were not many passengers on the bus. She sat by the window, put on earphones to listen to light music, and went over the day's work priorities in her mind. About 40 minutes later, she got off near Gloucester Road and walked to AIA Tower.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, on a bus from Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District to Gloucester Road in Wan Chai District

name: Reported to work and submitted annual leave application
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the 17th-floor office of AIA Tower, brewed a cup of hot tea, then turned on her computer. She logged into the OA system and submitted an annual leave application for February 10 with the reason “Family Day”; the application was automatically routed to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua. Then she organized and archived two client insurance policies that had not been processed yesterday.
location: Office, 17/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Focused on clearing the backlog of emails.
description: Yu Xiaowei focused on clearing the backlog of emails in her inbox. She replied to three clients' inquiries about product dividends, attaching detailed data charts; followed up on Boss Zhao's high-end medical plan, sending the comparison plan by email and copying her supervisor; she also noted the follow-up dates for several high-intent clients in her memo. The whole process was busy but orderly.
location: Office workstation, 17th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch break: wonton noodles and a call with my mother-in-law
description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowei ordered wonton noodle takeout via a mobile app. While eating in the office, she called her mother-in-law Li Shufen. She confirmed the time to pick up her mother-in-law at Kwun Tong at 7:30 Monday morning, and reminded her to fast for the medical checkup, go to bed early, and not sneak food. She also asked about her mother-in-law's health and only hung up reassured after confirming she didn't have a cold.
location: Office lounge, 17/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Client planning and team preparation.
description: In the afternoon, the work focus shifted to client planning. Yu Xiaowei opened the CRM system, screened out 20 high-potential clients, studied their insurance records and family situations one by one, and drafted personalized talking points and proposal suggestions. Around 14:30, she received a notification from her supervisor Liang Zhenhua that her annual leave request had been approved. She replied with thanks and continued working.
location: Office workstation and small meeting room, 17/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Reply to embroidery friends and wrap up work
description: After finishing the main work, Yu Xiaowei opened WeChat to reply to her embroidery friend He Meiling's message about a new stitching technique for Cantonese embroidery. She shared her experience using the overlapping stitch method to embroider lychee leaves and said she would go into more detail when she got home in the evening. Then she tidied her desk, turned off her computer, and got ready to leave work early.
location: Office workstation, 17th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commuting home
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into flat shoes and left the office. On the bus home, she texted her husband Zhang Weiming, asking him to bring the children downstairs to wait for her, so the whole family could go straight to the stationery store.
location: On a bus in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District.

name: Family shopping: a trip to the stationery store
description: The family of four walked to the bus stop and took the bus to Meimei Stationery on Fa Yuen Street, Mong Kok. In the store, her son Zhang Zixuan found a pencil case with a football pattern, her daughter Zhang Yuxin picked out a pink rabbit-pendant mechanical pencil, and Yu Xiaowei also rewarded them with cute erasers. The family returned home with their hands full.
location: Meimei Stationery, Fa Yuen Street, Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong SAR.

name: Family dinner time
description: When she got home, her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared dinner: steamed grouper, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, honey-glazed char siu, and lotus root and pork rib soup. The family sat around the table; her son shared funny stories from school and her daughter showed off her new pencil. Watching the warm scene, Yu Xiaowei felt much of her physical and mental exhaustion dissolve.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Rest after a meal and first experience on the treadmill
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes together with her mother and put the leftovers in sealed containers in the fridge. After resting for a moment, Yu Xiaowei changed into her workout clothes, started the folding treadmill in the corner of the living room, and set it to a 20-minute slow-walking program with a pace of 8:30. Amid the faint mechanical hum, she felt her muscles gradually wake up and warm up slightly.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize Ocean Park backpack
description: After running and showering, Yu Xiaowei took out the mommy bag in the master bedroom and started packing for tomorrow's trip to Ocean Park: a water bottle filled with warm water, snacks (dried mango and bear-shaped cookies), wet wipes, a sun hat, sunscreen, two sets of spare clothes, and the family annual pass. Finally, she wrote "Lin Jiaxin's son: cheese sticks" on a sticky note and stuck it to the inside of the bag to remind herself to buy them tomorrow morning.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal: Cantonese embroidery and online exchange
description: Yu Xiaowei went to the study, lit a lavender aromatherapy candle, took out the Lychee embroidery, and focused on practicing the overlapping stitch technique for leaves. Ten minutes later, she had a WeChat video call with her embroidery friend He Meiling. Facing the camera, she demonstrated and explained the details of the overlapping stitch, and the two discussed the stitching techniques in depth for nearly half an hour.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and family coordination
description: Yu Xiaowei checked the children's school uniforms and got them ready for tomorrow. After washing up and doing her skincare, she sent a message in the family group chat reminding everyone to get up at 6:30 tomorrow morning. Then she replied to running buddy Shen Peiwen on WeChat, telling her she had already walked 20 minutes on the treadmill, that it was no problem to resume morning runs on Monday afternoon, and arranging to meet at the usual place.
location: At home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR: bedroom, bathroom, living room.

name: Meditation and peaceful sleep.
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into her pajamas, turned off the main light and left only the bedside night light on, lay flat on the bed, and meditated for 5 minutes, letting her thoughts drift away from work and family chores and focusing on her breathing. Scenes of visiting Ocean Park with her best friend’s family the next day came to mind, and she soon fell asleep with anticipation.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning parent-child time
description: At 6:50, the phone alarm rang. She got up quietly, washed up quickly, and changed into casual jeans and a light blue sports jacket. Then she opened her daughter Zhang Yuxin's door, sat on the edge of the bed, and gently woke her, telling her that today she was going to Ocean Park with Brother Haoyu to see dolphins. The daughter got up excitedly, and she helped her into a pink thin hoodie and sports shoes. While she changed, she did a few simple yoga stretches on the living room floor to loosen up.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Before setting off, bought breakfast and snacks.
description: She took her daughter to the underground market at Whampoa Wonderland shopping mall near home. The familiar bakery owner recognized us, and we bought freshly baked cocktail buns and two boxes of Vitasoy for breakfast. Then we went to the 7-Eleven next door and picked two Chupa Chups lollipops and two packs of cheese sausages, which are the favorite snacks of Lin Jiaxin's son Haoyu. After shopping, carrying the bags and holding her daughter's hand, she walked toward the MTR station.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, basement market and 7-Eleven convenience store.

name: Metro commute and reading time
description: From Whampoa Station, I took the Kwun Tong line toward Yau Ma Tei. There were not many people on the train, and my daughter leaned against me sipping Vitasoy. I quickly browsed a PDF document about cross-border medical insurance plans for the Greater Bay Area on my phone, silently noting the key points. I transferred to the South Island line at Admiralty Station and soon arrived at Ocean Park Station, where sunlight streamed into the carriage through the windows.
location: Hong Kong MTR Kwun Tong Line and South Island Line (from Whampoa Station to Ocean Park Station)

name: Meet up with my best friend at the main entrance of Ocean Park.
description: At the Ocean Park Station exit, I saw my best friend Lin Jiaxin, wearing a bright yellow sweatshirt, and her son Lin Haoyu taking photos in front of the giant lantern installation at the main entrance. Haoyu ran over as soon as he saw my daughter, and the two little ones held hands and jumped up and down. Jiaxin and I exchanged glances, and she handed me an iced lemon tea she had bought on the way to quench my thirst. At the entrance, we asked a passerby to take a group photo of the four of us, with the blue sky, white clouds, and the 'Ocean Park' sign as the background.
location: Main entrance of Ocean Park, Aberdeen, Southern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning exploration of ocean wonders and the panda pavilion
description: After ticket check and entering the park, they went straight to the Ocean Wonders Pavilion. The two children pressed against the huge glass wall, watching devil rays and coral reefs swim past overhead, and let out cries of amazement. I held up my phone and kept pressing the shutter to capture their delighted expressions. Then we walked through to the panda pavilion, where a round giant panda was slowly nibbling bamboo. Haoyu and Xinxin imitated the panda, making Jiaxin and me bend over laughing.
location: The Ocean Wonders Pavilion and the Giant Panda Pavilion in Ocean Park, Aberdeen, Southern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Dolphin Theater and commemorative photos
description: When we reached the Ocean Theatre, the front-row seats were already full. Dolphins leaped out of the water, balanced balls on their snouts, and spun around; the children were so excited that they clapped until their palms were red and kept screaming. I asked the tourist next to us with a professional camera to take a close group photo of the four of us watching the show. The sunlight, the dolphins, the children, and my best friend’s smiling faces were perfectly captured. After the show we walked around the nearby themed areas, and the two children spent quite a while looking at plush toys in the souvenir shop.
location: Ocean Theatre, Ocean Park, Aberdeen, Southern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch at Sea Dragon King Restaurant and an in-depth talk with close friends
description: At noon we moved to the Sea Dragon King Restaurant, and there was a huge aquarium by the window. I ordered a kids' meal for my daughter, with rice balls and small fish-shaped potato cakes, while Jiaxin and I each ordered roast goose rice with iced lemon tea. The children ate heartily and curiously watched sharks swimming past outside the window, and the two of us finally got to chat quietly. Jiaxin talked about her worries over staff changes at school, and I also confided my frustration over being met with “reserved opinion” last Friday when I competed with Brother Hua for the assistant manager position. We encouraged each other and agreed to hang in there; the children's happiness at that moment was the most genuine.
location: Dragon King Restaurant, Ocean Park, Aberdeen, Southern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon adventure and playtime
description: After eating and drinking our fill, we took the Ocean Tower. As the observation tower slowly rose, we had a panoramic view of the sea views of the entire Southern District of Hong Kong Island. Then we visited the Shark Aquarium and watched the sharp-toothed big fellows swim around; the two kids were both scared and excited. The most thrilling part was riding the Arctic Blast roller coaster. Haoyu laughed so much the whole way that he drooled, and Xinxin clung tightly to my arm, nervous but happy, shouting 'so fun!' as we got off.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Southern District, inside Ocean Park, Aberdeen: Ocean Tower, Shark Aquarium, and Polar Speed roller coaster

name: Taking photos at the fountain area and making a parent-child promise
description: In the fountain area in front of the Ocean Wonders exhibit, I found a bench and sat down, letting the children run and jump around the fountain. I took out my selfie stick and took a four-person close-up photo and funny group photos with Jiaxin. The sunlight was just right and water splashed everywhere. Watching the children's smiling faces, I suggested a monthly parent-child outing. Jiaxin immediately agreed and said we should go hiking in Sai Kung next time, and the two little ones also raised their hands in agreement.
location: The Grand Aquarium fountain area inside Ocean Park, Aberdeen, Southern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return subway ride and daughter resting
description: At the main entrance, I said a reluctant goodbye to Jiaxin and her son. After hugging, the children agreed to have afternoon tea again next month. On the subway ride back, Xinxin, tired from playing, leaned on my shoulder and fell into a deep sleep. I gently stroked her forehead and felt her even breathing, my heart full of tenderness. I took out my phone and started sorting through the dozens of photos taken today, planning to send them to the family group and the besties' group as soon as I got home.
location: Hong Kong MTR South Island Line and Kwun Tong Line (along the section from Ocean Park Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Sharing at home and posting on Moments
description: At 4:30 p.m., I got home. Xinxin was still sleeping, so I gently carried her to her bed. Then I sat on the living room sofa and picked nine photos for a grid — the moment a dolphin leapt out of the water, a silly group shot of the four of us, and the kids' smiling faces. I wrote the caption, “With the most important people, in the best weather, feeling healed. #OceanPark #ParentChildTime #Besties” and posted it to the “Our Home” family group and the “Three Besties” group. Mom soon replied, “As long as Xinxin had fun, that's what matters — I made watercress soup tonight.” Likes and comments kept coming in.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Help with household chores and engage with children.
description: After waking up, Xinxin was in good spirits. My son Zhang Zixuan and my husband Zhang Weiming also came back from outside. As soon as Xuanxuan saw his sister, he went up to her and asked whether Ocean Park was fun. I went to the kitchen to help my mother Chen Meiling pick and wash the vegetables we had bought, then put today's sports jacket into the washing machine, and quickly tidied up the things that had been left messily before going out in the morning.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home

name: Warm family dinner time
description: At six in the evening, the whole family sat around the dinner table. My mother Chen Meiling had made pork bone soup with green and red radishes, steamed a fish, and stir-fried some choy sum. My father Yu Guoqiang was also there. During the meal, Xinxin chattered away to her dad and grandparents about the manta rays and dolphin show she had seen that day, and Xuanxuan listened with great interest. I drank the hot soup and felt warm inside. After dinner I took the initiative to clear and wash the dishes, while my husband was in charge of helping Xuanxuan with his homework.
location: Dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child reading and putting daughter to bed
description: After dinner, I played with Xinxin in her room with the new building blocks for a while, then helped her brush her teeth, wash her face, and change into pajamas. After she lay down on the bed, I picked a copy of the picture book Finding Nemo and told a story about the adventure of Nemo the clownfish. Halfway through the story, she closed her eyes and fell asleep with a smile on her lips. I gently kissed her forehead, turned off the light, and left the room.
location: Children's room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening leisure and planning
description: After putting my daughter to sleep, I returned to the living room, where my mother and father were watching TV news. Sitting on the sofa, I used WeChat to reminisce with Jiaxin about the afternoon's fun and cheer each other on, and replied to comments on photos in the besties group, proudly sending a sticker. Then I silently planned to go to Harbour City in Tsim Sha Tsui next Saturday afternoon to treat myself to a set of Hong Kong-style milk tea and pineapple bun, and browsed a few new restaurants as options for future family gatherings.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Communication and feedback with her husband
description: After my husband finished helping Xuanxuan with his homework, he came over and sat down. I shared my idea of trying a new restaurant with the family next weekend, and he readily agreed. I also casually mentioned today's conversation with Jiaxin about the promotion. My husband patted me on the shoulder and said, “Don't put too much pressure on yourself; you've always done well.” Looking at him, I felt how wonderful it was to have his support.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Light evening exercise and stretching
description: After sitting all evening, I got up and did twenty minutes of basic yoga stretching on the living room floor, focusing on relaxing my legs and lower back, which had done a lot of walking today. My body felt stretched out and much more comfortable.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and tomorrow's plan
description: She opened the memo app on her phone to confirm tomorrow's (Monday) annual leave plan: taking her mother-in-law for a physical checkup. She sent her mother-in-law a WeChat message to confirm picking her up at 9 a.m. tomorrow. After washing up and changing into comfortable pajamas, she lay in bed, her heart filled with the joy of the day and the ease of autumn.
location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Nighttime reading and falling asleep
description: She turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside lamp on, and opened a book about the insurance industry. After reading a few pages, she was too excited to focus, so she simply put the book down and turned off the light. The scenes of dolphins leaping in the daytime and Xinxin's laughter still replayed in her mind. She let out a satisfied sigh and slowly drifted off to sleep, filled with happiness.
location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run with running partner Shen Peiwen
description: At six in the morning, Yu Xiaowei met her running partner Shen Peiwen at the Hung Hom Waterfront Promenade and jogged along the waterfront for about 5 kilometers, maintaining a pace of around 7:15 per kilometer. As they ran, they chatted about the fun at Ocean Park last Saturday and the new half-marathon training plan released by Coach Zhao. After the run, they bought water from a vending machine, high-fived, and said goodbye.
location: Harbourfront Garden Promenade, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went home to wash up and prepare the supplies for staying with the patient
description: Yu Xiaowei hurried back to her home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City, took a hot shower, changed into a dark blue knit top and beige casual pants, and put a spare air-conditioning shawl, a peeled pear, a fruit knife, and a folder with the medical examination report into her large tote bag. Her mother Chen Meiling was preparing breakfast in the kitchen, asked about the arrangements for her mother-in-law's medical checkup, and told her to be careful on the way.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took a taxi to Kwun Tong to pick up her mother-in-law.
description: Yu Xiaowei hailed a taxi downstairs to go to Kwun Tong. On the way, she texted her husband Zhang Weiming to confirm the children's school arrangements. Traffic was somewhat congested, and after about 30 minutes she arrived at the entrance of Golden Bridge Mansion on Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong.
location: Entrance, Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pick up mother-in-law and head to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital
description: Yu Xiaowei picked up her mother-in-law Li Shufen, who was wearing a dark red coat, at the entrance of Jinqiao Building. She draped a shawl over her shoulders and helped her into the car by the arm. On the way, she chatted about her son Xuanxuan's math quiz and her daughter Xinxin's ballet class to ease her mother-in-law's anxiety about the medical check-up. The taxi arrived at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital in Happy Valley about 20 minutes later.
location: Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompany mother-in-law to complete the medical checkup
description: At the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital health checkup center, Yu Xiaowei supported her mother-in-law throughout the blood draw, blood pressure, ECG, and other examinations. When her mother-in-law was nervous about the blood draw, Yu Xiaowei played a short video of her granddaughter dancing on her phone to distract her, and carefully communicated to the nurse about her mother-in-law's long-term use of vitamin D and calcium supplements, ensuring the doctor could make a comprehensive assessment.
location: Health Assessment Centre, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wait in the rest area for the appointment and share pears.
description: After the examination, the two waited for the results in the rest area of the health checkup center. Yu Xiaowei took a peeled snow pear from her bag, carefully cut it into small pieces, and handed them to her mother-in-law, who smiled and said it was very sweet. They chatted about amusing stories from her husband Zhang Weiming's childhood, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Rest area of the Health Screening Centre, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Listen to the doctor explain the physical examination report
description: Family doctor Zhou Wenbin walked into the consultation room with the report and announced that her mother-in-law's indicators were all very good: blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood lipids were well controlled, and her bone density was excellent for her age. Yu Xiaowei let out a long sigh of relief, and her mother-in-law repeatedly thanked her daughter-in-law for the thoughtful arrangements. The three of them happily took a group photo to commemorate the occasion.
location: Consultation room, Health Check Centre, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her mother-in-law back to her home in Kwun Tong
description: Yu Xiaowei took a taxi to send her mother-in-law back to Jinqiao Mansion in Kwun Tong. She carefully put the medical examination report into a folder and reminded her mother-in-law to take a nap at noon and that she could make her favorite green radish and carrot pork bone soup in the afternoon.
