location: Workstation on the 19th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Internal training on cross-border business
description: Five minutes before the training was to begin, Yu Xiaowei took her notebook and pen and took the elevator to the training room on the 20th floor. The training started on time, led by Guo Junwei, product manager of the Guangzhou branch. He gave an in-depth analysis of changes in mainland high-net-worth clients' demand for critical illness insurance and savings and dividend insurance, with emphasis on foreign exchange compliance requirements and key points of the mainland's Personal Information Protection Law. Yu Xiaowei listened attentively and took notes continuously, especially writing several pages of highlights on how to use the connections of her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and childhood friend Zhou Minyi in Shenzhen to test the market.
location: Training Room, 20th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and strategy discussion.
description: After the training, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan first exchanged their thoughts in the pantry, then went together to Hop Kee Restaurant near the company for a meal. Yu Xiaowei ordered dry-fried beef ho fun, and Su Lishan ordered curry beef brisket rice. While waiting, Yu Xiaowei drew on Guo Junwei's data to have an in-depth discussion with Su Lishan about the strategy for expanding into the Shenzhen market. Su Lishan analyzed that Shenzhen clients care most about brand trust and claims efficiency. They initially planned to use the social circles of Yu Xiaowei's younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and her childhood friend Zhou Minyi in Shenzhen to test the market response. After the meal, the two walked along Thomson Road to help digestion and continued talking about next week's team meeting. On the way back to the company, Yu Xiaowei stopped by the convenience store at Convention Plaza and bought a pack of mints.
location: Wo Kee Restaurant, 8 Thomson Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; Convention Plaza Convenience Store, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai, Wan Chai District

name: Afternoon work and rest.
description: After returning to her desk, Yu Xiaowei first scanned the morning's training notes into her computer and planned to organize them in detail in the evening. Then she compiled her initial ideas for expanding the Shenzhen market into a brief memo and emailed it to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua for guidance. After dealing with emails, she checked next week's client appointments and added a draft client needs analysis for Miss Zhang. With that part of the work done, she went to the pantry to make a cup of hot tea and stood by the window overlooking the Wan Chai street scene to clear her mind. She then returned to her seat to handle the last batch of emails, and based on the day's progress, she wrote a to-do list for Friday, including following up on Mr. Wang's phone call and preparing Miss Zhang's proposal.
location: Workstation and pantry, 19th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing to leave work
description: Yu Xiaowei tidied up her desk and took the tote bag containing the gift and laptop. Before leaving, she sent her husband Zhang Weiming a message: "I'm about to finish work and head home. Tonight I want to eat the tomato and potato soup you made last time." Then she left the office.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute home
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Wan Chai to Kowloon City. Despite the crowded car, she habitually listened to music or read personal finance articles. After arriving at Kowloon City station, she walked home, and on the way bought a pineapple bun for tomorrow's breakfast at Saint Honore Cake Shop on Prince Edward Road West.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 284 Prince Edward Road West, Saint Honore Cake Shop and along the MTR line

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When she got home, her mother Chen Meiling was stir-frying dishes, and her husband Zhang Weiming had already set out the bowls and chopsticks. Yu Xiaowei changed into her home clothes and joined in to help. Dinner was her mother's signature steamed grouper, garlic choy sum, and the tomato and potato soup she had requested. At the table, she shared what she had learned from the training, the children talked about funny things at school, and the family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and household chores
description: After dinner, Zhang Weiming was responsible for washing the dishes. Yu Xiaowei first went to the study to help her son Zhang Zixuan check his math homework and helped him solve a word problem. Then she went to the living room to watch an episode of a cartoon with her daughter Zhang Yuxin and color together. During this time she also tidied up the toys on the sofa and folded the dried clothes.
location: Living room and study at home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Put daughter to bed.
description: It was time. Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to wash up, then told her a bedtime story about a little rabbit. Watching her daughter fall asleep quietly, she softly turned off the light and left the room.
location: Child's room at home, Prince's Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Study time: organizing notes and couple interaction
description: After the children had fallen asleep, Yu Xiaowei went into the study, turned on her laptop, and entered the four pages of handwritten training notes from the day into OneNote one by one, adding her own insights. She thought especially about how to combine her Shenzhen connections with insurance products and drafted the content for next week’s team meeting. At about 10:30, her husband Zhang Weiming gently pushed open the door and put a cup of hot Hong Kong-style milk tea on the desk. She looked up with a grateful smile and touched the back of his hand. He said, “Get some rest early,” then left. Yu Xiaowei finished the milk tea and kept working until nearly 11.
location: Home study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After finishing organizing all her notes, Yu Xiaowei saved the document, stood up to stretch her stiff shoulders and neck, then went to the bathroom to wash up and do her skincare routine. Back in the bedroom, she turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, recalled a fulfilling day: a pleasant family breakfast, carefully chosen gifts, a rewarding training session, heated discussions with colleagues, a warm parent-child time, and her husband's thoughtful milk tea. With a faint anticipation of tomorrow's Valentine's Day, she drifted into sleep.
location: Home bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: At 7 a.m., the phone alarm went off. After turning it off, Yu Xiaowei stretched in bed, feeling the slight muscle soreness from last night's strength training. Outside the window, the sky was just beginning to lighten and a light drizzle was falling. She noticed the carefully wrapped wrench set on the bedside table and felt a surge of anticipation for tonight's Valentine's Day.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family breakfast and interacting with the children.
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowei changed into an off-white trench coat and a dark blue suit skirt and went to the dining room. Her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared preserved egg and lean pork congee, and on the table were store-bought rice noodle rolls and fried sesame balls. Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter Xinxin break apart a fried sesame ball, and handed her son Mingzai the evaporated milk he liked. Xuanxuan excitedly shared about the school's small Valentine's Day activities, and the family enjoyed breakfast in a warm atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: It was still drizzling outside. Yu Xiaowei put on her trench coat, held up a transparent umbrella, and left home holding Xinxin, who was wearing a little raincoat. The two walked along Prince Edward Road West for about ten minutes to reach Kowloon City Kindergarten. At the gate, Yu Xiaowei squatted down to help Xinxin adjust her backpack, kissed her on the cheek, and gently told her that she would come home a little early tonight and that she should be a good girl. Xinxin nodded obediently and followed the teacher through the school gate.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute to the office and review client files
description: After sending off Xinxin, Yu Xiaowei walked to Sung Wong Toi Station and took the MTR to Wan Chai. Since she left early, the carriage was not too crowded. She put on her earphones, opened the client file for Wang Qiming on her phone, and reviewed the company's business scope, number of employees, and the pain points about medical reimbursement for employees in Shenzhen and Hong Kong mentioned in the last meeting. She also noted a few key questions in her memo to fully prepare for the afternoon call.
location: Hong Kong SAR MTR (from Sung Wong Toi Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Morning work: email processing and call preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the office on time at nine o’clock. She made herself a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea and then started working. First she skimmed through the cross-border training materials sent by her colleague Guo Junwei, then replied to eleven client emails. With one client who had questions about a retirement savings plan, she scheduled a tea meeting for next Monday. At ten-thirty, combining last night’s training notes and key questions, she mapped out the core logic for the afternoon call with Wang Qiming: starting from industry peers’ pain points, demonstrating the value of customized solutions, and making an initial invitation to the cross-border insurance sharing session in early March.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch with close friend and confirm evening plans
description: At noon, her close friend Su Lishan (Shanshan) came to find Yu Xiaowei, and the two shared one umbrella and walked to a cha chaan teng near the office. They ordered dry-fried beef ho fun and iced lemon tea, and while eating confirmed their 6 p.m. beauty treatment appointment in Causeway Bay. Shanshan said she had added ten minutes of shoulder and neck massage, caring about her stress. The two also excitedly talked about the beauty salon's bridal discount package, and Shanshan suggested trying the newly opened Taiwanese restaurant behind the company next Friday.
location: Hong Kong-style cafe near the company in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work: client follow-up calls and document organization
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei bought a bottle of mineral water at the convenience store and returned to her desk. In the afternoon, she made two follow-up calls to long-standing clients and confirmed that she would visit client Mrs. Chen, who had just been discharged from the hospital, next Tuesday. Then she spent an hour organizing the latest cross-border insurance information, including policy changes and success stories, updating the “Shenzhen Potential Clients” list on her phone, and filing Wang Qiming’s requirements document separately.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Key call: collecting requirements from Shenzhen clients
description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowei called Shenzhen client Wang Qiming on time. Following the train of thought she had sorted out in the morning, she patiently listened to his description of the real pain points his company's employees faced in cross-border medical reimbursement, and then raised several targeted, sharp questions. While taking detailed notes, she discussed preliminary solutions in a calm tone, and finally reiterated the customized plan for the sharing session in early March. The client expressed satisfaction and said he would follow it. The call lasted about forty minutes. When it ended, she immediately organized and sent a follow-up email.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Wrap-up work: email handling and appointment follow-ups
description: After the call ended, Yu Xiaowei quickly compiled the call notes into an electronic version and entered them into the customer management system. She sent a confirmation email to Wang Qiming, agreeing to have another phone discussion next Monday afternoon. Before leaving work, she also sent a client, Miss Zhang, the electronic version of the savings upgrade plan proposal, and texted her that they could continue the discussion tomorrow afternoon. At 5:30, she tidied her desk, fully charged her phone, and got ready for the appointment.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute to Causeway Bay
description: Yu Xiaowei clocked out and left the office at 5:35 p.m. To avoid the evening rush hour, she took the Island Line from Wan Chai Station to Causeway Bay Station, transferring at Admiralty Station, and arrived in about fifteen minutes. After exiting the station, she walked about five minutes to Liangjifang Beauty Salon opposite the World Trade Centre.
location: Hong Kong SAR MTR (Wan Chai Station to Causeway Bay Station)

name: Regular Friday skincare and shoulder-neck massage
description: At exactly six o'clock, Shanshan was already waiting in the beauty salon lobby. As usual, the two chose the basic facial cleansing and hydration package, and added an extra ten minutes of shoulder and neck massage to relieve the fatigue of days of desk work. Lying on the beauty beds, they enjoyed the technician's gentle touch while whispering gossip. Shanshan brought up the bridal discount package again and suggested Yu Xiaowei take a set of anniversary photos on Valentine's Day. After the treatment, they took selfies with face masks on. Shanshan posted on Moments, joking that Valentine's Day was a fixed event to spend with her bestie, and decided to book the same package next Friday.
location: Bright Skin Beauty Salon near the World Trade Centre, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Touch up makeup and transfer to Mong Kok
description: After the treatment, Yu Xiaowei quickly touched up her lipstick and powder in the beauty salon's restroom to make sure she still looked fresh. Then, after saying goodbye to Shanshan, she left the salon, took the Island Line across the harbour to Mong Kok East Station, and walked to Paradise Café on Fa Yuen Street. Along the way, couples on the street were holding flowers, and the festive atmosphere was strong.
location: On the way from Bright Skin Studio in Causeway Bay to Paradise Cafe on Garden Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Valentine's Day dinner at a cha chaan teng and a surprise gift
description: At 7:30, Yu Xiaowei pushed open the glass door of Paradise Café. Her husband Zhang Weiming (Mingzai) was already sitting in the booth they had most often sat in when they were young. The two ordered pineapple buns with butter, silk-stocking milk tea, beef chow fun, and curry beef brisket rice. Halfway through the meal, Yu Xiaowei took a wrapped ratchet wrench set from her trench coat pocket and handed it to Mingzai as a Valentine's Day gift. Mingzai's eyes reddened instantly at the sight of the gift. After a moment of silence, he spoke softly about his worries over the industry's transformation, fearing that his technical skills couldn't keep up with the development of new energy vehicles. Yu Xiaowei gently held his hand and comforted him, saying they would face it together, and suggested setting aside 1,500 yuan each month from the family fund starting in February as a 'future learning fund' to support each other's personal improvement. Mingzai was moved and nodded in agreement. The meal lasted a full two hours; they talked about work, parenting, and future plans.
location: Paradise Café, 27 Lun Shun Street, Fa Yuen Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Strolling through the streets of Mong Kok after the rain.
description: After dinner, the two paid the bill and walked out of the café. The rain had just stopped, and the air was fresh and cool. Hand in hand, they strolled through Mong Kok, walking from Fa Yuen Street to Sai Yeung Choi Street South, chatting about Xuanxuan's progress in math and Xinxin's recent watercolor painting, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. On the way home, Yu Xiaowei received a WeChat message from her embroidery friend He Meiling recommending an international Cantonese embroidery online community. She excitedly replied with thanks and planned to look into it carefully after getting home. As they walked, they planned to take the children to Kwun Tong to visit their grandmother next weekend, and then took the MTR back to Kowloon.
location: The area from Fa Yuen Street to Sai Yeung Choi Street South, Mong Kok, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A brief rest after returning home and saying goodnight to the children.
description: At ten o'clock she returned home; her mother had already fallen asleep, and a nightlight was left on in the living room. Yu Xiaowei tiptoed into the children's room, saw that Xuanxuan and Xinxin were both sleeping soundly, gave each a goodnight kiss on the forehead, and then gently closed the door.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Browsing the Cantonese embroidery community before bed
description: After returning to the bedroom, Yu Xiaowei quickly washed up, changed into comfortable pajamas, and leaned against the headboard. She opened the international Cantonese embroidery online community link sent by He Meiling and browsed with great interest the stunning works created by embroiderers from various countries using Cantonese embroidery techniques, including flowers, animals, and modern abstract paintings. She was especially impressed by an exquisitely crafted piece titled “Cat Playing with Butterfly,” which reignited her passion for learning Cantonese embroidery, and she decided to formally apply to join tomorrow morning.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: Yu Xiaowei put down her phone, and Ming also returned to the bedroom. The two lay side by side, whispering softly in the darkness. Ming brought up the 'Future Study Fund' again, saying he had already worked out the numbers. Yu Xiaowei smiled and held his hand, feeling touched and connected, reassured by the future direction they had decided on together. She said softly that it was time to sleep, since they had to take the children for dim sum the next day, then turned off the bedside lamp and fell into a deep sleep in the warmth.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: On Saturday morning, Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat by the window in the living room and started with 15 minutes of flow yoga, including a sequence of Cat-Cow, Downward Dog, and Warrior I and II, feeling her body stretch and awaken. Then she sat cross-legged, closed her eyes, and did 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and slowly breathing out the negative emotions from the past two weeks—work anxiety and the frustration of a failed promotion. Afterward, she felt refreshed and clear-headed, and was determined to make the weekend fulfilling.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast.
description: After washing up, Xiaowei changed into comfortable loungewear, woke up her daughter Xinxin and helped tie her little pigtails, and reminded her son Xuanxuan to wash up. Her mother had already prepared white congee, fried eggs, and char siu bao in the kitchen. Xiaowei made three cups of Hong Kong-style milk tea. The family of six sat around the table for breakfast, chatting about topics like Xuanxuan's new football shoes for his football class, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking my daughter to ballet class.
description: After breakfast, Xiaowei helped Xinxin change into a pink ballet dress, tights, and soft ballet shoes. At 8:15, Weiming drove, and the family of four set off, arriving at the Kowloon City Dance School about 12 minutes later. Xiaowei held Xinxin's hand as they entered the classroom and greeted the teacher. Then she stood outside the window watching her daughter do hip-opening exercises at the barre, took out her phone to take photos, with a pleased smile on her face.
location: Kowloon City Dance School, 1 Grampian Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take son to soccer class (commute)
description: After the ballet class started, Xiaowei returned to the car, and Weiming drove to the football pitch at Kowloon Tsai Park, about an 8-minute drive. Upon arrival, Xuanxuan ran excitedly to his friends, and Xiaowei briefly greeted the coach.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, on the way from 328 Prince Edward Road West to 13 Inverness Road

name: Accompany clients in the stands and handle client matters.
description: Xiaowei sat down in the shade of the stands, first quickly replying to client Mrs. Li's inquiry about medical insurance reimbursement documents and colleague Su Lishan's suggested itinerary for a Shenzhen client visit. Then, to prepare for next week's sharing session with Greater Bay Area client Wang Qiming, she called colleague Guo Junwei from the actuarial department and asked professional questions about the claims process for 'Greater Bay Area cross-border medical insurance.' Meanwhile, Weiming sat quietly beside her watching his son play football.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park football field grandstand, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shopping at ParknShop
description: After Xuanxuan's football class ended, the family of four met up. Xiaowei suggested going to ParknShop in The Whampoa to buy fresh fruits and vegetables. Wei Ming drove and arrived in about 10 minutes. Xiaowei pushed the shopping cart and selected New Zealand kiwifruit, Chilean blueberries, strawberries, organic broccoli, asparagus, tomatoes, and eggs from the list, and also picked a box of mango pudding for the kids. At checkout she used a credit card supermarket points offer.
location: ParknShop (Whampoa New Town store), 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home and rest briefly
description: After the shopping was done, the family drove 5 minutes back home. Xiaowei and Weiming sorted the ingredients and put them in the refrigerator, while the children played with building blocks and watched cartoons in the living room. Xiaowei changed into loose loungewear, rested on the sofa with a glass of warm water, feeling hungry and looking forward to lunch.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother prepared pork bone soup with green radish and carrot, steamed grass carp, and stir-fried choy sum. The family sat around the table for lunch. At the table, Xiaowei announced that she would join the international Cantonese embroidery community in the afternoon and schedule a health check-up. Her mother encouraged her to do what she loved, while her father reminded her to take a walk with him on the weekend. After the meal, Xiaowei cleaned up the dishes on her own.
location: Dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Apply to join an international online community for Cantonese embroidery
description: At 1 p.m., Xiaowei opened her computer in the study. Through a link from her friend He Meiling, she found the 'Cantonese Embroidery Splendor' international community. After carefully reading the introduction and rules, she clicked to apply to join and filled in her personal profile: 'Hello everyone! I am Yu Xiaowei from Hong Kong. I have studied embroidery for five years under Teacher Wu Xiuying and specialize in flower-and-bird themes.' She also uploaded photos of two works, 'Peony' and 'Lychee'. In less than 10 minutes, the administrator approved her application.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Self-introduction and interaction in the community
description: After joining the group, Xiaowei first sent a voice self-introduction in Cantonese and then in Mandarin, sharing her experience with color matching and stitching techniques while embroidering the Lychee Painting. Her work and sharing drew likes and comments from several embroidery friends in Singapore and Malaysia, praising her delicate embroidery. Xiaowei replied to each comment, feeling delighted, as if she had found a kindred-spirit organization.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Phone booking for health consultation
description: Xiaowei called the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital health check center from the living room and explained in Cantonese that she wanted to book a spring nutrition and training health consultation, as recommended by Dr. Zhou. Based on the time slots the nurse provided, she chose Wednesday, February 19 at 12:30 p.m., and specifically asked to focus on knee protection during marathon training and scientific protein supplementation. The nurse confirmed the appointment and reminded her to bring her recent medical examination report.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize next week's client materials and check community messages.
description: Xiaowei returned to the study, opened her work notebook and computer, and organized clear one-page files for client Wang Qiming's company background and needs, Miss Zhang's savings plan response, and Mrs. Li's medical reimbursement progress. Meanwhile, her phone vibrated; she quickly checked messages in the Cantonese embroidery community, replied to an embroidery friend's question about stitching techniques, and then continued focusing on her work.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping the child check homework and doing parent-child drawing
description: At 4 p.m., Xiaowei paused her work and came to the living room. She checked Xuanxuan's math workbook and found a word problem with a wrong unit, and patiently explained it. Then she took out drawing paper and colored pens and sat on the floor with Xinxin to draw. Xinxin wanted to draw a butterfly, so Xiaowei taught her hand-in-hand how to draw symmetrical wings, and, inspired by Cantonese embroidery color schemes, suggested coloring it in blue and purple. Her daughter nodded happily.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Xiaowei tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to help. She picked and washed vegetables, broke the broccoli she had bought in the afternoon into small florets, and cut the asparagus into sections, while her mother cut meat nearby. The two chatted while they worked, and Xiaowei enthusiastically shared the fun of joining a Cantonese embroidery group that afternoon.
location: Home kitchen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner included her mother's signature steamed pork ribs in black bean sauce, stir-fried choy sum, and garlic broccoli that Xiaowei helped prepare. The family chatted while eating. Xiaowei shared videos of her daughter dancing and her son playing football. Everyone praised the children for making great progress, and her father also brought up news from the newspaper. The dinner table was full of laughter and cheerful conversation.
location: Dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up the children and getting them to sleep
description: After dinner, Weiming checked Xuanxuan's homework and urged him to take a shower. Xiaowei ran warm water for Xinxin's bubble bath, dried her off, changed her into pajamas, then sat by the bed and told Xinxin the story of Little Rabbit Tom. After about 20 minutes, her daughter fell soundly asleep, and Xiaowei gently turned off the light and left the room.
location: Home children's room and bathroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family monthly financial review and budget meeting
description: After putting the children to bed, Xiaowei and Wei Ming sat down at the dining table. Xiaowei took out the account book, and Wei Ming pulled up the bank and credit card records. They checked item by item: beauty card renewal, ballet tuition, food expenses, car maintenance course tuition, and so on. After calculating, they had achieved 95% of February's savings target (including the new monthly 1500 yuan “Future Learning Fund”), and adjusted the March budget, deciding to reduce dining out and increase spending on household daily necessities. The meeting ended, and the two happily high-fived to celebrate.
location: Dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep review and embroidery appreciation exchange
description: After the finance meeting ended, Xiaowei curled up on the living room sofa and drank some water. She opened her phone and entered the 'Cantonese Embroidery Splendor' community again to admire several new works posted that day. She liked a piece titled 'Phoenixes in Flight' by a Canadian embroidery friend and commented, 'The color scheme is gorgeous, and the stitching is superb!' Then she thought of her daughter's focused expression in the ballet classroom, a warm feeling rose in her chest, and she smiled contentedly.
location: On the living room sofa at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing Things and Stretching Before Bed
description: Xiaowei put down her phone and prepared for tomorrow: she took out the clothes the children would wear and placed them by the bedside, and checked Xuanxuan's schoolbag to make sure nothing was missing. Then she went back to the living room and did a few simple moves on the yoga mat to relax her shoulders and back, which were stiff from sitting for a long time.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, living room and bedroom at home

name: Going to bed
description: At 10 p.m., Xiaowei quietly climbed into bed with a full sense of accomplishment and happiness from the day's events and said to Weiming, 'Tonight was so satisfying.' Weiming held her hand. She closed her eyes, recalling the moments of her daughter dancing, the likes on social media, and the high-fives, and soon drifted into a sweet sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wake up, family preparation, and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off on time. Yu Xiaowei got up quietly so as not to wake her husband Zhang Weiming, who was still fast asleep. She went to the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast. Her mother had already cooked century egg and lean pork congee, and Yu Xiaowei skillfully brewed a pot of Hong Kong-style milk tea, then put the BBQ pork buns and egg custard buns bought yesterday from the Whampoa New Sky shopping mall into the microwave to heat up. Her husband Zhang Weiming soon came to the kitchen to help and encouraged her for the afternoon online community debut: "You've got this! Our whole family supports you!" At 7:45, Yu Xiaowei went to wake the two children. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin lingered in bed, acting cute and demanding a three-minute hug before she would get up. Then the whole family sat around the dining table, enjoying the hot congee and buns in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: At home, No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (bedroom, kitchen, dining room)

name: Tidying up and quality family time.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei took the dishes to the kitchen, but her mother Chen Meiling insisted that she go attend to her own things. Yu Xiaowei went to the living room and saw her son Zhang Zixuan focusing on assembling a LEGO racing car, while her daughter Zhang Yuxin pulled her over to color together in a princess coloring book. Yu Xiaowei sat beside her daughter, helping her pick colors while scrolling through messages in the Cantonese embroidery group on her phone and liking the works of several embroidery friends. Although it was cloudy outside, the pothos on the balcony remained lush green, and the family cat 'Huahua' lay lazily on the back of the sofa, adding a touch of life to the quiet morning.
location: Home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (living room, balcony)

name: Return to the study to prepare embroidery pieces and the presentation

location: 20/F, AIA Tower, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday commute to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital
description: Yu Xiaowei packed her backpack, left the office early, and walked to the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital at 2 Village Road, Happy Valley, for a spring health consultation. The walk took about 20 minutes.
location: Walk from Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Happy Valley

name: Lunch and health consultation
description: Yu Xiaowei quickly ate at the hospital cafeteria as scheduled, ordering a light shredded chicken noodle soup. She then went to the outpatient department on time to see Dr. Zhou. Dr. Zhou commented on her recent exercise and diet plan, suggesting adding HIIT interval sprint movements such as high knees or jumping jacks before the jog, and adjusting the protein-to-carbohydrate ratio to improve results. They agreed on a follow-up in two weeks. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes and benefited a lot.

Her mother replied that everything was fine and said Xinxin was excitedly looking forward to going to the park tonight to watch running. Yu Xiaowei couldn't help smiling when she saw the message.

name: Buying embroidery thread in Sham Shui Po
description: Arriving at the New Peng Chai Fabric Market on Tung Chau Street in Sham Shui Po, Yu Xiaowei took out her prepared color cards and checklist and visited familiar thread stalls one by one, carefully comparing the luster of the threads and mentally matching them against the tiger-stripe color scheme of 'Tiger Roaring in the Mountains.' At a regular old shop, she selected 28 colors of fine, soft Hangzhou silk embroidery threads with excellent luster according to the checklist. The shopkeeper recognized a returning customer and gave her an extra half bundle of newly arrived gradient threads. In the middle of the shopping, Xuanxuan's homeroom teacher, Ms. Zhang, called to say that Xuanxuan had fallen again while playing football in PE class, but the school nurse had already handled it and the wound was not serious. Yu Xiaowei thanked her repeatedly and decided to go home and check carefully.
location: New Pang Jai Fabric Market, Tung Chau Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home
description: After shopping, Yu Xiaowei went home by MTR, satisfied. On the way, she took out the draft of Tiger Roaring in the Mountains, compared the newly bought silk threads, and annotated colors with a pencil, feeling happy.
location: Along the MTR line from Sham Shui Po Station to Kowloon City Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pick up son from school and check his wound
description: Yu Xiaowei first went home to drop off the embroidery silk, then went to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School to pick up Xuanxuan. On the way home, she carefully asked about the fall and reminded him to wear knee pads when playing football. After getting home, she carefully lifted the new bandage on Xuanxuan's knee, confirmed that the wound had scabbed over and was not red or swollen, and only then felt completely at ease. She changed it for a waterproof bandage.
location: Round trip from Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong

description: Her mother was already preparing dinner, so Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen to help wash and cut vegetables. After school, her daughter Xinxin ran over excitedly, hugged her, and told her funny stories from kindergarten. Yu Xiaowei listened and laughed, enjoying the warm mother-and-child time.
location: Home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family dinner
description: Ming returned home after repairing the air conditioner, and the whole family sat down to dinner. Mother had made white cut chicken, steamed fish, stir-fried choy sum, and pork bone soup with green radish and carrot. Everyone shared amusing moments from the day, and the atmosphere was pleasant. Yu Xiaowei double-checked the materials for her visit to Chen Meiling the next day and felt reassured.
location: Home dining room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child jogging time.
description: After dinner, they rested for a while. The weather was cool, so Yu Xiaowei took Xuanxuan and Xinxin for a walk to Kowloon Tsai Park. At the park, she first led Xuanxuan through warm-up stretches while Xinxin imitated alongside. Then the three of them started jogging about 1.5 kilometers, and Yu Xiaowei taught Xuanxuan how to adjust his breathing. Xinxin ran and stopped along the way, laughing constantly. After the run, they rested on a bench, and Yu Xiaowei told Xuanxuan the story of a Kenyan long-distance runner. Xuanxuan's eyes lit up and he said he wanted to run a marathon when he grew up. On the way home, Mingzai and the children stopped to buy milk and bread to replenish their energy.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go home to rest and put daughter to sleep
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowei gave Xinxin a bath first, dried her hair, and changed her into pajamas. She then coaxed her to sleep by telling her the story of Little Red Riding Hood. Listening to the story, Xinxin gradually fell asleep.
location: Home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description: After Xinxin fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei had some time to herself. She sat on the living room sofa and sorted the silk threads she had bought today with her existing threads by color. Then she took a photo and sent it to her Cantonese embroidery teacher, Wu Xiuying, to ask about the stitching method for the tiger stripes in “Tiger Roaring in the Mountains”. Teacher Wu quickly replied, suggesting that the gradient silk threads should be used in segments to ensure a natural transition. Yu Xiaowei noted everything down and felt full of anticipation for the work.
location: Home living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sorting out communication with family before bed
description: Yu Xiaowei took out the document folder and checked the materials prepared for Chen Meiling once more to confirm they were complete. Then she shared photos of tonight's parent-child jog in the family group, with a caption recording Xuanxuan's marathon wish, and friends in the embroidery group gave the post likes. After that, she did a simple skincare routine and drank a glass of warm water. Lying in bed, she chatted with Mingzai, who had just come home, about the joy of buying embroidery thread today and Xuanxuan's funny moments, sharing the little details of the day.
location: Home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Going to bed
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off the light and silently wished that tomorrow's client meeting would go smoothly. Looking back on the day, from yoga to work, from shopping in Sham Shui Po to the warm parent-child time, it was fulfilling and heartwarming, and she drifted into sleep with satisfaction.
location: Home bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning HIIT combined with strength training
description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei laid out a yoga mat in the living room and began her morning workout. She alternated three sets of resistance band squat jumps, three sets of bent-over rows, and three sets of planks, inserting 30 seconds of jumping jacks between sets to raise her heart rate. Sweat soaked her sports vest, but her mind became increasingly clear. After the 25-minute workout, she did five minutes of mindfulness meditation to calm her body and mind.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Showering, changing clothes, and getting ready to go out

She carefully checked her briefcase to make sure Chen Meiling's policy documents, the education fund plan comparison table, and the red pencil were all packed.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped with breakfast and family time.
description: At 7:00, Yu Xiaowei came to the dining table. Her mother had already prepared plain congee and steamed barbecue pork buns. She first poured a glass of warm milk for each of the two children, then brewed herself an essential cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea. While eating breakfast, she asked her son Zixuan about his knee. Zixuan said the wound no longer hurt, and she encouraged him to be careful in PE class today. Xinxin chattered about how kindergarten was going to paint spring today.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took daughter to school and returned
description: At 7:30, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Xinxin by the hand and walked to the kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin excitedly pointed at the wildflowers by the roadside. Yu Xiaowei walked her to the school gate, kissed her forehead, and watched the teacher lead her into the classroom before turning to leave. She then walked back home, ready to start the morning's work.
location: From Prince Building at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon City Kindergarten

Referring to her previous day's notes, she used a red pencil to mark the gap between the medical insurance coverage and inflation, and for the education fund plan, she recalculated the return comparisons for several payment periods based on the latest savings product interest rates. She attached these key figures and points to the front page of the documents with sticky notes, ensuring everything would be foolproof for the afternoon discussion.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

She opened the note-taking app on her phone and began outlining the framework for the PPT for the March Shenzhen sharing session, recording the key points and insights from the "Wang Qiming case".

name: Polished the PPT and integrated data at the company
description: Arrived at the office at 9:50. She first greeted her colleague Su Lishan, then returned to her workstation. She opened her computer, entered the outline she had recorded on the MTR into a PPT template, and used the company database to extract the latest "Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Medical Protection Plan" data, inserting it into the comparison charts for the Wang Qiming case. She also downloaded several official company product introduction PPTs as reference for page design.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: At 12:00, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan walked to the Dragon Dim Sum restaurant near the company. They ordered the signature shrimp dumplings, siu mai, and iced lemon tea. During the meal, Yu Xiaowei shared that she would be seeing Chen Meiling in the afternoon, and Shanshan gossiped with her about some amusing things in the team and cheered her on for the afternoon visit. After lunch, Yu Xiaowei rested briefly, then packed up, left the restaurant, and took the MTR from Wan Chai to Taikoo Shing in the Eastern District. During the roughly 30-minute ride, she went through the prepared materials and rehearsed her communication script with Chen Meiling in her mind.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Dragon Dim Sum at 216-218 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, and MTR train from Wan Chai to Tai Koo

name: Going to visit client Chen Meiling
description: After the MTR arrived at 13:20, Yu Xiaowei followed the navigation and walked to Chen Meiling's home at Golden Terrace, Taikoo Shing, checking the door numbers along the way to ensure she arrived on time. She arrived promptly at 13:30. Mrs. Chen warmly served almond cookies and Pu'er tea. At the living room coffee table, Yu Xiaowei spread out all the documents and first conducted an annual review of Mr. and Mrs. Chen's medical and savings insurance policies. She clearly marked the gap between the sum insured and inflation with a red pencil and patiently explained the changes in the dividend fulfillment ratio. Then, because Mrs. Chen's son was about to enter secondary school, she highlighted the newly launched children's education savings plan and calculated the returns under different premium payment periods. Mrs. Chen was very impressed, said on the spot that she would discuss it with her husband, and proactively mentioned that her friend Mrs. Lin also had needs and was willing to make a referral. Yu Xiaowei thanked her gratefully. The whole visit was focused and smooth, and by the time it ended it was already 4:30 p.m.
location: King's Terrace, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Ran into an old classmate at Cityplaza
description: After the visit ended, Yu Xiaowei was about to head to the MTR station when she unexpectedly ran into high school classmate He Junjie in the mall atrium. He had just finished business at a nearby car dealership. Both were pleasantly surprised to see each other and chatted for nearly 20 minutes beside a café in a corner of the mall. He Junjie teased her about working so hard, and Yu Xiaowei laughed and said the feeling was mutual. They agreed that He Junjie would organize the next class reunion.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Eastern District, 18 Taikoo Shing Road, Cityplaza Mall

name: Commuting back and recording review points
description: At 17:00, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her old classmate and took the MTR back to Kowloon City. On the train, she opened the memo app on her phone and quickly recorded the key points from this review: policy adjustment suggestions (increase daily hospital benefit, add outpatient coverage), Mrs. Chen's attitude toward the education fund (her husband's opinion needs to be considered), and most importantly, the contact information and insurance preferences of the new referral, Mrs. Lin (traditional savings type). She synced this memo to her computer through the company's internal software.
location: MTR train from Tai Koo Station to Kowloon City Station.

name: Buy fruit and, upon arriving home, prepare the preliminary work for Cantonese embroidery.
description: At 17:50, after the train arrived at the station, Yu Xiaowei did not go straight home but walked to the nearby Kowloon City Market, where she picked out a few fresh oranges, planning to give the children some vitamin C after dinner. Then she went home and handed the fruit to her mother, who was busy in the kitchen. After changing into comfortable loungewear, she went to the study and sorted the Hangzhou silk threads she had bought in Sham Shui Po the day before by color, winding them onto thread boards, especially storing the bundle of gradient-colored threads that had been a gift. Next, she found her embroidery hoop and white poplin embroidery fabric, washed and ironed them, and prepared everything for tonight's pattern transfer work.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City Market Cooked Food Centre, and No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince Tower

name: Family dinner

At the table, Yu Xiaowei asked about Zixuan's homework and Xinxin's spring painting activity at kindergarten, and the family chatted and laughed together.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Then she took Xinxin to bathe, read her two picture books, and coaxed her to sleep. Before bed, she made a point of checking the wound on Zixuan's knee. Seeing that the scab had formed well, she disinfected it with povidone-iodine and put on a new waterproof bandage.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

In the study, she first transferred the sketch of 'Tiger Roaring in the Mountains' from tracing paper onto the ironed embroidery fabric, lightly outlining the tiger with a pencil to make sure it was centered. When that was done, she opened her computer and continued working on the draft PPT for the Shenzhen sharing session. She turned the afternoon's data from Wang Qiming's case into charts with concise captions. At one point she felt thirsty, so she got up and made a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea to refresh herself.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing for bed and going to sleep
description: At 22:30, Yu Xiaowei saved the PPT file and stretched. She neatly arranged the embroidery basket and tools, then went to the bathroom to wash up. Before 23:00, lying in bed, she reviewed the fulfilling day and felt grounded and content. She softly said goodnight to her husband, closed her eyes, and soon fell asleep.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning easy run and meditation.
description: At 6:00 in the morning, started an easy run at Kowloon Tsai Park. The weather was clear today, planned to complete 6 km at a pace of 7:00 min/km. While running, mentally drafted the response script for handling Uncle Li's complaint. Completed the goal at 6:45, did 10 minutes of stretching by the park bench, then closed my eyes for 5 minutes of meditation, regulated my breathing, and charged myself with energy for the new day.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go home, freshen up, and have breakfast
description: At 7:00 sharp, she walked in the door and smelled the aroma of the shrimp roe noodles her mom had cooked. She quickly took a shower, changed into her professional suit, and put on simple work makeup. While eating the noodles, she asked her son Zixuan if his knee still hurt. He shook his head and said it was fine, which put her at ease. Her husband Weiming said he would drop their son off at Kowloon Tong Government Primary School on his way this morning, so she could go to the office without worry.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home

location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

On the train, I opened the notes app on my phone, jotted down the complaint-handling script I'd thought of in the morning, and checked this morning's stock market.
location: MTR (Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Morning preparation at the office

After turning on the computer, she checked her emails and today's to-do list, and pulled up the contact information of Mrs. Lin, who had been referred by Chen Meiling yesterday, from Excel.
location: Office, 27th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning core work.
description: The morning was very efficient. She first handled three emails about policy renewal payments and product inquiries, then made five customer follow-up calls, checking on one client's recovery and reminding another client of next month's policy payment deadline. Around 11:00, using the phone number given by Chen Meiling, she searched for and added "Mrs. Lam" on WeChat with a polite greeting. The request was quickly approved, and after a brief conversation, she successfully scheduled a phone call for next Tuesday afternoon.
location: Office, 27th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: 11:30 tidied up the desk, went downstairs to the lobby of AIA Building to meet Su Lishan. They walked together to Lockhart Road, discussing the "New Shanghai Kitchen" restaurant they were going to for lunch. At the restaurant they ordered pan-fried buns, scallion oil noodles, and hot and sour soup, and while eating discussed the presentation logic for the March Shenzhen sharing session. Su Lishan, from a frontline sales perspective, suggested adding a "high-frequency questions and answers from mainland clients" segment, and also pointed out several terms in the PPT that might seem obscure to mainland clients. She carefully recorded the key points and planned to finalize the draft over the weekend. At 13:15 lunch ended. On the way back to the office, she deliberately sent Mrs. Lin a WeChat message to confirm the phone call next Tuesday, strengthening trust, and arrived at the office at 13:30.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese restaurant on Lockhart Road and the surrounding streets

name: Handle customer complaints and follow-ups.
description: Shortly after returning to her desk, she received an impatient call from an old client, Uncle Li, complaining that his hospitalization claim had not been paid. She immediately calmed him in a gentle tone and promised to check right away. After hanging up, she called the claims department and found that the itemized list of hospital medication was missing. She called him back and patiently guided him on which department to go to in the hospital to get it reissued and what to say, and promised to proactively follow up next Monday. After handling this, she felt a bit unsettled, worried it might affect her reputation.
location: Office, 27th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Report client updates to the supervisor

Then she mentioned that she was discussing cross-border group insurance intentions with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming. General Manager Liang expressed appreciation and reminded her to pay attention to compliance details. She deliberately did not mention the complaint incident, planning to report it after it was resolved.
location: Liang Zhenhua's office, 27/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

She checked Wang Qiming's proposal file again, confirmed the data was correct, saved it to a USB drive, and planned to take it home over the weekend to continue improving it. At around 16:30, she sent a message to her mother at home: 'Mom, I'll be home around 8 tonight. No need to wait for me for dinner, but save me a bowl of soup.'
location: Office, 27th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Facial care for stress relief

The hospital didn't provide all the documents. Once that's sorted out next week, it'll be fine." Her mood gradually calmed during the treatment and with her friend's comfort.
location: Yaxuan Slimming and Beauty Centre (Shunxi Causeway Bay Centre Branch), 492 Lockhart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

While sipping the soup, I listened to my son share funny stories from school, and the day's fatigue seemed to melt away.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home

name: Parent-child time and household chores

She played princess puzzles with her daughter Xinxin for a while, then helped her son Zixuan check his math homework, patiently explaining the wrong answers in an easy-to-understand way. Then she bathed her daughter, read the bedtime story 'Little Red Riding Hood' to her, and coaxed her to sleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home

name: Online chat with embroidery friends and Cantonese embroidery

The two had a video call, chatting about the recent progress on the Cantonese embroidery piece Tiger Roaring in the Mountains and interesting bits of their lives, encouraging each other. After the call, she took out the embroidery hoop and continued using a fine rolling needle to outline the tiger's whiskers.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: At 22:45, she put away her embroidery tools, washed up, and did her skincare routine. Lying in bed, she reviewed the day: although she had faced the shock of a complaint, her mood had returned to calm through comfort from friends and the stress relief of skincare. She briefly scrolled through the calendar on her phone, remembering that tomorrow was Saturday and she needed to take the children to see their grandmother. At 23:30, she turned off the lights and went to bed.
location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: The alarm went off at 7, half an hour later than on workdays. I put on loose yoga clothes and spread my mat in the living room. I started with 12 minutes of morning vinyasa yoga, including five Sun Salutations and balancing poses such as Tree Pose and Eagle Pose, letting my body slowly wake up. Then I sat cross-legged and used the Headspace app for a 5-minute mindful breathing meditation. With each deep breath, I gently breathed out the annoyance from yesterday's client complaint (Uncle Li's claims case) and felt my thoughts settle.
location: Living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Called her mother to arrange afternoon tea
description: After meditating, I felt refreshed. Thinking that my mother should have just finished exercising in the park downstairs, I called her. We chatted about everyday things, and I asked her to meet at "Golden Phoenix Tea Restaurant" in Kowloon City Plaza at 3 p.m. I specially ordered her favorite silk-stocking milk tea and freshly baked pineapple buns; my mother smiled and promised to bring the sesame rolls I loved as a child. The call lasted about 15 minutes and was full of laughter.
location: Living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing breakfast and doing housework
description: After hanging up the phone, I went into the kitchen and toasted two slices of whole-wheat bread for myself and two for my husband, fried two sunny-side-up eggs, and made two cups of instant coffee. As we ate breakfast, I quickly wiped the dining table. I put the Lego bricks that the children had left scattered on the sofa the night before into a storage box, and took the laundry out of the washing machine and folded it.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing to take daughter to dance class

At exactly 9 o'clock, the three of us put on our jackets and left. Zhang Weiming drove, I sat in the front passenger seat, and Xinxin quietly hummed a nursery rhyme in the back seat.
location: Residence, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking daughter to dance class (commute)
