description: At 9:15, we arrived at the London Ballet School on Boundary Street. Xinxin happily ran into the classroom on tiptoe. My husband and I found a good spot outside the glass window and watched our daughter seriously follow the teacher through barre exercises and turns. After class, Xinxin ran out holding the 'Elegant Princess' sticker the teacher had rewarded her with and pressed it onto her forehead. I immediately smiled, took out my phone, and snapped several photos of her, while my husband smiled gently beside us.
location: London Ballet School, Boundary Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home after class (commute)
description: After class, Zhang Weiming drove us home. During the drive, Xinxin excitedly described the new moves the teacher taught today. I responded while adding a to-do item for "tomorrow's picnic" in my phone calendar. The drive took about 12 minutes.
location: In the car driving back to 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, from London Ballet School, Boundary Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Back home, my parents were already there. My mother had made simple char siu soup noodles, and the five of us (my son Zixuan had gone to a friend's house to play and wasn't back yet) sat around the dining table for lunch. My husband and I discussed the parent-child craft homework that our son needed to hand in for school next week, while my father read the newspaper beside us. After the meal, I put the dishes into the dishwasher and then rested on the living room sofa for 20 minutes.
location: Dining room and living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Free time (contacting son and scrolling on phone)
description: After resting, I called my son Zixuan, who was playing at a friend’s house, and reminded him to stay safe and come home early. Then I leaned back on the sofa and scrolled through my phone: I checked the internal work group messages at AIA to confirm next Monday’s morning meeting arrangement; and in the “Tiger Year Cantonese Embroidery” interest group chat, I replied to several embroidery friends’ discussions about thread color matching.
location: Living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize the family photo albums.
description: I went to the study, turned on the computer, and imported the photos from last month's family trip to Disneyland into the hard drive. I also picked out a few good shots and planned to post them on WeChat Moments in a couple of days. I organized the folders “2025 Spring Festival” and “Xinxin's Ballet Performance” in chronological order. In between, I got up and went to the balcony to water the plants, then poured myself a glass of water.
location: Home study, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk to the appointment.
description: At 2:45 p.m., I changed into a comfortable dress and flat shoes, checked my wallet and phone, and walked out. It's about a 10-minute walk from home to Kowloon City Plaza. The sunshine was just right and the breeze was gentle, and my mood became relaxed.
location: On the way walking from 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon City Plaza, Kowloon City District

name: Mother-daughter afternoon tea time
description: I chose a booth by the window and ordered two cups of silk-stocking milk tea and a plate of pineapple buns with butter. At 3 o'clock sharp, my mother arrived as promised and handed me a box of sesame rolls that were still warm. We ate and chatted. I poured out all my worries — the pressure of promotion, my concerns about my husband's career, and the unpleasant business of Uncle Li's complaint yesterday. My mother shared how she handled competition among primary school teachers when she was young, comforted me by saying that things would work out in the end, and praised me for doing better than my peers. We also talked about Xinxin's progress in ballet and Zixuan's studies, and agreed to do Cantonese embroidery together next month. These two hours alone with her made me feel very warm inside.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 128 Carpenter Road, 2nd Floor, Kowloon City Plaza, 'Golden Phoenix Cafe'.

name: Going shopping
description: After afternoon tea, I said goodbye to my mother at the entrance of the tea restaurant. Instead of going straight home, I first went up to the second floor and browsed a clothing store, where I picked out a nice spring floral silk scarf for myself. Then I went down to the basement level Wellcome supermarket and bought a pack of cheese sausages my son loves and a box of cherries, to prepare for tomorrow's picnic.
location: Clothing store on the second floor and Wellcome supermarket on the basement level of Kowloon City Plaza, 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home to organize the shopping
description: I walked home carrying shopping bags. After arriving home, I put the cheese sausages in the fridge, rinsed the cherries and put them on a plate, and hung the new silk scarf on the rack in the cloakroom.
location: Residence, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assist with preparing dinner and daily family routines
description: I put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help my mother. I was responsible for trimming and washing the vegetables, and I cleaned the sink. My father was in the living room testing his newly bought camera, saying it was to prepare for taking photos at tomorrow's picnic.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and planning tomorrow's picnic
description: My son Xuanxuan was brought home at 6:30 by a friend's father. The whole family sat around the table and started dinner. During the meal, I suggested, “Since the weather is so nice tomorrow, how about the whole family going to Kowloon Walled City Park for a picnic?” My husband was the first to agree, saying he could bring the new kite; my father volunteered to take charge of the photos; and my mother said she could prepare her signature soy-braised chicken wings. Everyone excitedly discussed the division of tasks, and we finally settled on: I would be in charge of rice balls and sandwiches, my husband would prepare the picnic mat, kite, and trash bags, and my parents would help look after the child.
location: Residential dining room, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time
description: After dinner, I accompanied my daughter Xinxin on the balcony to sort out the clothes for the little doll "Little Bear" that we'll bring to the picnic tomorrow. Meanwhile, my husband played a game of Ludo with my son Xuanxuan in the living room, filled with laughter.
location: Living room and balcony at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Putting the children to bed
description: At 8:30, my husband and I separately took the children to bathe and brush their teeth. I told my daughter two chapters of 'The Little Prince', then watched Xinxin fall into a deep sleep clutching her doll. As for our son, my husband tucked him in too.
location: Children's room at the residence, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparations for Tiger Year Cantonese embroidery
description: After the children fell asleep, the world quieted down. In the living room under the warm light, I spread out the embroidery fabric and first used a 4B pencil to redraw the tiger's outline darker. Then I opened the embroidery thread box, carefully matched black, yellow, orange, and white silk threads, and repeatedly compared the color transitions beside the fabric. I also checked the tension of the embroidery hoop, adjusted and tightened it, and tried a few stitches with a needle threaded with black silk thread; the feel was good. After finishing all this, I neatly put the tools back into the box, looking forward to officially starting the embroidery after tomorrow's picnic.
location: Living room of the residence at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: I returned to the bedroom, applied some night cream, and chatted briefly with my husband, who had just finished watching a tech documentary on his iPad, about tomorrow's picnic details. I scrolled through the photos I took today of my mother and Xinxin on my phone, feeling a deep sense of contentment. At 23:00, I turned off the light and lay down, drifting off to sleep with anticipation for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom of residence, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning recovery run and bumping into a fellow runner
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei set off from her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, for a slow jog, deliberately keeping the pace around 7 minutes per kilometer, focusing on relaxation and recovery. When she ran to Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road), she met her running companion Shen Peiwen, and they ran about 3 kilometers together along the park's outer edge, discussing route details for next weekend's night run in Kwun Tong, and suggesting running the Kwun Tong Promenade to the Cha Kwo Ling Seaside Park section. After that, Shen Peiwen turned toward home, while Yu Xiaowei continued along the Kwun Tong Promenade to finish the remaining distance, covering about 8 kilometers in 56 minutes. Returning to the shade of the trees at Kowloon Tsai Park, she did a full 15-minute post-run stretch, focusing on releasing the gastrocnemius muscle in her right leg with a foam roller.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road), Kwun Tong Promenade (Hoi Bun Road, Kwun Tong District)

name: Return home and wash up.
description: Walked home slowly, heartbeat calming down. While the family had not yet fully woken up, she took a warm shower, changed into comfortable loungewear, and, refreshed, prepared to start the day's activities.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home

name: Family picnic preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei put on an apron, shaped six triangular tuna salad rice balls with pearl rice, and wrapped them in plastic wrap; her husband Zhang Weiming made eight simple ham, cheese, and lettuce sandwiches; her mother Chen Meiling made a box of soy-braised chicken wings; her father Yu Guoqiang wiped down the DSLR camera and checked the batteries; Zhang Weiming packed a picnic mat, a kite, small toys, and mini ice packs into a large backpack; her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin darted excitedly between the living room and kitchen with bubble machines. At 8:45, Yu Xiaowei sent a voice message to her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen, letting him know the whole family was going on a picnic.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home kitchen and living room

name: Walk to Kowloon Walled City Park
description: The family of six set out from home on Prince Edward Road West and walked to Kowloon Walled City Park. The two children ran ahead holding hands, while Father Yu Guoqiang followed behind with a smile, looking after his granddaughter and carrying a DSLR camera. Yu Xiaowei walked side by side with her husband Zhang Weiming, who carried a heavy picnic bag. Her mother Chen Meiling held Yu Xiaowei's other arm and chatted as they walked, saying that the fish pond in the park probably hadn't been cleaned in a long time. The 15-minute walk was full of laughter and cheerful talk.
location: Along the route from 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to the South Gate of Kowloon Walled City Park (Carpenter Road)

name: Kowloon Walled City Park picnic and family time.
description: Spread out a picnic blanket on the lawn near the south gate, and the children ran off to play: Zhang Zixuan pulled his father to fly a colorful butterfly kite, which soon flew high; their daughter Zhang Yuxin blew bubbles with a bubble machine and ran after them laughing. The family laid out the food, eating and chatting while enjoying the sunshine and breeze. Around 12 noon, a performance by the band “Somali Pirates” came from the square. The family listened to a few Beyond songs, and the children swayed to the beat. Meanwhile, her father Yu Guoqiang stepped back to take a photo and didn't notice a stone at his feet, slightly spraining his ankle. Yu Xiaowei immediately applied a mini ice pack. After resting for half an hour, it was nothing serious, and they continued resting.
location: Lawn near the south gate of Kowloon Walled City Park, Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Packing up to head home and strolling through historic sites.
description: In the slanting afternoon sun, the family packed up: Zhang Weiming and Yu Xiaowei bagged the trash and took it away, Mother Chen Meiling brushed grass clippings off the children, Father insisted on walking by himself, and son Zhang Zixuan put on his little backpack and wanted to take care of Grandpa. Along the way, they visited the historical photo exhibition of the Kowloon Walled City in the park, and Yu Xiaowei told the two children about the history of the Walled City. Then they walked back home on Prince Edward Road West. After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei asked Zhang Weiming to apply some bruise-relieving medicated oil to her father's ankle to make sure he was all right.
location: Kowloon Walled City Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and return home to 328 Prince Edward Road West.

name: Afternoon rest and parent-child time
description: After returning home, everyone rested. Yu Xiaowei lay on the sofa for 20 minutes, drinking water and relaxing. Xuanxuan and Xinxin played with LEGO in the living room. After her rest, Yu Xiaowei joined them, and together they built a small castle. The daughter said the castle looked like the Kowloon Walled City. Her husband Zhang Weiming watched the news nearby, and later organized the photos he had taken today.
location: Living room and study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm family dinner and video call.
description: Mother Chen Meiling made shrimp wonton noodles, and the whole family sat together eating and chatting about the picnic fun. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei cleared the dishes on her own initiative so her mother could rest. Then she took out her phone and video-called her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen, shared picnic photos, asked about his recent work, and chatted briefly with her sister-in-law. The two children also vied to speak in front of the camera, telling their uncle about the fun of flying kites.
location: Dining room and living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Putting the children to bed
description: Husband Zhang Weiming showed the children the electronic photo album "Kowloon Walled City History" taken today, and Yu Xiaowei told a story about a little dragon girl's adventures in the Kowloon Walled City. Afterward, they gave soft goodnight kisses, and the two children quickly fell asleep.
location: Child's bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night Cantonese embroidery work.
description: After the world fell quiet, Yu Xiaowei set up her embroidery frame in the living room and began working on a Guangdong embroidery piece for the Year of the Tiger. First, using black silk thread and a rolling stitch, she outlined the tiger's head, including the lines of the eyes, nose, and mouth, adjusting the stitches by comparing with a photo of a tiger on her phone. Then she switched to golden-yellow silk thread to fill in the base color of the face, laying the foundation for the layered fur. After more than two hours of total concentration, she felt calm and content. She checked the tightness of the stitches and packed away the embroidery with satisfaction.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming stood on the balcony for 5 minutes, chatting about the day's happy moments in the night breeze. After returning to the room, she sat on the edge of the bed and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relax her neck, which had become stiff from long hours of embroidery. Then she kissed her sleeping husband, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully at 23:15.
location: Master bedroom and balcony at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning strength training and meditation
description: In the morning, I did strength training and meditation at home. Using a resistance band, I completed glute, leg, and core exercises, 15 reps per set for 3 sets, feeling the satisfying burn of muscles working. Then I meditated on a floor mat for 5 minutes, focusing on my breath and clearing my mind to infuse the new week with calm energy. After the session, I did additional post-run stretches because my calves had felt a bit tight after Sunday's run. I had also done some simple relaxation before bed last night, but I deliberately spent extra time easing the muscle tension.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and preparations
description: After meditating and taking a shower, she had breakfast with her family, feeling refreshed. Her mother had prepared fried eggs, ham macaroni, and milk tea. While eating, Xiaowei reminded her son Xuanxuan to bring the materials needed for science class, and helped her daughter Xinxin check the drawing book in her small schoolbag. Her husband Zhang Weiming helped prepare the children's insulated water bottles. Xiaowei also asked about her father's ankle, which he had sprained the day before; her father said it had improved a lot after applying medicated wine. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the children to school
description: She drove with her husband to take the children to school. First, they took their daughter Xinxin to the Kowloon City kindergarten; at the gate, she kissed her little cheek and watched her follow the teacher into the school. Then they hurried to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and dropped their son Xuanxuan at the school gate before 7:50, reminding him to listen carefully in class. She left only after making sure both children were safely inside.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten: No. 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; Kowloon Tong Government Primary School: Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to work
description: After dropping off the children, she took the MTR Kwun Tong Line from Kowloon Tong Station to Mong Kok Station, then transferred to the Island Line for Wan Chai Station. The ride took about 40 minutes. Xiaowei put on her earphones and listened to the Cantonese audiobook “The Struggle of a Hong Kong Blind Masseur” to relax. After exiting the station, she walked along Gloucester Road for 5 minutes and arrived at her office in AIA Building at 8:50.
location: MTR Kowloon Tong Station to MTR Wan Chai Station, finally arriving at AIA Tower, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning work and lunch invitation
description: After arriving at the office, she first handled several urgent emails. Then she systematically sorted through the client inquiries accumulated over the weekend and entered potential client information into the follow-up ledger. In particular, she prepared a detailed product proposal for Mrs. Wang, who planned to arrange coverage for her newborn, and made a preliminary estimate of the family's annual income and expenses. At the same time, she began preparing materials for the evening video conference with Guangzhou colleague Guo Junwei, studying the latest terms of cross-border medical insurance. After this part of the work was done, at 11:15 she called her friend Su Lishan (Shanshan) on the internal line, arranged to have lunch together at the café in Shui On Centre, and decided to set off at 11:45.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: She set off early with her colleague Su Lishan to the café at Shui On Centre to avoid the peak-hour queue. They ordered a Caesar salad and a hot latte, and chatted about weekend fun while eating. Xiaowei shared the joy of yesterday's picnic at Kowloon Walled City Park and the minor incident of her father twisting his ankle, while Shanshan shared her experience taking her daughter to swimming lessons over the weekend. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Café on the 1st floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday outing: hospital consultation and chance encounter
description: After lunch, she explained to Shanshan that she had personal matters to attend to and left alone. From Wan Chai Station she took the Island Line to Admiralty Station, transferred to the South Island Line to Ocean Park Station, and walked about 5 minutes to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. In the appointed consultation room, she described in detail her spring strength training and half-marathon preparation plan to her family doctor, Zhou Wenbin, and asked how to adjust her nutrition to prevent knee injury. After reviewing her food diary, Dr. Zhou pointed out that her calcium intake was too low, recommended adding one carton of milk per day, eating more soy products and dark green vegetables, and emphasized the importance of adequate stretching and cool-down after running. Xiaowei carefully noted the key points in her phone memo, and candidly admitted that she sometimes skipped the cool-down due to lack of time. Dr. Zhou seriously reminded her of the risk. After leaving the consultation room, she ran into her former co-worker Liu Jiahui in the lobby, who was accompanying his pregnant wife for a prenatal check-up. The two greeted each other with surprise and chatted for 5 minutes. She learned that he had been posted to Hong Kong by his company for short-term work. They exchanged new contact information and agreed to meet for tea and catch up when free. Afterwards she took the MTR back to Wan Chai, and at the convenience store in Convention Plaza, following the doctor's advice, she bought two cartons of high-calcium fresh milk and a small bag of mixed nuts as a snack.
location: Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital: 2 Village Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; Convention Plaza Convenience Store: 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work, rest, and communication with supervisor.
description: After returning to the office, she immersed herself in the afternoon's work. She opened the draft PPT for the March sharing session, focused on the cross-border medical insurance chapter, and listed questions about rate calculation and applicable terms, in preparation for the evening video conference with colleague Guo Junwei. She also replied to greeting messages from several regular clients, added Mrs. Lin, who had been referred the previous day, as a contact, and briefly introduced herself. At around 4 p.m., feeling tired, she went to the break room, brewed a hot American coffee in her own cup, drank a carton of fresh milk she had bought that morning, and ate a few nuts to relax. Later, in the corridor, she met her superior Liang Zhenhua (Brother Hua). He asked about the recent follow-up on major clients. Xiaowei briefly reported on Mrs. Lin's referral and the progress with new clients, and mentioned that she would have a meeting with Guo Junwei in the evening to resolve product details. Brother Hua expressed recognition and encouragement for her initiative and professionalism.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: After-work commute
description: On time, she packed up her desk and left the office, took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Kowloon Tong Station, then transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station. After exiting the station, she walked through the familiar Whampoa Wonderland Mall and headed home on foot.
location: Starting from AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, take the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station, then walk through The Whampoa shopping mall at 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, back home.

name: Family dinner and dietary adjustments.
description: When she got home, her mother had already prepared dinner: steamed pomfret, garlic broccoli, and pork rib soup with Chinese yam and corn. Following the doctor's advice, Xiaowei took the initiative to serve herself more soup and placed the broccoli in front of her, sharing with her family the new nutritional knowledge she had gained from seeing the doctor today. Everyone expressed their support. At the dinner table, her son Xuanxuan excitedly shared about the experiment of observing broad bean germination in science class, while her daughter Xinxin showed off her drawing of "the family flying a kite." The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family time: homework and parent-child games.
description: After the meal, helped her son Xuanxuan check his math homework. Found that he had made a mistake in a word problem, and patiently guided him to re-read the question and recalculate. Afterwards, she played a word card game with her daughter Xinxin in the living room, interacting with her using English words, combining education with fun. Her husband Zhang Weiming was beside them processing some work emails on his computer.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video conference with colleague Guo Junwei.
description: After coaxing the two children to take a bath and get ready for bed, Xiaowei went to the study for a scheduled video call with Guo Junwei, her colleague stationed in Guangzhou. The two communicated in Mandarin, focusing on the details of the cross-border medical insurance clauses in the March sharing session PPT. Guo Junwei professionally explained the zone-based premium calculation method for specific Greater Bay Area medical insurance and provided the latest compliance guidelines. Xiaowei carefully added key points in the PPT comment section and agreed to send him the revised version before next Monday.
location: Study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening embroidery: focusing on the tiger's eyes and facial stripes
description: After the video call, I made a cup of hot tea and took out the Year of the Tiger Cantonese embroidery piece on the living room sofa. I put on a thimble and first carefully embroidered the tiger's eyes with white and black silk thread, using radial stitches to show the gloss of the eyeball and the sharpness of the pupil. Then I switched to dark yellow silk thread and used random stitching to embroider the 'king' character marking on the forehead, aiming for a vivid three-dimensional texture. Wei Lan's classic Cantonese songs played softly in the background as I enjoyed a peaceful, focused time.
location: Living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening pre-bedtime preparation and reading.
description: After pausing her embroidery, she stood up and did five minutes of stretches for her shoulders, neck, and legs, carefully completing the simplified version of the post-run stretch routine as instructed by Dr. Zhou to relax the day's muscles. Then she went to wash up, did her skincare, and changed into pajamas. When she returned to the bedroom, her husband was already leaning against the headboard reading. Xiaowei slipped under the duvet and shared with him the coincidence of running into Liu Jiahui at the hospital today and the details of the doctor's advice to supplement calcium, chatting for more than ten minutes. Afterward, she picked up an essay collection from the nightstand and read a few pages to calm her mind. At 23:30 she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning easy run and post-run stretching.
description: At 6 a.m., as the sky was just beginning to lighten, Yu Xiaowei set off from home in her running shoes and completed an easy 7-kilometer run around the Whampoa Garden estate in a light drizzle. Her pace was 7:06 per kilometer, and the cool weather made her feel very comfortable. After the run, she went home to take a hot shower to ward off the chill, then laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 10 minutes of leg and core stretching.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Breakfast and a brief family gathering.
description: After stretching, she changed into loungewear and came to the dining room. Her mother Chen Meiling had prepared a nutritious breakfast: cereal, fried eggs, and high-calcium milk. Yu Xiaowei enjoyed it while listening to her father Yu Guoqiang talk about interesting moments from yesterday's chess game, and reminded her son Xuanxuan that he had morning reading today and needed to leave earlier. The family enjoyed a warm morning together.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Helped her husband take the children to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went out together. Her husband drove their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School first, and at the school gate reminded him to pay attention in class. Then they took their daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten, watching her run happily into the classroom. Afterward, her husband drove home, and Yu Xiaowei walked to the MTR station near Argyle Street.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, 2 Oxford Road, Kowloon Tong, to Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street

name: Commuting and contacting colleague Su Lishan
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from Argyle Street to Mong Kok East MTR Station and transferred to the subway to Wan Chai. In the carriage, she contacted her colleague Su Lishan via company WeChat to ask how to stick to morning yoga and meditation. Su Lishan enthusiastically shared her experience, recommending the Sun Salutation A sequence and the app "Tide," and encouraged her to keep going. Yu Xiaowei was inspired and decided to download and try it that evening. She transferred at Admiralty Station to the Island Line and got off at Wan Chai Station.
location: Along the MTR line from Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station

name: Arriving at the company and preparing for work.
description: Arrived at the AIA Building office in Wan Chai on time at 8:25. After putting down my briefcase, I went to the pantry to brew a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea to refresh myself, opened my computer to check today's to-do items, and checked the orange and yellow embroidery thread samples in my bag prepared for the evening embroidery. After confirming they were correct, I began planning the morning's work.
location: Office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Morning work: key client follow-up
description: Entering focused work mode. Yu Xiaowei first contacted Mrs. Li, a client interested in increasing her coverage. On the phone she patiently answered Mrs. Li's questions about savings dividends and medical protection clauses, helped finalize the specific amount of the additional coverage plan, then quickly entered the information into the CRM system and promised to send the electronic proposal later.
location: Office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Telephone follow-up and material preparation.
description: Yu Xiaowei made phone follow-up calls to several potential clients, asking about their recent situations one by one and introducing the latest offers. Among them, Miss Shen was interested in education savings plans, so Yu Xiaowei arranged to meet her the following week. After the calls, she updated the clients' statuses in the system, then prepared the comparison data and case analyses needed for her meeting with client Wang Qiming next week, printing and binding them.
location: Office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Lunch and review of training plan
description: During lunch break, Yu Xiaowei went alone to the Jinbao Cha Chaan Teng on Jaffe Road, Wan Chai, near her office, and ordered the regular set meal of satay beef noodles with iced lemon tea. While waiting, she took out her phone, opened the running app, and browsed the weekend training plan from her running group, thinking about whether to try a new route next week.
location: Golden Castle Restaurant, 154 Jaffe Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong (east of Kam Fok Mansion)

name: Stop by Sham Shui Po on the way to replenish embroidery thread

Then she took her daughter to Honeymoon Dessert on the 2nd floor, where they shared mango pomelo sago and stewed egg white with hashima, listening to her daughter talk about fun things that happened in class. The mother and daughter spent a warm time together until 11:25.

description: Back at her desk after the meeting, she struck while the iron was hot and organized the meeting points into a memo, readjusted the budget table of the previously submitted proposal, added an 'Expected Return Analysis' column, and supplemented cost control measures. After completing it, she emailed the updated version to Brother Hua. At 11 o'clock, she received a call from VIP client Mr. Li, who asked in a rather urgent tone about the details of the cash value withdrawal clauses in a large participating insurance policy. Yu Xiaowei patiently explained with her professional knowledge, illustrating the differences in returns under different scenarios, and calmed him down. After hanging up, she immediately wrote a detailed email to put the verbal explanations in writing, attached screenshots of the relevant policy pages, and confirmed the send.
location: Personal workstation, 12th Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday rest and seaside stroll
description: At noon, she took out the light salad and fruit she had brought from her bag and decided to go to Wan Chai Waterfront Park to rest in the sea breeze. She walked 13 minutes to the park, sat on a bench, and ate her salad while watching the sea view and boats, feeling her tense nerves relax. After eating, she took a slow 10-minute walk along the waterfront promenade and confirmed via WeChat her 2 p.m. meeting with client Mr. Li. At 13:00, she set off back to the company. Passing a convenience store at Convention Plaza, she remembered that the cat food at home was almost finished, so she went in and bought a bag of low-calorie prescription food that Fatty loves, planning to take it home after work.
location: After her husband and son came home, Yu Xiaowei used her laptop in the living room to polish the details of the "Cross-Border Wealth Planning" success case in her promotion materials. She played with Lego with her son while refining the data in the case. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables and prepare dinner.

name: Organize client data and follow up on emails
description: Back at her desk, she first jotted down in her memo several follow-up ideas for clients that she had thought of in the park, then organized the proposal materials for the afternoon meeting with Mr. Li, making sure all data was up to date. At the same time, she replied to the confirmation email from the morning's VIP client, Mr. Li, and copied the assistant to follow up.
location: Personal workstation, 12th Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: In-person meeting with VIP client Mr. Li
description: She set off 5 minutes early and walked to the café at Shui On Centre. After arriving, she ordered two cups of pour-over coffee, and Mr. Li arrived on time. The main topic was the education fund plan for his 8-year-old son. Based on the latest financial situation and possible immigration plans, she adjusted the pre-designed plan and strongly recommended the “AIA Long-Term Savings Plan,” explaining in detail the risks and the return cycle. The meeting had a cordial atmosphere. Mr. Li recognized her professionalism and said he would take the plan home to discuss with his wife, with an answer by next Tuesday. After saying goodbye, she walked back to the office and sent a WeChat message to her supervisor, Liang Zhenhua, to let him know the meeting had gone smoothly.
location: From the AIA Building at 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to the cafe at Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai, then back to the AIA Building.

name: Afternoon office work and client follow-ups
description: Returned to the office to handle routine matters: wrote a detailed meeting summary with Mr. Li and set up a customer follow-up file; made phone callbacks to two recent renewal customers to confirm they received their new policies and answer minor questions about payment methods; updated customer information in the CRM system.
location: Personal workstation, 12th Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute and book shopping
description: Before the evening rush hour, she tidied up her desk, took the MTR from Wan Chai station back to Kowloon City, and texted her husband on the way to ask when he would be home, telling him she would pick up the extracurricular book ordered for their son on the way. After collecting the reserved children's extracurricular reading at the bookstore in Wonder World, she returned to her home in Whampoa Garden.
location: From Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Garden residential estate in Kowloon City District, passing the Whampoa New World bookstore

name: Family dinner time
description: Pushing open the door of the Whampoa Garden home, mother had already made steamed grass carp and stir-fried chicken strips with broccoli. Father and husband chatted about the day's news. As they ate, Yu Xiaowei asked the children about their school day. Her daughter excitedly showed off a rainbow she had drawn; her son glumly said he hadn't done well on his math quiz. Yu Xiaowei comforted him and said they would review the wrong questions together after dinner.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening tutoring and parent-child games
description: After dinner, accompanied my son to do homework in the study, checked math and English question by question. I found he was not proficient at two-digit multiplication word problems, so I explained patiently using real-life examples (like buying 4 bags of chips at 25 yuan each), and encouraged him to copy the wrong questions into his mistake notebook. Later, I played with my daughter with a map of China puzzle in the living room, helped her find the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and imitated the sister running a marathon on the livestream, making the whole family laugh.
location: Study and living room at home

name: Family leisure time
description: The children went to take baths, her husband tidied up the toys, and her parents watched a TV drama in the living room. Yu Xiaowei leaned back on the sofa, broke off two small pieces of 70% dark chocolate and let them melt in her mouth as a reward, while taking out her phone to browse the embroidery tutorial videos that her Cantonese embroidery teacher Wu Xiuying had shared in the group, admiring the newly embroidered peony picture and enjoying the tranquility.
location: Living room at home

name: Evening stretching and relaxation
description: On the bedroom floor, she did 15 minutes of leg stretching and foam rolling to relieve the soreness still lingering from yesterday's first half-marathon training, and also to prepare for next month's half-marathon race.
location: Bedroom at home.

name: Bath and skincare
description: After taking a comfortable hot bath, I applied a hydrating sheet mask, and during the 10-minute wait I gave my legs a simple massage from my calves to my thighs to help relax and recover the muscles.
location: Master bedroom bathroom

name: Bedtime reading and conversation between husband and wife
description: Leaning against the headboard with her husband, she picked up a new book on client psychology and found the communication tips very practical; her husband scrolled through phone news. The two chatted off and on, sharing that Mr. Li had given good feedback on the proposal today. Her husband suggested taking the kids hiking in the country park on the weekend.
location: On the bed in the master bedroom.

name: Going to bed
description: After saying goodnight to her husband, she turned off the desk lamp. Reflecting that although work today was stressful, the family time had been especially warm, she gradually fell asleep listening to the occasional sound of cars outside the window, with a sense of fulfillment and anticipation for the future.
location: Bedroom at home.

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Outside the window a fine drizzle was pattering. Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat on the balcony and completed a 15-minute vinyasa flow, including Cat-Cow Pose, Downward-Facing Dog, and Warrior II, followed by 5 minutes of meditation. She focused on the sound of the rain and her breathing, letting go of the previous day's distractions and stress, and felt relaxed throughout her body.
location: Home balcony, 15A, Tower 3, 6 Dekang Street, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time and preparations.
description: Xiaowei changed into her loungewear and stepped out onto the balcony. Her mother had already prepared breakfast (oatmeal porridge, fried eggs, and fruit). She helped her daughter Xinxin braid her hair and reminded her son Xuanxuan to bring all his swimming gear, while her husband Mingzai got the rain gear ready. The whole family ate breakfast and discussed weekend plans, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Flat 15A, Tower 3, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped send the children to school.
description: Mingzai drove the car. The family first went to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, where Xiaowei took Xuanxuan to the school gate in the rain and reminded him about the swimming class. Then they arrived at Kowloon City Kindergarten; she held Xinxin’s hand and handed her to the teacher. After dropping off the children, Xiaowei told her husband that she would go for an evening run tonight and not be home for dinner, and the two said goodbye.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, No. 10 Yee Bun Road, Kowloon Tong, and Kowloon City Kindergarten, No. 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai.

name: Commuting to work
description: Xiaowei walked from the kindergarten to Sung Wong Toi Station, took the MTR and transferred to Wan Chai Station. On the way, she browsed financial news and industry updates and replied to a client's question about health insurance renewal. After exiting the station, she bought a sugar-free latte at Shui On Centre downstairs from the company, then walked to the office in the Immigration Tower.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 7 Gloucester Road, Immigration Tower (via Sung Wong Toi Station and Wan Chai Station)

name: Morning work: client follow-up, proposal revisions, and material preparation
description: Xiaowei first handled client policy renewals: she called Sister Ling to confirm the automatic transfer procedure, replied to Mr. Zhang's email about his physical examination report and attached health tips; then, based on yesterday's feedback, she adjusted Mr. Li's education fund plan, marked the key yield rates in red pen, and sent the revised version via encrypted email at 9:55; afterward, she systematically prepared materials for client Wang Qiming, evaluated a combined savings endowment insurance and critical illness insurance plan in light of market interest rates, printed the brochures, income statements, and company quarterly report, and listed talking points.
location: AIA Insurance Office, 6/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Rest and chat with colleagues.
description: Xiaowei goes to the pantry to refill her water, runs into her colleague Xiao Wang, and they chat about the underwriting progress of the group insurance policy and the company's insurance knowledge seminar next week. Xiaowei says she is interested in cross-border asset allocation cases. After the brief chat, she feels relaxed.
location: Pantry, 6/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch socializing
description: Xiaowei and her partner Su Lishan had a meal at Shun Hing Café, ordering shrimp wonton noodles, while Shanshan had Singapore-style fried rice noodles. During the meal, they discussed the new product promotion strategy and a business owner with cross-border needs. Xiaowei shared her boss's hint about promotion and her thoughts on the CFP course, and Shanshan encouraged her to get the certification while she was young. They cheered each other on.
location: Shun Hing Restaurant, 5 Arbuthnot Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work: follow up with potential clients.
description: Xiaowei returned to the office and, as planned, made phone follow-up calls to two new clients: the owner of a restaurant chain and an IT engineer who had just been promoted. She professionally introduced the services and recommended suitable protection plans, scheduled face-to-face meetings for next week, and after the calls recorded the clients' interests and initial impressions in detail.
location: AIA Insurance Office, 6/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Ran into my supervisor in the break room.
description: While making tea in the pantry, Xiaowei ran into her boss, Brother Hua. Hua proactively asked about her performance and quietly mentioned that the competition for the regional deputy manager position was fierce, hinting at the importance of professional certifications. He suggested she consider the CFP course. Xiaowei felt nervous but nodded in agreement and secretly made up her mind.
location: Pantry, 6/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Market Research and CFP Course Planning
description: Encouraged by Brother Hua, Xiaowei immediately used her browser to research Hong Kong CFP certification courses, compared the course content, duration, cost, and reviews of several institutions, and finally settled on one that offered evening and weekend courses. She decided to enroll in the Financial Planning Fundamentals module, noted the March 20 start date, and prepared to register online that evening.
location: AIA Insurance Office, 6/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Organizing and preparing before the end of the workday
description: Xiaowei closed the document, cleaned up her desk, confirmed that the email about Mr. Li's education fund plan and Wang Qiming's documents were ready, sent her husband a WeChat message saying she would be home late because of her evening run, then locked the drawer, picked up her backpack, and left the office.
location: AIA Insurance Office, 6/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Going home from work and shopping
description: Xiaowei took the MTR and transferred to Sung Wong Toi Station, walked to Whampoa New World shopping mall, bought strawberries and low-sugar biscuits at Kai Bo Food Supermarket as snacks for the children, then walked home.
location: Kai Bo Food Supermarket, Whampoa Wonderland Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm family dinner
description: Xiaowei pushed open the door and found that her mother had already cooked steamed yellow croaker, stir-fried broccoli with shrimp, and tomato egg drop soup. The whole family sat around the table. Xuanxuan shared his progress in breathing during swimming class, Xinxin showed her family portrait drawing, and Xiaowei shared a small breakthrough at work but concealed the promotion pressure. The table was filled with laughter.
location: Home dining room, Flat 15A, Tower 3, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time: helping with homework and spending time together
description: After dinner, Xiaowei first played with Xinxin building a castle out of blocks, then checked Xuanxuan's math homework and patiently explained fraction word problems; she praised Xuanxuan for being brave in swimming class and rewarded him with chocolate, feeling the children's growth.
location: Living room and study at home - 15A, Block 3, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sign up for CFP course
description: After the children washed up, Xiaowei went to the study and turned on the computer. She logged into the training institution's website that she had selected during the day, completed the online registration and payment for the Financial Planning Basics module, and felt relieved after seeing the successful deduction SMS. She checked the course schedule (starting March 20, every Tuesday and Thursday from 8 to 10 p.m., and Saturday afternoons) and synced it to her phone calendar, feeling an unprecedented sense of determination.
location: Home study at Flat 15A, Block 3, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR.

name: Evening exercise: night run and stretching
description: Xiaowei changed into her sports outfit, did a quick stretch, put on her earphones and headed out; she completed a 3-kilometer jog at a comfortable pace in Kowloon Tsai Park. The air was fresh after the rain, and she focused on her breathing and stride to relieve stress. After returning home, she stretched for 10 minutes on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing her legs and hips, feeling refreshed in body and mind.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the living room at home

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and couple communication.
description: Xiaowei took a hot shower and completed her evening skincare routine; lying in bed, she wrote down small things to be grateful for (Brother Hua's reminder, a pleasant lunch, moonlight in the park), confirmed the next morning's alarm, and set her phone to Do Not Disturb; her husband Mingzai asked why she came home late, Xiaowei shared her decision to enroll in the CFP course, Mingzai expressed support and suggested accompanying her to buy a new suit over the weekend. They smiled at each other, said goodnight, and turned off the lights to sleep.
location: Home bedroom, 15A, Block 3, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Waking up in the early morning, she unrolled her yoga mat on the balcony and followed the app for a 15-minute gentle flow yoga session and 5 minutes of breathing meditation, paying special attention to the right knee, gently stretching the outer thighs. Morning light filtered through the green plants onto her, awakening her body and mind.
location: Balcony, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and child handover
description: After morning exercise, my mother had prepared breakfast: white congee, scrambled eggs, pan-fried luncheon meat, and BBQ pork buns. During breakfast, I reminded my son Xuanxuan about his swimming class gear and helped my daughter Xinxin braid her hair. My husband Mingzai offered to take the children to school so I could leave easily. At 7:10, my husband left with the children. I said goodbye to my mother and went back to my room to change and get ready to go out.
location: Home dining room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute and breakfast meeting with new client Miss Lin.
description: Changed into my suit and brought the tablet with client data. Walked from Prince Building to Sung Wong Toi Station, took the MTR to Mong Kok East Station, and replied to client Miss Li's WeChat messages on the way. Arrived at Xinxingfa Restaurant and had breakfast with new client Miss Lin, introducing in detail the "Abundant Future" savings insurance plan, showing the dividend illustration on the tablet, and answering questions about exchange rates and withdrawals. Miss Lin said she needed to discuss it with her husband, and we agreed to follow up next week. At the restaurant, I also finished the ham macaroni and iced milk tea as breakfast.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West to Xinxingfa Restaurant, 193 Prince Edward Road West, Mong Kok, Kowloon City District; transport: walk to Sung Wong Toi Station, take the MTR to Mong Kok East Station, walk to the restaurant.

name: Commuting and handling office work
description: After saying goodbye to the client, she took the MTR from Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station, then walked to the AIA Building. On the way, she read an article about insurance development in the Greater Bay Area on her phone and liked colleague Shanshan's Moments post. After arriving at the office, she logged into her computer to handle client emails, compile the month's performance report, and check the team's renewal data. At around 10:30, she placed an order on the pet store website for Fatty's prescription food and healthy snacks, with home delivery. She exchanged views with colleague Su Lishan about a promotion and signing up for the CFP course; Shanshan encouraged her to keep going.
location: Office on the 13th floor of AIA Building, No. 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; commute via MTR from Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station.

name: Lunchtime core training and lunch
description: Bringing her own chicken salad, protein powder drink, and yoga mat, she walked 15 minutes to Gloucester Road Garden. On the lawn, she did 20 minutes of core strength training: 3 sets of planks (1 minute each), 3 sets of lying leg raises, and 3 sets of bird dogs. After training, she sat on a bench, ate the salad, drank the protein shake, and recharged her energy.
location: Gloucester Road Garden, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon client follow-up and document processing
description: Back in the office, she made phone follow-up calls to three potential customers and successfully scheduled two of them for face-to-face meetings next week. She then began working on the Regional Marketing Analysis Report and organized the customer data from the last three months. At 3 p.m., she went to the café at Shui On Centre with her colleague Guo Junwei for coffee, discussed the content of next week's team sharing session, and jotted down good ideas in her phone memo.
location: Office on the 13th floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai

name: Returning home, handing over the children, and preparing for the date.
description: She left work early and took the MTR from Wan Chai Station back to Kowloon City. After exiting the station, she bought two cartons of Ribena, her husband's favorite drink, at the convenience store downstairs. She arrived home at 17:25; her husband had already brought the children back. She took a quick shower and changed into a floral dress. Her mother had already made dinner and agreed to take care of the children. She reminded her son to do his homework, hugged her daughter, and told them that their parents had a little date tonight.
location: Home at Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR; commute passes through MTR Wan Chai Station to Sung Wong Toi Station

name: To Kowloon Tong for a dinner and movie date.
description: Hand in hand with her husband, they left home and took the MTR from Sung Wong Toi Station to Kowloon Tong Station. Along the way, they discussed the highly rated movie they were about to see. After arriving at Festival Walk, they had dinner at Crystal Jade La Mian Xiao Long Bao, ordering the signature xiao long bao, scallion oil noodles, and smoked fish. After dinner, they strolled to the AMC theater, caught the 19:20 screening, bought cola and popcorn, and cuddled together in the auditorium to watch a Hong Kong film. The movie ended around 20:35.
location: Crystal Jade La Mian Xiao Long Bao and AMC Cinemas, UG floor, Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; commute via MTR Sung Wong Toi Station to Kowloon Tong Station

name: Mall walk and heart-to-heart talk
description: After the movie ended, I walked out of the cinema with my husband, discussing the plot, and strolled along the walkway outside Festival Walk. In the evening breeze, I shared with him the pressure of my promotion and my feelings about signing up for the CFP course. He held my hand tightly, expressing trust and support, and suggested going to Mong Kok on the weekend to buy a suit and plan the family's long-term goals together.
location: Inside and outside Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home and pre-bed routine (interaction and washing up)
description: After the date ended, we held hands and took the MTR from Kowloon Tong Station back to Kowloon City, leaning against my husband on the way. We got home at around 21:45, and Mother told us the children had already fallen asleep. After thanking Mother, she went back to her room to rest. Then my husband and I washed up briefly, and I put on a hydrating mask and drank a glass of warm water in the living room.
location: Home at Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; commute via MTR Kowloon Tong Station to Sung Wong Toi Station

name: Pre-sleep conversation and going to bed
description: Lying in bed, my husband mentioned that a colleague had recommended a new restaurant in Repulse Bay, and suggested celebrating his promotion next Friday. I suggested waiting until after the first CFP module exam to celebrate together. Then we talked about plans to take the kids to the Zoological and Botanical Gardens this weekend, and gradually fell asleep in the warm atmosphere.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning ritual and yoga meditation
description: The 6:45 alarm went off. Remembering last night's movie date, she had gone to bed a bit late and felt slightly tired, but since today is Friday, she still needed to stay in form. She unrolled her yoga mat on the bedroom balcony, listening to the occasional birdsong downstairs and the distant traffic on Prince Edward Road, and completed 15 minutes of gentle sun salutation yoga and 5 minutes of focused breathing meditation, feeling her body gradually wake up.
location: Home, Block 17, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: A busy morning: keeping the children on schedule and having breakfast as a family.
description: After finishing yoga, I first woke up my 8-year-old son Xuanxuan and 5-year-old daughter Xinxin, and urged them to wash up and change into school uniforms. Mother Chen Meiling had already prepared white congee, fried eggs, and steamed shaomai. My husband and I quickly drank two cups of Hong Kong-style milk tea to refresh ourselves. While the children were eating, I checked Xuanxuan's schoolbag and reminded him that he had an extracurricular activity at school this afternoon.
location: Home, Block 17, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Split up to take the children to school
description: Left the house right at 7:50. My husband was responsible for walking our daughter to the nearby Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai). I took Xuanxuan downstairs, walked 3 minutes to Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line one stop to Kowloon Tong Station (about 5 minutes on the train), and after exiting, walked 5 minutes to send him to the school gate of Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong). Along the way, I reminded him to remember to finish some homework tomorrow Saturday morning.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Tin Fu Road, Kowloon Tong, Hong Kong

name: Commute and preparations for starting work
description: After dropping off my son, I took the Kwun Tong Line from Kowloon Tong Station to Mong Kok Station (about 5 minutes), transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station (about 10 minutes), then switched to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station (about 5 minutes). The whole journey took about 50 minutes. On the way, I took out my phone and quickly glanced through the WhatsApp messages from clients I had missed last night, giving brief replies to two clients who asked about policy renewal dates. Then I opened the CFP course app and listened to a 15-minute preview audio on tax planning to prepare for next week's class.
location: Hong Kong MTR train carriage (from Kowloon Tong Station to Wan Chai Station).

name: Team weekly wrap-up morning meeting.
description: Arriving at the company, I first went to the pantry to make a cup of coffee for myself. At 9:15 I attended the team's short Friday meeting on time. Hua Ge (Liang Zhenhua) summarized the team's performance this week and praised my initial progress on cross-border business. At the same time, he reminded everyone to focus on the renewal rate of existing clients next week. I also briefly shared information about my afternoon meeting with a high-end medical insurance client.
location: Company meeting room, 12/F, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Morning office work.
description: After the morning meeting, I returned to my desk and focused on work. First, I checked several renewal documents that arrived last week and filed them after confirming they were correct. Then, following the morning meeting's guidance, I started compiling the team's weekly report on client inquiries and closed deals, using an Excel spreadsheet to summarize the data with a brief analysis. In between, Su Lishan came over to confirm the time to meet at the beauty salon this afternoon (18:00 at the entrance of World Trade Centre, Causeway Bay). I also found time to email a new retirement savings plan proposal to a client I'm following up with.
location: Workstation on the 12th floor, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Lunch and confirming plans with close friends
description: At 12:30, I went downstairs with Su Lishan and walked about 8 minutes to the café at Shui On Center. We ordered a chicken Caesar salad and iced lemon tea. As we ate and talked, I confirmed with her again about going to the beauty salon after work; she smiled and said she had been exhausted from taking care of the kids lately and really needed a facial to relax. We also chatted briefly about weekend plans, and she said she would take her daughter to the newly opened children's playground.
location: Café on the 1st floor of Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Midday rest and preparation
description: Walked about 8 minutes back to my desk and spent 10 minutes resting with my eyes closed. After that, I checked the 'High-End Medical Protection Plan' and my laptop and iPad again for the afternoon client meeting, making sure all comparison data were accurate. I went downstairs 10 minutes early and set off.
location: Workstation on the 12th floor, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Meeting with a potential high-end medical insurance client
description: Walked about 5 minutes to the coffee shop at the convention center. Client Mr. Chen arrived as promised. Based on his needs (global medical coverage, unlimited specialist consultations, and priority for private hospitals), I explained in detail the "Asia Supreme" plan tailored for him, specifically addressing the details he cared most about: annual premium increases, the deductible, and coverage amounts. We talked for nearly two hours. He seemed relatively satisfied with the plan, said he would take it home to discuss with his wife, and agreed to give a final answer next Wednesday.
location: Pacific Coffee, Basement 1, Convention Plaza Shopping Mall, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Return to the company and organize client meeting notes
description: After seeing Mr. Chen off, she quickly returned to the company. She immediately turned on her computer, organized the key points of the meeting (client preferences, hesitations, committed follow-up reply date) into a formal meeting record, and logged it into the company's CRM system. At the same time, she sent a thank-you email to Mr. Chen with the PDF version of the proposal attached.
location: Workstation on the 12th floor, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Friday wrap-up work
description: After organizing the client materials, there was still an hour before leaving work. I handled the last few emails and made a to-do list for next Monday. Then I sent the compiled team weekly report to Brother Hua for review. Seeing that it was about time, I packed up my computer and personal belongings, turned off the lights, and left.
location: Workstation on the 12th floor, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Commuting to Causeway Bay
description: Take the Island Line from Wan Chai Station one stop to Causeway Bay Station (about a 3-minute ride). Take Exit F2 and walk about 3 minutes to the entrance of the World Trade Centre shopping mall (located at 280 Gloucester Road).
