name: Bestie 'beauty care time'
description: We met at the entrance of the World Trade Center and took the elevator together to the beauty salon on the 18th floor. We had booked in advance, so there was no queue. Using the monthly pass bought earlier, we were arranged in adjacent rooms and started deep facial cleansing and hydrating masks at the same time. The beautician's technique was skilled, and I quickly relaxed. During the session, we chatted casually across the room partition; she complained about how hard it was for her daughter to practice piano, and I shared my feelings about meeting clients in the afternoon.
location: Bright Skin Studio beauty salon, 18th Floor, World Trade Centre, 280 Gloucester Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.

name: Light dinner with bestie
description: After the facial treatment, we felt our skin fresh and glowing. Not in the mood for a full meal, we walked about five minutes to our usual light-fare café on Yun Ping Road. I ordered an avocado smoked salmon open sandwich, and she ordered a quinoa shrimp salad. As we ate, we shared parenting articles we had seen on our respective platforms over the weekend. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: The Cupping Room cafe on Yun Ping Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong

name: The journey home
description: After saying goodbye to Su Lishan, I took the Island Line from Causeway Bay Station to Admiralty Station (about 6 minutes), then transferred to the East Rail Line to Mong Kok East Station (about 10 minutes). After exiting the station, I walked about 8 minutes back to my home in Whampoa Garden. When I entered, I greeted my parents, who were watching the news in the living room.
location: MTR carriage (Causeway Bay Station to Mong Kok East Station) and at home in Whampoa Garden

name: A warm family moment
description: I tiptoed to the children's room. Xinxin was already asleep, and Xuanxuan was still reading an extracurricular book. I kissed his forehead and told him to go to bed early. Then I went to the kitchen and chatted with my mother, who was still awake. She had left me a bowl of red bean soup. After eating it, I sat back in the living room, opened my phone, and posted the photos I had taken of the beauty salon's interior tonight to the family group chat, with the caption “A little pre-weekend beauty treatment with Sister Shan.”
location: Home, Block 17, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Adjusting state: jogging and socializing.
description: After changing into my running gear and shoes, I still felt a bit tired, but knowing that a relaxed 5k run before the weekend would sweep away the week's stress, I decided to stick to the plan. I walked about five minutes to the jogging trail at Kowloon Tsai Park. The weather was cool and overcast tonight, perfect for running. I kept an easy pace of 6:35/km set on my sports watch, not chasing speed, just focusing on my breathing. When I finished the 5k, I took a photo of the park at night with my phone and posted it on Moments with the caption: "Friday night, jogged 5k, checking in at the quiet of Kowloon Tsai Park." Soon I received a like and comment from my running buddy Shen Peiwen: "Keep it up, Xiaowei!"
location: Jogging Trail, Kowloon Tsai Park, Inverness Road, Kowloon City, Hong Kong

name: Stretching, personal time, and bedtime preparation
description: After walking about five minutes home, I first did 10 minutes of stretching to relax my leg muscles. After showering, I felt my tense nerves relax, and my skin was in good condition (the effect of beauty care). I shared the day's client meeting progress and beauty tips with my husband, who was already lying in bed. Then I took out the Cantonese embroidery sample I had bought from the teacher in Sham Shui Po and embroidered for about 10 minutes under the lamp as a pre-sleep relaxation ritual.
location: Home, Block 17, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Falling asleep
description: At 23:20, she turned off the light and lay down. In her mind she reviewed the plan for next Saturday: she needed to accompany Xinxin to her ballet class, and in the afternoon she might take the kids to The Whampoa (No. 6 Tak Hong Street). With the relaxed and satisfied feeling unique to Friday night, she gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Block 17, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning wake-up yoga and meditation
description: Sunlight streamed through the white gauze curtains onto the wooden floor. After running 5 km last night, I felt a slight sense of accomplishment. I unrolled my yoga mat and did 15 minutes of Sun Salutation stretches, along with 5 minutes of abdominal breathing meditation. The slimming movements awakened my dormant muscles, leaving me calm and full of anticipation.
location: At home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast.
description: My husband Weiming made his signature century egg and lean pork congee, and my mother Chen Meiling fried eggs and luncheon meat. As I drank the congee, I said to the children, 'Today is Women's Day. Mommy and Grandma are going out to have fun. At noon, Daddy will take you and your brother to Café de Coral.' Xinxin agreed excitedly, while Xuanxuan kept focusing on his fried egg.
location: At home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparation before going out
description: I helped Xinxin change into her favorite pink ballet dress and ballet shoes, and carefully checked the water bottle and spare clothes in her backpack. I changed into a beige knit cardigan and comfortable wide-leg pants, with a tablet, power bank, and lipstick in my canvas bag.
location: At home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to ballet class.
description: We took Kowloon green minibus route 2A to Kowloon City Plaza. I sent Xinxin to the dance studio of Little Swan Ballet School on the 3rd floor and handed her to the teacher, then sat down at a window seat in the Pacific Coffee next door. I took out my tablet, confirmed the details of client Mr. Chen's "Asia Supreme" high-end medical insurance plan, and organized three key comparison points in my memo, planning to send them to him during a break in the afternoon. I also sent a message to the "iron triangle" best-friends group: "Happy Women's Day, ladies! I'm waiting for my daughter to finish class. In the afternoon I'm going shopping in Causeway Bay with my mom!"
location: Little Swan Ballet School and Pacific Coffee, 3/F, Kowloon City Plaza, 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Have wonton noodles after class.
description: Ballet class ended, and Xinxin ran out with rosy cheeks. I took her down to Chi Kee on the second floor and ordered two bowls of the signature shrimp wonton noodles and a glass of iced lemon tea. Xinxin clumsily picked up wontons with her little hands while excitedly gesturing the ballet spin she had just learned. I gently wiped the soup stain from the corner of her mouth with a tissue, feeling warm inside.
location: Chi Kee, 2/F, Kowloon City Plaza, 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk home.
description: After we were full, we didn't take a taxi right away. Instead, we held hands and took a slow walk home along Carpenter Road, which took about 20 minutes. On the way, we passed a flower shop. Xinxin looked up and said, "Mom, today is Women's Day. I want to buy a flower for Grandma and you!" I was touched by her sweet words, so I spent 28 Hong Kong dollars on two blooming pink carnations. We each held one and walked back to the neighborhood, happily humming a song.
location: Carpenter Road and the surrounding area of Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family rest and shopping preparation
description: After returning home, Xinxin presented the carnations to her grandmother, Chen Meiling, who beamed with joy and hugged her granddaughter. My mother and I discussed the afternoon shopping route. She suggested going to Lane Crawford in Times Square to look at skincare products first, and then having afternoon tea. I asked Weiming to take the children to eat their favorite fast food at noon. I changed into a dark blue dress with a short pearl necklace, ready to enjoy half a day of leisure with my mother.
location: At home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the MTR to Causeway Bay
description: My mother and I walked to Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, switched to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Island Line to reach Causeway Bay Station. The whole journey took about 40 minutes. On the train, my mother leaned against me, watching the cityscape whizzing past the window, while I quietly told her interesting things I had seen online.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region MTR Kwun Tong Line, Tsuen Wan Line, and Island Line (Whampoa Station to Causeway Bay Station)

name: Accompany mother for Women's Day shopping
description: After arriving at Causeway Bay Station, we went straight into Lane Crawford on the B1 level of Times Square. Mother tried several face creams at the La Mer counter, and the sales assistant patiently explained the ingredients. I gave honest advice based on Mother's dry skin, and in the end she chose a repair serum gift set. Then we went up to G/F at Chow Sang Sang, where I immediately spotted a pair of pure gold earrings in the counter that suited Mother well. I had the salesperson wrap them up right away as a Women's Day surprise for Mother. She said I was "wasting money," but the smile on her face could not be hidden.
location: Lane Crawford and Chow Sang Sang, Times Square, 1 Matheson Street, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Casual chat at the café
description: Tired from shopping, we went to the Ninetys coffee shop on the terrace of the 7th floor of Times Square and ordered Hong Kong-style milk tea and their signature egg tarts. The sunlight was just right, streaming in through the glass curtain wall. My mother talked about how she worked as a garment factory worker when she was young, often working overtime late into the night to earn more money to support my education. I, in turn, confided in her about the pressure I'd been feeling recently when communicating insurance policy terms with clients. My mother patted my hand and said, 'Just do your best. Whatever you do, I'm at ease.' At that moment, I felt all my fatigue melt away.
location: Ninetys Coffee, 7/F, Times Square, 1 Matheson Street, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home
description: Carrying my shopping bags with contentment, I took the MTR back the same way. I let my mother carry the light bags, while I carried the heavy La Mer gift box and the small bag from the gold shop. On the train, I looked at my phone, replied to a few client inquiries, and also saw Lin Jiaxin post in the group photos of her and her family having afternoon tea at the Peak. Everyone agreed to get together next weekend.
location: Hong Kong SAR MTR Island Line, Tsuen Wan Line, and Kwun Tong Line (Causeway Bay Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Listen to a personal finance podcast.
description: After returning home, I poured a glass of warm water for my mother, and the two of us curled up on the sofa to rest. Instead of starting my CFP preview right away, I put on earphones and opened a podcast called 'The Road to Financial Freedom for Middle-Class Families', and listened to an episode about 'Asset Allocation for High-Net-Worth Individuals and Cross-Border Medical Insurance Planning'. It happened to be related to the case of Mr. Chen I was following today, and I benefited a lot.
location: At home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child baking
description: After the break, seeing that the kids were a bit bored, I suggested making simple chocolate crunchies. I took out the cereal, chocolate, and nuts from the kitchen. I had Xuanxuan smash the chocolate and Xinxin stir the mixture. The kitchen filled with the aroma of chocolate and the children's laughter. Weiming captured the moment with his phone and said he would send it to the family group chat.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, home kitchen

name: Dinner preparation and family interaction
description: Mother made her signature soy sauce chicken and stir-fried choy sum. I was in charge of washing vegetables and cutting fruit, while Weiming set out the bowls and chopsticks. During the meal, everyone tasted the desserts the children had made; Xuanxuan talked about the fun he had building LEGO today, and Xinxin performed the ballet hand positions she had just learned. The whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening stroll
description: Since we had run last night, today was mainly for recovery. Weiming and I put on our sports shoes and walked to Kowloon Tsai Park, strolling along the park's jogging trail for nearly an hour while chatting about next week's work arrangements and the children's school parents' day. The evening breeze was gentle, and the streetlights stretched our shadows long.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese Embroidery and Music
description: After returning from a walk and taking a shower, I changed into a comfortable set of loungewear. Carrying my embroidery frame, I sat down at the small table on the balcony and played soft guzheng music on my phone. Under the moonlight and night breeze, I focused on embroidering a Cantonese embroidery piece with a butterfly pattern as a gift for next month's Mother's Day. With the needle and thread moving, my mood was especially tranquil.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, home balcony of Block 8, Whampoa Garden

name: Family bedtime interaction
description: Went to the children's room, read Guess How Much I Love You to Xinxin, and she sweetly closed her eyes in my arms. Then I checked Xuanxuan's weekend math homework and found that he had gotten two word problems wrong. Instead of scolding him, I took out scratch paper and taught him step by step to analyze with line-segment diagrams until he fully understood. Weiming was beside us packing the books to take to the library tomorrow.
location: Children's room at home, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Skincare and relaxation.
description: Back in the master bedroom, I took out the expensive night cream my mother gave me today and carefully applied it to my face and neck, as a reward to myself after the day. Then I lay in bed and posted today's photo with my mother to the 'Iron Triangle' group chat, with the caption: 'Women's Day, a day surrounded by love.' It drew a string of likes and envious comments.
location: Home master bedroom, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Pre-bedtime tidying and going to sleep
description: I picked up my phone and updated the to-do list in my memo, specifically noting "Reply to Mr. Chen's medical insurance plan on March 12" and "CFP online course starts March 20". Then I set the alarm for 6:40 tomorrow morning to prepare for a full night's sleep. Weiming also lay down; after we said goodnight to each other, I turned off the desk lamp. Replaying in my mind today's flowers from my daughter and my mother's smiling face, I felt deeply warm and content, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home master bedroom, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning preparations
description: After the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom and did 10 minutes of simple stretching and sun salutations, then meditated with her eyes closed for 5 minutes to settle her thoughts. Then she went to the master bathroom to wash up, changed into loungewear, and rechecked the list of party supplies she had prepared last night, confirming that balloons, ribbons, tableware, banners, and other items were all ready. She mentally ran through the day's schedule, making sure everything was foolproof.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block X, Floor X, Flat X, home bedroom and master bathroom

name: Family breakfast.

For breakfast, they steamed barbecue pork buns and egg custard buns and heated up Vitasoy. While eating, Yu Xiaowei told her son Xuanzai to help take care of his younger sister today.

Weiming hung up the "Happy Birthday" banner while Yu Xiaowei strung balloons together and stuck them to the ceiling. The living room gradually became wrapped in a warm party atmosphere.

Then her mother Chen Meiling and father Yu Guoqiang also arrived. Her father brought a large basket of fruit, and her mother bought cherries that Xinxin loves. Everyone chatted in the living room, and Yu Xiaowei confirmed the lunch menu with the elders: red eggs, Coke chicken wings, steamed grass carp, shrimp scrambled eggs, and a birthday cake.

Everyone chatted about family matters while working. Her mother-in-law praised her Cantonese embroidery skills, saying that Xinxin's pendant was embroidered so vividly. The kitchen was full of steam, filled with the taste of home.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block X, Floor X, Room X, home kitchen.

name: Party preparation and celebration

Weiming helped set out disposable plates and drinks, while her father played with building blocks with the children. Then Yu Xiaowei turned off the living room light, Weiming lit the candle, and their son led the singing of the birthday song, with the whole family joining in. Xinxin wore a birthday hat, made a wish, and blew out the candles. Yu Xiaowei helped her cut the first slice of cake, and everyone shared the cake and red eggs, creating a warm and lively atmosphere.

When Xinxin opened it, she was delighted to find a little dog matching her own zodiac sign. Yu Xiaowei helped her attach it to her small backpack. Xinxin couldn't put it down, put the backpack on, and showed it to the elders.

Her mother-in-law then also prepared to return to Kwun Tong, so Yu Xiaowei called a cross-harbour minibus for her by phone and asked her to send a message when she got home to let them know she was safe.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei set the alarm and lay down quietly. Weiming was already asleep. In her mind she replayed today’s smiling face of Xinxin and the laughter of her family. Her heart filled with happiness, and she soon fell into a sweet dream.
location: Master bedroom at home, Block X, Floor X, Unit X, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and meditation.
description: Completed 15 minutes of meditation and light stretching on the yoga mat in the living room. Even though the party last night wrapped up a bit late, I had to start the new workweek with a calm mind on Monday morning.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: Helped her mother set the leftover birthday cake from last night, fresh milk, and cereal on the table. At 7:05, she woke Xuanxuan and Xinxin on time and helped them wash up and change into their school uniforms. After breakfast, she told Xinxin to carefully put the small Guangdong embroidery ornament she received for her birthday into her schoolbag, and promised to tell her a new story when she got home in the evening.

Yu Xiaowei walked eight minutes to take her daughter Xinxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten, chatting along the way about the happiest moment at Sunday's party, and watched her walk happily through the school gate.

name: Commuting and CFP study.
description: Walked from the kindergarten to Kowloon Tong MTR station, took the MTR Kwun Tong line, transferred to the East Rail line, then switched to the Island line to reach the company in Wan Chai. The commute took about 45 minutes. She put on headphones, opened the CFP course app on her phone, and re-listened to the chapter "Medical Protection and High-End Medical Insurance," marking important points in the new regulations on cross-border medical services in the Greater Bay Area, in preparation for answering client Mr. Chen on March 12 and the Shenzhen sharing session at the end of the month.
location: On an MTR train in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (from Kowloon Tong Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Company morning meeting and performance confirmation
description: Attended the Monday routine team morning meeting. After the meeting, she logged into the company system and confirmed that February's commission of 28,000 yuan had arrived, up 10% from last month, and felt gratified. She immediately transferred 10,000 yuan to the family joint savings account via mobile banking and sent a screenshot to her husband on WhatsApp.
location: Meeting Room, 13th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Core financial planning and client work
description: At her desk, she used her personal notebook to plan the remaining commission of 18,000 yuan: set aside 5,000 yuan to settle the balance for her daughter's birthday party (New Shanghai Kitchen catering and the cake shop), and recorded the details. Then she replied to three client emails and began gathering information for client Mr. Chen's high-end medical insurance plan, reading the latest policies on mutual recognition of insurance between mainland China and Hong Kong.
location: Personal workstation, 13/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday exchange: material preparation, lunch discussion, and cross-team regular meeting arrangement
description: At her desk, she prepared the difficult points of the CFP course in advance (actuarial principles of participating insurance) and printed two copies of a comparison of cross-boundary insurance products in the Greater Bay Area. At 12:15, she arrived on time at Sun Chiu Kee Cafe on the street behind the company with Su Lishan, to welcome Guo Junwei, who had come from Guangzhou to Hong Kong for a meeting. The three ordered curry beef brisket rice, char siu with fried egg rice, and iced lemon tea. Su Lishan shared the case of signing a young family using the combined "children's savings + vaccine protection" plan; Yu Xiaowei consulted Guo Junwei on the insurance product part, and he gave the key point from an actuarial perspective: "the logic of the equity investment ratio and risk premium." As lunch was winding down, all three agreed that collaboration between the sales and product sides could improve efficiency. At Yu Xiaowei's suggestion, they agreed on the spot to hold a 15-minute online brief meeting every two weeks, with her coordinating the agenda, Su Lishan sharing customer needs, and Guo Junwei providing product innovation ideas. After the meal, the three walked to digest their food, and Yu Xiaowei stopped by the convenience store downstairs from the company to buy mint candies.
location: Sun Chiu Kee Restaurant, near 431 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon client proposal handling and work wrap-up
description: Back at my desk, I focused on work: followed up on payment method confirmation for two month-end renewal clients; prepared an upgraded comparison table for Mr. Chen's medical insurance plan, attaching the actuarial logic Guo Junwei mentioned; and incorporated the new idea of Greater Bay Area product differences discussed in the afternoon into the draft PPT for the end-of-month Shenzhen sharing session. After 17:00, I organized the day's work log, highlighted to-do items, packed my commuting bag, and took the empty gift boxes left over from yesterday's party, planning to go to the mall to find wrapping paper.
location: Personal workstation, 13/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute and shopping

name: Rest at home and family dinner
description: Walked 3 minutes from the mall back home, put away the daily necessities and wrapping paper she had bought, and changed into home clothes. Her mother had prepared dinner: steamed fish, stir-fried vegetables, and soup. Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to serve soup and rice, picked food for her mother with chopsticks, and asked whether her lower back was sore after yesterday's hard work. After dinner, she helped her mother with a shoulder massage for more than ten minutes. Then she helped her son Xuanxuan finish his math exercises and kept her promise to tell her daughter Xinxin the newly bought picture book story.

She then worked quickly to finalize and submit this week's business report. The system notified her that the submission was successful, and she breathed a sigh of relief. She then went over the plan for the afternoon client meeting in her mind again to confirm the key points.
location: 18th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Online three-party meeting to discuss cross-border business
description: Yu Xiaowei, colleague Su Lishan, and Guo Junwei in Guangzhou started an online meeting focusing on the solution for linking group health insurance and high-end medical insurance for client General Manager Wang Qiming from Shenzhen. The three discussed the tax and legal coordination between the mainland and Hong Kong. Guo Junwei shared similar group insurance cases, Su Lishan noted key points of premium calculation, and the meeting ended efficiently within 25 minutes.
location: 18th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Client policy review and preparation of visit materials
description: After the meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei took out the final version of client Mr. Chen's medical insurance plan and reviewed it again. After confirming it was correct, she encrypted and sent it, and reminded him via WeChat. Then she prepared materials for Mrs. Zhang, a potential high-end client she was meeting that afternoon: she compared Mrs. Zhang's family's existing policies item by item with the new and old Asian Supreme plans, marked the advantages with a highlighter, and put them into a folder.
location: 18th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Surprise birthday lunch for colleague Su Lishan
description: Su Lishan mysteriously pulled Yu Xiaowei to the first-floor café of Shui On Centre and took out a homemade cheese tart to celebrate her birthday. The two shared the cheese tart and ordered a teriyaki chicken sandwich and a mixed berry yogurt bowl. They chatted casually over lunch; Yu Xiaowei mentioned her son's math problems, and Su Lishan shared funny stories about her cat. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Café on the 1st floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparation for an off-site visit and MTR commute
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei did not return to the office. At the café entrance, she used her phone to check the route to Empire Hotel Kowloon in Tsim Sha Tsui and estimated the time, then went to the restroom to touch up her lipstick and straighten her shirt. She took the Island Line from Wan Chai Station to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line for Tsim Sha Tsui. On the way, she sent a confirmation message to her client Mrs. Zhang, stating her estimated arrival time.
location: Hong Kong MTR Island Line and Tsuen Wan Line (Wan Chai Station to Tsim Sha Tsui Station)

name: Paid a visit to high-net-worth client Mrs. Zhang.
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived on time at the lobby café of the Empire Hotel, smiled as she exchanged pleasantries with Mrs. Zhang, and gave her wife cakes as a small gift. She patiently listened to Mrs. Zhang's needs regarding family protection and overseas medical care, then introduced the 'Asia Supreme' global high-end medical plan in detail based on her family structure, and showed a compound interest illustration of the family savings plan. Mrs. Zhang asked about the details of premium payment and refunds, and Yu Xiaowei answered each one professionally. The meeting was harmonious, and they agreed to submit a detailed proposal next Friday.
location: Lobby Café, Empire Hotel, 6 Knutsford Terrace, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Picked up embroidery thread and exchanged ideas with Master Wu Xiuying
description: After leaving Tsim Sha Tsui, she took the Tsuen Wan Line to Sham Shui Po Station and walked quickly to Wu Xiuying's Cantonese embroidery studio on Yu Chau Street. She picked up the indigo and moon-white gradient embroidery threads she had asked Master Wu to dye last week; the colors were refined and elegant. Master Wu was embroidering peonies. The two briefly exchanged views on stitching techniques and color matching, and Master Wu affirmed Yu Xiaowei's taste. After paying the material fee, Yu Xiaowei carefully stored the threads.
location: Wu Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio, 247 Yu Chau Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Picked up the cake on the way home and contacted family
description: Leaving the studio, Yu Xiaowei walked to Sham Shui Po MTR Station. On the way, she called her husband Zhang Weiming to ask about preparations at home and learned that the children were drawing greeting cards, her mother-in-law's soup was ready, and her mother Chen Meiling's soy sauce chicken was done. She then went to Saint Honore Cake Shop at 170 Prince Edward Road West and used the pickup code to collect the pre-ordered fresh fruit cream cake. The cake had 'Happy Birthday Xiaowei' written on it. She carried the cake home lightly.
location: St. Honoré Cake Shop, 170 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family birthday surprise and reunion dinner
description: Yu Xiaowei pushed open the door. The living room was decorated with gold balloons and colorful streamers. Her son wished her a happy birthday, and her daughter showed off a cartoon version of her mother that she had drawn by hand. Her husband took the cake, and from the kitchen came the aroma of the green radish and carrot pork bone soup made by her mother-in-law Li Shufen, while her mother Chen Meiling was cutting soy sauce chicken. Yu Xiaowei was deeply moved, her eyes welling up. She hugged her family and opened the children's greeting cards and the Garmin sports watch from her husband. The whole family set out bowls and chopsticks, bringing out her mother-in-law's soup, her mother's soy sauce chicken, broccoli, and char siu. The six of them sat down to dinner. Her father Yu Guoqiang poured half a glass of glutinous rice wine, and everyone chatted while eating, frequently putting food onto Yu Xiaowei's plate.
location: Unit C, 12th Floor, Block C, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cutting the cake and birthday blessing ceremony
description: As dinner was winding down, her husband set the cake on the table and placed the number candles "3" and "6" on it, while the children helped excitedly. After the lights were turned off, the candlelight lit up smiling faces, and the whole family sang "Happy Birthday." Yu Xiaowei clasped her hands and made a wish: that her family would be healthy, work would go smoothly, and the children would make progress in their studies. She blew out the candles, everyone applauded, and her husband cut the first piece of cake and handed it to her. The cake was sweet but not too rich. Yu Xiaowei was filled with happiness, thanked her husband again for the gift, and said she would be even more motivated for her night runs from now on.
location: Unit C, 12th Floor, Block C, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-meal tidying and parent-child time
description: After eating the cake, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to help clear the dishes and washed them with her mother. Then she went to the living room to spend time with the children: her son proudly showed off his LEGO fire station creation, and she gave serious comments and encouragement; her daughter brought out a family portrait she had drawn and asked her mother to draw herself in it. Yu Xiaowei held her daughter's hand and added a smiling little figure, and her daughter hopped around happily. Meanwhile, her husband Zhang Weiming drove his mother-in-law Li Shufen back to Kwun Tong.
location: Unit C, 12th Floor, Block C, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Birthday night run — a gift to myself
description: After resting for an hour, Yu Xiaowei changed into her running gear, put on her new Garmin sports watch, and walked to Kowloon Tsai Park to start a 5 km night run. The park lights were soft in the night, and she ran at a relaxed pace of about 7:00/km, enjoying the rhythm of her body. At the third kilometer, she felt a very slight soreness in her right knee. She immediately slowed down to a brisk walk for half a minute, and after it was fine, continued jogging. After finishing, she cooled down and stretched thoroughly. The watch recorded an average pace of 6:58/km, and she felt an unprecedented sense of ease.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shower, self-care, and bedtime gratitude journal
description: After returning home, she first took a hot shower to wash off the sweat. Then, wrapping her hair in a towel, she took an ice pack from the fridge and applied it to her right knee for 10 minutes while using her phone to handle clients' WeChat messages and reply to a friend's birthday wishes. After the ice pack, she went to the study, turned on the desk lamp, and wrote in her diary: '36 years old, ordinary yet special. Saw Mrs. Zhang, had an online meeting, picked up embroidery thread, and Mom made soy sauce chicken. Family surprises, time with the kids, a 5K night run. Grateful for all of you.' After closing the diary, she felt calm and fulfilled.
location: Unit C, 12th Floor, Block C, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Before bed, chatted with husband and then went to sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei quietly got into bed, leaned on her husband Zhang Weiming's shoulder and shared her feelings of the day. Her husband gently stroked her hair and said, 'Happy birthday, you've worked hard.' She replied, 'This year will definitely be better.' The two said goodnight to each other, dimmed the bedside lamp, and Yu Xiaowei fell into a deep sleep filled with happiness and emotion.
location: Unit C, 12th Floor, Block C, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: At 6:45 a.m., Yu Xiaowei was woken by her alarm clock. To avoid disturbing her family, she got up quietly, laid out her yoga mat in the living room, and began a 15-minute Sun Salutation yoga practice, focusing on stretching her hips and right knee, which were a bit tight after last night's run. She then meditated for 5 minutes, focusing on her breath to let her thoughts settle and store up energy for the new day.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Got ready, set off, and walked to Kowloon Tsai Park.
description: After meditation, Yu Xiaowei changed into professional running gear, put on her Garmin watch, and took a water bottle and an energy gel. She walked from home to Kowloon Tsai Park. Along the way, she did dynamic stretching and paid attention to her right knee, feeling that it was in good condition, readying herself for the long run ahead.
location: Streets along the route from Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road)

name: Kowloon Tsai Park 15 km Long-Distance Run
description: At 7:20, Yu Xiaowei started a 15 km long run on the jogging trail at Kowloon Tsai Park and the Kowloon Tsai Hill trail, maintaining a steady pace of 7:10 per kilometer. At the 7 km mark (around 8:10), she took an energy gel and a few sips of water. Throughout the run, she paid close attention to her right knee, and there was no soreness like yesterday's. The cool morning air and gradually brightening sky made the run enjoyable and boosted her confidence in completing her goal of a sub-2 half marathon.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road), Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and surrounding hill trails

name: Return home to shower and refuel.
description: After the long run, Yu Xiaowei walked home to let her heart rate decrease slowly. When she got home, she took a shower, changed into comfortable loungewear, then drank a cup of warm honey lemon water and ate a banana and a small slice of whole wheat bread, quickly replenishing fluids and energy.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare to set out and cheer my son on
description: Her son Zhang Zixuan had excitedly put on his school uniform. Yu Xiaowei packed his water bottle, towel, and spare T-shirt into his backpack. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had prepared a simple breakfast (hot milk and sandwiches). While eating, Yu Xiaowei reminded her son, "Start steady, then push harder mid-race," giving him final mental preparation for the upcoming school sports meet.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School
description: At 9:50, Yu Xiaowei and her son walked out hand in hand and walked along the familiar streets to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. Along the way, Xuanxuan excitedly recounted the scene from yesterday's practice when he “ran faster than the wind,” and Yu Xiaowei smiled and reminded him to pay attention to his breathing rhythm. The mother and son enjoyed the morning parent-child time.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District streets (Whampoa Garden to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School)

name: Accompanied her son to the school sports meet.
description: The school sports meet officially started at 10 o'clock. Yu Xiaowei sat in the stands cheering for her son in the third-grade 50-meter and 100-meter sprint races. When she saw Xuanxuan dash across the finish line like a little cheetah and win first place with a clear advantage, she stood up excitedly and cheered, with tears in her eyes. It reminded her of the emotion she felt when she completed her first half marathon. During the breaks, she exchanged parenting tips with other parents and shared how to help children develop exercise habits.
location: Playground and spectator stands of Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Oxford Road, Kowloon Tong, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Mother and son jogged home at an easy pace
description: After the school sports meet ended, Yu Xiaowei and her son did not choose to take a ride but jogged home along their usual route at a very easy pace, covering about 2 kilometers in 15 minutes. All the way, Xuanxuan held up his gold medal and chattered on and on about the details of the race. Halfway home, he said excitedly, “Mom, we'll run fast from now on!” Yu Xiaowei was deeply moved; the passing on of a love for sports quietly flowed between mother and son.
location: Streets in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Kowloon Tong Government Primary School to Whampoa Garden)

name: Sharing the joy of winning the championship at family lunch
description: When she got home, her husband Zhang Weiming had already picked up their daughter Xinxin from ballet class. Her mother had prepared a hearty lunch: soy sauce chicken, tomato scrambled eggs, and more. At the table, Xuanxuan's heroic feat of winning the championship became a topic for the whole family. Her husband also shared the fun story of taking their daughter to eat a giant pineapple bun and buying a new hairband, and showed photos on his phone. The family laughed continuously and enjoyed their time together.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home dining room

name: Midday rest and Cantonese embroidery time.
description: After lunch, the family members took turns resting. Yu Xiaowei returned to the living room, took out the orchid silk scarf she had started embroidering last week and her needlework box, and focused on finishing the last few orchid leaves in the quiet afternoon. With every stitch, her mind calmed, and all her fatigue seemed to dissolve. She was immersed in the peace and satisfaction that traditional handicraft brought her.
location: Living room/balcony at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family free time and afternoon tea
description: After waking up from her nap, her daughter excitedly shared funny stories from her ballet class. Yu Xiaowei held her on her lap and listened to her talk about what she and her dad had seen at the mall. Her husband, meanwhile, played with LEGO with their son. Yu Xiaowei brewed a pot of jasmine tea and served it with the egg tarts her mother had baked. The family of four enjoyed a relaxing afternoon in the living room, with the fragrance of tea mingling with laughter.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with homework and assisting with meal preparation
description: After the school sports meet, Xuanxuan was in a playful mood. Yu Xiaowei reminded him that he still had weekend homework. She then went with him to the study to check his math and Chinese homework and made him copy out the new characters. After finishing the tutoring, she went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare dinner, washing and picking vegetables. Mother and daughter chatted about everyday things as they worked, and a warm family atmosphere filled the kitchen.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home study and kitchen

name: Home workouts and sports recovery.
description: Today's long-distance running and jogging left the muscles in her lower body a bit tired. Yu Xiaowei took out the yoga mat and did a 15-minute full-body stretch with her husband. Then she used a massage gun to carefully relax her calves and the front of her thighs, and applied ice to her right knee again for 10 minutes, while her husband massaged her tense shoulders and neck. The couple completed post-exercise recovery together, taking care of each other.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and evening family sharing
description: Dinner was her mother’s specialty: green radish and carrot soup, steamed pork patty with water chestnuts, and blanched lettuce. The family sat around the table, reviewing the highlights of the school sports meet as they ate. Xuanxuan once again became the center of attention. Yu Xiaowei shared that her son’s performance had strengthened her confidence in finishing the half marathon under two hours, and the family’s support and encouragement flowed through their conversation.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, home dining room

name: Evening family TV and game time
description: After dinner, the family watched a children's favorite animal documentary in the living room. Xuanxuan snuggled in Yu Xiaowei's arms, while Xinxin leaned against her father. After watching TV, the whole family played Ludo. The room was filled with the children's laughter and joyful voices, and the simple game brought the family closer together.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Children washing up and getting ready for bed
description: At 8:30, Yu Xiaowei and her husband divided the work: Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter Xinxin, told her stories, and coaxed her to sleep; her husband helped Xuanxuan take a bath, then let him read independently for half an hour. After the children were settled, the house gradually quieted down, and the couple was finally able to catch their breath.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Caring about high school classmate He Junjie.
description: Before going to bed, Yu Xiaowei saw her high school classmate He Junjie post a somewhat downhearted message in the group chat, hinting that he might be unemployed. She immediately sent an encouraging message in the group, then opened a private chat window and sent a handshake emoji and a voice message: "A Jie, I've been through transition periods too. If you need opportunities or resources, I have some friends and colleagues who might be able to help. Why don't we set a time to have tea first?" This showed genuine care for her old classmate.
location: Home bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal study and diary time
description: After checking on her classmates, Yu Xiaowei drank a glass of warm milk, put on her earphones, and listened to the last segment of the CFP (Certified Financial Planner) course audio to warm up for the official start of class next Friday. After listening, she took out her diary and briefly recorded today's emotional journey and the things that moved her, summing up a full and warm day.
location: Home bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening wrap-up and bedtime
description: Yu Xiaowei set the alarm for the next morning and packed the items she would need for taking the children to the park the next day. After turning off the lights, she chatted with her husband about her worries for her classmates' situations. Her husband reassured her, saying, "You've done very well." Listening to her husband's steady breathing, Yu Xiaowei felt filled with inner strength. All of today's plans had been accomplished successfully, and she slowly drifted off to sleep with a smile.
location: Home bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and breakfast preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat on the living room balcony and practiced yoga. Because her right knee was still sore, she adjusted the lunges and Warrior pose in the Sun Salutation to low-impact versions and relaxed her body and mind through breathing meditation. After 15 minutes, she went into the kitchen and started preparing breakfast: baking pineapple buns, frying sunny-side-up eggs, and brewing a pot of hot milk tea.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Block 3, Whampoa Garden

name: Family Sunday breakfast
description: The whole family sat around the dining table enjoying breakfast. Taking advantage of everyone's good mood, Yu Xiaowei proposed today's family plan: she and her husband Zhang Weiming would clean the storage room, and she suggested her parents take the children to Kowloon Tsai Park or go shopping in the morning. Her parents readily agreed, and the children excitedly discussed playing on the slide.
location: Restaurant in Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-meal preparations and reminders
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei put the dishes into the dishwasher, prepared water bottles, snacks and spare clothes for the children, and reminded her parents not to rush back for lunch. Then she and Zhang Weiming changed into old clothes, put on gloves and masks, and prepared for a thorough cleaning.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Block 3, Whampoa Garden

name: Quality morning time with her child
description: Before the big clean-up officially began, Yu Xiaowei decided to enjoy some parent-child time first. She built LEGO with the kids and listened to her daughter talk about funny things at kindergarten. Only when her parents urged the children to head out did she see them off.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, living room, children's room

name: Workday communication and client contact
description: Taking advantage of the quiet at home, Yu Xiaowei handled next week's important work matters in her study. She called her colleague Su Lishan to confirm the arrangement for Monday's routine meeting; then she opened her notebook and sent WeChat messages to two clients scheduled for next Monday, reminding each of the meeting time and the materials they needed to prepare. After finishing, she felt more confident about Monday's schedule.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, study room

name: Quick lunch
description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming had a simple lunch. She took out the braised beef shank and cucumber salad prepared last night from the fridge, while Zhang Weiming cooked two bowls of plain noodles. As they ate, they reviewed their plan for the afternoon cleaning.
location: Restaurant in Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and knee care
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei felt some stiffness in her right knee. She took an ice pack from the fridge, wrapped it in a towel, and applied it to her knee. She leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, she asked Zhang Weiming to go to the storage room first and move out the clutter.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, living room, balcony

name: Deep cleaning the storage room
description: Before 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei and her husband divided tasks outside the storage room: Yu Xiaowei was responsible for sorting and cleaning, and Zhang Weiming for repairing the shelving and handling heavy items in high places. The two then worked together to move everything out of the storage room into the living room. Zhang Weiming wiped down the shelves and corners, while Yu Xiaowei swept the corners. Next, on the living room carpet, they inspected the items together, putting the intact ones in a donation pile, discarding the damaged ones, and storing the ones to keep in labeled cardboard boxes. Zhang Weiming took out his tools to repair the loose shelf boards in the storage room, and Yu Xiaowei handed him tools as he worked. After the repair, the two put the kept items back according to the new layout: heavy items at the bottom, seasonal items at the top, and tools and documents in storage bins. The storage room looked brand new.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Block 3, storage room and living room

name: Shopping and donation outing
description: After the spring cleaning, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming drove to Wellcome (Yonggui Building branch). Yu Xiaowei got out alone to buy fresh salmon, broccoli, cherry tomatoes, kiwifruit, spaghetti, and soy sauce, and at checkout also grabbed two discounted Lindt chocolates. After shopping, the two drove to the Prince Building Community Services Centre on Prince Edward Road West, carried the three packed bags of donations out of the car, confirmed the condition of the items with the staff, filled in the donation registration form, and obtained an official charitable receipt.
location: Wellcome Supermarket (Wing Kwai House branch) on Wu Kwong Street and the Community Service Centre at Prince's Building, 282 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home to rest and ice the knee.
description: After driving home from the community center, the first thing Yu Xiaowei did was take out the ice pack again and apply it to her right knee. She leaned back on the sofa, drank a large glass of warm water, and closed her eyes to rest for 15 minutes.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Help prepare dinner.
description: After her knee felt better, Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen to help. She washed the lettuce and got ready to stir-fry it with minced garlic; she also helped her mother, Chen Meiling, rinse the grass carp clean and prepare it for steaming. Mother and daughter chatted about recent happenings as they prepped the ingredients.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Block 3, Kitchen

name: The whole family enjoys dinner together
description: On the table were steamed grass carp, garlic lettuce, tomato egg drop soup, and roasted goose legs brought back from the supermarket. The whole family sat around the table. Zhang Weiming raised his glass to celebrate the storage room getting a new lease of life. Yu Xiaowei smiled and took a sip of tea, while the children vied to claim credit for helping today.
location: Restaurant in Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-meal digestion and parent-child games
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei paced in the living room to aid digestion, and the family played a card game called 'Guess Who I Am,' with laughter throughout. The children felt especially comfortable in the tidy home. In the middle, Yu Xiaowei also browsed the embroidery pattern book her mother had brought for inspiration.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family time and personal relaxation
description: After the game, Yu Xiaowei helped the children wash up and told the story of "Little Rabbit Tidies Her Room" to hint at the meaning of the big cleanup. She helped her daughter get tucked into bed, checked the sports uniform and textbooks her son needed for Monday, and after the children fell asleep, she went to the study to browse the Chapter 1 handouts of the CFP course and take notes, and also wrote in her diary. Then she changed into pajamas, did gentle stretching on the bed, and chatted with her husband, mentioning that their friend He Junjie had lost his job. She also jotted down on her phone memo matters such as reminding clients about materials and printing contracts on Monday.
location: Children's room, study, and master bedroom, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei put down her phone, turned off the bedside lamp, drew the curtains, and, with the contentment of a fulfilling and peaceful day, soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up, yoga, and meditation.
description: The alarm went off. Yu Xiaowei did 15 minutes of low-impact yoga, focusing on hip joint and glute muscle activation while avoiding pressure on her right knee. Then she did 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation and 4-7-8 breathing to calm her mind. Afterwards, she removed the gel patch from last night's ice compress and wiped her knee with warm water.
location: Bedroom/living room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and taking the kids to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei helped her mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast, making peanut butter French toast and freshly squeezed orange juice. She confirmed with her husband Zhang Weiming that he would pick up their daughter from school tonight and buy anti-inflammatory pain relief patches. At 7:20, her husband took their daughter to kindergarten, and Yu Xiaowei took their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. On the way, she put a folding umbrella into her son's schoolbag and reminded him of the showers.
location: Kitchen and dining room, home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Listening to the CFP course during the commute.
description: Walk from Kowloon Tong Government Primary School to MTR Kowloon Tong Station, take the East Rail line to Admiralty Station, then transfer to the Island line to Wan Chai Station; the commute takes about 50 minutes. On the train, Yu Xiaowei wore Bluetooth earphones and listened to the audio of Chapter 1 of the CFP Introduction to Financial Planning, and wrote down key concepts and questions in her phone's notes app.
location: MTR route from Kowloon Tong Station, Kowloon City District, to Wan Chai Station, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning office work and client contact
description: Arrived at the workstation in AIA Tower, made coffee, then processed emails and replied to two clients' inquiries about policy renewals. At 9:30, checked that important client Chen Meiling's policy was due for its annual review, called to greet her and arranged to do the policy review at her Central office on the afternoon of March 31, then entered it into the system and sent a confirmation email. Organized this week's client visit plan and checked the afternoon medical insurance plan data. In between, briefly discussed CFP registration with colleague Su Lishan.
location: Personal work station, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and CFP experience exchange
description: Yu Xiaowei had lunch with her colleague Su Lishan at Yuan Ji Cha Chaan Teng near the company, ordering curry beef brisket rice and iced lemon tea. Wenhui told her about the weird man she had met on the subway, and they chatted as they entered the restaurant.

Jiaxin was so moved her eyes reddened, and she put on the bracelet immediately. The three ordered sake, plum wine, salmon sashimi, a yakitori platter, and grilled rice balls. After a few rounds of drinks, Jiaxin became downcast, mentioning that the school's student enrollment was declining and her logistics position might be cut. Xiaowei and Wenhui listened carefully and didn't give advice right away; instead, they shared their own low points at work and encouraged Jiaxin: 'You're so capable, there's nothing to fear.' The mood quickly recovered through inside jokes and memories of childhood embarrassments.

Wenhui was staying at a hotel in Causeway Bay, and they agreed to have a group chat next week. Xiaowei held an umbrella and walked to the MTR station in drizzling rain. On the way, she bought a bottle of honey and a carton of milk at 7-Eleven. She then took the Island Line, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line, then to the Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station, and walked home.

Teacher Wu taught the “double-lock flower stitch,” demonstrating how the needle insertion angle and thread tension give the petals a three-dimensional layered effect. I practiced with total concentration and observed others’ techniques, deeply feeling how difficult it is to pass down traditional crafts. After class, Teacher Wu pulled me over to sit on the sofa, worried that the craft might be lost, and hoped I would take over the studio. I solemnly promised to give it serious thought, viewing it as a responsibility.
