name: Underwriting communication, client phone calls, and proposal preparation
description: First, she spoke by phone with Manager Li of the Underwriting Department about the underwriting issue for client Mr. Li, who has mild fatty liver. She provided his diet adjustment records and recent follow-up results, and successfully secured standard-risk coverage. She then called client Mr. Chen to share the good news. After that, she replied to client emails, checked client Wang Qiming's needs record in the CRM system, drafted a preliminary savings and protection plan framework based on the Greater Bay Area product terms, and double-checked the policy documents for the afternoon visit to a client in Kwun Tong to ensure all files were complete.
location: Office, 15th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and park activities.
description: She brought a lunchbox to a bench in Wan Chai Park and ate. While eating a salad sandwich, she sent a WeChat message to her Shenzhen colleague Guo Junwei, asking about the designated network issue for the investment-linked policy with medical rider for Greater Bay Area clients. He replied with a detailed voice message; she noted the key points and thanked him. After lunch, she walked two slow laps around the park, enjoying the spring sunshine, thinking about the afternoon client communication priorities, and submitted her morning exercise check-in to the CFP study group.
location: Wan Chai Promenade, near Fenwick Street, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing documents and commuting to Kwun Tong.
description: After returning to the office from the park, I gave Wang Qiming's proposal a final polish and added a comparison table. Then I packed the product brochures, policy review reports, and documents needed for the afternoon client meeting into my briefcase. Afterward, I left and took the MTR to Kwun Tong, and on the way I paid the water, electricity, and gas bills via mobile banking.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 138 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, to Kwun Tong District, 72 Hoi Yuen Road, client company meeting room (commuting route)

name: Client policy review and signing
description: In the meeting room of the client's office building in Kwun Tong Industrial Area, she showed Mr. and Mrs. Li, a couple in the trading business, the past year's policy dividends and coverage on a tablet, and provided upgrade suggestions based on their changing family structure. The clients were satisfied and renewed their insurance, and each also added an accident insurance policy with a coverage of HK$500,000. She guided the clients in signing the application forms.
location: Meeting room at client company, 72 Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drop by to visit mother-in-law on the way
description: After visiting the client, she walked to Tsui Ping Estate in Kwun Tong to visit her mother-in-law Li Shufen, bringing fresh orange juice and wife cakes bought on the way. The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law chatted in the living room, exchanging updates on the children's studies and the mother-in-law's recent health. She took leave after about half an hour.
location: Mother-in-law's home, Tsui Ping Estate, 19 Tsui Ping Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting home
description: Walked from her mother-in-law's house to Kwun Tong Station, took the MTR to Prince Edward Station, and walked home after exiting the station; on the way she texted her mother to let her know when she would arrive home.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Jiahuan Building, Prince Edward Road West (east of Zhilan Garden) (route home)

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: After arriving home, her mother had already prepared two dishes and a soup. She ate quickly, hugged her daughter, and listened to her mother share fun stories about taking Xinxin to the park. Her husband Zhang Weiming said he would handle the children's bedtime tonight so she could go to class with peace of mind.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to CFP classroom
description: Put on lightweight canvas shoes, sling on a backpack with textbooks and notebooks, walk to Whampoa Station, take the MTR to Admiralty Station, and go to the CFP course venue.
location: Tower 2, Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (the building where the CFP classroom is located)

name: Pre-class preparation and discussion with classmates
description: Arriving early at the commercial building where the classroom was located, she browsed the handouts in the rest area and highlighted key points, then discussed the insurance needs analysis assignment from last week with two CFP classmates in her study group, exchanging ideas and data sources.
location: Classroom rest area, Tower 2, Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: CFP in-person course and break-time exchanges
description: The instructor taught Insurance Planning and Tax Law. In the first half, he explained the tax advantages of Hong Kong insurance policies and legal issues in estate planning. Yu Xiaowei actively answered using client cases and earned praise. During the break, she discussed the tax law content with classmates and arranged an after-class group practice session. In the second half, the lecture turned to the alignment of mainland and Hong Kong insurance law and the impact of CRS. She took extensive notes and marked the points relevant to Greater Bay Area clients.
location: Classroom, Tower 2, Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-class study group discussion.
description: After class, gathered with the four group members in the fast-food area of UNY Life Creation Depot downstairs, clarified the division of work for next week's case assignment (market analysis, product comparison, tax impact, risk assessment), and agreed to submit initial drafts in the group chat next Wednesday and do peer reviews before class on Thursday. Also proposed an online joint review session over the weekend.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Central and Western District, 88 Queensway, Pacific Place, UNY Life Creation Depot fast food restaurant

name: Returning home, washing up, meditating, and going to bed
description: She took the MTR home, and the children were already asleep. After a quick shower, she changed into pajamas, did 5 minutes of breathing meditation by the bed to clear her mind, and used the voice memo in her phone notes to record the 3 core points of the day's course and the client follow-up plan. After getting into bed, she chatted with her husband Zhang Weiming about some interesting moments from the course, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga, family breakfast, and school drop-off
description: Woke up naturally at 7 a.m., and did about 20 minutes of gentle morning yoga in bed to wake up the body. After washing up, prepared breakfast in the kitchen with mother Chen Meiling: fried eggs, toasted sliced bread, and made Ovaltine. Woke up son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin, and helped daughter tie her ponytail. The whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast. At 7:40, she walked her daughter to Kowloon City Kindergarten, while her husband Zhang Weiming drove their son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School.
location: Flat B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China (home); then to Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai)

name: Alone time and preparation before commuting.
description: After taking her daughter home, she made a cup of Hong Kong-style silk-stocking milk tea, paired with the pineapple bun bought last night, and sat on the living room sofa leisurely watching morning news and CFP study group messages. Then she changed into casual going-out clothes, picked up her sports bag and computer, and prepared to head out.
location: Living room at home, Unit B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: MTR commute to Causeway Bay
description: Left at 8:40, walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line, transferred at Yau Ma Tei to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty, then switched to the Island Line to Causeway Bay Station. On the ride, I used the time to browse popular science articles about family trusts.
location: Hong Kong, China MTR (from Whampoa Station to Causeway Bay Station)

name: Causeway Bay dim sum, monthly financial organization, and lunch
description: At 9 o'clock, she found a quiet booth at Tsui Wah Restaurant in Lee Theatre Plaza, Causeway Bay, and ordered shrimp wonton noodles and iced lemon tea. Afterwards, she opened the Excel spreadsheet 'Family Finance Ledger' on her tablet and entered and checked March's income and expenses item by item (commission 28,000, husband's salary 12,000; mortgage 15,000, son's interest class fees, daily expenses, etc.), calculating this month's balance at about 21,000. During lunch, she called Li Guodong, the relationship manager at Standard Chartered Bank, to confirm that this month's 3,000 HKD money market fund regular investment had been successfully deducted, and asked about recent market trends. Manager Li suggested maintaining the current allocation. After lunch, she packed a pineapple bun with butter to go.
location: Tsui Wah Restaurant, Lee Theatre Plaza, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, China

name: Shopping for fruit in Causeway Bay and going to the beauty salon
description: Went to Causeway Bay market and, as planned, bought dragon fruit, mangoes, and Sunkist oranges to replenish the weekend fruit at home. Then, carrying the fruit, walked 5 minutes to the Ailudema Beauty Salon at Lee Garden Two.
location: Hong Kong, China - Causeway Bay market, then proceeded to the Ailudema Beauty Salon at Lee Garden Two, Causeway Bay.

name: A duo facial treatment with her good friend Su Lishan
description: Arrived at the beauty salon and met up with colleague and good friend Su Lishan. Using the monthly care card, they had basic facial treatments in a double room. While wearing face masks, the two chatted and caught up: Su Lishan complained about the high work pressure, and Xiaowei shared the joy of securing standard underwriting for a client. During this, Su Lishan strongly recommended the "Tranquil Heart Mountain House" meditation retreat in Sai Kung, saying it was very effective last weekend. Xiaowei was tempted and asked in detail about the registration method and course content.
location: Ailudema Beauty Salon, Lee Garden Two, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, China

name: Returning home and getting ready for exercise
description: After saying goodbye to Su Lishan, took the MTR from Causeway Bay Station back to Whampoa Station and returned home in Kowloon City. Changed into a running singlet and shorts, checked the laces of running shoes, and put the newly bought fruit in the fridge.
location: MTR in Hong Kong, China (from Causeway Bay Station to Whampoa Station), then returned home to Flat B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District

name: 10 km endurance run at Kowloon Tsai Park
description: Wearing a sports watch and earphones, I jogged to Kowloon Tsai Park near home for the Friday routine 10 km run. Around 5 km into the run, I ran into fellow runner Shen Peiwen, who had already finished and was stretching. We briefly talked about our preparations for the weekend's Guangzhou Marathon. I then continued the remaining 5 km, maintaining a steady pace of 6:50/km throughout and feeling good. After the run, I did a full stretching routine by the lake and walked home slowly.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Family dinner and monthly financial meeting
description: After running home, her mother had already made steamed grass carp, garlic stir-fried broccoli, and pumpkin and pork rib soup. The family sat down for dinner; daughter Xinxin shared a painting she made at kindergarten, and son Xuanxuan reported his math quiz results. After dinner, she and her husband Zhang Weiming held their monthly family finance meeting in the living room. She showed the March income and expenditure details she had organized that morning, and they agreed to raise the emergency fund target from HK$60,000 to HK$80,000, and cut the April entertainment budget by HK$500 to make room for the two children's upcoming outdoor field trip fees (about HK$1,500 in total). The adjusted plan was entered into the shared online document "Family Finance Plan".
location: Home, Unit B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Evening study, signing up for the meditation retreat, and bedtime preparation
description: After the family meeting ended, she searched on the computer in the study and signed up for the two-day meditation retreat at “Serene Mind Mountain House” in Sai Kung this weekend (29th-30th), completing the online payment. Then she quickly reviewed the key points of the CFP lecture notes for Tax Law and Insurance Planning, preparing for tomorrow's online review with Group 3. After that, she began packing a simple bag for the weekend retreat (yoga clothes, notebook, sneakers, etc.) and chatted with her husband about tomorrow's arrangements. At 21:30 she went to the bathroom to remove her makeup and take a shower, then did 5 minutes of bedtime breathing meditation. After returning to the bedroom, she confirmed the time and link for the next day's CFP online review meeting, exchanged goodnights with her husband, and turned off the lights around 22:00.
location: Home, Unit B, 15th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning, did some simple stretches, then went downstairs. My mother Chen Meiling was already preparing breakfast. I talked with her about today's retreat schedule, helped set the table, and enjoyed a simple breakfast of white congee with preserved radish.
location: Flat A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: CFP group online review
description: After breakfast, she put on Bluetooth earphones in the dining room at home and had an online review session via Zoom with three members of her CFP exam preparation group. As the group leader, she guided everyone in discussing the practical points of CRS information exchange and shared a cross-border insurance case, completing an efficient half-hour review.
location: Flat A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Luggage check and farewell to family
description: After finishing the online review, I did a final check of my hiking backpack to confirm everything needed was inside. The children had already gotten up by then, and I hugged my son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin goodbye, telling them to be good. My husband Zhang Weiming walked me to the elevator and hugged me in support. My mother was also nearby.
location: Flat A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Travel by car to Sai Kung Retreat Centre
description: The taxi her husband had called arrived on time. After getting in, she waved goodbye to her family. The car drove out of Whampoa Garden, passed through the Kwun Tong Bypass and the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel, heading to Sai Kung. On the way, she turned off mobile data, kept only emergency calls available, enjoyed the view outside the window, and gradually calmed down.
location: In a taxi en route from Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, to 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Arrived at the retreat centre and checked in
description: Arrived at the Sai Kung Seaside Retreat Centre, checked in at the front desk, received the schedule card and room key, and put her luggage in Room 108. As required by the retreat, she voluntarily handed her phone to the staff for safekeeping.
location: Lobby, Sai Kung Seaside Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Garden stroll and seaside sitting
description: Before the retreat started, she walked alone in the garden of the retreat center, went to the sea-view terrace, sat down on the ground facing the sea, closed her eyes, and felt the sea breeze and the sound of the waves, enjoying a peaceful moment.
location: Garden and sea-view terrace, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Opening ceremony and first mindful walking session.
description: All trainees gathered in the meditation hall. Instructor Chen Zhiqiang introduced the theme and precautions of the retreat, then led everyone to a nearby beach and pine forest trail for mindful walking practice. Focusing on the sensation of the soles of their feet touching sand and pine needles, coordinated with breathing, they gradually entered a tranquil state.
location: Beach and pine forest trail, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Meditation at the sea-view pavilion
description: After mindful walking, I had free time and walked alone to the pavilion on the sea-view terrace. I sat facing the sea, quietly, without talking to anyone, completely absorbed in the present moment.
location: Sea-view terrace pavilion, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Vegetarian lunch and mindful eating
description: Enjoyed the first retreat meal at a vegetarian restaurant, including brown rice, stir-fried vegetables, boiled tofu, and miso soup. Under the instructor's guidance, practiced mindful eating, focusing entirely on the taste and texture of the food itself.
location: Vegetarian restaurant, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Midday rest and physical relaxation
description: Back in her private guest room, she lay on the bed and reviewed the morning's feelings, feeling peaceful inside. After a short rest of about 40 minutes, she got up and did some simple stretches to prepare for the afternoon body scan meditation.
location: Private Room (Room 108), Sai Kung Seaside Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Body scan meditation course
description: Did a body scan meditation in the indoor meditation hall. Lying flat on a yoga mat, following the instructor's guidance, I gradually scanned my body from toes to the top of my head, noticed slight soreness in my back, and tried to release tension with breathing, completing a deep relaxation of body and mind.
location: Indoor Meditation Hall, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Tea break and group discussion.
description: After the meditation class, she enjoyed herbal tea and cookies in the rest area and quietly exchanged meditation experiences with several classmates from the group, sharing smiles and simple encouragement with one another. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Rest area, Sai Kung Seaside Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Mindful listening and singing bowl healing.
description: Returning to the meditation hall, she took part in a mindful listening experience. The instructor struck singing bowls at different frequencies. She listened with her eyes closed amid the long overtones, without thinking or analyzing, letting her mind go completely blank and achieving deep relaxation.
location: Indoor Meditation Hall, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening coastal walk.
description: Under the setting sun, I strolled alone along the seaside path, listening to the waves, the wind, and birdsong, immersed in the peaceful beauty and filled with gratitude.
location: Seafront walkway, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Huimin Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Vegetarian dinner and mindful eating.
description: Dinner was tomato vegetable soup with whole wheat bread and a small salad. I continued practicing mindful eating, savoring the satisfaction brought by each bite.
location: Vegetarian restaurant, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Candlelight group sharing session.
description: In the evening, candles were lit in the meditation hall. All participants and mentors sat in a circle and candidly shared their original intentions for coming to the retreat. Yu Xiaowei shared the multiple pressures she faces as a career woman, wife, and mother, as well as her desire to stop running and listen to her inner self. Her voice choked with emotion, and she received understanding and resonance from everyone. The sharing session ended at 9:30 with everyone reluctant to leave.
location: Meditation Hall, Sai Kung Waterfront Retreat Centre, 18 Wui Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Late-night inner reflection
description: Back in the room, I took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, sat on the edge of the bed, took out a notebook, and wrote down the deepest impressions of the day: the feel of mindful walking, the release of the body scan, and the resonance in candlelight. I felt calm and fulfilled.
location: Private Room (Room 108), Sai Kung Seaside Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Going to bed
description: At 10 p.m., I turned off the lights and lay down on time. The sound of the waves outside the window was like a lullaby. My mind and body were completely relaxed, and I quickly fell into deep sleep.
location: Private Room (Room 108), Sai Kung Seaside Retreat Centre, 18 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Morning seaside flow yoga and changing clothes.
description: Waking up naturally in the early morning, I changed into yoga clothes and headed to the hotel's sea-view terrace for a 60-minute vinyasa yoga session with the retreat instructor. Facing the sea, I felt the sea breeze and the tides, connecting my body and mind with nature. Afterward, I returned to my room, changed, and put on comfortable cotton-linen casual clothes.
location: Seaview terrace and guest rooms, WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wui Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Mindful breakfast
description: Had breakfast with the retreat participants at the sea-view restaurant. Before the meal, they observed a minute of silence to give thanks for the food, then slowly savored the oatmeal and fruit while quietly discussing their sleep quality and expectations for the course. The atmosphere was peaceful and harmonious.
location: Sea View Restaurant, WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk along the coast.
description: After breakfast, she walked alone along the hotel’s garden path to the seaside, sat on a rock watching the tide rise and fall while the morning mist dispersed, completely clearing her mind.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sai Kung District, No. 28 Wai Man Road, WM Hotel Hong Kong, garden and coastal walkway

name: Mindful walking and breathing exercises
description: Under the instructor's guidance, practiced mindful walking on the garden lawn, feeling the grass with bare feet and focusing on each step. Then learned the "4-7-8 breathing technique" (inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7 seconds, exhale for 8 seconds), recorded the steps on her phone, and resolved to keep practicing.
location: Garden lawn of WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sitting meditation
description: During free time, she chose to sit cross-legged in meditation on the sea-view terrace, incorporating mindful walking and breathing exercises, and felt an unprecedented sense of calm and focus.
location: Hong Kong SAR - Sai Kung District - 28 Wai Man Road - WM Hotel Hong Kong - sea-view terrace

name: Mindful vegetarian lunch
description: All the students shared an all-vegetarian lunch, including stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tofu, and brown rice. They ate mindfully, chewing slowly, and appreciated the simplicity of vegetarian food and its kindness to all life.
location: Sea View Restaurant, WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and pre-run preparation.
description: After lunch, returned to the room for a lunch break, set an alarm, and took a 30-minute nap. After waking up, packed luggage and put loose items into bags. Then changed into running gear: professional vest, shorts, running shoes, applied protective kinesiology tape, carried energy gels and water, and prepared for the long run.
location: Guest room, WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Summary of meditation and free writing.
description: The final group activity of the retreat: the instructor led a deep relaxation meditation and a review of the two days' takeaways. In the free writing session, she wrote down her reflections in her notebook: "So it turns out that when you put down your phone, the world is so quiet. Only by running out do you know how strong you are inside." She also sketched the sea and sky.
location: Multi-function Room, WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wui Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Retreat wrap-up and phone retrieval
description: The camp closing ceremony was held in the hotel garden, and mentor Chen Zhiqiang gave blessings to the trainees. Yu Xiaowei solemnly signed the guest book. Afterwards, she went to the front desk to retrieve her stored phone, texted her husband about her long-distance running plan, replenished with electrolyte drink, and completed warm-up.
location: Garden and front desk, WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: 18 km seaside long run
description: Starting from the hotel, she ran along the Sai Kung Waterfront Promenade to Man Yee Road and back, completing an 18-kilometer long run. Her pace was about 6:50 per kilometer. Along the way she enjoyed the coastline, and at the 10-kilometer mark she drank water and had an energy gel. Her knees felt fine and her heart rate was steady. She sprinted at the end, took a finish-line selfie with her phone, and shared it with her running buddy Shen Peiwen.
location: Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, starting at WM Hotel Hong Kong, along the Sai Kung Waterfront Promenade to Man Yee Road (and back)

name: Post-run stretching and going home
description: After the long run, I walked slowly around the hotel garden to stretch and drank a full bottle of water. Then I called a taxi using an app and headed to 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District. In the car, I replied to messages from running friends and called my mother to tell her I was almost home. The ride took about 20-odd minutes, and I arrived home.
location: From WM Hotel Hong Kong, 28 Wai Man Road, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Family dinner
description: When she got home, her daughter rushed over to hug her. She had dinner with her husband Weiming, mother Chen Meiling, son Xuanxuan, and daughter Xinxin, excitedly sharing her retreat experience and the joy of long-distance running, and explaining mindful walking. The whole family was warm and happy.
location: Living room and dining area at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Spending time with her child
description: After dinner, she did animal puzzles with her daughter, then checked her son Xuanxuan's weekend homework and patiently explained the mistakes in the math word problems until he fully understood.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, home living room and son's room.

name: Tell a bedtime story
description: After daughter Xinxin finished her bath, she read her the picture book story Winnie the Pooh, whose theme is “Slow down and feel the beauty.” Xinxin said, “Mommy smells better since coming back from the retreat,” and they said a warm goodnight.
location: Children's room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Writing reflections on the retreat
description: After the children fell asleep, she was alone in the study recording her reflections from the meditation retreat and her breakthrough in long-distance running, and solemnly wrote down: 'Slow down, and you can go farther; run out, and you will know your inner strength.' She stored the notebook safely.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: Entered the bathroom to wash up, removed the dust and sweat, applied body lotion, massaged my calves, changed into cotton pajamas, and felt refreshed.
location: Master bedroom bathroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Husband-wife exchange and bedtime
description: She had a brief conversation with her husband Zhang Weiming, expressed her inner calm and contentment, then turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: Outside, a fine drizzle was falling. Yu Xiaowei unrolled her yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of flow yoga, feeling her body stretch and her strength return; after yesterday's 18 km long run, the backs of her thighs were slightly sore and heavy, but they felt better after stretching. She then did 5 minutes of meditation with the sound of rain in the background, using the 4-7-8 breathing technique she had learned at the meditation retreat to calm her mind and welcome the new week.
location: Prince Edward Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare and enjoy a nutritious breakfast.
description: Yu Xiaowei prepared spinach egg rolls and warm homemade soy milk for the family, and her husband Zhang Weiming voluntarily took on the task of taking the children to school. At the dining table, she reminded her son Xuanxuan to submit the craft homework "My Sai Kung Trip," kissed her daughter Xinxin on the forehead, and her mother Chen Meiling watched with a smile, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Prince Edward Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting and studying for the CFP course
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into business attire, walked to Prince Edward Station with an umbrella, and took the MTR to Wan Chai Station. During the roughly 40-minute ride, she put on earphones and continued listening to the audio course "CFP Financial Planning Basics," focusing on reviewing the "CRS Tax Information Exchange" module to gather material for tomorrow's case draft.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (start), via MTR Prince Edward Station to Wan Chai Station, to AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley (end)

name: Morning company preparation and personal review
description: After arriving at AIA Building, Yu Xiaowei made a cup of hot black tea, opened her computer to check emails and to-do items, kept urgent client materials at hand, and prepared for the 9 o'clock team morning meeting. During this time, she spent 5 minutes reviewing yesterday's long run in her memo: “18 km completed pain-free, knees feel great, keep it up!”
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Team Monthly Sprint Morning Meeting
description: Regional Director Liang Zhenhua led the Monday morning meeting, emphasizing that on the last working day of March, the team's performance still had a 5% gap from the quarterly target, and encouraged everyone to make a push on prospective clients. Yu Xiaowei mentally calculated her clients' progress. After the meeting, Liang Zhenhua patted her on the shoulder and encouraged her: “Xiaowei, you’ve done well this month — just one last step to go!”
location: Meeting room, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Month-end work sprint: payment collection and statistics.
description: After the morning meeting, she immediately got to work. She called client Mr. Lin to confirm the transfer before 12:00 today, then contacted Mrs. Liu gently but firmly to confirm the payment deadline. Afterward, she compiled the March statistics table for her personal signed policies and team contributions, entered it into Excel, calculated reward points, and prepared for the report to be submitted tomorrow.
location: Workstation at AIA Building, No. 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Standing before the ancestral grave, Uncle Yu Guoliang told the younger generation how their great-grandfather had left Guangzhou barefoot to go to Nanyang back then, and then built the family fortune from scratch in Shenzhen. Grandmother Liang Shufang added, her voice trembling, describing the hard details of how their great-grandmother had raised five children with her exquisite Yue embroidery skills during the years of material scarcity. Yu Xiaowei listened intently and gently placed a small white flower in front of the tombstone. For the first time, she felt so vividly how Yue embroidery ran in her blood.

description: After the tomb-sweeping, the two families—more than ten people in all—drove to Baiwei Garden, an authentic Cantonese restaurant near the cemetery, where they had booked a private room in advance and enjoyed a reunion lunch. During the meal, grandmother Liang Shufang held Yu Xiaowei's hand and earnestly urged her to carry on the craft of Cantonese embroidery. Yu Xiaowei nodded seriously and chatted with her mother Chen Meiling and husband Zhang Weiming about the resilience and wisdom that the women of the family had shown during turbulent times. Her mother also shared warm memories of learning embroidery from Grandma in her youth.
location: Baiwei Garden Cantonese Restaurant, Xili Subdistrict, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Said goodbye to family and friends and headed home.
description: They bid an affectionate farewell to relatives and friends in Shenzhen and set off back to Hong Kong at about 12:45 p.m. The return border crossing was still busy, but the mood in the car was warm and quiet. The children fell sound asleep in the back seat, while Yu Xiaowei, her husband, and her mother continued talking softly about the day's insights, deeply moved.
location: In the car returning from Shenzhen Bay Port to Prince Building, Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Arrived home and rested
description: At around 2 p.m., the car pulled into the familiar Whampoa Garden. Yu Xiaowei wiped the sleeping children's faces with a damp towel and settled them into their beds. Her mother, Chen Meiling, busied herself tidying up the odds and ends they had brought back. Yu Xiaowei drank a glass of warm water and rested briefly on the sofa to relieve the fatigue of the long drive.
location: Home at Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Recording family stories and looking through old belongings
description: Yu Xiaowei went into the study, took out her diary, and carefully recorded in detail the stories she had heard today about her great-grandfather, great-grandmother, and grandmother, as well as the emotions they stirred in her. Then she opened the yellowed old photo album her mother had found earlier, which contained several old photos of her grandmother's embroidery works and a picture of her grandmother as a young woman holding an embroidery hoop. She gently touched the photos, her heart filled with a strong sense of connection across time and space. She picked up her phone, searched for information on Cantonese embroidery hobby classes in Hong Kong, and saved the webpage to her bookmarks.
location: Home study, Crown Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Practice the basics of Cantonese embroidery.
description: Moved by today's story, Yu Xiaowei took out a beginner's Cantonese embroidery kit from her storage cabinet that she had bought long ago but never started. She found the embroidery hoop and, following a beginner's tutorial on her phone, tried to make the first few stitches. Although they were simple backstitches and came out crooked, every stitch carried her respect for her grandmother and her determination to carry on the tradition.
location: Home study, Crown Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and parent-child communication
description: Mother Chen Meiling and husband Zhang Weiming prepared a simple but warm dinner, including the dried vegetable pork rib soup that Yu Xiaowei loves. During the meal, everyone continued sharing their feelings about the day. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to ask the children, 'How did you feel visiting great-grandpa and great-grandma today?' Her son Zhang Zixuan said he thought grandpa's stories were amazing, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin said she liked the flowers great-grandma embroidered. She played a game of Ludo with them and read picture books for a while, enjoying a warm family time.
location: Home at Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening time with the kids and household chores.
description: Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter Zhang Yuxin, wrapped her in a towel, and helped her change into pajamas. Her husband Zhang Weiming bathed their son Zhang Zixuan. Afterwards, they told the children a bedtime story about family memories. After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei and her husband briefly shared their feelings about the day in the living room. He praised her for organizing things so thoughtfully today, and she felt warm inside.
location: Home at Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Recording reflections before bed
description: After the children were sound asleep, Yu Xiaowei returned to her study and glanced at the unfinished Cantonese embroidery, feeling a trace of warmth in her heart. She sat against the headboard, took out her phone, and wrote down the day's reflections in her memo: "Qingming is not just about remembrance; it is also a time to draw strength. The resilience of the women in our family is clearly visible in my heart at this moment. Heritage begins with each stitch." She confirmed the list of items the children would need tomorrow and planned her rest time.
location: Hong Kong SAR, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, home bedroom study

name: Pre-bedtime stretching to prepare for sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei did a simple pre-sleep stretch on the bedroom carpet, relaxing her tired legs, back, and especially her calves after standing all day. Thinking about how she had walked over 13,000 steps today, she gave herself a thumbs up. At 11 pm, she turned off the light and lay down, her heart filled with warmth and determination. With beautiful hopes for the future, she drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and yoga planning
description: Woke up naturally in the warm spring sunshine. Lingered in bed for a few minutes, stretched, and felt a slight soreness in my calf muscles from yesterday's ancestor-worship hike in Shenzhen, but felt fulfilled inside. After getting up, drank a glass of warm water, and did a few simple Cat-Cow and Downward Dog poses by the bedroom window to wake up the body. Then I opened my phone, quickly checked today's weather and to-do list, and confirmed that the day's overall theme was 'family and heritage.'
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Family breakfast and daily schedule discussion
description: Going down to the dining room, her mother had already prepared congee, fried eggs, turnip cake, and a plate of stir-fried greens. The whole family sat together in a relaxed atmosphere. Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to communicate the day's division of labor with her husband and mother: Mom, let us sort out that pile of winter clothes this morning. Weiming, if you have time this afternoon, could you go to Wellcome? I will make a list for you. The children will be left to you and Dad; do not let them cause trouble. Her father Yu Guoqiang laughed and took over the conversation, saying he would take his grandson to the park downstairs to ride a balance bike. The family chatted cheerfully and set the collaborative tone for the day.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Write a shopping list.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei took out a notebook and pen on the sofa. While recalling what was in the refrigerator, she discussed with her mother and wrote down the items to buy in the afternoon: fresh choy sum, char siu (buy the ready-made kind), breakfast bread, and the cheese cubes her daughter liked. She wrote the list in clear handwriting on purpose and reminded her husband to look for the 'roast meat stall' sign in the afternoon so he wouldn't buy the wrong things.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China

name: Sorting and washing winter clothes.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother began the “winter clothes battle” in the master bedroom. Yu Xiaowei was in charge of loading washable items such as heavy coats and down jackets into the washing machine in batches. Her mother sat on a chair in the bedroom, hand-washing a few delicate cashmere sweaters and silk scarves, muttering as she scrubbed: “This one was bought by your mother-in-law the year you married into the family. The fabric is really good.” “And this one, your dad specially bought a soft one when Xuanxuan was just born...” Yu Xiaowei cooperated by taking out the washed clothes and preparing to bring them to the balcony.
location: China Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, home master bedroom and balcony

name: Drying laundry on the balcony while listening to Cantonese opera
description: When the first load of laundry was done, mother and daughter carried the laundry basket to the balcony. The spring sunshine was ample and the breeze gentle. Yu Xiaowei skillfully hung up the heavy down jacket on a hanger, while her mother carefully laid the hand-washed cashmere sweater flat in a mesh drying net. As she hung the clothes, her mother unconsciously hummed a melody from the classic Cantonese opera "The Flower Princess". Yu Xiaowei listened beside her, feeling this moment was especially peaceful. The washing machine started a second load; while waiting, she took out her phone and took a photo of the drying clothes against the sunlight.
location: Home balcony, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Simple lunch
description: Around noon, everyone took a short break. Mother quickly cooked a pot of delicious wonton noodles, served with a plate of lettuce in oyster sauce. The family ate and chatted while the children chattered about what they had seen in the morning. Yu Xiaowei told her husband that on his way to the supermarket after lunch, he should stop by New Shanghai Kitchen (Whampoa Garden branch) to pick up a roast combo (char siu and roast pork) and a clay pot wonton chicken for dinner.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Seasonal storage and family memories
description: The afternoon session officially began. The first batch of clothes on the balcony had dried completely. Yu Xiaowei and her mother packed the washed down jackets, thick cotton pants, and other items into vacuum compression bags, squeezed out the air before sealing them, and neatly placed them on the top shelf of the master bedroom wardrobe. Then they opened the storage bins and took out the spring and summer clothes at the bottom. Yu Xiaowei hung the light jackets, dresses, and T-shirts by color, while her mother organized the folded shirts beside her. When they came to the skirts belonging to her daughter Xinxin, Yu Xiaowei found several that had become too short. Just as she was about to put them into a paper bag, her mother stopped her and took out from the camphor wood chest in the corner the little embroidered jacket she had worn as a child. The two sat side by side on the sofa. Pointing at the faded silk thread on the jacket, her mother told the story of how her grandmother had embroidered small flowers stitch by stitch under a kerosene lamp. Yu Xiaowei listened intently, her fingers gently tracing the patterns on the jacket, and felt a strong sense of responsibility rise in her heart. She decided that when Xinxin was older, she would pass on both the story of this jacket and the craft.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Cantonese embroidery practice and social sharing
description: While her mother went to rest, Yu Xiaowei cleared the living room coffee table and brought out her small Cantonese embroidery frame. She practiced the backstitch technique taught by Teacher Wu Xiuying yesterday with somewhat unskillful movements, while also opening her phone. She first photographed her daughter's little dresses and sent them to the family group and close-friend group to ask if anyone needed them. At the same time, she replied to her cousin Lin Jiaxin's message about going to Kowloon Tsai Park, but unfortunately Jiaxin had something come up in the afternoon, so they had to make it another day. She then felt at ease, and while listening to her mother's favorite nostalgic hits, she copied photos of old embroidered pieces sent by her grandmother, stitch by stitch, slowly and attentively.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China

name: Parent-child garden activity
description: After practicing Cantonese embroidery for about an hour, her eyes felt a little sore. Yu Xiaowei then remembered that the children had woken up from their naps, so she took Xuanxuan and Xinxin downstairs to the community garden. Xuanxuan kicked a football with the neighbor kids, while she accompanied Xinxin climbing up and down the slide. The sun was no longer dazzling, and a gentle breeze brushed her face. She sat on a bench quietly watching, occasionally getting up to join the children in hide-and-seek, and laughter filled the entire garden.
location: Garden, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shopping, returning home, and preparing meals
description: While the children were happily playing downstairs, Yu Xiaowei saw her husband Zhang Weiming return carrying many bags. In addition to fresh produce from the supermarket, there were, as expected, roast meats and clay pot wonton chicken packed from New Shanghai Kitchen (address: 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, about an 8-minute walk from Whampoa Garden). She brought the children home. Her mother was already in the kitchen chopping the newly bought corn and carrots to make soup. Yu Xiaowei took over, plated the roast meats, washed and stir-fried the choy sum. Soon, the dining table was filled with tempting aromas.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: A hearty family dinner
description: At dinner, the family sat around the table, eating hot char siu and drinking a bowl of savory-sweet slow-cooked soup. The children couldn't stop praising the roast pork, and the table was full of laughter and cheerful talk. Yu Xiaowei looked at her family and felt that although they hadn't done anything major today, this kind of plain, ordinary warmth was what she treasured most. After dinner, her husband took the initiative to wash the dishes and let her rest.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening parent-child learning and reading.
description: Yu Xiaowei first tutored Xuanxuan to finish the math homework assigned over the weekend and checked it. Then she held Xinxin in her arms, picked up a picture book called "The Different Carmela", and told her daughter the story of little chicken Carmela going to see the sea in a lively tone. Her husband Zhang Weiming was peeling fruit for his son beside them. Under the warm lamplight in the living room, it was the most intimate time for the family of four.
location: Living room and children's room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Children's washing and bedtime stories
description: Yu Xiaowei drew a warm bath for the two children. Xinxin took a bubble bath, and while scrubbing her back, Yu Xiaowei told the story of the little embroidered jacket that Grandma had told that day, but adapted it into a fairy tale version, saying that 'a brave little princess wearing a magic jacket can protect her family.' Xuanxuan, after taking a shower by himself, came over to listen too. After the bath, she applied lotion to each child, put them to bed, and kissed them goodnight.
location: Bathroom and children's room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening yoga and daily review
description: The children were all sound asleep, and the home grew quiet. Yu Xiaowei changed into loose loungewear, laid out her yoga mat on the balcony, and did 15 minutes of yin yoga stretching accompanied by the distant city lights and the cool evening breeze, focusing on relaxing her lower back and sore calves. Afterward, she returned to the living room, brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea, sat at her desk, opened her planner, and briefly reviewed the day: the seasonal wardrobe change was done, she had made progress in Cantonese embroidery, and the children had had a great time. She wrote down tomorrow morning's to-dos, including following up on yesterday's client message.
location: Balcony and living room of the home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Bedtime heart-to-heart talk and rest
description: After everything was done, Yu Xiaowei returned to the master bedroom. Her husband was already lying in bed looking at his phone. They briefly talked about the children. Zhang Weiming said, "You worked hard today, handling things with Mom all day." Yu Xiaowei smiled, turned off the bedside lamp, and said, "Let's sleep. We still need to get up early tomorrow." The night outside the window was quiet, and she soon fell asleep, feeling content and relaxed.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Morning meditation and preparation
description: As the sky was just getting light, Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally. Instead of getting up immediately, she sat quietly in bed for five minutes, focusing on her breath, silently grateful for the clear weather today and her body's good condition. Then she got up, quickly ate a banana in the kitchen, and drank a few sips of warm water to replenish basic energy for the upcoming half-marathon training run.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Changing clothes and checking equipment
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into the quick-dry clothes and running shoes she had prepared in advance, carefully checked the battery level of her sports watch, and attached her water bottle to her waist pack. After confirming everything was ready, she quietly closed the front door so as not to wake the family still sleeping.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm-up and easy jog start
description: In the courtyard of the residential complex, Yu Xiaowei did a full 10-minute dynamic warm-up, including jumping jacks, high knees, and lunge stretches, to activate her whole body. Then, at a relaxed jogging pace, she headed along Prince Edward Road West toward Kowloon Tsai Park, covering about 1.5 kilometers in about 7 minutes, waking up her body in the morning breeze.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, from Whampoa Garden to Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Half marathon training run
description: After arriving at the park, she began her half-marathon training as planned. She ran on the track at a steady pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, stopping briefly at the 7 km and 14 km marks to hydrate and adjust her breathing rhythm. Her body felt good, and she finished in 1 hour 50 minutes, slightly faster than expected, which made her very satisfied with today's performance.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Stretching, data recording, and shopping
description: After finishing the run, she did 15 minutes of serious stretching on the lawn, focusing on relaxing her calves and quadriceps. Then she used her phone to record the run data and core activation exercises. On the walk home, she deliberately detoured to the Deluxe Bakery on Waterloo Road and bought the children's favorite fresh pineapple buns. This walk was about 2.3 kilometers and took about 32 minutes.
location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: from Kowloon Tsai Park, return to Whampoa Garden via the Luxury Bakery on Waterloo Road

name: Shower, nutritional supplements, and breakfast preparation.
description: Back home, she took a quick shower and changed into loungewear. She first drank a glass of protein shake to help muscle recovery. Then she went to the dining room, where her mother was already busy. Yu Xiaowei helped prepare breakfast by slicing the freshly bought pineapple buns. As they prepared, the two discussed the filling and side dishes for today's wonton-making.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and sharing about running
description: The family members got up one after another and enjoyed a hearty breakfast together: milk tea made by her mother, eggs, and pineapple buns bought by Yu Xiaowei. At the table, Yu Xiaowei excitedly shared her feelings about the morning's half marathon. Her husband Zhang Weiming expressed admiration, and her son Zhang Zixuan said he wanted to run a marathon like his mother when he grew up. Her daughter Xinxin was more interested in the pineapple buns and ate them with crumbs all over her mouth. The whole family had a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family wonton lunch preparation (shopping and prepping ingredients)
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei, her husband, and her mother made a shopping list. Since Qingming Festival had just passed and there was still leftover roast meat at home, her mother decided not to make a double-meat platter and instead go with simple wonton noodles with the leftover char siu from the day before yesterday. The three of them walked to the Taste supermarket downstairs and bought fresh shrimp, half-fat half-lean pork, and wonton wrappers. Her husband, Zhang Weiming, pushed the shopping cart while Yu Xiaowei and her mother carefully chose the ingredients. Then they went home.
location: Whampoa Garden, No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, and Taste Supermarket, Whampoa New World, No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family made wontons together.
description: After returning home, a lively wonton-making session began. My mother Chen Meiling was in charge of mixing the key pork-and-shrimp filling, while Yu Xiaowei rolled out the wrappers — she deliberately made extra to prepare for teaching her daughter in the afternoon. Her husband Zhang Weiming and son Zhang Zixuan learned clumsily, producing wontons of all shapes, which made daughter Zhang Yuxin giggle.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wonton noodle lunch
description: Mother cooked wonton noodles with a homemade turbot broth base, absolutely delicious. On the table were also the leftover char siu from the day before yesterday. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting. Watching her family's contented expressions, Yu Xiaowei felt full of happiness.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon parent-child handicraft session and introduction to Cantonese embroidery
description: After a short rest following lunch, Yu Xiaowei did crafts with her daughter in the living room. They cut butterflies of various shapes out of colored card stock and stuck them on the window, and her daughter danced with joy. Then Yu Xiaowei took out her grandmother's embroidered jacket from the study and gently explained the stitching to Xinxin, teaching her hand by hand to try using a thick needle to embroider the simplest straight stitch on cloth. Although her daughter was still young, Yu Xiaowei hoped to pass on this love of tradition to her subtly.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal Cantonese embroidery practice.
description: Watching her daughter play with colored paper on her own, Yu Xiaowei used the half hour to take out her Cantonese embroidery tools and practice the backstitch technique that Teacher Wu had taught a few days earlier. She focused on embroidering a small leaf, and her resolve to pass on the craft grew even stronger.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the kids downstairs to walk and play

She sat on a bench to take care of work messages, occasionally watching the children running among the slides and swings. Her son Xuanxuan was playing remote-controlled cars with several kids of the same age in the neighborhood, while her daughter Xinxin quietly looked at flowers with her mother.
location: Garden, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize work logs and client proposals.
description: The children came back from playing, and her husband took over looking after them. Yu Xiaowei returned to her study and opened her laptop. She first organized this week's work log and followed up on greeting messages from a few long-time clients. Then she focused on reviewing the materials for tomorrow's 3 p.m. meeting with the client Mr. Wang, going over the retirement savings plan proposal he had previously consulted about, to make sure the data and presentation logic were all correct.

location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.

Then she did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, feeling grateful for today's fulfilling and lovely family time and personal breakthrough.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Stretching and reading before bed
description: After meditation, she did 10 minutes of pre-sleep stretching on the bed to relax the muscles tense from running. Then, with soft light, she read a few pages from her bedtime reading to completely wind down.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: Turning off the lamp, with a contented and slightly weary feeling, she soon fell into a peaceful sleep, storing up energy for the new week.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time and preparations.
description: After the 06:35 alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei felt that the muscle soreness from yesterday's half marathon had basically disappeared. She got out of bed quietly, changed into yoga clothes, and did 20 minutes of gentle morning yoga in the living room, focusing on stretching her hamstrings, glutes, and lower back. She then went into the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast, set the table, remind her son Zhang Zixuan to bring his math test paper, and ask her daughter Zhang Yuxin about kindergarten activities. After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei packed her commuting bag, put the retirement savings plan documents for today's meeting with client Mr. Wang into a file folder, checked her personal belongings, and her mother handed her a peeled apple. Then she left home.

name: Commuting to work and pre-work warm-up

At the same time, she replied to work emails on her phone and flagged pending files.

description: Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan had a meal at the café in Shui On Centre, ordering a club sandwich and Hong Kong-style milk tea. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei read Case Studies in High-Net-Worth Client Development on her iPad, learned ice-breaking techniques for first contacts, and summarized three application strategies in her notebook.

Meanwhile, she received an encouraging WeChat message from her colleague Su Lishan, which warmed her heart, and she replied with an “OK” emoji.

She closed her eyes and took a deep breath, silently telling herself that her task today was to get through it, learn something, and then set out again. Afterward, she took a 15-minute nap. When she woke up, she washed her face and touched up her makeup. Looking in the mirror, she tidied her appearance, and her eyes became resolute again.

Yu Xiaowei smiled wryly and told her about losing clients and being considered unprofessional. Su Lishan patted her on the shoulder and comforted her, saying that everyone has experienced setbacks, and agreed to treat her to a meal the next day to help her relax. Yu Xiaowei's feeling of disappointment was greatly eased by the warmth.

She prepared the relevant materials and document checklist and put them into her briefcase.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

After dinner, she played with building blocks with her daughter Zhang Yuxin, while her mother sorted out craft materials nearby. The family atmosphere was warm.

When she said, "They think I'm not professional enough," her nose stung and she began to cry. Weiming didn't say much; he just gently held her, giving her a firm hug and encouragement. Yu Xiaowei resolved to focus all her energy on passing the CFP exam, first arming herself to the teeth.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

The sweat washed away the stress and pent-up frustration of the day.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description: After exercising, Yu Xiaowei took a hot shower and changed into comfortable cotton pajamas. After drying her hair, she poured a glass of warm water for her mother and watched a TV drama with her for a while, preparing for her evening study session.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Then she wrote down three key tasks for tomorrow: presenting the plan online to Wang Qiming at 10 a.m., visiting Chen Meiling at 2 p.m., and consolidating CFP Chapter 3 content. Then she turned off the light and went back to the bedroom to rest.

Then she did a 15-minute morning yoga session on the yoga mat in the bedroom, doing cat-cow and downward-facing dog poses to wake up her body, while quickly going over today's plan in her mind.

Su Lishan shared her "pain point sorting method". At 10:50, she attended an online meeting, and afterward had a private discussion with Guo Junwei from the product department to confirm the technical details of the cross-border medical insurance product. After the meeting ended at 11:30, she quickly noted down the key points of common customer questions and answers about the new product in her notebook, preparing for the afternoon client meetings.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (workstation, pantry, meeting room)

name: Lunch and self-review
description: She went alone to the cafe at Shui On Centre near her company and ordered a chicken salad and a Hong Kong-style milk tea. During lunch, she opened her notebook and briefly reviewed the client key points and product selling points sorted out in the morning to ensure a clear line of thinking for the afternoon communication.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 6-8 Harbour Road, 1st Floor, Shui On Centre, Shui On Centre Cafe

name: Preparing for an external visit and calling client Wang Qiming

At Chen Meiling's home, she warmly made tea for her. Yu Xiaowei first spent time helping her organize and analyze her existing family insurance policies, pointed out coverage gaps, then focused on recommending a savings dividend product suitable for retirement planning, and used an iPad to dynamically demonstrate the long-term returns. Chen Meiling showed interest and raised a question about capital liquidity. After answering them one by one, she said she would think it over for a few more days, but hoped Yu Xiaowei would prepare a detailed proposal.
location: Starting from AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, via Wan Chai Station and Tai Koo Station, to the home of Chen Meiling, Kam Tin Terrace, Taikoo Shing, Hong Kong

Also checked the traffic conditions in the direction of her mother-in-law's home in Kwun Tong, started tidying the desk at 17:30, and packed the computer and main documents into the briefcase.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: Left work on time at 17:30. To get to Kwun Tong as soon as possible, she took a taxi from downstairs at her company directly to her mother-in-law's home. On the way, she contacted family doctor Zhou Wenbin in advance, explained that her mother-in-law might have accidentally sprained herself, and asked for initial treatment advice. The whole trip took about 35 minutes, and she arrived at Jinqiao Building in Kwun Tong at 18:05. Going upstairs, she found that her mother-in-law's ankle was already red and swollen after a misstep. Following the doctor's advice, she immediately had her raise the injured foot and applied an ice pack from the first-aid kit, while comforting her and calling her husband Zhang Weiming. Her husband arrived from Kowloon Tong at about 19:00. After confirming no signs of fracture, Yu Xiaowei taught her husband the key follow-up care points, such as ice application within 24 hours and heat application afterward.
location: Took a taxi from AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to her mother-in-law Li Shufen's home at Golden Bridge Building, 25-41 Hong Ning Street, Ngau Tau Kok.

After confirming that her husband had prepared the quilt and pillow and reminding him again of the observation points, Yu Xiaowei took a taxi alone at 19:30 back to their home in Kowloon City, arriving around 20:10.
location: Taxi from Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, back to Prince Edward Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

With a touch of fatigue and anticipation for tomorrow, I fell deeply asleep around 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

After a quick wash, changed into yoga clothes, spread out the mat on the living room balcony, and did 20 minutes of morning yoga, focusing on stretching the shoulders, neck, and lower back to wake up the body.

Her mother Chen Meiling brought out a Hong Kong-style breakfast from the kitchen (ham macaroni, fried eggs, toast). The family of five sat around the table, and she reminded Xuanxuan to focus on teamwork and run more during the match. Xuanxuan nodded excitedly.

Midway through the match, Xuanxuan broke through on the right wing and delivered a precise assist that helped a teammate score with a header. The team won 2:1 in the end. After the final whistle, she excitedly ran to the sideline to high-five Xuanxuan and take photos. The child's face was full of sweat and pride.

She and her husband listened patiently, and Zhang Weiming encouraged his son, 'Be more decisive with your shots next time.' The warm yum cha atmosphere temporarily made her forget yesterday's fatigue. They settled the bill at 11:15 and prepared to leave after tidying up a bit.

Her husband tidied up briefly and left early at 12:15 p.m. Xuanxuan played with building blocks nearby.

Xuanxuan also shared his block construction from the afternoon.

After the story, she kissed her daughter's forehead.

On the way, Yu Xiaowei, in the passenger seat, used the memo app on her phone to record the key framework of the cross-border group insurance draft, including team size and coverage scope. Outside, the rain was gradually letting up, and her mood eased a little.

name: Heart-to-heart with my best friend over afternoon tea.
description: Met her best friend Lin Jiaxin at the Red Tea House restaurant on the 4th floor of Langham Place. After apologizing for being late, she poured out all her anxieties in one breath: the stress of accompanying her mother-in-law to the doctor, work pressure, and the worry of learning Japanese and studying for the CFP. Lin Jiaxin listened patiently and shared amusing stories about her students to cheer her up. The two drank silk-stocking milk tea and ate pineapple buns with butter in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Red Tea House Restaurant, 4/F, Langham Place, 8 Argyle Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Stress-relief shopping and joint planning
description: After afternoon tea, she strolled around Langham Place to aid digestion. She browsed ZARA and tried on a floral dress, but did not buy it because she felt it was not suitable for client visits. At UNIQLO, she bought one discounted cartoon T-shirt for her son and one for her daughter. While shopping, Yu Xiaowei suggested that they sign up for a weekend yoga workshop together next month. Lin Jiaxin agreed, and the two immediately searched for classes on their phones. They initially planned to sign up for the “Partner Yoga” experience class in mid-May.
location: ZARA and UNIQLO stores at Langham Place Mall, 8 Argyle Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Returning home
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Jiaxin, she took the MTR Kwun Tong Line back to Kowloon City. On the train, she put on earphones and listened to a 15-minute beginner Japanese podcast, getting into study mode early. The day's running around left her a little tired, but she felt much more relaxed than in the morning.
location: Hong Kong MTR Kwun Tong Line train

name: Help with household chores and prepare dinner
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei changed into loungewear. She first washed and hung up the new clothes she had bought for the children, then went into the kitchen to help her mother, Chen Meiling, trim vegetables and set out bowls and chopsticks. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin ran over to learn Cantonese embroidery, specifically the backstitch, and she took a moment to guide her through two stitches.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden Residential Estate)

name: Cozy family dinner and dreaming about travel plans.
description: During dinner, her husband called from Kwun Tong to say that his mother had already gone to sleep and he would be home late. At the dinner table, Yu Xiaowei formally proposed a family trip to Japan during the summer vacation, sharing that she was learning Japanese and could act as a little interpreter. The children excitedly discussed Tokyo Disneyland and Universal Studios, while her mother yearned for the temples and autumn leaves of Kyoto. The family initially decided to visit Kansai and Tokyo during the summer vacation.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden Residential Estate)

name: Parent-child time and the role of the father.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's weekend homework and patiently guided him through the math problems he had missed. Then she read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You with her daughter Zhang Yuxin. Touched, her daughter hugged her and said she loved her, and Yu Xiaowei felt her fatigue disappear. Afterwards, she sent a message to her husband to say that everything was fine at home and to reassure him to take good care of his mother.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden Residential Estate)

name: Studied time planning and prepared the study.
description: After putting the child to bed, Yu Xiaowei sat in the study and used the calendar app to make a detailed study schedule based on the newly registered Japanese classes (Monday and Wednesday evenings) and CFP study goals (Tuesday and Thursday evenings), and set phone reminders. At the same time, she texted her mother to ask if she could help look after the child on Monday and Wednesday evenings, and her mother readily agreed. After that, she tested the laptop camera and microphone to prepare for the next day's class.
location: Hong Kong SAR, China, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince's Building (Whampoa Garden residential estate), study.

name: Washing up, meditation, couple chat, and bedtime preparation
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Yu Xiaowei sat on the edge of the bed. Thinking about the day's anxiety, she downloaded the mindfulness meditation app Tide and followed the guide to do a 10-minute breathing meditation. Her thoughts gradually calmed and the tightness in her neck and shoulders eased. She decided to make meditation a long-term habit. Afterwards, her husband made a video call from Kwun Tong, and they briefly talked about his mother's condition and family arrangements. She told him to rest early. After hanging up, she did neck stretches, then dimmed the lights, put on a sleep mask, and prepared to sleep, saving energy for Monday.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building (Whampoa Garden residential estate), 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Morning mindfulness meditation
description: At 6 a.m., Xiaowei woke up, having woken early because she was worried about her mother-in-law's foot injury. Instead of doing her usual morning yoga, she sat on the bed and completed a 10-minute mindfulness meditation to steady herself and prepare for what could be a busy day. After meditating, she changed into loungewear and quietly left the bedroom.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare breakfast and family handover
description: Xiaowei and her mother Chen Meiling prepared breakfast together: toasted bread, warm milk, and scrambled eggs. Xiaowei told her mother about her mother-in-law's condition, and her mother comforted her and told her to go to work without worrying. After her husband Zhang Weiming came downstairs, Xiaowei spread strawberry jam on her daughter's toast and reminded her husband that he might need to pick up their son from school in the afternoon, while she would leave early for Kwun Tong to look after her mother-in-law. The family quickly finished breakfast.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to school and handle some errands.
