description: Xiaowei walked with an umbrella to take her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the kindergarten in Kowloon City. After dropping off her child, she called Teacher Li from the ballet studio at the kindergarten porch to apply for a two-week suspension of classes for her daughter due to a sprained ankle last week. Teacher Li agreed and deferred the lessons. Then she used a grocery shopping app to order fresh vegetables, lean meat, and soft bread for her mother-in-law, choosing afternoon delivery to the Kwun Tong address. She then called her mother to confirm picking up her daughter in the afternoon and asked her to practice basic ballet movements with her daughter.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the office in Wan Chai
description: Walked from the Kowloon City kindergarten to Whampoa MTR station and took the subway to Wan Chai. On the subway, Xiaowei used the time to mentally sort through the urgent work that needed handling in the morning, including the framework of Wang Qiming's group insurance draft and several client emails. After a smooth ride of about 40 minutes, she arrived at Wan Chai station and walked to AIA Building.
location: MTR route from Whampoa Station, Kowloon City District, to Wan Chai Station, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning office work.
description: Xiaowei arrived at her office in the AIA Building, brewed a cup of hot tea, and started working. She quickly skimmed all new emails and flagged two urgent ones: a client asking about claim details for a hospitalization rider and an internal compliance notice. She handled both within half an hour. Then she focused on preparing the coverage framework for Wang Qiming's cross-border group insurance draft, referencing similar cases in the company database. During a break, her colleague Su Lishan came over to chat about weekend anecdotes. Xiaowei mentioned that her mother-in-law had been injured, and Su Lishan expressed her sympathy. At 11:30 a.m., she did 3 sets of wall sits in the corner of the office as micro strength training.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and caring for mother-in-law
description: At noon, Xiaowei went alone to the cafe at Shui On Centre near her office and ordered a bowl of shrimp wonton noodles. During the meal, she called her mother-in-law to ask about the recovery of her foot injury. Her mother-in-law said she was better than yesterday and had applied the medicine on time. Xiaowei felt a little relieved and urged her mother-in-law to try not to get out of bed and to call anytime if anything came up.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 6-8 Harbour Road, Shui On Centre, café

name: Afternoon work and emergency plans
description: In the afternoon, she continued to refine the cross-border group insurance draft and replied to an old client's email about policy renewal. Considering that her mother-in-law was alone at home and might have difficulty moving around in the afternoon, Xiaowei packed her laptop and charger into her commuter bag in advance and sent a message to her direct supervisor, Liang Zhenhua, explaining that there was a family emergency and she might need to leave early, and that her current work had been arranged. The supervisor replied with approval and told her not to worry.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Emergency handling of mother-in-law's second injury
description: At 3:30 p.m., Xiaowei received an anxious phone call from her mother-in-law. While going to the bathroom, her mother-in-law had twisted her back due to unsteady footing and was in so much pain that she couldn't move. Xiaowei immediately calmed her down, quickly packed up, explained the situation to her supervisor, and took a taxi straight to Kwun Tong. In the car, she contacted the family doctor, Dr. Zhou. Dr. Zhou advised that if the skin was not broken but there was muscle spasm, she could first apply a medicated patch and lie flat to rest, and if the pain did not subside at night, she should be taken to the hospital.
location: In a taxi from Wan Chai District to Jinqiao Building in Kwun Tong District

name: Checked the injury and decided to stay overnight to provide care
description: Arrived at mother-in-law's home and found her lying sideways on the sofa, looking pained. Xiaowei examined her lower back, confirmed there was no redness, swelling, or injury, but the muscles were tense. She carefully helped her mother-in-law lie flat on the bed, found a medicated patch and applied it. She then texted her husband to explain the situation, decided to stay overnight to take care of her, and asked her husband to take care of the children at home.
location: Golden Bridge Building, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Temporary trip home to retrieve items and hand over matters
description: While her mother-in-law napped, Xiaowei took a taxi and quickly returned to her own home. Her husband had already picked up the two children. She briefly hugged her son and daughter, explained that Grandma needed care, and told the older brother to take care of his younger sister. After quickly packing a change of clothes, toiletry bag, laptop and charger, and handing over family matters to her husband, she took another taxi back to Kwun Tong.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Caring for mother-in-law and preparing dinner
description: Returned to Kwun Tong and found that her mother-in-law's back pain had eased a bit. Xiaowei poured her water and helped her to the toilet. Then she used the vegetables delivered from her afternoon order to make a light meal of plain rice porridge, steamed egg, and blanched greens. She helped her mother-in-law to the table, and the two had dinner together. After dinner, she cleaned up the dishes and set out bedding on the living room sofa so she could care for her close by.
location: Golden Bridge Building, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Settling in and preparing for class
description: Mother-in-law was resting on the sofa. Xiaowei opened her laptop, connected to the internet using her phone hotspot, entered the online classroom early, and tested the microphone and camera. She placed her phone within easy reach in case her mother-in-law called at any time. The rain outside the window was still falling.
location: Living room, Jinqiao Mansion, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Attended an online Japanese class
description: At 7:30 p.m., the beginner Japanese course began, covering the rows of the gojūon chart. Xiaowei wore earphones, followed along attentively, and took notes. During the class, her mother-in-law called her twice—once because she felt uncomfortable and needed to move, and once because she wanted water. Xiaowei muted the microphone to help, then quickly returned to the class. Despite the interruptions, she persisted until the end.
location: Living room, Golden Bridge Building, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (online course)

name: Core training in short bursts and meditation
description: After class, Xiaowei felt stiff in her shoulders. While her mother-in-law was watching TV, she did a 5-minute plank and 5 minutes of the bird-dog exercise on the living room floor. Then she put on earphones and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation in the corner of the sofa to release the day's tension and anxiety.
location: Living room, Jinqiao Mansion, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Settling mother-in-law and unproductive review
description: After the meditation, Xiaowei helped her mother-in-law wash up and supported her to lie down on the sofa. She tried to review the key chapters of her CFP investment planning notes, but because of the day's tension and fatigue, she was very unproductive. Her eyelids soon began to droop, and she finally gave up.
location: Golden Bridge Building, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and brief relaxation
description: After giving up on studying, Xiaowei tidied the coffee table, texted her husband to confirm that everything was fine at home and the children were asleep. She opened her phone and read an introductory tutorial on Cantonese embroidery for a brief relaxation. Finally, she turned off the main light in the living room, leaving only the night light, and lay down on the sofa bed.
location: Living room, Jinqiao Mansion, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Restless night's sleep
description: She lay on the sofa bed trying to fall asleep, but her heart was worried about her mother-in-law, so she slept restlessly. During the night she woke up several times to check on her mother-in-law. It was not until around 1:15 a.m., after confirming that her mother-in-law was sleeping peacefully, that she finally fell into a deep sleep in exhaustion.
location: Living room, Jinqiao Mansion, 25-41 Hong Ning Road, Ngau Tau Kok, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning getting up, preparing, and caring for mother-in-law
description: At 6:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei woke up on the sofa in her mother-in-law's home at Jinqiao Mansion, still feeling a sore neck. She first quietly checked on her mother-in-law and, after confirming she was asleep, washed up briefly in the bathroom and changed into professional attire. At 7 o'clock, her mother-in-law Li Shufen woke up. Yu Xiaowei helped her sit up slowly and carefully fed her the congee she had brought from their home in Whampoa. At the same time, she called her mother Chen Meiling to confirm that she would take her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin to school, and messaged her husband Zhang Weiming on WeChat to tell him his mother's condition was stable in the morning and to arrange the handover that evening.
location: Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to the office in Wan Chai
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to Kwun Tong MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she put on her earphones, set the CFP audio course to 1.2x speed, and listened attentively to the content on "retirement planning" for about 15 minutes.
location: Hong Kong SAR MTR (Kwun Tong Line to Island Line, from Kwun Tong Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Arrive at the office and socialize with colleagues
description: Arrived at the Immigration Tower at 7 Gloucester Road in Wan Chai, ran into colleague Su Lishan at the café downstairs, and the two bought coffee together before going upstairs. Yu Xiaowei sipped her coffee while browsing the latest company news of Shenzhen client Wang Qiming, warming up for the afternoon's work.
location: 8th floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the café downstairs

name: Attend team morning meeting
description: Attended the team morning meeting in Meeting Room B, hosted by Regional Director Liang Zhenhua, who shared the new quarter's goals and an update on a technology tool to improve customer service. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes. After the meeting, she briefly talked with Brother Hua about taking care of her mother-in-law. Brother Hua said he understood and reminded her to take good care of herself.
location: Meeting Room B, 8th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning work: commission received, transfer communication, and client follow-up
description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowei returned to her workstation, opened the company's commission system, carefully checked the details, and confirmed that the approximately HK$35,000 commission from the renewal of an old client signed in March and two new businesses had arrived on time. She took a screenshot and saved it, and quickly calculated the monthly performance gap. Then, using mobile banking, she transferred HK$30,000 to the family joint savings account, left HK$5,000 in demand deposit for daily advances, and discussed the commission allocation with her husband Zhang Weiming via WeChat: priority was to pay the HK$4,000 renewal fee for her daughter's ballet class, and the remainder was used for her mother-in-law's nutritional supplements and household expenses. After that, she focused on following up on client policy matters, checking health disclosures, printing proposals, sending a renewal reminder text message to client Mrs. Li, and setting a reminder to get up and stretch her shoulders and neck every hour.
location: Workstation, 8/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday phone call and fragmented training
description: To focus on the call and exercise, Yu Xiaowei went to the empty stairwell on the 15th floor of the company building. She first called her husband Zhang Weiming, and the two discussed in detail the specific allocation of the commission, deciding to prioritize paying the ballet class renewal fee. Her husband also reported on taking the children to school in the morning and going to his mother's home to assist with rehabilitation exercises. After about 15 minutes on the call, she used the stairwell and wall space to do 10 minutes of wall sits and bird-dog exercises.
location: Stairwell, 15th floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and short break.
description: At the Shui On Centre café near her company, Yu Xiaowei took out the mango and simple sandwich she had brought as lunch. While eating, she quickly scrolled through Xiaohongshu for Japan travel guides, looking for inspiration for next year's family plans. After lunch, she closed her eyes and rested for 10 minutes on the café sofa.
location: Coffee shop at Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon work, study, and team interaction
description: In the afternoon, she entered deep work time, and Yu Xiaowei focused on completing the needs analysis reports for two prospective clients. When she felt her concentration wavering, she used a recovery break to put on headphones and listen to about 15 minutes of a CFP audio course, “Risk Management and Insurance Planning.” At 4 pm, colleague Su Lishan organized afternoon tea and ordered pineapple buns with butter and iced milk tea. Yu Xiaowei joined the chat, which touched on popular movies and the weather. After the casual chat, she went to the window in the rest area and did neck and shoulder stretches for 5 minutes to relieve soreness from sitting for a long time. In the final work period, she filed the client follow-up reports, planned the client revisit route for the next day, and booked cervical physiotherapy for next Wednesday on her phone.
location: Office and rest area, 8th floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute to Whampoa
description: Left work on time. Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Wan Chai back to Whampoa. On the way, she didn't listen to audio; instead she let her mind wander and played a few old songs to relax.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region MTR (Island Line transfer to Kwun Tong Line, Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Temporary errand to collect items and visit the children
description: After arriving in Whampoa, Yu Xiaowei first went to the pharmacy at the Wonder World mall to buy herbal plasters and nutritional powder for her mother-in-law, then quickly returned home to Whampoa Garden. She briefly checked her son Xuanxuan's homework and hugged her daughter Xinxin. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared dinner, so she told her mother that she needed to eat quickly and then rush to Kwun Tong to take over the shift.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa New World shopping mall, and home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District.

name: Quick dinner and preparation for departure
description: Yu Xiaowei quickly ate the meal her mother had kept for her, packed her commuter bag with pain patches, a power bank, and CFP notes, hugged the children again, told her mother to rest early, and then prepared to drive to Kwun Tong.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drive to Kwun Tong.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove from Whampoa to her mother-in-law's home in Kwun Tong. On the way, she felt her neck soreness worsening and decided she must stretch well tonight.
location: On the drive from Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, to Golden Bridge Mansion, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong

name: Met husband downstairs at mother-in-law's home for the handover.
description: Her husband, Zhang Weiming, was already waiting downstairs at Jinqiao Mansion. The two quickly completed the handover. Mingzai told her that her mother-in-law had been in good spirits today and had eaten most of a bowl of congee for dinner, and he had already helped her move around. Yu Xiaowei thanked her husband, told him to go home early and rest, and said she would keep watch tonight.
location: At the ground floor of Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Evening care and companionship with mother-in-law
description: After going upstairs, Yu Xiaowei gently greeted her mother-in-law Li Shufen, helped her wash up, applied a new medicated patch, and prepared a glass of warm water to help her sleep. Then she sat by the bed and told her mother-in-law amusing anecdotes about Xuanxuan's day at school and showed her the drawing that Xinxin had made, making her mother-in-law laugh heartily.
location: Mother-in-law's home, Golden Bridge Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening self-improvement, exercise, and meditation.
description: After her mother-in-law fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei opened a portable table on the living room tea table and reviewed the CFP course content she had listened to that afternoon for 20 minutes. Then she spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did 10 minutes of core training (plank, supine leg raises) and 10 minutes of neck stretches and cat-cow yoga to relieve tension, then applied a pain patch. Finally, she put on headphones and used a meditation app for 15 minutes of guided mindfulness meditation. After finishing, she recorded in her health app: “Neck slightly stiff, patch applied, need to keep an eye on it,” and wrote in her diary: “The commission came in, and I can finally breathe. Seeing my mother-in-law's smile makes it all worth it.”
location: Living room, Kam Kiu Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Try to fall asleep
description: After making up the sofa bed, despite being physically exhausted, Yu Xiaowei kept planning tomorrow's schedule and her mother-in-law's follow-up appointment in her head. She tossed and turned repeatedly, and only slowly fell asleep at around 1:20 a.m.
location: Living room sofa, Golden Bridge Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Morning stretching and mood adjustment
description: After being woken by the sound of rain outside the window, Yu Xiaowei canceled her outdoor morning run. Instead, she did 10 minutes of gentle neck and shoulder stretches on a yoga mat in the bedroom to relieve the stiffness from sleeping on the sofa at her mother-in-law's house in Kwun Tong the night before. She then checked the weather forecast on her phone and confirmed that humidity was high that day.
location: Home bedroom, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing breakfast and interacting with family
description: After changing into loungewear, Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen, toasted pineapple buns, chopped barbecue pork and mixed it into scrambled eggs, and heated milk. Her mother, Chen Meiling, got up to help. As the family of four sat down for breakfast, she reminded the children to bring their raincoats, and her husband, Zhang Weiming, said he would drop them off at the school bus stop on his way.
location: Kitchen and dining room of home, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Send the children onto the school bus.
description: Yu Xiaowei held an umbrella and, together with her husband, walked the two children to the school bus stop downstairs. She reminded her daughter to pack her ballet class clothes, helped her son organize his schoolbag, and watched the school bus leave before saying goodbye to her husband and setting off for the office.
location: School bus stop downstairs at Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to company
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from Whampoa Garden to Whampoa MTR Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line and transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then walked to the AIA Building in Wan Chai District. On the way, she listened to the CFP risk management chapter audio on her phone, and used the standing time to do neck lateral flexion stretches. She arrived about 50 minutes later, and the rain was gradually easing.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: from Whampoa Station in Kowloon City District to AIA Building in Wan Chai District (via MTR).

name: Company morning meeting and work handover
description: After brewing Hong Kong-style milk tea in the pantry, Yu Xiaowei attended the team morning meeting hosted by regional director Liang Zhenhua, where they discussed follow-up strategies for high-net-worth clients. After the meeting, she handed over to her colleague Su Lishan the file of a family client whose policy was about to be renewed, and asked Su Lishan to make a routine phone follow-up the next day.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Received news of her mother-in-law's sprain and dealt with it promptly.
description: Just after finishing the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowei received a call from her mother-in-law's neighbor in Kwun Tong, learning that her mother-in-law, Li Shufen, had slipped and sprained her left ankle while mopping the floor at home. She immediately contacted her husband, Zhang Weiming, asking him to go over and check first. She also asked for leave from her team and changed all of the day's scheduled client visits to online communication.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Drove to Kwun Tong and comforted mother-in-law.
description: Yu Xiaowei quickly went downstairs to get the car and drove from Wan Chai to Kwun Tong. On the way, she called her mother-in-law to reassure her and told her that she had made an outpatient appointment at the United Christian Hospital orthopedic clinic through a mobile app. After arriving at Jinqiao Huaxia Building in Kwun Tong, she saw that her mother-in-law's ankle was clearly swollen, so she helped her downstairs and into the car.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: en route by car from AIA Building, Wan Chai District, to Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District.

name: Accompanying mother-in-law to a medical appointment.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove her mother-in-law to the orthopaedic outpatient clinic at United Christian Hospital. The doctor diagnosed a mild tear of the lateral ankle ligament, advised immobilization and rest, and prescribed anti-inflammatory medication and pain-relief patches. She carefully noted the doctor's instructions, picked up the medication, and then drove her mother-in-law back home at Jinqiao Huaxia.
location: Orthopaedic Outpatient Clinic, United Christian Hospital, 130 Hip Wo Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare lunch and accompany mother-in-law for her meal and medication
description: After settling her mother-in-law on the sofa, Yu Xiaowei made a clear soup with lean pork and fuzzy melon, and steamed rice and egg custard. While waiting, she did three sets of wall sits and applied a hot towel to her neck. When lunch was ready, she helped her mother-in-law to the table, accompanied her through a slow meal, and made sure she took her midday medication. After the meal, she wiped her mother-in-law's face, helped her back to the bedroom for a nap, and placed a glass of water, medication, and the cane by the bedside.
location: The kitchen, dining room, and bedroom of mother-in-law's home, Golden Bridge Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Working from home handling client matters
description: After her mother-in-law took a nap, Yu Xiaowei opened her laptop in the living room of her mother-in-law's home to work. She replied to five clients' policy inquiry emails, sent a briefing to her superior Liang Zhenhua explaining that she would need flexible working hours for the coming week, and reminded her colleague Su Lishan via WeChat Work to follow up with a local renewal client.
location: Grandmother's living room, Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Reassuring a client who cancelled via video call and managing professional emotions
description: High-net-worth client Mrs. Wang requested to withdraw a HK$500,000 savings insurance policy due to market fluctuations. Yu Xiaowei went to the balcony and communicated patiently by video, explaining the value of the policy from the perspective of defensive family asset allocation. After nearly 40 minutes of persuasion, she successfully kept the policy. After hanging up, feeling exhausted, Yu Xiaowei took a deep breath and drank warm water to regulate her emotions.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kam Kiu Building, balcony at mother-in-law's home.

name: Handle the renewal of daughter's ballet class fees
description: Yu Xiaowei transferred 4,000 Hong Kong dollars from the family savings account to Wuyue Ballet Studio via online banking to renew her daughter Zhang Yuxin's ballet class fees, and sent a message in the family group chat to inform her husband that the payment was made, reminding him to resume pickups and drop-offs next week.
location: Grandmother's living room, Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare dinner for her mother-in-law
description: While her mother-in-law was still taking a nap, Yu Xiaowei cooked fish porridge with the fish fillets and greens in the fridge, and stir-fried a plate of choy sum, ensuring dinner was light and easy to digest, suitable for her mother-in-law's recovery needs.
location: Kitchen at the mother-in-law's home, Golden Bridge Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Having dinner with mother-in-law and evening care.
description: After her mother-in-law woke up from her afternoon nap, Yu Xiaowei helped her to the dining table to slowly eat fish slice congee and choy sum. After the meal, she used a warm towel to wipe her mother-in-law down, changed her into clean pajamas, checked that her ankle was not abnormally swollen, placed the medicine, cane, and night light by the bedside, and reminded her to be careful when getting up at night.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kam Kiu Building, grandmother's home restaurant and bedroom

name: Requesting leave from Japanese class and brief self-study
description: Yu Xiaowei asked for leave from her Japanese teacher via WeChat, explaining that there was a family emergency, and requested the course replay link. At 7 p.m. she opened the recorded lesson to study, but because she was tired from the whole day, she felt sleepy after watching only 10 minutes and decided to give up.
location: Grandmother's living room, Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leaving Kwun Tong and heading home.
description: After saying goodbye to her mother-in-law, Yu Xiaowei drove from Kwun Tong back to Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District. On the way, she called her mother Chen Meiling via car Bluetooth, explained her mother-in-law's condition, and asked her mother to help prepare the children's lunch boxes the next morning. Her mother readily agreed.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from Jinqiao Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District (while driving)

name: Returning home and greeting family
description: Yu Xiaowei returned home to Whampoa Garden at around 8 p.m., found her mother Chen Meiling watching TV in the living room, and learned that the children had already bathed and gone to sleep. She hugged her mother, thanked her again for helping, briefly shared the details of her mother-in-law's injury, and reassured her once she confirmed the situation was stable.
location: At home, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and neck relaxation
description: Yu Xiaowei washed up quietly, changed into loose loungewear, applied a hot pack to her stiff neck for ten minutes in the living room, and did several slow stretches in all directions to relieve the fatigue accumulated throughout the day.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Plan tomorrow's to-do list.
description: Yu Xiaowei used a notebook and pen and, on the living room sofa, wrote down the next day's plan: contact Kwun Tong Grace Community Physiotherapy Centre to book an in-home rehabilitation visit, go to Whampoa New City during the lunch break to buy a bath bench and a non-slip grab bar for her mother-in-law, and do an online insurance policy review with client Mr. Wang in the afternoon.
location: Living room at home, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Yu Xiaowei sent a message to her husband Zhang Weiming to let him know she had arrived home safely and to confirm the arrangements for picking up and dropping off the children the next day. After getting an affirmative reply, she set an alarm for 6:30 a.m. the next morning, turned off the light, and lay down. Reviewing the day, although she was tired, family and work were temporarily stable, so she felt at peace and slowly fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and getting the children ready for school.
description: After the 6:00 alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei did 5 minutes of gentle neck stretches in bed, then practiced about 25 minutes of home yoga in the living room (Sun Salutation A/B, Bird-Dog, and Cat-Cow poses) to activate her core. After drinking a glass of warm water, she quickly browsed and replied to 3 client inquiries left unanswered last night on her phone, checked the progress of the medical insurance claim, and left a message to inform the client that she was following up. Then she prepared breakfast for the children with her mother Chen Meiling (fried eggs, milk, whole-wheat bread), helped her daughter Xin Xin tie neat braids, and reminded her son Xuan Xuan to put the cleats and shin guards for the afternoon football class into the inner pocket of his schoolbag. At 7:15, she went downstairs with her mother and the children to the school bus stop at the Tak Hong Street intersection outside Whampoa Garden, and told them to bring umbrellas for the cloudy showery weather. After watching the school bus leave, her mother went to the market to buy groceries.
location: A residential block in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and the school bus stop at the corner of Tak Hong Street

name: Fragmented learning and planning on the commute
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to Whampoa MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station, taking about 45 minutes in total. During the commute, she reviewed the "Liability Risk" and "Personal Risk" chapters of CFP risk management on a mobile app, completed 10 practice questions, and in her memo listed the assistive devices to buy at Watsons in the afternoon: a shower bench and a no-drill anti-slip grab bar.
location: MTR (from Whampoa Station in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Wan Chai Station in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, via the Kwun Tong Line, transferring to the Island Line).

name: Arrival preparation and early-morning communication
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the AIA Building office, first went to the pantry to make coffee, and then organized the client files left unfinished from yesterday. Her colleague Su Lishan quietly handed her a box of pain relief patches, concerned about her stiff neck, and said it was an effective product her husband had used. Yu Xiaowei accepted them gratefully, and the two briefly exchanged updates on client follow-ups.
location: Office at AIA Tower, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Team weekly meeting
description: Yu Xiaowei attended the weekly team meeting on Thursday. Her supervisor Liang Zhenhua summarized last week's performance and announced the company's new incentive policy for high-net-worth clients. He specifically asked Yu Xiaowei about the progress of the "cross-border group insurance" plan for her client Wang Qiming. Yu Xiaowei said frankly that her family had just experienced an incident in Kwun Tong and she needed a short period of flexible family time, and she promised to submit the draft by next Wednesday at the latest. Liang Zhenhua expressed understanding and suggested she delegate some of the local client maintenance work to Su Lishan to ease her burden.
location: Meeting room, AIA Building, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Focusing on work and client proposals
description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei first sent a WeChat message to client Wang Qiming to schedule an online policy review at 4:00 p.m., briefly explaining that the proposal was still being refined. Then she devoted herself fully to drafting the promotional materials for the group accident insurance plan for small and medium-sized enterprise owners, incorporating the latest market cases shared by Liang Zhenhua and annotating the clauses suitable for technology companies.
location: Office at AIA Tower, 1 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Midday wayfinding and Japanese study
description: Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan walked to Qianghong Specialty Cafe and quickly finished a bowl of shrimp wonton noodles. While eating, she called the Japanese language training school to ask about joining the class mid-term. After learning that the spots were full, she decided to continue with the remote playback plus daily fragmented listening to NHK news, and wrote a reminder in her memo: '15 minutes of Japanese every day.' After the meal, she didn't rush back to the office. In the corner of the restaurant, she used the app to listen intermittently to a 10-minute replay lesson.
location: Qianghong Specialty Tea Restaurant, F1, Wan Chai Commercial Centre, 194-204 Johnston Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Pharmacy shopping and heading to Kwun Tong
description: Yu Xiaowei walked about 16 minutes from the tea restaurant to Watsons in Causeway Bay (Park Lane Hotel branch). In the assistive devices section, she carefully compared the seat height and anti-slip performance of shower stools from different brands, and finally chose a foldable shower stool and a set of drill-free anti-slip grab bars (with adhesive pads), and asked how to use them. After paying around 13:15, she walked to MTR Wan Chai Station, took the Island Line and transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Kwun Tong Station, the whole journey taking about 35-40 minutes.
location: Watsons (Park Lane Hotel branch), No. 22 Paterson Street, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, and MTR train carriage from Wan Chai Station to Kwun Tong Station

name: Kwun Tong caregiving and preparation for the online meeting
description: Arrived at mother-in-law Li Shufen's home at 14:00. Yu Xiaowei first installed the newly bought shower stool and a simple non-slip grab bar, using the existing tiled wall, and taught her mother-in-law how to use them. Then she settled her mother-in-law for an afternoon nap and opened her laptop at the dining table to finish the remaining part of the group accident insurance promotional materials. After her mother-in-law woke up at 15:20, she helped her to the bathroom and heated up the papaya and snow fungus dessert sent by her mother. During breaks in the care, she placed a rolled towel under her neck and did a two-minute static stretch to relieve neck soreness.
location: A unit in Lee Cheung House, Shun Lee Estate, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong

name: Client online policy review.
description: Yu Xiaowei had a WeChat video conference with her client Wang Qiming on time. She introduced the framework of the group accident insurance plan concisely, highlighting coverage for the overtime work and business travel risks common in technology companies. Mr. Wang expressed satisfaction and raised detailed questions about expanding outpatient medical coverage. She noted each one down and agreed to provide a complete plan next week.
location: A flat in Lei Cheung House, Shun Lee Estate, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong (grandmother's home)

name: Contact rehabilitation services and fragmented care.
description: After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei called the Kwun Tong Enci Community Physiotherapy Centre to book a weekend home rehabilitation assessment service and confirmed the fee and time. Afterwards, she reheated soup for her mother-in-law and watched TV news with her for a while. Taking advantage of her mother-in-law's rest break, she took out her phone and did a 5-minute seated core tightening exercise.
location: A unit in Lee Cheung House, Shun Lee Estate, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong

name: Family relay and commute home.
description: After work, her husband Zhang Weiming came directly to his mother's home. Yu Xiaowei carefully explained her mother-in-law's medication schedule, the use of the new assistive devices, and the home physical therapy appointment time. Zhang Weiming packed up some of the food his mother had made for Yu Xiaowei to take home. Remembering that she had not yet eaten lunch, Yu Xiaowei took the lunchbox, said goodbye to her mother-in-law and husband at 18:00, and took the MTR from Kwun Tong station back to Whampoa station.
location: From Lei Cheung House, Shun Lee Estate, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, via MTR Kwun Tong Station to Whampoa Station

name: Evening family dinner and quality time with the children
description: After arriving home, her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared home-style dishes such as steamed fish and stir-fried choy sum. While eating dinner with her mother, Yu Xiaowei listened to her daughter Xinxin excitedly show off her 'Little Park' craft made with stickers at school, and her son Xuanxuan added funny stories from his football training. After dinner, she helped finish her daughter's craft, checked her son's math homework and signed it. At 20:00, she played with LEGO with the children and told her daughter the bedtime story 'The Little Prince.' After the children quieted down, she went to the kitchen to help her mother wash the dishes and talked about the recent situation of her mother-in-law and father. Her mother comforted her not to worry too much, saying that Dad was just overthinking and that she had everything under control.
location: A residence in a certain block of Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (living room, dining room, children's room)

name: Self-recharge and silhouette practice.
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei sat in the study and, feeling that she had reached her physical limit, decided to skip the Japanese class replay. She opened the images of Cantonese embroidery works saved on her phone, took out a pencil and a sketchbook, and spent 20 minutes copying a line drawing of "Lingnan Kapok" to relax. She then spent 15 minutes recalling the requirements of Wang Qiming's proposal and wrote down the key points to add next week in her notebook.
location: A study room in a residence at Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Brother's warning and bedtime preparations
description: Her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng called from Shenzhen by video. After some casual chat, he changed the subject and said that their father Yu Guoqiang had lately been asking relatives about investments everywhere and seemed unusually excited, asking Yu Xiaowei if she knew anything. Yu Xiaowei's heart tightened. She said she hadn't noticed because she had been busy with her mother-in-law's matters, and promised to ask their mother indirectly when she had the chance. After hanging up, she quietly made a note of it and planned to sound things out when she went home at the weekend. Before bed, she did 5 minutes of mindful breathing meditation in the bedroom, felt warmth in her neck, set the alarm for 6:15 the next day, and wrote tomorrow's to-do list in her memo: 1. Update Liang Zhenhua on the progress of Mr. Wang's proposal; 2. Ask her mother about father's investment. She turned off the lights and went to sleep at 22:10.
location: A residence in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (study and bedroom)

name: Morning self-adjustment and reflection on transforming the learning model
description: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowei woke up on the folding bed in the living room at her mother-in-law's house. After the alarm rang, she did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches to shake off the drowsiness from lack of sleep. Then she opened Notes on her phone and, following the fragmented learning plan agreed upon with her husband the day before, downloaded the Duolingo app, planned to memorize 15 Japanese kana on the commute, and used her phone to draft an email to the Japanese language training institution to postpone the course, pausing the systematic classes in favor of self-study in fragments. Outside the window it was cloudy with some sun, temperature around 25°C.
location: Living room of mother-in-law's home on Wai Yip Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Deliver breakfast and arrange daytime care for mother-in-law
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowei prepared a simple breakfast for her mother-in-law Li Shufen, including instant oatmeal, hot milk, and half a banana. While her mother-in-law was eating, she called the neighbor Mrs. He, who agreed to come at 10 a.m. to help look after her mother-in-law for two hours. Yu Xiaowei put a note with her own phone number and the family doctor's number under the glass on the coffee table, told her mother-in-law to call anytime if anything came up, and then packed her things.
location: Kitchen and living room of mother-in-law's home on Wai Yip Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Fragmented learning during the commute home
description: Yu Xiaowei left her mother-in-law's home and bought a cocktail bun and a carton of lemon tea at the corner bakery as breakfast. She walked 3 minutes to Kwun Tong Bus Terminus and took Tunnel Bus Route 107 toward Hung Hom, a journey of about 30 minutes. On the way, she opened the Duolingo app and recited 15 kana (row by row), and sent an email to the Japanese language training institution requesting a course postponement.
location: Bus route from Wai Yip Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District; board at Kwun Tong Bus Terminus.

name: Organizing client materials and preparing insurance plans at home
description: Yu Xiaowei returned home at No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District. She quickly changed out of her coat and sat down at the computer. After drinking some lemon tea to calm herself, she began organizing the information of the four renewal policy clients she needed to contact today (Mrs. Chen, Mr. Wang, etc.). Then she carefully reviewed the electronic materials of client Wang Qiming and wrote down in her notebook a rough framework for the annuity withdrawal plan and the critical illness insurance sum assured design adjustment, preparing for the proposal to be submitted next week. Only then did she eat the cocktail bun at ease.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family communication and cat-proofing check
description: While her family was busy, Yu Xiaowei called her mother, Chen Meiling, and lowered her voice to remind her to keep her father steady and not let him transfer money. She then checked all the door and window locks around the house to make sure there were no gaps. Soon her father, Yu Guoqiang, came over from Kowloon City, pulled her onto the balcony, and showed her a wealth-management project brochure with an annualized return of 12%. Yu Xiaowei glanced through it quickly and spotted red flags such as "local infrastructure", "private equity fund", and "no filing". Alarm bells rang in her mind, but she still smiled, accepted the materials, and kept her father calm by saying she needed to study them.
location: Living room and balcony of the home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Client phone follow-up and policy review
description: After her father left, Yu Xiaowei returned to the sofa in the living room and called four long-standing clients one by one. In a gentle, professional tone, she reminded them of renewal deadlines and policy reviews amid market volatility, emphasizing the advantage of the changes in Hong Kong dollar interest rates and the policy's interest-lock clause. In between calls, she texted her close friend Lin Jiaxin to tell her she couldn't make the afternoon appointment and briefly mentioned her father's matter.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Fatty the cat went missing and an urgent search was carried out.
description: After hanging up the phone, Yu Xiaowei walked to the entrance and found the front door ajar by a palm-width gap. She rushed into the living room and saw that the bed of the orange tabby cat, Fatty, was empty. She called her husband Zhang Weiming, and the two confirmed the cat was missing. Just then, their two children, Xuanxuan and Xinxin, came home and cried in panic. The whole family divided the tasks: Zhang Weiming posted a notice in the property owners' group, Yu Xiaowei handwrote 10 lost-cat notices and posted them at the elevator entrance, the bulletin board, the convenience store entrance, the garden pavilion, and other places. Then the whole family conducted a thorough search in the corridors, fire escape routes, and the estate gardens. Yu Xiaowei walked quickly nearly 10,000 steps.
location: Inside and around Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Expanding the cat search scope and wrapping up midday work
description: Because they could not find Fatty in the estate, Yu Xiaowei and her husband expanded the search to the adjacent estate, a 5-minute walk away. Zhang Weiming continued posting information on social media, while Yu Xiaowei put up 5 homemade notices in the stairwells and garden of the adjacent estate. Anxiety mixed with guilt made her almost forget to eat lunch. After returning home at 13:00, she drank a large glass of plain water, then opened her computer to record the key points from the morning's client phone calls into the company system and file the Japanese course postponement email.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate and the neighboring estate

name: Midday rest and adjustment of cat-finding strategy
description: Exhausted, Yu Xiaowei sat in the living room, staring blankly at the empty cat bed. She decided to place a cardboard cat shelter at the entrance of the ground-floor corridor. She cut an arched doorway in a sturdy cardboard box, lined it with the small blanket Fei Zai often used, put in its favorite cat treats, and attached a note: “Cat, please come home. Your family is waiting for you.” At the same time, she set an alarm on her phone for 6:00 the next morning to remind herself to search the neighboring residential area again.
location: Home and ground-floor hallway, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery relaxation and cat-finding strategy discussion
description: To calm her anxiety, Yu Xiaowei took out her embroidery frame and copied the magnolia leaves from the new embroidery pattern, trying to use the "rolling needle" technique, keeping the stitches smooth and even. After embroidering for about 15 minutes, she felt a little calmer. She sent a WeChat message to her husband Zhang Weiming, suggesting they go together the next morning to the neighboring residential complex and nearby shops to ask for news of Fatty. Her husband agreed.
location: Study at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Home safety reinforcement and enhanced cat-proofing measures
description: Yu Xiaowei first called her mother and stressed again that Father must not be allowed to transfer money. Then she and her husband checked all the window screens at home and tightened the loose clasps with a screwdriver. At the door, she used a delivery cardboard box to make a sturdier removable door stop, ensuring there were no more large gaps. Through these actions, her sense of family security recovered somewhat.
location: Various places at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assisting with dinner and husband's thoughtful arrangements
description: Mother Chen Meiling prepared dinner, and Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to help wash and cut vegetables in the kitchen. The family sat together for dinner, and the atmosphere was slightly more relaxed than at noon. Zhang Weiming offered to deliver tonight's and the next two days' dinners to his mother in Kwun Tong himself, so that Yu Xiaowei could stay home and focus on the cat and her emotions. The two children also promised to continue looking for Fatty in the neighborhood tomorrow.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Had a brief heart-to-heart with her mother
description: As she was washing the dishes after dinner, her mother came into the kitchen and gently comforted Yu Xiaowei, saying that Chubby was smart and had probably gone out for a stroll; when he got hungry at night, he would naturally come back. Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to remind her mother again that her father's investment must absolutely not be touched, and that she would personally deal with it again the next day. The mother and daughter talked over the sound of running water, and Yu Xiaowei's agitation settled considerably.
location: Home kitchen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tutoring children with schoolwork and parent-child time
description: Yu Xiaowei sat down next to her son Zhang Zixuan and patiently helped him finish his math and English homework, focusing on correcting fraction calculation problems. Afterwards, she played with LEGO with her daughter Zhang Yuxin and listened to her tell stories about kindergarten. She tried to look relaxed, not letting her anxiety affect the children.
location: Study and living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime check and couple talk
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming sat on the living room sofa and talked in low voices. She explained in detail the risks of her father's investment and the details of today's cat search. Her husband shared a lead he saw in the owners' group, saying someone had seen an orange cat in the neighboring residential complex in the evening, and comforted her that they could go look again tomorrow. The two encouraged each other and felt a little burden lifted.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bed preparation, emotional settling, and falling asleep.
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowei lay in bed and opened her phone to check the cat-finding group chat; there were no new messages. She did a 5-minute mindfulness breathing exercise to regulate her heart rate and let her anxiety slowly settle. She set the alarm for 6 a.m. tomorrow. She was worried about Fatty and her father's investments, but she also knew she had done her best today. She turned off the light, closed her eyes, and tried to fall asleep, feeling somewhat calmer and believing tomorrow would be better.
location: Bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up in the morning and having a simple breakfast.
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up after the 7:00 alarm went off. She felt somewhat heavy-hearted thinking about the missing cat Feizai, but decided to perk up. After washing up, she made instant coffee in the kitchen and had the leftover pineapple bun from last night as breakfast. Her husband Zhang Weiming also got up, and the two quietly discussed the cat search, deciding to expand the scope after returning from Kwun Tong.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-departure preparation and pickup
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei changed into a light T-shirt and trousers and put on her tote bag. Before going out, she went to the lobby mailbox downstairs and took out the latest issue of Hong Kong Runner magazine, planning to bring it to her mother-in-law. She took a photo of the morning neighborhood and sent it to the family group chat with the caption The weather is nice today, hope there's good news, hoping that her mother-in-law's ankle would heal soon and also thinking about Fatty.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family set off for Kwun Tong to visit mother-in-law.
description: Yu Xiaowei went upstairs and woke the two children, Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin, and helped them put on their coats. The family of four walked about five minutes to Whampoa Garden bus terminus and boarded the 11B/X bus heading to Kwun Tong. On the bus, Xuanxuan and Xinxin asked about Feizai. Yu Xiaowei patiently explained that Feizai might have wandered off because he was being playful, but that she would try hard to find him, and reminded them to keep their great-grandma company. The children started chatting about next week's spring outing, and the mood eased.
location: Bus route 11B/X from Kowloon City District to Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Arrived at mother-in-law's home and divided up tasks
description: Arrived in Kwun Tong at about 9:05 and walked 5 minutes to her mother-in-law Li Shufen's home at Jinqiao Building. Her mother-in-law was already at the door with a cane to greet her and looked well. Yu Xiaowei carefully checked her mother-in-law's ankle and found that the swelling had gone down a lot, and she breathed a sigh of relief. She asked her husband Zhang Weiming to take their daughter Zhang Yuxin downstairs to the street market to buy groceries, while she and her son Zhang Zixuan helped her mother-in-law back into the house and handed her the copy of Hong Kong Runner magazine she had brought.
location: Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Husband prepared lunch; Yu Xiaowei tidied up and cleaned the house.
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming simmered a pork bone soup with carrot and green radish in the kitchen and steamed pork ribs. Yu Xiaowei began helping her mother-in-law clean the house: first she organized the wardrobe, packed the heavy winter clothes into compression bags, and swapped in everyday spring clothes; then she removed the living room sofa cover and bedroom sheets and put them in the washing machine. While cleaning, she kept her activity level in mind and deliberately did a few squats and calf raises, working up a light sweat.
location: Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Having lunch with the whole family and checking on my mother-in-law's injury
description: At 12:30 noon, the family sat around the dining table, with steaming hot pork bone soup with green radish and carrot, steamed pork ribs, and stir-fried choy sum on the table. Her mother-in-law took a sip of the soup and was full of praise, in a great mood. During the meal, Yu Xiaowei carefully observed her mother-in-law's ankle and confirmed there was no new swelling or pain, which made her feel more at ease.
location: Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon rest and household chores.
description: After the meal, the children Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin sat with Grandma in the living room, flipping through Hong Kong Runner magazine and pointing at running photos while asking questions nonstop. Yu Xiaowei cleared the dishes, then tidied the kitchen and the storage cabinet, sorted her mother-in-law's regular medications into a pillbox by morning, noon, and evening, and labeled them. Her husband Zhang Weiming found the dining room chandelier switch was not working properly, so he went downstairs to the nearby hardware store, bought new parts, and spent over an hour repairing and checking the circuit. Yu Xiaowei, meanwhile, combed her daughter's hair in the living room and did some doodling with her.
location: Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Teach mother-in-law rehabilitation exercises and entrust her to the neighbors.
description: At 4:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei searched on her phone for an ankle rehabilitation video and personally taught her mother-in-law to do the “toe grip” and “ankle circles” exercises. Her mother-in-law smiled and said it was troublesome, but still cooperated. She set a small goal of “three times a day, five minutes each time,” wrote it on a sticky note, and stuck it on the refrigerator door. Before leaving, Yu Xiaowei knocked on her neighbor Mrs. He's door and asked her to help look after her mother-in-law during the day. Mrs. He readily agreed.
location: Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Return trip and dinner on the way
description: At 5:30 p.m., the family of four said goodbye to grandma and walked to the bus stop to catch a bus back to Whampoa. The children fell asleep on the bus. They arrived at Whampoa Garden at about 6:10. Because lunch had been hearty, Yu Xiaowei suggested going to the nearby New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese restaurant for a simple dinner. It was about a 4-minute walk. They ordered wonton noodles, beef brisket rice, and iced lemon tea. After eating, they walked home.
location: New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant, 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Report safety to mother and search for the cat in the evening
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei first called her mother, Chen Meiling, to report that her mother-in-law was recovering well and the whole family had a harmonious day. After hanging up, she changed into running shoes and a thin jacket, went downstairs alone to search for the cat over a wider area. She carefully checked the community green belts, the parking lot, and the garbage station, and also went to the garden in the neighboring community where Fatty usually sunbathes. She called the cat's name and shone a flashlight into the bushes, but found nothing.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate and surrounding areas

name: Online contact and personal relaxation
description: Returning home with a trace of loss, Yu Xiaowei updated the lost-cat posts in her family group chat and social group with a photo and description of the cat's traits. Then, seeing the encouraging message from her running friend Shen Peiwen, she briefly replied: “Thanks Awen. I accompanied my mother-in-law today, and my ankle is much better. Once everything is settled, let's arrange a Wednesday night run again!” Afterward, she brewed a cup of pu'er tea and flipped through Hong Kong Runner magazine to relax her tense nerves.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and pre-sleep relaxation.
description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowei did a 5-minute deep-breathing relaxation exercise to momentarily put aside the day's busyness and worries. She set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning and put her phone on silent. After turning off the light, she said softly to her husband, "Fatty will definitely come back," and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up naturally and having breakfast with the family.
description: Waking naturally in the warm Sunday sunshine, you walk out of the bedroom to find your mother, Chen Meiling, has prepared traditional rice porridge and stir-fried noodles. Your father, Yu Guoqiang, is reading the newspaper on the balcony. The children, for once not sleeping in, are playfully messing around at the dining table. As you sip the rice porridge, you listen to your mother chattering about what she saw at the market yesterday. Your eyes sweep over Fatty's empty bowl by the kitchen door, and a trace of expectation and disappointment rises in your heart.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning chores and children's homework guidance
description: After breakfast, you quickly switched into weekend housekeeper mode. First you put a week's worth of accumulated workout clothes and a few of the children's school uniforms into the washing machine. Then you checked your son Zhang Zixuan's weekend math homework, found a few word problems he couldn't solve, and patiently explained them using diagrams. Meanwhile, your daughter Zhang Yuxin was imitating a teacher beside you, pointing a toy pointer at the pinyin cards on the wall and babbling as if teaching you.
location: Living room, balcony, and son's room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal relaxation and information browsing
description: With the housework done for the moment, the children went to watch cartoons. You made yourself a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea and curled up on the living room sofa scrolling through your phone. You specifically opened the cat-finding post in the social group; apart from a few comforting messages from friends, there were no new useful clues. You also saw your running buddy Shen Peiwen sharing her morning jog route along the waterfront promenade at 7 a.m., with the caption “Morning 10K, awesome!” It left you both envious and helpless. Your feet itched a little, but you held back.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Had a private talk with mother in the kitchen, prepared lunch
description: You go into the kitchen on your own to help your mother prepare lunch. You are making steamed grass carp, garlic choy sum, and your father's favorite braised pork belly with preserved mustard greens. As you trim the vegetables, you cautiously ask about your father's recent state. Your mother sighs and lowers her voice to tell you that after your father tried to buy his grandson a new game console with his pension last month and was rejected, he kept saying he was old and useless. This investment was his way of proving he could still contribute to the family. You feel a pang in your heart, but you don't say anything more, just silently wash the preserved mustard greens especially carefully.
location: Kitchen at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family lunch.
description: The whole family sat together eating lunch. At the table, her father Yu Guoqiang was quieter than usual. You took the initiative to put a piece of pork belly with preserved mustard greens into his bowl, and only then did a barely noticeable smile appear on his face. The children chattered about funny things at school, easing the subtle awkwardness at the table. You knew clearly that the tough battle in the afternoon was coming.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family time and a midday nap
description: After lunch, you accompanied the two children in building with LEGO blocks. Zixuan wanted to build a space station, while Yuxin wanted to build a princess castle, and they started arguing. As the peace ambassador, you calmed both sides and guided them to cooperate, suggesting they build a space castle. More than half an hour later, the children were tired, so you arranged for them to read picture books on the sofa, and you went back to the bedroom to rest with your eyes closed for 20 minutes, building up energy for the afternoon negotiation.
location: Living room and respective bedrooms at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling father's investment request (core negotiation)
description: At 2 p.m., your father indeed called you to the living room and took out the materials for the infrastructure private placement project. In a firm tone, he hoped you would support it with 150,000 Hong Kong dollars. You sighed inwardly but tried to keep your expression calm. You remembered what your mother said about wanting to prove herself, so instead of refusing directly, you used professional phrasing: “Dad, I understand you want to help with the family finances. But as an insurance agent, I am especially sensitive to the risks of this kind of non-standard investment. With such a large amount of money, I need to look at the terms carefully and also discuss it with Weiming. Let me get back to you in a couple of days, okay?” After hearing this, your father looked somewhat disappointed and anxious, but he reluctantly nodded.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Mother privately told Father about the true motive
description: Shortly after you returned to your room, your mother Chen Meiling quietly pulled you into the kitchen. Pretending to tidy the cupboard, she lowered her voice and told you that a few months ago your father had wanted to use his pension to buy the latest game console for his grandson but was turned down, and since then he had kept muttering that he was old and useless. This investment was actually his way of proving that he could still contribute to the family. After hearing this, you felt even more conflicted: you couldn't bear to directly puncture your father's fragile pride, but you also absolutely couldn't watch him walk straight into a trap.
location: Kitchen at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: The father mistakenly thought she had agreed and called her younger brother.
description: At 3:30 p.m., you left the room again to get water and heard your father talking on the phone in the living room. He said in a relaxed tone: 'Ah Feng, your big sister said she will seriously consider it and will discuss it with Weiming. This time it should be fine!' Your heart tightened. You wanted to walk over and explain, but seeing your father's rare happy tone, the words were on the tip of your tongue and you swallowed them back. You heard your younger brother Yu Xiaofeng on the other end of the line seem to warn him cautiously, but your father paid no attention. You stood at the corner of the hallway, your heart feeling as if it were being cut by scissors.
location: Living room and corridor at home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Short break and organizing thoughts
description: Back in the bedroom, feeling heavy-hearted. To distract yourself, you open the memo app on your phone and start organizing the key points of the proposal to be submitted tomorrow to client Wang Qiming (President Wang). You list the core data comparisons and risk warnings one by one, and your thoughts gradually become clearer, which gives your professional side some comfort.
location: Own bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Surprise! Fatty is back home.
description: At around 4:45 p.m., just as the whole family was feeling down because of the afternoon's events, a familiar cat meow came from outside the door. You dashed over and opened the door, and sure enough, there was dirty Fatty crouching at the entrance — thinner than before, but still bright-eyed. You excitedly scooped him up, and the children cheered and gathered around. You quickly checked him over and, after confirming there were no injuries, gave him a quick rinse with warm water.
location: At the entrance and bathroom of the home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking care of the cat and a warmer family atmosphere.
description: After giving Fatty a bath and drying him with a hairdryer, he regained some of his usual spirit. You took out the cat food and he wolfed it down. The children kept petting him, and Mother smiled and said, "You naughty cat, you finally know how to come home." You held him in your arms and said softly, "Don't run away again. The whole family was worried about you." The dark cloud hanging over the family because of the investment instantly cleared away, dispelled by this little cat.
location: Bathroom and living room of the home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A Heartwarming Family Dinner and the Decision to Go Out
description: Because of Feizai's return, Mother was in a great mood and specially added a steamed egg custard to dinner to go with the children's rice. The atmosphere at the dinner table was relaxed and cheerful, and the children each ate an extra bowl of rice. You decided to give yourself some alone time to process today's emotions, and said to your family, "After I finish eating, I'll go out for a while, take a walk, and buy something." Your husband Zhang Weiming said, "Go ahead, I'll watch them." You nodded.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Impulsive spending and private regret.
description: You set out from home and strolled along familiar streets, walking about 45 minutes to Kowloon City Plaza. In the mall, you wandered aimlessly. When you passed a designer handbag store, you thought of the pressures of the past few days—your father's stubbornness, the anxiety of looking for the cat, and work exhaustion—and felt an impulse for revenge spending. You lingered in the store for a long time, finally took a fancy to a black handbag priced at HK$8,500, and after hesitating for a few seconds, gritted your teeth and swiped your card to buy it. As you walked out and looked at the transaction alert on your phone, an intense wave of regret and anxiety hit you. You sat on a bench in the mall atrium, watching people come and go, and were in a daze for a long time.
location: Kowloon City Plaza, 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: On the way home
description: You sat on the bench for nearly an hour. It was completely dark, and you had calmed down a bit. Carrying heavy shopping bags, you didn't want to walk back, so you hailed a taxi at the mall entrance and went home. The ride was short, about 15 minutes. In the car, you thought about this month's budget, and the more you thought, the more uneasy you felt.
location: En route from Kowloon City Plaza, 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Late-night couple talk and financial negotiation.
description: When you got home, your husband Zhang Weiming noticed that you looked upset. He didn't ask, but just poured you a glass of warm water. In the bedroom, he asked gently, and you finally couldn't hold it in any longer. You burst into tears in his arms and poured out everything: the exhaustion of taking care of your mother-in-law, the pressure from your father to invest, and your regret over today's impulse buy. Zhang Weiming didn't blame you. Instead, he held you tightly, patted your back, and said, “Silly girl, if anything happens, just tell me; we'll sort it out together.” He took the initiative to promise: “In the next couple of days, I'll handle Mother's dinner and care. You focus on your job.” He also suggested, “The handbag is bought, so it's done. Tomorrow we'll recalculate the monthly budget together. In the next few months, we'll eat out less often, and we'll make up the money in no time.” Your feelings were fully accepted, and you finally felt completely relaxed.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bedroom in the family home

name: Morning preparations, family breakfast, and work check-in.
description: Woken up by the 6:30 alarm, she felt heavy-hearted on Monday morning because of the previous night's dispute over her father's investment, but thinking of her mother-in-law's rehabilitation treatment, she forced herself to get up. After washing up, she changed into a neat dark blue suit, combed her short hair, applied a light base cream, and gave herself some mental encouragement. Walking into the dining room, her mother Chen Meiling had prepared a Cantonese breakfast: congee, fried eggs, stir-fried vegetables, and steamed taro shreds. While eating, she checked her son Xuanxuan's math homework, praised him after confirming it was all correct. Her daughter Xinxin ran out wearing a new coat; Xiaowei helped check her backpack and water bottle, and reminded her to drink more warm water because of the temperature drop today. Her husband Ming proactively offered to take the children to school and told her not to worry too much about his mother, saying he would bring dinner in the evening. She gratefully squeezed his hand. While the family was putting on shoes at the entrance, she quickly took out her phone and called the Grace Community Physiotherapy Centre on How Ming Street, Kwun Tong, to confirm her mother-in-law's first treatment appointment at 9 a.m. Then she opened the company's internal system and entered the infrastructure private equity project number provided by her father into the search box in advance, laying the groundwork for the morning's work.
location: Flat D, 15/F, Tower 8, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to mother-in-law's home
description: After her husband drove the children to school, she drove her silver-gray Toyota Corolla from Whampoa Garden to Kwun Tong via the East Kowloon Corridor. The car radio was playing RTHK's 'Talk East, Talk West' program, which was telling stories about long-established shops in Kowloon City. She thought she could tell her mother-in-law about it later—she would definitely be interested. She arrived at the entrance of Golden Bridge Building on Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong, around 8:10.
location: Drove from Whampoa Garden residential estate in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, via the East Kowloon Corridor to Golden Bridge Building on Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District.

name: Pick up mother-in-law and take her to the physical therapy center
description: Went upstairs to pick up my mother-in-law Li Shufen. She had already changed into loose sportswear and was in good spirits. I helped her downstairs, carefully assisted her into the back seat, and fastened her seatbelt. After driving for about 5 minutes, we arrived at Grace Community Physiotherapy Centre at 108 How Ming Street, Kwun Tong, at 8:40.
location: From Golden Bridge Mansion, Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District, Kowloon, Hong Kong, to Grace Community Physiotherapy Centre, 108 How Ming Street

name: Accompanying mother-in-law to her first physical therapy session and personal fitness
description: Accompanied her mother-in-law to check in at the treatment center. The therapist, Miss Chan, warmly received them, gave her mother-in-law a 15-minute hot compress and gentle massage, and patiently demonstrated rehabilitation exercises such as ankle pumps and seated calf raises.
