She herself recorded a video with her phone and noted down the key points in a notebook. During her mother-in-law's rest break, she walked to the corner of the corridor, and by the wall and window she did three sets of standard planks, each held for 30 seconds, completing her fragmented exercise check-in.
location: Grace Community Physiotherapy Centre, 108 How Ming Street, Kwun Tong District, Kowloon, Hong Kong

name: Purchasing rehabilitation aids for her mother-in-law
description: After the treatment, she drove her mother-in-law to Jianmin Medical Equipment Store at 88 Junction Road, Kowloon City District. She carefully selected an aluminum alloy quad cane (thickened handle for a more stable grip), two rolls of elastic bandages, and a pair of breathable silicone knee pads. She chose the cane especially with her mother-in-law's comfort in mind, for a total of HK$1,150. Then she bought a bottle of muscle-relaxing ointment at the pharmacy across the street.
location: Jianmin Medical Equipment Store, 88 Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and the pharmacy opposite

name: Prepared a safe home environment and lunch for her mother-in-law.
description: Returned to her mother-in-law's home at Golden Bridge Building in Kwun Tong. She temporarily put away the non-slip mat at the living room entrance, moved the coffee table to the corner, and made sure there was a clear accessible path from the sofa to the bathroom. She applied muscle-relaxing balm to her mother-in-law and reminded her to use the new cane when going to the toilet or boiling water. Her mother-in-law agreed with a smile. Worried that her mother-in-law might just grab something simple for lunch, she suggested eating simple roast meat rice at the nearby Yue Man Square Cooked Food Centre. She ordered a sliced chicken rice for her mother-in-law and a bowl of shrimp wonton noodles for herself. While waiting for the food, she quickly browsed renewal reminders for several family insurance clients on her phone and jotted down key follow-up points in her notes.
location: Golden Bridge Mansion and Yue Man Square Cooked Food Centre, Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District, Kowloon, Hong Kong

name: Take mother-in-law home and drive back to the office alone
description: After sending her mother-in-law back to the entrance of Jinqiao Huaxia, she reminded her again to do her rehabilitation exercises on time and told her that her husband would bring dinner in the evening. She then drove through the Eastern Harbour Crossing to Wan Chai, connected her phone via Bluetooth in the car, and listened to a CFP course audio on tax optimization strategies to warm up for revising the high-end client proposal in the afternoon.
location: Drove from Gold Bridge Building, Kai Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District, through the Eastern Harbour Crossing to AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District.

name: Return to the office to handle client claims and check on her father's investment project.
description: After parking the car in the monthly parking lot near the company, she walked to the office on the 23rd floor of the AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road. She brewed a cup of hot oolong tea and placed the documents to be handled in the afternoon—Mrs. Chen's claims materials, the screenshot of her father's investment code result, and Mr. Wang's folder—on the desk in advance to think about possible directions for adjusting the plan. Soon after, she received a call from client Chen Meiling, who was upset because her husband's hospitalization medical claim had not been credited for two weeks. She apologized and calmed her down while quickly checking the system, and found that the delay was caused by incomplete hospital materials (the copy of the surgical record was unclear). She explained the process in detail and promised to personally contact the hospital's medical affairs department to urge them to submit the supplementary materials. After hanging up, she felt tired and wronged, and went alone to the pantry to wash her face with cold water to calm down. Then, using the company's internal risk-checking platform, she entered the project code for the "Global Infrastructure Private Equity Fund" provided by her father. The system popped up a warning: the product was not registered with the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission, and the parent company had a history of multiple investment disputes overseas. She took a screenshot to save the evidence and decided that she must formally and politely decline her father this week. Thinking that it would hurt his desire to prove himself, she let out a long, heavy-hearted sigh.
location: Office, 23/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Batch-process renewal documents and communicate with clients.
description: She set aside her father's matter for the moment and focused on processing the dozen or so renewal documents due this week. After checking the policy information one by one, she sent electronic reminders with brief greetings to several familiar clients via WhatsApp. She also replied to four clients' online inquiries about savings plans, and proactively called two clients who had not responded to confirm their renewal intentions, successfully securing one of them.
location: Office, 23/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Plan optimization, self-regulation, and working overtime
description: After working continuously for nearly two hours, she felt neck and shoulder soreness. She took a tennis ball out of the drawer, leaned back against the chair, and pressed it on the muscles near her shoulder blades for 5 minutes of relaxation. Then she took out the blueberries and unsweetened oolong tea she had brought in the morning as a healthy afternoon snack to recharge. Using the last hour before leaving work, she opened the combined savings + critical illness plan prepared for Wang Qiming (General Manager Wang). Based on the CFP course knowledge she had listened to in the afternoon, she optimized the combination of the critical illness coverage and the premium payment term of the savings dividends, and inserted a simplified tax-benefit comparison chart. After completing the first draft, she sent it to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua for preview. As her colleagues left work one after another, she stayed behind alone to further refine the plan, repeatedly adjusting the cash value illustrations under different coverage amounts in order to present the best proposal. She also set a phone alarm to get up and drink water every 30 minutes, or do a few sets of neck and shoulder stretches by the window to relieve the fatigue of prolonged sitting.
location: Office, 23/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Commute after work: walking, MTR, and a late-night snack from a convenience store.
description: After confirming that the draft plan had been sent by email, she turned off the computer and packed up. Stepping out of the AIA Building, she took a deep breath of the humid air after the thunderstorm and felt a sense of relief. She walked to Wan Chai MTR station, took the Island Line to Admiralty, then transferred to the East Rail line to Whampoa Station. After exiting the station, she stopped by the 7-Eleven on Man Tai Street in Hung Hom on the way, used Octopus to buy a carton of lemon tea and an oden (radish and fish balls) as a late-night snack, and replied to several messages in the runner friends group to confirm the weekend morning run plan. She arrived home at 20:25.
location: AIA Building, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, Wan Chai MTR Station, East Rail line, Whampoa Station, Man Tai Street, Hung Hom, 7-Eleven, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District

name: Family evening interaction
description: When she got home, her husband had just returned from delivering food to her mother-in-law's home, and the children were curled up on the living room sofa watching cartoons. After putting down her bag, she first checked her son's Chinese composition and found he had used a nice metaphor, the moon is like a curved banana, so she praised him. Then she sat on the carpet with her daughter and played a bead-stringing game for a while, listening to her talk about funny things at kindergarten. She noticed her mother was watching TV shopping, so she sat down and chatted with her for a bit about a new massage chair she had been thinking of buying.
location: Flat D, 15/F, Tower 8, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Deep conversation between husband and wife.
description: While her mother took the children to wash up, she led her husband to the sofa, sat down, and told him about the results of today's inquiry into her father's investment project and her heavy mood. After listening, her husband put his arm around her shoulder and comforted her: "Leave it to me; don't worry. I'll think of something on your father's side. Don't worry too much for now. Grandma is in good spirits today and has taken her medicine." Leaning on his shoulder, she felt a reassuring warmth.
location: Flat D, 15/F, Tower 8, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Daughter's Late-Night Surprise
description: After washing up and just as she was about to go to the study to handle today's work memos, her 5-year-old daughter Xinxin gently pushed open the study door, holding a crayon drawing with both hands. It showed a red kapok flower, with a smiling mother in the center of the flower, and below it, in wobbly handwriting, the words "Go, Mom!" Her eyes instantly reddened. She hugged her daughter tightly, and the exhaustion and pent-up frustration of the past few days melted away in the child's innocence. She gave her a big kiss on the forehead.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Tower 8, 15th Floor, Flat D, Study Room

name: Couple's monthly financial review and setting up a travel fund
description: After putting Xinxin to sleep, she sat down with her husband at the small desk in the study. She took out the receipts collected this week from her handbag, and her husband brought out the family ledger, and they checked them item by item. They focused on reviewing the HK$8,500 handbag she had impulsively bought last weekend because she was in a low mood, as well as her mother-in-law's additional medical expenses of about HK$3,000 this month, confirming that total expenses in April exceeded the budget by HK$3,000. Based on this, they jointly adjusted the May budget: cut eating out and non-essential shopping by 10%, and increased the monthly emergency reserve from HK$2,000 to HK$3,000. Then she proposed setting up an "annual family travel fund" with a goal of saving an additional HK$20,000 before the end of the year, planning to take the children to Taipei. Starting in May, they would deposit HK$4,000 into a dedicated savings account at the beginning of each month, and her husband signed his name in support. She used her phone to take photos of the ledger and the sticky note with the plan and saved them to the family album.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Tower 8, 15th Floor, Flat D, Study Room

name: Send work memos and personal review
description: She opened her work email and sent her supervisor Liang Zhenhua the preliminary draft of President Wang's proposal and the client list to be reviewed before tomorrow morning's meeting. Then she wrote today's review in her phone memos: her mother-in-law's first treatment went smoothly and all assistive devices were ready; thank her husband for helping deliver meals; she must contact the hospital tomorrow morning about Mrs. Chen's claims case; her father's investment plan had to be confronted this week — it was painful, but for the sake of the family she had to refuse; the preliminary draft of President Wang's proposal was completed and sent to her supervisor for review; her daughter's painting was the warmest highlight of the day; her monthly financial meeting with her husband was very effective, and life felt organized again; on the weekend she wanted to go to Master Wu's studio to embroider and relax.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Tower 8, 15th Floor, Flat D, Study Room

name: Stretching before bed and preparing for rest
description: Back in the bedroom, she changed into her pajamas and did 5 minutes of cat-cow pose and leg stretches on the yoga mat to relax the muscles that were tense from sitting for a long time. She set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and silently planned the next day's work priorities: discuss the investment matters with her father in the morning, follow up on Mrs. Chen's claim in the afternoon, and try to run 5 km at Whampoa Fitness Centre in the evening. After taking a deep breath, she turned off the light and lay down, feeling secure and calm.
location: Bedroom, Flat D, 15th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: Woke up at home in Whampoa Garden, turned off the alarm, and felt reassured at the thought of accompanying her mother-in-law to the follow-up appointment today. She got up quietly, did 5 minutes of stretching to wake up her body, washed up, then went to the living room to double-check the medical records, X-rays, medical insurance card, and ID card, and put them into a document folder. She left a note for her husband Zhang Weiming, telling him that the congee in the kitchen was ready, Xuanxuan's calligraphy supplies were at the entrance, Xinxin's little schoolbag was on the shoe cabinet, and reminding him that he would be responsible for taking care of his mother in the afternoon.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 8, 12th Floor, Flat A.

name: Breakfast and reminders before going out
description: Her mother Chen Meiling served rice porridge, fried eggs, and homemade pickled radish. While drinking the porridge, Yu Xiaowei reminded her son Xuanxuan to bring his calligraphy class supplies and helped her daughter Xinxin hang her small water bottle on the side of her schoolbag. Her husband Zhang Weiming said he could get off work at 5:30 and go straight to his mother's house. Before leaving, she hugged the children and told them to listen to their grandmother.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 8, 12th Floor, Flat A.

name: Commuting to Kwun Tong
description: From Whampoa Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Kwun Tong Station. Put on headphones and listened to soothing piano music, closed her eyes to rest, and silently reviewed the questions to ask Dr. Zhou: precautions for using stairs, whether a brace is needed after resuming walking, and the frequency of physical therapy. The train arrived at Kwun Tong Station on time, and she exited with the crowd.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, MTR Kwun Tong Line (Whampoa Station to Kwun Tong Station)

name: Pick up my mother-in-law and go to the hospital
description: Went to Unit B, 5th Floor, Kam Kiu Building, Kwun Tong, to pick up her mother-in-law Li Shufen, who was already neatly dressed and waiting at the door. She carefully helped her into the elevator and hailed a taxi downstairs to go directly to United Christian Hospital. In the car, her mother-in-law said she wanted to have yum cha, and Yu Xiaowei promised to go to De Xing after the follow-up appointment.
location: Flat B, 5/F, Kam Kiu Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; then went to United Christian Hospital, 130 Hip Wo Street, Kwun Tong District

name: Accompany mother-in-law to orthopedic follow-up visit
description: In the orthopedic consultation room on the 3rd floor of the outpatient building of United Christian Hospital, Dr. Zhou Wenbin carefully read the X-ray and examined the knee's range of motion. He announced that the ligament had healed well, the swelling had subsided, and she could slowly resume normal walking, and he recommended one more session of physical therapy to consolidate the recovery. Yu Xiaowei noted the doctor's instructions and asked for tips on going up and down stairs, then immediately used her phone app to book a physical therapy appointment for 3 p.m. next Tuesday.
location: Orthopedics clinic, 3rd Floor, Outpatient Building, United Christian Hospital, 130 Hip Wo Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going for morning tea to celebrate recovery
description: The follow-up results put both of them in a great mood, so they took her mother-in-law to a window seat at Dexing Teahouse on Yue Man Square for morning tea. They ordered shrimp dumplings, fresh bamboo rolls, chicken feet in black bean sauce, barbecue pork buns, and two bowls of double-boiled milk. The mother-in-law praised Xiaowei for being efficient, and Xiaowei promised to take the whole family to M+ over the weekend, even if she had to carry her mother-in-law up the stairs on her back. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Tak Hing Tea House, 2nd Floor, 67 Yue Man Square, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Escort mother-in-law home and help her settle in
description: After finishing morning tea, she strolled slowly back to Jinqiao Huaxia, buying a bottle of Wong To Yick Woodlock Oil at the pharmacy on the way. After arriving home, she helped her mother-in-law sit on the sofa, prepared hot water for her to soak her feet, applied the medicated oil, and massaged. She put away the hallway rug to prevent tripping, wrote the key rehabilitation exercises the doctor had instructed on a whiteboard, and hung it in a prominent spot in the living room. She helped her mother-in-law lie down for a nap and told her to call if anything came up.
location: Flat B, 5th Floor, Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Learning Japanese in Short Bursts and Preparing for the Handover
description: After her mother-in-law fell asleep, she sat on the living room sofa and used the Duolingo app to practice Japanese kana and everyday phrases, then took a screenshot and sent it to the CFP study group to share her fragmented learning method. She then used her phone's memo app to organize her mother-in-law's medication list and care points into a table, added a link to a video tutorial on using a cane, and prepared to send it to her husband Zhang Weiming.
location: Living room, Flat B, 5th Floor, Golden Bridge Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Handing over care responsibilities and liaising with neighbors.
description: At 1 p.m., her husband Zhang Weiming called to say he had arrived downstairs. Yu Xiaowei put her mother-in-law's front-door key on the shoe cabinet in the entryway and checked the handover information again. Then she called the downstairs neighbor Mrs. Chen, asking her to keep her mother-in-law company in the afternoon, and Mrs. Chen readily agreed. After Zhang Weiming arrived, Xiaowei explained all the details in person, and only left after showing him that her mother-in-law was sleeping peacefully.
location: Flat B, 5th Floor, Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return to Whampoa Garden
description: After settling everything, she took the MTR Kwun Tong Line from Kwun Tong Station back to Whampoa Station. There were few people in the carriage, so she leaned back in her seat, browsed unread work emails, and planned the priority order for handling them after returning: first reply to the claims department to push for progress, then apologize to Manager Wang and promise a solution.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region MTR Kwun Tong Line (from Kwun Tong Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Focus on clearing backlogged work
description: At 2:30 PM, Yu Xiaowei arrived home. Her mother Chen Meiling was watching a TVB midday drama in the living room. After greeting her, Yu Xiaowei went into the study, opened her laptop, and handled 17 unread emails: first, she emailed the company's claims department to follow up on client Chen Meiling's claim, copying the relationship manager; then she sent a long WeChat message to General Manager Wang Qiming apologizing for the delay in the proposal and promising to submit the initial cross-border group insurance plan before the weekend; then she replied one by one to 3 renewal reminders, 5 product inquiries, and 2 team notices, and updated the weekly report for the team meeting. In the middle, her mother brought in tangerine peel tea. After finishing all the emails, she stretched.
location: Study, Flat A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening rest and persuading father
description: After finishing work, she went to the living room and saw her father Yu Guoqiang pruning potted plants on the balcony. She brewed a pot of Pu'er tea and chatted about family matters and her mother-in-law's recovery. Then she gently but firmly told her father that she had checked the project he mentioned and found that it was not registered with the CSRC and that there were dispute records online. The risk was too high, and the family's money could not be put in danger. After a moment of silence, her father sighed, admitted he had been too eager for quick success, and agreed not to invest. Yu Xiaowei felt a weight lifted from her mind.
location: Living room balcony, Unit A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Light exercise at home
description: After helping her father feel better, she was in a relieved mood. She spread out her yoga mat in the living room and followed a fitness app for 30 minutes of flow yoga, focusing on stretching her legs and lower back. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was trimming vegetables nearby with a gratified smile. After exercising, she felt comfortable all over.
location: Living room, Flat A, 12/F, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm family dinner and parent-child time
description: Dinner was her mother's specialty, clear soup beef brisket casserole. The family sat around the table and shared the good news that her mother-in-law's follow-up visit went smoothly. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei checked Xuanxuan's math homework, found careless calculation errors, and patiently explained them. Then she read the picture book Ballet Princess with Xinxin, who was completely absorbed. Her husband Zhang Weiming repaired the little toy car that their daughter had broken when she dropped it. It was a warm scene.
location: Dining room and living room, Flat A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal planning and Cantonese embroidery.
description: After the children fell asleep, she wrote down the key items for next week in the study: complete the cross-border group insurance proposal, accompany the physical therapy, make an appointment for morning tea with her friend Lin Jiaxin, and go for a Saturday morning run. Then she took out her embroidery frame and practiced the chain stitch of Cantonese embroidery, embroidering a small ginkgo leaf. Teacher Wu had once praised her for making great progress. She felt a sense of inner peace with every stitch.
location: Study, Flat A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: She put down her embroidery frame and went to the bathroom to wash up. Back in the bedroom, her husband Zhang Weiming said softly that she had worked hard and that she didn't need to worry about his mother. Yu Xiaowei replied that family doesn't speak of hardship, and the two chatted about the next day's work arrangements, then turned off the light and got ready for sleep. Outside the window there was the occasional sound of a car passing by, and the house was peaceful.
location: Bedroom, Flat A, 12/F, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: Went to bed, reflecting on the day: successfully accompanied mother-in-law for a follow-up visit, smoothly handed over caregiving, dealt with accumulated work, cleared the air with my father, and did exercise and embroidery in the evening. Every task was accomplished with results; felt life was back under my own control. With this sense of fulfillment and contentment, fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Flat A, 12/F, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Recovery morning run
description: The alarm went off. Remembering the encouragement from her running buddy A Wen, she got up decisively. After changing into her running shoes, she jogged from Whampoa Garden to Kowloon Tsai Park in about 20 minutes. Today's target was 3 kilometers, completed at a pace of 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. The first half felt a bit strenuous, but the second half gradually became smoother, and the sweat brought a long-missed sense of ease. After the run, she stretched for 10 minutes beside a bench in the park, focusing on her calves and lower back, and the discomfort in her neck was noticeably relieved. She then jogged back home.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go home, freshen up, and have breakfast
description: Finished the morning run and walked home. Took a hot shower and changed into dry work clothes. Quickly prepared breakfast: a cup of black coffee, two slices of whole-wheat toast with peanut butter, to replenish protein and energy.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family collaboration
description: The nutritious breakfast was ready, and I began waking up the children. Helped my daughter Xinxin braid her hair and reminded my son Xuanxuan to check his schoolbag. My husband Weiming had already set out the breakfast. The whole family sat around the table and finished breakfast quickly. Confirmed today's pickup and drop-off arrangements with my husband: he would take the two children to school (Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and Xinxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten), while I would go straight to the office.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to the office
description: She left at 8:10, walked to Whampoa MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she took out her phone and quickly browsed the morning's financial news and industry updates to prepare for today's client meetings. After exiting the station, she walked about 5 minutes to the AIA Building.
location: Hong Kong MTR Kwun Tong line (Whampoa Station to Mong Kok Station) and Island line (Mong Kok Station to Wan Chai Station).

name: Morning office preparation and focused drafting of a cross-border group insurance plan.
description: Arrived at the AIA Building office in Wan Chai. First went to the pantry, made myself a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea, turned on the computer, and checked emails and schedule. Seeing yesterday’s good news about my mother-in-law’s follow-up visit and the team data, I felt relaxed. Then I got into work mode and focused entirely on client Wang Qiming’s cross-border group medical insurance plan. I pulled up the Shenzhen branch rate table on my computer for reference, and called my brother Yu Xiaofeng, who works in Shenzhen, to ask in detail about the specific operational details and latest policies for connecting mainland employees’ social insurance. After hanging up, I spent an hour and a half completing the first draft of the plan, with key data notes attached. Then I sent the draft to Guo Junwei, a colleague in the actuarial department, via internal email, asking him to review it and give professional feedback. While waiting for his reply, I replied to Cantonese embroidery teacher Wu Xiuying’s message in the group, expressed interest in the teaching assistant invitation, and asked if Saturday would be convenient to meet and talk in detail, and to arrange to go for morning tea.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday lunch gathering and walk
description: Work wrapped up for the morning. My colleague Su Lishan sent a message saying it was already time for lunch. I tidied my desk, grabbed my phone and wallet, and went downstairs with Shanshan. The two of us walked to a newly opened Vietnamese restaurant near the office. Shanshan recommended the signature beef pho with raw beef. The broth was tasty and the beef tender; it really tasted good. During the meal, Shanshan shared her experience of recently signing a small business owner as a client, and asked with concern about my mother-in-law's recovery. We agreed that once my mother-in-law fully recovered, we would sign up together for the evening yoga class near the office. After lunch, we took a 15-minute walk in a small park nearby. Shanshan quietly hinted that I should pay more attention to cross-border business trends, as they might be helpful for future team development.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Vietnamese restaurant on Hennessy Road and nearby park

name: Return to the office to handle miscellaneous tasks.
description: After saying goodbye to Shanshan, she walked about 10 minutes back to the office. She checked her email first and saw that her actuarial colleague Awei had replied that the draft framework was fine and suggested adding some detailed data. She noted this on her to-do list. Then she began organizing the client materials she needed for the afternoon.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Follow up on client Chen Meiling's claim
description: One of the core afternoon tasks. She called the company's claims department to ask about the progress of Ms. Chen Meiling's hospitalization claim. She learned that approval was suspended because the Social Welfare Department was slow in retrieving medical records. She noted down the key information, then immediately called Ms. Chen, explained the reason in a sincere tone, and proactively offered a free 'annual family policy review' service as an apology, promising to personally follow up on the claims process. Ms. Chen's attitude clearly softened and she expressed understanding. She then organized the communication records into the client file.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize team quarterly data
description: My supervisor Liang Zhenhua asked me to compile the team's data for this quarter for next week's regional meeting. I exported the raw data from the company system, including team members' premium income, number of new policies, and renewal rate, and spent an hour and a half creating a clear Excel chart. I specifically highlighted in red the key point that the proportion of potential cross-border business had risen to 15%, and planned to propose setting up a cross-border business team in the report to open a new track for the team.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute
description: At 17:00, she packed up her desk on time and left the AIA Building. She walked to Wan Chai MTR Station, took the Island Line to Mong Kok Station, then transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station. After getting off at Mong Kok East Station, she walked about 10 minutes to Kowloon City Market.
location: Hong Kong MTR Island Line (Wan Chai Station to Mong Kok Station) and Kwun Tong Line (Mong Kok Station to Whampoa Station) and Kowloon City Market

name: Supermarket shopping
description: Today's shopping goal was clear: at the seafood stall, I carefully picked out half a catty of fresh sea shrimp and bought some tender green choy sum. At checkout, I saw some plump, fresh clams and bought a little on a whim, thinking I could make steamed egg with clams for the children tomorrow morning. Then I walked about 15 minutes back to my home in Whampoa Garden.
location: Kowloon City Market, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Prepare dinner
description: Returned home to Whampoa Garden. Mother Chen Meiling was already busy in the kitchen, kneading dough to make scallion pancakes. Putting down the groceries, she took out the sea shrimp from the bag and cleaned them, preparing to make steamed shrimp with garlic. Mother and daughter chatted about family matters while preparing ingredients in the kitchen.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family meal time
description: At dinner time, the family was rarely all gathered around the table. On the table were garlic steamed shrimp, blanched choy sum, golden scallion pancakes made by my mother, and a bowl of tomato egg drop soup. Xuanxuan and Xinxin were competitively telling funny stories from school, and Dad Yu Guoqiang also rarely smiled. Looking at the scene before me, I felt very grounded.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family duties.
description: After dinner, helped clear the dishes. Then checked my son Xuanxuan's math homework and patiently explained a word problem. I also played with my daughter Xinxin using LEGO bricks and listened to her 'explain' the little castle she had built. Meanwhile, my husband Weiming was fixing our daughter's broken toy beside us.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling key family matters
description: After settling the children, she walked alone into the study and closed the door. After a moment to compose herself, she sent a voice WeChat message to her father, Yu Guoqiang, in a gentle but clear tone: 'Dad, I've looked up some information about that investment plan. There are a few things I'd like to discuss with you in detail this weekend. How about I come find you for morning tea on Saturday? Let's have Mom come too.' Soon, her father replied with a single word: 'Okay.' She let out a long breath; half the weight was finally lifted from her heart.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal relaxation and study
description: After completing the most important conversation, she relaxed. Instead of checking her phone right away, she picked up her iPad, searched the browser for “new types of financial fraud cases,” carefully read several analysis articles, and identified common features of investment traps to prepare for the weekend conversation with her father. Then she unrolled her yoga mat and did 15 minutes of simple stretching to loosen the day's tense muscles.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-Bedtime Preparations
description: After washing up, she changed into pajamas. Her husband Weiming also lay down. She briefly told him about sending the message to her father; he held her hand in support. She set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: The alarm clock went off at 6:15 in the morning. It was cloudy outside, but the morning light was visible. Yu Xiaowei got up and did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching in the living room to wake up her body. Then she woke her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin and helped them wash up and get dressed. At breakfast, Xuanxuan excitedly talked about having PE class today, while Xinxin was thinking about the colored paper she needed to bring for art class. Drinking her coffee, Yu Xiaowei reminded her husband Zhang Weiming to pick up the repaired air-conditioner remote control after work.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute: home to office
description: Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her husband at the entrance of the residential compound, and her husband rode a motorcycle to take the children to school. She walked six minutes to Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then switched to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station, for a total of about 40 minutes. After exiting the station, she walked briskly toward her office building.
location: Hong Kong MTR train (Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Morning coffee and knowledge warm-up
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the cafe in Shui On Centre downstairs from the company and ordered a hot latte and a tuna sandwich. While waiting, she quickly browsed the article about tax compliance for high-net-worth clients that she had saved on her phone last night, to warm up for the upcoming training.
location: Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai

name: Attend the company's tax-themed training
description: The training started promptly at 8:45 in the meeting room of the Immigration Tower. External tax consultant Mr. Liang gave an in-depth explanation of tax arrangements for high-net-worth clients in cross-border insurance, covering key points such as CRS, trust isolation, and estate tax. Yu Xiaowei sat in the front row, taking careful notes. During the tea break, she exchanged views with her supervisor Hua Ge and shared her thoughts on tax rate differences in the Greater Bay Area with colleague Su Lishan.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break: video call and lunch
description: After the training, Yu Xiaowei went to the company lounge and had a video call with her Shenzhen colleague Guo Junwei via the conference room screen. They finalized the details of the direct-payment network for top-tier tertiary hospitals in mainland China in Director Wang Qiming's proposal, and she adopted his suggestion to add an outpatient appointment green channel. After the call, she revised the proposal on her computer. Then she heated up her homemade multigrain rice and stir-fried beef with green peppers, and while eating, she browsed a running forum on her phone. She saw the registration preview for the November Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon, took a screenshot of the race preparation guide, sent it to the runner group, and listed the Guangzhou Marathon as an alternative plan.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handle core work and client communication
description: Yu Xiaowei sent the revised and optimized version of 'Mr. Wang Qiming's Cross-Border Group Medical Insurance Plan' to Mr. Wang's email, attaching a clear WeChat voice message explaining the improvements. Afterward, she handled 3 client emails about renewal inquiries and compiled the list of clients to visit next week.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Schedule physical therapy for mother-in-law.
description: Yu Xiaowei took some time to call Grace Community Physiotherapy Centre in Kwun Tong and booked her mother-in-law Li Shufen's final physiotherapy session at 3 p.m. next Wednesday, confirming that her husband Zhang Weiming would be the accompanying person. After hanging up, she sent the appointment details and a screenshot to the family group chat, reminding Weiming to watch the time.

participant.name: Community physical therapy center staff member.

location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Knowledge consolidation: archiving training notes.
description: Yu Xiaowei spent half an hour transcribing the key points from the recording of the 3-hour morning training into her notebook and drew a concise mind map summarizing the four core aspects of cross-border tax planning for high-net-worth clients. She took photos for archiving and planned to organize them into an electronic version over the weekend.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Internal team communication and casual chat
description: In the pantry, she ran into her colleague Su Lishan, and the two shared their thoughts on the morning training. Yu Xiaowei shared a case of using a trust to isolate policy assets, while Su Lishan reminded her that senior management had recently been paying close attention to cross-border business. They agreed to sign up together for an evening yoga class near the office after the end of the month.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Compensatory leave application and final check of the plan.
description: Yu Xiaowei submitted a compensatory leave request to leave work one hour early today. Then she opened Boss Wang's group medical insurance plan PDF again, carefully checked the format and figures, and after making sure everything was correct, closed the computer and prepared to leave early.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting home and shopping
description: At 16:45 Yu Xiaowei clocked out. The sky turned cloudy and a drizzling rain started; she walked to Wan Chai Station with an umbrella and took the MTR back. After exiting at Whampoa Station, on the way she went to Huicui Fang at the intersection of Tak Fung Street and Tak On Street, bought a box of fresh milk and some organic vegetables at Lüyouyou Organic Convenience Store, and then walked about 6 minutes home.
location: Ground Floor, Huicui Square, 140 meters southwest of the intersection of Tak Fung Street and Tak On Street

name: Family interaction and yoga preparation.
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei greeted her mother Chen Meiling, put down her things, and changed into yoga clothes. She invited her mother to exercise together, saying the weather was muggy, so they should get some activity. Her mother smiled and followed her to the living room, and they laid out the yoga mats.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening Hatha yoga
description: Yu Xiaowei opened a beginner Hatha yoga video on YouTube and led her mother through it, starting with abdominal breathing. Her mother was stiff during Cat-Cow pose and wobbled during Tree pose, and the two of them burst into laughter. She corrected her mother's posture and encouraged her to do her best. After 45 minutes, both were slightly sweaty and felt relaxed in body and mind.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Just as yoga ended, her husband Zhang Weiming brought the children home. The table was laden with lotus root and pork rib soup stewed by her mother, steamed fish, and choy sum. During dinner, Yu Xiaowei shared amusing stories from the day's training with her family, while Xuanxuan enthusiastically showed off the new jump-rope moves he had learned.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time: tutoring and companionship
description: Yu Xiaowei first went to her son's room to check his essay and guided him in correcting the language errors. Then she went to her daughter's room, read her a picture book story, and only left after seeing Xinxin contentedly close her eyes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: CFP online course study and summary.
description: After putting the children to sleep, Yu Xiaowei made herself a cup of hot lemon honey and went to the study. She opened the CFP online course platform and focused on the last two lessons of the personal tax planning module, for a total of 1.5 hours, carefully writing down key formulas. After the class, she independently completed three comprehensive calculation problems on salaries tax and profits tax and checked the answers.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meditation and journaling before bed
description: After studying, Yu Xiaowei went to the living room, turned off the lights, and sat cross-legged. She opened the meditation app and followed the guidance for 10 minutes of mindful breathing. After finishing, she opened her journal and wrote down today's reflections: the tax training was very rewarding, she felt happy doing yoga with her mother in the evening, she got through the CFP tax module, and she felt more confident about Mr. Wang's proposal. Steady progress.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Yu Xiaowei got up and stretched, then went to the bathroom to wash up and apply skincare. When she returned to the master bedroom, her husband Zhang Weiming was already lying down and asked if she was tired today. She charged her phone, set the alarm for 6:15 the next morning, and replied that she felt very fulfilled. After chatting for a bit, they turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time and follow-up visit preparation.
description: Waking up early, she quickly washed up and changed into loungewear. She prepared breakfast for the family: made coffee, got milk and fruit. She woke the children, helped her daughter Xinxin braid her hair, and urged her son Xuanxuan to put on his school uniform. The family of four sat together for breakfast. Yu Xiaowei checked the weather forecast and reminded the children to drink more water. After the meal, she and her husband Zhang Weiming sorted out her mother-in-law's medical records and ID documents, put them into a document folder, and called her mother-in-law to confirm the itinerary and reminded her to bring all the documents.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to pick up her mother-in-law.
description: Zhang Weiming drove, with Yu Xiaowei in the passenger seat. The two set off from their home in Kowloon City to Kwun Tong to pick up his mother, Li Shufen. Along the way, they chatted about the arrangements after the follow-up appointment, and Yu Xiaowei suggested going for Chiuchow cuisine at lunch to celebrate. About 15 minutes later, they arrived near Hong Ning Road in Kwun Tong.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, near Hong Ning Road

name: Accompanying mother-in-law to morning tea
description: At the New Kwun Tong Tea House on Hong Ning Road in Kwun Tong, the family accompanied her mother-in-law for morning tea. Yu Xiaowei ordered shrimp dumplings, siu mai, and fried sesame balls for her mother-in-law. Seeing that her mother-in-law had a good appetite and was in a happy mood, she reminded her to listen patiently to the doctor's advice during the follow-up visit.
location: New Kwun Tong Teahouse, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital
description: Setting out from the teahouse, Zhang Weiming drove through the Eastern Harbour Crossing to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital in Happy Valley, Wan Chai. Music played in the car. Her mother-in-law, in the back seat, shared the plot of a TV drama she had been watching recently, while Yu Xiaowei organized in her mind the key points she wanted to discuss with the doctor.
location: On the way from Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital on Village Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District.

name: Mother-in-law's follow-up appointment and examination
description: At Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, Yu Xiaowei skillfully completed the registration procedures for her mother-in-law. Dr. Zhou Wenbin gave her mother-in-law a careful ultrasound and joint assessment, and announced that the ligament had fully healed. She could walk normally but should avoid strenuous activity for a month. The mother-in-law excitedly called her old friend on the spot to share the good news: "Ah Fang! I can walk on my own now!" The whole family was beaming with joy in the waiting area. They then lingered briefly at the hospital entrance while her mother-in-law happily continued her phone call.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, Village Road, Happy Valley.

name: Family celebration lunch
description: To celebrate her mother-in-law's recovery, the family went to Kwun Tong Chiu Chow Restaurant on Hoi Yuen Road in Kwun Tong for lunch. They ordered signature dishes such as a mixed marinated platter, oyster omelette, stir-fried water spinach with dried flatfish, and steamed fish with preserved winter vegetables. The mother-in-law happily served everyone food with her chopsticks. Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to urge her: "From now on, let Weiming handle things like moving household items and mopping the floor. Don't overexert yourself anymore." Her mother-in-law nodded with a smile.
location: Kwun Tong Chiu Chow Restaurant, Kai Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Buy a fruit basket.
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei went alone to the Jinguoyuan fruit shop next to the restaurant, carefully chose a fruit basket containing apples, oranges, and grapes, and asked the owner to wrap it in red cellophane. She planned to give it to her neighbor Mrs. He as thanks for taking care of her mother-in-law.
location: Golden Orchard Fruit Shop, Hoi Yuen Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Visit neighbors to express gratitude
description: Yu Xiaowei, carrying a fruit basket, knocked on the door of Mrs. He's home on Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong, and warmly expressed her gratitude: “Mrs. He, I really can't thank you enough for looking after my mother-in-law during the day recently. Please do accept this small token of my appreciation!” After declining politely, Mrs. He accepted it, and the two chatted about everyday matters at the doorstep, sharing warm neighborhood affection.
location: Mrs. Ho's home, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to company
description: After leaving Mrs. He's home, she walked to Kwun Tong MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line and transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai. During the 30-minute MTR ride, Yu Xiaowei wore earphones and listened to an episode of a podcast about "estate planning for high-net-worth clients" to build up knowledge for the afternoon's work.
location: Kwun Tong MTR Station to Wan Chai MTR Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handled emails and enjoyed colleagues' care.
description: Arriving at the office on the 18th floor of the AIA Building on Gloucester Road in Wan Chai, Yu Xiaowei quickly skimmed the morning meeting emails and industry briefings, and replied to two customer inquiries about next week's regular premium policies. Her colleague Su Lishan handed her a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea, congratulated her on her mother-in-law's recovery, and the two chatted pleasantly for a while.
location: Office, 18th Floor, AIA Building, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Handle an urgent client claim dispute.
description: Supervisor Liang Zhenhua informed her that client Mr. Li complained because his claim had been rejected after he was injured in a fall. Yu Xiaowei immediately called Mr. Li, sincerely apologized, and promised to check it at once. After pulling up the policy, she found that the rejection reason was "failure to report the case within 24 hours." She then called the claims department, explained that Mr. Li was a ten-year client and had gone directly to the emergency room because of pain rather than deliberately delaying, and asked for an ex gratia payment. The claims department replied that a "Statement of Facts" and emergency room records needed to be provided, and the case could be reviewed within two days as a special arrangement. Yu Xiaowei reported the solution to her supervisor and, after receiving approval, contacted Mr. Li again, gently explained the situation, and told him what materials to prepare. Mr. Li's mood calmed down. Finally, she drafted a detailed email with a document checklist and sent it to the client.
location: Office, 18th Floor, AIA Building, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Review materials for tomorrow's discussion
description: After finishing the client matters, Yu Xiaowei quickly jotted down on a sticky note the names of several low-risk fund products she needed to download from the bank's official website in the evening, planning to use this as a starting point to help her father distinguish financial products and avoid being scammed.
location: Office, 18th Floor, AIA Building, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute home from work
description: After clocking out, she took the MTR back home to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City. When she arrived, her mother Chen Meiling had already changed the two children into going-out clothes. Yu Xiaowei quickly changed into a light T-shirt and sports pants, put on a small bag with wet wipes and snacks, and prepared to take the family to the night market.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take a taxi to the night market
description: Yu Xiaowei hailed a taxi with her mother and two children and headed to the Kowloon City Market night market. Along the way, the children excitedly discussed the evening's activities.
location: In a taxi, from Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon City Market.

name: Strolled through Kowloon City Night Market.
description: At the lively Kowloon City street market night market, her son Xuanxuan was drawn to a dinosaur model stall. Yu Xiaowei bought him a glowing Tyrannosaurus rex toy. Her daughter Xinxin, meanwhile, took a liking to a handkerchief embroidered with a butterfly. Yu Xiaowei crouched down and explained the stitching techniques of Cantonese embroidery to her, and the idea of cultivating her daughter's interest in embroidery began to grow in her mind. The family queued up to buy waffles and curry fish balls, eating while they strolled, enjoying family time together.
location: Night market at Kowloon City Market, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to settle the children down
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter Xinxin take a bubble bath, then urged her son Xuanxuan to finish washing up quickly by himself. Sitting by the small bed, she told the children the passage about the rose from The Little Prince, and the two children soon fell asleep.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tidying up the house and preparing materials.
description: Yu Xiaowei quietly tidied up the children's toys and folded the blanket on the sofa. Her mother, Chen Meiling, brought her a glass of warm water and told her not to work too late. Yu Xiaowei then went into the study to organize the financial planning materials for her talk with her father.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, living room and study at home

name: Organize financial materials and self-reward
description: In the study, she used her computer to download product brochures for recently popular low-risk bond funds from three Chinese-funded banks, carefully compared annualized yields, lock-up periods, and risk levels, highlighted key clauses with a marker, and compiled an “Anti-Fraud Guide” listing official verification channels. After placing all the materials into a kraft paper document folder, Yu Xiaowei opened a shopping app and ordered a pair of professional cushioned running shoes, then shared a screenshot of the order in her running group and announced the countdown to her return to training.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Evening relaxation and rest
description: On the yoga mat in the living room, she did 10 minutes of static leg stretches with soothing music to relax her body. Then she changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read Nonviolent Communication, reflecting on how she had communicated with clients that afternoon. After setting the alarm for the next day, she did 3 minutes of mindfulness meditation. As she was about to fall asleep, her mother came in quietly and asked about her mother-in-law. When she learned that she had fully recovered, the mother and daughter smiled at each other. Looking forward to tomorrow, Yu Xiaowei gradually drifted into sleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, living room and bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Morning wake-up, family interaction, and outing preparation.
description: After a full 9 hours of sleep, she got up feeling refreshed. She changed into a white cotton-linen top and wide-leg pants, picked out a floral dress for her daughter Xinxin, and braided her hair into two pigtails. In the kitchen, her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared a simple breakfast (fried egg toast, milk), and Yu Xiaowei brewed herself a cup of pour-over coffee. She reminded her son Xuanxuan to finish part of his weekend homework at home today, and reminded her husband Zhang Weiming of the time to leave for Kwun Tong in the afternoon. Before going out, she carefully checked her daughter's carry-on bag: water bottle, snacks, wet wipes, and brought along her own sketchbook and pencils.
location: No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (home living room, children’s room)

name: Drive daughter to school
description: Given the tight schedule, it was decided that Yu Xiaowei would drive her daughter to kindergarten. The traffic was smooth along the way, and they arrived at the kindergarten entrance about 7 minutes later. Xinxin happily waved to her mother. Watching her daughter's bouncing back, Yu Xiaowei felt full of anticipation for the art festival.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Participate in the kindergarten’s “Spring Art Festival”
description: The event started on time at 9:00, and the garden was decorated with balloons and ribbons. Yu Xiaowei and Xinxin chose the parent-child watercolor painting area. Xinxin focused on painting a girl in a pink ballet tulle skirt, surrounded by seven colorful butterflies. At 10:15, during the free creation session, Yu Xiaowei looked at her daughter's painting and suddenly remembered what Teacher Wu Xiuying had mentioned: “using embroidery thread to express light and shadow.” She immediately took out her sketchbook and quickly sketched with a pencil, transforming the dancer and butterfly posture into draft designs for the “Butterfly Dance” Cantonese embroidery series, and jotted down several color-matching ideas. Halfway through the drawing, she sighed softly and closed the sketchbook, telling herself to go deeper after her father's matter was resolved. Then she focused on helping her daughter mix colors and took photos of several works.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (campus playground and activity room).

name: After the art festival, she returned home happily with her daughter, calling her best friend on the way.
description: At 11:30 the activity ended. Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter pack up the watercolor painting and clay craft pieces. The two walked hand in hand out of the school, drove to a nearby "luxury tea restaurant" and bought hot egg tarts and iced lemon tea. On the way home, she called her best friend Lin Jiaxin (using car Bluetooth) and excitedly described Xinxin's creation and the burst of inspiration behind it. Lin Jiaxin laughed on the phone and said, "Xinxin can be your Cantonese embroidery model in the future!" Hearing this, Xinxin happily jumped around to the music.
location: From Kowloon City Kindergarten to the luxurious tea restaurant on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District, then back to the home on Prince Edward Road West.

name: Lunch, brief afternoon rest, and talk preparation
description: After arriving home, her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared a simple lunch (tomato and egg noodles). While eating, Yu Xiaowei shared the morning's interesting moments with her mother. After the meal, she asked her mother to look after the two children during their nap, then went into the study and spread out the documents for her afternoon talk with her father (a guide to identifying financial fraud and introductions to two low-risk bank funds) to familiarize herself with them again, and mentally rehearsed a gentle but firm persuasion process.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (home dining room, study)

name: Fragmented time: keeping son company and reflecting on Cantonese embroidery
description: After finishing her preparations, there was still some time left. She went to the living room and saw her son Xuanxuan building with LEGO. She sat down to join him, chatting casually about school while putting pieces together. At the same time, she took out her phone and quickly scrolled through posts on the embroidery forum about "expressing light and shadow with silk thread," saving two posts that she found useful as a knowledge base for deeper creation later.
location: No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (home living room)

name: Walking to the tea restaurant to meet my father as agreed.
description: As it approached 2 p.m., Yu Xiaowei changed into a pair of comfortable flat shoes and walked to the Hong Yun Roast Meat Tea Restaurant downstairs from her parents' home. The walk took only about 8 minutes; she took deep breaths along the way to relax.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden to Hongyun Roast Meat and Tea Restaurant (Kowloon City District, No. 20)

name: The key conversation with her father
description: At 14:00, her father Yu Guoqiang had already ordered a pot of Pu-erh tea and was waiting for her. She started casually, first asking about her father's health, then gradually got down to business. She candidly shared her findings on that high-risk project, explained the common signs of a Ponzi scheme in plain language, and took out the printed anti-fraud article. Seeing her father's gloomy expression, she promptly pulled out brochures for two low-risk bank funds and suggested dividing the retirement money into two parts: one part for stable allocation and one part for flexible use. After more than an hour of conversation, her father let out a long sigh and finally conceded: 'You're really thoughtful. Dad will follow your advice.' Yu Xiaowei was greatly relieved and immediately agreed with her father to go to the bank together on Monday morning.
location: No. 20, Hongyun Roast Meat and Tea Restaurant, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home, feeling relaxed.
description: Walking out of the Hong Kong-style diner, Yu Xiaowei felt the heavy burden of the past few days completely lifted, and her steps felt much lighter. She took a deep breath, feeling the weekend afternoon sunshine and breeze, and a relaxed smile that she hadn't had in a while appeared on her face.
location: From Hongyun Roast Meat and Tea Restaurant, No. 20, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to home at Whampoa Garden

name: Family rest and tidying up
description: Back home, she saw Xuanxuan doing homework in the study and Xinxin in the living room learning origami from her grandmother. She sat down on the sofa, changed into comfortable loungewear, and while drinking water, opened the Guangdong embroidery sketches she had drawn that afternoon and used her phone to look up specific embroidery thread color combinations. Meanwhile, she took out her tablet to show Xinxin photos from the art festival, and set Xinxin's best drawing, 'Ballet Dancer and Butterfly,' as her phone wallpaper.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room and study at home)

name: Getting ready to leave for Kwun Tong
description: Yu Xiaowei called the children to change into their going-out clothes. Her husband Zhang Weiming had also prepared the ingredients to take to his mother's home (he was in charge of the steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce tonight). She put the afternoon conversation materials into her bag, and the family got into the car chatting and laughing, with her husband driving toward Kwun Tong.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drive to Kwun Tong, buying fruit along the way.
description: While driving to Kwun Tong, Yu Xiaowei remembered that her mother-in-law liked sweet dragon fruit, so she asked her husband to pull over near Kwun Tong Market. She got out with Xinxin, picked out several red-fleshed dragon fruits and two bunches of imported grapes at a familiar fruit stall, and the whole stop took only 10 minutes.
location: Kwun Tong Market, Shui Wo Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to her mother-in-law's home
description: The drive from the market to the mother-in-law's home took about 18 minutes. In the car, Yu Xiaowei talked to the children about the new song they were going to perform later, and the car was filled with laughter and cheerful voices. At around 18:05 in the evening, the family arrived at the mother-in-law's home in Golden Bridge Mansion, Kwun Tong.
location: Golden Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening reunion dinner at the mother-in-law's house
description: Arrived at the mother-in-law's home, and the aroma of winter melon, barley, and old duck soup filled the living room. Zhang Weiming immediately put on an apron and took charge in the kitchen, with his mother Li Shufen helping on the side. Yu Xiaowei washed the fruit she had just bought and set it on the table. Three generations of the family sat around the dining table, and the atmosphere was warm. At the table, Yu Xiaowei announced, "Dad's financial investment issues have been properly resolved, and we'll go to the bank to get it done next Monday." Everyone raised their glasses (toasting with tea instead of wine) to celebrate. After the meal, the children performed new songs and dances they had learned in kindergarten, while the adults chatted about everyday family matters, and laughter kept filling the room.
location: Home of mother-in-law Li Shufen, Golden Bridge Mansion, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return trip, driving home
description: As night deepened, the family of four said goodbye to her parents and mother-in-law and drove back to Kowloon. The children were a little sleepy in the car. Yu Xiaowei gently patted her daughter and chatted with her husband about where to take the children tomorrow. The road back was smooth, and they arrived home in about 14 minutes.
location: From 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District to 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family care
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowei and her husband split the chores. She ran the bathwater for Xinxin and Xuanxuan and got them into their pajamas. Then she sat beside Xinxin's bed and read her two picture books until she fell asleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West (bathroom and children's room at home)

name: Personal relaxation and organization
description: The children were all asleep, and the house grew quiet. Yu Xiaowei returned to the study and took out this morning's sketchbook again, retracing the lines and ideas from today's inspiration and thoughts with a fine-tipped pen. She opened her phone and sent a short message to Teacher Wu Xiuying, asking if she would be free to go to the studio next week, planning to officially launch the “Butterfly Dance” series.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West (home study)

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She removed her makeup, did her skincare routine, and changed into pajamas. Lying in bed, she briefly exchanged a few words with her husband about how she felt today. She told herself that everything was moving in a good direction. With satisfaction and peace of mind, she turned off the lights and fell asleep at exactly 22:30.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West (home bedroom)

name: Early morning recovery jog and personal ritual
description: At 06:20, Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally with the faint light outside the window, got up quietly, put on her new running shoes, drank a few sips of warm water, and did some simple stretching in the living room. At 06:32, she set off from Whampoa Garden, jogged along Tak Man Street and Tung Lee Road for about 7 minutes to reach Kowloon Tsai Park, completed 3 km along the jogging trail with a steady pace of 7:15 per kilometer, and deliberately slowed down for the last 200 m to feel her breathing steady. After the run, she did 10 minutes of stretching beside a park bench and took a half-length selfie in the morning light with her phone, posting it to the 'CFP Study Group' with the caption 'First step of the restart, 3 km, feeling great!' At 07:20, she jogged home, showered, washed up, and changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region); Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Family breakfast time
description: Yu Xiaowei came out after her shower, and her mother Chen Meiling had already heated up white congee and fried eggs and sausages. She invited the whole family to sit down, and while eating, chatted with her husband Zhang Weiming about the division of labor for today's big cleaning: he would handle the air-conditioner filters and fans, she would take care of sorting clothes, and the children would help out. Yu Xiaowei cut the fried egg into small pieces for her daughter Zhang Yuxin and reminded her son Zhang Zixuan to warm up properly before playing football in the morning. The breakfast atmosphere was relaxed and lively, and the sun was shining brightly outside the window.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family trip preparations and parent-child time at the park
description: After breakfast, the whole family changed into casual clothes. Daughter Zhang Yuxin put on her new pink ballet tulle skirt and twirled excitedly in the living room. At 08:45, Yu Xiaowei brought her phone, water bottle, and picnic mat, and the family of five walked to Kowloon Tsai Park. On the way they passed Whampoa New World mall, where Zhang Yuxin was drawn to a toy in the storefront window and stopped for a moment. They arrived at the park at 09:10. Zhang Yuxin spun and danced freely on the grass, and Yu Xiaowei captured many adorable moments with her phone. Son Zhang Zixuan and father Zhang Weiming played football nearby, and mother Chen Meiling sat on a bench tidying their things. Yu Xiaowei sat on the picnic mat, enjoying this rare quiet Sunday.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Inquiring about summer swimming classes for her son.
description: When the park activity reached 09:50, Yu Xiaowei let her husband and mother continue playing with the children and walked alone to the adjacent Ho Man Tin Sports Centre and Swimming Pool. She arrived at 10:00. At the service desk, she asked the staff in detail about the summer children's swimming class curriculum, instructors, and fees, and learned that the beginner class (ages 6-10) still had openings. As planned, she enrolled her son Zhang Zixuan in the eight-week course (Tuesday and Thursday mornings), paid on the spot, and received the registration confirmation slip, thinking that this arrangement would fit right into his summer break. At 10:35, she walked back from the sports centre to the park.
location: Ho Man Tin Sports Centre and Swimming Pool (1 Chung Yee Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Wrapping up the park activity and heading home.
description: After Yu Xiaowei returned to the park, the children were almost done playing. She helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin brush the grass clippings off her dress, and the family sat on a bench to rest for ten minutes, sharing the water they had brought. At 11:00, they packed up and walked home. On the way, Zhang Yuxin imitated her father's soccer moves, while Zhang Zixuan excitedly told Yu Xiaowei how many goals he had scored. They arrived home at 11:25, the children washed their hands and faces, and Yu Xiaowei began preparing ingredients for lunch.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region) Whampoa Garden Residential Estate (Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Video call with my best friend during lunch
description: Her mother Chen Meiling had made a simple, warm lunch (stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, greens, and steamed fish). While eating, Yu Xiaowei video-called her best friend Lin Jiaxin on her phone. They chatted for about 15 minutes. Jiaxin mentioned that the school's parent-child sports day was worrying about props, and Yu Xiaowei excitedly shared the “Butterfly Dance” sketch she had drawn over the weekend and suggested making a class sign with Cantonese embroidery. Jiaxin laughed at her for being too “over the top” but supported her in picking up embroidery again. They also agreed to meet up around Mother's Day. After the call, Yu Xiaowei finished her meal at ease and helped her mother clear the dishes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon chores and seasonal organizing
description: At 13:00, the family housecleaning officially began. Yu Xiaowei was responsible for storing the thick quilts and sweaters from the master bedroom and storage room, packing them in batches into vacuum compression bags, then placing them on the top shelf of the storage cabinet. During this time she repeatedly squatted, stood, and stretched, joking that it was extra training. Her husband Zhang Weiming carried a ladder, removed the air-conditioner filters in the living room and bedrooms, took them to the bathroom and carefully scrubbed them with a brush, and wiped the fan blades clean with a damp cloth. The children helped in the living room by passing hangers and fetching cleaning tools. Although they occasionally made a mess, the atmosphere was cheerful. At 16:10, the seasonal reorganization was basically complete, and the spring clothes were neatly hung back in the wardrobe. Yu Xiaowei looked around with satisfaction and felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family rest and preparation for going out
description: After the big cleaning, everyone rested. The children returned to their room to play with toys and watch cartoons. Yu Xiaowei sat down on the sofa, drank a glass of warm water, and browsed messages in the running community. She saw friends from the CFP study group giving her likes and comments, which warmed her heart. Her husband Zhang Weiming went to take a shower, and Yu Xiaowei helped her mother Chen Meiling fold the dry towels that had just been collected. At 17:00, she began preparing the items to take out for dinner: wallet, keys, phone, wet wipes. At 17:20, the whole family changed into going-out casual clothes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family went out for dinner in the evening
description: At 17:30, the whole family left on time and walked to Jiataihe Japanese-style Restaurant. On the way, they passed a fruit stall near Whampoa Garden, and Yu Xiaowei bought some strawberries. They arrived at the restaurant at 17:44. The children excitedly picked up the menus as soon as they entered. Yu Xiaowei ordered tamago sushi and crab roe salad for her daughter Zhang Yuxin, grilled salmon for her husband Zhang Weiming, and her favorite scallops for herself. The whole meal cost about HK$320. Everyone ate and chatted, and the children happily compared whose plate pattern was the most interesting. At 18:20, after paying the bill, the family left satisfied.
location: Jia Tai He Japanese-Style Cuisine (Chongjing Building Branch) (Ground Floor, Chongjing Building, Chongjie Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: After-dinner walk and return home.
