description: Coming out of the sushi restaurant, Yu Xiaowei suggested walking home along Sung Kit Street and Tak Man Street to help digest the meal. A gentle evening breeze blew away the slight heat of the day. They passed a few small shops; her daughter Zhang Yuxin was attracted by the handmade hair clips in the shop window and stopped to look for a while. Holding the children's hands, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her husband about next week's plans. At 18:55, the family slowly walked back to the entrance of Whampoa Garden.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate on Sung Kit Street and Tak Man Street, Kowloon City District (Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District)

name: Evening family time and putting the children to bed
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei had the children wash their hands and change into pajamas first. In the living room, she watched an episode of her daughter Zhang Yuxin's favorite cartoon with her, while her husband Zhang Weiming checked their son Zhang Zixuan's weekend homework in the room. At 20:00, she read two picture book stories to Zhang Yuxin, and the child fell asleep while listening. She then went to Zhang Zixuan's room and told him to turn off the light and go to sleep. Once the children were settled, Yu Xiaowei felt that most of the day's tasks had been completed, and she felt a great sense of relief.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Study room plan: CFP study and Cantonese embroidery
description: After the children were all asleep, Yu Xiaowei went into her study and started her planning time for the evening. First she took out a new desk calendar and marked several dates in May with a highlighter (the dates for the key modules of the CFP course; she planned to study on Tuesday and Thursday evenings). Then she took out a sketchbook and a notebook and outlined the specific material list needed for the Butterfly Dance Cantonese embroidery: pure silk base fabric (moon-white), gradient silk threads (pink-purple, goose yellow, light green), No. 12 embroidery needles, embroidery hoop, and so on. She decided to contact her teacher Wu Xiuying after work the next day to book a visit to her studio next Saturday morning to ask about stitching techniques and, in the meantime, order the materials. She worked until 22:00 and felt her thoughts were very clear.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime social contact and rest
description: At 22:00, Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, picked up her phone, and sent a WeChat message to her running buddy Shen Peiwen (Awen): “Awen, I ran 3 kilometers this morning and felt great! I'm ready for the first Wednesday night run in May!” Awen quickly replied with a “Waiting for you!” sticker. She put down her phone contentedly, washed up briefly, and turned off the lights at 22:15 to go to bed. Today, she not only achieved a small personal breakthrough in running, but also enjoyed family time and made plans for future study. She fell asleep with a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning CFP study
description: In the faint early light, I got up under the desk lamp in the study, put on a thin jacket, brewed black coffee, and began studying the CFP materials, focusing on the “Retirement Planning and Tax Management” chapter. I worked through cases and calculated in my notebook, highlighted key points with a marker, and used the Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of study, 5 minutes of rest for water and stretching), completing the scheduled chapters and exercises.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, study room

name: Family morning preparations and breakfast goodbyes
description: After finishing studying, she woke her husband Zhang Weiming, and they divided the work: her husband woke the son and daughter and prepared a simple breakfast (milk, cereal, bread), while she checked the ballet dress, tights, and ballet shoes for her daughter Zhang Yuxin, filled a water bottle with warm water and put it in the side pocket of the schoolbag, and sorted the laundry into the washing machine. Then the whole family had breakfast in the dining room with her mother Chen Meiling, who had already prepared plain congee. During the meal, she reminded her daughter to change into her ballet dress after school and told her son he could watch 15 minutes of cartoons in the evening. At 08:00 she kissed the children goodbye, her husband took them to school, and she went back to the bedroom to change into business attire and put on light makeup, cheering herself on.
location: Living room, kitchen, children's room, and dining room at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Commute: home to office.
description: She left home with a sun umbrella and walked 8 minutes to Whampoa MTR Station, then took the Kwun Tong Line, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line, and then to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she used her phone to confirm client He Junjie's car insurance renewal terms and deadline. She arrived at Exit A2 of Wan Chai Station at 08:45, walked to AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, and bought sugar-free oolong tea and a pineapple bun at the lobby convenience store as afternoon snacks.
location: Walk from Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Whampoa MTR station; take the Kwun Tong line (Whampoa Station to Mong Kok Station), the Tsuen Wan line (Mong Kok Station to Admiralty Station), and the Island line (Admiralty Station to Wan Chai Station); then walk out of the station to AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Arrive at work and attend the team weekly meeting
description: She swiped her access card to enter the office, greeted the colleagues on duty, put down her belongings, turned on her computer, browsed the meeting outline that her supervisor Liang Zhenhua had posted in the team group chat, took a sip of oolong tea, and organized her thoughts for reporting on the progress of Wang Qiming's cross-border plan. At 09:00, she attended the weekly team meeting on time, listened to Director Liang Zhenhua's summary of last week's performance and deployment of key projects this week, briefly reported on the progress of the weekend communication with Guangzhou colleague Guo Junwei, confirmed that the final version of the plan would be sent this morning, and noticed colleague Su Lishan winking to hint that there would be a surprise at noon.
location: Office area and Conference Room B on the 12th floor of AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Finalizing and sending the cross-border group insurance proposal
description: After the meeting, she returned to her desk, opened the draft of the Wang Qiming Cross-Border Group Insurance Plan that had been confirmed by email with Guangzhou colleague Guo Junwei, carefully checked the list of designated mainland hospitals and the details of the emergency medical evacuation clauses, added risk warnings specific to Mr. Wang's personal situation, and wrote a formal email with professional wording. At 10:40, she sent the plan by email to Wang Qiming and copied her supervisor Liang Zhenhua, then left a WeChat message saying that she could schedule a video meeting at any time for a detailed explanation.
location: Yu Xiaowei's workstation, 12/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Customer renewal reminders and contact
description: After sending the important email, logged into the customer management system to pull up the auto insurance policy of old classmate He Junjie, confirmed it expires next week, called him, and reminded him about the renewal in a relaxed tone. He Junjie said he was just thinking about that and mentioned the idea of a class reunion. Yu Xiaowei readily agreed to take charge of organizing it once she got through this busy period. The call lasted about 10 minutes.
location: Yu Xiaowei's workstation, 12/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Lunch with colleague Su Lishan.
description: After receiving a WhatsApp invitation from Su Lishan at 11:50, met at The Coffee Academics on basement level B1 of Shui On Centre at 12:25. I ordered an avocado chicken sandwich and Earl Grey tea; Su Lishan ordered the signature pineapple bun with butter and iced milk tea. Su Shan took out a hand-drawn card she had made, with an orange cat and flowers on it, and the message 'Congratulations on Grandma's recovery & the cat coming home, keep going Ah Wei!' I was deeply moved, took a photo and sent it to the family group chat; my husband replied with a smiley emoji. The two of us ate and chatted, and Su Shan shared funny stories from last week's short trip to Lamma Island.
location: The Coffee Academics, B1, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong.

name: Afternoon work and client research
description: After the lunch break, I returned to my desk feeling energized, efficiently handled 5 customer calls and replied to 3 emails. Opened an Excel spreadsheet to plan next week's client visit schedule, focusing on two new-parent clients with newborns, and selected suitable savings and health insurance product portfolios. At 15:10, tidied up the desk and cleared out my daughter's ballet bag to take home in the afternoon.
location: Yu Xiaowei's workstation, 12/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Commute: company to ballet studio.
description: To make sure she arrived at the dance studio before 16:40, she took the MTR to avoid the evening rush hour. She walked from AIA Building to Wan Chai Station, took the Island Line, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line and then to the Kwun Tong Line, and got off at Whampoa Station. On the train, she put on earphones and played a relaxing Cantonese podcast. After leaving the station, she walked to Kai Tak Garden Mall at 388 Prince Edward Road West, texting her mother on the way to say she was going to pick up her daughter.
location: Walk from AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong to Wan Chai MTR Station, take the Island Line (Wan Chai Station to Admiralty Station), the Tsuen Wan Line (Admiralty Station to Mong Kok Station), and the Kwun Tong Line (Mong Kok Station to Whampoa Station), then walk from the station to Kai Tak Garden Mall, 388 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City.

name: Pick up daughter from class and pay tuition
description: Arriving at the Wuyue Ballet Studio on the 2nd floor of Kai Tak Garden Shopping Mall, she watched her daughter Zhang Yuxin through the glass window, focused on small jump combinations in her new ballet dress. Using the corridor space, she did three sets of wall sits as supplementary exercise, and exchanged running tips with another parent. After class, her daughter excitedly showed off her new moves. She squatted down to praise her and wipe off her sweat. Together they went to the front desk to ask Teacher Zhu about summer course arrangements, paid next month's tuition via WeChat Pay on her phone, and thanked the teacher for the video assignment guidance sent during the previous class suspension.
location: Corridor, front desk and rest area of Wuyue Ballet Studio, 2/F, Kai Tak Garden Shopping Centre, 388 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City, Hong Kong

name: Commute: from the dance studio to home
description: When leaving the mall, she bought the next day's breakfast (a loaf of sliced bread) at the community bakery downstairs. The mother and daughter walked home, chatting about the daughter drawing with her good friend at school, and returned to their home in Whampoa Garden at 17:45.
location: Walk from Kai Tak Garden Shopping Centre, 388 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City, to Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Evening Family Reunion and Dinner
description: After arriving home and changing into loungewear, Yu Xiaowei joined her mother Chen Meiling in the kitchen. While washing vegetables, she talked about the day's work and the card her colleagues had given her; her mother praised the colleagues for being thoughtful. Her daughter watched cartoons in the living room. Together they prepared home-style dishes such as pork bone soup. After 19:00, her husband Zhang Weiming brought their son Zhang Zixuan home. She helped her son put away his schoolbag and poured water for him, and exchanged glances with her husband to hint at a family meeting after dinner. Her mother Chen Meiling made a table of dishes: steamed grass carp, garlic choy sum, stir-fried tomato and eggs, and pork bone soup. Her father Yu Guoqiang also sat down to eat, and the family chatted while eating: her father mentioned how the mango tree downstairs was growing, her daughter shared her new ballet moves, her son complained that his math homework was hard, and the couple encouraged their son.
location: Kitchen, living room, and dining room of Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family meeting
description: After dinner, I cleared the table and asked my mother to take the children to bathe. Then I sat down formally with my husband in the living room, took out my phone calendar, and confirmed again that the new routine would take effect from May 1: I would get up at 5 a.m. every day to study for the CFP until 7. My husband solemnly promised to get up with me, brew honey water, and read beside me, and to help me organize the wrong questions every Saturday afternoon. The two of us high-fived to seal the pact, feeling warm in our hearts.
location: Sofa area in the living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Bedtime companionship and family chores
description: After the meeting, she checked her son's homework and encouraged him with star stickers, then read her daughter's two favorite picture-book stories. Afterward, she went to the balcony, took in the dried clothes, folded them, and put them back in the wardrobe.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, children's room, balcony, and living room

name: Gratitude before bed and falling asleep
description: After washing up, I wrote a gratitude journal in my phone's memo app, recording that today the proposal for General Manager Wang was sent out, a colleague gave a heartwarming card, watching my daughter dance was healing, and my husband and I confirmed our routine to work side by side. I set the 5:00 alarm, took off the soothing eye mask, turned off the light, and fell asleep quickly with a sense of peace and anticipation for tomorrow, sleeping soundly all night.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential complex, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Early morning study and reflection on daily routine
description: At 5 AM, after the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei got up and went to the study to begin studying the CFP risk management chapter. Because of fatigue from getting up early several days in a row, she could hardly concentrate after less than half an hour of studying. She realized that the 5 AM study plan was unrealistic, wrote in her notebook, "The 5 AM plan failed; it doesn't work for me," decided to give up the plan, then leaned back in her chair and rested with her eyes closed, reconsidering a daily routine that suited her better.
location: Master bedroom and study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning family wake-up and outing preparations
description: At 6:15, Yu Xiaowei first went to her daughter's room to wake Xinxin, helped her change into a floral dress, then woke her son Xuanxuan and urged him to wash up. Next, she took out an ironed pale blue-green jacquard xiangyun gauze blouse for her mother Chen Meiling, who happily took it. At 6:45, she urged her husband Zhang Weiming to go to the parking lot to get the car, helped her father Yu Guoqiang straighten his collar, and calmed his nerves about meeting the mother of his son-in-law. When the family was ready, they set off for the teahouse.
location: All rooms and the entrance hall, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family morning tea gathering: celebrating recovery and reconciliation
description: The family walked along the old streets of Kowloon City for about 15 minutes, and at 7:10 they met up with her husband and children at the entrance of the teahouse. Her mother-in-law Li Shufen also arrived just in time. Yu Xiaowei led everyone to the reserved large round table by the window. During dim sum, shrimp dumplings, siu mai, and other dishes were served one after another. Her mother-in-law was the first to raise her glass to thank Xiaowei and Weiming for their care; her father Yu Guoqiang also stood up and apologized, thanking his daughter for her earlier persuasion and efforts to mend the relationship. Yu Xiaowei said with tears in her eyes, "The most important thing for a family is to be together." The children, meanwhile, competed to eat shrimp dumplings. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious, and the rift vanished.
location: Di Mao Guan Teahouse, Nga Tsin Long Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanied her parents shopping at the street market.
description: After morning tea, Yu Xiaowei asked her husband to take her mother-in-law and the children home first, while she accompanied her parents around the Kowloon City fabric market. Her mother took a liking to a piece of light cyan cotton-linen fabric and wanted to make a qipao for Xinxin. Xiaowei paid for it and suggested that, after she completed her apprenticeship, she would embroider flowers on the cuffs. Her father selected top-quality dried fish maw at the dried goods stall and insisted that she bring it to her mother-in-law as nourishment. At exactly 10 o'clock, the three of them said goodbye at the market entrance. Her parents took a bus home, and Yu Xiaowei checked the map on her phone and decided to take the MTR to her office in Wan Chai.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Nga Tsin Long Road Fabric Market and Street Market, Kowloon City District

name: Commuted by MTR to the company in Wan Chai
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from Kowloon City to Lok Fu Station, took the Kwun Tong line to Mong Kok, transferred to the Tsuen Wan line to Admiralty, then transferred to the Island line to Wan Chai Station, the whole journey taking about 50 minutes. On the train, she used the time to handle client messages and emails and sort out her afternoon work list. At 10:55 a.m., she arrived at Wan Chai Station and walked five minutes to the company.
location: MTR line from Kowloon City District to Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning and afternoon work tasks and a light lunch.
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei first dealt with the internal reports that had piled up over the weekend and revised the data. Then she prepared a PPT on the feasibility of the cross-border business team, reviewing Wang Qiming's case experience, and called bank relationship manager Li Guodong to arrange a detailed meeting on Friday afternoon about corporate group insurance cooperation. At 1 p.m., she went downstairs to the cafe at Shui On Centre for a sandwich and iced lemon tea, looking at her daughter's butterfly sketch and her own embroidery design ideas while eating. After lunch, she was focused, polished the PPT, emailed it to her superior Liang Zhenhua, then handled renewal inquiries from two long-term clients and confirmed follow-up visits for next week.
location: Office in the AIA Building (Immigration Tower), 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the café in the Shui On Centre downstairs

name: Go to Sham Shui Po to visit the embroidery teacher
description: Yu Xiaowei left work early and took the subway to Sham Shui Po with a carefully wrapped gift box of Tieguanyin tea. On the way, she repeatedly reviewed the stitching techniques for her daughter's butterfly painting design. At 4 p.m., she arrived at Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio, handed over the gift, and showed her daughter's painting and her own sketches. Teacher Wu praised them highly and suggested using silk organza and silver thread, embroidering with scattered stitch and rolling stitch. She also guided her hand by hand and prepared the materials, and agreed to teach every Sunday afternoon. Yu Xiaowei left with the newly prepared materials and creative passion.
location: Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio, Yu Chau Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening rush hour returning home and family dinner
description: At 17:30, Yu Xiaowei returned from Sham Shui Po, taking the MTR Tsuen Wan Line and transferring to the Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station. The carriage was crowded during rush hour, but she was in a good mood. She arrived home at 18:30, where her mother had already prepared a table of dishes, including steamed fish and garlic broccoli. At the dinner table, Yu Xiaowei shared amusing stories about formally becoming a student of her teacher, saying that her daughter's painting had been praised, and Xinxin was immensely proud. The whole family was joyful and harmonious.
location: Restaurant, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening parent-child time and general family matters.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei first checked her son Xuanxuan's math homework, guided him to correct the mistakes, and then accompanied her daughter Xinxin in reading The Very Hungry Caterpillar; the children looked forward to Mom embroidering a butterfly. Afterwards, she did 15 minutes of stretching and 3 sets of wall sits on the balcony, completing her exercise check-in. Then she and her husband video-called her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in the living room to tell him about their father's recent condition and put his mind at ease. She also reviewed her daily routine with her husband, admitted that the 5 a.m. plan was not feasible, and decided to change it to getting up at 6:30 and extending evening study time by 1 hour, with her husband's support.
location: Children's room, balcony and living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation and grateful sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei took a hot bath and applied a face mask, then lay in bed reading "Illustrated Guide to Cantonese Embroidery Stitches." At 22:00, she turned off the light and reviewed in the dark the things worth being grateful for that day: family harmony, her father's emotional burden being resolved, the restart of her embroidery hobby, and having made a sustainable study plan. Her heart was full of peace and strength, and at 22:15 she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: Yu Xiaowei was woken by the alarm at 6:30, did 10 minutes of stretching in bed, including cat-cow pose and shoulder and neck circles, to ease the fatigue of taking care of her daughter. Then she got out of bed, stood by the window watching the street market gradually come to life, practiced 5 minutes of mindful breathing, silently recited the three most important things for the day: the regional meeting, accompanying her mother-in-law to treatment, and the family monthly settlement. With this pragmatic and efficient morning ritual, she started a busy day at the end of the month.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family teamwork and breakfast
description: Yu Xiaowei went to the kitchen and quickly divided the work with her mother Chen Meiling. Her mother cooked plain congee and steamed shrimp dumplings, while Yu Xiaowei was in charge of frying eggs and toasting bread. As she fried the eggs, she confirmed with her mother the filling for tonight's wontons (shrimp, pork, and wood ear mushroom) and the wrappers (to be bought at Jiaxing Grocery Store downstairs). Her husband Zhang Weiming urged the two children to hurry through breakfast and pack their school bags. Yu Xiaowei reminded her husband that the weather forecast said there would be thunderstorms in the evening, so remember to put an umbrella in the children's bags. She also confirmed with her father Yu Guoqiang whether he was going to Kwun Tong that afternoon (he was going to visit old neighbors, so it would fit well to go together later to pick up her mother-in-law, but because of the timing she decided to go herself, so her father could meet his friends at ease).
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, kitchen and dining room

name: Confirm before going out
description: Her husband first took the two children downstairs to the garage to get the car and drive them to school. Yu Xiaowei changed into her black commuter flats at the entrance, checked her handbag: confirmed the tablet with the regional meeting PPT, pens, makeup bag, fully charged power bank, folding umbrella, and massage cream prepared for her mother-in-law. She wrote "We're making wontons tonight, start at 7!" on the whiteboard behind the door to remind the family.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, entryway

name: Commuting and micro-learning.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked seven minutes to MTR Whampoa Station and boarded a train toward Admiralty at 8:10. She found a corner seat and took out her tablet to continue reading the PPT closely. In the notes section of the page on "integrating Shenzhen and Hong Kong client resources," she added a local case data point sent by her colleague Guo Junwei from Guangzhou last week. After finishing the PPT, she opened the Duolingo app and used the fragmented time to review five Japanese words related to "family" and "health."
location: Inside the MTR train carriage from Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparation before the morning meeting.
description: After exiting the MTR station, Yu Xiaowei bought a hot unsweetened latte at the convenience store in Convention Plaza, then walked to the office. She walked into the office at 9:20 and saw Su Lishan already at her desk. She clipped together three printed PPT copies and a shorthand outline, then greeted Su Lishan and said, "Shanshan, at today's meeting, I'll formally present my cross-border proposal. Last time you mentioned a client with cross-border needs; let's discuss it later." Su Lishan made a 'you can do it' gesture to her.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Immigration Tower office at 7 Gloucester Road, and the Convention Plaza convenience store at 1 Harbour Road

name: Monthly regional business meeting.
description: The meeting was held in Meeting Room A of the Immigration Tower. Regional Director Liang Zhenhua first summarized the overall performance of the previous month. When it was Yu Xiaowei's turn to report, she clearly presented her team's data (renewal rate, new customer growth points) and formally and confidently proposed the idea of establishing a dedicated cross-border business team. She used a PPT to show an analysis of the complementarity of customer resources between Shenzhen and Hong Kong, citing the mainland cases provided by her colleague Guo Junwei. Director Liang Zhenhua was very approving and asked her to submit a detailed feasibility plan before the end of the second quarter, hinting that success could bring promotion opportunities. The meeting ended at 11:45, and Yu Xiaowei felt very encouraged.
location: Conference Room A, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Quick lunch and preparation.
description: As soon as the meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei quickly returned to her workstation, took out the pre-prepared sandwich and banana from her lunch bag, and while eating, booked a ride-hailing service online from the company to Kwun Tong Community Centre at 12:30 to save time. She called her mother: “Mom, I'll be in Kwun Tong around 1 p.m. I won't come back for lunch. You can manage on your own.”
location: Office at Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompany mother-in-law to complete physical therapy
description: Yu Xiaowei got into the ride-hailing car on time and set off, arriving at Kwun Tong Community Centre about 15 minutes later. Her mother-in-law Li Shufen was already waiting for her at the entrance. She accompanied her mother-in-law inside for the last physiotherapy session. While waiting, she made good use of the time to do 3 sets of wall sits and 2 sets of bird dog exercises in the corridor to keep up her energy. The therapist said her mother-in-law had recovered very well and gave advanced home training advice, such as using resistance bands. Yu Xiaowei recorded the entire session on video to send to her husband. Afterward, her mother-in-law happily said she could now walk in the park without a cane. When they walked out of the centre, the sunshine was just right, and Yu Xiaowei, linking arms with her, sat with her for 5 minutes on a bench beside a flowerbed by the road, listening to her chat about everyday things.
location: Pneumoconiosis Mutual Aid Association Jockey Club Community Chest and Lung Rehabilitation Centre, 297 Ngau Tau Kok Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return trip and shopping along the way.
description: Yu Xiaowei waited with her mother-in-law for the bus home, watched her get on board, then went to the bakery at Kwun Tong MTR Station and bought breakfast for the family the next morning (two pineapple buns and one raisin wheat bun). She returned to the AIA Building office at 14:45.
location: Bakery inside Kwun Tong MTR Station, Kwun Tong District, and Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling month-end matters.
description: After returning to her desk, Yu Xiaowei started handling the backlog of end-of-month tasks: checking the payroll records, organizing the reimbursement receipts, and submitting them to the system. Then she called over the new hire, He Junwen, and assigned him a task: “Ah Wen, could you help me compile an Excel spreadsheet of the clients whose birthdays are next month, sorted by date and sum insured from high to low, and give it to me before Friday?” He nodded in agreement. Meanwhile, she received an inquiry from a long-time client about dividends on a savings policy, and she immediately replied via WeChat with a detailed explanation and a comparison chart.
location: Office at Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went home early and bought ingredients for wrapping wontons.
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off her computer and left work on time. She took the Island Line to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line. After getting off at Mong Kok East Station, she made a special detour to Mak Man Kee Noodle Shop on Parkes Street in Jordan and bought some fresher, sweeter local sea shrimp, which were fresher than the ones at the supermarket. Then she walked home.
location: Mak Man Kee Noodle Shop, Ground Floor, 51 Parkes Street, Jordan, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong SAR, and Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: The whole family making wontons together
description: When Yu Xiaowei got home, her mother had already prepared the meat filling and wood ear mushrooms. After washing her hands, she chopped the fresh shrimp and mixed them into the meat filling. At 17:50, her husband brought the two children home. She told them to wash their hands and gather around the dining table to wrap wontons together. The scene was lively and chaotic: her son Zhang Zixuan wrapped the small wontons into big buns, while her daughter Zhang Yuxin pinched every pleat with great care. Her husband recorded with his phone on the side, and her mother said with a smile that Yu Xiaowei was just like that when she was little. Outside the window, thunder rumbled faintly and a fine rain began to fall. The family sat together in the kitchen, sending tray after tray of wrapped wontons into the steamer and boiling water.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, kitchen and dining room

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: The fresh wontons were served, and the filling made by Yu Xiaowei and her mother was very popular; the children ate several bowls. During the meal, her husband shared the story of a difficult client he had encountered at work that day and had managed to win over, and her father Yu Guoqiang said he had beaten an old neighbor at chess in the afternoon. The whole family burst into laughter. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei had her husband and mother clear the table, while she watched 15 minutes of the cartoon the two children liked with them.
location: Restaurant, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: April review and May plan
description: Yu Xiaowei went into the study, opened her diary and phone memo, and did a checklist-style review: positive events (mother-in-law recovering, proposal approved); lessons (Japanese interrupted, long-distance running interrupted); May goals (morning runs of 5K every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday; embroidery practice on Sunday afternoons; 1.5 hours of CFP in the evening; learning Japanese in spare moments during commutes). She shared a reflection in the CFP study group: “The biggest takeaway today is not work recognition, but the realization that family harmony is the foundation of every plan.” She also attached a photo she had just taken of a plate of wrapped wontons.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child interaction before bedtime, stretching, and going to sleep.
description: Yu Xiaowei first put her daughter Zhang Yuxin to bed and played her favorite audiobook, The Very Hungry Caterpillar, on her phone. When the story ended, her daughter asked, "Mommy, will the butterfly you embroidered fly away?" She kissed her daughter on the forehead and said, "It will always stay on Mommy's embroidery hoop, keeping you company." After leaving the children's room, she did 15 minutes of bedtime stretching on the yoga mat in the master bedroom (focusing on relaxing her hips and front thighs from long sitting) and 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation. Lying down beside her husband, she said, "In May, let's take Mom and Dad and the kids to Sai Kung for yum cha on the weekend." He said yes. Before going to sleep, she picked up her phone and sent a voice message to her running friend Shen Peiwen to arrange a night run. At 22:15, she turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of the rain gradually fading outside the window.
location: Children's room and master bedroom in the Whampoa Garden residential estate at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: In the early morning, she unrolled her yoga mat by the bedroom window and followed an app-guided 10-minute vinyasa flow, focusing on stretching her shoulders, neck, and hips. Then she did five minutes of mindfulness meditation, feeling her mind and body fully settle into the holiday morning while birds sang outside the window.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, by the master bedroom window

name: Family breakfast.
description: My mother cooked wonton noodles in clear broth, served with char siu bao and fruit, and the family sat around eating breakfast. I reminded my husband to bring the refrigerated green and red radishes and pork bones for my mother-in-law to make soup, and my father said he was going to the street market to buy live grouper.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: CFP course trial session.
description: Went into the study, made a cup of green tea, opened the laptop, logged into the CFP learning platform, and clicked on the first video lesson, Functions and Legal Framework of Life Insurance, in the Risk Management and Insurance Planning module. She took notes on key terms while listening and remained highly focused throughout.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the children for outdoor activities.
description: I took the children downstairs to the central garden. My son raced bikes with the neighbor kids, and my daughter pulled me to play on the slide and in the sandpit. While watching them, I used my phone to reply to client Mrs. Lin's holiday greetings and recorded a video of my daughter laughing and playing, which I sent to the family group chat.
location: Central Garden, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Travel preparation
description: She took the children home to change into clean clothes, changed into a fresh casual outfit herself, checked the nutritional supplements and fruit to bring to her mother-in-law, and walked downstairs holding the children's hands with her husband, ready to drive off.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to her mother-in-law's house.
description: My husband drove the private car, and I sat in the passenger seat checking the navigation to avoid congestion. Starting from Whampoa, we took the Princess Margaret Road Link, then turned onto the Kwun Tong Bypass. The whole journey took about 15 minutes, and we arrived smoothly at my mother-in-law's home in Yue Man Square, Kwun Tong.
location: While driving from Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Yue Man Square, Kwun Tong District

name: Visit her recovering mother-in-law
description: My mother-in-law had a rosy complexion and happily showed that she could bend over easily, showing no sign that she had used a cane before. She insisted on cooking green radish and carrot pork bone soup using the ingredients we brought. I went into the kitchen to help trim the vegetables, and we chatted and laughed, our relationship made closer by the care from before. The children ate coconut pudding in the living room. I showed my mother-in-law photos of my daughter's painting from the Spring Art Festival, and she praised it again and again.
location: At her mother-in-law's home, a residence on Yue Man Square, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Packing up cart noodles
description: After saying goodbye to her mother-in-law, she drove on the way to Xin Ji Cart Noodles on Hoi Bun Road in Kwun Tong, got out, and packed four servings of cart noodles to take home for lunch.
location: Xin Ji Cart Noodles, Hoi Bun Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove back home
description: After packing everything up, the whole family drove back to our home in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District. The trip took about 20 minutes.
location: During the drive from Kwun Tong District to Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District

name: Family lunch and homework help
description: After arriving home, the children went to wash their hands by themselves. My husband and I portioned out the cart noodles and invited my parents to enjoy them together. After lunch, my husband cleared the dishes, and I helped my son finish the last fraction word problem in his math homework, correcting a writing mistake.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon reading and relaxation
description: The children and their father are watching midday cartoons. I lean back on the sofa flipping through an e-book about mindful communication on my iPad. Outside the window, birdsong drifts in, and I feel very relaxed.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organized CFP course notes
description: Feeling energetic, she went into the study, brewed green tea, opened her laptop, organized the notes from the morning CFP trial course, and searched online for relevant cases on 'the key implementation points of the incontestability clause in practice,' preparing for the official study next week.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Hearing the sound of chopping in the kitchen, I washed my hands and went to help. Mother was preparing ginger and scallion slivers for the steamed grouper and the roast meat platter. I offered to pick and wash the choy sum, soak the dried scallops, and slice the roast goose and barbecued pork along the grain, arranging them on a plate. Chatting with Mother about the reconciliation with Father at the teahouse last time, she sighed that the most important thing is for the whole family to be together. I felt a warmth in my heart.
location: Kitchen at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Setting the table and welcoming the family
description: As dusk fell, my mother and I carried the cooked dishes to the dinner table and laid a hand-embroidered tablecloth. My husband came back from taking the kids for a walk, and the kids ran into the kitchen shouting, “Smells great!” I took bowls, dishes, and wine glasses out of the disinfection cabinet, set out eight sets of chopsticks and bowls, and my father placed the steamed grouper on the table, looking tempting.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Labor Day family dinner
description: The family sat around the table; the main dishes included steamed grouper, a duo of roast meats, blanched choy sum, and dried scallop and winter melon soup. I raised a glass first to thank my parents for managing the household, then toasted my husband for his understanding and support. My father talked about the funny story of flying kites on Labor Day when he was young, which made the children laugh heartily. My mother-in-law also joined via video call and kept praising how fresh and fragrant the food was.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-meal cleanup and parent-child games
description: After dinner, my husband and I worked in sync to clear the dishes and sort the trash. Afterwards, I flopped down on the living room sofa to play Ludo with the kids. My son tried to cheat by moving extra steps, my daughter carefully counted the squares, and I smiled while enforcing the rules, as my husband secretly took photos.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal care and Yue embroidery appreciation
description: The children were taken over by their father for washing up and bedtime, and I enjoyed an uninterrupted moment: I took a comfortable hot bath for half an hour, applied a hydrating mask, and felt my pores open up. Then I sat at the dressing table and carefully browsed more than ten Guangdong embroidery works newly posted on Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio WeChat official account. I zoomed in especially on the 'Butterfly and Flower' design, silently noting the layered effect of the butterfly wings created with the long-and-short stitch technique.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening communication planning with husband
description: After settling the children, my husband returned to the bedroom. I shared with him how the CFP trial class went in the morning and my plan to start studying 1.5 hours every evening next week. He expressed support and suggested taking leave tomorrow afternoon to pick up the children, so I could go to my meeting with bank client manager Li Guodong without worry. My heart warmed, and I leaned on his shoulder and whispered thanks.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime gratitude and preparation
description: After saying goodnight to her husband, she turned off the lights and left a small bedside lamp on. She opened the memo on her phone and noted several things to be grateful for today: her mother-in-law's recovery, family getting together, and the successful warm-up of the new routine. She checked the folder with materials for tomorrow's client meeting, hung up her suit, and set the alarm to 6:30, feeling genuinely grounded and satisfied.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Falling asleep
description: She turned off the lights and closed her eyes, images flashing through her mind: her mother-in-law's smiling face, a table full of dishes, and the children playing noisily. She took a deep breath, felt her husband's steady breathing beside her, and gradually fell into sleep, content and exhausted.
location: Bed in the master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and yoga meditation
description: At 6:00 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowei got up half an hour earlier than usual, feeling well rested. She opened the curtains to let the morning light spill into the bedroom and began a 12-minute vinyasa flow yoga practice on the window seat cushion, including poses such as Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, and Warrior II, focusing on spinal flow. She then did 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath to clear her mind. After the practice, she washed up briefly, changed into loungewear, and started the new day full of energy.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family preparation and morning interaction
description: Yu Xiaowei walked out of the bedroom and saw her mother Chen Meiling already busy making breakfast in the kitchen, so she took the initiative to set out the bowls and chopsticks and refill the cat food for the family cat, Mimi. She chatted with her mother for a while, and her mother said the weather was nice and she planned to go to the street market at noon to buy fresh sea bass. Yu Xiaowei poured a glass of warm water and drank it to hydrate for the day, enjoying the warm family morning.
location: Living room and kitchen, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: In-depth CFP study and team communication
description: At 7:00, Yu Xiaowei entered the study on time, opened her laptop, and focused on studying Module 2 of the CFP course, Risk Management and Insurance Planning, with focus on the insurance regulations section (such as the incontestability clause and duty of disclosure). At around 8:30, her husband Zhang Weiming came in carrying two cups of freshly made coffee. Yu Xiaowei took hers and quietly thanked him. The two briefly discussed the children's arrangements for the morning. Zhang Weiming told her to study with peace of mind and that he would take care of waking the children. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowei continued studying case studies and taking notes until the study session ended at 9:00.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and holiday greetings to clients
description: At 9:00, Yu Xiaowei closed her book and came to the living room, where the children had already finished breakfast. She suggested taking Xuanxuan and Xinxin downstairs to play in the garden for a while. In the central garden of Whampoa Garden, Xuanxuan raced scooters with friends from the estate, while Xinxin picked up fallen leaves nearby. Yu Xiaowei sat on a bench, took out her phone, and sent “Happy Labor Day” greeting messages to several close clients, and also replied to Mrs. Lin's consultation from last night about naming a beneficiary.
location: Central garden on the ground floor, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing for an appointment and organizing materials.
description: At 9:45, after bringing the children home, she had them wash their hands and watch cartoons by themselves. Yu Xiaowei changed into a comfortable light blue linen dress and put on light makeup in the bedroom. At 10:00, she went to the study, turned on the computer, and checked the draft corporate group insurance cooperation proposal needed for the afternoon meeting with bank account manager Li Guodong. She highlighted the key terms and preferential rates with a marker, printed two paper copies, and placed them in a kraft paper document folder. At 10:30, she returned to the living room and chatted with her mother Chen Meiling, who was picking vegetables. Her mother smiled and supported her going out on a date with her husband.
location: Living room and study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A sweet outing with her husband.
description: At 11:00, Zhang Weiming changed his clothes. The couple said goodbye to the family and walked hand in hand to MTR Whampoa Station (on Tak On Street), took the Kwun Tong Line to Prince Edward Station (about 12 minutes, including waiting time), then transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Sham Shui Po Station (about 8 minutes). On the way, Zhang Weiming joked that the hot weather made wonton noodles perfect for detoxifying. Yu Xiaowei leaned against the window, watching the scenery fly by, and enjoyed the rare time alone together as a couple.
location: From Whampoa MTR Station on Tak On Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Sham Shui Po Station (MTR)

name: A long-overdue lunch date for two
description: At 11:30, the couple arrived at Sun Keung Kee Roast Meat Restaurant, a long-established cha chaan teng on Fuk Wing Street, Sham Shui Po, with a history of more than twenty years. They found a wall-side booth and sat down. Zhang Weiming insisted that Yu Xiaowei order. She ordered classic fresh shrimp wonton noodles with iced lemon tea, and he ordered pineapple bun and satay beef instant noodles for her. While waiting, they chatted about the repair shop having taken on a building's air-conditioning project, which brought good income. Yu Xiaowei finally opened up about the annoyance caused by her father's recent pressure over financial plans. Zhang Weiming quietly held her hand to comfort her, making her feel that all her worries had vanished.
location: Sun Keung Kee Roast Meat Restaurant, 118 Fuk Wing Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Return home to rest
description: Lunch ended at 13:00. The couple took the MTR back to Whampoa Station and walked home. When they arrived, mother was putting Xinxin to sleep for a nap, and Xuanxuan was playing with Lego. After letting her mother know, Yu Xiaowei went to the study and reorganized the low-risk investment materials (HSBC money market fund and time deposits) into her phone memo, and set several agenda items for the afternoon conversation.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparation for the business meeting
description: At 13:45, Yu Xiaowei took her document folder, phone and power bank and walked to the Whampoa New Town mall not far from home. A relatively quiet Pacific Coffee in the mall, on the second basement floor, had dedicated booth seating, was quiet and had internet access, making it suitable for business meetings. She arrived early, picked a seat and waited.
location: Pacific Coffee, B2/F, The Whampoa, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meeting with bank advisor to discuss corporate cooperation
description: At 14:00, bank client manager Li Guodong arrived on time for the appointment, and the two exchanged business cards. Yu Xiaowei handed him the prepared corporate group insurance cooperation plan (including employee benefit plans, critical illness insurance plans, etc.), and explained in detail the plan's advantages for small and medium-sized enterprises, such as flexible payment methods and risk hedging. After flipping through it, Li Guodong showed strong interest in the one-stop claims service, and raised common client concerns such as whether the premium rate could be lowered further and the underwriting grace period. Yu Xiaowei noted down each question in her mobile phone memo and promised to give a customized reply before next Tuesday. The two enjoyed their conversation, ordered an extra cup of coffee on the spot, and the meeting ended in a pleasant atmosphere.
location: Pacific Coffee, B2/F, The Whampoa, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family financial planning research and knowledge building
description: At 15:30, after saying goodbye to Manager Li, she walked home, went straight to the study, turned on her computer and phone, logged into the HSBC Mobile Banking app, and carefully compared three low-risk money market funds (such as the 'HSBC Jufu Fund Series - Hong Kong Dollar' historical annualized returns and subscription/redemption fee rates) with the preferential interest rates of two time deposits. Based on the lock-up period and liquidity, she did a simple return calculation in an Excel table. Given her conservative risk preference, she finally recorded two candidate funds in her phone memo and set a reminder to 'consult the client manager for details before the end of May'.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal interest: Cantonese embroidery and mental relaxation
description: At 16:30, after finishing her financial research, her eyes were a little tired. Yu Xiaowei took out the half-embroidered small silk gauze handkerchief she had been working on while learning from Wu Xiuying — the butterfly-wing shapes were outlined using the long-and-short stitch — and sat on the rattan chair on the balcony, stitching stitch by stitch facing the green plants outside the window while light classical music played through her earphones. She felt peaceful. This half-hour that was completely her own let her deeply immerse herself in the world of handicrafts.
location: Balcony, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner preparation and parent-child interaction
description: At 17:30, Yu Xiaowei put down her embroidery and went to the kitchen to help her mother prepare dinner. The menu was light: steamed sea bass, stir-fried choy sum with minced garlic, and tofu and shrimp soup. She was in charge of washing vegetables, cutting scallions, and smashing garlic. At 18:15, her husband Zhang Weiming brought home the two children who had attended a special activity at school. Xuanxuan said he was hungry as soon as he entered. While picking vegetables, Yu Xiaowei told her mother that the afternoon talk with Manager Li had gone smoothly, and her mother was very happy.
location: Kitchen and living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm family dinner and parent-child study guidance.
description: At 18:30 the whole family sat around the table for dinner. Father Yu Guoqiang was in a good mood and had an extra bowl of soup. During the meal they discussed taking the children to Sai Kung Country Park tomorrow (Saturday). Zhang Weiming agreed. At 20:00 after dinner, father helped clear the tableware, while Yu Xiaowei went to the study with Xuanxuan to finish his personalized homework (a math word problem), encouraging him to solve it in two ways. After finishing, she accompanied him to build a newly bought LEGO Mars rover, enjoying parent-child time.
location: Living room and study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Daughter's picture-book time and family conversation.
description: At 20:00, Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter Xinxin with strawberry-scented body wash, then took her to sit on the bedroom bay window and read the picture book The Rainbow Fish together. As she read, she imitated the voices of different small fish, making Xinxin giggle. Xinxin kept asking why the scales sparkled. After finishing the book, they played with finger puppets for a while until Xinxin became a little sleepy.
location: Bedroom bay window, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Evening personal care and me time
description: At 21:00, with the child basically asleep, Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom to remove her makeup and wash her face, then put on a hydrating mask. Lying in bed, she took out her phone and sent a voice message to her colleague Su Lishan, briefly discussing the policy service she planned to follow up on tomorrow for a long-time client. Then she opened Xiaohongshu and spent a while looking at the newly listed Guangdong embroidery works in Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio (embroidered lychees, very lifelike), marveling at the teacher's superb craftsmanship. Afterward, she turned off her phone and enjoyed the rest of her mask time.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's late-night talk and confirmation of future plans
description: At 21:45, Zhang Weiming finished his work and returned to the bedroom. Yu Xiaowei took off her face mask, and the couple leaned against the headboard for a bedtime chat. She shared the takeaways from her afternoon conversation with Li Guodong, and followed his suggestion to continue the plan on Saturday. Together they took out the calendar on their phones and marked the evening time slots next week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) for CFP study as unavailable for meetings to ensure 1.5 hours of study each night. Zhang Weiming mentioned that he might need to work overtime once or twice next week, so Yu Xiaowei arranged with her mother in advance to help take care of the child. After confirming the plan for next week, they felt at ease.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing for tomorrow and going to bed
description: At 22:30, Yu Xiaowei got up to check her running shoes and water bottle for tomorrow's (Saturday) morning run at Kowloon Tsai Park, and prepare the interest class leaflet for Xuanxuan to bring to his tutoring class. After confirming everything, she turned off the lights, set the alarm (planned to get up at 7:00 for a long run), exchanged goodnights with Zhang Weiming, and fell asleep at exactly 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling a cat emergency and morning yoga meditation
description: At 5:50 in the morning, she heard a strange noise in the living room and found the orange cat "Xiao Ju" vomiting a hairball. She immediately cleaned up the vomit and comforted the cat, then set a reminder in her phone notes: "8:00 feed Xiao Ju hairball remedy." After handling that, she completed an 8-minute vinyasa yoga flow and 3 minutes of mindfulness meditation by the bedroom window to quickly adjust her mental and physical state.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning chores and family breakfast
description: After meditation, I went to the kitchen to help my mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast, heating milk and toasting bread. I told her that the Sai Kung outing was postponed and invited her to watch her granddaughter's movie together in the afternoon. My mother agreed and suggested making tomato scrambled eggs for lunch. At 7:00, the five of us had breakfast together. Seeing the rain, my husband Zhang Weiming proactively brought up the original plan, and I took the opportunity to suggest changing it to a stay-at-home weekend—helping our son with a little invention in the afternoon and watching Coco together as a family in the evening. My husband and children excitedly agreed. My husband took care of the dishes after the meal, and I got ready to take our daughter to school.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to ballet class.
description: After getting ready, at 7:45 she drove her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the dance studio on Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong. On the way, her daughter hummed a ballet tune in the car. They arrived at 8:10. She told her to wait at the classroom door after class, and watched her run into the building carrying her pink ballet shoe bag.
location: A dance studio, Block B, 130 Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling work matters and studying while waiting for my daughter
description: After sitting down on the bench outside the dance studio, she first opened her phone to reply to client Mrs. Lin's questions about the medical insurance claims process, reminding her to provide the original hospital diagnosis certificate. Then she sent a voice message to team newcomer He Junwen, wishing him a happy birthday and praising his work. Next, she opened her iPad to study the CFP electronic textbook “Insurance Laws and Regulations”, focusing on the chapters on the incontestability clause and beneficiary designation, marking key points with a highlighter. During this time, she called her embroidery friend He Meiling to ask about the specific “wrapped stitch” technique she had shared; Meiling explained in detail and she took notes.
location: Outside the dance studio, Block B, 130 Boundary Street, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the nearby Pacific Coffee (Festival Walk, Kowloon Tong)

name: Pick up daughter after class and buy groceries on the way
description: At 11:00, I picked up my daughter Zhang Yuxin on time. On the way home, I stopped at ParknShop in the basement of Whampoa New World. I placed my daughter in the shopping cart seat and bought cherries, cheddar cheese, fresh milk, and snacks like blueberries and nuts that the kids love. During this time, I researched a money market fund via the mobile banking app, noted its recent 7-day annualized yield, and planned to compare it with the two funds compared earlier.
location: ParknShop, B1, The Whampoa shopping mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went home to help her mother prepare lunch and checked financial market developments.
description: After getting home, she sorted the ingredients into categories and put them in the refrigerator, washed the cherries, and helped her mother Chen Meiling in the kitchen: peeling garlic, washing tomatoes, and chopping scallions. Her mother made steamed grass carp and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. During a break, she logged into her securities account on her phone, quickly scanned last night's U.S. stock performance and early Asia-Pacific market movements, confirmed that the net value of the Hong Kong stock fund she had invested in was fluctuating slightly, and decided not to trade for now.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family lunch and after-meal conversation
description: The whole family sat around the table for lunch, tasting my mother's steamed grass carp and tomato scrambled eggs. After the meal, my daughter Xinxin acted spoiled and wanted to go downstairs to splash in puddles in the afternoon. My husband Zhang Weiming agreed to let her play for 15 minutes after the rain eased. My son Xuanxuan was eager to start his science invention, so I arranged for him to start at 2 pm sharp. During that time, I saw my husband had put Xinxin's ballet class drawing on the refrigerator. Before the afternoon nap, I cuddled with my husband on the sofa and chatted. We talked about needing to reply to client Li Guodong's group insurance proposal by next Tuesday. My husband offered to help organize the data. I decided to accompany the children in the afternoon and work on the proposal details in the evening.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Make a small science invention with my son.
description: At exactly two in the afternoon, my son Zhang Zixuan and I started working at the dining table, using a cardboard box, a small motor, batteries, and a propeller to make a simple fan. I guided him in connecting the circuit and fixing the parts with a glue gun; my son showed strong hands-on ability. Halfway through, one wire was connected in reverse; after troubleshooting together for 15 minutes, it ran successfully. My son drew a smiley face on the fan blade and excitedly demonstrated it to the whole family. I recorded the whole process with my phone and sent it to my friend Lin Jiaxin, inviting her daughter to come and play together.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Communication regarding personal work time and family matters
description: While the children were taking a break watching TV, she went back to the study to work. On the computer, she created a new folder '20250506 Li Guodong - Corporate Group Insurance Plan' and, drawing on the insurtech article and money market fund information she had researched last night, recorded her initial idea of connecting the mobile app to the mainland medical record system to simplify the claims process. She organized the client concerns from yesterday's meeting with Li Guodong into a to-do list. Then she called her mother-in-law, Li Shufen, chatted about family matters, and reminded her to remember to go to Teacher Wu's Cantonese embroidery class tomorrow afternoon. Her mother-in-law laughed and agreed, and asked her to come over early tomorrow for lunch.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening parent-child puddle-splashing activity
description: The rain let up. Xinxin and Xuanxuan put on their little raincoats and dashed to the garden downstairs, excitedly splashing in the shallow puddles. My husband Zhang Weiming and I stood at the entrance of our building watching, and occasionally joined in. After 15 minutes, I called the kids upstairs and took charge of changing the two children out of their wet clothes, while my husband prepared fruit and snacks for movie night: washed cherries, cut up Hami melon, and opened potato chips and popcorn.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate and the garden downstairs, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family movie night
description: I dimmed the living room lights, connected the streaming device to the projector, and picked Coco with Cantonese dubbing. My husband put snacks and fruit on the coffee table, and my mother Chen Meiling came over to sit with us. The whole family curled up on the sofa, snacking and immersing ourselves in the movie's warmth and music. When the touching singing scene came on, my eyes welled up, and Xinxin leaned against me and said, 'Mommy, I love you.' After the movie ended, my husband took charge of putting our son to bed, and I took our daughter to wash up.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tucking daughter in and late-night couple talk.
description: I coaxed my daughter Zhang Yuxin to sleep by telling her the story The Rainbow Fish for half an hour. After she fell asleep, I went to the living room, where my husband Zhang Weiming had already brewed two cups of jasmine tea and was waiting there. We snuggled on the sofa and talked about how we felt today. I shared that although we didn't make it to Sai Kung, being at home was also fulfilling; my husband praised our son for successfully making a fan. Then I spent 30 minutes focused on listing the key improvement points for client Li Guodong's group insurance plan in the memo app on my phone, including the app idea for connecting to mainland medical records, risk-sharing mechanisms, and so on, and saved it.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and self-care
description: After washing up, I applied a moisturizing mask. Lying in bed, I replied to my good friend Lin Jiaxin’s WeChat message—she said she is free next week and can come over to my place. Then I opened the Cantonese embroidery mini-program to browse the newly shared works from Teacher Wu Xiuying’s studio, and saved a picture of a double-sided embroidered goldfish as inspiration. Before bed, I wrote in my gratitude journal app: “A busy but loving day; my family’s smiles are the best recharge.” At 22:30, I put on an eye mask and got ready to sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling the cat's emergency and morning recovery
description: Yu Xiaowei was woken by the sound of the orange tabby A Ju throwing up. She quickly got up to clean the hairball from the floor, gently comforted the cat, and gave it hairball paste. Because she got up later than planned, she couldn't do the full yoga and meditation, so she only did an 8-minute simple stretch by the living room window, followed by 3 minutes of breathing meditation with her eyes closed. The sky outside was faintly white, and her mood gradually settled.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 3, 12/F, Flat B

name: Family morning interaction, breakfast, and washing up.
description: After a quick wash, Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen, where her mother Chen Meiling was cooking white porridge and steaming barbecue pork buns. She told her mother that dim sum would be postponed to 9 o'clock. Seeing the children watching cartoons, she poured them warm water and reminded them to be polite to elders. Soon her husband Zhang Weiming returned from his morning run and took a shower, and the whole family sat down to breakfast. Her father Yu Guoqiang brought up an investment advertisement, and Yu Xiaowei skillfully steered the topic toward dim sum, asking her son if he wanted big shrimp dumplings, successfully diverting attention. After breakfast, she and her husband changed the children into going-out clothes, and she put on light fresh makeup to prepare for the dim sum outing.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Block 3, 12/F, Flat B

name: Drive to Lei Yue Mun.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove a seven-seater carrying the whole family, setting off from Whampoa Garden and taking a route via the Eastern Harbour Crossing and Cha Kwo Ling Road to avoid congestion in Kwun Tong. Outside, the sun was bright; her daughter Xinxin sang a newly learned nursery rhyme in the car, filling the cabin with laughter and cheerful voices. About 40 minutes later, they arrived at Lei Yue Mun, which is full of fishing-village charm, parked in the open-air parking lot, and the family walked through alleys lined with salted fish and shrimp paste to the seafood restaurant.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, open-air parking lot near 39 Lei Yue Mun Praya Road, and the alleyways of Lei Yue Mun

name: Family dim sum gathering
description: Seated in a window booth with a sea view, Yu Xiaowei expertly ordered shrimp dumplings, siu mai, barbecue pork buns, Ma Lai cake, chicken feet in black bean sauce, and shrimp rice rolls. During the meal, her father again brought up the news about pension investment. Yu Xiaowei smiled, put a shrimp dumpling on his plate, and said casually that such news was only worth listening to, and that she would help him analyze the bank wealth-management products from the bank her company cooperates with another day, emphasizing their low risk. She successfully steered her father into asking about the specific products. Her mother, meanwhile, used a spoon to break the Ma Lai cake into small pieces and feed her granddaughter. The whole family was cheerful and harmonious.
location: Lei Yue Mun Seafood Restaurant, 39 Lei Yue Mun Praya Road Central, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Quality family time at Kowloon Park
description: After yum cha, Yu Xiaowei drove with her husband and two children to Kowloon Park. Despite the hot weather, the park was shady with trees. Xuanxuan climbed up and down a rope frame in the shade, while Xinxin sat in the sandpit, focused on building a castle with a small shovel. name: Studied embroidery at Ms. Wu's studio
description: Yu Xiaowei entered the studio and, after warmly greeting Teacher Wu, could not wait to take out the butterfly dance sketch. The two sat at the workbench. Teacher Wu praised the creativity but suggested adjusting the perspective of the butterfly wings to enhance the three-dimensional effect. They also discussed the contrasting-and-gradient color scheme for Cantonese embroidery and the stitch techniques: the overlapping stitch for layered gradients, the seed stitch for dotting the scales, and the rolling stitch for outlining the contour. Teacher Wu then demonstrated the stitches in person on a practice embroidery hoop, first using the rolling stitch to outline the wings, then the overlapping stitch to lay out the color gradient, and finally the seed stitch to dot the scales, with precise and smooth technique. Yu Xiaowei watched carefully and asked about starting and ending stitches. Encouraged by Teacher Wu, she then tried starting a stitch. After securing the base fabric, she outlined the butterfly wing with golden silk thread using the rolling stitch. Her first stitch was awkward, and Teacher Wu softly reminded her to relax. Gradually, Yu Xiaowei got into the flow. Watching the golden lines leave smooth traces on the fabric, she felt calm and fulfilled inside.
