While eating, she reviewed the visit on her phone, noted Mr. Wang's questions and her own responses, and thought about how to better address his concerns in the next conversation. She chewed slowly and thoroughly to reduce the burden on her digestive system.
location: Shek Kee Kitchen, D'Aguilar Street, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned to the office and rested.
description: Walked from Shek Kee Kitchen to Central Station, and took the MTR back to the Wan Chai office. On the way, she saw a street stall selling fresh fruit, remembered that her mother had been coughing lately, so she bought a bag of snow pears to bring home tonight. Back in the office, she spent the last 15 minutes of her lunch break leaning back in her chair with her eyes closed to rest.
location: On the commute from D'Aguilar Street, Central and Western District, to 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handle a difficult customer complaint.
description: In the afternoon at work, she handled a complaint that had been on her mind. A client, Mr. Chen, called with a misunderstanding of a critical illness insurance policy's terms and was agitated. Xiaowei stayed calm, first soothed his emotions, then patiently explained the specific definition and scope of coverage for carcinoma in situ under the terms. Afterwards, she promised to immediately send a more detailed written explanation by email and coordinated with the back-office claims department to pull up the original policy for verification, ensuring the information was accurate.
location: Office at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing team internal affairs
description: After handling the complaint, she felt a bit tired and got up to get some water. Seeing that her colleague Su Lishan had also just finished a phone call, she walked over and chatted briefly with her, asking about how she was mentoring the new hires. Back at her desk, she began organizing this week's team visit volume data and updated it in the shared spreadsheet to prepare for next week's morning meeting.
location: Office at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal Study and Preparation for Tomorrow
description: She opened the CFP textbook, focused for 30 minutes on the "Investment Planning" chapter, and tried to work through an example problem on ROI on scratch paper. Afterward, she cleaned up her desk, turned off the computer, and printed out the written explanation documents for the complaining client that she needed to bring home tonight.
location: Office at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute and household shopping
description: Took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station, a journey of about 12 minutes. After arriving, she stopped by the ParknShop supermarket inside the Whampoa New World shopping mall. Besides the snow pears she had bought in the morning, she also bought a carton of low-fat fresh milk and fresh vegetables to prepare breakfast with her mother tomorrow morning. After checking out, she walked about 3 minutes home carrying the bags.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall (ParknShop)

name: Return home and have a brief chat
description: When she entered the house, her mother was in the kitchen preparing dinner. Seeing her husband Ming sitting on the sofa scrolling through his phone, she didn't bring up the weekend plans right away. Instead, she walked over, dangled the snow pears in front of him, and said that her mother had a cough, so she had bought a few snow pears, and reminded him to have her stew them with rock sugar that night. He nodded in acknowledgment. After changing into loungewear, she went into the kitchen to help her mother.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: Dinner was stir-fried choy sum, tomato scrambled eggs, and steamed sausage, cooked by her mother. Feeling a bit more stressed than usual today, she ate half a bowl more rice than normal, so the number on the scale might go up a bit. After dinner, she played her daughter Xinxin’s favorite pretend-play game with her. Xinxin made her play the role of “guest” and chatted with her in Cantonese, making her giggle. Meanwhile, she kept an eye on her son Xuanxuan and made sure he had started his homework under his father’s supervision.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (dining room and living room).

name: Check homework and arrange family plans
description: After her son Xuanxuan finished his homework, he carefully checked his math workbook and found two word problems with errors. She patiently explained the problem-solving approach to him until he fully understood. Then, seeing her husband Mingzai on the balcony taking in the laundry, she walked over and said, trying to appear casual: "Mingzai, the weather looks good this Saturday — I checked, and it won't be that hot. Why don't we take Xuanxuan and Xinxin to hike on Lamma Island? They were asking to go to the beach last time." He didn't answer immediately; under her expectant gaze, he nodded and said softly, "Mm, okay."
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (study room and living room)

name: Personal relaxation and Cantonese embroidery practice
description: Finally free, she sat down on the living room sofa, opened the Cantonese embroidery tutorial video on her phone, and took out an unfinished orchid pattern from the past few days. She played a soothing piano piece, threaded the needle, and focused on the rise and fall of each stitch, feeling the sensation of the silk thread moving across the fabric. Half an hour of embroidery practice eased the nerves that had been tense from the day's work and family chores.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room sofa)

name: Evening wrap-up and preparing for bed
description: She put down the embroidery hoop and went to wash up. When she lay down in bed, her husband Ming was already asleep with his back to her. She glanced at the weight scale data on her phone—55.9 kg—sighed, and remembered the half bowl of extra rice she had eaten at dinner compared to usual, silently reminding herself to keep controlling her diet tomorrow. Then she set the alarm for 5:10 tomorrow, turned off the bedside lamp, and gradually fell asleep in the day's fatigue and anticipation of the weekend.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (bathroom and bedroom)

name: Morning yoga and meditation
description: At 5 a.m., Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in the study and did 20 minutes of gentle yoga stretching. Then she sat cross-legged for 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath to calm her mind. After meditating, she drank a cup of warm honey water.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Study CFP investment planning course
description: Yu Xiaowei opened her iPad and continued studying the investment planning module of the CFP certification course, focusing on asset allocation strategies. She took notes while watching the course videos and completed 10 accompanying practice questions to reinforce her memory.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the kitchen, toasted whole wheat bread with the toaster, boiled eggs, and heated up the preserved egg and lean pork congee her mother had made. Then she went upstairs to wake up her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin, helped them put on their school uniforms and pack their schoolbags, and reminded Xinxin that there was a craft class at kindergarten today.
location: Home kitchen and children's room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

On the way, she reminded him to bring back his math homework after school and encouraged him to take his English class seriously. After arriving, she watched him walk through the school gate.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, No. 1 Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

On the way, Yu Xiaowei wore earphones and continued listening to the CFP course audio, and sent a WeChat message to her mother asking about her throat.

name: Buy throat lozenges and arrive at the office.
description: After exiting the turnstile at Wan Chai Station, Yu Xiaowei went to the Mannings store near her office to buy three packs of Ryukakusan throat lozenges for her mother, then walked to the AIA Building, bought unsweetened soy milk at the convenience store downstairs, and took the elevator to the 16th-floor office to get ready for work.
location: Mannings drug and cosmetics store on Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Room 1612, AIA Building.

name: Morning office work.
description: Yu Xiaowei brewed a pot of unsweetened green tea, turned on her computer to handle emails, and focused on organizing client Chen Meiling's policy documents, checking the medical, savings, and education fund policies, preparing an annual review report, and drafting an initial upgrade plan for high-end medical insurance. In between, she handled team administrative matters, asked new recruit He Jiaming about his work progress, and expressed appreciation for his completion of the client document organization task.

During the meal, they discussed the training plan for newcomer He Jiaming. Su Lishan suggested letting him participate in the preparation of next week's small client appreciation event, and Yu Xiaowei agreed.
location: Hechang Tea Restaurant, Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (near the junction of Hennessy Road and Fleming Road)

name: Afternoon work and phone calls with clients.
description: After lunch break, Yu Xiaowei continued to perfect Chen Meiling's high-end medical insurance plan, ensuring the proposal data was accurate and the terms were clear. Around 2 p.m., she called Chen Meiling, briefly explained the highlights of the plan, and confirmed the appointment for a home visit at 3 p.m. the next day, which Chen Meiling agreed to.
location: Room 1612, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Brief team meeting and new-hire coaching
description: Yu Xiaowei called a 15-minute team huddle, shared last week's performance, and reminded everyone about the preparations for next week's client appreciation event; after the meeting, He Jiaming asked her a client question, and she patiently answered it and suggested he read more from the company's case library.
location: Room 1612, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing and preparing before the end of the workday
description: Yu Xiaowei tidied her desk, archived the completed documents, set up the next morning's schedule reminders in the system, and texted her husband Mingzai with her approximate arrival time. Then she packed her bag and left the office.
location: Room 1612, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital and completed the physical examination.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to Wan Chai Station, took the Island Line to Causeway Bay Station, and after exiting walked about 15 minutes to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital. After registering at the front desk, under a nurse's guidance she completed the checks of weight, blood pressure, and fingertip blood sampling for blood glucose, then entered the consultation room to see Dr. Zhou Wenbin.
location: Outpatient Department, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Met with Dr. Zhou Wenbin
description: Dr. Zhou Wenbin carefully reviewed the physical examination report and pointed out that Yu Xiaowei's weight had increased by 1 kg compared with three months ago and her blood pressure was at the upper limit of the normal range. He advised adjusting her diet, reducing takeout and foods high in oil and salt, increasing vegetables, fruits, and high-quality protein, and maintaining aerobic exercise at least three times a week. He also reminded her to spend less time on her phone before bed and to try soaking her feet in warm water.
location: Consultation room, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: After leaving the consultation room, Yu Xiaowei walked from Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital to Causeway Bay Station, took the Island Line to Admiralty Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line and got off at Prince Edward Station. After exiting the station, she walked about 10 minutes back to her home at Whampoa Garden.

name: Dinner with the family
description: Back home, her mother had already prepared dinner, and the whole family sat together. Yu Xiaowei shared her check-up results and the doctor's advice. Her mother said she would look into light dishes, her father reminded her to follow the doctor's orders, and her husband Mingzai picked up steamed fish for her and showed his support.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Each day's calories were kept within 500 kcal. She decided to start strictly following it from Monday and wrote an encouraging note in her memo: "Come on, for health and the marathon!"
location: Home dining table, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: Yu Xiaowei sat down in the study, took out the embroidery frame, and continued practicing the orchid pattern embroidery taught by Teacher Wu under the desk lamp. Stitch by stitch, she felt calm and focused, temporarily forgetting her stress and worries.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

location: Home bathroom and children's room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep meditation and preparing for sleep

location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home, master bedroom

Afterward, sat on the living room sofa and used my phone to download the Healthy Living app, set weight and blood pressure management goals based on the previous day's medical checkup results, and recorded the calories burned during morning exercise.
location: A certain block and flat in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

At 6:30 she woke the children up to wash and change into school uniforms. At 6:45 the whole family sat down to breakfast, and Yu Xiaowei recorded her breakfast intake in a health app.
location: A certain block and flat in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

The husband rode an electric bike to take his daughter to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, while Yu Xiaowei walked their son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, asking along the way about his homework preparation and encouraging him. After watching him enter the school at 7:25, she walked toward Prince Edward MTR Station.

name: Commute study and podcast listening

description: Arrived at the company, AIA Financial Center, tidied up, brewed high-mountain oolong tea, opened the computer and pulled up the policy review report and high-end medical insurance plan for the afternoon client visit. After rechecking the documents, she put them into her handbag.

The explanation was clear and the interaction pleasant. Chen Meiling decided to add high-end medical insurance for her husband, and on the spot used an iPad to help fill out the electronic application and successfully paid the first premium.

name: Drove back to the office.

location: Drive from Taikoo Shing in the Eastern District via the Island Eastern Corridor back to Wan Chai North

She mentioned the warmth of having the same surname as the client.

Yu Xiaowei excitedly shared the detailed process of signing the contract that afternoon. Her son was curious about the income, and her daughter praised her in a sweet baby voice. The atmosphere was warm.

location: A certain block and flat in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

location: A certain block and flat in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

She used her breath to release the day's tension and excitement and let her mind settle.

She set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning, exchanged goodnights with her husband, hugged and kissed him, and thanked him for his efforts during the day.

location: A certain block and flat in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

After that, she felt calm and relaxed and recorded her weight of 55.9 kg in the health app on her phone.

At 9:45 she picked up her daughter on time and drove back home along the same route in about 10 minutes.
location: Wu Xiangxia Ballet School, 719 Nathan Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Their son Xuanxuan excitedly served as a “supply runner,” passing screwdrivers and cloths. Around 11:00, she brewed a cup of homemade selfheal and chrysanthemum herbal tea for Mingzai, who was drenched in sweat, and used her phone to take a picture of her husband’s focused back as he worked, teasing, “Mingzai, you look so handsome right now—you could be on a home improvement show!” Mingzai laughed in response. By 11:25, the indoor and outdoor units of both air conditioners were cleaned; after a power-on test, the cool air was fresh and strong.

Yu Xiaowei pretended to be angry, gently patted the cat's rear, and muttered, "Little rascal!" Then she swept up the dirt and fragments and put the flowerpot back. After cleaning up, she rewarded the cat with treats and played with it for a while using a teaser wand. Then she had the family wash their hands, put the balcony tools back in place, took out the vegetables her mother had prepared from the fridge, and made simple preparations for lunch.

Yu Xiaowei again announced that they would go to Chuangfa Chaozhou Restaurant in the evening to celebrate her promotion. Her mother warmly agreed, and her daughter clapped in delight. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, only gave a faint response and lowered his head to pick up food, which made her feel a little disappointed, but she quickly adjusted her mood and chatted with Mingzai about the children's activities next week. After dinner, she took the initiative to help her mother clear the dishes and cleaned the kitchen.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

The living room was filled with the children's laughter.

After tidying up, the family of three watched an episode of the animated series "Mini Force" in the living room. When the animation ended, she asked her husband to call the children to change clothes, while she went back to the master bedroom to choose evening wear. She finally put on a well-tailored dark blue dress with pearl earrings and checked her hair in the mirror to make sure she looked presentable.

description: When she got home, she saw her husband Zhang Weiming playing with LEGO with their son and daughter in the living room. Their daughter proudly showed off the little house she had built, and Yu Xiaowei praised her. Sitting on the sofa watching her family play, she felt very happy.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: CFP corporate tax study.
description: After brewing a pot of jasmine tea, she sat down at the desk in her study and opened the CFP textbook, focusing on the 'Corporate Taxation' chapter. She concentrated on learning about Hong Kong's profits tax credit policy and the differences with mainland corporate income tax, and took two pages of neat notes.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Talking with her husband and washing up before bed
description: She walked into the bedroom and saw her husband, Zhang Weiming, browsing web pages on his phone. She asked how his research into auto repair courses was going. He said he was interested in a structured course at the Vocational Training Council, which had weekend classes, and planned to go and check it out next week. Yu Xiaowei encouraged him to take the course, and he gratefully held her hand. Then Yu Xiaowei went to wash up.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bedroom in the family home

name: Stretching, meditating, and preparing for bed
description: After washing up, I did a ten-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat to relax my stiff shoulders, neck, and back from sitting for long periods. Then I sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed and did a ten-minute mindful breathing meditation with a mobile app to clear my mind of the day's thoughts. At 23:00, I turned off the lights on time and fell asleep with the satisfaction of a fulfilling day.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bedroom in the family home

name: Couple's morning run and stretching
description: At 6 a.m., the alarm went off on time. After drinking a glass of warm water, I gently woke my husband Weiming. We put on our running shoes, did a quick warm-up, and set off at 6:10. After walking a few minutes, we arrived at Kowloon Tsai Park and started a 3-kilometer jog along the jogging trail at a pace of about 6 minutes 35 seconds per kilometer. While running, Weiming said how long it had been since we last ran together in the morning. I smiled and agreed that we would do this every Saturday. We finished the run at 6:40, then did five minutes of leg and shoulder relaxation in the stretching area. The sky was cloudy and the air was very humid. After the run, we were drenched in sweat and felt wonderful.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and waking the family
description: After arriving home at 6:50, I spent 20 minutes doing yoga stretching on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing my hips and back, and added 5 minutes of meditative breathing to calm my body and mind. Weiming went to the bathroom to take a shower and wake up our son Zixuan. Mother Chen Meiling was already in the kitchen preparing breakfast. At 7:10, after finishing yoga, I gently woke up my daughter Yuxin, helped her pick out a ballet dress and ballet shoes, then took a quick shower and changed into casual clothes.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and preparations
description: The five of us sat around the table and enjoyed the oatmeal porridge, fried eggs, and whole-wheat toast made by my mother. I told everyone that I had arranged to have afternoon tea with my good friend Jiaxin that afternoon. Weiming mentioned that he wanted to go to the Mong Kok computer mall to look at repair technical materials and planned to enroll in a course. The children chatted about fun things at school, and the home was filled with a relaxed weekend atmosphere. After the meal, Weiming and I cleared the table together, while my mother helped Yuxin put her hair into a bun.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking daughter to ballet class and making use of the waiting time
description: At 8:20 I drove out with Yuxin and arrived at the ballet school in Kowloon Tong at 8:45. This was the last regular class of this stage; because classes are suspended next week for the Dragon Boat Festival, the teacher would personally remind about summer vacation precautions. After Yuxin ran happily into the classroom, I quickly dealt with several work messages on a bench in the corridor, replied to team members' questions about the weekly report, then did 20 CFP tax simulation multiple-choice questions on my iPad, and also did 5 minutes of core training while it was not crowded. At 9:55 I picked up Yuxin, and sure enough, the teacher reminded us about the summer break arrangements.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Waterloo Road near Junction Road, a certain ballet school

name: Returning home and a short rest
description: At 10:05, I drove home, told Yuxin to go to the living room to play with her brother and grandmother, and went into the study to begin organizing family financial documents. I first poured a glass of water, turned on the computer, and synced the work screenshots and notes from my phone to it.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize family financial records
description: In the study, I focused on sorting out the family income and expenses for April to May 2025. I spread out bank monthly statements, credit card bills, investment income reports, and receipts for my mother's living expenses, and used Excel to create a summary of income and expenditure. I specially checked the materials prepared for tonight's monthly financial review meeting, clearly listing daily expenses, education costs, utilities, the travel fund, and changes in the emergency reserve, making sure all receipts and monthly summary data were categorized and bound so the family could see everything at a glance during the evening review.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Simple family lunch at noon
description: At 12 o'clock, I paused work and had lunch with my family. Mother cooked everyone's favorite wonton noodles, served with stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Weiming and Zixuan hadn't gone to play football because of the morning rain; they came back after being active downstairs, and the family ate and chatted. I told them I had plans to have coffee with Jiaxin in Sham Shui Po at 2 p.m. Weiming said he wanted to go to the Mong Kok Computer Centre to look at second-hand textbooks for a new energy vehicle maintenance course, and Mother happily said she would take the two children to Whampoa New World Mall in the afternoon to buy handicraft materials.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon rest and preparation
description: After the meal, I helped clear the dishes, then went back to the bedroom for a 20-minute nap to recharge. At 13:20, I changed into a simple, comfortable dress, slung on a casual shoulder bag, put in my phone, wallet, and a sample of Cantonese embroidery, said goodbye to my family, and left at 13:40. The weather was clearing up and the sun was blazing.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took the subway to meet her best friend.
description: I walked 10 minutes from home to Whampoa MTR station, tapped my card to enter, took the Kwun Tong line to Prince Edward station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan line, and arrived at Sham Shui Po station; the whole trip took about 25 minutes. On the train, I was browsing social media and saw a photo of a morning run on Nam Shan Bypath shared by fellow runner Shen Peiwen, and I liked it. At 14:10 I walked out of Exit C2 and met up with my close friend Lin Jiaxin, who was waiting.
location: Exit C2, Sham Shui Po Station, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon tea with close girlfriends in Sham Shui Po
description: Jiaxin and I walked arm in arm to a boutique coffee shop hidden in a side street, and each ordered Earl Grey tea and handmade Basque burnt cheesecake (original and matcha). I shared the pressure of being promoted to regional deputy manager, the challenges of integrating with a new team, and the difficulties of liaising with Shenzhen client Wang Qiming on cross-border business. Jiaxin confided that she felt burned out in her current teaching position and was considering applying for a transfer to educational administration. We analyzed the pros and cons for each other and shared workplace stress-relief methods. As we got into the conversation, we agreed to take our children on a two-day, one-night short trip to Cheung Chau Island around mid-July during the summer vacation, and created a group chat called “Summer Cheung Chau Squad” with plans to make a detailed plan after going home.
location: A specialty coffee shop on Fuk Wing Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong SAR.

name: Saying goodbye and returning home.
description: At 4:30 p.m., we hugged and said goodbye at the MTR station. I went back the same way, taking the Tsuen Wan Line from Sham Shui Po Station to Prince Edward Station, then transferring to the Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station. After exiting the station, I walked home and pushed open the door at 5:10 p.m.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Learned that her husband signed up for a course
description: As soon as he came in the door, Weiming excitedly walked up to me, held up his tablet, and told me he had just successfully signed up online for the 'Advanced Certificate Course in New Energy Vehicle Maintenance' at the Hong Kong Productivity Council. The course lasts six months, starts next month, and has classes on Wednesday evenings and all day Saturday. Surprised and delighted, I took the tablet and looked through the syllabus. Seeing modules such as 'Battery Management System' and 'High-Voltage Electrical Safety', I was genuinely happy for him and patted him on the shoulder to encourage him to study hard. We quickly discussed how to reallocate Saturday family time: from now on, I would take full charge of the kids on Saturday mornings while he went to class, and the afternoons could be adjusted flexibly.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Core training and playing with the cat in the evening
description: Feeling happy, I changed into home workout clothes and, in front of the TV in the living room, followed an app to do the second 15-minute bite-sized core training session, including crunches, Russian twists, and bird-dog exercises. After the workout, I walked onto the balcony, picked up the cat teaser, and played with our tabby cat "Xiao Wanzi" for a while. Watching it pounce and leap made me giggle. Afterwards, I went into the kitchen, checked the ingredients in the fridge, and prepared for dinner.
location: Living room and balcony of the home at Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cook a family dinner.
description: I decided to cook myself. I briskly washed rice and cooked it, made the tomato scrambled eggs that Weiming likes, pan-fried the yellow croaker my mother bought in the morning, and stir-fried a plate of choy sum. My mother helped peel garlic and assisted on the side. As we cooked, mother and daughter chatted about the amusing moments of meeting Jiaxin today, and the kitchen was filled with a warm, homely vibe.
location: Kitchen at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family dinner
description: At 6:30, Weiming brought Zixuan, who had been playing wildly outside, back home. Father Yu Guoqiang also arrived, and the whole family sat around the dinner table together. The dishes I made were very popular. As everyone ate, they shared their news: Zixuan said he had read a new dinosaur encyclopedia, Yuxin excitedly said her ballet teacher praised her graceful movements, and Father proudly said he had won three rounds of chess against an old friend in the park. After dinner, Father took the initiative to clear the table and let me rest.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Monthly family financial review and movie viewing
description: At 7:30, I took out the organized financial documents and held the monthly financial review with Weiming and Dad. I used an Excel spreadsheet to clearly show a four-month income and expenditure overview, specifically pointing out the increase in education expenses and the progress of the travel fund savings. Weiming suggested appropriately reducing dining out to support his course tuition, and Dad suggested converting part of the emergency reserve into a conservative bond fund. We jointly decided that starting next month, we would save 5% from daily expenses each month as a dedicated education fund. The review lasted about 45 minutes with a pleasant atmosphere. Afterward, the whole family watched "Moana."
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and bedtime preparation
description: The movie wasn't over and the children were already getting sleepy. I took my daughter Yuxin to wash up, checked in her room that the paintbrushes and drawing pads needed for tomorrow's art interest class were all there, confirmed nothing was missing, then told a short bedtime story, watched her fall asleep sweetly, and gently closed the door.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, daughter's room at home

name: Personal time and bedtime preparation
description: Back in the master bedroom, I opened the health app on my phone to record the day's diet and exercise data (3 km morning run, 20 minutes of yoga, 2 core training sessions), quickly scanned tomorrow's calendar to confirm there was nothing missed. Then I combed my hair with a wooden comb, did basic facial care, and got ready for bed.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: At exactly 10 o'clock, I turned off the main light in the bedroom and left a soft bedside lamp on. Lying beside my husband, I reviewed the fulfilling day: the sweat of the morning run, my daughter's dance, conversations with my girlfriends, my husband's progress, and the warmth of the family. My heart was filled with joy and satisfaction. Raindrops tapped gently outside the window. I turned over comfortably and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: At seven in the morning, Yu Xiaowei did core training and stretching on the bedroom floor to wake up her body. She then went to the dining room to have breakfast with her mother, Chen Meiling, who had prepared plain congee, scrambled eggs, and barbecue pork buns. While eating, Yu Xiaowei checked her travel items: parasol, sunscreen, power bank, Octopus card, and some Hong Kong dollars in cash, and briefly discussed with her mother her plan to go to Shenzhen that day to meet friends.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Commuting from home to Luohu Port
description: Yu Xiaowei bid farewell to her mother, walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon Tong Station and transferred to the East Rail Line. Along the way, she watched the scenery outside the window change from the urban area to the green fields of the New Territories, and finally arrived at Lo Wu Station around 8:50.
location: Along the MTR from Whampoa Station to Lo Wu Station in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Crossing the border at Luohu Port.
description: Yu Xiaowei followed the crowd into the Shenzhen Luohu Port travel inspection building. Because there were many people returning to Shenzhen on Sunday, she waited in line for nearly an hour to clear immigration, and finally passed through mainland customs smoothly at 9:30 and entered Shenzhen.
location: Shenzhen Luohu Port Passenger Inspection Building, Heping Road, Luohu District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Taking the MTR to the appointment
description: After passing through customs, Yu Xiaowei scanned the QR code to buy a ticket at Luohu Metro Station and took Line 1 to Hi-Tech Park Station. The carriage was quite crowded, so she gripped the handrail tightly and contacted her friend Shen Peiwen on her phone to share her progress. Shen Peiwen replied that she would be waiting at the main entrance of MixC World.
location: Along Line 1 from Luohu Metro Station to Hi-Tech Park Metro Station, Luohu District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Meet up with Shen Peiwen
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at Hi-Tech Park Station and walked to MixC World Plaza, where she excitedly met Shen Peiwen, who had been waiting by the fountain. The two hugged and exchanged greetings, then each ordered a cup of iced lemon tea at the café near the mall entrance, rested briefly, and caught up on each other's news.
location: MixC World, 9668 Shennan Boulevard, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Gathering at a cha chaan teng and heart-to-heart talk
description: The two went to the Da You Li tea restaurant in MixC World and ordered pineapple buns, iced milk tea, wonton noodles, satay beef noodles, and more. During the meal, Yu Xiaowei poured out her work stress and frustration about suspending training, while Shen Peiwen also shared her family troubles. Shen Peiwen encouraged Yu Xiaowei to resume training in autumn and aim for the half marathon at the Hong Kong Marathon at year-end. They agreed to do a weekly Sunday video call for core check-ins and mutual supervision.
location: Da Youli Tea Restaurant, MixC World, No. 9668 Shennan Avenue, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Shopping at MixC World
description: After the meal, the two walked around the mall to help digest and entered a sports brand discount store. Yu Xiaowei was attracted by a pair of fluorescent green professional running shoes. Encouraged by her friend, she tried them on and felt the fit and rebound were excellent. It happened to be member day with 40% off, so she swiped her card and bought them. Afterward, they visited a clothing store, where Yu Xiaowei picked out a sun-protection jacket for her daughter but did not buy it.
location: Shop inside Shenzhen MixC World, No. 9668 Shennan Boulevard, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: A walk to say goodbye
description: The two took a commemorative photo in front of the art installation at MixC World, then walked to the turnstiles at Hi-Tech Park Metro Station, hugged and said goodbye again, and reminded each other to send a message when they got home. Shen Peiwen returned via Futian Port, while Yu Xiaowei headed toward Luohu Port.
location: Shenzhen MixC World, No. 9668 Shennan Boulevard, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province to Hi-Tech Park Metro Station

name: Return to Hong Kong
description: Yu Xiaowei took Metro Line 1 from Hi-Tech Park Station back to Luohu Station. The return trip at Luohu Port was still crowded; she waited in line for about 50 minutes to pass through customs, then stepped into MTR Luohu Station, took the East Rail line, transferred to the Kwun Tong line to Whampoa Station, and walked home. The whole journey took about 70 minutes.
location: Along the route from Luohu Port, Luohu District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, to MTR Whampoa Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Going home to rest and visiting mother
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei took a shower and changed into loungewear, then took a photo of her new running shoes and sent it to Shen Peiwen to confirm the autumn training plan. After a short rest of thirty minutes, she went to the living room to watch her mother preparing vegetables, shared her experiences in Shenzhen, took the initiative to say she wanted to drink green radish and carrot pork bone soup, and helped blanch the pork ribs, preparing dinner together.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family games and dinner
description: Husband Zhang Weiming returned from a jog, and the two children were watching TV. Yu Xiaowei suggested playing Monopoly. The family of four laid out the board on the floor, with Yu Xiaowei acting as the banker, and everyone took turns rolling the dice and laughing. Then her mother prepared dinner: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, steamed grass carp, and pork bone soup with carrots and turnips. The family sat around the table eating and chatting, and Yu Xiaowei shared amusing stories from her trip to Shenzhen.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Helping children with homework
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math workbook and patiently guided him to draw diagrams to solve two word problems; her husband bathed their daughter and read picture books to her, while her mother washed dishes in the kitchen. Household chores were carried out in an orderly manner.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Monthly family financial review
description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband picked up the ledger and calculator from the coffee table in the living room, confirmed that the travel fund and emergency reserve had been deposited on time, reviewed the itemized income and expenses for the month, calculated the total income and expenses, and confirmed the surplus. Then they discussed next month's expenses: their daughter's ballet class renewal, the summer camp budget, and the extra transportation costs for her husband's new energy vehicle repair course. In the end, they set aside a gift budget for Father's Day and adjusted their demand deposits.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Reflection and bedtime preparation
description: After the review, Yu Xiaowei encouraged her husband to prepare seriously for the course. She then went to the study, opened the health app to record the meal calories and the expense of her new running shoes, and resolved to eat lightly the next day. She then did fifteen minutes of mindfulness meditation to calm herself. After meditation, she returned to the bedroom, saw that her husband had already prepared his commuter bag, tucked the children in and kissed their foreheads. Finally, she brushed her teeth, washed her face, and changed into pajamas.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Relaxation and bedtime
description: Yu Xiaowei leaned against the headboard, browsed the weather forecast, replied to client messages on WeChat, and chatted with her husband about the weekend plans for next month. Feeling reassured, she turned off the light at 23:00 and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning recovery jog and stretching
description: After the alarm rang, I got up immediately, drank warm water, and did dynamic stretching on the balcony, focusing on the right calf. I went for a 2.5 km recovery jog at a pace of about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. After the run, I did static stretching on the bench on the platform to make sure the muscles relaxed.
location: Podium garden, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Breakfast and helping family members get out the door for school
description: After a quick shower, she changed into home clothes and prepared breakfast with her mother, Chen Meiling: she ate oatmeal porridge for herself and made avocado egg sandwiches for her son Zixuan and daughter Yuxin. She helped Zixuan check his schoolbag and math homework, braided Yuxin’s hair, and organized her art kit. Then she helped her mother take the children to the school bus stop in the residential complex and watched them leave for school.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to the office in Wan Chai
description: Walk to Prince Edward Station, take the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, transfer to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the commute, use iBooks to read the PDF of Key Differences in Insurance Terms Between Mainland China and Hong Kong to prepare for tomorrow's training. After exiting the station, walk to the Immigration Tower.
location: MTR Prince Edward Station to Wan Chai Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning work: team weekly meeting and client follow-up
description: After arriving at the office, she brewed unsweetened green tea, browsed emails and the calendar, and listed to-do items. She led the team's weekly review meeting, presented performance charts, praised colleagues who exceeded targets, analyzed the reasons for underperforming policies, and reminded everyone about the next day's training. After the meeting, she did client follow-up: called to schedule policy reviews for two clients, handled an accidental hospitalization claim, and comforted the family. She completed administrative work (replying to emails, organizing visit records) and prepared a cross-border insurance proposal framework for the next day's training. During this time, she recorded the 800 yuan spent on running shoes purchased in Shenzhen into the expense app, with the note 'Shenzhen MixC World, bought at Shen Peiwen's urging', and replied to Peiwen's WeChat message about their morning run. During a tea break, she discussed client scheduling with Su Lishan.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: First fragmented core training session
description: Using the tea break, she did a set of planks and bird-dog exercises next to her workstation, completing the morning's fragmented core training.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break: light lunch, online learning, and Japanese practice
description: Ate the homemade salad she brought (lettuce, chicken breast, cherry tomatoes, corn kernels), while on her iPad watching the video course Latest Interpretation of Mainland Insurance Regulatory Regulations. After that, she used Duolingo to complete a beginner Japanese lesson, practicing time expressions and shopping sentence patterns. She chatted with colleague Su Lishan in the pantry, discussed possible issues at tomorrow's training, shared the cases they had each prepared, and agreed to sit together during the training.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon product proposal refinement and routine work
description: She focused on refining the cross-border insurance plan for Shenzhen client Chen Zhiqiang's company, comparing Hong Kong participating insurance products such as 'Abundant Future 3' and 'Simple Love Continuation' with mainland products, and marked the suitable combinations with different colors. After completing the training, she sent an email to confirm the meeting room for tomorrow's training, double-checked key data in the proposal, handled administrative chores, replied to the last few emails, packed tomorrow's notebook, computer, and charger into her commuter bag, and sent her husband Zhang Weiming a WhatsApp message telling him not to buy groceries.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Second fragmented core workout
description: Felt soreness in the shoulders and neck, and did wall sits and side planks in the corner by the pantry to relieve fatigue from prolonged sitting.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute home from work
description: Walked back along the same route to Wan Chai Station, took the MTR Island Line to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Prince Edward Station, and walked back to Whampoa Garden. Listened to instrumental music along the way to relax.
location: Hong Kong SAR, MTR Wan Chai Station to Prince Edward Station

name: Family interaction after returning home: assisting with dinner preparation and helping with homework.
description: Arrived home, changed into loungewear, went into the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables, and asked about the children's day at school. Her son Zixuan showed off a handmade model, and her daughter Yuxin showed her painting "Our Family." She kissed the children, then checked Zixuan's math exercises.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A warm dinner for a family of five
description: Husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, and the family sat around eating dinner: steamed sea bass, stir-fried pea shoots with garlic, and mustard greens and pork rib soup. Xiaowei followed her light meal plan, eating only fish, vegetables, and half a bowl of soup, and no rice. The atmosphere at the dinner table was harmonious, and everyone shared their experiences.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: Cleared the dishes with her mother; her husband suggested washing the living room ceiling fan the day after tomorrow, and her mother discussed the ingredients and menu for making zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival. She accompanied her daughter in watching cartoons and told bedtime stories, and urged her son to pack his schoolbag. She had a brief conversation with her husband on the sofa, reminding him that the new energy vehicle course starts next month and the Saturday childcare arrangements need to be adjusted; her husband said he would discuss it with her mother.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: In the study, she reads the printed official regulatory documents on cross-border insurance, taking notes on 'comparison of cross-border insurance regulations,' 'key points of foreign exchange management,' and 'tax impact.' Based on the afternoon plan, she also compiles a list of questions to ask Guo Junwei, including 'how to explain the difference in claim waiting periods between the two places' and 'the impact of the latest CRS reporting on policy allocation for high-net-worth clients.'
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Used the health app to record the whole day's diet and body weight of 55.7 kg. After lying down, she softly shared with her husband her expectations and nervousness about tomorrow's training. Her husband Zhang Weiming held her hand and comforted her, saying that she was fully prepared and there was definitely no problem. After saying goodnight to each other, she set the alarm and closed her eyes to sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up, yoga, and breakfast
description: At 5:00 the alarm went off. You sat up gently so as not to wake your husband, and drank the warm water your mother had prepared the night before. Then, in the dim morning light, you unrolled the yoga mat and did 10 minutes of shoulder, neck, and hip stretches. After that, you took a quick shower, changed into your professional suit, and combed your short hair. In the kitchen, your mother was already preparing breakfast for the whole family. You chatted quietly, and she reminded you to bring an umbrella. You quickly ate two slices of whole-wheat toast, a boiled egg, and drank a cup of unsweetened soy milk.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family collaboration
description: While eating breakfast, you helped your husband check your son Xuanxuan's schoolbag to confirm his art class supplies were all packed. Your 5-year-old daughter Xinxin dressed herself and ran over; you deftly made two small ponytails for her and kissed her cheek. You reminded your husband to pick up Xuanxuan, who was staying after school for training today. The whole family bustled around the living room and kitchen, starting a new day.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Workday commuting and fragmented learning
description: At exactly 7:00, she left the house carrying an umbrella, walked to Whampoa MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Yau Tong Station, and transferred to the Island Line.
