description: She walked 6 minutes from the Convention and Exhibition Center to Royal Court Plaza, which was just across the street. She found a light-meal restaurant and ordered a grilled chicken breast salad and fruit tea. After sitting down, she first sent a WeChat message to Zhou Minyi, thanking her for making the introduction, and asked whether she could share the contact information of the Shenzhen boss who was interested in purchasing high-end medical insurance. Then, using the 15-minute gap, she contacted client Chen Meiling via WeChat voice to confirm the key terms of her daughter's protection plan (such as vaccine benefits and overseas medical treatment allowance), and finalized the specific details for the meeting at 2 p.m. the next day at the Starbucks near Whampoa Garden.
location: gaga Fresh restaurant, Level G, Royal Court Plaza, 118 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Return to the summit venue
description: Walk from Huangting Plaza back to the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center to prepare for the afternoon agenda.
location: In Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, walking from Huangting Plaza at 118 Fuhua 3rd Road to Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center at 111 Fuhua 3rd Road.

name: Full-day summit (afternoon session: case sharing and pain-point discussion)
description: Return to the venue and participate in the roundtable discussion on "Pain Points and Innovation in Cross-border Insurance Customer Service". Listen carefully and think; when hearing the discussion about "cumbersome after-sales processes", relate it to my own clients and jot down my solution on a sticky note.
location: Chrysanthemum Hall, 5th Floor, Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, 111 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Deep networking and business card exchange over tea break
description: During the tea break, she proactively approached the summit organizers, expressed high appreciation for the content, and asked about possible future cooperation opportunities, such as recommending Hong Kong market cases as a guest speaker. Afterwards, she exchanged WeChat contacts with several peers she had met in the morning, invited them to join her industry exchange group, and agreed to meet for coffee in Hong Kong or Shenzhen for a detailed chat.
location: No. 111 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, outside the venue on the fifth floor of Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center

name: Full-day summit (afternoon session closing and summary).
description: Attended the closing session of the summit, listening to the conference's summary report and future outlook. At the same time, used the last moment to organize all the key information and contacts gained today in the mobile phone memo, preparing for follow-up.
location: Plum Blossom Hall, 5th Floor, Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, 111 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Return to the hotel to change and relax
description: After the summit ended, she took a taxi back to the hotel. After returning to the room, she first changed into comfortable loungewear. She spent half an hour organizing the day's takeaways: entered all new business card information into her phone contacts, adding notes on company, position, and impression; photographed key pages of the summit handbook and saved them to the '2025 Summit' folder.
location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province: took a taxi from Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center, 111 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, back to Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District.

name: Video call with family
description: She made a WeChat video call to her husband Zhang Weiming. The children had just finished dinner and were excitedly vying for the camera. Xuanxuan proudly showed off the newly built LEGO mechanical vehicle and, in Mandarin, corrected a part name that she had mispronounced. Xinxin then improvised a short ballet dance she had just learned in front of the camera. Although her movements were not precise, she was very adorable. Looking at the warm, happy scene on the screen, she asked her husband, "How is Dad feeling today?" Her husband said, "Pretty good. In the afternoon, he went downstairs for a walk with Mom." The weight in her heart finally dropped. The call lasted about 15 minutes, and they agreed to watch cartoons with the children together after she returned home on Wednesday night.
location: Guest room on the 32nd floor, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Dinner alone and making team plans
description: Walked about 4.7 minutes from the hotel to the nearby Baheli Chaoshan Fresh Beef Hot Pot restaurant and ordered a set meal for one, including hand-beaten beef balls, tender beef, and greens. While waiting for the food, opened the photo album on her phone and selected a few close-up detail shots of her recent Cantonese embroidery works that she was most satisfied with. While eating the beef ball hot pot, she used her phone to draft a preliminary one-on-one communication schedule for the team for next week (drafted in Excel) to keep progress under control.
location: Baheli Chaoshan Fresh Beef Hot Pot (Shenzhen Nanshan Hi-Tech Branch), Keji South 8th Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: After dinner, while taking a walk, replied to Teacher Wu.
description: After dinner, instead of returning directly to the hotel, she strolled to the seaside walkway at nearby Shenzhen Bay Park. Feeling the sea breeze, she replied to Teacher Wu Xiuying via WeChat: “Teacher Wu, the Shenzhen itinerary is tight. After I return to Hong Kong tomorrow, I’ll organize the exhibition materials for you. My initial idea is to exhibit the ‘Daughter’s World Spring’ series, along with the design drafts and creative notes. Do you think that would be appropriate?” After receiving Teacher Wu’s affirmative reply, she felt very happy.
location: Seafront promenade of Shenzhen Bay Park, Binhai Avenue, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Hotel fitness and running stretches
description: Back at the hotel, she changed into running gear and used the hotel treadmill. Since she had no fixed running plan after returning to Hong Kong the next day, she decided to do a recovery run. She jogged at a pace of 8:00/km for 30 minutes, covering 3.8 km in total. After finishing, she did 10 minutes of systematic post-run stretching on a yoga mat nearby, paying special attention to her calves and hip flexors to relieve the fatigue from sitting for long periods during the summit.
location: No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, third-floor gym of Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel

name: Evening study organization and reflection
description: Back in the room, she used the hotel desk and opened her iPad. Drawing on what she had seen and heard that day, she used Excel to refine the schedule for next week's one-on-one meetings with the team, allocating time slots and also noting each person's key discussion points and pending issues. After that, she spent half an hour browsing industry research reports on Greater Bay Area InsurTech to build up material for tomorrow's follow-up conversation with client Wang Qiming.
location: Guest room on the 32nd floor, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Mindfulness before bed to calm the mind
description: After washing up, she changed into pajamas and sat on the bed, doing a 15-minute mindfulness meditation using the Keep app. The guided audio helped her shift her attention away from anxiety points such as "husband's career transition, relationship with father, and team management" and focus on her breath and physical relaxation. After the meditation, her mind felt much lighter.
location: Guest room on the 32nd floor, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning. Put the phone on the nightstand, put on the eye mask and earplugs. Although she knew that the day after returning to Hong Kong would be Family Day and a brand-new workday, everything today was well in hand. With a deep sense of satisfaction and a clear plan for the next two days, she peacefully settled down to sleep.
location: Guest room on the 32nd floor, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Morning wake-up and checkout.
description: In the hostel room, complete 10 minutes of simple yoga and 5 minutes of mindful breathing, then quickly pack your luggage, go to the front desk to check out, and organize the summit materials into your backpack.
location: Guangdong Province, Shenzhen, Nanshan District, No. 18 Dengliang Road, Star Isle Youth Hostel (Nanyou Metro Station Branch)

name: Commuting back to Hong Kong and arriving home
description: Walked from the hostel to Nanyou Station, took Metro Line 2 and transferred to Line 1 to reach Luohu Port in Shenzhen. After clearing customs efficiently, took the East Rail line to Hong Kong. On the train, used a tablet to organize key summit insights and write notes for the team, and browsed financial news. After arriving at Kowloon Tong Station, transferred to a green minibus. On the way, texted her mother to confirm she was safe. After arriving home, hugged her mother, put down the Shenzhen specialty gifts, and confirmed the children's pickup and dinner arrangements for the afternoon.
location: Starting point: Dengliang Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province; pass through Shenzhen Luohu Port (Heping Road, Luohu District, Shenzhen); take the East Rail line to Hong Kong Kowloon Tong Station; then transfer to a minibus and go to Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Breakfast and organizing materials
description: She enjoyed the shrimp wonton noodles and hot lemon water her mother had prepared, while sorting the summit materials from her suitcase and putting them back into the study's file shelf.
location: Dining room and study at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Focused work: proposal fine-tuning and renewal preparation
description: In the study, she opened the company system and made final fine adjustments to client Wang Qiming's high-end medical insurance plan, focusing on optimizing the direct-billing network details for Grade-A tertiary hospitals in the Greater Bay Area. Then she pulled up client Chen Meiling's policy information, marked the renewal term changes with a highlighter, and prepared an explanation checklist.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family coordination and lunch out
description: Her husband called to confirm the arrangements for picking up their daughter from school. After coordinating, the husband would pick her up. Yu Xiaowei then left early and walked to Whampoa New World mall, where she ordered a bowl of hot and sour soup and steamed dumplings for lunch at the Chinese restaurant New Shanghai Kitchen.
location: At home and New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant, Whampoa Xintiandi Mall, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District

name: Commuting to client Mrs. Chen's residence.
description: From Whampoa Station, she took the MTR via Mong Kok East Station and Kowloon Tong Station, transferring to the Island Line to Tai Koo Station, replying to several customer inquiries along the way.
location: Along the MTR line from Whampoa Station to Taikoo Station

name: Client meeting: policy renewal and in-depth discussion
description: Arrived at the residence of client Chen Meiling in central Taikoo Shing. After asking about her family, she used a tablet to log in to the company system, clearly explained the reasons for the slight premium adjustment and the upgraded coverage, and after confirming each item, Mrs. Chen completed the renewal online. Then they moved to the living room. While sipping tea and chatting, Mrs. Chen lamented the family's financial pressure, and Yu Xiaowei shared her views on risk management and retirement planning, patiently answering questions and deepening her sense of professional value.
location: Chen Meiling's residence, Cityplaza, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return trip and uploading work materials
description: After saying goodbye to Mrs. Chen, she took the MTR back to Kowloon Tong. On the way, she used her phone to upload the organized summit notes and business reminders to the team's shared cloud drive.
location: MTR Tai Koo Station to Kowloon Tong Station

name: Preparing and sharing a family dinner
description: After arriving home, she helped her mother bring the winter melon and pork rib soup to the table and stuck the children's drawings on the refrigerator. The whole family (herself, her husband, the children, and her parents) sat around the table for dinner. During the meal, they shared what they had seen and heard in Shenzhen and funny family stories, with laughter throughout.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child bonding and homework guidance
description: After dinner, accompanied her daughter reading the picture book "The Very Hungry Caterpillar," imitating the actions to amuse her, then helped her son with his math homework, offering a solution suggestion for a word problem.
location: Living room and study at home.

name: Evening personal relaxation: requesting leave, stretching, and meditation
description: Used WeChat to ask fellow runner Shen Peiwen for leave and explain that I could not attend the evening training. Then I changed into sportswear, did a 10-minute shoulder and neck stretch on the living room carpet, and then sat cross-legged for 15 minutes of mindful meditation, focusing on my breath and emptying my mind.
location: Living room at home

name: Cantonese embroidery creation
description: After the children quieted down, she sat down at the embroidery table in the study, took out the piece 'Daughter's World Spring,' and embroidered a new leaf using the rolling needle stitch, while thinking about the composition adjustments for the exhibit suggested by her teacher. She felt calm and focused.
location: Embroidery desk in the home study

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, reading, and going to sleep
description: After washing up, she used her phone to record the day's diet and exercise, then leaned against the headboard to read the final chapters of Nonviolent Communication, underlining key sentences. After reading, she fell asleep at 21:00 feeling satisfied and calm.
location: Bedroom at home.

name: Morning wake-up and mind-body activation.
description: The alarm went off, and I drew the curtains; outside was Hong Kong's hot, humid summer weather with cloudy skies. On the yoga mat in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room, I did 15 minutes of gentle flow yoga, focusing on breathing and neck-and-shoulder stretches to ease the physical fatigue from back-to-back business trips. Then I added 5 minutes of a plank and bird-dog circuit to reinforce my daily core-strength habit.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family collaboration and morning observation
description: After finishing exercise, I quickly showered and changed into professional casual attire. Walking into the kitchen, I found my mother had already cooked congee. I helped her bring the fried eggs and barbecue pork buns to the table. My husband Weiming was helping our daughter pack her schoolbag. I chatted with him for a bit and noticed he looked slightly pensive, but I didn't ask directly; I just lightly reminded him to remember to pick up Xuanxuan from school this afternoon. The family had a simple and warm breakfast together.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, Weiming and I split up according to our plan. He drove our son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, while I walked our daughter to the nearby Kowloon City Kindergarten. On the way, I held her little hand and listened to her describe in her baby voice the little hamster that a classmate had kept in class yesterday. After handing my daughter to her teacher, I walked home to get my commuter bag.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute and work warm-up
description: Walked from home to the MTR station on Prince Edward Road West, took the Kwun Tong line to Mong Kok station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan line to Admiralty station, then switched to the Island line and arrived at Wan Chai station. The whole journey took about 50 minutes. On the train, I put on my earphones, listened to a pop playlist, and quickly listed in my phone's memo the key points for the upcoming one-on-one discussion with team member He Junwen: first affirm his work in referring clients last month, then focus on the difficult points in learning the terms of the new personal accident insurance.
location: From Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, via MTR

name: Arrive at work and tidy up the office environment
description: After arriving at the office, she first went to the pantry and made herself a cup of unsweetened green tea. Back at her desk, she quickly checked her work email, handled three internal emails about next week's training arrangements, and neatly put the notebooks and promotional leaflets brought back from yesterday's Shenzhen summit into the filing cabinet.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: One-on-one meeting with team member He Junwen
description: Xiao He and I met in the conference room on time. First I praised his initiative in successfully referring a car insurance client to me last month, then gently mentioned that when I used the "new business system" last time, I found he rarely queried the cash value of accident insurance. Xiao He hesitated for a moment, then frankly said he was not confident enough in explaining the terms of some non-flagship insurance products, so he tended to avoid such questions when clients asked. I said I understood, and confirmed with him on the spot that at next Wednesday's internal product training session, a special segment on "Detailed Explanation of Accident and Medical Insurance Terms" would be arranged, and asked him to prepare two common questions in advance. Xiao He was obviously relieved.
location: Small meeting room, 3rd Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing follow-up work from the business trip
description: Back at the workstation, I spent about 90 minutes dealing with the backlog from yesterday's Shenzhen trip. I organized the key information from the summit notes (such as new developments in cross-border medical services in the Greater Bay Area) into electronic form and filed it in the team's shared folder. Then I logged into the customer management system and, one by one, completed the contact information, needs, and meeting notes of the five new clients that had not been entered in time during the two-day business trip. I also tagged one client, who had clearly expressed interest in high-end medical insurance, as 'high potential - follow-up week.'
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Phone follow-up with key clients
description: She called Ms. Li, who had inquired about education insurance for her newborn. In a warm and professional tone, she briefly exchanged updates about the baby and, based on Ms. Li's earlier request for “higher education fund planning,” highlighted a participating savings plan from the company that features flexible premiums and guaranteed returns. They agreed to discuss the details at a café near Ms. Li's home at 3 p.m. next Wednesday (July 2), and she promised to prepare a tailor-made proposal in advance. After the call, she immediately created a follow-up record in the system.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and browsing race information
description: Took out the homemade lunch prepared last night from the company fridge: broccoli stir-fried chicken breast with brown rice. While eating quickly, I opened the Hong Kong Amateur Athletic Association website on my phone and saw that the November "Hong Kong Streetathon" half marathon had opened early-bird registration. I quickly browsed the route map and felt very excited, but thinking about the family financial changes to handle in the evening, I didn't sign up immediately. Instead, I saved the event page and planned to decide after discussing it with Weiming tonight.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Proposal refinement and professional development
description: After lunch I felt a little sleepy, so I walked to the window and looked out at Victoria Harbour for five minutes to refresh myself. Returning to my seat, I opened client Wang Qiming's high-end medical insurance proposal and, combining the new policy on 'direct payment for cross-border medical treatment in the Greater Bay Area' heard at yesterday's Shenzhen summit, made two small but key optimizations to the payment terms and hospital network sections, making the proposal more competitive. Then I began outlining the PPT for next week's internal team training on 'Analysis of Common Accident Insurance Claim Rejection Cases.'
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Responded to social and exhibition-related communications.
description: During a break, replied on WeChat to Teacher Wu Xiuying, a Yue embroidery artist, regarding her inquiry about the exhibition process for the Autumn Arts and Crafts Exhibition. Confirmed to Teacher Wu my intention to participate, and asked about the submission deadline and size requirements for the work "Daughter's World Spring". Teacher Wu quickly replied, gave the specific information, and urged me to finish on time. I acknowledged receipt and promised to visit her studio next week to discuss the work details in person.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Off-site work and remote communication
description: Decided to change the setting and handle some relatively independent paperwork. Carrying her laptop and an insulated mug, she walked to the café in Shui On Centre downstairs and ordered an iced lemon tea. In that hour-plus, she efficiently completed three things: 1) via LinkedIn, she sent a preliminary connection request and self-introduction to a potential client in Shenzhen (who runs a cross-border e-commerce business), introduced by Zhou Minyi; 2) she organized and replied to three client-service inquiry emails; and 3) she browsed the latest issue of the Hong Kong Insurance Authority Quarterly on her phone to understand industry compliance developments.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leaving work early for the commute
description: She left the company about an hour earlier than usual, walked from Shui On Centre to Wan Chai Station, and took the MTR back to Kowloon City. The whole trip took about 51 minutes. When the train passed through the cross-harbour tunnel, she called her best friend Lin Jiaxin. She briefly mentioned how her communication with team members and client follow-up had gone that day, then casually said that Weiming wanted to talk to her about something in the evening, with a hint of uncertainty in her tone. Jiaxin understood immediately and cheered her on with her characteristic hearty laugh: “Things will work out in the end!” They agreed to go shopping together at the mall in Whampoa New Town on Saturday afternoon.
location: From Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong SAR to Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, via MTR.

name: Family time and dinner preparation
description: When I got home, my mother was washing vegetables in the kitchen. I changed out of my work clothes, put on loungewear, and first played an Animal Clinic make-believe game in the living room with my daughter, who had just come back from kindergarten. Around 5:30, my husband Weiming brought my son Xuanxuan home. I checked Xuanxuan's math homework and found a wrong problem about two-digit subtraction with borrowing. I patiently guided him to recalculate it himself. After that, I went into the kitchen and helped peel garlic while discussing the dinner menu with my mother (steamed grass carp, stir-fried choy sum with minced garlic).
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Husband informs of major decision
description: Just before dinner was about to start, Weiming motioned for me to sit down on the living room sofa. Calmly and solemnly, he told me that he had officially submitted his resignation to the company that day, expected to take effect at the end of July, and had already contacted a repair shop specializing in new energy vehicle maintenance; he could go for a trial shift at the beginning of next month. Hearing this, although I had a feeling it was coming, for a moment I still felt a gentle thump in my heart. I took a deep breath, remembered the enthusiasm he had shown during our late-night conversation earlier, reached out and held his hand, and said, "Since you've thought it through, I support you. It's okay if the income is a bit lower at first—we're in this together, and we'll work it out." Weiming's eyes reddened slightly.
location: Living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and sharing news
description: At the dinner table, I took the initiative to tell my mother about Weiming's decision. Mother was stunned for a moment, then looked at Weiming and said in a slightly worried but supportive tone, "It's good for a man to have his own ideas, but the burden on the family is heavy too. Xiaowei, you two will have to work even harder in the future." I quickly chimed in, "Mom, don't worry, we'll plan things out." During the meal, Weiming and I tacitly changed the subject, chatting about Xuanxuan's final exams next week and the funny stories from Xinxin's painting class, trying hard to keep the usual family atmosphere.
location: Restaurant, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family time and childcare
description: After dinner, I was responsible for clearing and rinsing the dishes. Then I urged my son Xuanxuan to go back to his room to review, and dictated 10 English words and 5 Chinese synonym sentences to him. Next, I ran bath water for my daughter Xinxin, helped her bathe and wash her hair, and then put her in cute polka-dot pajamas. In bed, I read her the story 'Guess How Much I Love You', and she fell asleep peacefully as she listened.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's late-night financial discussion
description: After the children were asleep, Weiming and I spread out the ledger and the expense-tracking app on our phone in the bedroom. We carefully calculated the family's monthly fixed expenses (mortgage, car expenses, children's tuition, household expenses) and the expected income gap after Weiming quit his job. After repeated discussions, we reached an agreement: 1) suspend the originally planned family trip to Taiwan in August; 2) reduce the number of restaurant meals and impulse purchases over the next six months; 3) I decided to sign up directly for the half marathon in November, using the energy of race preparation to distract from financial stress. Weiming promised that once he settled into his new position, he would strive to obtain an advanced certificate in new energy vehicle maintenance as soon as possible to increase his income.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Self-soothing and engagement in hobbies
description: After the financial discussion, I felt a heavy pressure. I walked into the study, turned on the desk lamp, and took out the Cantonese embroidery work 'Daughter's World: Spring,' which was more than half finished. Holding my breath and focusing, I threaded the needle and concentrated on embroidering the delicate veins of the spring willow leaves with the rolling stitch. The process of embroidering gave me a wonderful sense of calm, as if the trivialities and anxieties of life were being dissolved stitch by stitch.
location: Study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Mindful meditation and bedtime preparation
description: Put down the embroidery frame and do a 15-minute bedtime mindfulness meditation, focusing on breathing and letting the thoughts of the day gradually settle. After meditating, wash up, change into pajamas, and write on the bedside table calendar one thing to do tomorrow: call coach Zhao Zhiming to confirm registration for the November Hong Kong Street Marathon half marathon. With a trace of uncertainty about the future, but more so the firmness of supporting her husband's decision and the calm healed by her own hobby, she turned off the light and went to bed at 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning Yoga and Getting Ready to Go Out
description: In the early morning, she spread out her yoga mat in front of the living room floor-to-ceiling window, doing 15 minutes of Sun Salutations and shoulder-and-neck stretches with deep breathing to wake up her body; then she quickly washed up, drank honey lemon water, checked the weather, put a folding umbrella and a light jacket into her commuter bag, and took her lunch bento out of the refrigerator.
location: Home at Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: The family sat around the table for breakfast; Mother had prepared white congee, fried eggs, and steamed turnip cake. After the meal, they did a 5-minute core workout in the kitchen (plank and bird dog). Then the husband drove, and the family of four took the daughter to Kowloon City Kindergarten. At the school gate they hugged the daughter and told her to behave, and the husband then drove the son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School.
location: Home at Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District

name: Commute to the office and morning preparation
description: Take Bus 113 to Wan Chai, listen to the 'Greater Bay Area Insurance Observer' podcast on the phone on the way, and note the latest cases of combining high-end medical insurance with cross-border medical resources; after arriving at the office, brew black coffee, check and reply to urgent emails, and write a work list to post beside the monitor.
location: 12/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning work and preparations for going out
description: Handled client emails: confirmed Wang Qiming's high-end medical insurance plan and scheduled a physical examination; replied to colleague Su Lishan's feedback on the team weekly report; provided a preliminary savings dividend insurance plan for Mr. Li, who was referred by a friend in Shenzhen, and arranged communication next week. Then she polished the outline for next Wednesday's internal product training PPT; after that, she saved files, tidied her desk, arranged to meet her husband at the Junction Road hardware store at 11:10, and listed a shopping list in her phone memo (light blue eco-friendly latex paint, protective tape, small roller, brush, paint tray, and star sticker mold).
location: 12/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the hardware store and purchase materials
description: Take the Island Line and transfer to the Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon City Station, then walk to Junction Road, messaging her husband on WeChat along the way to share their locations. She met her husband at Hang Cheong Hardware, and they selected light-blue eco-friendly latex paint, protective tape, small rollers, brushes, paint trays, and star-sticker stencils according to the list. Her husband discussed the application details with the shop assistant while Yu Xiaowei checked the list and paid by mobile phone (about HKD 380). Her husband suggested putting the materials back in the car first.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, 14 Yung Chong Street, Hengchang Hardware

name: Return home to rest and have lunch.
description: Her husband drove home with the materials. Yu Xiaowei bought blueberries, dragon fruit, and mangoes at the ParknShop in Whampoa New World, walked home, and put them in the fridge. Her mother had already prepared lunch (steamed grass carp belly, blanched choy sum with rice). While eating, they talked about the division of tasks for renovating the children’s room tomorrow, and she told her mother she was going out with friends in the afternoon. After the meal, she changed into a comfortable dress and flat sandals, rested with her eyes closed for 10 minutes, and decided to keep a new dress she had been planning to return, altering it to wear instead.
location: Home at Crown Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and ParknShop supermarket, Whampoa New Sky shopping mall, No. 6 Tak Hong Street

name: Go to Langham Place to meet up with friends.
description: She walked to Mong Kok East Station, took the East Rail line, then walked to Langham Place. On the way, she confirmed the meeting with WeChat friend Lin Jiaxin. They met at 13:30 in the atrium on the ground floor of Langham Place, hugged warmly. Yu Xiaowei praised Jiaxin's new blouse, and Jiaxin shared that she had bought new clothes to celebrate her project being approved.
location: L1 Atrium, Langham Place Mall, 8 Argyle Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shopping with friends
description: The two browsed ZARA, UNIQLO, and a local designer multi-brand store. Yu Xiaowei tried on a light green floral fitted waist dress and was praised for making her look fairer and slimmer, so she bought it (HKD 529). Jiaxin picked out two tops. While shopping, they talked freely about work stress, and Yu Xiaowei shared how she used morning runs and Cantonese embroidery to relieve stress. During a break, Yu Xiaowei used her phone to reply to a client on WeChat to confirm next week's meeting time, and decided not to return the old dress.
location: Fashion stores on all floors of Langham Place Mall, 8 Argyle Street, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Hong Kong-style afternoon tea time.
description: The two walked to Men Wah Cafe, ordered iced milk tea, the signature pineapple bun with butter, and a char siu egg sandwich; as they ate and chatted, Jiaxin shared the good news that her husband had been promoted, Yu Xiaowei mentioned her goal for the November half marathon, and Jiaxin said she wanted to go to the finish line to cheer. The whole afternoon was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, Mong Kok, ground floor of Sun Po Theatre Building, Min Wah Café.

name: Returning home and family dinner
description: After saying goodbye to Jiaxin at the entrance of the ice cafe, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR back to Kowloon City. When she got home, she put on the new floral dress to show it off. Her daughter clapped and said it was pretty, and her husband complimented her. Then she changed into home clothes, helped her mother pick vegetables and set the table, and shared fun stories about the shopping trip and tomorrow's renovation plan. The whole family of six had dinner together. The main dishes were tomato and potato pork rib soup, blanched shrimp, and garlic stir-fried pea shoots. They chatted about the afternoon's fun while eating, and her father mentioned going to the flower market on the weekend.
location: Home at Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Checking homework and keeping the children company
description: After the meal, she checked her son's math homework and corrected a mistake in a word problem about area; while her daughter played with building blocks, Yu Xiaowei read her the picture book The Little Princess and enjoyed warm parent-child time.
location: Home study and living room, Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Relaxation before bed and preparation for renovation
description: She dug out an old T-shirt and sweatpants, folded them, and placed them by the bed to wear for tomorrow's renovation work, and reminded her husband to bring old newspapers and a mask. She then did 10 minutes of full-body stretching in the living room, focusing on relaxing her calves and hips, followed by 5 minutes of cross-legged mindful meditation to clear her mind.
location: Bedroom and living room of her home in Prince's Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery practice and interaction
description: In the study, she took out her Cantonese embroidery tools and added a few decorative stitches (little flowers and butterflies) to the piece Spring in My Daughter's World. At the same time, she interacted with Teacher Wu Xiuying on WeChat, sharing today's fulfilling life and tomorrow's plan for the whole family to renovate the children's room.
location: Home study, Crown Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Washed up and applied basic skincare, changed into pajamas, set an alarm for 23:00, and wrote a brief text message summarizing what was accomplished today; got into bed and read a chapter of Nonviolent Communication for about 20 minutes, then felt sleepy, turned off the light and went to sleep, listening to the traffic outside the window and thinking about tomorrow's renovation plans as I drifted off.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Prince Building, Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning yoga and core training
description: Yu Xiaowei got up on time and spread out her yoga mat in the sunlit living room. She first did 15 minutes of Sun Salutation breathing and stretching to wake up her body. Then she added 5 minutes of core training, focusing on side plank and glute bridge, to prepare for today's physical work. During this, she heard the children's excited discussion coming from the children's room next door and couldn't help but smile.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and final check of the renovation materials
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming had prepared a simple breakfast (fried eggs, toast, milk). The family of four ate while discussing the color details for today's painting. Xuanxuan and Xinxin argued endlessly over whether to use little sun stickers or star stickers. Yu Xiaowei gently suggested, “You can mix and match freely.” After the meal, she went to the balcony to check again the light blue latex paint, protective tape, rollers, and brushes her husband had bought yesterday, confirming all the tools were complete.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Children's Room Cleaning and Childproofing
description: The whole family pitched in. Yu Xiaowei and her husband covered large pieces of furniture, such as the bed and desk, with old sheets and moved them to the center of the living room to minimize how far they had to be moved. She carefully applied protective tape along the gaps around the walls, baseboards, door frames, and switch plates, moving nimbly. The children helped pass the tape and newspapers, and although they fooled around occasionally, the overall cooperation was cheerful.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The Whole Family Had Fun Painting
description: Painting officially began. Zhang Weiming handled the high areas and the ceiling with a large roller, while Yu Xiaowei focused on the details of the corners, window frames, and door frames, carefully touching them up with a small brush. The two children happily doodled on their own sections of the wall with mini rollers, getting some paint spots on themselves and the floor, but laughter never stopped. Midway through, her mother Chen Meiling brought cut watermelon and herbal tea and reminded everyone to rest. The siblings had argued over the shade of color in one area, so Yu Xiaowei stopped what she was doing and patiently had them compare the effect after the paint was applied and dried, successfully resolving the conflict.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Finishing touches, decoration, and celebration
description: After finishing the painting, they quickly removed the protective tape and cleaned the brushes and rollers. Under Yu Xiaowei's guidance, the children carefully peeled off the backing of the star and moon stickers and, with their parents' help, stuck them in the designated positions. Once everything was ready, the family pulled away the protective cloth and put the furniture back in place. Finally, the four of them lay together on the brand-new floor, enjoying the refreshed room, and took a group selfie with their phones.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and rest
description: Mother Chen Meiling had prepared lunch: steamed sea bass, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, and the tomato scrambled eggs the children love. As they ate, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother and asked whether her father had gone out to play chess again today. Her mother said she had seen him reading the newspaper on the balcony before she left and that he seemed to be in good shape. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to wash the dishes and asked her husband to watch cartoons with the children. She stood in the dining room to help digestion and used her phone to reply to a few weekend greeting messages from clients.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Supplement with core training.
description: Although she had already exercised quite a bit in the morning, in order to maintain her daily exercise routine, Yu Xiaowei did 15 minutes of fragmented core training in the living room, including crunches, plank variations, and air cycling. After finishing, she was slightly sweaty and felt her physical function had been strengthened.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon free time and self-improvement
description: The children were looked after by her husband and grandmother in the living room, so Yu Xiaowei got some time to herself. She first opened her phone and looked at photos from yesterday's shopping trip with her best friend Jiaxin, then switched to the CFP course study materials and reviewed the chapter on “Employee Benefit Plans”. She planned to use spare moments to keep studying and prepare for the promotion.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Welcoming father home and observing his condition.
description: Yu Xiaowei checked the time. Her father should be about done playing chess in the park and on his way back. She went downstairs and walked to the Ho Man Tin Hill Road Rest Garden near the estate, where she saw her father Yu Guoqiang and several old chess buddies packing up the board and getting ready to go home. She went up to him and naturally walked side by side with him toward home. Along the way, her father was silent and looked unwell. Yu Xiaowei's heart tightened, but she did not ask immediately; she just chatted about interesting things from the home renovation.
location: Ho Man Tin Hill Road Rest Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Father's emotional outburst and the follow-up soothing.
description: After returning home, her mother, Chen Meiling, asked as usual how the chess game had gone. Unexpectedly, her father suddenly flew into a rage, slammed his teacup heavily on the table, and loudly complained that his old chess partner had been cheating and that everyone had laughed at him for making a wrong move. He shut himself in the bedroom and stopped communicating with anyone, and her mother seemed at a loss. Yu Xiaowei first gently comforted her mother, signaling that there was no need to worry and that she would handle it. Then she went to the balcony, made a WhatsApp call to her younger brother, Yu Xiaofeng, and briefly explained what had just happened with their father. After hearing this, her brother was also quite worried and agreed to observe for another day or two; if it continued, they should still go see the general practitioner at the community center. Yu Xiaowei agreed and reminded him to come home more often in the near future. After hanging up, she returned to the living room and saw that her mother had already gone to the kitchen to prepare dinner, so she quietly replaced the herbal tea in her father's teacup with warm water.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with dinner and family interaction
description: Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen to help her mother pick over the vegetables and prepare dinner. She took the initiative to suggest having some chrysanthemum tea with dinner to ease down the heat. Afterward, she played a few rounds of Ludo with the children, trying to create a relaxed family atmosphere and keep the children from being affected by her father's mood.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: During dinner, her father Yu Guoqiang remained silent, ate only a little rice, and returned to his room. Yu Xiaowei exchanged a glance with her husband and tacitly did not bring up the matter at the table. She served food to the children and chatted with Zhang Weiming about the new energy vehicle repair shop where he would start a trial shift next week, as well as the parent-child activity arrangements for their daughter's kindergarten next week, trying to keep the dinner table harmonious.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Check children's homework and enjoy picture book time.
description: Yu Xiaowei first sat in the living room and patiently checked her son Xuanxuan's remaining math homework. She praised his neat handwriting and corrected his approach on two word problems. Then, in the light of the newly renovated children's room, she sat at the new desk and read the newly bought picture book The Little Seed to her daughter Xinxin, describing the story of the seed's journey.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery practice
description: After the children quieted down, Yu Xiaowei sat at her desk and took out her unfinished Cantonese embroidery piece, A Daughter's World in Spring. Under the soft lamplight, she focused on every stitch. As she embroidered, she felt her worries gradually settle with each rise and fall of the needle. After the piece had been praised at Teacher Wu's studio a few days earlier, she worked on it with even more care.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening mindfulness meditation
description: After practicing Cantonese embroidery, Yu Xiaowei washed up, sat cross-legged on the bed, and began 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation. She tried to focus on her breathing, letting turbulent thoughts such as worries about her father, the joy of the renovation, and next week's work plans drift by like clouds, and her heart gradually returned to calm.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Brief conversation with husband, planning next week.
description: After meditation, her husband Zhang Weiming had just settled the children. The couple leaned against the headboard and briefly exchanged how they felt about the day. Yu Xiaowei shared about her father and the communication with her younger brother. Her husband advised her not to be too anxious, as things have to be resolved step by step. Yu Xiaowei took out her phone, glanced at the address of the clinic where she would take client Wang Qiming for a physical examination on Monday, and sent a message to her mother, reminding her that she could invite her father to go for yum cha tomorrow to lighten the mood.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and journaling.
description: After taking a shower and changing into her pajamas, Yu Xiaowei took out her diary and quickly wrote down her feelings of the day: the joy of a successful renovation, the oppressiveness after her father's outburst, and the relief after communicating with her family. She wrote: “Today, the walls of my room are completely renewed, but the wall in my father's heart still needs to be opened slowly by all of us together.”
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei poured herself a glass of warm water, set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, and planned her Sunday: a morning run with company, an in-depth talk with her younger brother, and taking her father to see a doctor. Then she turned off the bedside lamp, closed her eyes in the darkness, and settled down to sleep. Though a trace of worry remained in her heart, the fulfilling day also made her feel grounded.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and yoga
description: At 5:45 in the morning, Yu Wei woke up naturally. She drank a glass of warm water, then laid out her yoga mat in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room and did 15 minutes of gentle morning yoga, including Child's pose and Cat-Cow, to relax her shoulders, back, and spine and begin the new day calmly.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Community jogging and stretching
description: At 6:00, Yu Wei left home and walked 5 minutes to the Whampoa Garden waterfront jogging trail. She jogged 3 km easily at a 7:30/km pace, keeping her heart rate around 140. After the run, she did 10 minutes of full-body stretching beside the viewing platform, focusing on loosening the fronts of her thighs and calves, laying a solid foundation for the 12-week half-marathon plan. After stretching, she walked home.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden waterfront jogging trail

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast with the family.
description: After jogging home, Yu Wei showered and changed into home clothes, then prepared breakfast for the family: whole wheat bread, fried eggs, a fruit platter, and Pu'er tea for her mother. At 7:30, the whole family sat down for breakfast. Yu Wei noticed that her father Yu Guoqiang was a little quiet, so she took the initiative to serve him dishes, talked about the weather, and the plan to take the children to Kowloon Park. Her husband Zhang Weiming also cooperated by sharing anecdotes, and the two children's chatter kept the dining table from being too dull.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Monthly diet review and planning
description: After breakfast, Yu Wei opened a nutrition management app on her phone, completed yesterday's food diary, and exported the June report. She found that the variety of vegetables was too small, especially dark green leafy vegetables were insufficient, so she planned a new July menu in the app's recipe section, increasing the frequency of kale and spinach.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Market shopping and personal time
description: Given her father's low mood, Yu Wei instead went alone to the Prince Edward Road West street market and bought fresh seasonal fruit (Taiwan pineapple, blueberries) and the char siu her father loved. After returning home, she washed and cut the fruit, arranged it on the coffee table, and organized the client birthday greeting messages that needed to be sent today.
location: Prince Edward Road West Market, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family interaction and sharing creations
description: Yu Wei took out the album of the Cantonese embroidery work “Daughter’s World Spring” and enjoyed it together with her daughter Zhang Yuxin. She taught her daughter to distinguish different colors of silk thread and demonstrated the “rolling needle” embroidery technique. The mother and daughter enjoyed an intimate time through warm interaction.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video core training session with a friend
description: At exactly 10:00, Yu Wei and her good friend Shen Peiwen did core training over a WeChat video call. Each did three sets of plank variations (20 seconds per set) and crunches (20 reps per set) at home. During the breaks, Shen Peiwen shared the date of her business trip to Singapore next Wednesday, and the two agreed to have dinner together after she returned.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Monthly financial review
description: After the training session, Yu Wei and her husband Zhang Weiming conducted their monthly financial review. She listed the May balance, travel fund deposits, and the status of the regular fund investments. Because her husband might leave his job at the end of July, she proposed cutting the eating-out budget, suspending the travel fund for three months, and transferring HK$10,000 from the flexible fund for emergencies. The two eventually reached a consensus.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Free activity and emotional warming
description: After the financial review, Yu Wei noticed her father smoking alone on the balcony, so she brought over some pineapple and kept him company, gently asking whether he would like her to accompany him on a walk. Later, she joined her son Zhang Zixuan in building LEGO, and suggested going downstairs for a walk around the neighborhood, asking her father to come along. Her father did not say much, but followed quietly with slow steps.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the surrounding community.

name: Lunch and report card celebration
description: Mother Chen Meiling prepared home-style lunch dishes such as scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried greens, and steamed egg custard. Her son Zhang Zixuan brought home his end-of-term report card (Math A, Chinese B+, English B). Yu Wei kept her promise and immediately bought online the LEGO Space Shuttle set he loved. The whole family applauded Xuanxuan, the atmosphere was lively, and his father also smiled.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break, work preparation, and checklist organization.
description: After lunch, Yu Wei urged the children to take a nap and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing relaxation. Then she moved to the study and spent 30 minutes browsing the company's internal system, confirming the list of clients to follow up on July 1, and marking them in her memo. Starting at 14:30, she organized the client follow-up list, categorized and prioritized the key clients for next week, and prepared follow-up scripts, making full preparations for next week's work.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time at the community playground.
description: At 3 p.m., just after the sudden rain stopped, Yu Wei took her two children to the playground of Whampoa Garden. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin swung on the swing, while her son Zhang Zixuan challenged himself on the climbing frame. Yu Wei sat on a bench supervising, replied to a few non-urgent client WeChat messages on her phone, and enjoyed a leisurely time with her children.
location: Playground at the Whampoa Garden housing estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home to tidy up and assist in preparing the meal
description: After walking home from the playground, Yu Wei helped the children shower and change clothes. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling prepare dumpling filling and wrappers, chatting and sharing stories about the playground and her husband's trial work next week.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Mother Chen Meiling's pork and cabbage dumplings were served, and the whole family sat around to enjoy them. The dinner atmosphere was harmonious. Yu Wei announced that she would lead her team to "move at a running pace" next week, and her husband Zhang Weiming also shared the news that he would go to the new energy vehicle repair shop for a trial shift next Tuesday. Father Yu Guoqiang made an exception and ate two bowls of dumplings, which made Yu Wei feel much more at ease.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tidying up after the meal and chatting with family
description: After dinner, Yu Wei cleared the dishes and washed fruit. In the living room, she discussed her father's health with her husband and mother, and agreed to make a doctor's appointment if his mood still did not improve next week. They also checked their schedules for the next week to ensure seamless arrangements for picking up and dropping off the children.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and study tutoring
description: Yu Wei first checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math homework and corrected the decimal point errors; then she read two picture books with her daughter Zhang Yuxin, helped her wash up, and told her stories until she fell asleep.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Husband-wife communication and Cantonese embroidery practice
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Wei briefly talked with her husband Zhang Weiming about the psychological preparation and tool purchases needed after the career change. Then her husband watched a ball game, while Yu Wei took out her embroidery hoop to practice the flat stitch and rolling stitch of Cantonese embroidery. Following a tutorial video, she embroidered a few bamboo leaves and felt calm inside.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening relaxation, meditation, and bedtime preparation
description: Yu Wei completed a 10-minute full-body stretch in the bedroom, relaxing her gastrocnemius muscles, then did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, letting go of the past and accepting the present, entering a relaxed state with confidence in her family and anticipation for the next week. Afterward, she washed up briefly, wrote a gratitude journal, thanked her family for their company and herself for adjusting, set the alarm, and went to bed at exactly 10 p.m.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and core training
description: At 6:30 in the morning, after the alarm went off, you spread a yoga mat in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in your living room and did 15 minutes of breathing and stretching exercises to gently wake up your body. Then, with eyes closed, you practiced 5 minutes of mindful breathing, setting the tone of "stability, communication, planning" for the new work week. After yoga, you put away the mat and did 5 minutes of fragmented core training directly on the floor, including plank and bird-dog cycles. You felt that your core strength could complete these movements easily, and your whole body felt comfortable.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family morning time and breakfast preparation
description: After yoga, you returned to the bedroom and woke up your husband Zhang Weiming and the children. After washing up, you worked with your mother Chen Meiling in the kitchen to prepare a simple breakfast for the family: toast with fried eggs, milk, and fruit. At the table, you asked your son Zhang Zixuan what he was looking forward to in the new school week, and encouraged your husband, who was going to a trial shift at the new repair shop the next day, saying that no matter how things turned out, it would be a good start. You used your phone to take a family breakfast photo, recording this warm Monday morning.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the children to school
description: After breakfast, you and your husband divided the work. Your husband, Zhang Weiming, drove your daughter, Zhang Yuxin, to Kowloon City Kindergarten (about a 5-minute drive), while you walked your son, Zhang Zixuan, to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (about a 15-minute walk from home). On the way, you told your son to concentrate in class and agreed to play with the new puzzle together after school. After watching your son walk through the school gate, you turned and walked to Kowloon Tong MTR Station (about 5 minutes).
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 1 Oxford Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and Kowloon Tong MTR Station

name: Commuting and calculating payroll
description: After tapping your Octopus card to enter Kowloon Tong MTR station, the train happened to arrive just as you got there. During the commute, on the MTR, taking the East Rail Line and transferring to the Island Line, you took out your phone, logged into the company's internal payroll system, and received and carefully checked the June payslip. You confirmed the adjusted base salary after the promotion and the May renewal performance bonus. Calculating it, you found the total had increased by about 8,000 Hong Kong dollars compared to last month, and felt pleased. You took a screenshot of the payslip and quickly recorded the income distribution plan (savings, household expenses, emergency fund) in your phone memos.
location: MTR from Kowloon Tong Station to Wan Chai Station (inside the carriage on the East Rail line transferring to the Island line)

name: Arrived at the office, prepared before the weekly meeting, and led the team weekly meeting.
description: After arriving at the company, you greeted your colleagues and saved the salary distribution plan you had prepared during the commute. Then you began final preparations for the 10 a.m. team weekly meeting. You opened your notebook and rechecked the details of the new management measures to be implemented from July (the daily 15-minute one-on-one communication template and task assignment table), and communicated with colleague Su Lishan, who had arrived early, to confirm that she would assist in presenting the new plan at the weekly meeting. At 10 a.m. you presided over the team weekly meeting as scheduled. You first summarized the team's performance last week and announced the improvement in the June policy renewal rate. Then you officially announced the new management measures to be implemented from July, presented the standardized task assignment table, and clearly explained the significance of each new rule. Su Lishan said on the spot that she would help with the implementation, He Junwen also nodded in agreement, and the other team members expressed their approval. Your superior, Brother Hua, participated in the meeting online and praised the professionalism of your weekly meeting.
location: 3rd floor office and meeting room, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Customer service and document organization
description: After the weekly meeting, you returned to your desk, called client Wang Qiming to remind him to complete the physical examination as originally planned. Then, you spent half an hour preparing the materials for the afternoon client follow-up visits, logged into the client system, entered the potential client information introduced by Zhou Minyi last week, and checked the preliminary plan for Mr. Li from Shenzhen once more before sending it to his email.
location: Office, 3rd Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and midday break
description: You and your colleague Su Lishan walked to Kam Fung Café near the office (ground floor, Spring Garden Building, 41 Spring Garden Lane, Wan Chai). While ordering, you happily whispered to her that you got a pay raise today, and Su Lishan immediately congratulated you. The two of you ate dry-fried beef ho fun and iced lemon tea while exchanging management insights on how to communicate more smoothly with team members after the weekly meeting. On the way back to the company after the meal, you passed the Shui On Centre café (Shop 103, 1st Floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai), ordered an Americano, and sat on a sofa in the corner to rest. You put on your earphones and listened to a short podcast about time management, while using your phone to browse the nutrition management app you needed for the evening health review, mentally preparing for the evening fasting plan.
location: Kam Fung Cafe (Wan Chai branch) (G/F, Spring Garden Mansion, 41 Spring Garden Street, Wan Chai) and the cafe at Shui On Centre (Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai)

name: Afternoon client follow-up, policy service, and wrapping up work
description: Back in the office, you started your afternoon work. You called three clients who had recently closed deals for follow-up, confirmed their satisfaction with their policies, and answered questions about renewal terms. Then you dialed the mainland colleague you had met at last week's summit and had a professional, in-depth exchange. You both agreed to recommend clients with cross-border insurance needs to each other next month. After the call, you entered their information into the system and set a follow-up reminder for next week. Next, you handled the post-policy services for several clients who had received medical examination reports, including submitting supplementary underwriting materials for one client, and contacted Guo Junwei, a colleague in the actuarial department, via WeChat to confirm the terms of the high-end medical insurance product. Finally, you compiled today's customer service records, filed the to-do list for tomorrow, started tidying your desk, and wrote an encouraging note to tuck into your husband's coat pocket, ready to go home and surprise him.
location: Office, 3rd Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute home and pick up son from school
description: You left the office and walked to Wan Chai MTR Station (about 5 minutes), took the Island line to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the East Rail line toward Kowloon Tong. As the train crossed the city, you leaned against the window and dozed for a moment, thinking about how to have a heart-to-heart talk with your husband that evening and encourage him for his job trial tomorrow. After the train arrived, you walked directly to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School to pick up your son Zhang Zixuan (about a 5-minute walk from the MTR station). Xuanxuan was very happy to see you and took your hand to share fun stories from school. You walked home together (about 15 minutes) and bought a bottle of water at a convenience store on the way.
location: MTR Wan Chai Station to Kowloon Tong Station, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (1 Oxford Road, Kowloon Tong), on the way home

name: Family financial transfer
description: After arriving home, you changed into loungewear and opened mobile banking in the study. Following the plan made during the morning salary calculation, you transferred 5,000 Hong Kong dollars into the joint family savings account for medium- and long-term goals (such as the children's education fund). Then, you transferred the remaining approximately 3,000 Hong Kong dollars into the daily household account to supplement this month's family expense budget.
