At 8:40 she got off at Wan Chai Station, walked in the drizzle with an umbrella to the convenience store at Convention Plaza, and bought unsweetened soy milk and a vegetable salad as lunch provisions.
location: Along the Hong Kong MTR route from Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station, and the convenience store at Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning work preparations and team meeting
description: Walk from the convenience store to the office on the 22nd floor of Immigration Tower, tidy up the workstation, check the schedule and emails, and retrieve the policy documents for high-net-worth client Mr. Chen. At 9:15, organize the team morning meeting, reviewing the previous day's work with team members including new colleague Liu Qian and emphasizing the day's priorities. After the meeting, continue reviewing Mr. Chen's policy to prepare call-back scripts.
location: Room 2208 and small meeting room, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Urgently handling client complaint and analysis
description: At 10 o'clock, received an intense complaint call from client Mr. Zhang, who questioned the inaccurate explanation of critical illness coverage and the professionalism of new colleague Liu Qian. I immediately paused work, calmed him patiently, and recorded his concerns in detail. Afterwards, I pulled up Mr. Zhang's full policy documents, analyzed the disputed points one by one, reviewed the process, and concluded that the problem lay in insufficiently thorough communication details. I then focused entirely on organizing the key points to prepare for the afternoon discussion.
location: Room 2208, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunchtime break and in-depth phone call with a client
description: At my desk, ate a vegetable salad and ready-to-eat salmon, and logged the meal in an app. Because of staring at the screen for a long time, I applied artificial tears and did 5 minutes of eye yoga with eyes closed. At 13:00, I called Mr. Zhang and had a 45-minute in-depth conversation, explaining the disputed clauses and payout conditions in plain language, and promised to arrange a home visit as soon as possible to show the contract details. His tone softened, but he still had concerns.
location: Room 2208, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon work follow-up and cross-department collaboration.
description: After hanging up, I immediately sent a message to my actuarial colleague Guo Junwei, politely but firmly urging him to provide the Shenzhen market rules data, and explaining the urgency of the client proposal. Then I handled other client emails and inquiries, and organized and archived documents.
location: Room 2208, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon rest, eye care, and organizing materials
description: After the phone reminded her to take a break, she stood up and went to the window to gaze at the Victoria Harbour view, did neck exercises to relax her eyes and mind, and applied artificial tears for the second time. At 15:30, she began organizing the documents needed for tomorrow's visit to Mr. Zhang, including copies of insurance policies, the latest terms explanation, and handwritten communication points, placing them in order into a dedicated folder.
location: By the window on the 22nd floor and Room 2208, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Finished work and left
description: Replied to the last email, tidied the desk, and shut down the computer. Clocked out at 17:05, took the elevator down, and left the Immigration Tower.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute, shopping, and heading home.
description: Leaving the office, I held an umbrella against the drizzle and walked to Wan Chai Station, then took the MTR back to Whampoa. Arriving at Whampoa Station around 18:00, I walked to the Taste supermarket at Whampoa New World and bought blueberries, yogurt, and other fruit. Then I walked home, arriving at about 18:15.
location: Along the Hong Kong MTR from Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station, and the Taste supermarket at 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Plaza, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family gathering and pre-dinner time
description: Upon returning home, the children greeted her happily. She handed the fruit to her mother Chen Meiling, who was busy in the kitchen, and chatted briefly about the day's work. Seeing the home-style dishes her mother had prepared, she felt relaxed.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner time
description: The whole family sat together for dinner. She brought up the car replacement plan with her husband Zhang Weiming, and they decided to reconsider it in the fourth quarter as originally planned; Mingzai agreed. Everyone discussed Mingzai's birthday gift, and the children eagerly offered ideas, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child tutoring and companionship.
description: After dinner, she checked and helped her son Zhang Zixuan with his math homework, explaining fraction word problems. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin drew with crayons beside them and showed off My Family, which she had learned in kindergarten.
location: Living room and study of the home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family conversation
description: As the children got ready for washing up, she sat in the living room with her parents watching TV and chatting. She quietly confirmed with her husband again about picking up the glasses and shared the embarrassing office incident of accidentally playing music; her husband comforted her.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing personal affairs and work notes
description: After the children and parents went back to their rooms to rest, she went to the study, turned on the computer, and organized the day's communication records with Mr. Zhang and the future visit plan into an electronic document. Her phone was placed nearby to charge.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-Night Incident: Accidental Phone Touch Leads to a Neighbor Dispute and Emotional Calm
description: At 22:30, when she got up to pour water, her arm accidentally hit the music play button on her phone, and a fast-paced Cantonese song suddenly blared out; she fumbled to turn it off. Immediately, the door was knocked on violently. When she opened it, she found the downstairs neighbor, Mr. Chen Zhiqiang, furious. Yu Xiaowei sincerely apologized and explained that it was accidental. In the hallway light, she recognized him as Chen Zhiqiang, the prospective client she had lost in April due to poor communication. For a moment she was speechless, feeling guilty and embarrassed, and could only apologize humbly. The other man seemed not to recognize her; after complaining about the noise, he turned and went downstairs. Yu Xiaowei felt toyed with by fate. She slumped on the sofa with a tight chest and forced herself to do 10 minutes of meditation to calm down. She washed up and went to bed half an hour later than usual, and recounted the embarrassing incident to her husband Zhang Weiming, but did not mention that the man was the client she had lost contact with—she just felt extremely shamed. After her husband comforted her, he turned off the light, but she could not fall asleep for a long time, thinking that she must put her best foot forward tomorrow.
location: Front door and bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: The alarm went off at 5:10 in the morning, and Yu Xiaowei got up quickly. Outside the window the sky was overcast and a light rain was falling. She took a deep breath and suppressed the guilt in her heart. She put on her professional running shoes and fluorescent green quick-dry clothes, grabbed her earphones and keys, and prepared for her morning run.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wednesday morning marathon training run
description: Yu Xiaowei walked about 10 minutes with an umbrella to Kowloon Tsai Park. After a 10-minute warm-up, she started the planned 10 km interval run in the rain. The air was fresh, and she focused on regulating her breathing, completing three sets of uphill intervals (200 m sprint, 400 m recovery). Then she did 20 minutes of core training, including supine scissor kicks, bicycle crunches, and side planks, 15 repetitions each for three sets. Sweat and rain mingled, letting her temporarily forget her worries.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park under the flyover at Prince Edward Road West and Boundary Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go home, shower, have breakfast, and remind the family.
description: Yu Xiaowei jogged home, soaked through. She took a quick hot shower and changed into dry shirt and trousers. Her mother Chen Meiling had prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and stir-fried spinach. While eating breakfast, she reminded her husband Zhang Weiming to go to Baoguang Optical in the afternoon to pick up her custom-made glasses. Her husband nodded and continued feeding their daughter Zhang Yuxin steamed egg custard. Yu Xiaowei looked at her son Zhang Zixuan, who was still sleeping soundly, and kept in mind that she needed to tutor him in the evening.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the child to school and commuting
description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming each held an umbrella. They first took their daughter Zhang Yuxin to the nearby Alliance Primary School Whampoa (21 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom), about a 5-minute walk. Then the two drove their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (6 Tin Fu Road), about a 10-minute drive. After watching her son enter the school gate, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her husband and handed him the car keys. She walked 2 minutes from the school to MTR Kowloon Tong Station, took the Kwun Tong Line toward Whampoa, and arrived at MTR Whampoa Station at 8:55.
location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: starting from Whampoa Garden residential estate, going in order to Alliance Primary School Whampoa (21 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom), Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (6 Tin Fu Road), and finally to MTR Whampoa Station.

name: Arrived at Taikoo Shing, prepared for the client meeting
description: Yu Xiaowei exited Tai Koo Station at 8:58, and the rain was gradually letting up. She arrived at Cityplaza early, bought a hot Americano at Starbucks, and sat down in a corner. She took out her briefcase, did a final check of Mr. Zhang's critical illness insurance policy documents, highlighted key terms with a marker, and prepared a simple market product comparison table to make sure she could explain clearly.
location: Starbucks, Cityplaza, 18 Taikoo Shing Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Visiting clients to explain policies and resolve complaints
description: At exactly 9:00, she rang Mr. Zhang's doorbell. The door was opened by Mrs. Zhang, who did not look well. Yu Xiaowei put on her most professional smile and greeted them politely after entering. She sat on the sofa across from them, took out the documents, and instead of defending herself first, listened to Mr. Zhang's complaints and concerns. She listened patiently throughout, then compared the critical illness insurance clauses item by item, using everyday examples to explain the definition of 'carcinoma in situ.' Mrs. Zhang asked about several details, and she answered them one by one. After nearly two hours of open communication, Mr. Zhang's expression clearly relaxed; he finally expressed understanding and decided to keep the original policy. Yu Xiaowei let out a long sigh of relief and thanked them again and again for their trust.
location: Mr. Zhang’s home, a certain block of Taikoo Shing, Taikoo Shing Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Phone follow-ups and lunch.
description: After leaving Mr. Zhang's home at 11:00, Yu Xiaowei found a corner seat at Cafe de Coral in Cityplaza. She first called Mr. Zhang to confirm whether he had time in the afternoon, and promised that she would directly follow up on the subsequent service. Mr. Zhang agreed with satisfaction. After hanging up, she immediately shared her experience in handling complaints via voice message in the team WeChat group, reminding everyone to explain terms in plain language. Her colleague Su Lishan gave her a thumbs-up. Only then did she feel at ease and order a bowl of beef brisket noodles in chu hou sauce, and slowly finished it.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Eastern District, 5th Floor, Cityplaza, 18 Taikoo Shing Road, Café de Coral

name: Commute back to the office by subway.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei bought a bottle of artificial tears at Mannings downstairs. She then took the MTR back to Wan Chai. On the train, she sent her husband a WeChat message: “Remember to pick up the glasses.” He replied with an “OK” gesture.
location: On the Island Line of the MTR in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (from Tai Koo Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Office work and team sharing.
description: At 12:25 she returned to the Wan Chai office and sat down at her workstation. She turned on the computer and first organized Mr. Zhang's complaint-handling file and the follow-up checklist. Striking while the iron was hot, she posted a detailed written feedback message in the team group chat, summarizing the lessons from the incident and the communication skills. Afterwards, she handled over a dozen client emails, replied to inquiries from two potential clients, and updated the clients' follow-up records in the system.
location: AIA Insurance office, 33/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Handling client work and relaxing my eyes
description: Yu Xiaowei continued with her work, spending time studying the policy information of Mr. Chen, a high-net-worth client assigned to her last week. She remembered that she had not followed up with him for a month, and planned to contact him first next Monday. During a break from work, she remembered the doctor's advice, put in eye drops, leaned back in her chair, and did 5 minutes of eye yoga with her eyes closed, rotating her eyeballs and pressing on her eye sockets. She felt much better.
location: AIA Insurance office, 33/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute after work and shopping preparation
description: Left work on time at 16:00. Yu Xiaowei took the Island Line from Wan Chai Station to Admiralty Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Mong Kok Station, then walked from Mong Kok Station to Mong Kok East Station, transferred to the East Rail Line for one stop to Hung Hom Station. After exiting the station, she walked about 8 minutes to Whampoa New World mall.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from the Immigration Tower at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, to the Whampoa New World shopping mall at 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, via MTR and walking.

name: Buying an apology gift and household daily necessities.
description: In the supermarket, Yu Xiaowei went straight to the coffee section and carefully picked a box of Japanese imported pour-over specialty coffee packs with exquisite packaging. Then she went to the stationery section and chose a simple-style note card. At checkout, she also picked up blueberries, unsweetened yogurt, and cereal.
location: TASTE Supermarket, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to prepare an apology card.
description: Yu Xiaowei returned home to find the house quiet; her mother was preparing dinner in the kitchen. She put down her things, took out the card, sat at the dining table, and carefully wrote a message: "Mr. Chen, I am very sorry about last night. It was inconsiderate of me to disturb your rest. A small token of appreciation, I hope you like it. From your neighbor, Yu Xiaowei." She placed the card and the coffee packets into a decent paper bag, took a deep breath, and decided to go downstairs alone to complete this difficult task.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Apology to neighbor and former client met with a cold reception.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked downstairs to Chen Zhiqiang's door, her heart beating a little faster. She rang the doorbell. After a while, Chen Zhiqiang finally opened the door; seeing it was her, his expression turned cold. Yu Xiaowei forced a smile and said sincerely, "Mr. Chen, I'm really sorry about last night for disturbing you. This is a small token of apology, please accept it." She handed over the paper bag. He glanced at it, didn't take it, hesitated for a moment, and then said, "That's enough. Just be more careful next time." Then, expressionless, he took the paper bag and, before Yu Xiaowei could say anything else, slammed the door with a bang. Yu Xiaowei stood stunned outside the door, with mixed feelings — besides embarrassment, more a sense of frustration: she recognized him as the client lost in April, and repairing this relationship was harder than she had imagined. She stood in the hallway for a few seconds, sighed, and turned to go home.
location: At the doorway of Chen Zhiqiang's home in a building of the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Back at home, her mother had already prepared a meal: sweet and sour pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steamed egg custard, all dishes the children love. Yu Xiaowei tried to temporarily suppress the unpleasantness in the hallway and adjust her mood. At the dinner table, she praised her daughter for the painting she made at school today and asked her son about the new content from today's math class. When her husband came back, she casually asked whether he had picked up the glasses. He said he picked them up on the way in the afternoon. She nodded, finally relieved of that worry.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with homework and family time
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother clear the dishes, then sat down beside her son to help with his math homework, patiently explaining a word problem about fractions. Meanwhile, her daughter drew with colored pencils on the side, drawing a scene of the family walking in the rain, and occasionally ran over to show her the artwork.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening video stretching session
description: Yu Xiaowei connected with her running buddy Shen Peiwen on video on time. The two chose to do dynamic stretching and myofascial release. While using a foam roller to relax the back of her thighs, Yu Xiaowei talked about the day's work. She didn't go into detail about her neighbor's coldness, only mentioning that the customer complaint had been resolved. Shen Peiwen shared her experience competing in a trail race over the weekend and strongly recommended the Ashtanga morning class at her community yoga center: 'It's really effective! My shoulders and neck have opened up a lot! Want to try it together next Monday?' Yu Xiaowei said she'd think about it, but felt a longing inside. After chatting for half an hour, she felt both her physical fatigue and inner gloom had eased considerably.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime diary and relaxation for the eyes
description: After the video call ended, Yu Xiaowei took a hot shower. After changing into her pajamas, she sat down in the study, opened her diary, and wrote about the day's experiences: the successful handling of the claims complaint, the frustration brought by the neighbor's coldness, and the complex feelings after recognizing Chen Zhiqiang. She sorted through her emotions and analyzed that her sadness was because old regrets had been stirred up, and also because not every kindness receives a response. After writing the diary, she felt a little lighter. She lay down on the bed, opened the eye yoga tutorial on her phone, followed a 5-minute set of exercises, and placed a warm towel over her eyes, feeling very relaxed. Then she tried a newly learned abdominal breathing technique, slowly inhaling and exhaling, and felt drowsiness gradually creep in.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime reading
description: Yu Xiaowei felt a little sleepy, but her habit of reading before bed remained. She picked up Hong Kong Trilogy and leaned against the headboard to read for about ten minutes; the old-era atmosphere in the story relaxed her.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting ready for bed
description: At 22:00, Yu Xiaowei closed the book, set the alarm for 5:30 the next day, turned off the light, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning wake-up and trip to the yoga center
description: At six in the morning, Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally. After washing up, she changed into dark blue yoga sportswear, put her phone, access card, and cash into a sports waist bag, and left the house quietly. She walked through the community path and arrived at the Hung Hom Community Yoga Centre, located underground in Hunghom Bay Centre, in about 5 minutes, breathing in the cool morning air with a peaceful mood.
location: Walk from Whampoa Garden residential estate in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to the Hung Hom Community Yoga Centre on the ground floor of Hung Hom Bay Centre, Kowloon City District

name: Ashtanga morning class and buying a monthly pass
description: Yu Xiaowei attended an Ashtanga morning class of about 65 minutes at the Hung Hom Community Yoga Centre. Under the guidance of an experienced female instructor, she tried her best to keep up with the pace and did the challenging vinyasa sequences in simplified versions. After class, the stiffness in her shoulders and neck was noticeably relieved, and she felt calm inside. Very satisfied with the experience, she proactively went to the front desk and bought a monthly pass for Tuesday and Thursday morning classes, deciding to make this a fixed weekly habit.
location: Hung Hom Community Yoga Centre, Ground Floor, Hung Hom Bay Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After yoga, returned home for a shower and family breakfast
description: After the morning session ended, Yu Xiaowei quickly walked home, took a warm shower, changed into a shirt and trousers as business attire, and blow-dried her hair. When she got to the dining room, her mother Chen Meiling had prepared Hong Kong-style milk tea, fried eggs, and ham sandwiches. During breakfast, she reminded her son Zhang Zixuan to finish his summer homework carefully, kissed her daughter Zhang Yuxin on the cheek, and exchanged a few words with her husband Zhang Weiming, sharing warm family moments.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Met a neighbor on the way out and commuted to work
description: As Yu Xiaowei was leaving, she bumped into her neighbor Chen Zhiqiang in the elevator lobby. She took the initiative to smile and nod, but he remained expressionless, his eyes cold, and walked straight to another elevator. She felt relieved and continued on her way. She took the Kwun Tong Line from Whampoa Station to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then switched to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station; the whole trip took about 35 minutes. On the train, she wore earphones and listened to a podcast about the Greater Bay Area's new insurance policies, and used the notes app on her phone to record key points. After exiting the station, she bought a nonfat latte and sugar-free soda crackers at the convenience store in Convention Plaza, then walked to her office at the Immigration Tower.
location: From the residential estate of Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, took the MTR to the Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District.

name: Morning work: handling emails and planning tasks
description: At 9:00 sharp, Yu Xiaowei swiped into the office, sat down at her desk, started her computer, logged into the system, quickly browsed today's schedule and unread emails, and drank coffee to refresh herself. She then focused on handling a dozen or so work emails, including replying to client inquiries, confirming next week's meeting times, answering team questions, and listing the morning's work priorities in her notebook.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cross-border business channel exploration and a short break.
description: Yu Xiaowei followed the plan to try to expand cross-border business. She first called the Bank of China Shenzhen Branch and explained that she wanted to be transferred to the cross-border insurance department, but the receptionist did not transfer her, citing the need for an internal referral. Not discouraged, she immediately sent a voice message via WeChat to Shenzhen client Wang Qiming, explaining the difficulty and asking him to introduce local banking or insurance friends. Wang Qiming replied that he would help ask around. After that, she went to the pantry to get water, stood by the window looking out at Victoria Harbour, let her mind rest, and reviewed the attempt just made.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drafted the team's customer service supervision process.
description: Yu Xiaowei focused on drafting the Team Customer Service Supervision Process Draft in the morning and afternoon. Using recent customer complaint cases as examples, she sorted out service gaps in detail. The draft includes: tiered customer service standards (customers are divided into three tiers — A, B, C — based on assets and relationship value, with different follow-up frequencies and responsible persons); new member permissions and training mechanism (newly hired members must complete at least two weeks of on-the-job training, and in the first month all client communication content is reviewed by senior colleagues); regular review checkpoints (supervisors spot-check 3 client records per team member each month); and emergency handling process (when a client expresses clear dissatisfaction, it must be escalated within 2 hours and a customer appeasement plan initiated). She reviewed past client files to enrich the content, and in the afternoon read through, adjusted, and polished the draft to form a complete first version.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch socializing and buying a notebook
description: During her lunch break, Yu Xiaowei invited her colleague Su Lishan to the coffee shop at Shui On Centre for lunch. She ordered a pineapple bun with butter and iced lemon tea, while Su Lishan had satay beef instant noodles. The two discussed the difficulties of cross-border business, and Su Lishan shared how she had hit a wall when contacting Macau banks, suggesting they could try using LinkedIn to find local peers. On the way back to the office after lunch, Yu Xiaowei stopped by the stationery shop on Hennessy Road and bought a blank notebook with a linen cover, imagining she would use it to record her insights on Cantonese embroidery.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; and the nearby stationery shop on Hennessy Road

name: Client Mrs. Chen policy review and post-meeting organization
description: At three o'clock in the afternoon, the client Mrs. Chen arrived as scheduled. In the small meeting room, Yu Xiaowei explained in detail the dividend status of the savings-type products, the updated critical illness insurance coverage, and the medical insurance renewal plan, and patiently answered questions about adjusting the accident insurance sum insured with charts and case examples. Mrs. Chen signed the renewal confirmation with satisfaction. After seeing the client off, Yu Xiaowei tidied the meeting room, returned to her workstation for a short rest, and did a few neck stretches to relieve fatigue.
location: Small meeting room, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Contact younger brother and wrap up work
description: Yu Xiaowei contacted her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen via WeChat voice call. After catching up, she asked whether he had any contacts in Shenzhen's insurance or banking industry who could be introduced. Yu Xiaofeng remembered a college classmate at Huatai Securities' Shenzhen branch, so he forwarded the classmate's business card to his sister and told her to add him as a friend. Yu Xiaowei was pleased at the new lead. After saving the note, she spent half an hour giving the morning draft a final polish, saved it, and set a to-do item to review it the next day. She then organized the day's work log and planned a preliminary schedule for the next day.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute after work and supermarket shopping
description: She got off work at five. Yu Xiaowei tidied her desk, turned off her computer, and walked to Wan Chai MTR Station. She took the MTR, transferring via Admiralty and Mong Kok, back to Whampoa. The carriage was crowded in the evening, so she stood in the connection between cars, wearing earphones and listening to light music to relax. After leaving the station, she stopped by the Taste supermarket in the basement of Whampoa New World shopping mall and bought the chicken-flavored cat food that Xinxin loves, some apples, blueberries, and unsweetened Greek yogurt. Then she carried her shopping bags and walked home.
location: From Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, via Wan Chai MTR Station and Whampoa MTR Station, to Whampoa New World Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, then back to Whampoa Garden residential estate.

name: Family dinner
description: Yu Xiaowei returned home carrying shopping bags. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared dinner, including steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and tomato egg drop soup. The family of five sat around the table, and her husband Zhang Weiming was also there. Her son Zhang Zixuan excitedly shared his experience with science experiments in the summer class, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin showed off her crayon drawing. Yu Xiaowei ate while listening, occasionally praising the children. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping children with homework and spending time with them
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's summer math homework in the children's room. Finding two word problems wrong, she patiently guided him to re-read the questions and recalculate. Then she joined her daughter Zhang Yuxin in making little animals out of colored clay. The daughter made a lopsided but cute kitten, and Yu Xiaowei smiled and encouraged her, saying, “It looks just like a real one.” The parent-child interaction was pleasant.
location: Children's room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening Cantonese embroidery
description: After the children were taken by her husband to watch a cartoon, Yu Xiaowei washed up in the bathroom, changed into comfortable loungewear, and made a cup of chrysanthemum and goji berry tea. She sat down by the floor lamp in the living room and took out her sewing kit and the unfinished Guangdong embroidery hoop of twin lotus flowers. Using pale pink silk thread, she embroidered the petal outlines with a rolling needle stitch, then switched to deep pink thread to fill in the gradient. After two hours of complete concentration, all the petals and stamens were finished, and a lifelike twin lotus flower appeared on the fabric. She cut the thread with satisfaction and carefully put away the embroidery and tools.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation, diary writing, and going to bed
description: After a long period of embroidery, her eyes felt sore. Yu Xiaowei closed her eyes on the sofa and did a 5-minute eye yoga routine she had learned, relaxing with deep breaths. Then she went back to the bedroom, took out her new notebook, and wrote the day's diary on the first page: recording the Ashtanga experience, new cross-border business leads (she had contacted Mr. Wang and her younger brother), the achievement of completing the draft, the calming mood brought by Cantonese embroidery, and reflections on bumping into neighbor Chen Zhiqiang, once again confirming that 'not disturbing is also a gentle kindness.' After finishing, she closed the notebook, turned off the desk lamp, and soon fell into a deep sleep amid her husband's even breathing.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning marathon training
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally at 5:30. After drinking a glass of warm water, in order to conserve energy for the long-distance easy run on Saturday, she adjusted her originally planned high-intensity workout to an 8 km basic aerobic run at a pace of 5:45/km. After her run at Kowloon Tsai Park, she did 15 minutes of core and lower-body strength training in the fitness area, including jump squats, lunge squats, and lying leg raises, 3 sets each. Then she stretched under the shade of trees and recorded the training data with a mobile app.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Going home for breakfast and family communication
description: After training, walked home, took a hot shower, and changed into loungewear. At 7:15 had breakfast with family, enjoying the soy milk, boiled eggs, and tuna sandwiches prepared by mother Chen Meiling. During the meal, she shared today's work priorities (draft revisions) with husband Zhang Weiming and reminded him to pick up daughter Zhang Yuxin at 4:30 p.m.
location: Home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, near No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Taking the kids to school and commuting
description: At 7:40, she left home with her husband and the children. She walked their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and reminded him to hand in his art homework, then took their daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten. At 8:00, she walked alone to Whampoa MTR station, took the Kwun Tong Line, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line at Mong Kok station, then to the Island Line at Admiralty station, and arrived at Wan Chai station at 8:30, reaching the office. On the commute, she listened to a Greater Bay Area financial news podcast through her phone earphones.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (6 Tin Fu Road) Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street) Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Handling morning work and revising drafts
description: Arrived at the office at 8:30, bought hot unsweetened soy milk at the convenience store in Convention Plaza, went to her desk, turned on her computer and Slack, browsed emails, organized the to-do list, and sent the 'Team Customer Service Supervision Process Draft' completed last night along with a background explanation to Director Liang Zhenhua. At 9:15, she received a voice message from Director Liang with feedback, suggesting adding a 30-day orientation training and assessment standard for new members. Yu Xiaowei recorded the comments one by one and revised the document: after 'new member permission activation', she added 'must pass the online product and compliance exam (85 points to pass)', and before 'emergency procedures', she added 'hold a monthly case review meeting for new employees'. At 10:30, she finished the revisions and replied to the director on Slack requesting confirmation.
location: AIA Insurance Office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Online compliance training and cross-border business expansion.
description: At 10:30 I brewed chrysanthemum and goji berry tea, put on anti-blue-light glasses, and logged into the company intranet learning platform to take the half-hour required course "2025 Anti-Money Laundering and Customer Privacy Protection", carefully noting key legal provisions and the key points of customer data masking operations. After the training ended at 11:00, I opened LinkedIn and searched for insurance broker peers in Shenzhen and the Greater Bay Area, browsing their profiles; then on WeChat I left a message for my younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, asking him to introduce a classmate from Huatai Securities, so as to understand the asset allocation trends of high-net-worth clients on the mainland.
location: AIA Insurance Office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Lunch break: having lunch and chatting with colleagues to relax
description: At 12:00 met colleague Su Lishan for lunch in the lobby lounge of the Island Shangri-La, Hong Kong, and ordered salad and pasta. During the conversation, Su Lishan shared her experience dealing with mainland Chinese investment clients and suggested paying attention to family office forums in the Greater Bay Area. At 13:00 returned to the office, rested with eyes closed on the sofa for 15 minutes, then walked to the window to gaze out over Victoria Harbour and did a set of eye yoga exercises (rolling the eyeballs, near-far focus adjustment, warm palm cupping) to relieve screen fatigue.
location: The lobby lounge of Island Shangri-La, Hong Kong on Court Road, Central and Western District, and the AIA Insurance office at Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Client follow-up and insurance renewal processing.
description: After recovering mentally in the afternoon, she began client work. First, she called client Mrs. Chen to confirm the renewal documents were in order, and agreed to do an annual policy review at the cafe in Shui On Centre next Wednesday at 10:30 a.m. Then she called client Mr. Zhang for a gentle follow-up, informed him that the critical illness insurance renewal premium would be deducted next week, and scheduled a phone call for next Wednesday at 3:00 p.m.
location: AIA Insurance Office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Handling emails during work breaks
description: After finishing the client call at 15:30, handle the remaining emails: reply to prospective client inquiries, assist colleagues in reviewing health disclosure forms. Then get up again to do three minutes of eye yoga. At 16:00, start organizing work documents, archive the final draft that Director Liang has provided feedback on to the shared folder, and update the client follow-up records in the CRM system.
location: AIA Insurance Office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Commute after work, shopping, and going home to help with household chores
description: Left work on time at 16:30, took the MTR to Mong Kok East Station, went to Wan Kee Sports City on Fa Yuen Street to choose a new quick-dry sports T-shirt, then bought grapefruit, blueberries, and two family-size yogurts at Wellcome Superstore (Star City branch). Returned to Whampoa Garden at 17:30, put the fruit in the refrigerator, saw her mother preparing dinner, took the initiative to help trim and wash the vegetables, and chatted about lunch with colleagues. At 18:00, her husband brought the children home from extracurricular classes, and the family gathered in the living room to rest.
location: Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong: Yuen Kee Sports City on Fa Yuen Street; Yau Tsim Mong District: Wellcome Supermarket at 47-51 Shantung Street; Kowloon City District: home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate near 6 Tak Hong Street.

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner started promptly at 18:30, and they enjoyed the garlic stir-fried Chinese broccoli, steamed grass carp, and corn and pork rib soup made by her mother. At the table, Yu Xiaowei shared her joy at finishing the draft revisions. Her father mentioned wanting to visit a car dealership on the weekend to look at new cars, and her husband added that a colleague had recommended a used hybrid MPV, which would be suitable for family trips.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, near 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Family time: discussing replacing the car and parent-child activities
description: After the meal, she drank pu'er tea with her husband on the balcony to aid digestion. She took out her phone and browsed the several Toyota Prius pages she had bookmarked before, comparing prices and mileage, and discussed MPVs in detail. They decided to go to the used-car dealership in Mong Kok on the weekend to see the cars in person, and initially shortlisted two options. Her son Zhang Zixuan came over with a football and acted coquettishly. Yu Xiaowei promised to play football with him after the last five minutes of discussion, and then played a 10-minute dribbling relay game with him in the living room.
location: Balcony and living room of the home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, near 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Helping with homework and parent-child reading
description: After the game ended at 20:30, she accompanied her son to his desk to check his math word-problem homework, found an error in a distance problem, and drew a simple route diagram to help him understand. At 20:50, her daughter came over with a picture book. Yu Xiaowei sat on the edge of the bed and vividly told the story Little Rabbit Anubis, asking her daughter to point out colors.
location: At home, in the children's room, beside the bed, Whampoa Garden residential estate, near 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Personal Relaxation and Hobby Brainstorming
description: After the children got ready for bed, she returned to the study, first did a 10-minute pre-sleep stretch to relax her shoulders, neck, and back. Then she opened her tablet to browse car-owner forum posts about weekend test drives. Next, she took out the Cantonese embroidery handkerchief with twin lotus flowers completed yesterday, examined it under the light, and planned the next pattern — embroidering a few bamboo leaves along the edge of the handkerchief.
location: Home study at Whampoa Garden residential estate, near 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 22:00, finished washing up and applied moisturizer. In bed, used the Notes app to write down tomorrow's to-do list: long-distance jog on Saturday, family dim sum in the morning, and going to the car dealership in the afternoon to look at MPVs. Set the alarm for 6:00 and turned on Do Not Disturb mode on the phone. Turned off the lights at 22:30 and fell asleep to the sound of cicadas.
location: Master bedroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, near 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning preparation and walk to Kowloon Tsai Park.
description: Woke up naturally at 5:30 in the morning and felt that my body was ready for today’s LSD long run. I drank a glass of warm water, changed into running shoes and workout clothes, applied sunscreen carefully, put on my sports waist pack (containing phone, keys, energy gel) and water bottle, and slipped out quietly so as not to wake my family still fast asleep. Starting from home, I headed west along Prince Edward Road West, turned onto Inverell Road after a few blocks, and walked about 18 minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park, enjoying the quiet of the early morning.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon Tsai Park.

name: Meet up with running buddies, warm up, and do LSD long-distance running training
description: She walked to Kowloon Tsai Park and met up with running partner Shen Peiwen on time at the agreed spot. The two did a 15-minute dynamic warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, lunge stretches), then began an LSD long run targeting 15 km at a pace of 6:40/km. They moved steadily along the park's running trail, chatting about recent news as they ran. At around the 7.5 km mark (about 8:00), they took a 2-minute water break. After completing the target, they did 20 minutes of deep static stretching together (09:00-09:20), focusing on relaxing the quadriceps and calves. After stretching, Shen Peiwen excitedly invited her to continue this pace challenge next week (09:20-09:28).
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: On-the-way supply shopping
description: Walked home from Kowloon Tsai Park, passing by Whampoa Metro Mall on the way. Quickly went into the supermarket and bought a box of fresh blueberries, two grapefruits, and a family-size pack of yogurt, planning to add some variety to the kids' breakfast.
location: Wonder World Shopping Centre, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going home, washing up, and family interaction
description: After arriving home, I took a comfortable hot shower. I washed the fruit I'd bought and put it on a plate; the kids were already up playing in the living room. While eating breakfast (a slice of whole wheat toast and a glass of milk), I chatted with my husband Mingzai about the afternoon car-viewing plan and confirmed that he could leave at 1:30. At the same time, I took out my phone and quickly set up the Screen Time limit, restricting daily total usage of WeChat and social apps to 2 hours, and turned on Night Mode.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to ballet class and communicate after class
description: I walked my daughter Zhiqing to the Bauhinia Dance Art Center (left at around 10:45, walked for 18 minutes). During the 45 minutes of her class (11:00-11:45), I sat in the rest area, took out my sketchbook, recalled the new Cantonese embroidery pattern I had been thinking about—a few flowing bamboo leaves—and jotted down some rough sketches. After class (11:45-12:00), Ms. Zhou warmly praised Zhiqing's improvement in continuous turns and suggested considering adding an extra one-hour intensive class each week to prepare for the year-end performance. I listened carefully and said I would discuss it with my family.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 128 Carpenter Road, Bauhinia Flower Dance Art Center

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: Took her daughter home (departed at 12:00, walked 18 minutes to get home). Mother had already prepared a table of home-style dishes: tomato scrambled eggs, shredded pork with green peppers, and stir-fried choy sum. During the meal, chatted with the children about next week's activities. After lunch, watched a 20-minute insect documentary with her son, then played on the balcony with her daughter with her new sticker book. Seeing it was almost 1:30, she left the children with her mother and got ready to go out.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Viewing MPVs in person with her husband.
description: With her husband Zhang Weiming, she walked from home to Whampoa MTR Station (departed at 13:30, 10-minute walk), took the MTR to Mong Kok East Station (boarded at 13:40, about a 15-minute ride, arrived at 14:00), then walked to Yongli Used Car Dealership (14:00-14:10). At the dealership, they carefully inspected the two used MPVs they had preselected, and the salesman patiently explained the vehicle condition and prices. They each took a test drive to feel the handling and space (14:10-15:30). After exchanging opinions, they were initially inclined toward the silver-gray Toyota, but still needed to think about the price and loan options. They took a brochure and said they wanted to compare other dealerships (15:30-16:00).
location: Wing Lee Used Cars, 106 Boundary Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong SAR

name: Family communication on the way home
description: On the MTR on the way back (16:00-16:20, from Mong Kok East to Whampoa Station), the carriage was not crowded, so she seized the opportunity to tell her husband about the teacher's suggestion that Zhiqing take extra classes. Together, considering the installment payments for the newly replaced air conditioner in the living room and daily expenses, they briefly discussed the pressure on the family budget. Her husband said that after getting home and getting the ledger, he could calculate in more detail.
location: MTR train carriage from Mong Kok East Station to Whampoa Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Guiding her husband through abdominal breathing
description: Back home (arrived at 16:30), the children were watching TV with their maternal grandparents. Taking advantage of the quiet moment, she led her husband to sit on the rattan chairs on the balcony and guided him to try abdominal breathing. She had him lie down relaxed, demonstrated several times, and asked him to place his hand on his abdomen to feel the rise and fall. A few minutes later, her husband found that his belly really did rise and fall with his breathing, found it novel, and said his shoulders did feel more relaxed.
location: Balcony, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family time and helping with meal preparation.
description: Back in the living room, her son Xuanxuan ran over and said he wanted to show her a backflip he had just learned. Smiling, she encouraged him to try it on the carpet and reminded him to be careful. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother trim green beans and peel garlic, and talked about the afternoon's car viewing and Zhiqing's schoolwork. Her mother said she understood.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was Mother's specialty dishes: steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce, blanched shrimp, water spinach with fermented bean curd, and lotus root and pork bone soup. The family sat around the table. She shared her car-viewing experience with her husband, and her father gave some suggestions on buying a car. The children chattered about wanting to go to Disneyland for the summer vacation.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Special discussion on family education expenses
description: After the children finished washing up and the elderly family members had gone back to their rooms, my husband and I spread out the family ledger in the study. We carefully checked this month’s fixed expenses: mortgage, water, electricity, and gas, and management fees, and calculated the current tuition for Zhiqing’s ballet and art classes. Regarding Teacher Zhou’s suggestion to add more classes, we seriously weighed the costs and benefits and finally agreed: keep the current number of classes for now, observe for two months, and only consider adjusting if Zhiqing still shows interest and progress after school starts in September.
location: Master bedroom study, Prince's Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Reading before bed and book club sharing
description: Back in the bedroom, she leaned against the headboard and opened the WeChat group of the book club. She saw Ah May's reply, in which she thanked and encouraged her for the story she had shared. Remembering that she had promised Ah May last night to tell her story about her father, she gathered her thoughts and sent a voice message of a few minutes in the group, recounting how her father had driven a bus rain or shine in his youth to support her studies, and the deep yet inarticulate fatherly love. After sending it, she felt a warmth in her heart. Then she did 5 minutes of eye yoga, applied soothing eye drops, turned off the bedside lamp, and got ready to sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Ending the day and preparing for bed.
description: After lying down, she savored the sense of accomplishment from today's exercise, the new progress on car shopping, the in-depth conversation with her husband, and the sharing at the book club, feeling fulfilled and calm inside. Although there was a slight, expected worry about the planned investment in Zhiqing's future education, what she felt more was the steady reassurance of the family facing and solving things together. She set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and packing
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat in the living room. She first sat quietly and regulated her breathing for 5 minutes, then did yin yoga stretches aimed at recovery after long-distance running, including Child's Pose, Reclining Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose, and Pigeon Pose, holding each posture for 3 minutes, and finished with eye yoga to relieve dryness. Afterwards, she returned to the master bedroom to quickly wash up and do skincare, then changed into a quick-dry sports T-shirt. Back in the living room, she checked her backpack and put in warm water, sunscreen, wet wipes, snacks, and children's masks, and also tucked in picture books and sticker books to soothe the kids on the high-speed train.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast.
description: The aroma of fried eggs and toast made by her mother Chen Meiling wafted from the kitchen. Yu Xiaowei set out the tableware and woke up her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin. The family sat around the table; Xuanxuan excitedly showed his new water bottle to his younger male cousin on a video call, while Xinxin quietly ate her star-shaped fried egg. Her husband Zhang Weiming confirmed the plan for the station drop-off and going to the car dealer in the afternoon. Her father Yu Guoqiang reminded her that Shenzhen was hotter and told her to bring a small fan, and Chen Meiling smiled and wished them a fun trip.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Head to West Kowloon High-Speed Rail Station and wait for the train.
description: The family of four set off from Whampoa Garden in a silver-gray Toyota driven by Zhang Weiming, traveling along Princess Margaret Road and the West Kowloon Corridor. Yu Xiaowei used her phone to confirm the high-speed rail schedule and check information about shopping malls in Shenzhen. After arriving at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, Zhang Weiming dropped off the mother and two daughters at the drop-off area and reminded them to be safe. Yu Xiaowei took the children through the ticket gates, passed the security checks and border clearance procedures at both the Hong Kong and mainland checkpoints, and reached the waiting area in the departure hall on Level B3. She sprayed sunscreen on the children and reminded them to drink plenty of water.
location: Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, Austin Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: High-speed rail journey (Hong Kong to Shenzhen)
description: Yu Xiaowei took the children on train G5812 from Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Shenzhen North Station. The children pressed against the window to look at the scenery. She read a picture book story to Xinxin and asked Xuanxuan to teach his sister to identify the sights outside the window. Then she put on an eye mask, did 5 minutes of eye yoga, and took a nap to rest. Before arriving at the station, she woke the children and helped them organize their things to get ready to get off.
location: High-speed train G5812 from Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Shenzhen North Station

name: Younger brother picked me up at the station and morning parent-child time.
description: Her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng was waiting outside the gate of Shenzhen North Station. He picked up his niece Xinxin and spun her around, while Xuanxuan excitedly showed off his new shoes. Then Yu Xiaofeng drove everyone to Futian Xinghe COCO Park. On the third-floor children's play area, they met up with his wife Lin Shiya and their son Yu Zihao. Xinxin and her younger male cousin played in the ball pit and on the slide, while Xuanxuan and his uncle competed to build castles in the building block area. Yu Xiaowei and her sister-in-law drank mango pomelo sago at the nearby milk tea shop and chatted about her brother's company's recent situation and her sister-in-law's new job.
location: Futian Galaxy COCO Park, Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her younger brother's family had lunch at Tai Hing Hong Kong-style restaurant. She ordered the children's favorites: sweet and sour pork with pineapple, shrimp wonton noodles, and the signature roasted meat platter, plus her own favorite stir-fried beef ho fun. During the meal, the adults talked about the differences between life in Shenzhen and Hong Kong, and the children shared toys and funny stories, in a warm atmosphere. Yu Xiaowei logged her lunch in a calorie tracking app and kept an eye on her calorie intake.
location: Tai Hing Restaurant, Futian Galaxy COCO Park, Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Waiting for the client, but the client stood her up at the last minute.
description: After lunch, her younger brother's family said goodbye and left first. Yu Xiaowei took the children to Starbucks. She ordered an iced Americano for herself and a kids' milk for each of the children. Xuanxuan took his sister to the public children's play area in the mall to play on the slide and soft mats, while Yu Xiaowei used her phone to confirm the details of the 2 p.m. meeting with the client introduced by Wang Qiming and replied to work WeChat messages. At 2 p.m., the client did not show up. She sent a polite WeChat message asking about it, and the other party replied that he was still on the way. Twenty minutes later, she contacted him again. The client sent a message saying that something urgent had come up at the company and he could not make it, and apologized. Although disappointed, Yu Xiaowei still replied politely, 'It's okay, let's reschedule another day.' She then put away her notebook, walked around the mall with the children, and bought Xinxin a pair of rabbit hair clips at a boutique as a consolation.
location: Starbucks and public areas on the 2nd floor of Futian Galaxy COCO Park, Fuhua 3rd Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Afternoon tea and gathering career information
description: To comfort the children and herself, Yu Xiaowei took them to the brightly decorated gaga Fresh. She ordered fresh fruit tea for herself, while the children enjoyed mini beef burgers and french fries. During the meal, she played with sticker books together with the children while opening LinkedIn to check updates from local insurance peers in Shenzhen, and bookmarked several posts about industry events on Greater Bay Area business development, accumulating information for future work.
location: gaga Xianyu, Futian Xinghe COCO Park, Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Supermarket Shopping and Welcoming My Best Friend
description: Yu Xiaowei took the children to the blt supermarket on the basement level and bought them two boxes of children's milk and some organic fruit, as well as snacks for the high-speed rail ride home in the evening. Then she went to the first-floor atrium, where her close friends Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi had already arrived. The two had bought the children toy cars and bubble wands. Zhou Minyi enthusiastically brought up the high-end client Yu Xiaowei had mentioned in the group chat, and said that having worked in real estate for many years, she knew quite a few high-net-worth individuals and could help make connections. The three sat in the rest area chatting while the children played nearby blowing bubbles.
location: Guangdong Province, Shenzhen, Futian District, Fuhua Third Road, Futian Galaxy COCO Park, B1 blt supermarket and first-floor atrium.

name: Close friends' dinner and information sharing
description: Yu Xiaowei chose the Qiaoyuan Sichuan Restaurant recommended by her younger brother and had dinner with Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi. She ordered mildly spicy fish with pickled mustard greens and Kung Pao shrimp balls to suit the children's tastes. During the meal, Zhou Minyi again enthusiastically offered to help connect high-end clients. Trusting her close friend of many years, Yu Xiaowei immediately sent Zhou Minyi the client's WeChat contact card and a brief summary of his basic needs from her phone. Zhou Minyi then added him as a friend and sent a greeting. Huang Wenhui talked about her new job on the side. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye again in the parking lot to her younger brother's family, who had come to see her off, and they agreed to meet again in Hong Kong next time.
location: Qiaoyuan Sichuan Restaurant and parking lot, Futian Galaxy COCO Park, Fuhua 3rd Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Best friend sees her off at the station.
description: Zhou Minyi drove Yu Xiaowei and her two daughters to Shenzhen North Station. In the departure hall, the three women chatted about plans for the next gathering. Yu Xiaowei felt a little uneasy about sharing client information, but her best friend's warm words eased it. She told them to be careful on the way back, then took the children through security and the gates.
location: Departure hall of Shenzhen North Station, 28 Zhiyuan Middle Road, Longhua District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: High-speed rail return trip (Shenzhen to Hong Kong).
description: Took train G5837 from Shenzhen North Station back to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station. After playing until they were tired, the children leaned against Yu Xiaowei and fell asleep. She finally relaxed, didn't play with her phone, and quietly watched the city lights flashing by outside the window. In her mind, she replayed the act of sending Zhou Minyi a client's business card today. The unease in her heart gradually became clear.
location: High-speed train G5837 from Shenzhen North Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station

name: Returning home and getting the children settled.
description: After arriving at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, Yu Xiaowei gently woke the sleeping children. She carried her backpack, held Xinxin, and held the drowsy Xuanxuan by the hand, then queued for a taxi outside the station to return to Whampoa Garden. Her mother Chen Meiling had left the lights on. Yu Xiaowei quietly thanked her mother, quickly helped the two children wash up, and changed them into pajamas. Xinxin murmured, "Mommy, I was so happy today." Yu Xiaowei kissed her daughter's forehead and tucked the children in.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night meditation and reflection
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming poked his head out from the study to greet her; Yu Xiaowei gestured for him to go to bed first. She stayed alone in the study, turned off the main light, left only a small desk lamp on, and did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation. As she breathed, the day's fatigue and inner turmoil surged up together. She regretted sharing the business card with her close friend without the client's consent, which crossed the trust red line in the insurance industry. Zhang Weiming later came in to ask; Yu Xiaowei briefly recounted what had happened today, and he comforted her, saying, 'Maybe you're overthinking it, but you'd better be more careful from now on.'
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Weighing, washing up, and going to bed
description: Yu Xiaowei stepped on the electronic scale in the master bedroom; it showed 54.5 kg, slightly heavier than yesterday. She noted the number in her phone's memo app and added a question mark as a reminder to resume a healthy diet. Then she quickly took a hot shower and applied skincare products. When she got into bed, her husband was already asleep. Before turning off Do Not Disturb mode on her phone, she saw a message from Zhou Minyi: "Client added, said hello, not yet discussed in detail." She did not reply. After turning off the light, she repeatedly mulled over today's decision in the dark and did not fall into a deep sleep until the early morning.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, master bedroom and bathroom

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The 05:30 alarm went off on time. After getting up, Yu Xiaowei drank a glass of warm water, did some simple stretches to wake up her body, and changed into her running gear. Looking at the faintly lit sky outside the window, she told herself to stay focused and cautious in the new week.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Monday morning marathon training run
description: 05:45 jogged to Kowloon Tsai Park (about 15 minutes). 06:00 started training on time: first a 1 km jogging warm-up (pace 6:15), then a 6 km interval run (pace strictly controlled per kilometer: 5:30/6:00/5:45/6:15/5:50/6:00), feeling the coordination of heart rate and stride while staying focused on the present. After that, 15 minutes of core training (3 sets of 1-minute planks, 3 sets of 20 supine crunches, 3 sets of 15 Russian twists), and finally 10 minutes of systematic stretching, especially targeting tight calves and hips. The whole session felt good today; I was in top form.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go home to freshen up and prepare.
description: 07:00 Jogged home (about 15 minutes). Quickly showered and changed into work clothes. While blow-drying my hair, I reviewed today's work priorities: I must call the client to follow up on issues, and contact the Huatai Securities classmate recommended by my younger brother. After confirming my husband was waking the children, I quickly packed my commute bag, and my mood shifted into work mode.
