name: Evening leisure and exercise
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, she focused on practicing the new Cantonese embroidery stitch that Teacher Wu had taught her, trying to create a gradient effect on the butterfly wings. Her daughter sat nearby quietly drawing, her husband tuned the repaired radio and played nostalgic golden oldies, and her mother watched a Cantonese feature film. The atmosphere was warm and cozy. At exactly nine o'clock, she opened her tablet for a video call with her running buddy Shen Peiwen. They did dynamic stretching and supplemental core training, shared their feelings about last Saturday's long-distance run, and exchanged insights on speed intervals. After stretching, her whole body felt refreshed.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and parent-child time
description: After stretching along with a video, she took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and did 5 minutes of eye yoga and 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation in bed, reviewing the day and feeling grateful. She opened her phone to quickly log what she had eaten and check the next day's schedule. Then she went to her daughter's room first to read a bedtime story and lull her to sleep, then checked on her son, who was reading a comic book. She reminded him it was time for bed and turned off the light for him. Back in her room, she flipped through the breathing workshop handout to preview the next breathing meditation class.
location: Bedroom and children's room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the lights at exactly 11 p.m., said goodnight to her husband, lay in bed, reflected on a fulfilling and smooth day, felt at peace, and fell into a deep sleep with a sense of contentment.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The phone alarm rang right on time at 6:10. A little light came through the gap in the curtains, and the sound of pattering rain reached your ears. You remembered the weather forecast had said scattered showers would turn sunny, with a high of 33 degrees, and the humid heat seemed to arrive ahead of time. You sat up and lightly pressed your calves, which were still sore from yesterday's interval run, but inside you were looking forward to this morning's yoga class. After changing into yoga clothes and drinking half a glass of warm water, your body gradually woke up from sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Ashtanga yoga morning class and breathing exercises
description: Holding an umbrella, you walked about 8 minutes to Whampoa Fitness Centre. The 6:30 Ashtanga early morning class started on time. Under the teacher's steady guidance, you started with Sun Salutations and gradually transitioned into standing postures and a seated sequence. Each breath was coordinated with movement, and the stiffness in your shoulders and neck, along with yesterday's fatigue, dissolved in the flow. After class, you sat on your mat for an additional 5 minutes of nadi shodhana meditation, feeling an unprecedented sense of freshness and ease in body and mind.
location: 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Buying breakfast and having breakfast with the family
description: After the morning class, the rain had gradually eased. On the way, you walked to New Shanghai Kitchen and bought the family's favorite sticky rice rolls, soy milk, and savory Chinese crepes. When you got home, your mother had already made plain congee. You and your family sat around the dining table, eating the warm breakfast while asking your son about today's painting class theme at school, and teasing your daughter about whether she shared toys with friends at kindergarten. You noticed that your husband Zhang Weiming seemed in good spirits today, and you reminded him to be careful when going out for repair work in the rain.
location: Hong Kong SAR, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, No. 7 Tak Fung Street, New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant, and Whampoa Garden residential estate at 328 Prince Edward Road West.

name: Study cross-border insurance materials in depth and send birthday wishes to my younger brother.
description: After breakfast, you went into the study and opened your laptop. Because the cross-border business in Shenzhen was meeting with a cold reception, you decided to proactively recharge yourself. You brought up the company's cross-border insurance training PDF from last month and two internal case manuals, focusing on the underwriting rules and tax considerations for cross-border high-end medical insurance. While reading, you took summary notes in a new notebook and highlighted key clauses with different colored pens. At about 10:15, you remembered that today was your younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's birthday, so you made a WeChat voice call to him, sent your sincere wishes, and listened with interest as he talked about the amusing story of the stray cat the family had just adopted. Laughter eased the tension of studying.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Light lunch and browsing news on my phone
description: You took out the fruit salad and a small cup of yogurt you had prepared yesterday from the fridge as lunch, sat on the sofa, and browsed your phone while eating. You quickly checked customer messages and replied to an inquiry about policy terms; then scrolled through a few industry articles to catch up on the latest insurance regulatory developments.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to the Wan Chai office and preparing work documents
description: After changing into her professional suit and taking the briefcase containing the documents for the afternoon's contract signing, she walked from home to Whampoa Station and took the MTR to Wan Chai. During the roughly 50-minute commute, she took the folder out of her bag and double-checked Mr. and Mrs. Chen's savings life insurance proposal, application form, and receipts. She also replied to two emails about renewal reminders while the MTR signal was good, and thought about how to communicate with her new colleague He Junwen later.
location: MTR (Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Team communication and preparation before signing the policy.
description: After arriving at the office, you spent 15 minutes briefly chatting with He Junwen, a new team member, patiently reminding him of details to note when filling in the follow-up form, such as the classification criteria for customer intention levels and the accurate recording of the next follow-up time. Then you returned to your workstation, brewed a cup of green tea, and reviewed the talking points for the afternoon meeting again to get yourself into a professional state.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meet with client and complete the policy signing
description: At 2:00 p.m., Mr. and Mrs. Chen arrived on time. You warmly welcomed them into the small meeting room reserved in advance. Following the prepared plan, you once again emphasized the long-term returns and protection benefits of the savings life insurance plan in plain language. Mr. and Mrs. Chen had few questions about the terms and quickly signed the insurance application form. Joy rose in your heart. You then entered the policy details in the system and emailed the underwriting department.
location: Small meeting room, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-contract follow-up and work plan
description: After seeing the client out, you returned to your desk and handled several emails awaiting replies, including a client's inquiry about the claims process. Next, you began outlining a proposal for revisiting Mr. and Mrs. Chen next week. You also took out your phone and sent a WeChat message to your client Chen Meiling, confirming a policy review at 3 p.m. tomorrow (Friday, July 18) at a café near her home.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Socializing with colleagues and planning weekend shopping
description: Before leaving work, you remembered your coffee date with your good friend and colleague Su Lishan. You called her and asked whether she was free this weekend to go shopping in Causeway Bay together, to make up for not being able to go last week. Su Lishan said she was free on Saturday afternoon, and you agreed to contact each other on WeChat then. After hanging up, you tidied your desk and put tomorrow's documents into your briefcase.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuted home and had a phone call with her mother-in-law
description: You took the MTR back to Kowloon City. On the train, you called your mother-in-law who lives in Kwun Tong, asked about her health, and told her you would bring the kids to visit her tomorrow evening, so she didn't need to prepare too many dishes. She was very happy on the phone and urged you not to work too hard.
location: MTR (Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Helping with meal preparation and a warm dinner
description: After arriving home, you changed out of your suit, went into the kitchen to help your mother, washing vegetables and cutting fruit. Your husband Zhang Weiming also came back; he had fixed the loose desk drawer in your daughter's room. The family sat around the dining table for dinner, and your mother had made green-and-red radish soup. At the table, you talked about the joy of successfully closing a deal today, and Zhang Weiming also shared interesting stories from his repair work. After dinner, you checked your son's math homework, found a mistake in one problem, and patiently taught him to correct it.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A short evening rest and sharing Cantonese embroidery works
description: After dinner, take a short rest. You walk to the balcony and feel the moist air after the rain has cleared. You take out your phone, look through the photos of the finished “Butterfly Dance” series of Cantonese embroidery you took before, select a few with the best angles, and send them to your Cantonese embroidery teacher, Wu Xiuying, via WeChat, with a message asking for her advice.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child interaction and family chit-chat
description: As evening fell, you and your daughter played with puzzles on the living room sofa, while your son watched a science education animation on his tablet nearby. Your husband Zhang Weiming came over and sat down. You talked with him about the plan to go see cars tomorrow and the arrangement to test-drive a Toyota Prius on the weekend. He was very interested in the new car's features.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family documentary night: The Craftsmanship of Hong Kong
description: At 8:30, you suggested turning on the TV to watch the agreed-upon documentary Craftsmanship Port. This episode told the story of a retired watchmaker whose focused gaze as he repaired old watches made the whole family fall silent. Your husband Zhang Weiming sighed as he watched, "Craftsmanship is the real iron rice bowl," and you smiled and squeezed his hand. Your mother shared an amusing story about a tailor she knew in her youth, and the children quietly snuggled close, feeling the warmth of a family ritual.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime preparations and putting the children to sleep
description: After the documentary ended, you urged the children to go wash up. You helped your daughter wash her face and brush her teeth, then read her a bedtime story by her bed. Your son went to bed obediently on his own. You kissed them on the forehead and said goodnight.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening self-care, meditation, and bedtime
description: Back in the master bedroom, you did 10 minutes of eye yoga and 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation. During the meditation, you reviewed today: the stretch from the morning yoga class, the breakthrough in cross-border knowledge, the smooth completion of signing the order, your husband's insight into craftsmanship, the warmth of family... All of it made you feel fulfilled and content. Before bed, you picked up your phone and set reminders for tomorrow's work, exercise, visiting your mother-in-law, and test-driving a car. At about 22:30, you turned off the bedside lamp and adjusted your breathing in the dark, ready to fall asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: The phone alarm rang at 5:30, and she got up immediately. The sky outside the window was already bright; the weather forecast said there would be thunderstorms in the afternoon. Yesterday's contract signing and her younger brother's birthday celebration gave her a restful sleep and plenty of energy. She changed into a quick-drying sports tank top and shorts, put on running shoes, tied her hair up with a headband, drank warm water, and put on her sports watch and Bluetooth earphones.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning workout: 10km variable-pace run and core training
description: She tiptoed out of the house and walked about 15 minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park. The morning air was moist with the scent of flowers and grass. On the way, she met Uncle Lin, who was doing morning exercise, and they smiled at each other in greeting. On the park track, she first jogged 1 km to warm up, then did a 10 km interval run: 1–2 km at 6:00/km, 3–4 km at 5:40/km, 5–6 km at 6:15/km, 7–8 km at 5:30/km, 9–10 km at 5:50/km, with a steady heart rate and good breathing. After the run, she completed core training in the fitness area: 3 sets of Y raises, 3 sets of bird-dogs, and 3 sets of dead bugs. While stretching, she ran into Coach Zhao Zhiming, who praised her for being in good shape. She recorded the data on her phone and took a photo with him.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Chatted with neighbors on the way home.
description: After the training, I walked home. At the 7-ELEVEn convenience store next to Kowloon Tsai Park, I bought a sports drink and ran into my neighbor Mrs. Chan. We chatted about morning running tips. Mrs. Chan envied my running frequency, so I recommended the yoga class at Whampoa Fitness Centre and we agreed to go together next time.
location: 7-ELEVEn convenience store near Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Washing up and changing
description: When she got home, her family was still asleep. She quickly showered to wash off the sweat, changed into a clean casual T-shirt and shorts, dried her hair, applied sunscreen, and prepared to have breakfast with her family.
location: Home bathroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family breakfast time
description: Mother had prepared breakfast: congee, fried eggs, stir-fried greens, and iced soy milk. My husband Zhang Weiming called our son Zixuan to get up, and our daughter Xinxin was already at the table. The family shared as they ate breakfast; our son talked about the school's Little Inventor activity, and our daughter recited a nursery rhyme. Father Yu Guoqiang spoke little. Remembering the earlier argument, I hesitated and did not mention it. After the meal, Father went out to the park to play chess.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Preparing client policy review materials at home
description: The children were taken to school by my husband and my mother, and my father went out to play chess. After clearing the table, I went to the study to prepare the policy review materials for Chen Meiling in the afternoon. I spread out the three policy folders, checked the premium payment records, coverage amounts, and beneficiary information, and highlighted key points with a highlighter. I reviewed the terms of the company's new high-end medical insurance, wrote down the recommended reasons and matching suggestions on sticky notes, neatly packed the materials into a document folder, and drafted the conversation outline in my notebook. During this time, I received a WeChat message from my younger brother Yu Xiaofeng, thanking me for the high-end sports earphones I sent yesterday, which warmed my heart.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Simple lunch and call mother-in-law
description: Her mother made a bowl of wonton noodles. Yu Xiaowei ate while giving the documents in the document bag a final check to make sure nothing was missing. After the meal, she returned to the study, changed into a white shirt and dark gray suit trousers, and put on light makeup. She then called her mother-in-law, who happily said she would go to the street market to buy green and red radishes and make soup for us to drink in the evening. After hanging up, she felt relaxed.
location: Kitchen and study at the Whampoa Garden home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Commuted to Taikoo Shing and made final preparations at a café.
description: She put on her briefcase, picked up an umbrella, and left the house. After a five-minute walk to Whampoa Station, she took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Yau Tong Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Tai Koo Station, about 40 minutes in total. On the train, she silently reviewed the coverage gaps and recommended plans. After leaving the station, she walked to the "% Arabica" café at Cityplaza Phase 2, ordered an American coffee, and opened the documents again to organize her thoughts and imagine possible questions the client might ask. Once fully prepared, she headed to Chen Meiling's home.
location: % Arabica Coffee Shop, Cityplaza Phase 2, 18 Taikoo Shing Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong

name: Client policy review and uncovering new needs
description: Arrived at High Terrace, Taikoo Shing 30 minutes before the appointment time, waited briefly in the garden downstairs, then rang the doorbell on time. Chen Meiling warmly welcomed me, and we spread out the work on the living room coffee table. I explained the current status, dividends, and annual adjustments of each policy one by one. The client was very satisfied with the clear organization and professional interpretation. At the right moment, I recommended the company's new high-end medical insurance, emphasizing the advantages of global medical coverage and private wards. Chen Meiling said she would discuss it with her husband, and also took the initiative to introduce her best friend to me, making an appointment to have tea together early next month. I recorded the friend's general needs.
location: Hong Kong, Quarry Bay, Taikoo Shing Road, Taikoo Shing, Ko Shan Terrace, Po Shan Court

name: Returned to the office to input records and assist colleagues
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Meiling, I took the MTR back to the AIA Building in Wan Chai. In the CRM system, I created a potential customer profile for Chen Meiling's close friend, noting the referral relationship and initial needs. I opened Word to draft a protection optimization proposal for Chen Meiling's family, adding a comparison plan for high-end medical insurance. After finishing, I sent Chen Meiling a WeChat message of thanks. At that moment, He Junwen, a new colleague on the team, came to ask about claims underwriting issues. I put down my bag and patiently explained the clauses and shared my handling experience.
location: Office at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Going to her mother-in-law's home to share a lovingly prepared soup
description: The sky was overcast and the air was muggy, so I quickened my pace. From Wan Chai Station I took the Island Line to Admiralty, transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Kwun Tong Station, then walked 8 minutes to Kam Kiu Mansion on Hong Ning Road. My mother-in-law had already simmered a pot of green radish and carrot soup, and the room was filled with a sweet aroma. I helped her wipe her hands, and together we ladled out the soup and sliced the char siu. While sipping the soup, I listened to her tell amusing stories about the neighbor’s granddaughter, and my heart felt warm and secure.
location: Grandma's home, Golden Bridge Mansion, Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong.

name: Return home, family dinner, and parent-child bonding
description: Took leave from my mother-in-law's home. It was already dark and a light drizzle was falling, so I hurried on with an umbrella. Took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station and went home. My husband called to say he was picking up our daughter. When I got home, my mother and husband had already set out the meal, and Yuxin ran over to hug me. At dinner we chatted about my husband's amusing experience fixing the air conditioner and Xinxin learning a new song. After dinner, I checked Zixuan's math homework and taught him word problems, played with blocks with Yuxin, and listened to her kindergarten stories.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Called her father to mend the relationship
description: While the children watched TV, I went into the study, closed the door, and called my father. I tried to invite him in a relaxed tone to go for yum cha at Lin Heung Kui in Prince Edward tomorrow morning. My father was silent for a moment, then agreed, and we set it for 8:30. After hanging up, my palms were sweaty, but I felt a huge weight lifted from my heart.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Putting the children to sleep and preparing items for tomorrow
description: Feeling much more relaxed. Went to my daughter's room to read a bedtime story and watched her fall asleep sweetly. Returned to the study to prepare tomorrow's long-distance running gear in advance (running shoes, sportswear, water bottle), confirmed the time and place for tea, and set the alarm 30 minutes earlier.
location: Children's room and study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Evening yoga and mindfulness meditation
description: In the living room, she unrolled her yoga mat and did a yin yoga sequence, focusing on stretching her back and hips. Then she sat cross-legged and did ten minutes of mindfulness meditation, feeling her breath rise and fall and letting the day's thoughts settle.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep.
description: Did 5 minutes of eye yoga before bed, checked her phone to confirm there were no urgent work messages, and set it to Do Not Disturb mode. There was faint thunder and rain outside the window, and she felt calm inside. She fell asleep with a sense of contentment.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning long run training.
description: In the early morning, after a 15-minute warm-up with running partner Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park, they started an 18 km long slow run at 05:45 with a target pace of 6:30 per kilometer, running along streets including Junction Road and Tung Po Avenue. During the run, they took energy gels and water at the 5th and 10th kilometers. While running, Yu Xiaowei and Peiwen exchanged insights on cadence, breathing rhythm, and interval training. They picked up the pace in the last two kilometers and finished with an average pace of 6:28 per kilometer. Back at the park, they did 10 minutes of static stretching and foam rolling relaxation, and took photos of the morning track and a group photo of the two of them with a phone. She felt drenched in sweat and mentally clear.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, and the surrounding Junction Road and Tung Po Road area, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home after the run to rest and check in with her grandmother.
description: After finishing the run, I walked home, drank water, and wiped off the sweat. After a quick shower, I changed into a casual T-shirt and jeans. In the kitchen, I ate two slices of whole wheat toast and drank a glass of skim milk. Then, remembering it was Saturday, I called my grandmother who lives in Kwun Tong to say hello. On the phone, I shared the joy of having just completed an 18-kilometer morning run and asked if she needed me to bring anything back when I went shopping in Causeway Bay in the afternoon. Grandma told me to take care of myself and not to bring anything. I also chatted with her about the latest news about Xuanxuan and Xinxin, and we agreed that I would bring the kids to visit her next weekend. I felt warm inside.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Having tea with her father at a teahouse to mend their relationship.
description: I walked to Lin Heung Kui in Prince Edward, arrived early and chose a window booth, ordered a pot of Tieguanyin tea, and rinsed the cups and plates for my father. At 8:45 he arrived on time. At first the atmosphere was quiet. I poured him tea and opened with topics about my younger brother Xiaofeng's family photos from Ocean Park and my nephew's water fight, then told him that Xuanxuan had been praised in his football class for being “fast and full of drive.” A smile gradually appeared on my father's face. After a sip of tea, he asked with concern, “You're always running around for work — is it tiring? Take care of yourself.” My heart warmed. I ordered shrimp dumplings, chicken feet, barbecue pork buns, and pan-fried turnip cake. Over tea and small talk, the atmosphere became harmonious, and I felt the rift between my father and me being filled in. Around noon, he left first because his old friends had invited him to play chess. I walked him to the door and watched him go, then sent my mother a WeChat message saying “All sorted,” and walked home.
location: Lin Heung Kui, 218-220 Sai Yeung Choi Street South, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family midday rest and lunch
description: After returning home from the teahouse, the house was lively. Mother was busy in the kitchen, and I could smell the aroma of steamed fish with black bean sauce. The children were playing in the living room, and my husband was reading the newspaper on the balcony. After changing into home clothes, I first drank more than half a bowl of the carrot and green radish pork bone soup Mother had made, and it felt refreshingly sweet and nourishing. Lunch included steamed grass carp, blanched shrimp, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, and shrimp with scrambled eggs—all dishes I love. During the meal, I shared with my husband how smoothly the dim sum gathering with Dad had gone. He patted my hand and said, 'Dad doesn't say much, but he sees things clearly.' After the meal, I read a 10-minute picture book, 'The Adventures of Little Fish,' with my daughter Xinxin, while my son Xuanxuan showed off his newly assembled racing car beside us. The whole family was full of joy and harmony.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday nap and preparations to go out
description: After lunch, she rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for 20 minutes. Remembering she had plans with a friend, she replied to Jiaxin's message about setting off. After resting, she organized her handbag, putting in a power bank, sunscreen, a small wallet, and a small notebook for recording Cantonese embroidery inspiration. She changed into a light-colored dress, applied sunscreen, and told her mother she was going out with Jiaxin to shop in Causeway Bay and would bring back souvenirs.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shopping and socializing with best friend in Causeway Bay, and test-driving a Toyota Prius
description: I took the MTR from Whampoa Station to Causeway Bay Station and arrived at Hysan Place around 13:45 to meet Jiaxin. We first browsed UNIQLO and a Japanese general merchandise store. While Jiaxin was trying on clothes, she mentioned that she had interviewed for an administrative assistant position but had not heard back yet, and her tone was discouraged. I gently suggested that she consider getting an insurance license, but she firmly said she wanted to rely on herself. I did not press further and instead brought up the Korean drama Extraordinary Attorney Woo, imitating the main character's way of speaking to make her laugh. Later, while browsing a boutique, I noticed a white porcelain teacup with hand-painted plum blossoms and planned to give it to my father. After more than an hour of shopping, we went to a dessert shop for mango sago. During that time, I contacted my husband Zhang Weiming and told him that we would soon go to the Toyota showroom opposite Windsor House to test-drive the Prius; he said he would drive over from Whampoa to meet us. After finishing the sweet soup with Jiaxin, we walked to the Toyota showroom opposite Windsor House. The sales consultant received us warmly. I booked a 15-minute test drive and drove the Prius on roads near Causeway Bay to experience the smoothness and quietness of the hybrid. I was basically satisfied with the fuel consumption and space. Just as the test drive ended, my husband arrived. He talked with the salesperson about the specifications and maintenance intervals, exchanged business cards, and agreed to bring the children next week to look at the car. Jiaxin egged us on from the side to treat everyone to dinner, and everyone ended the fulfilling outing with laughter and joking.
location: Hysan Place and the Toyota showroom at Windsor House, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Returning Home and Recovering with Family Dinner
description: After the test drive, I said goodbye to Jiaxin at Causeway Bay MTR station and took the MTR back to Whampoa with my husband. On the way, I showed him the white porcelain teacup I had bought for my father, and he laughed at me for always finding ways to please Dad. After getting home, I changed into loungewear and rolled my calves with a fascia ball for 15 minutes to relieve the soreness from the morning run. My mother had saved dinner for us; I had a bowl of soup and some vegetables and fish. After dinner, my husband voluntarily cleared the dishes, and I played with the children in the living room. I read The Adventures of Little Fish with my daughter and deliberately made anxious sounds to make her laugh, while my son built a castle with LEGO beside us, enjoying warm family time.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child interaction and bedtime preparation
description: At 8 o'clock I started getting the children ready for bed, helping my daughter take a bath and change into pajamas. In the bedroom, I told each of the two children a short Cantonese bedtime story, and after they both settled down, I turned off the main light and left a small night light on. Back in the living room, I selected the morning run photos—a group photo with Shen Peiwen, a selfie of myself wearing a sports watch, and the track in the morning light—and wrote: '18km done! Thanks to my best running partner @Shen Peiwen and the great weather this morning! Although my legs are sore, I feel more than satisfied! Looking forward to the next long run!' I posted it on Moments, and soon received likes and encouragement from friends such as Su Lishan and Coach Zhao.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal relaxation, preparation for tomorrow, and bedtime
description: After the children fell asleep, I changed into loose loungewear and did 15 minutes of mindful meditation on the yoga mat in the living room, settling the day's thoughts and fatigue. Then I took out the half-finished "Butterfly Dance" series Cantonese embroidery, looked through the sashiko stitch photos I had taken before, and thought about how to combine several stitching techniques. After that, I checked my water bottle and running gear for tomorrow morning's run and confirmed that I had arranged to meet Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Tsai Park at 6 a.m. on the 20th. With everything ready, I turned off the bedroom lamp at 22:30 and fell asleep peacefully, feeling fulfilled and content.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family wake-up and cozy breakfast
description: I woke up naturally in the weekend morning light and felt a slight tightness in my calves from yesterday's long run, so I did 5 minutes of leg stretches first. Then I tiptoed out of bed and saw my husband Zhang Weiming already on the balcony, busy repairing the old electric fan. My mother was brewing selfheal herbal tea in the kitchen and handed me a cup of warm water. I woke up my son Zixuan and daughter Xinxin. Zixuan dressed himself, while Xinxin lingered in bed, so I helped her tie two small bun hair buns. At breakfast, my mother steamed Cantonese sponge cake, my husband bought fresh pineapple buns with butter, and the whole family sat around drinking Hong Kong-style milk tea. While eating, I checked my phone and saw the group photo from the 18 km run that my running friend Shen Peiwen had sent yesterday. I felt warm inside and liked it.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Weekend homework help and family mutual support
description: After breakfast, I took my son Zixuan to the study to review English words, using a 'you act, I guess' game to help him memorize. My daughter Xinxin played with water toys on the living room floor, looking forward to swimming. My husband continued fixing the electric fan on the balcony and successfully got it working; the children clapped happily. During this, I checked Zixuan's weekend homework. Math was done well, but there were a few spelling errors in English; I patiently corrected them three times.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Housework sharing and parent-child reading
description: She helped her mother prepare soup for lunch, chatting while picking vegetables about switching to a more spacious hybrid car to make weekend family trips more convenient. After that, she read two picture books to her daughter Xinxin, enjoying her attentive gaze. Her husband fixed the fan and put it back in place, earning praise from the whole family. The entire morning was filled with the warmth of the family helping one another.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pool gear organizing and simple lunch
description: As the weather was getting hot, she decided to go swimming in the afternoon. She packed a large bag with swimsuits, big towels, sunscreen, a kickboard, and Xinxin's squirting whale toy, making a point to find her favorite Little Mermaid swimsuit, while Zixuan got his own goggles. Her mother served tomato and egg noodle soup and blanched choy sum for lunch, which was light and appetizing.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday rest and work reflection
description: While the children were watching cartoons, she went back to the bedroom with her husband for a short rest. Lying flat with eyes closed, she felt the soreness from yesterday's long run gradually ease. In her mind, she silently went over the details of the proposal for Mr. and Mrs. Chen, whom she would revisit next Monday, to make sure nothing was missed. After half an hour, she felt much more refreshed.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-swim sun protection and changing
description: Urged the children to change into swimsuits, helped Xinxin put on her Little Mermaid swimsuit, and carefully applied waterproof sunscreen on both. Zixuan tried to dodge because it felt sticky, so she persuaded him by saying, “If you get tanned like a roast pig, we won't go to Ocean Park.” She also reapplied sunscreen on herself, put on her straw hat and sunglasses, and her husband carried the pool bag to the car.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drive to Kowloon City community pool for swimming.
description: Husband Zhang Weiming drove, Yu Xiaowei sat in the front passenger seat, and the two children in the back seat chatted excitedly. Xinxin hummed a mermaid song, and Zixuan kept confirming whether the kickboard was brought. From Whampoa Garden, they took Hung Hom Road and turned onto Princess Margaret Road Link, arriving at the Kowloon City Community Swimming Pool in about 15 minutes.
location: Kowloon City Community Swimming Pool, Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: First Sunday Family Pool Time
description: After arriving at the outdoor swimming pool, she found a shady spot and laid out a towel. Her husband took Zixuan to the children's pool to practice kicking, while she helped Xinxin put on a swim ring and accompanied her as she slowly got used to the water. Later, she sat under a poolside umbrella reading the novel A Gentleman in Moscow, occasionally looking up to watch her family happily splashing around, feeling a rare sense of mental release. The impromptu pool activity was a wonderful experience, and she thought to herself that it could be established as a Sunday family ritual.
location: Kowloon City Community Swimming Pool, Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return from swimming and rest in the car
description: After a full two hours of swimming, we packed up and drove home. The two children, exhausted, fell asleep quickly in the car, their hair still half-damp. She gently reminded her husband to turn up the car heater to prevent them from catching a cold. Along the way, there was only the sound of driving and the children’s even breathing—peaceful and content.
location: En route from Inverness Road, Kowloon City, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Returning home, showering, and sorting clothes.
description: After arriving home, she woke the children and urged them to take hot showers. She first helped Xinxin wash her hair, dried her, and changed her into home clothes; Zixuan washed himself. She hung the wet swimsuits and towels out to dry and put the items in the pool bag back in place. Her mother had already prepared herbal tea and served it to everyone to clear heat and dispel dampness.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Dinner preparation and family gathering
description: She helped her mother cook steamed grass carp, shrimp scrambled eggs, and garlic stir-fried choy sum. Her husband watched TV with the children who had just woken up. During dinner, everyone shared funny stories about the pool. Zixuan proudly said he had learned how to breathe when swimming, and Xinxin showed off that she dared to close her eyes underwater. The dining table was filled with laughter and joy.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Called my mother-in-law to report that we were safe.
description: After dinner, she proactively called her mother-in-law Li Shufen, who lives in Kwun Tong, to let her know they were safe and to share the joy of the children's swimming. She mentioned the idea of switching to a hybrid car. Her mother-in-law agreed and reminded her to go out less and take care of her health. She had just made carrot and radish soup and invited us to come and have some when we had time. Hearing that she sounded happy, she felt at ease.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video chatted with a close friend in Shenzhen about parenting tips.
description: In the living room, she had a video call on her phone with her close friend Zhou Minyi in Shenzhen. They exchanged experiences about children learning to swim and shared how to help Xinxin love swimming through water toys and encouragement. They also talked about the educational differences between Shenzhen and Hong Kong and agreed to talk again next week.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Creating the Cantonese embroidery "Butterfly Dance Series".
description: After the children washed up, her husband read bedtime stories with them. She went back to the study to continue her Cantonese embroidery of the "Butterfly Dance Series." She switched to royal blue and silver-white threads to stitch the final layer of the wings. With soft instrumental music in the background, she felt especially calm with every stitch, enjoying her focused creative time.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Eye yoga and diet log.
description: Putting down her needlework, she did 5 minutes of eye yoga in the study (warming her palms over her eyes, rolling her eyeballs, etc.) to relieve dryness. Back in the bedroom, she used her phone's memo app to record the day's food: breakfast was half a piece of ma lai go, a pineapple bun with butter, and milk tea; lunch was tomato and egg macaroni; dinner was half a bowl of rice with steamed grass carp and shrimp scrambled eggs; and she drank plenty of water at the pool. Her weight was 54.6 kg, as expected.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Heart-to-heart talk before bed and get ready to sleep
description: She changed into her pajamas and lay down beside her husband. He shared the satisfaction of having repaired the fan, while she mentioned that she needed to go over the proposal again before her follow-up visit to Mr. and Mrs. Chen next Monday. They chatted about funny things the kids did and planned to take the whole family to Repulse Bay next weekend. She set the alarm, turned off the light, took a deep breath, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of fulfillment after the full day.
location: 15B, Tower 1, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning Road Run and Core Training
description: I was woken by my phone alarm at 5:30 a.m. The sky outside was already light, and the weather forecast said it would be sunny with a southwest wind. After getting up, I washed up briefly, changed into running gear, drank a glass of warm water, checked my sports watch and Bluetooth earphones, and then walked about 15 minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park. On the way, I did several shoulder and neck stretches to wake up my body. After arriving at the park, I did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up (high knees, jumping jacks, lunges), then completed an 8-kilometer road run at a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, speeding up to 5 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer for the last kilometer, feeling the explosive power of my heart, lungs, and leg muscles. After the run, I did core strengthening on the grass: 3 sets of planks (60 seconds each), 2 sets of lying leg raises (15 reps each), and 2 sets of bird dogs (12 reps per side), followed by a 15-minute full-body stretch. I used an app to record the workout data. Finally, I walked home, wiping sweat with a towel on the way, and felt great.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong; and Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West

name: Family breakfast and school preparation
description: After returning home, I quickly showered and changed, then had breakfast with my family. Mother had prepared rice porridge, fried eggs, and stir-fried greens. As I ate, I listened to my son Xuanxuan talk about his painting assignment 'My Family' that he needed to turn in today, which showed our family of five and the cat. I checked his schoolbag for him, and also checked the painting my daughter Xinxin needed to bring to kindergarten. After the meal, I quickly went over the education savings proposal I needed to prepare for Mrs. Chen that afternoon on my tablet, confirming the key terms and figures.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

She then walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station and transferred to the Island Line, arriving at Wan Chai Station about an hour later. After exiting the station, she walked to AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, buying a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at a convenience store on the way.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Team regular meeting and case coaching
description: Held a 30-minute team morning meeting, reviewed last week's performance, specifically praised Friday's follow-up with the referred client at the Jockey Club, clarified the list of high-net-worth clients needing focused attention this week, and reiterated the Friday review system. After the meeting, I had a one-on-one discussion with team member Chen Li in the pantry. I helped her analyze the client's hesitation, suggested using education fund planning as an entry point, and emphasized long-term value. Chen Li said her thinking was much clearer and planned to arrange another meeting with the client that afternoon.
location: Office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Phone follow-up with renewal customers.
description: Following the list, I called the three clients whose policies are about to be renewed one by one. A retired teacher and a homemaker readily confirmed their renewals and scheduled appointments to sign at the office this Friday; another client was still thinking it over, so I patiently answered his questions about upgrading his medical insurance and agreed to speak with him again by phone on Wednesday.

During the meal, we ran into Liu Jiahui, a former co-worker from the packaging factory. He happened to be in Hong Kong on business, so we briefly caught up and exchanged WeChat contact cards. After lunch, we walked for 15 minutes around Convention Plaza to aid digestion. Back at my desk, I sent a voice message to my younger brother Yu Xiaofeng wishing him a belated happy birthday for yesterday and asked how the celebration went. Then I checked and printed the materials needed for the afternoon client visit, including the policy, the company health magazine, and education savings product brochures.
location: New Hennessy Café, 6 O'Brien Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong; and Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road

On the train, I used the notes app on my phone to organize the terms of the education savings insurance policy that Mrs. Chan was concerned about, and prepared two similar successful cases. At Luckin Coffee in Festival Walk, Kowloon Tong, I met the client Mrs. Chan, who was considering planning an education fund for her 5-year-old son. I presented the proposal, explained the coverage and returns item by item, compared two options with different payment periods, and used real cases to dispel her doubts. Mrs. Chan was satisfied and said she needed to discuss it with her husband before replying.
location: Luckin Coffee, Shop UG-24, Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Kowloon Tong

name: Visit client Mrs. Li
description: Took a taxi from Kowloon Tong to Lok Fu Estate to visit long-time client Mrs. Li, a homemaker. This visit was mainly to maintain the relationship. I gave her the company's latest health magazine and chatted about her child's summer arrangements for moving from kindergarten to primary school and the fresh fruit at the nearby market. Mrs. Li warmly served homemade snow pear tea, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Client's home, Wang Tat House, Lok Fu Estate, Wong Tai Sin District, Hong Kong

name: Returned to the company to organize client records.

After returning to my desk, I immediately entered the visit records for the two clients from the afternoon into the system and made detailed notes on Mrs. Chan's potential needs and concerns for future follow-up.
location: Office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Commute home from work

On the way, received a WeChat voice reply from my younger brother Yu Xiaofeng. He thanked me for my wishes and said he had a seafood dinner with the family in Shenzhen last night and was very happy.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (in transit)

I listened to my daughter Xinxin tell us about the 'ABCD' song she had just learned in kindergarten, my son Xuanxuan shared how his teacher praised his creative drawing, and my husband Weiming talked about being thanked for repairing a client's split air conditioner.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Parent-child park activity.

In the summer evening breeze, the children played on the slide and climbing frame in the plaza while I stretched on a bench nearby, enjoying a relaxing moment.
location: Children's play area, Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

location: Children's room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City, Hong Kong

Weiming agreed, and we briefly discussed color preferences and budget range.

After meditating, she recorded her diet and exercise data on her phone and replied to her running buddy Shen Peiwen on WeChat, confirming a pace run at Kowloon Tsai Park at 7 a.m. the next morning. She set the alarm for 5:30 a.m., did a simple skincare routine, and turned off the lights at 10:15 p.m. to go to bed.

Then she talked with Shen Peiwen, who shared that she had signed up for the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Half Marathon at the end of the year and encouraged Xiaowei to join. Xiaowei made a mental note.

location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute home

Then she went to the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic and chatted about the day's experiences. Her husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, and the family had dinner together, with steamed sea bass and stir-fried pea shoots with garlic. During the meal, Xiaowei brought up the electric car advertisement she had seen in Sham Shui Po, discussed how the family's old car had many problems, and suggested going to a car dealer over the weekend to look at cars. Weiming agreed, and her mother reminded them not to forget to check the government's environmental subsidy policy. The car replacement topic got off to a good start.

Next, she checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math homework, found two word problems with errors, patiently guided him to reread the questions, and he finally worked out the correct answers on his own.

name: Personal time: practice Cantonese embroidery

Accompanied by soothing light music, she stitched one stitch at a time, and work pressure and daily trivialities gradually settled, leaving her mind at peace.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation: meditation, reading, and gratitude journaling.
description: After washing up and completing her evening skincare routine, she turned off the lights and sat cross-legged on the bed for a 15-minute mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and clearing her mind. She then leaned against the headboard and read a few pages of A Gentleman in Moscow, and used a mobile app to record three small things she was grateful for today: successfully signing the contract, reaching an agreement with the family on changing the car, and enjoying peaceful embroidery time.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: Feeling sleepy, she turned off the desk lamp and drifted into sleep with the satisfaction of a fulfilling life and expectations for the future.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run training and sharing
description: Waking up naturally in the early morning, feeling mentally focused, she first weighed herself (54.3 kg), changed into running gear, drank warm water, checked the weather, and then left the house quietly. She jogged about 20 minutes from home to Kowloon Tsai Park as a warm-up, then started high-intensity interval running on the park's track: first a 10-minute dynamic warm-up, then 6 sets of 800m fast runs (pace 4:50/km) with 400m jogging recovery, taking small sips of water during each rest interval. She also added core training: plank 3 sets (70 seconds each), Russian twists 3 sets (20 per side), and bicycle crunches 3 sets (30 seconds). After the workout, she cooled down with a 5-minute jog, did 10 minutes of static stretching on the lawn, recorded the training data in a phone app, and sent a voice message to her running partner Shen Peiwen to share the results and ask about the jogging trail information. Finally, she jogged about 20 minutes home at a relaxed pace.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park and Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Breakfast and family time
description: After showering and changing into home clothes, she enjoyed the plain rice porridge, scrambled eggs, and fried rice rolls prepared by her mother together with her husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, and daughter Zhang Yuxin. She especially felt her daughter Yuxin's forehead with the back of her hand, found her temperature normal, reminded her to drink more water at school, and chatted with the family for a bit.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting and handling client claims
description: Walking from home to Whampoa Station, she took the MTR (Kwun Tong line, then East Rail line, then Island line) to Wan Chai Station. The whole trip took about 40 minutes, during which she browsed industry news on her phone and replied to simple client inquiries. After arriving at the AIA Building, she brewed black coffee and checked her email, where she found an email sent by team member He Junwen about a client's complaint regarding a delayed claims settlement. She immediately called He Junwen into a small meeting room, learned the details of the reason for the claim delay (an internal document handover omission), and guided him to draft an apology email and propose offering a 500-yuan supermarket gift voucher as compensation. After reviewing it, she sent it and Cc'd herself. She then anonymized the case, updated the team's shared knowledge base, and wrote a comment reminding about service timeliness. Finally, she did 5 minutes of eye yoga.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Follow up with client and check on daughter's condition
description: Carrying a thermos as a gift, she walked from the office to Wan Chai Station, took the Island Line to Causeway Bay Station, and went to Starbucks to meet the client Miss Li. She gave her the thermos, introduced the company's customer appreciation activity, asked about her health condition, and reminded her to update her contact information. The whole process was efficient and friendly. On the way back, she took the MTR one stop to return to Wan Chai. During the ride, she received a call from her mother and learned that her daughter Yuxin had a low-grade fever of 37.8°C after her nap. She asked in detail about her mental state, guided her mother through physical cooling (applying a fever patch and wiping her body with warm water), and instructed her to monitor her temperature and notify her immediately if it continued to rise.

Yu Xiaowei remained calm on the surface but was inwardly alert. She noted this and replied that without proof it was hard to make a fuss, but she would keep an eye out.

Around 14:30, I took a moment to call my mother and learned that my daughter's fever had broken and she was in good spirits, so I felt completely relieved. Then I used the quiet period to prepare protection plans for clients and called two claims clients to update them on progress. Before leaving work, I tidied my desk, met Su Lishan in the lobby downstairs, and set off together for Kowloon City.

Yu Xiaowei responded calmly, saying they should stay put for now and she would keep an eye out. After the treatment, she returned home alone, taking the Tuen Ma Line from Sung Wong Toi Station and transferring to Whampoa Station, a journey of about 20 minutes, and texted her husband to ask about dinner.

Around 16:00 a sudden downpour came; while sheltering at the showroom entrance, I ran into my high school classmate He Junjie. We chatted happily for nearly 10 minutes, talked about why I was buying a car, and he joked that next time we gather he would ride in the new car. We said goodbye after the rain eased.

She drank warm water on an empty stomach, changed into a running vest, shorts, and running shoes, put energy gels and salt tablets into her waist pack, and tied her hair back with a headband. Then she walked about 50 minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park, met up with her running buddy Shen Peiwen beside the pavilion, and did dynamic warm-ups such as high knees, butt kicks, and side leg stretches. After that, they started a 20 km long run at a pace of about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, running an out-and-back route along the park track, Junction Road, and La Salle Road, hydrating and taking energy gels every 5 km. The two chatted about new cars while running, accelerated for the last 2 km, and finished in 2 hours 12 minutes. After the run, they helped each other do 15 minutes of deep stretching, focusing on relaxing the thighs and calves. Then she said goodbye to Shen Peiwen and began walking home.

Then the whole family enjoyed breakfast together. On the table were oatmeal with fresh milk, blueberries, nuts, and homemade protein shakes. Her mother added hot tea for her and reminded her to be safe. During the meal, she told the children they would go to see a new car in the morning. Her daughter Xinxin was excited about riding in the new car, and her son Xuanxuan asked whether it would be more environmentally friendly. After breakfast, in the living room, Yu Xiaowei helped Xuanxuan check his summer homework and pointed out a careless mistake in a math problem. She also taught her daughter to trim the claws of the orange tabby cat 'Bobo' with child-safe scissors, while her mother tidied up the dishes nearby, enjoying the cozy time.

Then she shares her morning running route in the running enthusiasts group and receives likes. After that, she checks the formal quotation received yesterday and puts it in her carry bag. Her husband Zhang Weiming has changed clothes, and the two tell their son to look after his younger sister, say goodbye to their mother, and prepare to leave for Wan Chai to look at a car.

The whole trip took about 40 minutes. After exiting the station, they walked to the Toyota Wan Chai Showroom at 39 Gloucester Road. The sales consultant, Mr. Wu, had the test-drive car ready. Yu Xiaowei drove first, heading east along Gloucester Road, turning onto Fenwick Street, then onto Hennessy Road and looping back, experiencing the quiet ride of the hybrid and the intelligent driving safety system. When Zhang Weiming took over the wheel, he focused on acceleration response and rear-seat space, joking that the kids could do somersaults in the back. After the test drive, both were satisfied with the car. They confirmed the installment payment details and the paint color. Zhang Weiming paid a HK$5,000 deposit and made an appointment to sign the contract the next day. Yu Xiaowei took a photo of the display car and sent it to the family group with the caption “Done!” The family responded with likes and cheers. Then the two walked about 12 minutes to Lee Tung Avenue and had lunch on the second floor of “Dragon City Cafe,” ordering a roast duck combination, stir-fried broccoli with scallops, and two pineapple buns with butter, along with iced lemon tea and iced milk tea to celebrate the car purchase. During the meal, Zhang Weiming talked about plans to drive her to a weekend trail race in the future.

Yu Xiaowei showed her the new car photos on her phone, and the daughter excitedly pointed at the blue car and shouted, "Little Blue, Little Blue!"

She put on a sports vest and quick-dry shorts, glanced out the window; it was already light, so the weather should be nice today. location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Jog to Kowloon Tsai Park for a recovery jog and stretching.
description: Yu Xiaowei started from her home in Whampoa Garden, jogging along the sidewalk of Prince Edward Road West toward Kowloon Tsai Park. The streets were quiet in the early morning, and the air was fresh with the scent of plants. She kept a comfortable cadence and arrived at the entrance of Kowloon Tsai Park after about 10 minutes. On the park track, she began a 5 km recovery jog, deliberately slowing her pace to about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, focusing on her breathing rhythm and letting her body slowly loosen up with the easy exercise. After finishing, she did 10 minutes of static stretching under a tree by the lawn, focusing on relaxing the backs of her thighs and hips, and logged the workout on her phone app. At that moment, she received a voice message from Lin Jiaxin: "Got it! Totally understand. See you next weekend. Can't wait to see photos of your new car!" She smiled and felt even better.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park running track and lawn, Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Return home, shower, and change into formal attire.
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowei went straight to the bathroom and took a warm shower, washing off the light sweat. After showering, she changed into a well-tailored light blue dress, paired with comfortable white-and-gold flat ballet shoes, looking capable yet gentle. She quickly fixed her hair in the mirror and applied sunscreen.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: The whole family had breakfast together and then did household tidying and preparations.
description: At the dining table, Mother Chen Xiuzhu had already prepared congee, fried eggs, barbecue pork buns, and stir-fried greens. After sitting down, Yu Xiaowei put a fried egg on the plates of her son Zixuan and daughter Yuxin, and reminded them: 'This morning Daddy and Mommy are going to take you and the new car to Victoria Peak; in the afternoon we'll go play in the pool, okay?' The two children nodded excitedly, and Zixuan even urged: 'Mom, eat quickly! Let's hurry!' Yu Xiaowei turned to her husband Zhang Weiming and confirmed: 'Are the documents all ready? We'll get to the dealership at 10.' He patted the folder beside him, indicating everything was ready. After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei helped clear the dishes into the kitchen. Back in the study, she checked again the ID card, credit card, and old car documents needed for signing, and put them in a folder. Then she walked over to her mother: 'Mom, at 3 p.m. we'll take the kids to the Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool. Why don't you come too? I've already prepared your swimsuit.' Her mother smiled and nodded: 'Sure, I'll go take a look and keep an eye on them, and you can rest for a while.'
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong: the dining room, kitchen, and study.

name: Set off for the Wan Chai car dealership and had a video call with her mother-in-law.
description: At 9 o'clock, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming set off from home on time. Xiaowei drove their existing old car along the Princess Margaret Road Link toward Wan Chai. On the way, she made a video call to her mother-in-law Li Shufen and said excitedly, "Mom, we're going to sign the contract now! The new car is so quiet. I'll drive it to Kwun Tong to show you!" Her mother-in-law said yes repeatedly and told them to be careful on the road.
location: On the way from Whampoa Garden at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, to the Toyota dealership at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Officially signed the contract to buy a new car at the Toyota dealership.
description: Arriving at the Toyota dealership on Gloucester Road in Wan Chai, sales consultant Wu Zhiqiang received them warmly. In the meeting room, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming carefully checked the contract: the old car was valued at 28,000 HKD, the down payment was about 50,000 HKD, and the remaining balance was to be paid in 24 interest-free installments. Yu Xiaowei solemnly signed the contract, and Zhang Weiming paid the down payment with a credit card. After the paperwork was done, Wu Zhiqiang led them to a brand-new white Toyota Prius with a festive red ribbon tied at the front. Unable to hide their excitement, they sat in the driver's seat to feel the new car's interior and asked the dealership staff to take a photo of them beside the car. Yu Xiaowei immediately sent the photo to the “Happy Family” family group with the caption: “Our new partner is home!”
location: Toyota dealership, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Refueling the new car, picking up the family at home, and driving to Victoria Peak for a joyride
description: After filling up the tank, Yu Xiaowei studied the interface of the center console screen and said to Zhang Weiming, 'Wow, this car is so much smarter than ours.' He smiled and nodded, while sensing the vehicle's quietness and smoothness. Then they drove back to Whampoa Garden on Prince Edward Road West. When they arrived at the building, they picked up her mother Chen Xiuzhu and the two children, Zixuan and Yuxin, who had been waiting there. Zixuan and Yuxin excitedly climbed into the back seat, touching the seats and windows. The car drove smoothly toward Victoria Peak, and on the winding mountain road, the power delivery was smooth and quiet. Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother about the quiet experience of the new car, while the children leaned against the car windows, curiously looking at the hillside villas and green trees. After arriving at the Peak car park, Yu Xiaowei took a panoramic photo with her phone and asked her husband to take a family photo of her and the family in front of the viewing platform at the Peak Tower. The sunlight was just right, the view of Victoria Harbour was unobstructed, and the whole family's faces were filled with joy.
location: Starting from the Caltex gas station on Gloucester Road in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, passing through Whampoa Garden at 328 Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District, heading to The Peak Tower at 128 Peak Road and the Victoria Peak parking lot in Central and Western District, Hong Kong, along the route

name: Do some shopping on the way down the mountain, then go home for lunch and a rest
description: After a short stop at the hilltop for photos, the family drove back down. Yu Xiaowei suggested stopping at the supermarket, so Zhang Weiming drove to the parking lot of the familiar Whampoa mall. Yu Xiaowei quickly went inside and bought fresh cherries, a tub of Häagen-Dazs ice cream, and some sports drinks to prepare for the afternoon pool activities. Back home, her mother Chen Xiuzhu reheated last night's corn and pork bone soup in the kitchen and stir-fried a plate of seasonal vegetables. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting about the drive. Yu Xiaowei served food to the children and ate most of a bowl of rice herself. After the meal, her mother took the children for their afternoon nap, while Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming rested for a while in the living room. He studied the new car manual, and Yu Xiaowei flipped through a few pages of Hong Kong Crafts.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, and Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, home dining room and living room

name: Preparing pool supplies and personal reading time
description: Yu Xiaowei did not take a nap. She got up and began to pack for the afternoon trip to Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool: she put swimsuits, goggles, large towels, sunscreen, and waterproof bags for her family of four and her mother, one by one, into a large eco-friendly tote. She changed into a brightly colored one-piece swimsuit and put a white cover-up over it. Then she put Hong Kong Handicrafts and her Kindle into her portable waterproof pouch, planning to read while the children played in the water.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Wake the children and head to Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool for a family pool day.
description: At 2:30 PM, Yu Xiaowei gently woke the children, helped them wipe their faces, and changed them into swim trunks and swimsuits. Her husband Zhang Weiming said he wanted to stay home and continue researching new car information, so he did not go. So Yu Xiaowei and her mother took the two children and walked to Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool. Upon arriving, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother and the children find a rest area with umbrellas. Her mother soaked her feet by the poolside and watched over the children; Zixuan and Yuxin could not wait to jump into the children's pool and play. Yu Xiaowei first played water guns with the two children in the shallow area and taught her daughter to kick, and only after making sure they were having fun did she return to the lounger, put on sunglasses, and read 'Hong Kong Crafts' while sipping a sports drink. Whenever she came across something interesting, she would take a photo and share it with her embroidery teacher Wu Xiuying. Occasionally she looked up at her children laughing and playing in the water and her mother watching tenderly from the side, feeling peaceful joy in her heart.
location: Walking from Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, to Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool, 7 Wan Hoi Street, Kowloon City District, and within the pool area.

name: Walked home after swimming
description: At nearly 5 o'clock, Yu Xiaowei called the children out of the water, wrapped them in large towels, and the family slowly walked home. The children's faces were flushed, they were still full of energy, and chattered about who had made the biggest splashes in the water.
location: On the way walking back from Tai Wan Shan Swimming Pool, 7 Wan Hoi Street, Kowloon City District, to Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

name: Family shower and enjoying fruit and snacks.
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei and her mother helped the two children take showers and change into dry home clothes. Yu Xiaowei also quickly showered and changed into loose-fitting home T-shirt and shorts. In the living room, Yu Xiaowei washed the cherries she had bought in the morning, cut some chilled watermelon, and brought them to the table for the children to cool down. Zhang Weiming also put down his phone and came over to eat fruit together, listening to the children talk about their fun at the pool.
location: Home bathroom and living room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Prepared dinner with mother and had dinner together as a family.
description: After a short rest, Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen to help her mother. She was responsible for picking and washing the vegetables, while her mother deftly sliced the grass carp to make a steamed fish dish. The mother and daughter chatted while they worked, and Yu Xiaowei shared the details of the morning's contract signing with her mother, who kept nodding and said that getting a new car for the family was a great thing. The dinner was abundant: steamed grass carp, boiled shrimp, garlic stir-fried broccoli, and corn and pork bone soup. The whole family sat around the table in a warm atmosphere. Zhang Weiming talked about the technical advantages of the car he had chosen, while the children kept talking nonstop as they ate shrimp. Yu Xiaowei served soup to everyone. Family time like this made her feel extremely content.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Evening family financial review and budget adjustment
description: After dinner, the mother took the children to the room to watch TV. Yu Xiaowei stopped Zhang Weiming, who was clearing the table, and said: 'Ming, come sit down, let's go over the accounts.' She took out the family ledger, a stack of receipts, and a highlighter. The two sat side by side at the coffee table in the living room and checked income and expenses month by month starting from January. Yu Xiaowei highlighted the overspent yoga classes and Cantonese embroidery silk thread costs (about 3,000 Hong Kong dollars) with the highlighter, and Zhang Weiming also confessed his extra expenses on car repair online courses and certification exams (about 1,500 Hong Kong dollars). The two communicated frankly without blaming each other, instead focusing on the second half of the year: son Zixuan's football intensive class, daughter Yuxin's ballet class renewal, and the registration fee for the year-end half marathon that Yu Xiaowei signed up for. Yu Xiaowei suggested: 'Let's set up a flexible fund of 1,500 yuan each month to cover these temporary and hobby-related expenses. That way every overspend can be taken from the fund without affecting our mandatory savings.' Zhang Weiming thought for a moment and nodded in agreement. The two organized all the adjustment conclusions into a clear summary, and Yu Xiaowei neatly clipped it into the ledger. Closing the ledger, she saw her husband nod with satisfaction and felt much more at ease.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, beside the living room coffee table

name: Sorting receipts, evening wash-up, mindfulness meditation, and diet logging.
description: After the financial review, Yu Xiaowei organized the scattered receipts on the table and filed them under the corresponding months in the accounting book. Then she went into the bathroom for a simple evening wash-up, carefully removing makeup, washing her face, and brushing her teeth to take care of her skin. After changing into pajamas, she didn't get into bed right away; instead, she sat cross-legged on a cushion on the bedroom bay window, closed her eyes, and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation. She focused on her breathing, letting the busyness and joy of the day settle. When the meditation ended, she picked up her phone, opened the health app, and recorded today's diet and weight (54.3kg).
location: Home living room, bathroom, and bedroom bay window at Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Evening couple chat, bedtime reading, and falling asleep.
description: When Yu Xiaowei lay down on the bed, Zhang Weiming had also finished washing up. The two leaned against the headboard and chatted softly for a while. They planned the next day's schedule: “Ming, tomorrow is Monday. How about going to IKEA in Kowloon Bay at 7 p.m. after work? I want to buy a storage box for the trunk of the new car.” Yu Xiaowei then reminded herself, “Oh, right, tomorrow at work I need to handle Mr. Liu's cargo insurance quote.” After that, Yu Xiaowei picked up A Gentleman in Moscow from the bedside table and flipped through a couple of pages, but drowsiness came over her. She put down the book, said “goodnight” softly to her husband, and turned off the bedside lamp. The room quickly became quiet, with only the occasional distant street sound from outside the window. She gradually fell asleep, filled with anticipation for her new life and contentment with family harmony.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

Yu Xiaowei said she would just take two pineapple buns—there was coffee at the company, so no need to bother.

Her husband said he would take Xuanxuan and Xinxin directly to his mother's house for dinner, telling her not to worry about work, and that he had already packed the children's schoolbags. Yu Xiaowei felt a warmth in her heart.
location: Living room, Block 5, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
