Added the family financial review record from yesterday's car purchase with her husband, printed the meeting agenda with handwritten notes, and drafted a speech outline titled "Face the Gap, Consolidate the Defense." During this period, she only drank water and did not eat lunch.

While eating, she checked the meeting agenda photos on her phone and silently reviewed her speaking points and the data she might be asked about to ensure a complete logic chain.

Yu Xiaowei directly presented the performance charts, honestly faced the gaps, and pointed out that the loss of high-net-worth clients and insufficient conversion of new policies were the main causes, while warning the team to be alert to competitors poaching. She invited Chen Li to share a case in which her client had been tempted by commission rebates, and wrote the key talking points and client characteristics on the whiteboard. Finally, she proposed a defensive plan to be piloted next Monday—the Monthly Return Visit System for High-Net-Worth Clients—and asked team members to think through the implementation details.

name: Practiced tempo runs with Shen Peiwen and made a training plan
description: Yu Xiaowei and Shen Peiwen met at Kwun Tong Promenade, warmed up for 15 minutes, then completed a 6 km tempo run at a pace of about 6:05, alternating leads. While stretching after the run, they jointly worked out a 12-week periodized training plan, including interval runs, tempo runs, easy runs, LSD and yoga practice, and synced the plan to their phone calendars.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, 25 Laguna Street, Kwun Tong Waterfront Garden, waterfront running track

name: After the run, commuted home and took a shower and changed clothes
description: After saying goodbye to Shen Peiwen, Yu Xiaowei took a taxi home, wiping sweat with a wet wipe on the way. Back at her home in Whampoa Garden, she quietly took a shower and washed up, then changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: After taking a shower, Yu Xiaowei had breakfast with her family. Her husband Zhang Weiming had bought back egg tarts, rice rolls and BBQ pork buns from New Shanghai Kitchen. At the table, the children excitedly talked about the afternoon plan to visit the Science Museum, and the family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Flat A, 12/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family went to the supermarket in Whampoa New World to buy travel supplies.
description: After breakfast, the whole family walked to the ParknShop supermarket at Huangpu Xintiandi Mall to buy supplies for their upcoming trip to Macau. Yu Xiaowei picked out a toiletry bag, children's water bottles, biscuits, juice, sunscreen, and more. Her husband Zhang Weiming also bought Pu'er tea leaves and soup ingredients. The children looked at dolls in the toy store.
location: Hong Kong SAR, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Wonderland shopping mall, basement, ParknShop Supermarket

name: At home, packing luggage for the Macau trip and checking the checklist.
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei unpacked the suitcases with her mother and husband, checking the packing list. Her mother checked clothes and medicine, while Yu Xiaowei counted documents and children's essentials. Meanwhile, she also browsed exhibition cases shared in her embroidery friends group.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepared and enjoyed a family lunch with mother
description: While her mother was preparing lunch, Yu Xiaowei helped out, making beef chow fun and oyster sauce lettuce, and heated up egg tarts for the children. Her daughter Xinxin also came to help peel garlic. After a simple family lunch, Yu Xiaowei began getting things ready for the afternoon outing.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the children by MTR to the Hong Kong Science Museum
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into casual clothes and took Xuanxuan and Xinxin from Whampoa Station on the MTR Kwun Tong Line, transferring to the Tsuen Wan Line to Tsim Sha Tsui Station. After exiting the station, she bought pineapple buns and milk tea as supplies.
location: Whampoa Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Tsim Sha Tsui Station, Yau Tsim Mong District.

name: Take her children to visit the Hong Kong Science Museum
description: After entering the Science Museum, Xuanxuan played the building simulation in the Children's Gallery, while Xinxin played with light-and-shadow painting. The family watched the 15:00 high-voltage discharge show, and Xuanxuan was amazed by the lightning effect. Afterward, they tried simulated driving in the Transport Technology Zone. Yu Xiaowei supervised and took photos throughout.
location: Hong Kong Science Museum, 2 Science Museum Road, Tsim Sha Tsui East, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the Star Ferry back to Hung Hom and handing over the children
description: After the visit, Yu Xiaowei walked with the children to Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry Pier and took the ferry to Hung Hom. The children admired the Victoria Harbour view from the side of the boat. After disembarking, they bought ice cream cones and walked back to Whampoa Garden. Downstairs, she handed the children over to her husband Zhang Weiming and prepared to go for a run.
location: Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry Pier, Salisbury Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Hung Hom Ferry Pier, Hung Hom Bay, Kowloon City District, and return to Whampoa Garden

name: Completed a solo easy LSD run
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into her running shoes, set off from Whampoa Garden, ran along the Hung Hom waterfront promenade to the Avenue of Stars and turned back, completing an easy 10-kilometer run at a pace of about 6:30. After the run, she stretched and told Shen Peiwen how it went.
location: Hung Hom Promenade, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden to Avenue of Stars section)

name: Resting after the run and family dinner
description: After her run, Yu Xiaowei went home to shower and change. Dinner that evening was white cut chicken, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato egg drop soup, prepared by her mother and Weiming. At the table, the children excitedly shared what they had seen at the Science Museum, and Yu Xiaowei also talked about the sunset view during her run. Weiming had already packed the large luggage for Macau.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped son with his homework and read picture books to daughter
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei checked Xuanxuan's holiday math homework and corrected two problems. Then she read the picture book 'The Little Seed' to Xinxin, and together they used LEGO to build the garden from the story.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Had a phone call with embroidery friend He Meiling to discuss the online Cantonese embroidery exhibition.
description: Yu Xiaowei received a WeChat voice message from He Meiling, an embroidery friend from Shenzhen, who proposed the idea of holding an online Cantonese embroidery mini-exhibition and invited her to contribute works. Yu Xiaowei shared the progress of her autumn leaf embroidery from her 'Butterfly Dance Series' and suggested adding making-of videos. The two agreed that He Meiling would take the lead, and Yu Xiaowei would submit photos and descriptions of her work within 7 days. The call put her in a good mood.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Get the children washed up and read them a bedtime story
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowei urged Xuanxuan and Xinxin to take a bath, helped Xinxin wash her hair, checked Xuanxuan's backpack, and reminded them about tomorrow's travel items. After the children changed into pajamas, she told two bedtime stories until they fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and children's room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal time: embroidery and relaxation
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei returned to her study, played soothing music, and continued embroidering the autumn leaf piece from the Butterfly Dance Series, feeling at peace. Afterwards, she weighed herself and recorded 54.2 kg in her memo.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Bedtime preparation and mindfulness meditation, then lights out and sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei washed up and did her skincare routine, then confirmed the departure time and alarm for tomorrow with her husband. She put on her sleep headphones and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation to relax her body and mind. Finally, she set the 6 o'clock alarm and turned off the lights at 22:45 to sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run preparation and commute
description: At 5:50 in the morning, the alarm went off. After getting up, Yu Xiaowei drank a large glass of warm water, changed into running gear, and did dynamic warm-ups in the living room. She left at 6:05, walked to Hung Hom Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Kwun Tong Station, then walked to the Kwun Tong Promenade, arriving at the meeting point at 6:43.
location: Kwun Tong Promenade, Hoi Bun Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning LSD long run and chat with running friends
description: Yu Xiaowei met her running buddy Shen Peiwen at the Kwun Tong Promenade. After warming up, they started running at 7:00 and did a 12 km long slow run along the waterfront path at a target pace of 6:40. They kept the rhythm for the first 5 km, chatted while running through the middle 5 km, with Shen Peiwen pouring out her work and marriage-pressure worries, and Yu Xiaowei sharing her experience in balancing things. They sprinted for the final 2 km, and at 8:05 after the run they stretched on the seaside benches and drank iced lemon tea. The two agreed to keep exercising while in Macau.
location: Kwun Tong Promenade, Hoi Bun Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home, take a shower, and prepare breakfast.
description: After saying goodbye to A Wen at 8:10, Yu Xiaowei took a taxi home, about a 12-minute ride. Once home, she went straight to the bathroom to take a shower and changed into loungewear. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had prepared plain congee and snacks. Yu Xiaowei helped set out bowls and chopsticks while drying her hair, praising her mother's cooking.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cozy family breakfast.
description: Around 9:30, her husband Zhang Weiming arrived at the restaurant with their son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin. The family sat together. Yu Xiaowei shared what she had seen and heard during her morning run; Xinxin talked about dreaming of riding a horse-drawn carriage; Weiming reminded the children to pack their luggage. They discussed the next day's Macau itinerary over breakfast in a warm and lively atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Discovered her husband's surprise course.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei was organizing work documents in her study and accidentally found the payment receipt for the "Basic Sports Nutrition Course" that her husband Zhang Weiming had enrolled her in at Kowloon City Community College, dated August 1. When Weiming came in, Yu Xiaowei hugged him emotionally, and Weiming shyly said he wanted to surprise his wife and better support her running hobby in the future.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assisting with housework and brainstorming creative ideas for Cantonese embroidery
description: After calming down, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother wash the vegetables for lunch, then took out her Cantonese embroidery kit, studied the detail photos of the 'Autumn Leaves' piece from the 'Butterfly Dance Series,' and sketched keywords for the creative description in her notebook, preparing for the later communication with He Meiling.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family lunch and discussion of the Macau itinerary
description: For lunch, her mother prepared home-style dishes such as steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce and stir-fried choy sum. During the meal, everyone continued discussing the Macau trip. Yu Xiaowei showed hotel photos on an app, and the children screamed with excitement. She suggested cycling around the Taipa Houses, Weiming agreed, and considered exploring running routes near the hotel.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family joined forces to pack luggage.
description: In the afternoon, the family dragged their suitcases into the living room. Yu Xiaowei checked the ferry tickets, hotel reservations, and documents; Weiming organized electronic devices and miscellaneous items; Xuanxuan packed books and toys; Xinxin insisted on bringing her dolls and picture books. Yu Xiaowei reminded everyone to prepare motion sickness medicine and band-aids, and checked the automatic feeder to make sure there was enough food and water for the cat.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Burning off energy at Kowloon Tsai Park.
description: With luggage basically packed, the whole family drove to Kowloon Tsai Park. Xuanxuan played football on the pitch, Xinxin played on the slide and swing at the playground, while Yu Xiaowei and Weiming sat on a bench chatting, once again talking about the course Weiming had applied for, their eyes full of understanding and contentment.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Purchase travel supplies.
description: Walked from the park to Whampoa New Town shopping mall. Bought seasickness medicine, band-aids, and disinfectant at Watsons; chose snacks at ParknShop. Xuanxuan picked cookies and juice, Xinxin chose strawberry Pocky and milk candy. Weiming bought bread for backup, and called his mother in Kwun Tong to tell her about the travel plan.
location: Wonder World Shopping Centre, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Dinner and final check before departure
description: When they got home, her mother had prepared wonton noodles. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei and Weiming moved the luggage to the door, checked the items once more, and put the ID documents and ferry tickets into their carry-on bags. Together they refilled the automatic feeder with cat food and water, and her mother changed the cat litter.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening parent-child time
description: They took turns bathing the children. Yu Xiaowei bathed Xinxin and sang to her, while Weiming explained boating safety tips to Xuanxuan. After the bath, in the children’s room, Xuanxuan put away his own clothes, and Xinxin pestered her mother into reading two picture books. After the stories, they kissed their foreheads and said goodnight.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple communication and pre-bedtime yoga
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei and Weiming double-checked the next day's departure plan in the living room and took a family photo. Then Yu Xiaowei did a 15-minute pre-bedtime yoga stretch in the living room to relieve soreness from the long run, while Weiming checked the weather in Macau. After stretching, she sent a WeChat message to He Meiling to update her on the progress of the creative concept.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep
description: After washing up, she changed into pajamas, checked that her phone alarm was set for 6:30 the next morning, and confirmed that her ID documents, wallet, and charging devices were all in place. Leaning against the headboard, she flipped through a few pages of 'The Running Bible,' then turned off the light and lay down, falling deeply asleep with anticipation for the Macau trip.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation, breakfast, and departure
description: At 6:00 a.m., Yu Xiaowei was woken by her mobile phone alarm. After quickly washing up, she changed into a light T-shirt and quick-dry pants to prepare for the boat ride. She gently woke her husband, Weiming, and he began checking the suitcase and backpack they had packed the night before. Then Yu Xiaowei gently shook their son, Xuanxuan, and daughter, Xinxin, awake, telling them they were going to take a big boat to see the sea, and the children cheered up. The family had a simple breakfast of milk, bread, and bananas to avoid feeling unwell on the boat on an empty stomach. During this time, Yu Xiaowei gave her spare house key to her mother, Chen Meiling, who had come to help take care of the cat, and reminded her to bring in the clothes in the evening.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take a ferry from Hong Kong to Macau and check into Galaxy Hotel.
description: At 7:00, Weiming drove their family's seven-seater car. Yu Xiaowei sat in the front passenger seat, and the two children in the back seat excitedly discussed swimming and the water slide. About 25 minutes later, they arrived at the parking lot of the Sheung Wan Macau Ferry Terminal. The family took the 7:45 Cotai Water Jet ferry to Taipa Ferry Terminal in Macau. Xiaowei had bought three ferry tickets in advance with a mobile app; Xinxin, who was ticket-free, sat on her lap. During the crossing, Xuanxuan leaned by the window looking at the sea, Xinxin took a nap, and Yu Xiaowei flipped through The Running Bible but also felt a little drowsy from the sea breeze. At 8:15, after arriving at Taipa Ferry Terminal, the family took the free shuttle bus of Galaxy Hotel Macau and reached the hotel in 10 minutes. Xiaowei completed the check-in and received the room card for the family-themed room on the 28th floor. The room had a tent, plush toys, and children's slippers; Xinxin immediately hugged a plush toy and refused to let go.
location: Galaxy Hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run in the hotel garden
description: While her husband was settling the luggage in the room and washing the child's face, Yu Xiaowei changed into her running shoes and went downstairs. She did an easy run of about 3 kilometers in about 25 minutes on the beautiful tropical garden track of the Galaxy Hotel Macau. She recorded the run with her sports watch and sent a photo of the hotel garden morning view to her running partner Shen Peiwen with the caption "First run in Macau, sea breeze on my face!" Shen Peiwen replied with a thumbs-up emoji to encourage her.
location: Outdoor garden running track, Galaxy Macau Hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macau Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family enjoys the hotel's buffet breakfast.
description: After Yu Xiaowei finished her run and quickly showered in the room, the family went to the Qunfang buffet restaurant at the Galaxy Hotel Macau. Yu Xiaowei chose fried eggs, Portuguese sausage, and coffee for herself, temporarily setting aside her fasting plan; the kids helped themselves to cereal and mini egg tarts. Xuanxuan said excitedly, 'Dad, after we eat, let's go on the water slide!' Everyone chatted about the day's plans while eating, in a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere.
location: Café Grande Buffet Restaurant, Galaxy Hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macau Special Administrative Region

name: Returned to the room to freshen up and prepared pool gear.
description: After breakfast, they returned to the family-themed room. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Wei Ming carefully applied waterproof sunscreen to the two children, prepared swimsuits, arm floats, swim rings, and waterproof phone pouches, and checked all the flotation devices to ensure safety. Everyone changed into swimsuits, put on hotel bathrobes, brought their water bottles, and set off lightly for Grand Resort Deck.
location: Family-themed room at Galaxy Macau hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child water park time and poolside lunch
description: The family entered the famous Grand Resort Deck, with sunlight sparkling on the heated pool. Yu Xiaowei took Xinxin to the children's area to splash and learn to float, and Xinxin excitedly kicked her feet; Weiming accompanied Xuanxuan to challenge the rainbow water slide three times, and each time Xuanxuan's screams and laughter could be heard. Yu Xiaowei used her phone at the poolside to capture the happy moments of her husband and children in the water. Around 12:30, the family bought sandwiches and freshly squeezed juice at the poolside and had a simple lunch.
location: Macao Special Administrative Region, Cotai Reclaimed Area, Galaxy Hotel Macau, Grand Resort Deck (children's pool area and water slides)

name: Brief play in the children's playroom
description: Considering the children were still not ready to stop, Yu Xiaowei suggested playing for 15 minutes in the children's playroom on the second floor of the hotel before going back to the room for a nap. Xuanxuan and Xinxin splashed around in the ball pit, while Yu Xiaowei sat on a nearby mat and quickly confirmed the walking route to The Venetian for the afternoon on her phone.
location: Macao Special Administrative Region, Cotai Reclamation Area, Galaxy Hotel Macau, children's playroom

name: Child's midday nap and personal recharge
description: Back in the parent-child themed room, with the air conditioning on and blackout curtains drawn, Xuanxuan and Xinxin quickly fell asleep. Yu Xiaowei did not rest, but sat at a small table by the window, took out her tablet and embroidery notes, and began to organize the final creative description for the “Butterfly Dance Series Autumn Leaves” embroidery. She made the imagery of “golden breeze and jade dew” and the techniques of laying stitch and set stitch clearer, then typed it into a document with a Bluetooth keyboard and sent it to her friend He Meiling. Her husband Weiming sat nearby quietly browsing his phone, planning the next day's route.
location: Family-themed room at Galaxy Macau hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Transitional reading, preparing to go out.
description: The children were still sound asleep. Yu Xiaowei booked a 15:30 wake-up call. She took The Running Bible out of her bag and read two chapters. Her husband Weiming shared what he had found: The Venetian would have an artificial-sky sunset light show at 16:00. Yu Xiaowei began quietly packing the things she needed to bring: a water bottle, wet wipes, snacks, a spare light jacket, and a camera.
location: Family-themed room at Galaxy Macau hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Strolling through The Venetian, encountering a canal performance
description: After the children woke up, the family walked along the hotel corridor for 10 minutes to the third-floor main street and canal area of The Venetian Macao shopping mall. Xinxin looked curiously at the artificial blue sky and streets above. By the canal, a gondolier happened to be singing at the top of his voice. Encouraged, Xinxin improvised a ballet spin from "The Nutcracker" on the open space by the canal, drawing applause and cheers from several tourists. Xuanxuan, on the other hand, was attracted by the bubble show, and her husband Weiming recorded this warm moment with his phone.
location: Third-floor main street and canal area, The Venetian Macao Shopping Mall, Cotai Reclaimed Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Visited Uniqlo and returned to the hotel.
description: After leaving the canal area, passing by UNIQLO (Venetian Macao shopping center), Yu Xiaowei remembered that Xinxin had forgotten her sun-protection top, so she bought Xinxin a cute sun hat and chose a light athletic T-shirt for herself. After paying, the family walked back to Galaxy Hotel Macau; the children were a little tired but still had excited smiles on their faces.
location: Inside the UNIQLO at the Venetian Macao shopping mall in the Cotai reclaimed area of the Macao Special Administrative Region, and along the way back to the Galaxy Hotel Macao.

name: Went back to the room for a short rest.
description: As they passed through the hotel lobby, Yu Xiaowei helped the children take photos with the huge crystal chandelier in the lobby. Back in the kids-themed family room, everyone used the restroom, washed their hands, drank some water, and rested briefly before heading out for dinner.
location: Lobby and parent-child themed room of Galaxy Hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Dinner: Exploring Authentic Macau Cuisine
description: Yu Xiaowei chose to explore Broadway Food Street once again, and this time she walked into "Tim Fat Bowl." She ordered a portion of the signature small-bowl shark fin soup and shrimp roe noodles; Weiming ordered bamboo-pole wonton noodles, and the children split a portion of Hainanese chicken rice. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei went back to the counter to buy two freshly baked Portuguese egg tarts, giving one to Xuanxuan and one to Xinxin. She also took a bite herself and remarked that this was the taste of travel.
location: Macau Special Administrative Region, Cotai Reclamation Area, Galaxy Macau Hotel, Broadway Food Street, Tim Fat Wun Zi Chi.

name: Buying souvenirs and strolling on Cunha Street
description: After dinner, as the lights came on, the family followed the navigation to Rua do Cunha (about a 10-minute walk). The place was full of life, with the aroma of beef offal and almond cookies in the air. Yu Xiaowei bought a box of traditional almond cookies for her mother, Weiming bought a few jars of water crab congee sauce, and Xuanxuan and Xinxin each picked out an egg tart fridge magnet.
location: Cunha Street, Carmo Parish, Macao Special Administrative Region.

name: Bathe the children and put them to bed.
description: Back in the family-themed room at the Galaxy Hotel Macau, Yu Xiaowei and her husband quickly bathed the children. After the bath, Yu Xiaowei told them the story of a gondolier and read a picture book they had brought. The children soon fell asleep, excited and exhausted.
location: Family-themed room at Galaxy Macau hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Arrange the next day's matters
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei quietly confirmed the next day's schedule with her husband. She called room service and booked breakfast delivery for 8:00 the next morning (two Western set meals and two Chinese congee set meals), and asked her husband to check the procedures for checkout or luggage storage the next morning. Yu Xiaowei noted all of this in her phone memo.
location: Family-themed room at Galaxy Macau hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Night talk on the balcony, planning a future trip to Japan
description: After the children were fast asleep, Yu Xiaowei and her husband carried two cups of hot water onto the balcony outside the room. The night view of Cotai sparkled like a river of stars. Yu Xiaowei talked about the adorable moment of Xinxin doing ballet, while Weiming praised Xuanxuan for being braver on the water slide than last time. The conversation naturally turned to their son’s dream of Japan. Yu Xiaowei said seriously, “I want to try applying for the Tokyo Marathon next year. The whole family can go and have fun together. You can plan the trip and learn a few phrases of Japanese, how about it?” Weiming smiled and agreed. The two chatted softly in the night breeze, full of anticipation for their future family trip.
location: Balcony of the family-themed room at Galaxy Macau, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region.

name: Pre-sleep stretching and going to bed.
description: After the heart-to-heart talk on the balcony ended, Yu Xiaowei did a simple 10-minute yoga stretch by the bed, focusing on relaxing her calves, shoulders, and back, which were a bit sore from today's walking and playing in the water. At 23:10, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell into a deep sleep amid the quiet of the Macau night.
location: Family-themed room at Galaxy Macau hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Morning Wake-up and Fasting Record
description: At 7 a.m., sunlight streamed through the gap in the curtains into the room. Yu Xiaowei woke up and saw her family sleeping soundly, feeling warm and content. She got up quietly, first drank a glass of warm water to ease her hunger, then recorded her physical sensations on the first day of fasting in her phone memo: her mental state was good, she was slightly hungry after 13 hours without food but it was bearable, and her weight was to be measured.
location: Galaxy Suite, Galaxy Hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macau Special Administrative Region, China

name: Family morning activities
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into sportswear and went for a 20-minute walk in the hotel garden, breathing fresh air. Around 8 o'clock she returned to the room; the children woke up one after another. She played little games with them on the bed, and the room filled with laughter. Afterwards she helped her daughter tie her hair, while her husband Zhang Weiming helped their son find clothes.
location: Rooms and landscaped gardens of Galaxy Hotel, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Family Schedule Meeting
description: The family gathered in the room. Yu Xiaowei used the notes app on her phone to announce the day's plan, emphasizing the rule that they could not eat until after 10 o'clock. She told her son they would go to the Grand Prix Museum again in the afternoon. The boy jumped up excitedly, and her daughter clapped along.
location: Room at Galaxy Hotel Macao, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Getting ready and heading out.
description: Yu Xiaowei and Weiming packed their backpacks, bringing water bottles, sunscreen, wet wipes, and snacks for the kids. She set an 18:00 alarm to remind herself that the eating window would close. At exactly 10 o'clock, the family of four came to the hotel lobby with their luggage, ready to set off.
location: Galaxy Hotel, Cotai, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Café brunch
description: Eating window opened; the family enjoyed brunch at the hotel lobby lounge. Yu Xiaowei ordered a tropical fruit platter and sugar-free iced latte as her first meal after the fast, reminding herself to chew slowly. Her husband and children had croissants and milk.
location: Galaxy Macau Lobby Lounge, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macau Special Administrative Region, China

name: Taking the shuttle bus to the Macau Peninsula.
description: The family took the hotel's complimentary shuttle bus from outside the Diamond Lobby to the New Road area on the Macau Peninsula, about a 15-minute ride. The bus was well air-conditioned; the children pressed against the windows to look at the Portuguese-style buildings, while Yu Xiaowei rested her head on Weiming's shoulder.
location: Shuttle bus from Galaxy Macau Hotel in the Cotai reclaimed area, Macau Special Administrative Region, China, to Avenida de Almeida Ribeiro, Macau Peninsula.

name: Visited the Ruins of St. Paul's
description: The family walked to the Ruins of St. Paul's and took photos; Yu Xiaowei explained the statues and history on the facade to her son. Afterward, they walked through the adjacent Love Lane to experience the romantic atmosphere.
location: Ruins of St. Paul's, Rua de São Paulo, Cathedral Parish, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Lunch on Cunha Street
description: The family took a taxi to Rua do Cunha in Taipa to sample local snacks. At Tai Lei Loi Kei, they bought a pork chop bun, and also bought water crab congee and Portuguese egg tarts. Yu Xiaowei and Weiming shared a pork chop bun, keeping lunch within the eating window.
location: Rua da Cunha, Carmo Parish, Macau Special Administrative Region, China

name: Returned to the hotel for an afternoon rest
description: After lunch, they took a taxi back to the hotel to rest. Yu Xiaowei wiped the children's faces and hands, coaxed them to take a nap, and she and Weiming closed their eyes and rested for half an hour. She edited a text entry recording her fasting and brunch experience, added photos, and set it to private.
location: Room at Galaxy Hotel Macao, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Grand Prix Museum experience
description: Yu Xiaowei walked with her son Zhang Zixuan to the Grand Prix Museum. Her son went straight to the simulation driving area, sat in the ultimate simulator, chose an F4 race car, and sped around the virtual Guia Circuit while Yu Xiaowei recorded everything. She herself admired legendary race cars from various eras in the museum.
location: Macau Grand Prix Museum, No. 431 Rua de Gomes, Sé Parish, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Parent-child time in the museum's cultural and creative zone
description: While her son was focused on the racing cars, Yu Xiaowei took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the museum's cultural and creative merchandise area. Her daughter used colored pens to draw the Venice canal and a racing car on drawing paper, with Yu Xiaowei accompanying and guiding her.
location: Cultural and Creative Zone, Macau Grand Prix Museum, 431 Gaomeishi Street, Cathedral Parish, Macau Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening walk and dinner
description: From the museum, they strolled back to the hotel along the streets, admiring the Portuguese-style architecture in the sunset. Before the eating window closed, the family had dinner at the hotel's garden restaurant. Yu Xiaowei ordered a garden salad and Portuguese chicken rice, strictly adhering to her rule of no eating after 6 p.m.
location: Courtyard restaurant at Galaxy Macau hotel resort, Cotai, Macao Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Family free time in the evening.
description: After dinner, the children played in the garden beside the Grand Resort Deck. Yu Xiaowei and Wei Ming sat on a bench chatting, discussing whether to try the water park the next day. Afterward, they returned to the room to bathe the children and change them into pajamas.
location: The area around and rooms of the Grand Resort Deck, Galaxy Hotel Macau, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macau Special Administrative Region, China

name: Parent-child bonding time
description: A family of four sat together on the bed. Yu Xiaowei read the picture book "The Very Hungry Caterpillar" to her daughter, and her son shared his racing video from the simulator and narrated it excitedly. Yu Xiaowei kissed her son and praised him for driving so well.
location: Room at Galaxy Hotel Macao, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Light workout at the gym
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei went alone to the hotel fitness center. She power-walked on the treadmill for 30 minutes, keeping her heart rate around 130, then did 15 minutes of static stretching on a yoga mat, focusing on the thighs and calves.
location: Galaxy Macau Hotel Fitness Center, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macau Special Administrative Region, China

name: Bathing and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After taking a hot shower, Yu Xiaowei did bedtime yoga poses such as Child's Pose and Legs-Up-the-Wall Pose. After Weiming finished his shower, the two of them enjoyed the evening breeze on the balcony, chatting about the children's funny moments and how the first day of fasting felt.
location: Macau Special Administrative Region, China, Cotai reclaimed area, Galaxy Macau hotel room and bathroom.

name: 2025-12-15 07:50:00 to 2025-12-15 08:10:00
description: Yu Xiaowei wrote in her phone memo in detail that the first day of the fasting challenge was a success. Though she felt hungry, she got through it by drinking water and adjusting the order of eating. She looked forward to tomorrow’s weight and planned to go to The Venetian tomorrow for a gondola ride and to Fisherman’s Wharf. After recording this, she and Weiming said goodnight to each other, and she turned off the lights and went to bed before 23:00.
location: Room at Galaxy Hotel Macao, Cotai Reclamation Area, Macao Special Administrative Region, China

name: Morning preparation and family division of labor.
description: After getting up early in the morning, Yu Xiaowei did a gentle morning vinyasa flow yoga in her room at Galaxy Hotel Macau. After waking up her body, she booked ferry tickets for the 3 pm Cotai Water Jet from Taipa Ferry Terminal to the Hong Kong-Macau Ferry Terminal, and reserved an 11:30 am gondola ride on The Venetian's official website. She then woke up her family and explained the final itinerary for the day to her husband Zhang Weiming and the children: Dad would take their son to the Grand Resort Deck to play in the water, she would accompany her daughter to a balloon twisting craft class, and after checking out at noon they would all go to The Venetian for a gondola ride and shopping. The whole family agreed with the plan. At breakfast time, Zhang Weiming took his son to the buffet restaurant, while Yu Xiaowei stayed in the room to make milk for her daughter. Following her fasting window, she drank only water, then helped her daughter change into a swimsuit and changed into sportswear herself.
location: Inside a room at Galaxy Hotel, Cotai, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child craft class: balloon twisting.
description: After Zhang Weiming took their son to the Grand Resort Deck, Yu Xiaowei took their daughter Zhang Yuxin by the hand to the children's craft workshop on the 3rd floor of Galaxy Hotel Macau. Under the guidance of a young female teacher wearing a cartoon apron, Zhang Yuxin excitedly learned to twist a puppy out of a long pink balloon. Yu Xiaowei accompanied her patiently throughout, helping her daughter hold the balloon and watching her carefully turn and tie knots. In the end, a lopsided but utterly adorable pink balloon puppy was completed. Her daughter proudly showed off her work, and Yu Xiaowei captured the heartwarming moment with her phone.
location: Macau Special Administrative Region, Cotai Reclaimed Area, Galaxy Macau Hotel, 3rd Floor, Children's Craft Workshop

name: Time at the Grand Resort Deck Water Park
description: Yu Xiaowei brought her daughter and her balloon dog to Tianlang Taoyuan to meet up with her husband and son. The daughter played in the shallow water while Yu Xiaowei sat on a poolside lounge chair watching the children. Zhang Weiming came over from time to time to share funny stories about their son playing in the water. During this time, Yu Xiaowei got up to hand the children water and apply sunscreen, telling them to be careful, while she herself enjoyed a moment of leisure. Approaching noon, the children reluctantly left the pool and the whole family returned to their room.
location: Grand Resort Deck, Galaxy Hotel Macau, Cotai Reclaimed Area, Macau Special Administrative Region

name: Checkout and luggage packing
description: After the whole family returned to the room, they quickly showered and changed. Zhang Weiming checked every corner to make sure nothing was left behind; Yu Xiaowei packed the children's wet swimsuits and towels into waterproof bags, then went to the front desk to check out. Everything went smoothly. After storing their luggage, the family prepared to set off for the next stop.
location: Inside a room at Galaxy Hotel, Cotai, Macao Special Administrative Region

name: Take a taxi to The Venetian and go shopping.
description: The family took a taxi from Galaxy Macau Hotel to the Venetian Macao shopping mall, about an 8-minute ride. Upon arrival, the children were immediately attracted by the mall's "blue sky and white clouds" dome and canal. Yu Xiaowei went straight to Koi Kei Bakery to buy almond biscuits and egg rolls as souvenirs, then quickly picked out a purple quick-dry T-shirt at Uniqlo. Zhang Weiming bought a pork chop bun as an afternoon tea snack for the ride back.
location: Macao Special Administrative Region, Cotai reclaimed area, Estrada da Baía de Nossa Senhora da Esperança, The Venetian Macao shopping mall

name: The Venetian gondola ride experience
description: With the reservation code, the whole family boarded at the gondola pier. After putting on life jackets, the children excitedly got on the boat. The boatman was a handsome Italian man who sang "The Moon Represents My Heart" in Chinese while rowing. The whole family hummed along, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming smiled at each other, and they took many photos and videos, leaving beautiful memories of this Macau trip.
location: Macao Special Administrative Region, Cotai Reclaimed Area, Estrada da Baía de Nossa Senhora da Esperança, The Venetian Macao Shopping Mall Gondola Dock

name: Trip from Macau back to Hong Kong
description: After disembarking, the family took a short rest and then took a taxi to Taipa Ferry Terminal, about a 13-minute drive. Upon arriving at the terminal, they smoothly collected tickets, went through customs, and boarded the ferry. The 15:00 Cotai Water Jet ferry departed on time, and the children, tired from playing, soon fell asleep in Yu Xiaowei's arms. Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming chatted softly about the trip over the past few days, and she took a moment to send a WeChat message to her friend Shen Peiwen, informing her of the return and arranging a morning run the next day. The ferry arrived on time at the Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal at 16:00.
location: Macao Taipa Ferry Terminal, Our Lady of Carmel Parish, Macao Special Administrative Region to Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Arriving home for family reunion and dinner
description: After arriving at the Hong Kong-Macau Ferry Terminal, Zhang Weiming went to pick up the car, while Yu Xiaowei waited with the children at the exit. About 20 minutes later, the family drove back to Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District and arrived home around 16:30. Her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared green radish and carrot pork bone soup to welcome them. The whole family washed their hands and sat down to eat. Yu Xiaowei enjoyed a light dinner, including hot soup, stir-fried choy sum, and steamed grass carp, strictly adhering to the 16:8 fasting window. Her son excitedly told his grandmother about riding the gondola, and the home was filled with a warm atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pack luggage and rest
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei began putting things from her suitcase back in their places one by one: she sorted the dirty clothes and put them in the washing machine, categorized the souvenirs, and took out her running gear and shoes for the next morning's run in advance. Zhang Weiming was in charge of looking after the two children. Yu Xiaowei rested briefly, drank some water, and sat quietly on the sofa for a moment to regain her energy.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family time and social connections
description: Yu Xiaowei replied in detail to her friend Shen Peiwen on WeChat, sharing her fasting experience over the past two days, and agreed to go for a run together at 7 a.m. the next morning at Kowloon Bay Waterfront Park. Afterwards, she watched half an hour of cartoons with the children, then took out the sticker book she had brought back from Macau and applied stickers together with her daughter, while her son played with LEGO beside them. The whole family was immersed in a relaxed and happy atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Art creation and health records
description: While Zhang Weiming was bathing the children, Yu Xiaowei returned to the master bedroom, opened WeChat, and found the chat history with her Cantonese embroidery teacher He Meiling. She combined the Macau Portuguese blue-and-white tile pattern with the sense of speed from the Grand Prix Museum, sketched abstract waves and racing car streamline trajectories in a sketchbook, took a photo, added a text explanation, and sent it to her teacher. After that, she recorded today's weight as 54.4 kg and was satisfied with the results of her fasting.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child bedtime moments.
description: After the children bathed and changed into pajamas, Yu Xiaowei read them the newly bought picture book “Riding the Pirate Ship with Dad”. Then the whole family did a 15-minute body stretch, and Yu Xiaowei taught the children simple yoga moves. At 22:00, the children fell asleep peacefully with goodnight kisses. Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming said goodnight to each other; he returned to the study to attend to matters, while Yu Xiaowei washed up, lay in bed, reviewed the fulfilling day, and looked forward to the next day’s recovery training. At 22:30, she turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting up and waking the body
description: The phone alarm rang, and Yu Xiaowei turned over and got up. She opened the curtains to check outside; the sky was gloomy and heavy rain was forecast. Stepping on the scale, it showed 54.2 kg, a little lighter than last night — the fasting was beginning to show results. She did a few minutes of simple stretching in bed to wake up her body, and drank the first glass of warm water.
location: Master bedroom, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run and group training (adjusted plan)
description: Due to the weather, Yu Xiaowei canceled the plan to practice with Shen Peiwen at Kowloon Bay Waterfront Park, and instead ran alone along the Whampoa Garden waterfront promenade in Kowloon City District. Before leaving, she sent Shen Peiwen a voice message explaining: “It's raining, I've switched to running along the Whampoa promenade, you don't need to come over.” She then completed a 5 km recovery run at a pace of 6:20. The air was fresh in the drizzle. After the run, she stretched on a bench, took a screenshot of her running data and shared it in the group chat, with the note: “Changed to run along the promenade today, feeling good, let's encourage each other.”
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Waterfront Promenade

name: Freshening up and taking my son to school
description: After returning home, her husband Zhang Weiming had already prepared a simple breakfast for the children. Yu Xiaowei quickly took a shower, changed into her suit, and ate two soda crackers to prepare for fasting. At 7:40, she drove with her husband to take their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. The road was congested, and Yu Xiaowei reminded her son to remember to go to the tutoring class after school.
location: From Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, 2 Oxford Road, Kowloon Tong

name: Catching up on backlogged work during commute
description: After sending her son off, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Kowloon Tong Station to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she opened her phone's email to deal with backlogged work, focusing on replying to client Chen Meiling's inquiry about policy renewal and confirming the deduction details. She browsed the claim files handed over by colleague Su Lishan and initially judged the documents to be complete. On WhatsApp, she left a message for client Wang Qiming: 'Mr. Wang, I'm doing the final check on the proposal you need before the weekend. I'll send you the draft for your review before I leave work this afternoon.'
location: MTR Kowloon Tong Station to Wan Chai Station, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai

name: Team morning meeting and customer follow-up visits
description: Attended the team morning meeting. Her supervisor Liang Zhenhua (Brother Hua) emphasized the importance of focusing on local Hong Kong clients and reminded her to revisit old customers more often. After the meeting, Yu Xiaowei called Su Lishan to confirm claim details, then sorted out five long-standing local Hong Kong clients, called each of them to follow up, and recorded their needs. During this period, feeling hungry from fasting, she took out sugar-free milk tea and worked while drinking it, combating the empty stomach with sweetness and focus.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai, 138 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, 15th floor meeting room and personal workstation

name: Midday rest and distraction
description: During the lunch break, colleagues went out to eat, but Yu Xiaowei stayed alone in the break room, browsing Cantonese embroidery tutorial videos on her phone. She then opened her photo album and sent a sketch from her Macau trip idea—a fusion of Portuguese blue-and-white tiles and racing elements—to her Cantonese embroidery teacher He Meiling, with a message asking for advice. Afterwards, she went downstairs to the convenience store at Convention Plaza to buy unsweetened green tea, then walked around the building for 15 minutes, listening to the rain and taking deep breaths to calm herself down.
location: Pantry, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong SAR; convenience store, Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai

name: High-intensity work in the afternoon.
description: The afternoon was prime time for paperwork. Yu Xiaowei focused on completing the first draft of Wang Qiming's cross-border group insurance proposal, focusing on the differences in claims rules between Mainland China and Hong Kong. Afterward she entered the morning's claims information into the company system and printed a paper handover checklist. At 16:30 she proactively called back two local clients to confirm next week's phone follow-up times, ensuring that she completed her supervisor's requirements. At 17:00 she sent the draft proposal to Wang Qiming and left a message asking for his feedback.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai, 138 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, personal workstation

name: After-work commute and family shopping
description: Left work on time and used spare moments during the commute to review the plan details. After arriving at Whampoa Station, she stopped by the ParknShop supermarket in Whampoa New World shopping mall to buy fresh vegetables, fruit, and the cheese her son loves, restocking the family's supplies. Although she was fasting, she bought groceries for the family. After shopping, she walked home.
location: MTR Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station, ParknShop at Whampoa Xintiandi Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family dinner time
description: Family dinner, and on the table was mother's lotus root and pork rib soup. Yu Xiaowei poured herself a large glass of warm water, sat on the rattan chair on the balcony, put on earphones to listen to instrumental music, and took deep breaths to distract herself from food cravings. After her husband and children finished eating, she returned to the living room and cleared the dishes with her mother, then accompanied her daughter Xinxin to look at her drawings and listened to her funny stories about twisting balloons at kindergarten.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Documentary Night
description: The whole family watched Planet Earth in the living room. Her son Zhang Zixuan excitedly asked questions about deep-sea hydrothermal vent creatures, and her daughter Xinxin was captivated by the fluffy baby emperor penguins. Yu Xiaowei explained things while drinking water, immersed in the warmth of the family, and her hunger subsided.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal relaxation and preparation for the next day
description: After the documentary ended, she urged the children to take a shower and go to bed. Yu Xiaowei spread her yoga mat on the master bedroom floor and did 20 minutes of gentle yoga stretching to relax her muscles and calm her mind. After washing up, she briefly talked with her husband about the next day's arrangements. She opened her notebook to confirm the important tasks for tomorrow: following up on Wang Qiming's feedback on the proposal and arranging communication with Teacher He Meiling about the embroidery pieces.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:00, I turned off the lights and lay down on time. Although the hunger from a day of fasting was real, my heart felt full. The planned morning exercise, work, and family activities were all completed as expected. Yu Xiaowei said to herself: Day two of the fast passed smoothly. She took a deep breath and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and family breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 5:55 in the morning, finished abdominal breathing in bed, then changed into yoga clothes and did a 20-minute gentle flow yoga session in the bedroom, focusing on breathing and stretching and avoiding core poses to get through the hunger period smoothly. Afterward, went to the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast, chopping scallions, setting out bowls and chopsticks, toasting whole wheat bread, and preparing warm lemon water for herself. After her husband Weiming and the children got up one after another, she poured milk for them and distributed breakfast. Then she sat at the dining table drinking water, chatting with her family about Xuanxuan's after-school tutoring and Xinxin's painting class plans.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate (Block 3), Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Dropping off her son at school and commuting on the MTR
description: At 7:20, she changed into her business suit and walked with her son Xuanxuan to MTR Whampoa Station to take the Kwun Tong Line. On the train, Xuanxuan shared about the school science experiment. At 8:00, they arrived at Kowloon Tong Station, and she walked him to the school gate, reminding him to listen carefully in class. She then continued on the MTR, transferring to the Tsuen Wan Line and the Island Line to Wan Chai. On the way, she read the article "Light and Shadow Treatment in Cantonese Embroidery" on her phone, thinking about how to combine the rhythmic lines of Portuguese blue-and-white tiles with the sense of speed in running to find inspiration for a creative description.
location: Hong Kong SAR, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (12 Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong) to MTR Kowloon Tong Station, then to MTR Wan Chai Station, finally arriving at AIA Building.

name: Arrival at the office and team morning meeting
description: At 8:40, she stepped out of Wan Chai Station and arrived at AIA Tower. In the elevator, she talked with colleague Su Lishan about their fasting experience. After reaching her desk, she drank warm water and browsed emails. At 9:00, she attended the department morning meeting. Her supervisor Liang Zhenhua emphasized the importance of maintaining relationships with local high-net-worth clients and shared insights from client visits. Yu Xiaowei made a note: schedule visits with local clients next week. After the meeting she exchanged fasting experiences with Su Lishan.
location: AIA Insurance office, 12th Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing the client list and handling miscellaneous chores.
description: Selected 5 high-net-worth clients in Hong Kong, including Chen Zhiqiang, whose policy needed review, and Li Wanyi, who was planning overseas education funds for her children. She wrote the key requirements and appointment dates on sticky notes and stuck them to the screen bezel. Then she handled client email inquiries about claims, confirmed the weekend report format, and sent a message in the running group inviting colleagues to join the evening easy run.
location: AIA Insurance office, 12th Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break alone and recharging
description: During the lunch break, she politely declined a colleague's invitation to dine together and went alone to Harbour Road Park in Wan Chai. After buying unsweetened oolong tea at a convenience store, she sat on a bench in the shade. She put on earphones to watch a Cantonese embroidery tutorial video, learning the technique of using the rolling needle stitch to express the light and shadow layers of petals. She spent a refreshing time in the quiet, and the feeling of hunger was replaced by calm.
location: 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Harbour Road Park beside Convention Plaza)

name: Afternoon business work: plan adjustments and client follow-up.
description: According to client Wang Qiming's email request, I fine-tuned the outpatient surgery reimbursement and Asian private hospital coverage clauses in the high-end medical insurance plan and resent it. I helped client Chen Meiling with online banking instructions for renewal payment and left a message to inform her. Then I called Mrs. Li Wanyi to arrange a meeting next Wednesday at a cafe for a policy review, and contacted Mr. Chen Zhiqiang's secretary to schedule a visit next Friday to his office in Central. I marked these as completed on the client list.
location: AIA Insurance office, 12th Floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-run preparation and company running group activity
description: At 4:30 p.m., she changed into running gear in the locker room, drank plenty of warm water in the pantry, sent a message in the running group chat, then walked with colleagues including Su Lishan to Wan Chai Harbourfront Park. After warming up, they jogged 5 kilometers along the promenade toward Golden Bauhinia Square at a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, chatting about fasting and exercise sensations while running. After the run, they stretched together by the railing, feeling light and clear.
location: Wan Chai Waterfront Park, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (140 meters northwest of the intersection of Convention Avenue and Tonnochy Road) and the Golden Bauhinia Square waterfront promenade

name: After-work commute and supermarket shopping
description: After running, she returned to the company to shower and change into casual clothes, left AIA Building at 18:50, and took the MTR home. After getting off at Whampoa Station, she went to ParknShop (Silver Bamboo Court, Whampoa Garden) to buy organic blueberries, cherry tomatoes, ready-to-eat chicken breast, and non-fat Greek yogurt for the next day's refeeding. At 19:30, she returned home carrying shopping bags.
location: From AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to MTR Wan Chai Station, then to MTR Whampoa Station, and finally to ParknShop (Whampoa Garden Silver Bamboo Court Branch), Kowloon City District, and Whampoa Garden Residential Estate

name: Warm family dinner
description: When she got home, the family was already seated. Her mother Chen Meiling had made steamed grass carp, garlic choy sum, and tomato and egg drop soup. Yu Xiaowei poured lemon water and sat down with them, listening to her husband Weiming share the news of landing a big project, watching her son Xuanxuan show off his 98-point math quiz, and her daughter Xinxin sing a newly learned nursery rhyme. The family enjoyed a warm, lively dinner together.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with homework and parent-child reading together.
description: After dinner, she first helped her son Xuanxuan with math homework, using Lego bricks as an analogy to explain word problems about fractions and decimals, helping him overcome the difficult points. Then she told her daughter Xinxin the story of the little chick going to see the sea from the "Different Carmela" series. Xinxin was completely absorbed, and they enjoyed the warm parent-child time.
location: Children's room and living room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and self-review.
description: After the children fell asleep, she did 10 minutes of gentle yoga stretching in the bedroom to relax her legs. Then she replied to her best friend Lin Jiaxin's WeChat asking about her fasting experience, sent a photo of lemon water, and made a plan to have yum cha after breaking the fast. She jotted down a fasting diary in her phone's memo app, concluding that hunger could be diverted by fulfilling activities and that her body felt light. Finally, she looked at the Cantonese embroidery design sketches and envisioned a new line design that incorporated the dynamism of running.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: At 22:15, her husband Weiming came in from the study. Yu Xiaowei shared with him the joy of a perfectly completed day and received his praise for her perseverance. Then she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and reminded her husband to have the children prepare their swimsuits. At 22:30, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully in the faint light from the window and the sound of her husband's breathing.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation and wake-up yoga
description: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowei naturally woke up, weighed herself at 53.8 kg, and drank warm water to wake up her body. Then she spread out her yoga mat in the living room and practiced vinyasa flow yoga, stretching her legs and back to prepare for a long run, feeling her body light and energetic.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and pre-workout preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei prepared millet porridge and whole wheat toast in the kitchen, and discussed the day's schedule with her husband Zhang Weiming: she would go for a 15 km run, he would take the children to watch the ballet rehearsal, and afterwards they would meet at the swimming pool for a picnic. During breakfast, her daughter Xinxin showed off a new ballet move, and her husband confirmed the community arts center address and the picnic supplies. After drinking half a bowl of porridge, Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, changed into a fluorescent green running T-shirt and compression shorts, put on a heart rate monitor, prepared sports drinks and energy gels, and used her camera to take photos of the Cantonese embroidery work.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Light jog to the training venue as a warm-up
description: Yu Xiaowei left home briskly and jogged to Kowloon Tsai Park as a pre-run warm-up. The sun was dazzling; the whole distance was about 2 kilometers and took about 15 minutes.
location: Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, along the route from Whampoa Garden to Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Completed a 15-kilometer long-distance training session alone
description: Yu Xiaowei started a 15-kilometer training run on the jogging trail at Kowloon Tsai Park at a pace of 6:35 per kilometer and a heart rate of 145. At the 7th kilometer, she felt tired, stopped to drink water and eat an energy gel, and a thought of self-doubt crossed her mind, but she gritted her teeth and completed the entire distance. After the run, she stretched in the shade for 15 minutes.
location: Jogging Trail, Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Post-run recovery and fun family pool time
description: After stretching, Yu Xiaowei bought an iced Pocari Sweat at the park convenience store to replenish electrolytes, then walked 5 minutes to the entrance of Kowloon Tsai Swimming Pool to meet her family. Her husband had prepared chicken sandwiches, cantaloupe, and strawberries. She held the child and shared her running experience. Xuanxuan and Xinxin played in the children's pool, and she joined the water fight while her husband took photos. During this time, Yu Xiaowei took a short nap due to fatigue, dreamed of the race track, and after waking up and watching the children play, felt some self-doubt inside.
location: Swimming pool, Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pack up, go home, and put the kids down for a nap
description: The family packed up the picnic mat and belongings and walked back to their home at Whampoa Garden. On the way, Xuanxuan fell asleep in the stroller, and Xinxin also dozed off. After getting home, the couple divided the tasks of showering the two children, changing them into pajamas, and putting them down for a nap. Yu Xiaowei drew the curtains and, taking advantage of the quiet, sat at the computer to prepare for work.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Submit the Cantonese embroidery work and creative statement.
description: In her study, Yu Xiaowei imported the photos of her embroidery piece “Autumn Leaves from the Butterfly Dance Series” into her computer, fine-tuned the brightness and contrast with software, wrote a creative description of about 300 characters describing the composition and needlework of ginkgo leaves dancing with butterflies, and sent it by email to Teacher He Meiling, leaving a WeChat message as well.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Discussed the afternoon shopping arrangements with her husband
description: While the children napped, Yu Xiaowei discussed the afternoon plans with her husband, Zhang Weiming. They decided he would stay home with the children while she went alone to the supermarket to buy ingredients for tomorrow's breakfast and invitation cards for Xuanxuan's birthday party. Her husband suggested buying salmon to make a dinner salad.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went shopping at ParknShop
description: Yu Xiaowei walked 5 minutes to the B1 floor of Whampoa New World shopping mall's ParknShop supermarket. She selected organic eggs, whole wheat bread, yogurt, and bananas, chose a set of dinosaur-themed birthday invitation cards in the stationery section, and also bought colored pens and stickers.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, B1 floor, Whampoa Wonderland shopping mall, ParknShop supermarket

name: Returning home to rest and chatting with mother
description: When she got home, the children were already awake and watching cartoons. Her mother, Chen Meiling, brought over pear and lean pork soup, and Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother while drinking it. Afterward, she sorted the items she had bought and showed the invitation card to Xuanxuan, who was very happy.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handwrite birthday party invitation cards.
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the study, confirmed that Teacher He Meiling had replied, saying the work was wonderful, and put the embroidery into a dust bag. Then she began handwriting invitation cards for Xuanxuan's birthday party, neatly writing down the names of friends and classmates, and making a list of parents who needed to be notified.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Rest and prepare to go out for dessert
description: Her husband suggested the family go to Jiajia Sweet Soup Shop for dessert and discuss Xuanxuan's birthday party. Yu Xiaowei happily agreed. After tidying up briefly, they changed the children into clean clothes and got ready to go out.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family enjoys sweet soup and plans a birthday party.
description: The family of four walked 12 minutes to Jiajia Sweet Soup Shop and ordered black sesame paste, mango pomelo sago, and ginger soup dumplings. Her husband ordered ginger soup dumplings for her to warm her stomach. While eating dessert, they discussed the arrangements for Xuanxuan's 10th birthday party and decided to hold it next Saturday evening at McDonald's near Whampoa New Landmark, inviting good friends and fellow runner Shen Peiwen's family.
location: Jia Jia Sweet Soup Shop, No. 6 Whampoa Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Walking home in the night
description: Walking home from the sweet soup shop, the night is gentle. The children walk ahead holding hands, while the couple shares amusing stories behind them. Yu Xiaowei feels relaxed because of the family warmth, and the self-doubt from the morning vanishes.
location: Along the way from Whampoa Street to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped the children wash up and read picture books to them
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei helped the children wash up, read two dinosaur picture books to Xinxin, while Xuanxuan looked at the invitation card by himself and went to bed obediently when urged by her husband.
location: Children's room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime stretching and relaxation, plus writing in her diary.
description: After the child fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei did a 15-minute bedtime stretch in the bedroom to relax her legs, then took out her diary to record the day's training and family warmth, writing, "Though tired, surrounded by love, everything is worth it."
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Fell asleep after chatting with her husband.
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off the light, chatted softly with her husband about what to have for breakfast tomorrow, and then fell asleep fulfilled and content.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up, family preparation, and commute to the convention center
description: Woke up at 6:30 a.m., did abdominal breathing and mental stretching, performed morning eye yoga, washed up, and changed into loungewear. Said good morning to her husband Mingzai, daughter Xinxin, and son Xuanxuan, and helped Mingzai check the children's belongings. Drank a large glass of water on an empty stomach. Mingzai got ready to take Xinxin to the art studio, while Xiaowei and Xuanxuan prepared for the anime convention, changing into casual clothes and bringing crossbody bags. Left at 7:50, walked to Whampoa Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Yau Ma Tei, then transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Wan Chai Station. Along the way, Xuanxuan excitedly shared his anime convention plan, and Xiaowei browsed the venue map on her phone. Arrived at the Wan Chai Convention and Exhibition Centre around 8:30.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District; MTR: Kwun Tong Line from Whampoa Station to Yau Ma Tei Station, transfer to Tsuen Wan Line to Wan Chai Station; Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai District

name: Explore the Hong Kong Anime-Comic-Game Festival
description: Arrived at the convention and exhibition center, bought tickets, and entered. Xuanxuan was extremely excited and dragged Xiaowei around the robot model zone, the popular game trial-play area, and anime merchandise shops. Xuanxuan used his pocket money to buy a box of Gundam model kits. At the creative bazaar, Xiaowei found a stall incorporating Cantonese embroidery styles, bought a phone strap and badges as inspiration references, and chatted with the stall owner for half an hour about craft techniques. She spent the whole morning immersed in the lively atmosphere of the anime festival.
location: Exhibition Hall, Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, 1 Expo Drive, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return trip and family lunch
description: After the exhibition visit, Xiaowei took Xuanxuan back to Whampoa Garden by metro. On the way back, Xuanxuan flipped through the exhibition commemorative booklet while Xiaowei browsed the photos she had taken of the Cantonese embroidery works. When they got home, Mingzai and Xinxin had already returned, and Xinxin showed off her painting. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had prepared a light lunch: boiled shrimp, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg drop soup. Because Xiaowei was fasting, she only ate a small amount of vegetables and a bowl of soup. The lunch atmosphere was relaxed. Xuanxuan told the family about his experiences at the anime convention, and Xiaowei shared the Cantonese embroidery accessories. After the meal, Xiaowei took the initiative to clean up the dishes and chopsticks.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing the wardrobe and discovering a surprise receipt.
description: After lunch, Xiaowei returned to the master bedroom to organize the wardrobe and dressing table drawers. She folded summer clothes and stored the Macau souvenirs. While tidying the drawer for Ming's documents, she found a kraft paper envelope containing a receipt for enrollment in a nutrition course from the Hong Kong Nutrition Society dated August 1. It suddenly dawned on her that her husband had been quietly learning about nutrition to support her running. At that moment, Ming came into the room and, seeing the receipt in her hand, smiled and explained a little sheepishly. The couple hugged briefly, and Xiaowei was deeply moved.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Birthday party phone invitation
description: After calming down, Xiaowei sat on the rattan chair on the living room balcony and called the guests for Xuanxuan's birthday party one by one. She warmly notified the parents of her son's classmates and confirmed the party arrangements at McDonald's in The Whampoa at 4 p.m. this Friday, August 15. She then contacted her running buddy Shen Peiwen, and Awen readily agreed to attend and said she would give a big sports gift.
location: Balcony at home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Work tasks and customer maintenance
description: After finishing the call, Xiaowei got into work mode. She sat down at the computer in the study, handled the client inquiry emails she had missed yesterday, and replied to them one by one. Following her supervisor's reminder, she booked Cantonese-embroidery-style bookmarks online as birthday gifts for three local clients whose birthdays are next month, completed the payment, and noted the delivery time. After working, she closed her eyes and looked out the window for 5 minutes to protect her eyes.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family time, a walk, and supermarket shopping
description: After work, Xiaowei accompanied Xinxin in the living room to draw a “family”-themed picture with crayons, checked Xuanxuan's summer homework, and explained the wrong answers. Then the whole family went downstairs to the neighborhood garden for a walk and completed the 8,000-step goal. During the walk, Xiaowei and Mingzai dropped by the ParknShop supermarket in Whampoa New World to buy milk, fruit, and more, picking out yogurt and kiwifruit, with warm interactions.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, living room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate and the estate garden in Kowloon City District; then went to ParknShop on the basement floor of Wonderful Worlds of Whampoa shopping mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District.

name: Evening stretching and dinner preparation
