description: After returning home, Xiaowei changed into workout clothes, spread a yoga mat in the living room, and did 15 minutes of full-body stretching and joint mobility exercises, focusing on releasing the tension in her thighs and calves after the long run. She then helped prepare dinner. Her mother cooked Hong Kong-style home dishes: onion pork chops, garlic broccoli, and borscht. Xiaowei continued her fast, drinking only a bowl of borscht and eating a little broccoli.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family evening time and schoolwork tutoring
description: After dinner, Ming did the dishes while the parents watched TV. Xiaowei sat with Xuanxuan to finish his summer math homework, checking and explaining the wrong answers. Xinxin quietly played with her little toys. They spent a warm family evening.
location: Dining room and living room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime ritual, planning, and going to sleep
description: Xiaowei took Xinxin back to her room, told her a bedtime story, and settled her down to sleep. Back in the master bedroom, she did 15 minutes of bedtime yoga and an eye massage. She chatted with Mingzai about the day's funny moments, expressed thanks to her husband, and discussed Xuanxuan's party and tomorrow's arrangements. After that, Xiaowei used a mobile app to confirm the shipment of client gifts, replied to Awen in the running group and arranged next week's training, and finally wrote in her diary to record the day's touching moments, Yue embroidery inspiration, and her fasting state. At 22:45, she turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and indoor exercise
description: Woke up naturally to the howling of Typhoon Signal No. 8 and could not run outdoors. First did five minutes of eye yoga in bed, then went to the living room, unrolled the yoga mat, and followed a Keep course for a 45-minute combined workout: 15 minutes of flow yoga focusing on spinal twists, 20 minutes of core strength training (planks, squats, burpees), and 10 minutes of stretching and meditation. After exercising, my whole body felt great and my energy was activated.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family teamwork and a warm breakfast
description: After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear. Her husband woke up their son, while her daughter got up by herself. Her mother cooked white porridge and fried eggs with ham, and her father made scallion egg pancakes; she prepared warm lemon water and sugar-free oatmeal. During breakfast, she confirmed the company notice to work from home all day and reminded the children that even though they didn't have to go to school, they still needed to finish their homework and reading plan.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Working from home and parent-child bonding
description: After breakfast, she went into the study and started working. She handled urgent policy renewal emails and replied to client claims inquiries; sorted this week's client list and changed tomorrow's visit to a conference call; noted preferences for long-standing clients and studied materials on new products. During a work break, she went to the living room to watch her mother make paper pinwheels with her daughter, took a warm photo, and sent it to the family group chat.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday rest and fasting lunch
description: Lunch included steamed grass carp, stir-fried pea shoots with garlic, and tomato egg drop soup. She had a bowl of vegetable borscht prepared in advance, with a few slices of blanched lettuce and broccoli, dressed with olive oil and black pepper, sticking to her fasting plan. While eating, she listened to her father and son arguing about a Hong Kong film's plot, feeling relaxed and authentic.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and observing the rain.
description: After dinner, she took the initiative to help her mother clear the dishes. Then she stood by the window watching the rain and noticed a brief lull in the wind and rain. She immediately decided to use the window of time to go shopping in Mong Kok and Sham Shui Po, told her husband about the plan, changed into a windbreaker and rain boots, and got ready with a canvas bag and umbrella.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going out to shop on a typhoon day.
description: Took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok and went straight to "Sportsman" on Sneaker Street to buy the blue running shoes her son had been longing for; the shop assistant thoughtfully put them in a waterproof bag. Then transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Nam Cheong Street in Sham Shui Po, where she bought gold embroidery thread from the shop owner Wu Ying at "New Arts City Embroidery Shop". Wu Ying warmly recommended threads of different thicknesses and taught her matching techniques. Before leaving, she bought an egg waffle from a small shop nearby.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, Mong Kok, Garden Street, Sportsman Sporting Goods Store; Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Nam Cheong Street, New Arts City Embroidery Shop

name: Organizing takeaways and parent-child time
description: Took the subway back the same way. After arriving home, she put away the shoe box and embroidery threads, washed her hands, and went to the living room. Her daughter excitedly showed her the paper pinwheel she had made with Grandma. They played with the pinwheel, built with LEGO bricks, and constructed a little garden. Her daughter asked about the running shoes, and the mother and daughter spent a warm and happy time together.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wrapping up work and communicating with the team.
description: Returned to the study to handle remaining client emails, called colleague Su Lishan, exchanged updates on their work-from-home and family situations, encouraged each other, and agreed to go over meeting details at work tomorrow. After organizing work notes, she turned off the computer with peace of mind.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Chess instruction and family interaction
description: Her son came over with 'An Introduction to Chess' asking for help. The couple turned on the TV, found a tutorial video, and explained the rules together. The son couldn't tell the difference between the knight's L-shaped move and the bishop's diagonal move, and the whole family laughed and joked. Their daughter sat nearby drawing people playing chess, and even the sound of wind and rain outside the window seemed pleasant.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and warm interactions.
description: At dinner, my mother made Chu Hou beef brisket in a clay pot. I drank vegetable soup and ate tofu. My son asked if he could wear the running shoes tomorrow, and I told him they were a birthday gift. My daughter kept asking about the pendant, and I promised to give it to her once I finished embroidering it. At the table, we shared funny stories about sheltering from rain during the day, and laughter kept filling the room.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Chess practice partner and hand embroidery
description: After dinner, continued the chess lesson, with the couple taking turns practicing with the child. Then went to the master bedroom and began embroidering the "Peace" hanging ornament, sketching the outline and threading the needle. The daughter came in carrying water and said how hard I had worked, and I felt warm inside. Afterwards, went to the living room to read the picture book "Sometimes It Rains Pigs" to the whole family, and everyone laughed uproariously.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Daughter's bedtime story and embroidery time
description: Took her daughter back to the room, told the story of Sofia the First, and softly patted her until she fell asleep. Returning to the master bedroom, she continued embroidering the "Ping An" ornament and completed the first stroke of the character 'Ping'. Meanwhile, her husband came in to pour hot water, and they chatted about his insights from his nutrition course; she was very supportive of him.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening routine and bedtime
description: After washing up, she did a 5-minute eye massage, then replied to fellow runner Shen Peiwen in the running group "Huangpu Wind-Chasing Running Club" to arrange a recovery run on Wednesday. She quickly browsed Moments, turned off her phone, and fell into a deep sleep amid the sound of wind and rain and her husband's even breathing.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning preparation, interval running training, and returning home
description: Woke up at 5:50 on time, washed up briefly, put on running shoes and workout clothes, drank warm water, and weighed in at 53.9 kg, satisfied with the results of the fast. At 6:00, she took her husband's motorcycle to the Kowloon Bay waterfront running track, met up with running buddy Awen, and completed 8 sets of 400-meter intervals at a 4:55 pace. The air was fresh after the rain, and they timed and encouraged each other. After the workout, she stretched and cooled down, then caught a ride home with her husband at 7:10.
location: Waterfront running track at the intersection of Wang Chiu Road and Hoi Bun Road, Kowloon Bay, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Yoga relaxation, shower, and completing the Cantonese embroidery assignment
description: After arriving home, I did 30 minutes of relaxing yoga in the living room, focusing on stretching the calves, thighs, and hips, combined with abdominal breathing to calm my heart rate, then took a shower. At 8:00, in the study, I focused on finishing the last few stitches of the Cantonese embroidery piece “Flowers and Birds,” took close-up photos and sent them to Teacher Wu Xiuying, and asked her about the petal transition issue.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and getting the children ready for school
description: Seventh day of the fast; for breakfast she only drank the clear white mushroom soup her mother had made. She helped her daughter Xinxin braid her hair and reminded her son Xuanxuan to check his schoolbag and math homework. Her husband Mingzai told her he would pick up the kids in the afternoon.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take daughter to school and take the MTR to Wan Chai.
description: At 8:50, she walked Xinxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten and kissed her goodbye. Then she walked to Whampoa Station and took the MTR Kwun Tong Line, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line, then the Island Line to Wan Chai. The whole trip took about 50 minutes. She put on her earphones and started listening to the audio course for Chapter 1 of CFP Investment Planning.
location: Walked from Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon City Kindergarten at 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, then took the MTR to Immigration Tower at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District.

name: Company morning meeting and work organization
description: Arrived at the AIA office at 9:30 for the team morning meeting. Supervisor Liang Zhenhua shared the latest preferential policies for savings products and affirmed last week's performance. After the meeting, she reviewed client situations with her partner Su Lishan, then handled client emails and replied to an existing client's inquiry about claim progress.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Start CFP study and birthday party preparations
description: On the office computer, she studied Section 3 of Chapter 1, "Investment Environment and Macroeconomic Indicators," of the CFP Investment Planning module and downloaded the PDF handout. At the same time, she confirmed the status of the cake order for her son's Friday birthday and added party hats and other items to the online shopping cart, making sure everything was ready for the party.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Phone call to client Mrs. Chen
description: As planned, held a 40-minute phone meeting with client Mrs. Chen, asked about her health, then explained the savings plan in detail and answered her questions about premium rebates and the lock-in period. The client said it was clear, and agreed to come to the office next Wednesday afternoon to sign.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and CFP knowledge review
description: At noon, I went to the coffee shop at Shui On Centre with my colleague Su Lishan and ordered only a cup of unsweetened black coffee. While drinking it, I wrote down and organized the key concepts from the morning CFP course from memory, then rested with my eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Café on the 1st floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handle afternoon work and prepare for the commute
description: Processed 2 insurance policies that urgently needed to be signed for and 1 claim report, and sent confirmation text messages to the clients she was scheduled to meet the next day. At 14:00, she downloaded the CFP course materials to her phone, packed her belongings, and got ready to set off for Kwun Tong.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: MTR Commute to Kwun Tong
description: At 14:30, left the office and took the MTR from Wan Chai to Kwun Tong, a ride of about 40 minutes, continuing to study the CFP course with earphones and using the memo app to note terms to look up and next week's study plan.
location: By MTR from Wan Chai District to Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Island Line transfer to Kwun Tong Line).

name: Visiting mother-in-law and parent-child time
description: At about 15:40, she arrived at her mother-in-law's home in Jinqiao Huaxia on Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong. The children had already been brought over by her husband. Her mother-in-law was simmering Chinese yam and pork soup. Ayi only drank a small half bowl of the clear soup and praised the soup for being cooked just right. Afterwards, they sat together in the living room picking vegetables and peeling garlic, listening to her mother-in-law tell amusing stories about drinking tea. She politely declined the sweet potato syrup.
location: Grandmother’s home, Gold Bridge Building, 25-39 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Purchase ingredients for tomorrow's post-fast meal.
description: After saying goodbye to her mother-in-law, she walked with the children to Kowloon City Market, bought fresh salmon, skinless chicken breast, broccoli, and eggs, and also bought sugar-free Greek yogurt and avocado at the supermarket to prepare for resuming regular meals the next day.
location: Kowloon City Market, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home and prepared dinner.
description: Took a minibus back to Whampoa Garden and arrived home around 18:05. Her husband had already picked up their daughter and prepped the ingredients. Ayi helped marinate the salmon and blanch the broccoli, and she herself made a vegetable soup with tomatoes and onions for dinner.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family had dinner together. Mother stir-fried char siu with scrambled eggs and stir-fried choy sum. The children ate with relish. A Yi had tomato vegetable soup. Father talked about his amusing apprenticeship days in junior high school, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Summarize fasting insights and post an encouragement message
description: In the study, she opened the Fasting Diary and recorded today's weight of 53.9 kg, high energy, and successful resistance to cravings. Then she posted a short reflection in the running group and on her personal social media, accompanied by a photo of the Kowloon Bay coastline taken during her morning run.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Parent-child tutoring and family time
description: Checked her son Xuanxuan's summer homework and helped with word problems on fraction concepts; played house and folded paper cranes with her daughter Xinxin; finally told both children the picture book story The Tiny Seed, kissed them goodnight.
location: Living room and children’s room at home in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Plan tomorrow's return to eating and relaxation preparation
description: After the children fell asleep, I planned tomorrow's post-fast meal plan in detail in my phone memo: breakfast of avocado egg salad, lunch of salmon and broccoli bento, and dinner of chicken breast and vegetable soup. I prepared the yoga clothes and lunchbox for the next morning, and did 10 minutes of eye yoga to relax.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, home study and bedroom

name: Bedtime preparations and a couple's chat in bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she chatted with her husband Zhang Weiming about his leaving work early, and thanked him for helping pick up and drop off the children and buy groceries. She set her phone to Do Not Disturb, and at 22:30 they said goodnight and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning running training and early-morning home activities
description: At 6 a.m., Yu Xiaowei set out from home to the waterfront running track at Kai Tak Cruise Terminal Park, completed a 5 km easy run at a 5:30 pace, and while stretching happened to meet her running partner Shen Peiwen. The two chatted about how they felt after resuming regular meals and about the arrangements for Xuanxuan's birthday party. She returned home at 7:05, did 15 minutes of post-run stretching, then showered and did her skincare routine, changing into a light blue shirt and dark gray suit trousers. When she entered the kitchen, her mother Chen Meiling had already cooked white congee. Xiaowei put a pineapple bun and Hong Kong-style milk tea into a lunch bag, hugged and chatted with her mother, and shared how energetic she felt after resuming regular meals.
location: Kai Tak Cruise Terminal Park, 33 Shing Fung Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Subway Commute and CFP Study
description: At exactly 8:00, Xiaowei walked to MTR Whampoa Station and took a train toward Admiralty. During the approximately 50-minute ride, she put on earphones, watched an online course for the CFP investment planning module, focusing on modern portfolio theory, and used her phone memo to record key formulas, making full use of her commute to enrich her professional knowledge.
location: Along the MTR train line from Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station

name: Team morning meeting and coffee greeting
description: After arriving at Wan Chai station, Xiaowei first went to the coffee shop at Shui On Centre to buy two Americanos for her supervisor Liang Zhenhua and colleague Su Lishan, then entered the Capital Centre office. At 9 o'clock sharp the team morning meeting began. Liang Zhenhua shared market updates, and Xiaowei listened attentively and took notes, already beginning to think through the framework for a cross-border group insurance plan.
location: AIA Insurance office at Capital Centre, 151 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, and Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road

name: Morning office work: resuming meals, advancing proposals, and handling emails
description: After the morning meeting, Xiaowei returned to her desk. At exactly 10 o'clock, she enjoyed her first proper snack after resuming eating — pineapple bun and Hong Kong-style milk tea — and found it exceptionally sweet and fragrant. She then got down to work, opening Excel to sort out the rates and coverage liabilities of Wang Qiming's cross-border group insurance plan, quickly completing 80% of the first draft. Next, she had a video call with actuarial colleague Guo Junwei in Guangzhou, checking item by item the details of the medical reimbursement ratios between the two places and recording key connection points. After hanging up, she focused on client emails, sending policy confirmation letters, replying to renewal questions, and exporting the list of three birthday clients, preparing to choose Cantonese embroidery bookmarks as gifts for them.
location: AIA Insurance office, Capital Centre, 151 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Lunchtime (New Shanghai Kitchen)
description: At noon, Xiaowei and Su Lishan went to New Shanghai Kitchen near the office for lunch. She ordered a bowl of shrimp wonton noodles; the broth was savory and the wontons were plump, and she enjoyed it very much. Shanshan shared a video of her youngest daughter at kindergarten, and the two chatted about parenting anecdotes in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Wan Chai District, 181 Gloucester Road, G/F Bank of East Asia Building, New Shanghai Kitchen

name: Afternoon work: polishing the plan and arranging yum cha with Dad
description: After lunch, back in the office, Xiaowei made final adjustments and polished Wang Qiming's proposal based on Guo Junwei's suggestions. Then she took a deep breath and sent her father Yu Guoqiang a WeChat message inviting him to have afternoon tea at Jufu Lou in Kowloon City at 4 p.m., mentioning that she wanted to discuss Xuanxuan's birthday. Her father briefly replied that it was fine, which made her feel at ease.
location: AIA Insurance office, Capital Centre, 151 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Went out to visit client Mrs. Chen
description: At 14:15, Xiaowei set off early, took the MTR from Wan Chai back to Whampoa, and went to visit her client Mrs. Chan at Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom. In the living room, she used her iPad to present the savings plan proposal and patiently answered questions about dividend payout ratios and policy holidays. Mrs. Chan expressed satisfaction, and the two agreed to formally sign the contract next Monday. Xiaowei shook hands with her and said goodbye.
location: A block of Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District (client Mrs. Chen's home)

name: Commute to the teahouse and organize the meeting minutes.
description: After the visit, Xiaowei took the MTR from Whampoa Station to Kowloon City. During the 10-minute ride, she quickly organized the meeting notes with Mrs. Chen on her phone's notes app, sent a confirmation email, and searched for the location of Jufu Building in advance, confirming that it was right opposite Kowloon City Plaza.
location: Along the MTR line from Whampoa Station to Kowloon City Station.

name: Have tea with her father alone to ease the tension in their relationship.
description: At 16:10, Xiaowei met her father Yu Guoqiang at the entrance of Jufu Restaurant. She proactively poured tea for him and ordered his favorite crystal shrimp dumplings and shrimp rice rolls. The two chatted about the weather and the grandson's birthday gift, deliberately avoiding the topic of stock investing. Xiaowei mentioned that Xuanxuan had already invited several classmates to the birthday party; her father showed a rare smile, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Jufu Lou Dim Sum Restaurant, 74 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City, Kowloon City District

name: Evening family gathering and dinner time
description: After yum cha, Xiaowei parted with her father outside the teahouse and walked home. After arriving home at 17:20, she put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare dinner, washing broccoli, chopping green onions, and briefly responding to her mother's concern about the meeting with her father. At 18:00, the whole family had gathered, including her father, husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, daughter Zhang Yuxin, and her mother, and they enjoyed a hearty dinner together: roast meat combo, blanched choy sum, garlic broccoli, and lotus root and pork rib soup. Xiaowei was especially satisfied to eat roast pork after so long. During the meal she naturally brought up Xuanxuan's birthday arrangements, and her father volunteered to help on that day. After dinner, her husband cleared the table, while Xiaowei checked her son's English homework, circled the spelling mistakes and corrected his pronunciation; her daughter Xinxin proudly showed off a crayon drawing from kindergarten, and Xiaowei kissed her daughter and put the drawing on the refrigerator door.
location: Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building (home kitchen, dining room, and living room)

name: Confirmed the preparation details for her son's birthday party
description: After settling the children, Xiaowei and her husband sat down in the study and took out a notebook to go through the preparation checklist for the party in two days: the cake and disposable tableware have been confirmed for delivery online, her mother-in-law will bring a carton of Vitasoy, and the newly bought blue sneakers need to be remembered as a gift for Xuanxuan. Her husband said he would go straight to McDonald's tomorrow afternoon to save seats. After efficient communication, all details were finalized.
location: Home study in Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Yoga practice and relaxing shower.
description: After discussing the party matters with her husband, Xiaowei changed into yoga clothes, spread her yoga mat beside the bay window in the living room, and did 40 minutes of vinyasa flow and stretching to soothing music, focusing on relaxing her tense leg and back muscles after running. After the workout, she took a hot shower, washed away the fatigue, and both body and mind returned to calm.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

name: Evening study and embroidery consultation.
description: After showering, Xiaowei changed into a casual dress. In the study, she first organized and transcribed her study notes for the CFP investment planning module, systematizing the key points she had recorded on the subway. Then, using her phone, she sent the draft of the Cantonese embroidery hanging scroll 'A Harmonious Family Brings Prosperity' to her teacher Wu Xiuying, and sent a voice message humbly asking about the starting point for the character 'home' and the issue of using silver-gray silk thread for the border.
location: Home study in Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Bedtime routine and going to sleep
description: At 21:30, Xiaowei said goodnight to her husband, checked that the children were sleeping soundly, and returned to the master bedroom to prepare the next day's yoga clothes and put them in her bag. Leaning against the headboard, she browsed the running group chat and saw a photo Shen Peiwen had candidly taken of her back view during the morning run. She praised it and interacted happily in the group. Then she went to the kitchen, washed, cut, and portioned the salmon and asparagus to prepare tomorrow's lunch box of pan-seared salmon with asparagus. At 22:30, everything was ready. She turned off the light and went to bed, peacefully falling asleep in contentment as she reflected on the beauty of the first day of resuming regular meals.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at home, Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

name: Morning run and socializing
description: At 5:50 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei quickly washed up and changed into running clothes. She walked from her home on Prince Edward Road West to the waterfront running track at Kai Tak Cruise Terminal Park and met up with her running partner Shen Peiwen. The two did an 8-kilometer tempo run at a pace of about 5:15, adjusting their breathing and chatting about daily life. Ah Wen confirmed she would bring her son to Xuanxuan's birthday party the day after tomorrow. Xiaowei thanked her and told her about having tea with her father last night.
location: Seaside running track at Kai Tak Cruise Terminal Park, 33 Shing Fung Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Stretching after morning run and commute preparation
description: After finishing the run, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to Shen Peiwen and walked home. In the living room, she did 10 minutes of leg and core stretching, then quickly showered, washed her hair, and did her skincare routine. She changed into a work outfit (light blue shirt, dark trousers) and prepared the little dress her daughter Xinxin would wear that day.
location: Home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: The whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast; her mother had prepared white congee and fried eggs. Yu Xiaowei braided her daughter Zhang Yuxin's hair and told her to listen to the teacher at kindergarten. At 7:20, she walked hand in hand with Xinxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten and watched her daughter enter the campus.
location: From the dining room at the home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street

name: Work from home and prepare materials for the license exam
description: Yu Xiaowei opened her computer in the study to prepare insurance intermediary examination materials for her best friend Lin Jiaxin. She downloaded the latest study materials and mock test sets from the company's internal system, organized the registration website link and operation guide, and made them into a clear PDF file. She put these materials, along with two textbooks she had used herself, into a new file folder, and attached a handwritten note to encourage Jiaxin.
location: Home study, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting and CFP study.
description: Yu Xiaowei left with her document folder and commuter bag, walked 10 minutes to Mong Kok MTR Station, and took the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she put on her Bluetooth earphones and studied the CFP audio course “Asset Allocation and Portfolio Management”, jotting down key points and questions in her phone's memo app. After exiting the station, she walked 5 minutes to the office in the Immigration Tower, Wan Chai.
location: From home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, via MTR Mong Kok Station to the Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Handle company affairs
description: After arriving at the office, Yu Xiaowei made a cup of instant coffee, quickly handled three client emails, and logged into the system to record client needs. She then opened Wang Qiming's cross-border group insurance plan for final polishing and clause review, saved the final draft, and planned to finalize and send it next Monday.
location: AIA Insurance Office, 40/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: Around noon, her colleague Su Lishan came to find Yu Xiaowei and they went to the New Star Tea Restaurant downstairs for lunch. The two chose a window seat. Xiaowei ordered shrimp wonton noodles, and Shanshan ordered twice-cooked pork with rice. They talked about work, and Xiaowei shared her experience handling client objections. After the meal, Xiaowei used the break to review the portfolio model content in her CFP textbook.
location: New Star Cha Chaan Teng, Ground Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon rest and work preparation.
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei closed her eyes and rested for 15 minutes. Then she opened the memo on her phone and wrote down the key points for the afternoon meeting with Lin Jiaxin: encourage her, emphasize independence, share relaxation techniques for the license exam, and remind herself that today's focus was Jiaxin.
location: AIA Insurance Office, 40/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Meeting her best friend Lin Jiaxin at a coffee shop
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived early at the Starbucks near her company and bought two matcha lattes, which Lin Jiaxin liked. After Jiaxin arrived, Xiaowei handed her the prepared document folder and briefly introduced the contents. She restrained the urge to explain details, and casually shared her exam experience and parenting anecdotes; the atmosphere was relaxed and equal.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 318 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Ran into fellow embroiderer Mrs. Chen at a craft store.
description: After leaving Starbucks, Yu Xiaowei walked to the Colorful Thread Pavilion handicraft store in Hopewell Centre to look at embroidery threads and buttons. In the store she met her embroidery friend Mrs. Chen, and the two chatted about embroidery patterns. Mrs. Chen mentioned wanting to set up a savings plan for retirement, and Xiaowei professionally introduced the features of a participating savings insurance policy, agreeing to discuss in detail next Tuesday afternoon, saying it could count as an embroidery friends' gathering.
location: Color Thread Pavilion Handicraft Materials Store, G/F, Hopewell Centre, 183 Queen's Road East, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return commute and party planning details
description: After saying goodbye to Mrs. Chan, Yu Xiaowei walked to Wan Chai MTR station and took the subway back to Mong Kok. During the 30-minute ride, she opened her phone memos to plan the details of Xuanxuan's birthday party the day after tomorrow: whether to buy new hair clips, whether they had enough balloons, and decided to check the McDonald's venue before finalizing. After exiting the station, she walked home.
location: From Queen's Road East in Wan Chai District, via MTR Wan Chai Station, to home on Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District.

name: Go home to pick up party decorations.
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei quickly took the pre-prepared blue-themed balloons, streamers, and decorations out of the storage cabinet, put them into a large bag, and prepared to bring them to the McDonald's party venue.
location: Home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Confirm venue for son's birthday party.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to the McDonald's at Huangpu Xintiandi, found the shift manager, took out the decorations, and confirmed the venue layout plan for the afternoon of the 16th: blue as the main color, with a long table reserved next to the game area. She checked the invited headcount of about 8 families and the contents of the Colorful Party Package, and paid a partial deposit.
location: McDonald's, G/F, Whampoa New World Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home to rest and spend time with the children.
description: Walked home from McDonald's and stopped by Wellcome Supermarket on the way to buy pork ribs and winter melon. After getting home, she washed her face and changed into loungewear. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin had already been picked up by her grandmother and was drawing in the living room, and her son Zhang Zixuan was doing homework in his room. Xiaowei drew with her daughter for a while, drank a glass of water, and rested.
location: Home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Mother Chen Meiling cooked spare ribs and winter melon soup with the ingredients Xiaowei had bought, along with steamed grass carp and stir-fried choy sum. Everyone chatted and laughed during the meal. Xiaowei shared the unexpected gain of running into Mrs. Chen, and her husband Weiming reminded his son to remember to hand in his homework tomorrow. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, a Chinese restaurant on Prince Edward Road West

name: Homework tutoring and family time.
description: After dinner, her husband washed the dishes and tidied up. Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math homework and patiently explained a problem he had answered incorrectly. Then she read two picture books with her daughter Zhang Yuxin. After her daughter fell asleep, she chatted with Xuanxuan and encouraged him to do his best at the weekend party.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, home living room and son's bedroom

name: Evening embroidery and relaxation
description: After the family had settled down, Yu Xiaowei took out the almost-finished “Peace” hanging ornament in the study and embroidered it stitch by stitch under the soft light. She planned to hang this embroidery on her son’s door as a birthday gift. Embroidery made her feel calm and content.
location: Home study, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation and review
description: After showering and changing into pajamas, Yu Xiaowei lay in bed and opened the notes app on her phone for a brief review: Jiaxin's decision made her relieved, Mrs. Chen's clue was an unexpected surprise, and the party venue had been confirmed. She sent a warm text to her husband, set the alarm for 5:50 the next morning, and prepared to sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning awakening and yoga.
description: Woken naturally by my body clock, the sky outside the window was already clear blue. Out of habit, I picked up my phone and weighed myself: 54.3 kg, 0.7 kg lighter than at the beginning of the month. I felt satisfied with the effect of fasting and refeeding. I changed into yoga clothes, spread the mat on the master bedroom carpet, and did 20 minutes of simple Hatha yoga—from Cat-Cow to awaken the spine to Downward Dog to stretch the back of the legs—feeling my body's lightness and the day's vitality.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, master bedroom at home

name: Washing up and getting ready
description: Took a quick hot shower and patted her face with refreshing skincare products. Prepared a white dress and matching hair clips for her daughter Xinxin, checked her son Xuanxuan's schoolbag, and confirmed that the homework notebooks and swimming gear were all packed.
location: Bathroom and kitchen at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Warm breakfast and birthday wishes
description: Mother Chen Meiling had already prepared shrimp dumplings, siu mai, and preserved egg and lean pork congee in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowei cooked soba noodles for herself, topped with greens and a fried egg, as a nutritious breakfast for refeeding day. After the whole family sat down, she and her husband gave their son Xuanxuan 10th birthday wishes, and her daughter Xinxin also followed along in a babyish voice. The atmosphere was warm and sweet.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Holding her daughter Xinxin’s hand, she walked to kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin shared her joy about sharing her painting with classmates today. At the school gate, she obediently waved goodbye, and the teacher came over to welcome her.
location: Walked from home to Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai)

name: Commute and preparation for work
description: Walked from the kindergarten to Whampoa Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong line and transferred to the Island line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, put on earphones, opened the CFP study app to replay the investment planning chapter, marked the difficult parts of the asset allocation model, and planned to ask a colleague. After exiting the station, bought a cup of sugar-free hot latte at the company's building to refresh.
location: MTR Kwun Tong Line and Island Line carriages, and the coffee shop downstairs at Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai.

name: Efficient morning office work
description: Attended the team morning meeting. Her supervisor Liang Zhenhua praised Yu Xiaowei for her initiative in following up with local clients. After the meeting, she immediately called two long-standing clients and successfully scheduled annual policy reviews for next Wednesday afternoon. She then concentrated on handling client emails and policy documents, calmed a client's emotions about a claims inquiry, and organized the details of the group insurance plan, preparing to send them to Guo Junwei, the actuarial colleague in Guangzhou. During her break, she called the McDonald's near her home to confirm the final details for tomorrow's birthday party.
location: Office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Choosing a birthday card for her son
description: Walked quickly out of the office and walked about 12 minutes to a long-established stationery store on Hennessy Road. Carefully browsed the greeting card section, and finally chose a birthday card with a 3D origami cake design and a large 10 on the cover. Asked the shop assistant to wrap it simply.
location: Hengfa (Hong Kong) Stationery Company, 59 Hennessy Road, Hong Kong

name: Lunch and chat with colleagues
description: Walked about 8 minutes to the café at Shui On Centre to meet colleague Su Lishan. Ordered the signature baked pork chop rice and iced lemon tea. Happily shared the plans for her son's birthday tonight and the plan to take the afternoon off. Su Lishan expressed birthday wishes.
location: Shui On Centre Cafe, Shop 103, 1st Floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: Midday personal time and afternoon work.
description: Back at her desk, she wrote a blessing message to her son on a greeting card with a pen, then touched up her makeup to look refreshed. In the afternoon, she focused on the final priorities of the day: finishing the final draft of Wang Qiming’s cross-border group insurance plan and emailing it to her Guangzhou colleague Guo Junwei, replying to all client WeChat messages, and entering today’s follow-up records and processing progress into the system for archiving.
location: Office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leaving work early and commuting home
description: Tidied up the desk and organized her bag, then went to her supervisor Hua Ge's office to report in and ask for leave before leaving early. She walked to Wan Chai MTR Station and took the train back to Whampoa Station. During the commute, she opened the WeChat runner friends group and saw everyone discussing the countdown to Tokyo Marathon registration. The idea of bringing her family to Japan for marathon travel began to form in her mind.
location: In the MTR carriage on the way from Wan Chai to Whampoa: walk from the Immigration Tower at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, to Wan Chai MTR Station, then take the MTR to Whampoa MTR Station.

name: Purchasing birthday ingredients at the supermarket
description: After getting off the subway, she walked straight into the supermarket in Whampoa Wonderland mall, carefully selecting fresh shrimp, greens, fresh noodles, and tomatoes for making longevity noodles. She also bought fruit her son liked and a bottle of sugar-free sparkling water as her own post-fast beverage.
location: Supermarket, Whampoa New Town Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to prepare the birthday dinner and decorations.
description: Carrying her shopping bags home, she tied on an apron and cooked with her mother. They prepared longevity noodles and stir-fried shrimp and vegetables for later. Then she blew up and tied the balloons her husband had prepared in advance, sticking them on the walls and curtains to create a birthday party atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family reunion and birthday celebration
description: Her husband picked up their son from school, and her mother picked up their daughter. Yu Xiaowei gave her son a big hug and blessings. The whole family sat together to enjoy her mother's signature soy sauce chicken, blanched choy sum, steamed grouper, and longevity noodles. After the meal, her husband turned off the lights, brought out a cake, lit candles, and they sang Happy Birthday. Her son made a wish for the whole family to travel to Japan. Then they opened presents: Yu Xiaowei gave him new running shoes and a hand-embroidered Cantonese embroidery peace charm, her husband gave him a popular science encyclopedia, and the son excitedly tried on the new shoes.
location: Dining room and living room at home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Signing up for the Tokyo Marathon and family discussion
description: Seeing her son's love for the new shoes and his wish to go to Japan, Yu Xiaowei opened her phone, clicked the Tokyo Marathon registration link shared in the running friends group, checked the information, decisively submitted the registration, and successfully paid. She sent the screenshot to the family group. The whole family immediately became excited. Her husband immediately looked up Tokyo Disneyland and Universal Studios guides and hotels, her son excitedly spun his sister around, and her parents smiled in support but reminded them to get enough rest.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and children's bedtime preparation
description: To keep her daughter from getting too excited, she carried Xinxin to the bedroom, read the travel picture book Little Penguin Goes to Tokyo and played with puzzles. Then she divided tasks with her husband: he helped their son prepare pajamas and bath water, while Yu Xiaowei showered and washed their daughter's hair. After changing both children into pajamas, she kissed each on the forehead and said goodnight.
location: Living room, bedroom, and bathroom of the residence at Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video call with her mother-in-law and communication with her husband
description: Opened the iPad and connected a video call with mother-in-law Li Shufen, who lives in Islands District. The son, in his pajamas, showed off his new running shoes and encyclopedia, excitedly telling her about his wish and his mom signing up for the marathon. Grandma blew kisses from the screen. After the children went to sleep, the couple had a brief review in the bedroom, shared small work achievements, thanked each other for their efforts for the party, and encouraged each other to work hard for the Japan trip.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Pre-bedtime relaxation and self-improvement
description: Did 15 minutes of pre-sleep eye yoga in the bedroom, rubbing hands together to warm them and pressing them over the eyes to relieve fatigue. Opened the running app to plan a 6 km easy run route along the Whampoa waterfront promenade tomorrow morning. Finally, browsed the new pattern images sent by the Cantonese embroidery teacher, posted a photo of the peace pendant embroidered yesterday to Moments with a caption expressing love and birthday wishes for her son, and received likes and comments.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Going to bed
description: She put down her phone, turned off the bedside lamp, and replayed in her mind the smiling face of her son opening gifts and the lively scene of the whole family discussing the Japan trip. Filled with contentment for her family and anticipation for the future, she slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning wake-up and light yoga
description: Woke up to the alarm clock, noticed the gloomy weather, and there was a forecast of showers. To keep energy throughout the day, she spread a yoga mat by the bedroom window and did 15 minutes of simple flow yoga, focusing on stretching the shoulders, back, and hips that were tight from yesterday's run, loosening up her whole body.
location: Bedroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and family breakfast
description: After yoga, she took a quick shower and changed into loungewear. Her husband Zhang Weiming had prepared white porridge, fried eggs, and barbecue pork buns. The whole family sat around the dining table, eating while checking today's party assignments: Weiming was in charge of decorations and photography, mother would prepare dinner, father would look after Xinxin, Xuanxuan would confirm the party procedure, and Xinxin wanted to draw a greeting card for her brother.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to McDonald's and decorate the party venue.
description: After breakfast, she checked the decoration kit and cake pickup slip and put them into a storage bag. She walked about 10 minutes with her husband Zhang Weiming to the McDonald's at Whampoa Wonderland Mall. On the way, they discussed the banner and balloon decoration plan. After arriving, they confirmed the second-floor party area with the duty manager. The two divided the work: Weiming used a ladder to hang ribbons and balloons, while Yu Xiaowei put up the "HAPPY BIRTHDAY" banner on the dining tables and background wall and tied the small "Peace" pendant she had embroidered by hand to the back of the main chair. She also adjusted the store's Bluetooth speaker to play children's songs as background music.
location: Party area, second floor, McDonald's, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going home to rest and pick up the cake
description: After finishing the venue decoration, she first walked home with her husband, told Xuanxuan to change into his new dinosaur T-shirt, and calmed the excited Xinxin. Then she walked alone for about 20 minutes to Maria's Bakery on Yuk Yat Street in To Kwa Wan, picked up the reserved 10-inch birthday cake, confirmed it was correct, carried it back, and carefully put the cake in the refrigerator at home.
location: Along the route from the Whampoa Garden residential estate in Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Maria's Bakery Limited, Fook Shing Industrial Building, 1A Yuk Yat Street, To Kwa Wan.

name: Family preparation and early lunch
description: Checked the ingredients her mother had prepared for dinner and confirmed everything was complete. Helped Xuanxuan pack the gifts for his classmates. Her mother simply cooked noodles in soup, and the whole family had an early lunch to store up energy for the afternoon party. Xuanxuan only ate a few bites because he was excited.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Midday rest and change of clothes
description: Before the children's midday nap, she closed her eyes and rested on the sofa for 15 minutes. After waking up, she changed into a bright yellow dress, touched up her light makeup, and fully charged her camera and phone, ensuring the party record would go off without a hitch.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Head to McDonald's early.
description: Walked to the McDonald's party venue with her husband and Xuanxuan, carrying the cake, and told her father to set off later with Xinxin, who had woken up from her nap.
location: Along the route from Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to the McDonald's at Whampoa New World.

name: Final preparations and welcoming guests
description: After arriving at the store early, she confirmed the venue again, placed the cake on the main table, and posted a 'Xuanxuan's Birthday Party' sign at the door. Around 13:40, the first classmate and parents began to arrive one after another; she warmly welcomed them and guided them to their seats.
location: Party area, second floor, McDonald's, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Son Zhang Zixuan's 10th birthday party
description: The party officially began. Led by the McDonald's hostess, the children played games such as 'pass the flower while the drum beats' and 'draw and guess,' and the atmosphere was lively. Fellow runner Shen Peiwen arrived on time with her son and gave a sports water bottle as a gift, and agreed to go running with Yu Xiaowei next week. The couple helped distribute kids' meals. At 16:00, the lights were dimmed throughout the venue, everyone sang 'Happy Birthday,' Xuanxuan made a wish and blew out the candles, and Yu Xiaowei captured every happy moment with her camera.
location: Party area, second floor, McDonald's, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Clean up the venue and say goodbye
description: After the party ended, she quickly took down and recycled the decorations with her husband, and packed the leftover cake and food to share with neighbors and family. She said goodbye to Shen Peiwen and the other parents, and agreed to meet again in the running group. Her father took the two children home first, while Yu Xiaowei completed the venue handover with the McDonald's staff.
location: Party area, second floor, McDonald's, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon tea with close friend Lin Jiaxin
description: After getting ready, she briefly said goodbye to her husband and walked alone to the Jinzhuang Tea Restaurant on Chuen King Street to meet her close friend Lin Jiaxin. They sat in a window booth and ordered the signature shrimp wonton noodles and iced lemon tea. The two excitedly shared party photos and videos on their phones, and Jiaxin praised Yu Xiaowei for looking energetic today. After eating, they browsed a nearby boutique, where Yu Xiaowei bought a cute cat keychain.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Chuen King Street, Golden Café

name: Returning home, family dinner, and after-dinner cleanup
description: After saying goodbye to her best friend, she walked home contentedly. When she arrived, her mother had already prepared a hearty home-style meal: braised pork ribs, steamed grass carp, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, and more. During the meal, Xuanxuan excitedly recounted the party games, Xinxin showed off her abstract but precious birthday card, and her father drank half a glass of beer and said he was happy today. The whole family was full of joy. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei cleaned up the dishes with her mother, while Zhang Weiming played Ludo with the two children on the carpet and her father watched the TV news on the sofa.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Tucking the children into bed
description: After telling Xinxin a story and seeing her fall asleep, I went to Xuanxuan's room and talked with him about the best part of his day, encouraging him to be more sensible now that he was a year older. Xuanxuan fell asleep contentedly, holding that small "peace" pendant.
location: Child's bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Alone time: listening to old songs and petting the cat
description: After the children fell asleep, changed into comfortable loungewear, brewed a pot of jasmine tea, turned on the TV and connected the Bluetooth speaker to play classic old songs by Sam Hui and Paula Tsui. Scooped the lazy orange cat "Fat Boy" from the sofa into her arms, gently sang along while stroking its fur, and enjoyed her own private tranquility.
location: Home living room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

She ate slowly to replenish her energy. After the meal, she leaned against the window and watched the rain for a while, then sent her husband Zhang Weiming a message reminding him to take an umbrella when he went out in the afternoon.
location: Company cafeteria, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went out to visit clients and successfully signed a contract.
description: Yu Xiaowei packed her briefcase with contract documents, business cards, a calculator, a power bank, spare socks, and a long-handled umbrella, and set off at 12:45. At 13:00 she took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Causeway Bay Station; it was raining heavily. She arrived at Causeway Bay Station around 13:30. When she exited the station, her trouser legs and shoes were a little wet. She arrived on time at a café on Tang Lung Street, Causeway Bay, to meet her client Mrs. Chen. The two discussed the final policy details in detail. After confirming that the retirement planning and children's education fund needs were satisfied, Mrs. Chen signed readily. Around 15:00 the signing was completed. During the chat, Mrs. Chen mentioned that her mother had knee discomfort. Yu Xiaowei noted it and said she could introduce a familiar orthopedic doctor. After taking leave at 15:15, Yu Xiaowei changed into the spare socks.
location: A café in Tang Lung Street, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Returning to the office and filing contracts
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the office, immediately scanned and filed the signed contract, and sent a confirmation email to Mrs. Chen. While tidying her desk, her phone vibrated and she saw a message in the family group: her mother-in-law Li Shufen said her rheumatic joint pain had flared up, so she decided to go directly to visit her mother-in-law after work.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Confirming the visit to mother-in-law by phone
description: Yu Xiaowei immediately called her mother-in-law Li Shufen. Hearing her mother-in-law's slightly tired voice, she reassured her not to worry, saying she would go to see her after work tonight and bring her favorite pineapple buns and hot milk tea. Her mother-in-law happily said yes repeatedly. After hanging up, she took out her portable Cantonese embroidery sewing kit from the drawer, planning to embroider with her mother-in-law in the evening.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wrap up work before leaving.
description: Yu Xiaowei used the time before leaving work to organize today's visit records and prepared the mentoring materials for the new hire, then sent them over. After confirming tomorrow's work schedule, she clocked out on time at 17:30.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: Yu Xiaowei walked from the office to Wan Chai Station and took the MTR to Kwun Tong Station. There were not many people in the carriage. She closed her eyes and rested, recalling the sense of accomplishment from signing the deal today and thinking about how to please her mother-in-law.

name: Buy dim sum and head to mother-in-law's home
description: Around 18:00 she arrived at Kwun Tong Station. Yu Xiaowei went directly to the Shun Hing Cafe next to the station and, following her mother-in-law’s preference, packed a freshly baked pineapple bun and a cup of hot milk tea. The shop owner recognized her and asked with a smile if she was going to see her mother-in-law again. She then carried the snacks and walked about 10 minutes through the rain-washed streets to Golden Bridge Building, No. 45 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, Shunxing Cafe next to Kwun Tong MTR Station and Golden Bridge Building at 45 Hong Ning Road

name: Visiting her mother-in-law and sharing embroidery time.
description: Yu Xiaowei rang the doorbell. Her mother-in-law, Li Shufen, opened the door and smiled when she saw her. She helped her mother-in-law sit down in the living room, with a blanket over her knees. She handed her the steaming-hot snacks, and her mother-in-law happily ate a pineapple bun with butter and drank milk tea. Yu Xiaowei took out her Cantonese embroidery tools and suggested they embroider a picture of butterflies and peonies together. Her mother-in-law recalled her days working in a garment factory when she was young and taught her a 'seed stitch' technique for embroidering the flower stamens. As they threaded needles and chatted about family matters—her son Xuanxuan had scored an A on his exam, her daughter Xinxin had learned a new nursery rhyme, and her husband had asked about a restaurant for the National Day dinner—her mother-in-law listened with great interest. Together they completed a small peony petal. Seeing that it was getting late, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother-in-law put away the embroidery thread, promised to visit again next weekend, and reminded her to apply the ointment on time and keep her knees warm. Her mother-in-law held her hand and said yes repeatedly. Then Yu Xiaowei gently closed the door and left.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kwun Tong District, 45 Hong Ning Road, Kwun Tong, Golden Bridge Mansion (mother-in-law's home)

She arrived home at 21:15; the children were already asleep. Her husband was sitting on the sofa looking at his phone and asked about her mother-in-law. Yu Xiaowei shared how enjoyable the embroidery session had been tonight and thanked her husband for inquiring about hotels. The two briefly exchanged information about the hotel. Afterward, she went to the children's room to look at their sleeping faces and felt at peace.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Lying in bed, she reported that she was safe in the family group chat and told her mother-in-law that she would visit her again next week. She wrote in her phone memo: 'Signed the contract smoothly today, mother-in-law is in a good mood, grateful.' Then she switched off her phone, set the alarm, and fell into a deep sleep around 22:30, feeling peaceful and fulfilled.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Under the teacher's guidance, she focused on the flow of breath and core strength, doing deep stretches for the muscles from yesterday's 5-kilometer run. An hour later, her clothes were soaked with sweat and her body and mind felt refreshed. After the class ended at 7:30, she walked home, wiping away sweat with a towel, and planned to remind her husband to pick up their daughter later.

She went home briefly; her mother had kept dinner for her: steamed grass carp and blanched choy sum. She had no appetite, but forced herself to eat a few bites.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening worries about pets and insomnia
description: Yu Xiaowei sat on the sofa and sent a message to her husband Zhang Weiming to tell him that Feizai was hospitalized. Her husband replied to comfort her not to worry. She searched many posts on her phone about feline hairball disease and gastroenteritis care, and jotted down some key points. Without Feizai's meowing and running around, the house felt especially quiet. She had no mood to study, nor to look at the Cantonese embroidery works. She took a shower early and lay in bed, tossing and turning, constantly swiping her phone to re-read pet care posts, silently praying that Feizai would recover soon. Dull thunder came from outside the window. Amid worry and exhaustion, she gradually felt sleepy. She turned off the bedside lamp, and scenes of Feizai's cute face and vomiting flashed through her mind again and again, until she finally fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home living room and bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wake up and morning check-in
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up according to her biological clock. She had slept poorly the night before because she was worried about her pet cat Feizai, but a sense of responsibility drove her to get up immediately. The first thing she did was pick up her phone and proactively send a WeChat message to the vet at Chongxin Animal Clinic to ask whether Feizai was stable enough to be picked up. When she saw the vet's reply, "It stabilized in the early morning and can be picked up this morning," the weight in her heart was lifted. She then changed into her swimsuit, planning to use the early morning time to do water jogging at the community pool to protect her left ankle.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Water jogging in the community pool
description: Walk 5 minutes to the community clubhouse swimming pool and do 40 minutes of water jogging and upper-body paddling exercises. This training has no impact on her left ankle and effectively maintains cardiopulmonary function. Yu Xiaowei focused on completing the workout, injecting vitality into the day.
location: Swimming pool at the clubhouse of Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: Yu Xiaowei quickly returned home, took a shower, and changed into commuting clothes. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared a simple breakfast: boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, and hot milk. While eating breakfast, Yu Xiaowei told her mother that Fatty could be brought back. Her mother said happily, 'Once we bring him back, we'll be at ease.' The family interaction was warm.
location: Bathroom and dining room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute relaxation

About 40 minutes later, she arrived at Wan Chai Station, then walked 3 minutes to the AIA Building office.
location: From Hung Hom Station in Kowloon City District to Wan Chai Station in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, ending at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley

At 9:00 she attended the team morning meeting; her supervisor Liang Zhenhua presided and praised the education fund policy she had signed yesterday. The team atmosphere was positive.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

She then handled urgent work: filing yesterday's policy documents and replying to Shenzhen client Mr. Wang's email about the cross-border group insurance plan, stating that the revised draft had been sent.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Deep work: proposal revision and client follow-up
description: Yu Xiaowei put on earphones and focused on revising Mr. Wang's group insurance plan. She adjusted the terms according to Liang Zhenhua's suggestions, added risk explanations, and sent it via encrypted email. During that time she also called Mr. Wang to schedule a meeting for tomorrow, and was very efficient.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch

She ordered the signature shrimp wonton noodles and iced Hong Kong-style milk tea. During the chat, Su Lishan mentioned her daughter's school progression, and Yu Xiaowei took the opportunity to suggest considering an education fund plan. Su Lishan expressed interest, and the two agreed to talk it over in detail over the weekend.
location: Woo Sing Cafe, Luard Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuted to the clinic to pick up Fatty and take him home, then settled him in and gave him his medication.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei changed into casual clothes and took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Hung Hom Station, arriving at the Chongxin Animal Clinic at 73 Bulkeley Street in about 30 minutes. The veterinarian explained Fatty's condition in detail: the hairball had been passed, and the gastroenteritis was improving; she needed to keep feeding him hairball paste and watching his bowel movements. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes, paid the remaining bill of about HK$2,500, put the energetic Fatty into the cat carrier, and walked about 7 minutes home. As soon as she entered, Fatty rushed out of the carrier to drink water. She changed the fresh cat food and water. Then came the hardest task — feeding the hairball paste. On the dining table, using a coaxing posture, even though Fatty frantically twisted his head away, she still managed to get him to swallow most of the tube. She was covered in sweat.
location: No. 73 Bulkeley Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Chongxin Animal Clinic, and home in Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Stay home to watch Feizai and work remotely
description: Seeing that Fatty was emotionally stable, eating cat food on his own and rubbing against her pant legs, Yu Xiaowei was completely reassured. She opened her laptop, connected to the company intranet, and worked remotely: she handled a few non-urgent client emails, confirmed tomorrow's meeting time, and also sent Liang Zhenhua a WeChat message to let him know she was safe.
location: Living room of home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

She clocked out on time at 17:00.
location: Office, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

She bought fresh Chinese broccoli, grass carp belly, braised tofu, and enoki mushrooms, and planned to make steamed grass carp belly and a stir-fry. It took about 4 minutes to walk home. As soon as she entered, her son Zixuan and daughter Yuxin rushed over to see Feizai, and happy laughter filled the room. Her mother had already started preparing dinner. Yu Xiaowei put down the shopping bags, added ginger and scallion to the fish belly, and put it in the steamer. After her husband Zhang Weiming got home, she told him that Feizai had fully recovered, and the two of them planned to take the kids to the Ngong Ping 360 cable car on the weekend.

At the table, the conversation revolved around Fatty's recovery, their son's math exam, and the upcoming weekend activities, with a harmonious atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Facing each other across screens, they followed the live home core-training session Shen Peiwen shared and did 30 minutes of dynamic stretching and core exercises. While exercising, Yu Xiaowei shared the ordeal of getting Fatty back, and Shen Peiwen laughed, calling her “cat-crazy.” They also caught up on their ankle injury recovery and agreed to go for an easy jog together on the weekend.

location: Living room and study of the home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Back in the master bedroom, she prepared the next day's schedule for herself and the children: check school bags, lay out outfits, and plug in the phone charging cable. Then she quickly washed up and applied night cream. At 23:00, she turned off the bedside lamp, and listening to the rain outside the window and Feizai's soft snoring in the room, she fell into a deep sleep with a sense of relief and contentment.
