location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom, Block 6, Whampoa Garden, home master bedroom

name: Morning routine and pet care
description: On Saturday morning, after the alarm went off, I meditated with my eyes closed for 5 minutes to regulate my breathing. Then I spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of low-intensity morning yoga, focusing on relaxing my lower back and shoulders, and noticed that my left ankle felt no discomfort. After yoga, I rested for a while, then went to the bathroom to wash up, and chose a light blue linen shirt paired with dark casual pants—comfortable and appropriate. Later, I went to the living room to take care of my pet cat 'Fatty', giving him fresh drinking water and patiently feeding him hairball gel. Seeing him in good spirits made me feel at ease.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Check the embroidery and packaging
description: Took the carefully framed Cantonese embroidery piece Daughter's Summer World from the custom embroidery cabinet in the study, laid it flat on the desk, turned on the desk lamp, and carefully checked every stitch, color, and framing edge. After confirming it was flawless, she wrapped it in a clean cotton cloth and carefully placed it in the carrying bag to make sure everything was secure.
location: Home study at Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: Mother Chen Meiling had prepared white congee, fried dough sticks, fried eggs, and fermented tofu. The family of six sat around the dining table. As she drank her congee, Yu Xiaowei shared the day's plans with the family: in the morning she would visit Ms. Wu in Sham Shui Po with her embroidery friend Mrs. Chen and wouldn't come home for lunch; in the afternoon, her daughter Xinxin's ballet performance was in Kowloon City, and she asked her husband Zhang Weiming to bring the sunflowers prepared last night and meet directly at the auditorium. Father Yu Guoqiang also smiled and said he would go watch the granddaughter's performance, which made Xinxin laugh happily.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Meet up with embroidery friends and take a ride to Sham Shui Po.
description: Yu Xiaowei took her embroidery tote bag and handbag, said goodbye to her family, and went out. At the entrance of the residential complex, she met up with her embroidery friend Mrs. Chen, who was full of praise for the embroidered pieces. The two decided to take a taxi to save time, and Yu Xiaowei hailed one using a mobile app. After getting in, they chatted about their recent insights on Cantonese embroidery along the way, and the taxi drove through the Hung Hom Cross-Harbour Tunnel into Sham Shui Po.
location: In a taxi, from Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Sham Shui Po

name: Visit Teacher Wu Xiuying, appreciate embroidery works, and discuss insurance needs.
description: The taxi stopped at 245 Lai Chi Kok Road in Sham Shui Po, and the two went upstairs to visit Wu Xiuying, the teacher. In the living room, Yu Xiaowei solemnly unfolded the embroidery piece A Daughter's Summer World. Ms. Wu put on her reading glasses and examined it closely, praising it highly. She said the luster of the silk threads and the layered texture were handled very well, suggested applying for the craft exhibition next March, and gave a few suggestions for color adjustments. Mrs. Chen was fascinated and offered to learn embroidery together with Ms. Wu. The three then chatted about everyday life. Mrs. Chen again brought up her wish to make a protection plan for the whole family, so Yu Xiaowei briefly asked about Mrs. Chen's family composition and current protection coverage, suggested they might initially consider a combination of education funds and critical illness insurance, and they agreed to discuss it in detail next week.
location: Teacher Wu's home, 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong

name: Say goodbye to Teacher Wu and take a ride to Kowloon Tong.
description: After saying goodbye to Teacher Wu, Yu Xiaowei took a reluctant leave of Mrs. Chen downstairs. Seeing that there was plenty of time, she decided not to go home and used an app to call a car to Festival Walk mall in Kowloon Tong, planning to have lunch and prepare for the afternoon performance.
location: In a taxi, from Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po, to Festival Walk mall, Tat Chee Avenue, Kowloon Tong.

name: Solo lunch and a short rest
description: After arriving at Festival Walk, Yu Xiaowei had a quick lunch at Men Wah Cafe, ordering the signature Soul-stirring Rice and a glass of iced lemon tea. While eating, she replied to a few client messages and texted her husband to confirm the afternoon meeting time. After lunch, she went to the restroom to freshen up, reapplied her lipstick, and made herself look more alert.
location: Men Wah Bing Teng, Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Bought a gift for her daughter and went to the auditorium to wait for the performance.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei strolled through the mall and remembered that her daughter wanted a ballerina music box. She walked into a boutique and carefully selected a spinning crystal-ball music box featuring a little ballerina in a pink tutu dancing Swan Lake, and asked the clerk to wrap it in pretty paper. She then walked across the footbridge connecting Kowloon Tong and Kowloon City to the Kowloon City Community Hall, which her daughter's school had rented. When she arrived, her husband Zhang Weiming, her parents, and her son were already waiting at the entrance; Zhang Weiming was holding a large bouquet of sunflowers. Her son excitedly said that his sister looked beautiful getting her makeup done backstage, and the family chatted and laughed as they entered and found their seats.
location: From Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Kowloon City Community Hall at the junction of Argyle Street and Lo Ming Road

name: Watching her daughter's ballet performance and the backstage celebration.
description: The small auditorium was packed with parents, and the performance officially began. As one of the lead dancers, daughter Zhang Yuxin performed an excerpt from Swan Lake, her small figure spinning and leaping across the stage with confidence and elegance. Yu Xiaowei watched unblinkingly, her eyes slightly moist, filled with pride. When the performance ended, the audience burst into thunderous applause, and she clapped heartily. Afterwards, the family went backstage, and Yu Xiaowei gave her daughter, who was wearing a white little-swan dress, sunflowers and a crystal-ball music box. The daughter hopped joyfully and said she wanted to become a ballet teacher in the future. The whole family gathered together for a group photo.
location: Hong Kong, Kowloon City District, junction of Argyle Street and Lok Ming Road, Kowloon City Community Hall

name: Family celebration at a dessert shop
description: The family left the auditorium and went to the 'Sweet Auntie' dessert shop on Fuk Lo Tsun Road, which their daughter had suggested. The shop was filled with the aroma of sweet soup. Everyone ordered mango pomelo sago, mango pancakes, and black sesame paste, and toasted to Xinxin's successful performance. As she ate, Xinxin gestured about her stage moves and shared her feelings; her older brother also picked up a piece of mango for his younger sister, creating a warm and joyful scene.
location: Sweet Auntie Dessert Shop, Fuk Lo Tsun Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Take a taxi home
description: After leaving the dessert shop, the family took a taxi home. On the way, the daughter got sleepy and fell asleep leaning on her grandfather's shoulder. Yu Xiaowei leaned against the car window and saw a WeChat message from Mrs. Chen saying she wanted to bring her husband to hear the proposal next week. She simply replied 'OK.' Then she closed her eyes, savoring the morning's exchange with Teacher Wu and her daughter's shine in the afternoon, feeling balanced and content.
location: In a taxi, from Fuk Lo Tsun Road in Kowloon City to Whampoa Garden in Hung Hom

name: Solitary reflection on the balcony.
description: After arriving home, each family member rested or prepared dinner. Yu Xiaowei didn't rush to help; she quietly walked to the balcony. The sunset was just right, and the sky was tinged with a gentle orange. She brewed a cup of her favorite Phoenix Dan Cong tea, sat in the rattan chair, and looked out at the distant harbor in thought. She made a firm resolution: the Cantonese embroidery circle is a sanctuary where I nourish my soul and make friends; it must never become a place for sales pitches. Hobbies and work must have boundaries, and I must hold that line.
location: Home balcony at Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Share with her husband and help prepare dinner
description: After tea, she felt cheerful. She walked into the living room, where her husband was sitting on the sofa looking at today's photos. Yu Xiaowei sat down next to him and pulled up the screenshot of Teacher Wu's comments on the embroidery on her phone to share it with him. Her husband praised her, saying she was really amazing, felt proud of her and their daughter, and felt that today was a double blessing. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother pick vegetables and rinse rice for dinner.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was Mother's signature home-style dishes: steamed grass carp, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, spare ribs in black bean sauce, and a pot of slow-cooked soup. The family talked about the afternoon performance again. Father praised his granddaughter's dancing talent, and her son said his sister's classmates all liked her very much. Yu Xiaowei served food to her parents and shared the news that Teacher Wu had suggested she participate in an exhibition. Her parents were happy for her when they heard it.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Check son's homework
description: After the meal, her mother cleared the dishes and her husband played with their daughter. Yu Xiaowei called her son into the study and looked through the math workbook he needed to hand in next week, finding several word problems with errors. She didn't give him the answers directly, but patiently guided him to read the questions again and find the mistakes himself. The son quickly understood what was wrong and recalculated correctly. Yu Xiaowei encouraged him to read the questions carefully next time and that he would definitely do better.
location: Home study at Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Feed the cat and share with family before bed
description: After checking homework, Yu Xiaowei took the hairball paste from the refrigerator to feed the cat “Fatty.” This time Fatty cooperated well and, after eating, jumped onto the sofa and licked its paws. She picked up her phone and sent the photos and videos of her daughter's performance taken during the day to the family WeChat group with the caption “Our little white swan, we are proud of you!” Relatives soon gave likes and compliments one after another. She showed them to her daughter, who was so happy that she rolled around on the bed.
location: Living room and daughter's bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Shower and prepare for tomorrow
description: Yu Xiaowei went to the bathroom and took a hot shower, washing away the day's fatigue, and changed into comfortable pajamas. She sat at the vanity to apply skincare products, then opened the calendar to confirm tomorrow's plan to go to Ngong Ping 360 with her family: leave at 9 a.m., bring water and snacks, wear comfortable shoes, and noted the key points in her phone's memo.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom in Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Having a late-night chat with her husband and telling her daughter a story
description: She lay down on the bed; her husband was already leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. They talked about how they felt today. Yu Xiaowei said that Teacher Wu's words made her more confident about the road ahead, and that both her hobbies and career brought her a sense of fulfillment. Her husband squeezed her hand. Then she got up and went to her daughter's room. Xinxin was still awake and insisted that her mother tell her a story. Yu Xiaowei softly told her a fairy tale adapted from "Swan Lake", and halfway through, Xinxin fell asleep.
location: Home master bedroom and daughter's room, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Back in her own room, Yu Xiaowei did not turn off the light immediately. She picked up The Complete Guide to Cantonese Embroidery Stitches and flipped through the several improved stitching techniques Teacher Wu had mentioned. After reading for more than ten minutes, she gradually felt drowsy. She turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, put on her earphones, and listened to soothing piano music. As the music gradually faded, drowsiness came over her. She took off her earphones, turned off the light, and mentally reviewed today's achievements: her embroidery being praised, her daughter's successful performance, and maintaining the boundary between her hobby and her career. With satisfaction and anticipation for tomorrow's trip to Ngong Ping, she fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning LSD long-distance training run
description: Got up at 05:30, drank warm water, and changed into running shoes. At 05:45, she walked to the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade near her home to meet her running partner Shen Peiwen, and they did an 18 km long slow run at a steady pace of 6:40/km. Along the way, they discussed their ankle recovery progress and shared the joy of her daughter's ballet performance yesterday. At 07:15, they completed the full distance and did a 15-minute systematic stretching session in the promenade's stretching area, focusing on relaxing the calves and hips.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom Promenade (Whampoa Promenade section, 20 Tak Fung Street to Harbour Green)

name: Shower at Home and High-Protein Breakfast
description: Walked 7 minutes back home to Whampoa Garden, took a shower to wash off sweat. In the kitchen, prepared a high-protein smoothie (with banana, whey protein powder, and skim milk), paired with two slices of whole wheat bread. Meanwhile, she checked the weather app on her phone, confirmed there would be showers in the afternoon, and silently adjusted the time for going out later.
location: Flat C, 12th Floor, Block 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Submit CFP assignment
description: In the study, she opened her laptop, logged into the CFP exam system, and reviewed page by page all the assignments from the previous two weeks, focusing on the solution steps and values in the CAPM calculation questions. After confirming everything was correct, she clicked submit and saw the 'Submission Successful' pop-up. She then spent 10 minutes organizing the study materials into folders by subject.
location: Study, Unit C, 12th Floor, Block 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the kids to buy school supplies and preparing for departure
description: Leaving the study, she saw that her mother had already prepared water bottles and small snacks for the children, and reminded the children to take their own little backpacks. She confirmed the dinner menu with her mother, who suggested steamed grouper, and she nodded in agreement. After telling the children to be careful on the road, she took Xuanxuan and Xinxin out. From Whampoa Station she took the MTR to Mong Kok Station, then walked to Chung Nam Plaza Stationery Company. In the stationery section she patiently accompanied the children in choosing: her son Xuanxuan picked a Transformers-patterned schoolbag, and her daughter Xinxin chose a Hello Kitty pencil case. To fulfill their wishes, she bought plenty of manuscript paper, pencils, and erasers. After shopping, on the way she also bought individually packaged snacks at the nearby Okashi Land for use as snacks between classes.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Phase 3, Block 7, Flat C, 12th Floor (departure preparation), Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, Mong Kok, 68 Sai Yeung Choi Street South, Zhongnan Plaza Stationery Company and surrounding area.

name: Mall lunch and return home
description: After shopping, the three went to the food court on the 4th floor of Langham Place for lunch. Yu Xiaowei ordered Japanese chashu ramen, and for the children she ordered cartoon-shaped kids' meals (with French fries, chicken nuggets, and orange juice). Xinxin excitedly played with her new pencil case, and Xuanxuan promised to work even harder after school started. After lunch, carrying three large bags of stationery and snacks, they walked from Langham Place to Mong Kok East Station, took the MTR to Hung Hom Station, and then walked about 10 minutes back to their home in Whampoa Garden. By then the sky was beginning to darken and a few raindrops were falling; Yu Xiaowei was glad they had finished the outdoor activities early.
location: Food court on the 4th floor of Langham Place, 8 Argyle Street, Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; then returned to Flat C, 12th floor, Block 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Check summer vacation homework.
description: After letting the children drink water and rest, Yu Xiaowei took out her son's summer homework notebook and flipped through it. While checking the math section, she found that two pages of "Shapes and Space" exercises at the end had been missed. Xuanxuan panicked, but Yu Xiaowei did not blame him. She pulled him to sit beside her, took out scratch paper, and patiently explained how to count shapes and draw axes of symmetry. Mother and son spent about 50 minutes completing the two pages of exercises together and checking them for correctness.
location: Flat C, 12th Floor, Block 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room dining table)

name: Afternoon tea and rest
description: After finishing their homework, their mother cut up the cantaloupe she had bought from The Whampoa shopping mall and brought it to the table. The family sat on the living room sofa eating fruit and watching the midday news on TV. Xuanxuan and Xinxin pestered their grandmother to tell stories about when they were little, and everyone was happy and relaxed.
location: Flat C, 12th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Phase 3, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room)

name: Afternoon housework and laundry
description: Yu Xiaowei asked her husband Zhang Weiming to stay in the room with the two children so they could take an afternoon nap first. She began doing housework: first, she put two new school uniforms into the washing machine; then, she opened the shoe cabinet at the entrance, wiped and neatly arranged the family's seasonal slippers and sports shoes; finally, she fluffed the sofa cushions, put away the picture books and remote controls scattered on the coffee table, and restored the living room to a fresh and tidy state.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Phase 3, Block 7, 12th Floor, Flat C (Balcony, Living Room, Entryway)

name: Cantonese embroidery touch-up and inspiration notes
description: After finishing the housework, she took out the Cantonese embroidery work Summer in My Daughter's World, which had received high praise from her teacher Wu Xiuying the day before, and examined it closely in the natural light by the window. With small scissors, she trimmed a slightly rough silk thread, then wrote down a new inspiration in her portable embroidery diary: use gradient blue silk thread to express the folds of her daughter's ballet skirt, preparing for the next piece.
location: Flat C, 12th Floor, Tower 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (a corner of the study)

name: Preparing dinner together with mother
description: At 17:00 she entered the kitchen on time and tied on an apron. Yu Xiaowei was in charge of the vegetables and soup: she washed the green radish, carrot, and pork bones, blanched them in cold water, then put them into a soup pot to simmer slowly. Her mother deftly cleaned the grouper. The mother and daughter worked well together; as she cut baby cabbage, she talked with her mother about the specific arrangements for school drop-off and pickup the next day.
location: Flat C, 12th Floor, Tower 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (kitchen)

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming woke up from his nap and got the children to wash their hands and set the table. Dinner was plentiful: steamed grouper, garlic stir-fried baby bok choy, tomato egg soup, and green radish and carrot pork bone soup. The family sat together, eating and chatting about the day's amusing events and the next day's back-to-school plans.
location: Flat C, 12/F, Tower 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (dining room)

name: Whole family wrapping book covers
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei took out transparent book covers and scissors. The whole family sat around the coffee table in the living room. She personally taught her son Xuanxuan how to align the book cover with the edge of the textbook, use a fingertip to smooth out bubbles, and fold the corners neatly. Xinxin sat nearby holding her new schoolbag and helped pass book covers in a serious manner. Her husband played soft background music on his phone, filling the room with a warm back-to-school ritual atmosphere.
location: Flat C, 12th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Phase 3, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room)

name: Tucking daughter into bed and arranging tomorrow's school runs.
description: She took her daughter into the bathroom to wash up. After changing into pajamas, Xinxin insisted on going to bed with her new Hello Kitty schoolbag. Yu Xiaowei sat on the edge of the bed and told her the story 'Little Rabbit Goes to School Obediently.' After 10 minutes, her daughter fell asleep peacefully with a smile. She gently closed the door and went to the living room to discuss tomorrow's school drop-off and pick-up arrangements with her husband. In the end, it was decided that her husband would take the two children to school in the morning, and since she needed to go to the company in the morning to handle client documents, she would be responsible for picking up her daughter from school in the afternoon.
location: Flat C, 12/F, Block 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (daughter's bedroom/living room)

name: Evening family care and pet time.
description: After discussing business matters with her husband, the two of them cleaned up the book covers and paper scraps scattered across the living room. Yu Xiaowei then went to the balcony, took out the pet hairball remedy, and gave a bit to Feizai, who was dozing on the cat tree. The little one contentedly licked its paw. She also filled the children's thermos bottles with warm water and placed them at the entryway, ready for them to grab when they headed out early the next morning.
location: Unit C, 12th Floor, Block 7, Phase 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (living room, balcony)

name: Pre-bed relaxation and preparation for an early night
description: At 21:00 she went into the bedroom and set all the family's alarms half an hour earlier, to 6:00. Then she changed into pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, and emptied her mind. At 21:30 she turned off the lights, put on an eye mask, and fell into a deep sleep before 22:00, recharging for the busy new semester and the new month of work ahead.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Phase 3, Block 7, 12th Floor, Flat C (bedroom)

name: Morning wake-up run.
description: Woke up naturally at 5:30 a.m. and didn't stay in bed. After changing into sportswear and doing a brief stretch, she set off from Whampoa Garden at 5:45 on the dot, jogging along Prince Edward Road West to Kowloon Tsai Park, completing a 2 km easy wake-up run. Today she kept her pace around 6:15/km, focusing on breathing and stride rather than speed. After arriving at the park, she did 5 minutes of deep breathing and leg stretches beside a bench, letting the morning breeze blow away the tension of the new semester, and started walking home at 6:15.
location: Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (along the route from Whampoa Garden to No. 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon Tsai Park)

name: Assisted with meal preparation and the family breakfast
description: At 6:15, she got home, quickly took a shower, and changed into loungewear. She took out the first-day-of-school breakfast ingredients prepared last night from the refrigerator (fried egg toast and wonton noodles), and gently woke up her son and daughter, who were still lying in bed. She and her mother worked in tacit coordination in the kitchen: she was in charge of frying eggs and toasting bread, while her mother cooked the wonton noodles her son loved and prepared hot milk for her daughter. At 7:00 the whole family sat around the dining table. She reminded her son, 'Check your schoolbag later to see if you've missed any notices,' and then braided her daughter's hair.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Whole family escorts the children to school on the first day of school
description: At 7:20, her husband Zhang Weiming drove while Yu Xiaowei sat in the passenger seat, and the two children in the back seat excitedly talked about their new classmates. At 7:40, they arrived at the entrance of Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. She helped her son straighten his school uniform collar and watched him walk into the school gate. At 7:55, they drove to Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street). She held her daughter’s little hand, walked her to the classroom door, kissed her forehead, and said, “Mom will pick you up after school.” After watching her daughter being led into the classroom by the teacher, the couple left at 8:10.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Kowloon Tong, Tin Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School; and Ma Tau Wai, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City Kindergarten

name: Previewing CFP materials during the commute
description: At 8:20, her husband drove off to work, and Yu Xiaowei took the MTR at Kowloon Tong Station. Out of habit, she put on her earphones, opened the CFP online course app, and started listening to the introduction chapter of the Investment Planning module. The subway noise was shut out. As she listened, she quickly jotted down two core concepts in her phone memo: "time value of money" and "risk-return tradeoff." The train changed to the Island Line at Admiralty Station and arrived at Wan Chai Station at 9:00.
location: Along the route from Kowloon Tong Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, via Admiralty Station, to Wan Chai Station, Wan Chai District (MTR Kwun Tong Line and Island Line)

name: Efficient morning at AIA Building
description: At 9:10, she arrived downstairs at the office and first bought a tuna sandwich and a bottle of unsweetened green tea at the convenience store. At 9:20, she officially started work. She opened her computer and handled the following matters: 1. Organized the materials for tomorrow's (September 2) meeting with client Mrs. Chen, prepared two latest savings plan documents, and highlighted the key points; 2. At 10:30, coached new colleague He Junwen, explained common claim-denial cases in medical insurance claims, and had him simulate an explanation letter to a client; 3. At 11:30, briefly communicated with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua (Brother Hua) about the September team goals, and updated the tracking data on the team performance dashboard.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch, eye yoga, and CFP online course
description: At 12:30, colleague Su Lishan invited her to lunch at Men Wah Bing Teng near the company. They ordered a signature barbecued pork with fried egg rice and a cup of iced yuanyang. Yu Xiaowei talked about the funny things from sending her child to school that morning, while Su Lishan shared about her son's newly learned robotics course during the summer vacation. While walking back to the company after lunch, she glanced at the school notice on her phone and saw a parent receipt about "English bridge book subscription" that needed confirmation that evening. At 13:20, back at her desk, she first leaned back in her chair, closed her eyes, and did 5 minutes of eye yoga to relax her tense ciliary muscles. Then she took out her homemade sandwich and green tea, and while eating, continued listening to a 15-minute CFP online course to deepen her understanding of what she had learned on the subway that morning.
location: Office spot at Men Wah Cafe, Luard Road, and AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Out shopping and efficient work at the office
description: At 13:35, after dealing with a few emails, Yu Xiaowei decided to use the free time in the afternoon to go out. She first walked to a stationery store near the office (Johnston Road) and bought the forms and kraft paper book covers needed for her son's subscription to “English Bridge Books.” Then she walked to the bakery on the basement floor of SOGO Department Store in Causeway Bay and, as planned, bought two portions (four in total) of her daughter's favorite croissants as an after-school snack. She arranged with the clerk to pay first and pick them up later in the afternoon on her way, ensuring the croissants would be freshly baked. Back in the office at 14:00, Yu Xiaowei was in good spirits. She set a 60-minute Pomodoro timer and focused on the following tasks: 1. Follow up with potential clients: sent a detailed proposal to a client who had recently asked about retirement planning; 2. Team matters: organized the materials for this Friday's team meeting and sent the key points of the case that new hire He Junwen needed to present; 3. Preparation for tomorrow: double-checked all the materials for the meeting with Mrs. Chen and set a reminder in her digital calendar for tomorrow's departure. At 16:15, she tidied her desk and got ready to leave work early.
location: Stationery store on Johnston Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; basement level of SOGO Department Store at 555 Hennessy Road, Causeway Bay; and the office at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road

name: Commuting to pick up my daughter from school and go home
description: Left the office at 16:30 and walked to Wan Chai Station to take the MTR. She transferred to the Kwun Tong Line at Admiralty Station and arrived at Kowloon Tong Station at 17:05. After exiting the station, she quickened her pace and walked along Dorset Road to Kowloon City Kindergarten. She arrived at the kindergarten gate at 17:15, just in time for dismissal. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin, carrying her schoolbag, saw her mother coming to pick her up and ran over happily. Yu Xiaowei squatted down and took her daughter's hand, and the two walked home along Argyle Street toward Whampoa Garden. On the way, she stopped by SOGO Department Store to pick up the croissants she had pre-ordered.
location: From Wan Chai Station in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, via Admiralty Station to Kowloon Tong Station in Kowloon City District, and from Kowloon City Kindergarten at 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, to Whampoa Garden at 328 Prince Edward Road West, passing SOGO Department Store in Causeway Bay along the way.

name: Family dinner and time with the children.
description: At 18:00 she arrived home. Her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared dinner: steamed grass carp, stir-fried seasonal vegetables with garlic, and tomato-potato soup. Her father Yu Guoqiang was also sitting at the dining table. Yu Xiaowei gave the croissants to her daughter and son as an after-dinner dessert. At the table, her son excitedly shared interesting stories from the new semester, while her daughter showed the 'My Family Portrait' she had drawn in kindergarten today. At 19:00, her husband cleared the table, and Yu Xiaowei checked her son's schoolbag. She found that he had an art class tomorrow and needed to bring watercolor pens, so she helped him pack them in the side pocket of the schoolbag. At 19:15, she played with blocks with her daughter for 15 minutes, enjoying a moment of parent-child time.

Basic consolidation period (Sept. 1-15): study every evening from 8:00 to 9:30, listen to online courses during commutes and lunch breaks, and review knowledge on weekends; 2. Difficult-point breakthrough period (Sept. 16-30): focus on watching tutorial videos for key and difficult chapters, and do accompanying exercises; 3. Mock sprint period (starting in October): complete one mock exam set per week and target gaps with targeted review. She told herself, "Three more, keep going." She sprinted the last repeat with all her might, and her watch showed a pace of 4:45/km. When the workout ended, she was drenched in sweat, yet her mind was unusually calm. In the mechanical repetition she felt a kind of pure release. Sitting on the grass by the track stretching, she felt that running was no longer just tedious numbers, but a way of talking with her body.

Is it the pace, or the more focused version of myself? Perhaps the most important thing about running is not surpassing numbers, but rediscovering that pure joy.”

name: Evening study and reflection journal
description: Walking into the study, she opened the CFP question bank and completed 20 practice questions on risk management and insurance planning within the time limit, with a correct rate of 78%. She marked the knowledge points of the wrong questions in her notebook. Then she took out her training diary and wrote down her feelings about today's run: the 5 kilometers at Flower Market Park still gave her a sense of detachment, like an outsider watching herself run. She decided to make an appointment with Coach Zhao this weekend to talk; maybe he could also give her some inspiration beyond running and help her balance her mindset.
location: Study room, Flat A, 12th Floor, Tower 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: Back in the bedroom, she first completed a second round of eye yoga and used a heated eye mask to relieve the day's eye strain. Then she sat on the edge of the bed and used the Tide app for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, letting her chaotic thoughts slowly settle.
location: Bedroom, Unit A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: After meditation, she gave her already asleep husband and children a gentle kiss. At 23:00 she turned off the lights and went to bed on time, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom, Unit A, 12th Floor, Block 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning easy run and inner dialogue
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally at 5:30 in the morning, put on her running gear, drank a glass of warm water, and went out. She walked to the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade and began a 3 km easy run at a pace of 6:20/km. She deliberately did not pay attention to pace or distance, focusing only on her breathing and bodily sensations. After running past the morning scenery of Victoria Harbour, she did 5 minutes of static stretching by a bench, focusing on loosening her calves and hip flexors, and told herself that running is all about the steadiness of every step.
location: Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home to freshen up and prepare for the school run
description: After her run, Yu Xiaowei returned to her home in Whampoa Garden and quickly showered and changed. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared whole wheat bread and milk. While eating breakfast, Yu Xiaowei confirmed the division of tasks with her mother: she would take her daughter to Kowloon City Kindergarten, and her husband Zhang Weiming would take their son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei left home at 6:55 with her daughter Zhang Yuxin, walked about 10 minutes to the entrance of Kowloon City Kindergarten, watched her daughter happily greet the teacher and go inside, then left with peace of mind and headed to Whampoa MTR Station.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute and CFP online course study.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from home to Whampoa MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, and transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai. During the approximately 45-minute ride, she put on earphones and focused on listening to Chapter 5 of the CFP portfolio management online course, recording the key formulas for calculating risk asset allocation weights to prepare for evening practice questions.
location: From Whampoa MTR Station in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Wan Chai MTR Station (Kwun Tong Line transfer to Island Line)

name: Arriving at the office and morning preparations
description: After arriving at Wan Chai Station, Yu Xiaowei walked to the AIA Building office. She first went to the pantry to get some water and greeted colleagues who had arrived early. Then she opened her computer, checked today's emails, and organized the materials to share at the team morning meeting.
location: Office at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Attended team morning meeting
description: At the team morning meeting hosted by Director Liang Zhenhua, Yu Xiaowei proactively shared her experience from last week in Shenzhen signing a high-end medical insurance policy for Wang Qiming's team, analyzing how to approach from the corporate benefits angle and the unique medical security needs of mainland clients, and received Director Liang's praise and encouragement.
location: Meeting room, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Confirming commission receipt and handling client matters
description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowei checked her mobile banking app and found that the first commission for September plus the Shenzhen signing bonus, totaling HKD 58,000, had arrived. Delighted, she immediately took a screenshot and sent it to her husband Zhang Weiming with a message saying they should discuss the allocation plan in the evening. She then focused on client matters: she replied to Mrs. Chen on WhatsApp to confirm the annual policy review at the cafe in Shui On Centre at 3 p.m. next Tuesday; sent a follow-up message to Shenzhen client Wang Qiming asking about his team's supplementary medical insurance needs; and organized Wednesday's Shenzhen visit notes and detailed client requirements into an electronic document, entered them into the company's client management system, and marked the next follow-up points.
location: Office workstation at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and socializing with colleagues.
description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan went to Manman Café near the office for lunch. She ordered the signature pineapple bun with iced Hong Kong-style milk tea, while Su Lishan had satay beef instant noodles. The two talked about how morning runs felt, and Su Lishan advised her to take it easy and not overtrain. They also chatted about the new colleague in the group. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Mam Man Restaurant, G/F, Hennessy Road Building, 213-219 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take a walk after lunch to refresh my mood
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan took a ten-minute walk on the sidewalk near Gloucester Road and Hennessy Road. After confirming that her husband Zhang Weiming had replied that he could be home on time in the evening, they returned to the office together.
location: Near Gloucester Road and Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Focused on systematic CFP study and practice questions.
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei switched to study mode, took out the CFP risk management question bank and started practicing, aiming to complete 20 questions and strive for an 82% accuracy rate. After finishing each question, she carefully compared the answer explanations, marked the knowledge points related to the incorrect questions, and wrote brief review notes in her notebook.
location: Office workstation at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Coaching and follow-up work for new team members
description: According to Director Liang's arrangement, Yu Xiaowei provided one-on-one business coaching to two newly joined team members. She first listened to their work concerns, then shared client communication cases and insights on creating family financial planning proposals based on her own experience entering the industry, encouraging them to practice more and reflect more. After the coaching, she processed a batch of emails, confirmed next week's client meeting arrangements, and confirmed with her running buddy Shen Peiwen via WhatsApp a long-distance training run at 6:30 Sunday morning at the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, reminding her to bring energy gels and water. Shen Peiwen immediately replied to confirm.
location: Office at AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting home and starting the evening study session.
description: After work, Yu Xiaowei walked to Wan Chai MTR Station, took the Island Line and transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to return to Whampoa. During the 45-minute commute, she continued listening to the CFP online course, focusing on reviewing the portfolio management chapter she had studied in the morning and trying to recite the key calculation steps in her mind.
location: Wan Chai MTR Station to Whampoa MTR Station (Island line, transfer to Kwun Tong line), Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: When Yu Xiaowei got home, her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared dried vegetable pork bone soup and home-style dishes. Her husband Zhang Weiming, children, and father Yu Guoqiang were sitting around the table. She felt warm drinking the hot soup. During the meal, her daughter Zhang Yuxin shared her kindergarten paintings, while her son Zhang Zixuan complained that the math problems were hard. The whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (home dining room)

name: Family financial communication and planning
description: After dinner, the children went to play. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming had their monthly financial discussion in the living room. She explained in detail how she planned to allocate the HK$58,000 that came in today: transfer HK$30,000 to the family joint savings account, set aside HK$20,000 for the next quarter's renewal fees for their son's soccer class and daughter's drawing class, and keep the remaining HK$8,000 as personal spending money for new running shoes and a sports watch. Zhang Weiming agreed and said his September income was expected to be stable, so the monthly household budget would be fine.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden residential estate (living room at home)

name: Parenting time and interest browsing
description: Yu Xiaowei first went to her son Zhang Zixuan's room to help him finish his math homework for the day, focusing on explaining several word problems. Then she returned to the living room to accompany her daughter Zhang Yuxin as she drew an “Underwater World” picture with watercolor markers. In between, she took a moment to check the Cantonese embroidery exchange group, saw a photo of a new embroidery piece “Golden Pheasant and Peony” posted by Teacher Wu Xiuying, with elegant colors. She saved it and planned to visit the Sham Shui Po studio on the weekend to ask about colors and stitch methods.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, No. 6 Dekang Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (children's room and living room)

name: CFP practice question review.
description: Yu Xiaowei sat down at her desk, opened her iPad, and watched a 15-minute CFP exercise explanation video, focusing on reviewing several commonly missed questions she had marked while doing practice questions in the afternoon. The teacher's explanations deepened her understanding of the core concepts of risk management.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 6 Dekang Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (home study)

name: Evening restorative yoga and mindfulness meditation
description: After the children got ready for bed, Yu Xiaowei unrolled a yoga mat in the living room, played soft background music, and did 30 minutes of vinyasa flow yoga, focusing on stretching her legs, hips, and lower back as pre-recovery for Sunday's long-distance training. Then she sat cross-legged for 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation and eye yoga, clearing her thoughts, focusing on her breath, and feeling her body deeply relax.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden residential estate (living room at home)

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After meditation, Yu Xiaowei briefly washed up, returned to the bedroom, and exchanged goodnights with her husband Zhang Weiming, who had already lain down. Lying in bed, she reviewed the day and felt fulfilled and at ease.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate (home bedroom)

name: Go to bed and rest
description: Yu Xiaowei closed her eyes in peace and contentment, gradually drifting into sleep, storing up energy for the next day's Saturday filled with family warmth.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate (home bedroom)

name: Early morning long-distance training
description: Just before dawn, Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally before 4:50, washed up briefly, drank half a glass of warm water, put on her running gear, and brought a water bottle and energy gels. She drove 15 minutes to the Tseung Kwan O Promenade. According to the training plan remotely sent by coach Zhao Zhiming, she completed a 16-kilometer long run at a steady marathon pace of about 6 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer, passing the Cross Bay Bridge and running against the sea breeze. The first half took about 1 hour; she deliberately picked up the pace in the second half and finished in 1 hour 38 minutes. After the run, she did deep stretching on a seaside bench for 15 minutes and took a morning view photo to check in with her coach. While running, a brief sense of emptiness crossed her mind, but she told herself to finish the run first and think about other things later.
location: Tseung Kwan O South Waterfront Promenade, Chi Shin Street, Tseung Kwan O, Sai Kung District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home for breakfast and morning interaction with family
description: After driving home, Yu Xiaowei took a quiet shower and changed into home clothes. Her mother Chen Meiling was already up and had left her some plain congee and scrambled eggs. While eating breakfast, she checked the embroidery kit she would need to bring in the afternoon, confirming that the embroidery hoop, silk thread, small scissors, and other items were all in order, and packed a box of homemade almond cookies to give to Teacher Wu. Then the children got up one after another. She accompanied her daughter Zhang Yuxin in coloring a coloring book and listened to her son Zhang Zixuan describe the “little plan” he had for going to the park with Grandpa that day. She confirmed with her husband Zhang Weiming that he would pick up the children for their football class at noon, and that she would take over after her afternoon class ended as planned. Finally, she double-checked the route and time to Sham Shui Po on her phone calendar, and at exactly 9 o'clock she grabbed her backpack and left the house.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Metro commuting and buying souvenirs
description: Yu Xiaowei boarded at Whampoa Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line at Prince Edward Station, and headed to Sham Shui Po. During the 35-minute commute, she saved the latest detail photos of embroidered works posted by Teacher Wu last week in the Cantonese embroidery exchange group. After arriving at Exit A of Sham Shui Po Station, she deliberately took a detour to "Golden Garden Egg Tart King" on the corner of Cheung Sha Wan Road, and bought six hot, freshly baked puff pastry egg tarts from the first batch out of the oven, as a token of appreciation for her teacher.
location: Golden Garden Egg Tart King, Cheung Sha Wan Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Arrived early at the studio and prepared for the class.
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio fifteen minutes before the appointed time. Teacher Wu Xiuying was organizing silk threads. She put down the egg tarts and cookies and took the initiative to help the teacher sort the goldfish stitch pattern diagrams and silk threads by color for the day’s class. At 10:30, her embroidery friend He Meiling also arrived. The three sat around the tea table by the window, drinking Pu’er tea and catching up. Taking advantage of the relaxed atmosphere, Yu Xiaowei briefly mentioned her recent career confusion. Teacher Wu listened quietly, with understanding in her eyes, which made her feel a little better. She then picked up the base fabric ahead of time to practice the basic rolling stitch and set stitch techniques, warming up for the afternoon class.
location: Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio, 1/F, 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Simple lunch at the studio
description: To save time, He Meiling suggested ordering delivery. Using her phone, Yu Xiaowei ordered stir-fried chicken gizzards with pickled green beans, stir-fried seasonal vegetables with minced garlic, and tomato and egg drop soup from Hunan Flavor Kitchen, a nearby restaurant with good reviews. After the delivery arrived, the three of them ate at the studio table while discussing the difficulties of the goldfish embroidery technique they needed to tackle in the afternoon. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei voluntarily cleaned up the bowls, chopsticks, and the table.
location: Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio, 1/F, 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery class and the teacher suddenly feeling unwell.
description: The core course began. Yu Xiaowei and He Meiling sat next to each other and, under Teacher Wu Xiuying's guidance, learned to use long-and-short stitches and couching stitches to convey the lively motion of a goldfish flicking its tail. Because her stitching technique was wrong, Yu Xiaowei unpicked the threads and re-embroidered; the teacher guided her hand by hand on the correct needle angle. At about 3:30 p.m., during a break, Teacher Wu stood up to make tea and suddenly felt dizzy, her body swaying. Yu Xiaowei noticed immediately and rushed over with He Meiling to support the teacher, helping her recline half-lying on the sofa. She asked He Meiling to fetch warm water while she took out the candy she always kept in her bag, unwrapped it and fed it to the teacher, then used a wet towel to wipe the teacher's forehead and palms.
location: Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio, 1/F, 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize the studio and partnership invitations
description: After Teacher Wu rested for half an hour, her condition was stable but she still needed to recuperate. To put the teacher at ease, Yu Xiaowei suggested that she and Meiling clean up. She rewound and put away the scattered silk threads by color, while He Meiling was responsible for cleaning the table and the floor. Watching the two of them work briskly, Teacher Wu was silent for a long time before speaking. She said she was getting old and wanted to entrust the future of this studio to the two of them to run together, and asked whether they would be willing to jointly carry on this craft. The silk thread in Yu Xiaowei's hand stopped, and her heart skipped a beat. This trust made her feel honored and warm, but it also brought great responsibility and uncertainty. Her eyes slightly moist, she looked at He Meiling, who was equally surprised, took a deep breath, and said she needed time to think it over carefully.
location: Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio, 1/F, 245 Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Farewell at the studio and late-night talk at the MTR station
description: After leaving the studio, Yu Xiaowei and He Meiling walked to Sham Shui Po MTR station together. While waiting on the platform, she couldn't help sharing her initial feelings about the studio invitation with He Meiling. She felt it was a godsend, but worried that she wasn't capable enough and would find it hard to balance family and insurance work. He Meiling responded seriously, saying that she had good craft skills and great ideas, and that the two of them would definitely make it work together, but she needed to think it through carefully. The two chatted until the Tsuen Wan line train for He Meiling arrived, and they agreed to talk in detail over the phone on Monday evening.
location: Sham Shui Po MTR Station, near the Exit C turnstile, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home to share dinner together.
description: Yu Xiaowei pushed open the front door, and the aroma of food greeted her. Her mother, Chen Meiling, and her husband, Zhang Weiming, had already prepared dinner. She put down her bag and joined them with a smile. At the table, she listened to her son Zhang Zixuan vividly describe the cool remote-controlled car he had seen with Grandpa Yu Guoqiang in the park during the day, and picked some broccoli for her daughter Zhang Yuxin. She temporarily set aside her studio matters and immersed herself in the warmth of family, but the turmoil in her heart had not yet calmed.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time and family matters.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei first helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin finish a simple drawing assignment and read two picture books with her. Then she moved to the study to help her son Zhang Zixuan check his weekend math practice problems. When she found he was stuck on a word problem, she patiently guided him to understand it by drawing a diagram. At exactly 21:00, she and her husband Zhang Weiming put the children to bed together.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's deep late-night conversation
description: After the children were asleep, Yu Xiaowei poured a glass of warm water for her husband Zhang Weiming, and the two leaned against the headboard. She told her husband in full detail about Teacher Wu's invitation to jointly run a studio during the day, including the scene at the time and her inner feelings. Zhang Weiming did not respond immediately, but analyzed point by point: in terms of time, Saturday afternoons were feasible, but if she needed to go to the studio on weekdays, what about her main insurance business? In terms of finances, was it an initial investment or a commissioned operation? And how much energy would the two children at home require? Finally, he held her hand and said that as long as she liked it, he would definitely support her, but she must plan carefully. The main business was the ballast of the family; stabilize that first before considering other things. Yu Xiaowei leaned on his shoulder and nodded heavily.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime meditation, planning, and sleep
description: After talking with her husband, Yu Xiaowei changed into her pajamas, sat cross-legged on the yoga mat by the bay window, and did a 15-minute mindfulness meditation using a guided meditation app to calm the excitement and anxiety caused by the invitation. Then she did 10 minutes of eye yoga to relieve the eye strain from a long day. Next, she took out her phone and wrote down the next steps in her notes: discuss the plan with He Meiling, evaluate time and energy allocation, understand the studio's financial situation, and consult mentor Liang Zhenhua for advice. After turning off her phone, she gently kissed her sleeping husband's forehead, switched off the desk lamp, and recorded her weight for the day as 53.8 kg. With expectations for the future and a heavy sense of responsibility, she slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early morning wake-up, morning run, shower, and change of clothes
description: Sunday morning, sunlight came into the bedroom, waking up a bit later than usual. The calves were still slightly sore from yesterday's long run. First drank a glass of warm water, changed into loose workout clothes, and did dynamic stretching in the living room to mobilize the hip joints and ankles. Then went out for a 4 km recovery run along Prince Edward Road West, controlling the pace at 6:50/km, running back and forth in the Kowloon City section, keeping the heart rate in the aerobic zone, and flushing out lactic acid at a comfortable rhythm. After the run, she did static stretching downstairs, then returned home. She quickly showered to wash off the sweat, changed into loungewear, briefly chatted with her husband Zhang Weiming about the morning run, and discussed taking the whole family out for dim sum later.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, Chui Yeung Court, and along Prince Edward Road West

name: The whole family went to Mong Kok for dim sum.
description: The family of six walked to MTR Whampoa Station and took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station. On the train, the children excitedly talked about dim sum. After arriving at Kam Wah Café, they had a short wait for a table, then ordered shrimp dumplings, siu mai, barbecue pork buns, pineapple buns, and pu-erh tea. Mother Chen Meiling and father Yu Guoqiang shared amusing stories about yesterday's chess game in the park, while the daughter and son ate happily. I took photos of the dim sum with my phone and sent them to the family group. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Kam Wah Café, G/F, 47 Fuk Wa Street, Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home and morning family time.
description: After dim sum breakfast, the whole family took the MTR back to Whampoa. When getting out of the station, her daughter was attracted by the daisies at a roadside flower shop, so she bought two for her. After arriving home, her husband and son assembled the LEGO Space series in the living room while her daughter painted with watercolors. She took out her yoga mat and did 15 minutes of gentle yoga while guiding her husband through the instructions. During that time, she replied to a few messages about the Cantonese embroidery studio on her phone, then put the phone down and devoted herself fully to the family.
location: Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shopping at Kowloon City Market
description: Leaving my husband at home to look after the children, I took advantage of the cool morning and walked to the Kowloon City Market. At the Kee Wah Bakery stall, I bought two boxes of double-yolk white lotus seed paste mooncakes and one box of miniature snow skin mooncakes, planning to give them to my mother and mother-in-law. Then I browsed the fruit stalls. Seeing that the Japanese air-freighted Akizuki pears and Kyoho grapes looked tempting, I bought a bag of each, intending to use them as a healthy snack while watching a movie tonight. After shopping, I walked home carrying the items.
location: Kowloon City Market, 102 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch time
description: Mother prepared a simple lunch at home, making dry-fried yi noodles and dressed cucumber. I helped set the tableware. The family sat around together, chatting about fun stories from dim sum breakfast and the street market while eating, enjoying the taste of home cooking.
location: Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, returned to the bedroom, turned on the air conditioner, and lay down to rest for about half an hour to save energy for the afternoon get-together with close friends.
location: Bedroom, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparation and heading to Causeway Bay
description: Waking from her nap feeling refreshed, she changed into a floral dress, paired with white canvas shoes and light lipstick, and checked her belongings. She texted her best friend Lin Jiaxin to set a meeting time, then walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, and transferred to the Island Line to Causeway Bay. On the subway, she wore earphones to listen to relaxing music and browsed messages in the Sunday marathon training group, seeing the coach's comments on yesterday's long-run data and giving herself a thumbs-up.
location: Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to MTR Causeway Bay Station

name: Shopping and afternoon tea in Causeway Bay
description: Met Lin Jiaxin in the atrium on the first floor of Times Square. First we browsed Lane Crawford and tried on autumn trench coats and boots, giving each other opinions. Then we went to Lady M on the third floor for the classic mille crêpes cake and Earl Grey tea. During the chat, I confided my vague worry about the recent distance between me and my Shenzhen friends Huang Wenhui and Zhou Minyi, as well as my excitement and concerns about Teacher Wu's invitation to co-run a Cantonese embroidery studio. Lin Jiaxin patiently comforted me, advised me not to overthink my friends, and rationally reminded me that the studio should be run on a part-time basis in the early stage to manage time and energy costs.
location: Times Square, 1 Matheson Street, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Lady M (Times Square branch)

name: Returning home and resting.
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Jiaxin at the entrance to Times Square, I took the MTR back the same way. When I got out at Whampoa Station, I stopped by Maxim's Cakes on the way and bought a croissant for tomorrow's breakfast. After getting home, I put away the mooncakes and fruit and drank a large glass of water. My husband was helping our son put together the last few pieces of Lego. I rested for a little while, feeling uplifted by the afternoon's good conversation and having a clearer idea about the studio matters.
location: MTR Causeway Bay Station to Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family movie night and preparations.
description: My husband, daughter, and I prepared movie-night snacks in the kitchen: I used the air fryer to make oil-free, low-fat popcorn; my husband made a special drink with oranges, apples, and mint leaves; and my daughter was in charge of putting washed Kyoho grapes into bowls. At six, the whole family sat together in the living room, drew the curtains, and played the Disney animation Zootopia on the projector, sharing snacks. My daughter applauded Officer Judy, my son focused on analyzing the plot, and I leaned on my husband's shoulder, enjoying the cozy atmosphere.
location: Living room, Chui Yeung Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child bedtime moments.
description: After the movie ended, she urged the two children to take baths. She bathed her daughter, changed her into pajamas, and blow-dried her hair. Then, in the children's room, she told her son an astronaut bedtime story and hummed her daughter's favorite nursery rhyme twice. After they fell asleep peacefully, she gently closed the door.
location: Children's room and bathroom, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night conversation between husband and wife
description: After her husband finished dealing with work emails, the two went to the bedroom balcony for some air. I shared in detail how I felt about meeting Lin Jiaxin in the afternoon, including my confusion about a Shenzhen friend growing distant and my worries about the Cantonese embroidery studio. My husband analyzed it patiently and suggested I first consult my mentor Liang Zhenhua to hear prudent advice from someone with experience. I nodded in agreement and felt much more at ease.
location: Balcony of the master bedroom, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bed relaxation, checking to-dos, and going to sleep
description: Changed into loose pajamas. On the bedroom carpet, she first did 10 minutes of eye yoga to relieve eye strain, then dimmed the lights and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath to sort through and settle the day's thoughts, restoring inner calm. She then opened the notes app on her phone to confirm tomorrow's to-do list: handle emails for the Cantonese embroidery studio in the morning, and review insurance policies with client Mrs. Chen at the cafe in Shiu Kin Centre at 3 p.m. After setting the alarm for 7 a.m., she gently kissed her husband's cheek, said goodnight, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: Master bedroom, Cuiyang Court, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early-morning wake-up and morning run
description: The alarm went off on time, and she got up quickly. After washing up, she changed into her running gear (compression tights, quick-dry T-shirt, running shoes) and checked her Bluetooth earphones and heart rate strap. The sky outside was faintly bright, and the air was humid. She walked to the starting point of the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade (entrance at 20 Tak Fung Street), did a 5-minute dynamic warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, jumping jacks), and jogged 3 km along the waterfront at a comfortable pace (about 6:30/km) to Laguna Verde and turned back. After the run, she did static stretching on a bench, focusing on relaxing the front of her thighs and her calves, to prepare for the evening workout.
location: Home at Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street

name: Cantonese embroidery studio video conference
description: After stretching, she immediately called He Meiling on WeChat video. The two discussed taking over Teacher Wu's studio for about 45 minutes and confirmed the division of work: He Meiling is responsible for course design, embroidery technique organization, and material procurement; Xiaowei is responsible for external liaison, market development, and financial planning. They agreed to go to Sham Shui Po together on the weekend to discuss the details with Teacher Wu.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Whampoa Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District (a bench facing the sea view)

name: Returning home to wash up and take a short rest.
description: After walking home, I took a quick shower and changed back into loungewear. While drying my hair, I thought back to my conversation with Meiling and felt that we were in sync. The timing was just right, so I was ready to go downstairs for breakfast.
location: Home at Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Breakfast and family conversation
description: Her mother prepared preserved egg and lean pork congee and fried eggs. During the meal, she discussed the weekend plans with her husband, confirming that they would go visit Brother Hua and go to Sham Shui Po to finalize the studio matters. Her husband expressed understanding and volunteered to take on the task of looking after the children. She also confirmed to her mother that she would not be home for dinner tonight. The family rarely had breakfast together, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: At 7:55, holding my daughter's hand, I left home and walked 8 minutes to the kindergarten. At the school gate, I straightened her schoolbag, hugged her goodbye, and told her, "Have a happy day today." Watching her skip inside, I felt at ease.
location: Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten, Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to work
description: Walked from the kindergarten along Prince Edward Road West and entered Prince Edward Station via the pedestrian footbridge. The weather was hot and humid, with possible showers. She used the time on the MTR: first opened the notes app on her phone to organize the studio division-of-labor details and set a weekend reminder; then listened to the CFP investment module online course audio and completed 3 in-class quiz questions; finally sent a WhatsApp message to her mentor Liang Zhenhua to ask about a time to consult over the weekend.
location: Walk from Prince Edward Road West in Kowloon City District to MTR Prince Edward Station, then take the MTR Kwun Tong Line, Tsuen Wan Line, and East Rail Line to the Immigration Department Tower at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai.

name: Office work and client preparation
description: Arrived at the office at 9:25. At 9:30 attended the team weekly meeting, shared insights from closing deals in Shenzhen last week, and reminded everyone to pay attention to the insurance needs of mainland residents in Hong Kong. After the meeting, I handled 5 emails and sent a greeting WeChat message to long-time client Wang Qiming. From 10:30 to 11:30, I prepared materials for the afternoon meeting with Mrs. Chen, printed the cash values and coverage changes for 3 policies, and wrote a summary list by hand. At 11:30, I coached a new team colleague on underwriting process questions.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch with Su Lishan and CFP study.
description: Arrived at the cha chaan teng five minutes early to grab seats, and Su Lishan arrived shortly after. We ordered pineapple buns with butter and hot milk tea. The main discussion was on CFP dynamic rebalancing and factor strategies. Su Lishan used a high-net-worth client case to break down in detail how to adjust the stock-bond ratio based on market factors, and Xiaowei suddenly saw the light.
location: Man Man Cafe (Thomson Building Branch), 93-103 Thomson Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned to the office for flexible work
description: Back in the office, she used the lunch break to reply to several client inquiries on her phone and handled a simple insurance claim. She then opened the CFP electronic question bank and, while the momentum was fresh, did 10 dynamic balance calculation questions, scoring 80% correct. Her thinking became much clearer, and she felt more confident about meeting clients in the afternoon.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to policy review with client Mrs. Chen
description: I asked my supervisor for 15 minutes off in advance, then walked to Shui On Centre, arriving in just a few minutes. I got there early, picked a quiet corner, and ordered two hot lattes. Mrs. Chen arrived on time. I handed over the policy summaries and explained the dividend and coverage changes item by item. I suggested Mrs. Chen increase her critical illness sum insured by 5% per year in line with inflation, introduced the enhanced plan with additional multiple cancer payouts, and also asked whether her husband's company would be interested in group high-end medical insurance. Mrs. Chen was satisfied, said she would consider it, and made an appointment to discuss details next Tuesday.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 6-8 Harbour Road, Shui On Centre, Shop 103, 1/F, Coffee by the Bay

name: Brief shopping trip
description: After the meeting, I walked to a nearby sporting goods store. I picked out a pair of compression training pants that can be worn as an inner layer or as outerwear, for training as autumn approaches. I also bought 2 packs of energy gels to prepare for weekend race training. A small reward for myself today.
location: Sports goods store, Lee Tung Avenue, Queen's Road East, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: On the commute home
description: After shopping, she took the MTR home. She began planning the evening study tasks: she would first have dinner with her family, then do practice problems at 8:30 p.m., aiming for an accuracy rate of over 85%. On the train, she sent coach Zhao Zhiming a message to confirm tonight's training: Coach, 400-meter intervals at Kowloon Bay sports ground tonight. There's something I want to say after it ends. The coach replied in agreement.
location: MTR East Rail line (Wan Chai to Admiralty, transfer to West Rail line to Hung Hom, then transfer to East Rail line to Mong Kok East)

name: Family dinner and replenishing energy
description: When she got home, dinner was already prepared. Her mother had made steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce and stir-fried choy sum. She quickly finished a bowl of rice to replenish carbohydrates. During the meal, her son talked about fun moments playing football with classmates, and her daughter imitated a little rabbit. The whole family was full of laughter, and her fatigue disappeared.
location: Home dining room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-training preparation and heading to the sports field
description: After dinner, she helped her mother clear away the dishes, went back to her room to change into training clothes and running shoes, and checked her earphones, water bottle, and heart rate strap. Taking a deep breath, she set her goal to complete the workout rather than chase speed. She walked to Mong Kok East Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon Bay Station, then walked five minutes to the sports ground, listening to light music to relax on the way.
location: From home at Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon Bay Sports Ground, Kwun Tong District (via MTR from Mong Kok East Station to Kowloon Bay Station).

name: Interval running training and coach communication
description: Coach Zhao was already warming up. After a brief exchange, I began 10 sets of 400-meter intervals, each run at full effort, with 200 meters of slow jogging between sets for recovery. On the sixth set, a feeling of detachment swept over me, and I almost wanted to stop, but I gritted my teeth and finished the last four sets, hitting the target pace. After the session, the coach handed me water. Sitting by the track, I confided, 'Recently, training has felt so empty; I can't find the pure joy of going sub-2 in my first half marathon.' The coach replied, 'Have you considered changing your training goal from sub-3 to enjoying the sound of every footfall?' At that, I was suddenly enlightened.
location: By the track at Kowloon Bay Sports Ground, Kwun Tong District

name: Commute home
description: After saying goodbye to the coach, she went home alone, replaying the coach's words in her mind. She decided to let go of her obsession with results and put her energy into the Cantonese embroidery studio and the CFP exam, feeling much lighter.
location: MTR Kwun Tong Line (Kowloon Bay to Mong Kok East) and walk back to Whampoa Garden

name: Family time and being with the kids
