description: After getting home and taking a shower, she played with building blocks with her daughter and helped her son check his math homework, patiently guiding him to draw diagrams to solve word problems. At 9:00 p.m., her husband put their daughter to bed, while Xiaowei and her son organized the art supplies for the next day.
location: Living room and children's room at home, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: CFP study and emotional processing
description: The children are all asleep, and the house is quiet. I made a cup of honey water, opened the CFP question bank app, and focused on tackling the investment module. In 40 minutes I completed 15 questions with an 85% accuracy rate, meeting my goal. In my running log I wrote: 'Coach said, enjoy the sound of landing. Okay, I'll try. C'est la vie.'
location: Study at home, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening relaxation and preparation
description: Turned off her phone and did 10 minutes of eye yoga to relieve screen fatigue. She shared insights from her conversation with the coach with her husband lying in bed. He comforted her: "Being happy is the most important thing. Forget about achievements – as long as our family is safe, that's enough." Leaning on her husband's shoulder, she felt secure. Before bed, she checked her phone; her mentor Liang Zhenhua still had not replied, so she decided to follow up tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: After confirming the next day's work schedule, I put down my phone and my thoughts, turned off the light, and fell asleep. Fatigue, confusion, and gains all stayed in my dreams.
location: Bedroom at home, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wake up, wash up, and prepare.
description: After the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei stayed in bed for five more minutes to ease the fatigue from last night's interval run. After getting up, she opened the curtains to check the sky, saw dark clouds, remembered that the weather forecast had predicted thundershowers, and took a folding umbrella from the storage cabinet into her commuter bag. Then she quickly washed up, changed into the yoga clothes she had prepared in advance, and went to the kitchen to help her mother take breakfast ingredients such as milk, bread, and fruit out of the refrigerator and set them on the table, getting breakfast ready for the whole family.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning Ashtanga yoga practice
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived on time at Whampoa Fitness Centre for the early morning yoga class. During the class, the instructor focused on guiding the students to bring their breath into the rhythm of the poses. Yu Xiaowei started with Sun Salutations and gradually went deeper. Although her body felt stiff from the previous day's interval run, she gradually loosened up with deep breathing. The final Savasana rest let her completely relax and restored her energy.
location: 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home for a shower and quick breakfast.
description: After walking home from the fitness center, Yu Xiaowei took a quick shower to wash away the sweat. She changed into a pre-ironed white shirt and a dark blue A-line skirt, with a thin gold necklace. In the dining room, she ate the fried egg toast and non-fat latte her mother had prepared while talking to her son and daughter, who were having breakfast. She asked about her son's math homework and her daughter's time at kindergarten. Before leaving, she applied a hydrating mask in front of the mirror to ensure she looked fresh, preparing for the contract signing in the afternoon.
location: At home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei put up her umbrella and walked hand in hand with her daughter to Kowloon City Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter excitedly shared the cartoon she had watched last night, and Yu Xiaowei smiled in response. After arriving at the kindergarten gate, she crouched down to straighten her daughter's collar, had a brief exchange with the head teacher, and reminded the teacher that her daughter had a slight cough recently. After watching her daughter skip into the classroom, she turned and left.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commuted to the office and studied efficiently.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from the kindergarten to Mong Kok East Station and took the MTR Kwun Tong Line and Island Line to Wan Chai. On the train, she put on Bluetooth earphones and used a mobile app to replay at 1.5x speed the part of the CFP "Investment Planning" course she had missed because of yesterday's run, quickly noting key formulas and case points in a note-taking app, making full use of her commuting time to study.
location: From Mong Kok East Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District (MTR Kwun Tong Line, Island Line)

name: Office work and client communication
description: After arriving at the AIA Insurance office in the Immigration Department Tower in Wan Chai, Yu Xiaowei first made herself a cup of hot tea. She logged into the email system to process unread emails, then sent the prepared high-end medical renewal plan and comparison table to client Wang Qiming as a PDF, along with a voice message explaining key clause updates. She then turned her focus to the afternoon signing: she pulled up client Chen Meiling's family policy file, checked the benefit illustration data a third time to ensure figures such as cash value and death benefit were accurate, and did the final sequencing of the Uplift Future proposal and the tablet presentation file. During this, she stood up to stretch her neck, ate a few blueberries and soda crackers for energy, and silently rehearsed the afternoon communication flow and key Q&A points.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch with colleague Su Lishan.
description: Yu Xiaowei went with her closest colleague Su Lishan to Man Man Cha Chaan Teng near their company. They ordered the signature curry beef brisket rice and pineapple buns, chatting while they ate. Yu Xiaowei shared how she felt physically and mentally during last night's 300-meter interval runs and her coach's encouragement to enjoy running. Su Lishan laughed and said she had finally figured things out. Yu Xiaowei also quietly told Su Lishan about her video call with He Meiling the previous day to discuss the division of work in the Cantonese embroidery studio, and mentioned that she would go to Sham Shui Po for a face-to-face talk on the weekend. Su Lishan expressed support and reminded her to watch her time balance.
location: Man Man Cafe (Thomson Building Branch), 93-103 Thomson Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Final check and preparations to head out
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the office, opened Mrs. Chen's signing file package again, and arranged the printed documents in signing order. She charged her tablet fully, put the presentation slides into full-screen mode, and wrote down a few talking points in her notebook in response to possible client questions. When everything was ready, she took a deep breath, picked up her commuter bag containing the documents, tablet, and umbrella, and set off early for Taikoo Shing.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to Taikoo Shing and prepare tea and snacks.
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR Island Line from Wan Chai to Tai Koo Station. After exiting the station, she deliberately went to a traditional bakery at Cityplaza and, from memory, bought a box of Mrs. Chen's favorite coconut black tea scones. Then she found a quiet café in the mall, ordered an American coffee, sat down to review the presentation content on her tablet again, adjusted her mindset, and made final preparations for the upcoming contract signing.
location: Cityplaza, 18 Taikoo Shing Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the coffee shop inside it

name: Visited client Chen Meiling and successfully signed the contract
description: Yu Xiaowei rang Mrs. Chen's doorbell on time. After entering, she first handed over the still-warm scones, which made Mrs. Chen very happy. After sitting down, Yu Xiaowei reviewed the family's overall annual policy returns for Mrs. Chen on a tablet, explained the current economic environment in plain language, and then opened a comparison page to demonstrate the cash flows of three popular AIA savings insurance products for short-term break-even, medium-term growth, and long-term wealth transfer. She ultimately recommended the "Abundant Future" series because of its stable long-term returns and suitability for education fund planning. Mrs. Chen raised questions about withdrawal ratios and the fulfillment ratio of non-guaranteed benefits; Yu Xiaowei answered each with professional knowledge, and Mrs. Chen signed the documents after concurring. After signing, they chatted for another half hour about family and children in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: At Chen Meiling's home, Golden Terrace, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Return trip and family communication
description: Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to Mrs. Chen and walked briskly out of the residential complex. At once, she sent a WhatsApp message to her husband Zhang Weiming: "Contract signed! Tonight, could you pick up our daughter? I'll go buy the remote-control car parts." After receiving his confirmation, she also video-called her son, told him the contract was signed, and promised to buy the remote-control car parts for him after work. Her son cheered excitedly on the other end. She then took the MTR from Taikoo Station back to her office in Wan Chai.
location: From Jindian Terrace, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District (MTR Tai Koo Station)

name: Organize documents and briefings
description: Back at the office, Yu Xiaowei hummed a tune while efficiently sorting and archiving the electronic files from the contract signing, and updated Mrs. Chen's policy status and next follow-up date in the customer management system. Then she drafted a concise signing report and sent it with images to regional sales director Liang Zhenhua, reporting the premium, policy term, and the client's potential needs. Finally, she tidied her desk and prepared to leave work.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute after work and continue studying
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR Island Line from Wan Chai and transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to go home. During the commute, she put on earphones and continued listening to the online course recording for the CFP risk management module. When she reached key points, she quickly jotted down insights in the memo app on her phone, planning to finish the remaining lessons and practice questions after getting home.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District to Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District (MTR Island Line, Kwun Tong Line)

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: After arriving home, her mother had already set out lotus root and pork rib soup and several home-style dishes on the dining table. Her husband said he had already picked up their daughter. Yu Xiaowei happily announced to the family that the contract signing had succeeded that afternoon, and her mother and husband both cast approving glances. The family sat together for the meal. While eating, she asked her son about funny things at school and put some broccoli, which her daughter loves, onto her daughter's plate. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child interaction time
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei first took out the remote-control car parts she had brought back and sat on the floor with her son to assemble them together according to the instructions. When they finished, her son excitedly tried it out in the living room. Then she went into her daughter's room, accompanied her daughter in finishing her doodle homework, and read two picture books that her daughter liked. Finally, she helped her daughter brush her teeth, wash her face, change into pajamas, and coaxed her to sleep.
location: Living room and children’s room at home in Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening study and CFP practice
description: After the children were settled, Yu Xiaowei made herself a cup of chrysanthemum and goji berry tea and went into the study. She concentrated and finished listening to the remaining CFP "Investment Planning" course that she hadn't finished during her morning commute, adding important knowledge points to her notebook. Then she opened the practice question bank and completed the 30 practice questions in the asset allocation module. The process required considerable thought. When she checked the answers, she found that she got 5 wrong. She saved screenshots of the wrong questions to her mistake-notebook app, carefully reviewed the explanations, and noted where her understanding had gone off track to ensure she had fully mastered the content.
location: Home study in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Eye yoga, meditation, and relaxation
description: After closing the book, Yu Xiaowei walked to the window and looked into the distance for a few minutes to relax her eyes, then returned to the study mat, closed her eyes, and did 10 minutes of eye yoga and 10 minutes of simple meditation. She focused on her breathing, letting go of the joy of signing the contract and the pressure of studying, letting the day's fatigue gradually dissolve.
location: Study and balcony at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night talk with her husband
description: After her husband finished, the two of them went to the balcony, where the rain had stopped and the air was fresh. Yu Xiaowei leaned on her husband's shoulder and shared the details of the afternoon's contract signing and her sense of accomplishment. Her husband hugged her and praised her. She mentioned that she needed to go to Sham Shui Po over the weekend to meet He Meiling about the studio. Her husband understood and said he would take care of all the children's pickups and drop-offs over the weekend. Yu Xiaowei was touched, kissed his cheek, and they said goodnight.
location: Balcony at home in the Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Pre-Bedtime Preparations
description: Back in the bedroom, Yu Xiaowei sent He Meiling a WeChat message to confirm their Saturday afternoon plans in Sham Shui Po, then quickly glanced through tomorrow's schedule and set an alarm on her phone. After plugging in her phone, she turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, recalled the day's full and smooth experiences—from healing yoga to the flawless contract signing to sticking with her studies. A steady, satisfying sense of happiness washed over her. She adjusted her sleeping position and soon drifted off.
location: Bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Morning run and training log
description: Yu Xiaowei set off from her home at Whampoa Garden and jogged to the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, completing an easy 3 km morning run at a pace of about 6:20/km. The sea breeze blew gently, and she focused on her breathing and stride. After returning home and showering, she wrote a ten-day training diary in the study, recording the recent feeling of 'detachment' — as running became a chase after pace, the original joy seemed diluted. Then she sent a message to her coach Zhao Zhiming on her phone, arranging to talk about her recent feelings after Saturday's training.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: Yu Xiaowei walked into the dining room, where her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared breakfast: plain congee, fried eggs, pork floss, and stir-fried greens. Her husband Zhang Weiming was pouring milk for their son Zhang Zixuan, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin was still rubbing her eyes. Yu Xiaowei told the family about her plan to take their daughter to Sha Tin to see the Cantonese embroidery exhibition that morning. The daughter immediately became alert and shouted excitedly, "Look at the embroidery! Look at the embroidery!" Her husband reminded them to be careful on the road, and her son talked about yesterday's school football match. After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter check her schoolbag and walked her to Kowloon City Kindergarten, holding her hand. On the way, the daughter kept asking questions about embroidery. After sending her daughter into the school, Yu Xiaowei nodded to the teacher and left.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home to prepare and commute to Sha Tin Museum
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei hurried home, changed into comfortable casual clothes, and picked up the snacks and water she had prepared for her daughter. She then walked from home to Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Prince Edward Station, and transferred to the East Rail Line toward Sha Tin. On the train, she pulled out her phone and browsed the exhibition map for "Lingnan Embroidery Charm" at the Hong Kong Heritage Museum, marking exhibit highlights and interactive area locations. She also sent a voice message to her mother, saying that her daughter was very interested in Cantonese embroidery and would share the details by video after returning home.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking her daughter to visit the Cantonese embroidery exhibition and returning home
description: Yu Xiaowei waited at the entrance of the Hong Kong Heritage Museum. Her husband Zhang Weiming picked up their daughter from kindergarten and drove to the museum entrance to meet her. The mother and daughter entered the Lingnan Embroidery Charm exhibition hall. Yu Xiaowei pointed at the exquisite Guangdong embroidery screen and explained to her daughter the difference between horsetail embroidery and couched gold-thread embroidery. In the interactive area, they chose an embroidery card with a lychee pattern. The staff provided needles, thread, and cloth. Yu Xiaowei held her daughter's little hand and taught her to outline the lychee with a basic running stitch. After more than an hour, they finished the work. The daughter carefully held the card and said she wanted to show it to grandma. After the visit, they took the MTR back to Kowloon City. On the way, the daughter fell asleep from exhaustion. Yu Xiaowei held her close and sent her mother a group photo of the work on her phone, with a text expressing her daughter's enthusiasm for learning embroidery.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sha Tin District, 1 Man Lam Road, Hong Kong Heritage Museum

name: Go home for lunch and rest
description: When she got home, her mother had already prepared lunch: tomato and egg noodles with blanched greens. Her daughter couldn't wait to show her grandmother the embroidery work as soon as she entered the door. Her mother put on her reading glasses, examined it carefully, and praised the neat lychee stitches. Yu Xiaowei sat nearby watching the grandmother and granddaughter chat, and ate a bowl of noodles herself. After the meal, she asked her mother to put her daughter down for a nap first while she prepared for the afternoon's work.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the office in Wan Chai
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her business attire and high heels, picked up her briefcase, and left. Taking the MTR from Whampoa Station, she transferred from the Kwun Tong Line to the Tsuen Wan Line and then to the Island Line to reach Wan Chai Station. On the way, she opened her laptop and reviewed the PPT for the Global Guardian cross-border high-end medical insurance plan, mentally rehearsing how to introduce the coverage and claims process to client Wang Qiming. After arriving at Wan Chai Station, she walked to her company building.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Office work and client meetings
description: After sitting down at her desk, Yu Xiaowei first opened the system and filed the "Affluent Future" policy documents for Chen Meiling, who signed yesterday, confirming that the commission entry was correct. Then she replied one by one to the five client emails that had accumulated in the morning and scheduled face-to-face meetings with two clients who had inquired about critical illness insurance for next Tuesday afternoon. Her colleague Su Lishan brought her a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea, and the two chatted for a while. Later, she went to the pantry to eat a few digestive biscuits and drink some water. Around 15:40, she began printing the materials for Wang Qiming, placed them in a blue folder, and sent Mr. Wang a confirmation text message. At 16:00, she packed up and left early. She first went to the convenience store at Convention Plaza downstairs to buy water, then walked to the cafe at Shui On Centre, chose a window booth, and ordered a hot lemon honey drink to wait. At 16:30, Wang Qiming arrived on time. Yu Xiaowei handed him the proposal and introduced in detail how "Global Guardian" covers the world's top hospitals and provides unlimited hospitalization coverage, using examples to explain cross-border emergency rescue and medication coordination. Mr. Wang asked questions about premium payment methods and the scope of the direct-billing network hospitals. Yu Xiaowei answered them one by one and emphasized that the core advantage lay in the referral green channel. Mr. Wang said the plan suited the team's needs, but he needed to discuss the annual budget with his partner and promised to reply within a week. Yu Xiaowei sent him the electronic materials and her business card via WhatsApp and thanked him for taking the time.
location: Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to the sports ground for a run and return home
description: After leaving the coffee shop, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Wan Chai Station, transferring from the Island Line to the Tsuen Wan Line and then to the Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon Bay Station. On the way, she briefly replied to her husband about the dinner time arrangement and to an old client's policy renewal inquiry. After arriving, she walked to the changing room at Kowloon Bay Sports Ground and changed into her running gear. After warming up for a few minutes, she began a 5 km tempo run, maintaining a steady pace of 5:55/km, her target half-marathon pace. She focused on her breathing and rhythm. Although she still felt a sense of detachment inside, she told herself to enjoy the running itself. After the run, she stretched her legs carefully and drank water. Then she jogged to Kowloon Bay Station, took the Kwun Tong Line extension back to Whampoa Station, and walked home. On the way, she sent her husband a message. He replied that dinner was ready and that their daughter and her grandmother were doing embroidery together.
location: Kowloon Bay Sports Ground, 1 Kai Lok Street, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family evening time.
description: When Yu Xiaowei arrived home, her mother had made steamed grass carp and garlic broccoli. At the dinner table, her daughter excitedly described today's embroidery lesson and took out a card to show everyone. Her son shared details of his goal in the football match. Her husband listened while serving food to everyone, and the atmosphere was warm. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother clear the dishes. Then she made a WeChat video call to her mother, who had already returned home in Kwun Tong. The two chatted about her daughter's interest in Cantonese embroidery, and her mother happily agreed to come over every Saturday afternoon to teach her daughter the basic stitches. Yu Xiaowei felt that intergenerational parent-child courses might become popular in the future. After the video call, her daughter, exhausted from playing during the day, quickly became sleepy, so Yu Xiaowei read her a bedtime story to lull her to sleep. Then she went to her son's room to check his homework and patiently explained a math word problem.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening relaxation, late-night talk with her husband, then sleep.
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the study and first did 15 minutes of eye yoga to relax her eyes, then practiced 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, replaying the day's warm moments in her mind and feeling grateful. After meditation, she walked to the balcony, where her husband Zhang Weiming was also there drinking beer. Her husband brought up the plan to visit the studio in Sham Shui Po on Saturday and asked if she was ready. Yu Xiaowei leaned on his shoulder, said she had a rough idea, and in turn asked if his work went smoothly that day. They chatted for a while about the children and work, enjoying a rare moment alone together. Afterwards, she returned to the bedroom, took out her planner and jotted down tomorrow's to-do items, then turned off the light and fell asleep with a content and peaceful feeling.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and exercise.
description: Woke up at exactly 6 a.m. to the phone alarm; it was cloudy outside. I drank a few sips of warm water, changed into yoga clothes, and walked to Whampoa Fitness Center with a sports water bottle and towel. The residential area was quiet in the early morning, and the breeze carried a slight chill. After arriving at the fitness center, I briefly greeted the early-morning yoga instructor, put down my backpack in the locker room, laid out my yoga mat, adjusted my breathing, and prepared to begin practice. The Ashtanga yoga early class started at exactly 6:30. Today's theme was "Backbends and Opening the Heart." With the instructor's guidance, I completed the entire sequence. Although my body was a bit stiff in the morning, I persisted through poses such as Camel Pose, and felt my chest thoroughly open. The feeling of being bound by stress eased considerably, injecting positive energy into the day's work.
location: 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time and taking her son to school
description: After the yoga class, with her whole body warmed up, she started jogging back home along the waterfront promenade toward De'an Street, at a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. The morning sea breeze was refreshing. After arriving home, she took a quick shower to wash off the sweat. Her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and stir-fried greens. While blow-drying her hair, she helped set out the bowls and chopsticks and woke up her daughter Zhang Yuxin. Then she helped her son Zhang Zixuan, who is in third grade, check his school bag, made sure he had packed all his math homework, reminded him to wear sneakers for PE class, stuffed a box of cherry tomatoes into his bag as a fruit snack, and told him to come home on time after school.
location: 18th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 7 Tak On Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting and CFP study.
description: Walked from home to MTR Whampoa Station, took the MTR and transferred at Admiralty Station to Wan Chai Station. On the train, I put on earphones, opened the CFP investment planning online course, quickly reviewed the "Dynamic Asset Allocation" chapter from yesterday, and previewed the knowledge points of the mistakes I need to review at noon. The carriage had a strong learning atmosphere; I focused on absorbing key concepts. When transferring at Admiralty Station, the crowds were heavy, but I still finished listening to one section.
location: Along the MTR in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station).

name: Morning core work: submitting insurance policies and sending the group insurance proposal
description: Arrived at the office on the 13th floor of AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, put down her bag, turned on the computer, made a cup of hot tea, and quickly browsed her emails and schedule. The first task was to handle her mother Chen Meiling's insurance policy. She carefully checked the application form, copy of identity document, and payment receipt, and after confirming everything was correct, submitted it to the underwriting department through the company system. Then she entered her electronic file in the client relationship management software, including contact information, family members, and financial needs analysis. Next, based on the recording of yesterday's meeting with Wang Qiming at the cafe in Shiu Kin Centre, she drafted a group insurance proposal, highlighting his interest in cross-border high-end medical insurance, organized common questions such as the reimbursement process for mainland hospitals and the coverage of the direct-payment network into a FAQ attachment, carefully wrote an email, and sent it to Wang Qiming with the subject “Detailed Plan for Your Company's Cross-Border High-End Medical Insurance Solution, Please Review.” After it was sent successfully, she felt a sense of relief.
location: Office, 13/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-noon follow-up with potential clients
description: After handling important matters for two major clients, I went through the customer follow-up list in the CRM system and made a few calls: one was to Mrs. Zhang, who had inquired about savings insurance last month and said she was still considering; the other was a young person introduced by a friend who wanted to learn about a first medical insurance policy. I answered their questions briefly and effectively, and scheduled meetings for next week, one of which was set for Friday at 3 PM.
location: Office, 13/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday CFP review and eye relaxation
description: Instead of going to the cafeteria during the lunch break, she ate her homemade whole-wheat sandwich and plain water in the office pantry, went through her CFP mistake notebook while eating, and quickly reviewed the 5 asset allocation questions she got wrong last week to strengthen her memory. Her colleague Su Lishan walked by with an iced lemon tea, peeked at the notebook, and joked, “Aiya, 'Yu the study geek' is having a private session again! Can you still handle the weekend marathon training?” She looked up and smiled wryly, “No choice. I can't neglect either performance or study; there's never enough time.” After Su left, she put down the mistake notebook, went back to her desk, closed her eyes, and did her first eye yoga session, rotating her eyeballs clockwise and counterclockwise to relieve the dryness from staring at the screen all morning, trying to calm her anxiety about time management.
location: Office pantry and workstation on the 13th floor of AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon consultation handling and interview preparation
description: In the afternoon, I began to reply to several client emails about policy dividends. At the same time, I remembered that I was supposed to go to Sham Shui Po on Saturday afternoon to meet with my embroidery friend He Meiling to discuss studio matters. I took out my memo from my bag and started to write a rough outline: the studio's current operating status, Teacher Wu Xiuying's expectations, the possible division of work between me and He Meiling, and an assessment of the time and energy I would need to invest.
location: Office, 13/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Product sharing session
description: The team's new-hire product training sharing session was held in the training room on the 14th floor. As a senior agent, I was named by regional director Liang Zhenhua to share sales experience for the "Abundant Future" savings insurance. Drawing on yesterday's case of signing Chen Meiling, I vividly explained how to identify client needs, design solutions, and close deals. The new colleagues listened attentively and raised several practical questions, and I answered them one by one. The sharing session was very lively.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 7 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, 14th Floor, Training Room

name: Afternoon rest and administrative work
description: After the sharing session, she returned to her workstation, went to the pantry, and made herself a cup of black tea. She chatted briefly with colleagues about recent hot news and weekend plans as a short break. Then she went back to her seat to handle routine administrative work, including updating the weekly report and filling in client visit records. Afterward, she refined the weekend interview outline she had drafted at noon, adding specific questions about the capital contribution from both sides, ideas for venue renovation, and time commitments, ready for an in-depth discussion with He Meiling on the weekend.
location: Office, 13/F, AIA Building, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute home and relaxation
description: Left work on time, walked to MTR Wan Chai Station, and took the MTR via Admiralty Station to Whampoa Station. On the way back, she didn't listen to courses on the MTR; instead, she put on headphones and played her collection of classic Cantonese songs, letting her mind go completely blank. Watching the city scenery flash by the window, the day's fatigue gradually eased away with the music.
location: Along the MTR in Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (from Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Returning home to rest and picking up my daughter from school.
description: After arriving home, she put down her briefcase, changed into loungewear, drank a glass of water, and sat on the sofa for 2 minutes to rest briefly. Then she walked to Kowloon City Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Zhang Yuxin. The moment her daughter saw her, she happily rushed over and said that today in art class she had learned to draw a puppy. Holding her little hand, she listened all the way as her daughter shared funny stories from school in a sweet, childish voice, and the mother and daughter slowly walked home.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family dinner
description: When she got home with her daughter, her husband Zhang Weiming had already picked up their son, and her mother Chen Meiling had prepared dinner. Dinner included steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried broccoli, and tomato, potato, and pork rib soup. At the table, she shared the progress of successfully submitting Wang Qiming's plan today, and her husband mentioned that he had repaired a client's air-conditioning system. The family chatted while eating, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: 18th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 7 Tak On Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family time: helping with homework and doing household chores.
description: After dinner, she checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math homework. He was a bit unclear on today's topic of "multiplying three-digit numbers by two-digit numbers," so she patiently taught him the steps of vertical multiplication step by step until he fully understood. Meanwhile, her daughter Zhang Yuxin spread drawing paper on the living room coffee table and drew a puppy she had learned today. Yu Xiaowei praised her from time to time and encouraged her to show it to her grandmother when finished. After the children were settled, they took the initiative to help their mother put the dishes into the dishwasher and wiped down the stove top. Then they watched a little TV drama with their mother in the living room, discussed the plot, and enjoyed a short mother-child chat, also mentioning that work and studies had been a bit stressful lately.
location: 18th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 7 Tak On Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: CFP risk management module study
description: After the family members were ready to rest, she went to the study and began the core learning task of the day. She opened the CFP question bank app, selected the 'Risk Management and Insurance Planning' module, and completed 20 questions with full concentration. After checking the answers, her accuracy rate reached 80%. She used a highlighter to write down the knowledge points related to the 4 wrong questions, such as 'the impact of moral hazard' and 'types of reinsurance,' in her notebook, and tore off a sticky note on which she wrote 'Types of reinsurance: what is the difference between proportional and non-proportional reinsurance?' and stuck it on the wall in front of the desk to remind herself to focus on it over the weekend. At that point, she looked up at the time and felt a bit anxious about her barely completed study progress, feeling that her time management was still not ideal.
location: Study, 18th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 7 Tak On Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Relaxing before bed, nighttime conversation, and going to sleep.
description: After finishing her studies, she went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into pajamas, and sat on the edge of the bed for five minutes of abdominal breathing, closing her eyes and focusing on each inhale and exhale, feeling the stress accumulated during the day slowly release with each breath. Once relaxed, she put on a steam eye mask and did a second session of eye yoga, rotating her eyeballs clockwise and counterclockwise to fully soothe her tired eyes. After taking off the mask, her husband Zhang Weiming had just lain down too. They chatted briefly. He asked about her confidence in the Wang Qiming case and sighed, saying he hoped they could win it smoothly. He also brought up meeting about the studio in Sham Shui Po on Saturday afternoon. Her husband expressed support and told her not to put too much pressure on herself. Then she picked up her phone, quickly glanced at tomorrow's (September 12) work calendar, confirmed there were no urgent matters, sent her mother a message in the family group chat not to worry about breakfast, set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning, and switched her phone to silent. She turned off the bedside lamp and gradually drifted off to sleep to the steady sound of her husband's breathing. Though she still felt some anxiety about time management, she knew tomorrow would be a new day.
location: Bedroom, 18th Floor, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, 7 Tak On Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Easy morning run
description: After the alarm went off, Xiaowei changed into her sportswear, did some simple stretching at home, and then went out for a jog along the Whampoa waterfront promenade, running from the entrance of Whampoa Garden to near the Whampoa cruise ship and back, about 3 kilometers in total. The morning sea breeze from Victoria Harbour brushed her face, the scenery was pleasant, and the light jog made her slightly sweaty, injecting energy into the day.
location: Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went home, took a shower, and had breakfast
description: After returning home from her run, Xiaowei did post-run stretching, then took a shower and changed into her work shirt. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already prepared plain congee, scrambled eggs, and steamed BBQ pork buns. As she ate breakfast, Xiaowei listened to her mother say she needed to buy a good bottle of soy sauce today to make soy sauce chicken on the weekend.
location: Home, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Help with breakfast and take daughter to school
description: After breakfast, Xiaowei woke up her daughter Xinxin, helped her change into her school uniform, and after finishing breakfast walked hand in hand with her to the Kowloon City kindergarten. They passed several streets along the way and arrived 15 minutes later. At 7:15 she handed her daughter to the teacher. As they parted, her daughter said she wanted to eat a pineapple bun with butter after school. Xiaowei smiled, agreed, and kissed her forehead.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Reviewing on the metro during commute.
description: After dropping off her daughter, Xiaowei walked to Whampoa MTR Station and took the MTR to Wan Chai. In the crowded carriage, she put on her earphones and opened a note-taking app to review CFP exam points, focusing on several models of dynamic asset allocation rebalancing strategies. After passing Whampoa Station, transferring to the Tsuen Wan line at Yau Ma Tei Station, and transferring to the Island line at Admiralty Station, she arrived at Wan Chai Station 45 minutes later.
location: MTR (Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Finishing breakfast and getting organized at the office.
description: After exiting the station, Xiaowei bought a bottle of unsweetened sugarcane and imperata root drink at Hung Fook Tong downstairs from the company. Took the elevator to the 19th-floor office, turned on the lights, computer, and air conditioner, laid out the client folders needed for the day in a row on the desk, and wrote down the day's key tasks on a sticky note.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Organizing client documents and preparing the report
description: Xiaowei opened her computer, checked and scanned the policy documents signed by Chen Meiling the previous day, and filed them after confirming everything was correct. She then prepared a special explanation of the Wang Qiming High-End Medical Plan for the upcoming report to the director, highlighting that the plan was based on the team's client connections and reputation accumulated in Hong Kong and extended to the Shenzhen market. During this time, her colleague Su Lishan passed by, and they encouraged each other.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Report work to Director Liang Zhenhua
description: Xiaowei took a deep breath and knocked on the door of the director's office. She first reported the good news of Chen Meiling signing the policy, then presented Wang Qiming's high-end medical insurance plan, emphasizing that the client's trust came from professional roots in Hong Kong, with Shenzhen being merely an extended branch. Director Liang Zhenhua's expression turned from serious to approving, and he agreed that they should firmly grasp both markets. After the half-hour conversation, Xiaowei's mind was at ease.
location: Director's Office, 19/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Focus on handling business and preparing for next week's meeting.
description: After returning to her seat, Xiaowei efficiently replied to several clients' WhatsApp inquiries about critical illness claim terms. Then she opened her calendar to prepare for the retirement planning meeting with client Mrs. Chen next Tuesday, recalculating the pension gap under different assumptions. The new hire Tommy came to ask about the details of 'Jia Yu Zhi Zhi Bao' regarding claims for congenital diseases, and Xiaowei patiently explained with past cases.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch with colleague Su Lishan.
description: During the lunch break, Xiaowei and Su Lishan went to Baohua Tea Restaurant near the company. Xiaowei ordered satay beef rice noodles with iced lemon tea, and Su Lishan had char siu with fried egg rice. As they ate, they chatted about the upcoming wine tasting. Su Lishan worried she might have trouble identifying aromas, and Xiaowei encouraged her to treat it as a way to broaden her horizons, which would also come in handy when treating clients to meals in the future. They also shared funny stories about their families from the previous night.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Jaffe Road, Baohua Tea Restaurant

name: Handled administrative work and internal support.
description: After lunch, Xiaowei returned to the office to organize next week's team activity notices, update the customer management system, and reply to several emails. She also checked the materials she needed to bring to the afternoon wine tasting, brewed a cup of black tea, and recharged for the afternoon's new experience.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute and afternoon tea break
description: At 3 PM, Xiaowei packed up and left the office early, took the Island Line to Causeway Bay Station, and walked to Sharp Street East. Since it was still early, she went into a quiet cafe called Tempo Coffee, ordered a hot Americano, put on an eye mask, and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation to completely relax the tense nerves from the morning.
location: Tempo Coffee, near 33 Stewart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wine tasting workshop learning session
description: At 4:30 p.m., Xiaowei met Su Lishan on time at the Mellow Wine Cellar in the basement of Holiday Inn Express Causeway Bay. The sommelier first introduced basic wine-tasting knowledge, then guided them step by step through observing the color, swirling the glass, smelling the aromas, and tasting five wines, from a crisp Bordeaux white to a structured Tuscan red. Xiaowei focused on taking tasting notes and found that deconstructing wine flavors was remarkably similar to dissecting insurance policy terms.
location: Vintage Cellar, Basement, Holiday Inn Express Hong Kong Causeway Bay, 33 Sharp Street East, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wine buying and socializing at a wine tasting workshop.
description: After the tasting, it was time for free shopping. Xiaowei asked the store clerk to recommend a Carménère red wine from Colchagua Valley, Chile, with soft tannins and ripe fruit, at a reasonable price of just over HKD 400. She imagined bringing it to her father's house on the weekend, paired with her mother's soy sauce chicken, and knew her father would love it. Su Lishan also bought a bottle, and they agreed to come regularly and make this a new hobby.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 33 Sharp Street East, Holiday Inn Express Hong Kong Causeway Bay, Vintage Cellar

name: Commuting home
description: After saying goodbye to Su Lishan at the MTR station, Xiaowei boarded at Causeway Bay Station. The evening rush was even more crowded than the morning rush. She carefully protected the red wine in her tote bag, sent a voice message to her husband Ming, asked about the children, and told him she was bringing home a good bottle of wine, and would find an excuse to visit her father's house on the weekend.
location: MTR (Causeway Bay Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Red wine care and helping in the kitchen at home
description: When she got home, her mother was stir-frying in the kitchen. Xiaowei cleared a spot on the shelf in the corner of the kitchen and carefully laid the red wine on its side. As she washed her hands and helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, she enthusiastically told her mother about the wine-tasting knowledge she had learned that day — things like 'tannins' and 'finish' — making her mother laugh.
location: Home kitchen, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: Her husband Ming Chai picked up Xuanxuan and Xinxin and brought them home, and the family enjoyed a warm dinner together. Her mother had made pork bone soup with green radish and carrot, stir-fried beef with Chinese broccoli, and steamed a grouper. Xiaowei announced the good news that her work presentation that day had been successful, and the children clapped and cheered. Xuanxuan shared about scoring in his football match, and Xinxin showed off a watercolor family portrait; although Dad's face was painted green, it made everyone laugh. Xiaowei successfully stopped Ming Chai's suggestion to open wine that night, saying the wine would only be fully flavorful with Father's chicken.
location: Home dining room, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Homework tutoring and family activities.
description: After clearing the table, Xiaowei sat in the study with her son Xuanxuan to help him with his English composition, titled “My Weekend.” She used a mind map to guide Xuanxuan in listing his weekend activities, then helped him enrich his sentence patterns and vocabulary. When they finished, they went to the living room together. Dad was telling a story to daughter Xinxin. Xiaowei unrolled her yoga mat nearby and did a set of flow yoga and 10 minutes of eye yoga to relieve the fatigue of the day.
location: Study and living room at home, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night chat with husband on the balcony
description: After the children fell asleep, Xiaowei and her husband Mingzai came to the balcony with warm water. A gentle night breeze blew. She shared funny stories from the wine tasting and her idea of giving wine to her father to ease the relationship. Mingzai agreed, saying her father was tough on the outside but soft inside, and that proactively giving him something he liked would work better than sweet words. They also discussed the details of tomorrow's meeting in Sham Shui Po with the Cantonese embroidery studio, feeling reassured.
location: Home balcony, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Plank exercise before bed and a phone call to father
description: Back in the bedroom, Xiaowei first did a 10-minute plank workout. Then she called her father, Yu Guoqiang, and said she would bring a bottle of something good over on Saturday afternoon to go with her mother's soy sauce chicken. Her father was half-doubtful but a little expectant; he said it was a waste of money, but his tone was pleased. After hanging up, Xiaowei set the alarm for 6 a.m. tomorrow and put her Cantonese embroidery sewing kit on the bedside table.
location: Master bedroom at home, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: Before turning off the light, Xiaowei quickly reviewed the day in her phone notes: work communication went smoothly, the wine-tasting new experience was very satisfying, and there were signs of easing in her relationship with her father. The shortcoming was that she could have been more focused in the afternoon. She listed three to-dos for tomorrow: go to the Sham Shui Po studio for a meeting, accompany the children for outdoor activities in the morning, and bring wine back to her parents' home. After confirming everything, she fell asleep peacefully before 11 o'clock.
location: Master bedroom at home, Phase 8, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time
description: At 6:30 on Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowei was awakened by her alarm clock. She stayed in bed for 5 minutes, then got up and drank a large glass of warm water. Stepping on the scale, she saw her weight was 54.1 kg, well maintained. She changed into a sports bra and yoga pants, ready to start an energetic day. Around 7 o'clock, she walked out of the bedroom. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had prepared dried scallop congee, scrambled eggs, and char siu rice noodle rolls, and the family of five sat around the table. Her mother asked about the day's arrangements. Yu Xiaowei said she would take her son Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tsai Park to play football in the morning, go to the library to review for the CFP, meet Teacher Wu in Sham Shui Po at noon to discuss co-organizing a Cantonese embroidery club, visit her mother-in-law in Kwun Tong in the afternoon, and go to her father's house for dinner in the evening. Her husband, Zhang Weiming, said he would take the children to the Whampoa Xintiandi mall. She also reminded her daughter Xinxin to stay home obediently in the afternoon and learn embroidery from her maternal grandmother. After breakfast, she helped her son check his football gear and prepared to leave.
location: Home kitchen/dining room at Block 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take son to football class
description: Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's football shoes, shin guards, and water bottle filled with water, and put on her canvas eco-friendly bag containing CFP textbooks and a notebook. The mother and son set off on foot from their home in Whampoa Garden. The morning breeze smelled of grass, and they arrived at Kowloon Tsai Park about 15 minutes later. She handed her son over to football coach Zhao Zhiming, watched him warm up running with the other children, nodded greetings to several parents she knew, reminded her son to drink plenty of water after playing and listen to the coach, then left the park and headed to the library.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Focused CFP study in the library
description: After walking about 10 minutes from Kowloon Tsai Park to the Kowloon City Public Library, Yu Xiaowei chose a quiet window seat in the self-study area on the second floor, put on noise-canceling headphones, and quickly got into a study mode. Today she focused on dynamic balance strategies, and using the three cases of her mother Chen Meiling, her friend Wang Qiming, and her own family, she analyzed in detail in her notebook how to adjust asset allocation ratios at different life stages. In the middle, she referred to the book "Risk Management Practice" and clarified her question about the core position of insurance in asset allocation. The two-plus hours of studying left her feeling very fulfilled.
location: Self-study area, 2nd floor, Kowloon City Public Library, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to Sham Shui Po for an interview at the Cantonese embroidery studio.
description: Yu Xiaowei packed up and left the library on time. On the way to Kowloon City MTR Station, she passed Qi Xiang Bakery and remembered that Ms. Wu Xiuying had a sweet tooth, so she bought a box of fresh egg tarts as a gift. She took the Kwun Tong line to Prince Edward Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan line, and reached Sham Shui Po Station about 40 minutes later, then went to Ms. Wu's Cantonese Embroidery Studio on the 2nd floor of the tenement building at 88 Fuk Wing Street. Ms. Wu and her embroidery companion He Meiling were already waiting. The studio was full of embroidery frames and colorful silk threads. She handed over the egg tarts, and the three of them ate while discussing the studio's future operating model, focusing on ways to attract customers with beginner experience classes, course scheduling, material purchasing, and cost sharing. Drawing on her customer management experience in insurance work, Yu Xiaowei offered many suggestions. He Meiling was very knowledgeable about accounts and materials. They reached an initial consensus to 'operate jointly and let each person play to their strengths,' and agreed to refine the plan next week.
location: Wu Xiuying Cantonese Embroidery Studio, 2nd Floor, tenement building, 88 Fuk Wing Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch alone in Sham Shui Po
description: After saying goodbye to Teacher Wu and He Meiling, Yu Xiaowei wandered alone through the streets of Sham Shui Po looking for food. She went into Lau Sum Kee Noodle Shop at the corner of Fuk Wing Street and Kweilin Street and ordered a bowl of shrimp roe tossed noodles and an ice-cold lemon tea. The noodles were springy and chewy, and the shrimp roe was salty and fragrant. She finished lunch quickly, replying to a few client messages on her phone and also texting her husband to let him know the meeting had gone smoothly.
location: Lau Sum Kee Noodle House, corner of Fuk Wing Street and Kweilin Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went to Kwun Tong to visit her mother-in-law.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei took the MTR from Sham Shui Po station to Kwun Tong. At the mall near Exit A of Kwun Tong station, she bought oranges that her mother-in-law Li Shufen loved and a box of Ovaltine. When she arrived at the 20th floor of Chui Wah House, Tsui Ping Estate, her mother-in-law opened the door and beamed with joy at the sight of her. Holding her hand, she asked with concern whether she had been too busy and lost weight. Yu Xiaowei sat with her mother-in-law on the living room sofa, listened to her talk about the new vegetable stall in the market downstairs and the TV series she had been following, reminded her to drink more water in the hot weather, and confirmed the time for the next family dinner together. Before leaving, her mother-in-law insisted on giving her a box of almond cookies brought back from Macau, telling her to take them home for the children.
location: Mother-in-law's home, 20th floor, Tsui Wah House, Tsui Ping Estate, Kwun Tong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: In-depth discussion with the running coach
description: After leaving her mother-in-law's home, Yu Xiaowei took the subway to Kowloon Tong Station, then walked about 15 minutes along Waterloo Road to Kowloon Tsai Sports Ground. She found Coach Zhao Zhiming in the shade beside the grandstand, where he had just finished training his students. She admitted that recently, in interval training and long-distance runs, she had developed a sense of detachment of "running for the numbers," and running had become mechanical and no longer pure. The coach first affirmed her recent progress, then gently suggested reducing the training volume by 30% over the next two weeks and picking one day on the weekend to run 10 kilometers by feel, without wearing a watch or checking pace, in order to rediscover her original intention for running. I reflected on how my earlier communication had focused too much on efficiency while overlooking a sense of fairness. Then I returned to my desk, replied to two longtime clients' emails asking about savings dividend insurance, and looked through the new product materials sent by Shenzhen client Wang Qiming. At the same time, I organized the key review points into an electronic document as reference material for drafting guidelines later.

The two of us sat by the window and discussed while eating. I brought up the risk assessment tool case I had studied in the morning, along with the real problem of a high-net-worth conservative client, and Shanshan shared her experience with similar cases. After the lunch break, we went back to the small meeting room and brainstormed at the whiteboard to jointly draft the Team Task Allocation Transparency Operating Procedures, formulating five core draft items: announcing all team tasks every Monday, setting up an anonymous feedback mailbox, and conducting a satisfaction survey every six months. I organized them into a formal email on my laptop.
location: Pantry and small meeting room, 15/F, AIA Financial Center, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

I patiently answered her detailed questions and agreed to go to her home in Taikoo Shing next Tuesday afternoon to explain the policy in detail. After the call, I updated the communication record in the customer management system and noted, "Mrs. Chen was very careful about the terms, and everything went well."
location: Office workstation, AIA Financial Center, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

Just then, I received an approving email from Brother Hua. He praised the draft as specific and suggested rolling it out at next Monday's regular meeting. Carrying my bag, I went downstairs to the first-floor lobby. Outside, the sky was dark and a sudden shower hit. I realized I had forgotten my umbrella, so I stood at the entrance with a few colleagues who also had not brought umbrellas, looking out and waiting. I chatted with Jason, a colleague from the neighboring team, about weekend plans and movies. When the rain eased a bit, I dashed through the rain to the subway station.
location: Ground floor lobby, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong SAR, China.

Once we officially started, Mingzai used a roller brush to paint the large wall areas, while I used a small brush to carefully touch up the ceiling seams, corners, and door and window frames, and applied masking tape around the switch and socket outlets before painting them carefully. As we worked, we discussed using this small room in the future as a study or a Cantonese embroidery workspace, and we kept the windows and fan on throughout to let the smell dissipate. Finally, we peeled off the masking tape, installed two new switch plates, and stepped back to admire the refreshed walls, feeling a great sense of accomplishment.

Through this concentrated review, I made the fragmented learning from the day more solid.
