The children were very interested in the box of Shenzhen specialty pastries, so she opened it and gave each of them a piece to try.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince's Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West (Whampoa Garden residential estate)

name: Homework help and parent-child time
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math homework and found an error in a fraction word problem, so she patiently explained it to him. Then she accompanied her daughter Zhang Yuxin in making a handmade flower out of colored cardstock. Her daughter happily ran around the living room holding up the flower. To avoid affecting the subsequent installation work, she bathed the children early and coaxed them to read by themselves before going to bed.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince's Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West (Whampoa Garden residential estate)

name: Installation of wall-mounted racks and a workbench in the storage room
description: At 19:15, after the children were settled, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming changed into old clothes and entered the storage room with an electric drill, a spirit level, and other tools. Zhang Weiming was responsible for drilling holes with the electric drill and embedding expansion bolts, while she handed him tools and held the shelf steady. Working in good coordination, they firmly fixed the solid wood wall shelf, which had been primed the day before yesterday, to the wall. Then they started installing the foldable workbench, and Zhang Weiming repeatedly tested the smoothness of the folding mechanism and its load-bearing capacity. After installation, they checked the sturdiness together. Under the light, the white wall set off the natural wood-colored shelf, and the storage room finally began to take shape. Although she was busy with the work, the low whisper from the afternoon echoed in her mind from time to time.
location: Storage room, Prince Edward Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden residential estate)

name: Personal hygiene and short rest
description: When the installation work ended, it was nearly 9 p.m. Yu Xiaowei took a comfortable hot shower, washing away the dust and fatigue. After changing into loungewear, she made herself a cup of hot tea and sat on the living room sofa. She briefly browsed the Cantonese embroidery exchange group on her phone and saw photos of new embroidery shared by Teacher Wu Xiuying, which relaxed her mood a little.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince's Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West (Whampoa Garden residential estate)

name: CFP evening practice questions and review
description: At 21:45, Yu Xiaowei walked into the study, opened the CFP study software, took out the question list she had organized earlier, and focused on solving 30 multiple-choice questions related to investment risk. After finishing, she carefully checked the explanations and marked the 3 questions she still had doubts about, planning to review the recorded online lesson again tomorrow.
location: Study room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden Residential Estate)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: 22:30 Yu Xiaowei tidied up her desk and returned to the bedroom. Lying in bed, she thought again of the whisper she had heard outside the restroom at the cha chaan teng that afternoon. She turned over and thought: 'What exactly are A Hui and Minyi hiding from me? Is it something about Wen Hui herself, or is it about me?' She decided to find an opportunity next week to ask Minyi out alone and get to the bottom of it. Then she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to Mingzai: 'The shelf is installed, and the storage room finally looks presentable. Thanks for the hard work this weekend.' At 23:15 she turned off the bedside lamp and closed her eyes. Tomorrow was Saturday; she could sleep in, then take the kids to the library, and also make up for the exercise plan she hadn't completed today (weekend morning run). With a trace of speculation about her doubts and anticipation for the weekend, she fell into a deep sleep around 23:45.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Whampoa Garden residential estate)

name: Morning stretching and family time
description: Woke up to the alarm, felt stiffness in the gastrocnemius of my right leg, so instead of a morning run I did 15 minutes of gentle stretching on the living room floor, focusing on relaxing the calves and quadriceps. Then I helped my mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast (fried eggs, milk, whole wheat bread) for the children who had just woken up, packed the toys for the weekend park trip with them, and played with the pet cat “Nuomici”.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the children to their interest classes.
description: On Saturday, the children each had plans in the morning. She drove her son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road) for the 9:00 football training class, dropping him off to meet the coach. Then on the way, she took her daughter Zhang Yuxin to the art studio on the second floor of Kowloon City Plaza (128 Carpenter Road) for her 10:00 drawing class.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West to 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon Tsai Park, then to 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City Plaza

name: Returned home to prepare and walked to the library
description: After parking the car and returning home, she organized her backpack and confirmed she had brought her CFP study materials, notebook, water bottle, and wallet. Considering it was still early, she decided to walk to the library.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk to the library.
description: Carrying her study materials, she walked from home (near Prince Building) to the Kowloon City District Public Library. Along the way, she passed a familiar street market, bought a newspaper, and savored the quiet of an early weekend morning.
location: From Prince Edward Road West to No. 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Deep study at the library
description: Arrived at the library and found a seat in the quiet area by the window on the second floor. Spread out textbooks and notebooks, focusing on tackling the difficult part of CFP study: the application of estate tax planning in insurance. Concentratedly drew a spider-web knowledge map, linking Hong Kong's estate tax regulations with different life insurance and annuity products, and added practical case notes in the margins. During this time, the phone was set to silent, completely immersed in studying.
location: Kowloon Public Library, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch and unexpectedly met an old colleague
description: I felt a bit tired from studying, packed up, and left the library. At Saint Honore Cake Shop, diagonally opposite the library, I bought a tuna bun and a bottle of Vitasoy for lunch. Just as I walked out of the shop, I ran into Liu Jiahui, a former factory colleague who had come to Hong Kong from Shenzhen on business. We were both surprised and chatted on the roadside for 10 minutes. He praised me for successfully transitioning from a factory clerk to a professional insurance agent, and I encouraged him to keep developing in the logistics industry. We exchanged our new WhatsApp contact details.
location: Saint Honore Bakery near Kowloon Public Library, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Walk home and handle messages.
description: After saying goodbye to Liu Jiahui, she strolled home slowly along Prince Edward Road West. On the way, she checked her phone, replied to several client messages confirming meeting times for next week, and also glanced at next week's weather forecast while mentally planning weekend family activities.
location: Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to finish up study and self-assessment
description: After returning home, she first watered the green plants on the balcony, then went into the study. She spread out the notes and the mistake notebook from the library, compared them with the difficult points marked by highlighter, and spent 1 hour completing 10 final questions. Then she opened the self-evaluation form, scored the second phase of study item by item, drew an asterisk beside "Estate Tax Planning," and wrote "deepen with cases." Finally, she organized all study materials and stacked them neatly in a corner of the bookshelf. The total study time that day was exactly 3.5 hours.
location: Home study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Rest, massage appointment, and preparation
description: Feeling a bit tired, she collapsed on the sofa to rest for 20 minutes, drank a glass of lemon water, and chatted with her mother Chen Meiling for a while. Remembering the scheduled sports massage, she called the masseuse recommended by Teacher Wu Xiuying and successfully booked the massage service for 5:00 PM at the Commercial Building on Wan Chai Road. She set a reminder on her phone calendar (leave at 16:10), then changed into loose, comfortable workout clothes to prepare for the afternoon massage.
location: Home living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walked to the MTR station.
description: She carried her lightweight canvas bag and walked from home to Whampoa MTR Station, which took about 10 minutes. On the way, she bought a bottle of water at a convenience store to prepare for the upcoming journey.
location: Prince Edward Road West to MTR Whampoa Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took the MTR to Wan Chai.
description: She took the Kwun Tong Line from MTR Whampoa Station to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. The whole trip took about 30 minutes. On the train, she rested with her eyes closed, listening to light music she had downloaded to her phone in advance to relax her mind.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region MTR (Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Walk to the massage center.
description: Exit from Wan Chai Station's Exit A2, follow the phone navigation and walk about 10 minutes to the massage center at Zhonghui Building, 110 Wan Chai Road.
location: Wan Chai Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Professional sports rehabilitation massage
description: Arrived at Summit Sports Rehabilitation Center and briefly described to the massage therapist the stiffness in her right calf. The therapist first had her walk slowly on the treadmill for 2 minutes to assess her running form, pointing out that her left leg bore slightly more weight while running, which could cause the right leg to compensate. Then she lay flat on the massage table, and the therapist used forearms and elbows to perform deep release on the right quadriceps and deep fascia bundles. Although there were a few sharp pains during the process, after it ended both legs felt exceptionally relaxed, as if a weight had been lifted. After getting off the table, she couldn't help jumping twice and marveled, 'It's amazing.'
location: Jifeng Sports Rehabilitation Center, 11th Floor, Zhonghui Building, 110 Wan Chai Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Take the MTR back home
description: Feeling relaxed, she walked back to Wan Chai Station and took the MTR home along the same route. On the train, she used her phone to order a massage gun and decided to have a deep relaxation session at least once a week.
location: MTR, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Walk home and relax with stretching
description: Walked home from Whampoa Station, about 10 minutes. Once home, drank a large glass of warm water, then changed into loungewear. On the living room carpet, while doing simple leg stretches, I reviewed the massage experience just now. I added the new habit of purchasing a massage gun to the reminder list in the Health app on my phone, determined to incorporate active recovery into my daily training routine.
location: Home living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare wine for dinner
description: Walked to the storage cabinet in the dining room and took a bottle of Chilean red wine from the wine rack bought at the wine tasting workshop. Gently wiped the thin dust off the bottle with a clean soft cloth and placed it on the dining table. Then she found her father's favorite small wine glass from the cupboard, rinsed it with hot water, carefully dried it, and set it beside the wine bottle. Everything was ready, waiting for tonight's family dinner.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, home dining room

name: Family dinner and father-daughter heart-to-heart talk
description: At 7 p.m., the family sat around the dinner table, and Mother served her signature braised pork with preserved mustard greens, steamed grouper, and garlic stir-fried broccoli. I opened the red wine with a corkscrew, poured a glass for my father first, and then a small half glass for myself. Raising my glass, I said, 'Dad, this wine was brought back from my studies. Try how it tastes.' Father took the wine and took a small sip, and the tight line of his mouth softened slightly. During the meal, I avoided the last argument about investing and instead talked about recently signing several large insurance policies and the fun of preparing for the marathon. Although Father still had some complaints about the rejected investment last time, with Mother mediating, the atmosphere remained harmonious. After dinner, Father and I moved to the living room to continue tasting the wine. He took the initiative to ask how the marathon training was going, and I shared the preparation plan and pace in detail. He gave a snort and said, 'Why run so far?' but his words carried concern. Slightly tipsy from the wine, we chatted for half an hour, and for the first time in months, warmth flowed between father and daughter.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lighting and seating arrangement in the storage room
description: After chatting, we put away the glasses and changed into clothes convenient for moving around. Around 8:30, I continued renovating the storage room with my husband Zhang Weiming. He stood on an aluminum ladder, installing the newly purchased high-color-rendering, eye-friendly light on the ceiling, connecting the wiring, and using the remote control to adjust it to the most comfortable 4000K natural white light. Meanwhile, I pushed the ergonomic chair bought online earlier to the workbench and carefully adjusted the seat cushion height and lumbar support. Then I moved rattan storage boxes from the living room and placed the previously scattered Cantonese embroidery tools, embroidered pieces, and rolled-up yoga mats one by one onto the wall-mounted shelf, adjusting their angles. After these days of effort, the originally messy small space finally looked neat and comfortable. Zhang Weiming rubbed his hands and said, 'Hey, it's actually looking like something now!' Both of them felt satisfied.
location: Home storage room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening wrap-up and parent-child time
description: After the storage room was initially completed, she first took a hot shower to completely relax her body and mind. When she came out, she accompanied her daughter Zhang Yuxin in the living room to build a small castle with LEGO bricks, while her husband Zhang Weiming checked their son Zhang Zixuan's reading homework that he needed to bring to school the next day. The family enjoyed a warm weekend evening together.
location: Home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family evening chat and bedtime preparations
description: After putting the children to sleep, she returned to the bedroom with her husband. While applying a moisturizing mask, she chatted with him about today's chance encounter, the massage experience, and how it felt to ease the relationship with her father. He listened quietly and responded from time to time. The two agreed to take the children to Inspiration Lake for a picnic tomorrow. At 22:50, she prepared the simple outing items for the next day, removed the mask, and completed her skincare routine. At 23:00, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully in a relaxed, warm, and fulfilled mood.
location: Home bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation and family interaction
description: Woke up naturally on Sunday morning. After washing up, changed into light sportswear and did a five-minute gentle stretch for the right leg that had been massaged yesterday. Then gently woke up her daughter Zhang Yuxin, helped her put on a UV-protective jacket, and tied her hair into two little pigtails. While preparing beach-cleaning gear—rubber gloves, litter pickers, garbage bags, sunscreen spray, and mineral water—she encouraged her in a lively tone to be a little ocean guardian. Later, in the living room, she explained to her husband Zhang Weiming the arrangements for father and son: she would take their daughter to Shek O Beach for a beach cleanup and be back around 12:00 noon, and asked her husband to take their son for training and then remember to supervise his math homework. Her husband nodded in response, and she then left the house holding their daughter's hand.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to Shek O Beach.
description: Drove a silver Toyota sedan, taking her daughter from their home on Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City, along the Island Eastern Corridor, then onto winding Shek O Road. The car played nursery rhymes her daughter loves; the mother and daughter hummed along, enjoying the sea view. The drive took about 26 minutes.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Island Eastern Corridor, Shek O Road

name: Check-in and participation in the Shek O Beach clean-up activity
description: Parked at the Shek O parking lot, walked to the meeting point, saw the community event organizer and more than twenty volunteers, checked in and received the activity instructions, and exchanged encouragement with neighbors she knew well. Then the beach cleanup officially began. Under the blazing sun, wearing gloves and bending down, they carefully searched for all kinds of rubbish: plastic bag fragments, foam pieces, glass shards. Her daughter carried a small basket and diligently looked for cigarette butts and plastic pieces, excitedly reporting each find. Together with the other volunteers, the mother and daughter helped clear three big bags of rubbish. After the event, they took a sweaty group photo with a phone by the shore and briefly rinsed the sand from their feet at the washing area.
location: Shek O Beach, Shek O Road, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drive back home.
description: After driving away from Shek O, I returned home to Kowloon City via Shek O Road and the Island Eastern Corridor. My daughter played a touchscreen game in the back seat while I listened to traffic reports on the radio, thinking all the way about posting photos of the event on Moments when I got home.
location: Shek O Road and Island Eastern Corridor, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family lunch and sharing
description: After arriving home at 12 o'clock, she took her daughter to rinse off the sand and sweat first and change into home clothes. The whole family was already seated, and the table was set with the winter melon and barley pork bone soup made by her mother Chen Meiling, along with home-style dishes. During the meal, her daughter excitedly described the details of the beach cleanup to her husband and son, while she listened with a smile and added a few remarks, enjoying the warmth of family togetherness.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-lunch socializing and space preparation
description: After the meal, leaning on the sofa in the living room, she selected photos from the beach cleanup event and mother-daughter photos, and wrote a WeChat Moments post: "Today I volunteered with the community and took my daughter to Shek O Beach for a beach cleanup. For the first time, I feel that 'picking up trash' is more meaningful than signing a big deal. Small hand in big hand, let's protect our ocean together." After posting, she received many likes and comments: colleagues praised the positivity, her running buddy liked it, client Mrs. Chen commented "a meaningful weekend," and her friend Lin Jiaxin instantly replied "bring me next time." She replied to each with thanks. Then she walked to the storeroom door and peeked through the crack at the Cantonese embroidery and yoga space that would be opened in the afternoon, feeling full of anticipation.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Noon break and casual chat with spouse
description: While the children played in their room, she sat with her husband Zhang Weiming on the rattan chairs on the living room balcony, showed him the beach cleanup photos on her phone, and they talked about today's experiences and next week's plans (Monday team meeting, Tuesday meeting with clients), enjoying a quiet moment that belonged just to the couple.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese Embroidery Yoga Space officially launched
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, carrying the embroidery frame and the eye-care lamp, with her husband carrying decorative paintings, Yu Xiaowei walked into the carefully renovated storage room (now a Cantonese embroidery and yoga space). First, under the new lamp, she spread out the unfinished peony Cantonese embroidery and plied the needle for about 20 minutes, testing the comfort of the new chair and the lighting angle, and was satisfied. Then she unrolled the yoga mat and did 15 minutes of Sun Salutations, feeling the calm focus brought by the non-slip floor and the soft lighting. Halfway through, her husband helped hang two small decorative paintings and laid the remaining non-slip mats along the edges of the floor. This multifunctional space, combining Cantonese embroidery and yoga, was now fully complete.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Yue Xiu Yoga Space

name: Location check-ins and family interactions
description: She excitedly used her phone to take a panoramic photo of the space, documenting the fruits of her labor. Then she called her son and daughter in to look around. Her daughter curiously touched the embroidery frame, while her son was drawn to the sailing-boat picture hanging on the wall. The family lingered for a while in the small new space, warm and content.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Yue Xiu Yoga Space

name: Family free time
description: She first sat with her son and looked at his newly purchased sci-fi comic, listening as he explained the tech concepts in it. Then she sat beside her daughter and guided her in drawing, with colored pencils, the little dolphin she had dreamed about the night before. Outside, the sky was gradually darkening; inside, the light was gentle and peaceful.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Her mother had prepared a hearty dinner, including steamed grouper, garlic lettuce, and turnip cake stir-fried with XO sauce. She served a bowl of soup to her father Yu Guoqiang, and the family ate and chatted in a warm atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-dinner walk and parent-child bonding
description: The family changed into casual shoes and went downstairs, walking a full circle around the community garden in Whampoa Garden. The children chased each other while she walked side by side with her husband at the back. After returning home, the couple joined the children in the living room to build a small ocean world with LEGO, and their daughter put in the seashells she had collected during today's beach cleanup.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and home

name: Check homework and bedtime story
description: Asked my son to take out next Monday's math workbook, quickly checked it, pointed out two calculation errors, and explained them. Then went to my daughter's room, read her two bilingual Chinese-English picture books about ocean protection, and watched her fall asleep peacefully in my arms.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal Cantonese embroidery time
description: The children were all asleep and the living room became quiet. Returning to her newly renovated Cantonese embroidery and yoga space, she sat down in the warm light, took out the half-finished peony embroidery, and stitched with full concentration for half an hour, her mind gradually calming as the needle and thread moved back and forth.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Yue Xiu Yoga Space

name: Washing up and skincare.
description: Returned to the master bedroom, took a hot shower to relieve the day's fatigue, then carefully completed the evening skincare routine in front of the mirror, letting her skin rest.
location: Master bathroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Back in the Cantonese embroidery and yoga space, she changed into loose pajamas, sat cross-legged on the yoga mat, and did a 15-minute breathing meditation with her eyes closed, emptying her mind and soaking in the peace of the space, bringing a perfect end to the day.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Yue Xiu Yoga Space

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She said goodnight to her husband, set the alarm on her phone, and quietly reviewed the day before bed: the sweat from the beach cleanup, the joy of opening the new space, and the company of her family — everything felt grounded and fulfilling. Then she turned off the light, listened to the faint wind outside the window, and fell asleep with a calm, introspective, and loving heart.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm went off right at 6:30. Yu Xiaowei turned it off, feeling the morning light coming through the window—a nice day, sunny turning cloudy. She sat up and gently moved her right leg; the effect of yesterday's deep muscle release was still there, and she felt very comfortable. After a quick wash-up, she changed into a sports bra and yoga pants, ready to start the new day.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Morning ritual: taking care of the cat and personal stretching.
description: First, she walked to the corner of the living room, added fresh cat food and water to the bowl of the cat Xiaohua, and cleaned the litter box while she was at it. Then she returned to the study and did a simple 10-minute yoga stretch on the floor, focusing on relaxing her lower back, shoulders, and neck to fully wake up her body.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Wake up the family, prepare breakfast, and help out
description: Yu Xiaowei went to wake up her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin and had them change into their school uniforms. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was already busy in the kitchen preparing steamed glutinous rice with Chinese sausage and hot milk. Yu Xiaowei helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, urged the children to sit down and eat breakfast quickly, and herself quickly drank a glass of warm water and ate a few slices of whole wheat bread and a boiled egg.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Take the children to school.
description: At 7:20, Yu Xiaowei drove out with Xuanxuan and Xinxin. She first drove to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, arriving at 7:28, and reminded Xuanxuan to go to Grandma's house to do homework after school today. Then she continued driving to Kowloon City Kindergarten, arriving at 7:35. She handed Xinxin to the teacher and watched her walk into the classroom before turning away. After parking the car, she walked to the MTR station.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, 1 Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China; Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Walk 8 minutes from Kowloon City Kindergarten to Whampoa Station, then take the MTR to Wan Chai. After getting on the train, put on earphones and play the CFP “Estate Tax Planning” course recording from last week on your phone. In the rocking carriage, while listening, note several key points in the phone memo and silently recite a few complex provisions. Arrive at AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, at about 8:30.
location: 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China, to 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong (Whampoa Station, Wan Chai Station, MTR Kwun Tong Line, Tsuen Wan Line, Island Line).

name: Morning organizing and preparation
description: I arrived at the office half an hour early, first went to the break room to make a cup of coffee, then returned to my desk, turned on the computer, logged into email, quickly scanned the day's schedule and important emails, and got ready for the work ahead.
location: 32/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Handled emails and client information.
description: At 9 o'clock she officially began work. She quickly scanned more than 30 emails, several of which were client inquiries about policy dividends and renewals, and replied to or logged each one. Then she pulled the 'Meet Mrs. Chen Tomorrow' folder out of the filing cabinet and checked the document list to make sure everything was complete for her visit to Taikoo Shing tomorrow.
location: 32/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Weekly team meeting
description: At 10 o'clock sharp, the meeting room was full. Director Liang Zhenhua presided over the regular meeting and first reviewed the team's performance from last week. When it was Yu Xiaowei's turn, she stood in front of the whiteboard and formally announced the Team Task Allocation Transparency Operation Standards, which she had drafted with her colleague Su Lishan. She explained in detail the core of the standards—making the person responsible for each task, the deadline, and the progress tracking table public. The colleagues all took careful notes and had no objections. Brother Hua also nodded in approval and told her to start implementing it next week.
location: Meeting room, 32nd floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Prepare tomorrow's critical illness insurance explanation materials
description: After the regular meeting, returned to my desk. Took out the documents prepared for Mrs. Chen's critical illness insurance, including the latest claims data charts and several successful claims cases from clients of similar age and health condition. While organizing, wrote a few clear explanation points on sticky notes to communicate more efficiently when visiting her home tomorrow.
location: 32/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Lunch with Su Lishan to discuss work
description: I agreed to meet Shanshan at the “Hui Xuan” Chinese restaurant near the office to try something different. We ordered shrimp dumplings and BBQ pork buns and chatted while eating. I asked her opinion on today’s new guidelines; she said they were practical and shared her plans for following up with several clients next week. We also talked about last Saturday’s beach cleanup at Shek O Beach. After she saw the photos on Yu Xiaowei’s Moments, she praised Xinxin for being very capable.
location: Hui Xuan (Hopewell Centre Mall Branch), 183 Queen's Road East, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China.

name: Called Zhou Minyi.
description: After lunch, she walked back to the company. Using the last bit of the lunch break, she called Zhou Minyi from the pantry. After a few rings, Zhou answered, and in a relaxed tone Yu Xiaowei asked when she was free this week, saying she wanted to invite her for afternoon tea and chat about something personal. Zhou said her schedule was very full this week but agreed to spare some time at noon on Wednesday. Yu Xiaowei agreed and said she'd confirm the location later.
location: 32/F Pantry, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Client follow-up and document organization
description: During the afternoon work hours, she systematically handled several to-dos: first, she replied to a young client who had asked about savings insurance last Friday, attaching the product proposal and return illustrations he was interested in. Then she organized the files of all clients to be served next week and updated the follow-up records in the CRM system.
location: 32/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Send a message to the coach to cancel the training.
description: She glanced at the time and remembered that tonight's running club dinner would take up training time. She took out her phone and sent a WhatsApp message to her coach Zhao Zhiming: "Coach Zhao, the running club has a dinner tonight, so I can't run the 10K as planned. I'll make it up tomorrow evening. Sorry." She also attached a cat bowing emoji. The coach quickly replied with an "OK" hand gesture.
location: 32/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Work wrap-up and preparation for tomorrow.
description: The last hour. I checked all the materials for tomorrow's visit to Mrs. Chen at Taikoo Shing again to make sure nothing was missing. Then I handled several documents that were waiting to be signed. At 17:20, I turned off the computer, tidied the desk, put tomorrow's document folder into the briefcase, and got ready to leave work.
location: 32/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China

name: Commuted to the running group's dinner gathering place
description: At 17:25, he left the office and walked 5 minutes to Wan Chai Station. He took the Island Line to Admiralty Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Mong Kok Station, and finally switched to the Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon City Station. Exiting from Exit C, he walked about 5 minutes to Old Zhao's tea restaurant on Fuk Lo Tsuen Road in Kowloon City District, a regular gathering spot for running friends.
location: From No. 1 Stubbs Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong, China, to Fuk Lo Tsun Road, Kowloon City District (Wan Chai Station, Kowloon City Station; MTR Island Line, Tsuen Wan Line, Kwun Tong Line)

name: Running group dinner
description: Arrived right at 6 o'clock; seven or eight running friends were already seated around a big table made by pushing tables together, with a lively atmosphere. Everyone ate and chatted, topics ranging from insights from the just-finished trail race to gossip about their clients. Mr. Chen, a banker and running friend, mentioned that several high-net-worth clients he dealt with had recently shown strong interest in collecting handicrafts, especially fine intangible cultural heritage pieces, and were willing to pay high prices. Yu Xiaowei's heart skipped a beat, and she immediately put down her chopsticks to ask exactly what types of things they liked and whether they might be interested in Cantonese embroidery pieces with a story. Mr. Chen said he could help inquire about his clients' tastes. She quickly jotted down the key information in her phone's memo.
location: Old Zhao's Tea Restaurant, Fuk Lo Tsuen Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China.

name: Returning home
description: The dinner gathering ended at 20:00. After saying goodbye to her running friends, she walked back to the MTR station. She took the Kwun Tong Line train bound for Whampoa, and on the train, her mind was still replaying the information she had just heard, making her feel a bit excited. At 20:25, she arrived at Whampoa Station and walked five minutes back to her home at 328 Prince Edward Road West.
location: From Old Zhao Tea Restaurant on Fuk Lo Tsun Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China, to 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District (Kowloon City Station / Whampoa Station, MTR Kwun Tong Line)

name: Family time and washing up
description: When I got home, the children had already bathed and were watching TV in the living room. My mother was in the kitchen preparing ingredients for tomorrow's breakfast. I chatted briefly with my husband Zhang Weiming about tonight's dinner party anecdotes and told him that we have an appointment with Zhou Minyi next Wednesday. Then I quickly took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Study Reflection: Trade-offs and Decisions
description: After taking a shower, she walked into the study and closed the door. She sat down at the desk, where the Cantonese embroidery album that her teacher Wu Xiuying had given her was spread out, next to an unclosed CFP textbook and next week's training schedule. Flipping through the album and looking at those exquisite patterns, she began to imagine organizing a VIP Cantonese embroidery appreciation event, inviting the clients Mr. Chen had mentioned. Not only would it promote the intangible cultural heritage, it could also naturally bring up insurance topics. But when her eyes swept over the thick CFP textbook and the training schedule, she instantly calmed down and gave a self-deprecating laugh, realizing that she could barely guarantee her weekly fixed embroidery time, let alone have the energy to run a commercial project. Reason told her that the most urgent things now were her work promotion, CFP certification, and competition training. She made a decision: put this cross-field idea on hold for now, but keep the few notes in her phone memo and revisit them when the time is right.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: From the study she returned to the bedroom. Her husband Zhang Weiming was already lying down. She turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Leaning against the headboard, she briefly browsed tomorrow's weather forecast and financial news on her phone. At 23:10, she turned off her phone, lay down, and got ready to sleep. She felt satisfied with the day's efficiency and had also temporarily come to terms with her inner impulses. At 23:20, she fell asleep.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, China

name: Morning preparation and travel to Victoria Park
description: At six in the morning, Yu Xiaowei was woken by her phone alarm. She quietly washed up, put on a bright orange running vest and dark shorts, and slipped on her ASICS running shoes. She added cat food and water for the orange tabby, then checked her phone and saw a WhatsApp message from her running buddy Shen Peiwen confirming their run. Yu Xiaowei replied with an OK emoji, left at 6:20, and jogged and walked east along Prince Edward Road West as a warm-up, enjoying the fresh morning sea breeze, until she reached the main entrance of Victoria Park, ready for the morning run.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 8th Floor, Block 12, 328 Prince Edward Road West; and along Prince Edward Road West to the main entrance of Victoria Park, Wan Chai District.

name: Victoria Park morning run and stretching
description: Arrived at the main entrance of Victoria Park on time and met up with running buddy Shen Peiwen. The two smiled and high-fived, then did 5 minutes of dynamic stretching side by side, including high knees, lunge stretches, and shoulder circles. Shen Peiwen asked with concern about Yu Xiaowei's right calf, and Xiaowei said it was no big deal. They started running on the park's loop track at around 6:50, keeping a steady pace of about 6:15/km. Along the way, Shen Peiwen shared amusing stories about her students, keeping the mood light. At the 8th kilometer, Xiaowei felt slightly tired, and Shen Peiwen slowed down to encourage her. They completed the 10 km in 1 hour 3 minutes, then did 3 minutes of static stretching beside the track, feeling refreshed in both body and mind.
location: Victoria Park, Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Breakfast heart-to-heart talk and farewell with Shen Peiwen
description: After the run, the two walked along Jardine Street to Kam Kee Cafe in Causeway Bay, a local diner they often went to after running. They sat in a booth by the window. Yu Xiaowei ordered a pineapple bun with butter, fried egg, and iced milk tea; Shen Peiwen ordered shrimp wonton noodles and hot lemon honey. As they enjoyed breakfast, Yu Xiaowei opened up and told Shen Peiwen about her work pressure, setbacks in team management, trouble with a Shenzhen client, and her anxiety about being unable to expand new business due to lack of energy. Shen Peiwen listened attentively and shared her own experience of using a "small-goal breakdown method" in teaching to ease anxiety, comforting Xiaowei not to be too tense. Yu Xiaowei felt understood, relaxed, and showed an easy smile. After breakfast, the two made a pinky promise at the cafe entrance to meet again next Tuesday at the same time, rain or shine, then said goodbye.
location: Kam Kee Cafe, Jardine Street, Causeway Bay, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Returned home to find cat chaos and quickly tidied up.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked home. As soon as she entered, she found the orange cat had knocked over the embroidery thread box in the living room, and colorful threads were tangled into a mess. With time running short, she quickly stuffed the tangled threads back into the storage box, took a quick shower, changed into business attire (light blue shirt, dark gray skirt, flat black leather shoes), blow-dried her hair, applied sunscreen, put on her commuter bag, and got ready to take her child to school.
location: Home, 8th floor, Block 12, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Send son and daughter to school
description: Yu Xiaowei first walked with her son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, reminding him along the way to remember his English dictation review. After saying goodbye at the school gate, she quickly turned back and picked up her daughter Zhang Yuxin near home. Xinxin happily shared the painting she drew yesterday; Yu Xiaowei praised her and agreed to do crafts together in the evening. At 09:38, she sent her daughter to the entrance of Kowloon City Kindergarten and watched her enter the school.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Tin Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong; Kowloon City Kindergarten, No. 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai

name: Commute to the office in Wan Chai
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Yu Xiaowei walked along Argyle Street to MTR Kowloon Tong Station and tapped in with her Octopus card. She took the MTR via the East Rail line, Kwun Tong line, Tsuen Wan line, and Island line, transferring at Admiralty Station, and finally arrived at Wan Chai Station. On the train, she put on her Bluetooth earphones to listen to the CFP course chapter “The Application of Estate Tax Planning in Insurance,” marked calculation cases, and wrote down questions in her phone memo. After exiting the station around 10:22, she walked directly to the 28th-floor office at AIA Financial Centre.
location: Kowloon Tong MTR Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District (via MTR)

name: Morning office work.
description: After arriving at her workstation in Zone C on the 28th floor of AIA Financial Centre, Yu Xiaowei first opened her computer and scheduling software to confirm the key afternoon items. She checked the critical illness insurance terms booklet and case tables prepared for the afternoon client Mrs. Chen to make sure all materials were complete. Then she went into deep work: organizing the folders she would need that afternoon, including contract copies, FAQ brochures, and coverage review templates; replying to Director Liang Zhenhua's email to confirm that the team's task transparency rules would be implemented next Monday; reviewing and sending three client renewal reminder text messages; sorting out the visitor appointment form for next week; at 11:15 receiving a call from the secretary of Shenzhen client Wang Qiming to confirm the time of next week's conference call; and finally rereading the key details in the critical illness insurance terms to ensure the afternoon explanation would be accurate and clear.
location: 28th floor, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and a short shopping trip with colleague Su Lishan
description: At noon, she met her colleague Su Lishan at Wing Kee Café near the company. Yu Xiaowei ordered rice with silky scrambled eggs and shrimp, paired with iced lemon tea, while Su Lishan ordered curry beef brisket rice. The two chatted over the meal: sharing their morning run experiences and Shen Peiwen’s advice, reviewing the feedback on the team standards approved yesterday, exchanging preparation tips for the afternoon client visits, and talking about the funny mischief caused by the orange tabby at home — the atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei went to the 7-Eleven on Johnston Road, bought low-sugar soy milk and seaweed crackers, and then walked back to AIA Financial Centre.
location: Wing Kee Cafe on Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the 7-Eleven convenience store on Johnston Road.

name: Afternoon client meeting preparation and execution.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei returned to her desk, had some biscuits to replenish her energy, then packed the materials needed for the afternoon meeting into her briefcase, including documents, a tablet, a notebook, and so on, and sent Mrs. Chan a confirmation message. At 13:40 she took the Island Line from Wan Chai Station to Tai Koo Station, and at a nearby tea shop bought two cups of lemon tea as a gift. After arriving at Mrs. Chan's home at Kornhill Garden, Taikoo Shing, she was warmly welcomed. After some small talk in the living room, Yu Xiaowei quickly got down to business: she brought out the critical illness insurance brochures and charts and explained the upgraded terms in detail, especially the underwriting rules, possible additional premiums, or exclusions related to Mrs. Chan's thyroid nodules, while also answering her husband's questions using analogies and case examples. During the conversation, she proactively asked about the family's protection structure, identified a new need for coverage for the new house, and noted it down. The two eventually reached a consensus to consider raising the sum insured by 30%, and Yu Xiaowei promised to prepare a detailed proposal when she returned. At 16:15, after saying goodbye, she walked back to Tai Koo Station and took the MTR back to her office in Wan Chai.
location: At Mrs. Chen's home and on the way, 8/F, Block E, Kornhill Gardens, 3 Tai Fung Road, Taikoo Shing, Eastern District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Office wrap-up and commute home.
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowei immediately entered the summary of the afternoon meeting into the system: the client Mrs. Chen intended to increase her coverage by 30%; she recorded the underwriting recommendation and set a reminder. She updated the client follow-up log, replied to a colleague's WhatsApp message about team guidelines, and texted her mother to say she would be home around 7 p.m. At 17:15 she tidied her desk and left work, taking the MTR from Wan Chai Station back to Kowloon. On the way, in the crowded carriage, she put on her earphones and replayed the CFP course again, reinforcing the calculation logic and jotting down key points. Around 17:50 she exited Whampoa Station and walked home.
location: AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District (via MTR).

She checked her son Zixuan's schoolbag and found the English dictation scope and wrong questions, so she patiently took him through two rounds of spelling at the whiteboard. Her daughter Yuxin was building a little house with blocks nearby and pulled her over to look; Yu Xiaowei praised her and promised to do crafts together after dinner.
location: Home, 8th floor, Block 12, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner

The whole family chatted as they ate: Yu Xiaowei shared the good mood brought by her morning run, her father mentioned winning at the chess stall in the afternoon, her mother said cabbage at the market was cheap, and her husband said he could take the children to and from school tomorrow. Her son volunteered that his English dictation had improved, and her daughter sang a children's song she had learned at school. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious; after the meal, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to help clear the dishes.
location: Home dining room, 8th Floor, Block 12, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Then she went to the living room to make origami bags and cherry blossoms from colored cardstock with her daughter, playing Cantonese songs while guiding her. After finishing his homework, her son came over and folded paper cranes too, and the family had a pleasant time together. At 20:45 her husband took the two children to wash up.
location: Home, 8th floor, Block 12, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal time: organizing embroidery threads, CFP review, and relaxation
description: While the children were washing up, Yu Xiaowei finally dealt with the morning cat disaster: she took out a storage box, patiently untangled a dozen or so knotted mulberry silk threads, carefully picked apart the knots with small scissors, spent about 25 minutes smoothing out all the threads, sorted them, and put them back into the embroidery thread box, then wiped the cat paw prints off the coffee table. After that, she returned to the bay window area in the bedroom, changed into loose pajama pants, took out the textbook "CFP Investment Planning" and reviewed the wrong answers in the "Estate Tax Planning" chapter. By rereading the questions and writing out the steps from memory, she fully understood the calculation logic. Then she did a 5-minute guided meditation breathing exercise on her phone and a simple set of stretches for her right leg and shoulders, and she felt completely relaxed.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 12, 8th floor, living room and bedroom at home.

name: Bedtime preparations and couple's evening talk
description: Yu Xiaowei brushed her teeth and washed her face in the master bathroom, applied face cream, packed her commuter bag and sports backpack for the next day, putting in CFP textbooks, a spare silk scarf, and proposal forms, and sent a message in the family group asking about breakfast. After lying down, her husband softly asked how she was feeling today. Xiaowei briefly summarized that the morning run and her conversation with Shen Peiwen had resolved her concerns, the afternoon meeting had gone smoothly, and the cat's mischief had been handled. Her husband comforted her and said he would continue to support her morning run tomorrow and would take the children to school. They chatted for about 10 minutes and said goodnight to each other. Yu Xiaowei turned off the bedside lamp, confirmed the 6:00 a.m. alarm, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block 12, 8th floor, master bedroom

location: Bedroom and living room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

At the table, Xiaowei reminded Zixuan to bring his sports shoes for PE class, and helped Xinxin peel a boiled egg while listening to her talk about her dream last night. The atmosphere was warm and peaceful.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

After hearing this, Zhou Minyi smiled with relief and confessed that she had recently been considering a job change, which was why she had kept it from everyone. Xiaowei breathed a sigh of relief, and the two shared their worries with each other just as they did in their school days.

At the dinner table, Yu Xiaowei shared funny stories from her lunch with her best friend, and her husband Zhang Weiming talked about helping the neighbor fix his computer. After dinner, she checked her son Xuanxuan's math homework, while her daughter Xinxin nestled in her arms and listened to her read The Little Prince.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Video call with younger brother and planning National Day gathering
description: Yu Xiaowei first plugged in her phone to charge, restarted the Wi-Fi, and took out her notebook to write down the points to discuss: confirm the National Day dinner location (Qi Ji Cantonese Restaurant), purchase Ocean Park tickets online, and tactfully ask about Tencent's internal insurance benefits information. She then had a video call with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen. On the screen, her brother appeared holding his son, who was wearing a one-piece pajama. After Xiaowei interacted with her nephew, they discussed things in an orderly way: the dinner was confirmed for 6:30 p.m. on October 1 at Qi Ji Cantonese Restaurant, with her brother responsible for making the reservation; on October 2, Xiaowei would purchase the Ocean Park tickets online. Xiaowei brought up the topic of Tencent employee insurance benefits, and her brother sent a screenshot of the company's internal benefits overview from his phone. Xiaowei quickly saved the image. After the call, Xiaowei wrote the confirmed itinerary in her notebook and handwrote a summary of the key Tencent insurance points. She took a photo of the notes and sent it to her brother to confirm, and he replied with an OK gesture. She then verbally informed her husband and mother in the living room of the preliminary three-day National Day arrangements to ensure everyone was on the same page.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden residential estate, home living room and mother's bedroom

She turned off the bedside lamp and slowly fell asleep in a calm mood.

Her thoughts occasionally drifted toward the marathon course, but she gently pulled them back. After the meditation, she turned off her phone and repeatedly reminded herself to stick to the plan. She fell asleep faster than the previous day, drifting off around 22:30.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning weigh-in, stretching, and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 7:30. Yu Xiaowei turned it off and lingered in bed for two minutes. After getting up, she stood on the electronic scale in the corner of the bedroom in her pajamas, saw the number showing 53.9kg, took a deep breath, and told herself to be patient and persistent. Then she did 10 minutes of morning stretching and mindfulness meditation on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing her right calf muscle, which was sore after yesterday's run. While washing up, she encouraged herself in the mirror and sorted out her study priorities for the day. After changing into loungewear, she went to the dining room, where her mother Chen Meiling had prepared a special breakfast for her: a chicken breast whole-wheat sandwich and unsweetened yogurt. Seeing that the family had steaming wonton noodles in their bowls, Xiaowei struggled inwardly but resolutely drank the lemon water, restraining the urge to drink milk tea. Her husband Zhang Weiming gave her an encouraging look, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin curiously asked why she wasn't eating noodles. Xiaowei took the opportunity to explain the relationship between running and a healthy diet. The whole morning was filled with a positive, self-disciplined atmosphere.

Then she got up, added cat food and water for Bailey, the family's orange cat, patted its head, and told it not to disturb her studying. After that, she formally entered study mode, played the course video through earphones, followed along with the electronic textbook on her laptop, and drew a mind map in her notebook, recording in detail the various risk types (market, credit, liquidity, etc.) and measurement indicators (standard deviation, beta, Sharpe ratio, etc.). She was fully focused, and although she occasionally heard the children playing and making noise in the living room, she quickly returned her attention to her work. Once, in the middle of her study session, she got up to drink some water and stretch her neck. At 11:30, she paused her studies and went to the living room to rest. Seeing her son Xuanxuan building with LEGO, she squatted down to chat with him and listened as he excitedly talked about how his father had taken him to the playground at Kowloon Park yesterday, and said he also wanted to learn to run like his mother. Xiaowei smiled and encouraged him to try jogging a short distance with her on the weekend to build a good foundation first.
location: Study and living room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Yu Xiaowei sat at the table with her husband, two children, and mother, eating the light fish and brown rice, feeling grateful for her mother's thoughtful arrangement. Xuanxuan brought up wanting to run with his mother again, and Xiaowei promised to take him to the sports ground to try it when the weather cooled down. After the meal, she helped her mother clear the dishes into the kitchen; the family interaction was warm.

After waking up, she felt refreshed and decided to switch to studying on the living room sofa to maintain a sense of novelty. Hugging a back cushion, she opened the companion practice question bank on her tablet, carefully completed the first 5 questions, and after checking the answers, her accuracy rate reached 80%. She noted in detail on her notebook the reason for a wrong question about portfolio standard deviation calculation, and re-derived the formula. In between, she got up several times to drink water and stretched her neck.

She sent Hui a private message, and the two chatted by voice for nearly 10 minutes. Xiaowei complained aggrievedly about how hard it was to stick to her diet, especially when she saw her family eating snacks. Hui laughed and encouraged her, saying that beginnings are always hard, telling her to think about her full-marathon goal, and promising to treat her to a nice meal after returning to Hong Kong as compensation. After the call, Xiaowei felt much better and decided to go out and take a 15-minute walk in the community garden to get some fresh air, relieve the fatigue from sitting too long, and get a little sunshine.

I'm fine anytime!' Her daughter drew a little flower nearby, and Xiaowei gently praised her for doing a great job, enjoying the warm mother-daughter time.

name: 20-kilometer long-distance training run and coaching guidance
description: At 07:00, Coach Zhao asked her to start at a pace of 5:15-5:20/km. For the first 8 kilometers, Yu Xiaowei ran side by side with A Wen, and the rhythm was manageable. But at 8.5 kilometers, her right calf muscle tightened again, her cadence went slightly off, and her pace dropped to 5:30. She wanted to speed up, but at the 15th kilometer Coach Zhao stopped her. Ignoring A Wen's presence, he sternly criticized her unstable mindset and warned that she would collapse like this at the street marathon at the end of the month. Her eyes welled up, but she followed the instructions, lowered her pace to 5:45-5:50, adjusted her breathing rhythm, and barely completed the final 5 kilometers. After the long run, she sat on the sidelines using a foam roller to relax her muscles. The coach recorded the pace curve and suggested she strengthen her core and single-leg balance training. A Wen handed her warm water and whispered comfortingly, 'There are still three weeks left, we have enough time.'

name: Stretching, refueling and communicating with the coach
description: Walked slowly for a few minutes to let my heart rate settle, then Yu Xiaowei and Awen did 15 minutes of deep stretching. Coach Zhao's attitude softened, and he gave adjustment advice: reduce running volume in the coming week, add more core training, and do daily meditation to relax. She nodded seriously and noted it down in her phone memo. The three agreed on the interval training time next Tuesday. After that, Awen excused herself and headed to Kwun Tong. Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to the coach and walked home.
