description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowei put on her running shoes at home and walked to the Rest Garden on Hung Hom South Road. She completed a relaxed 3-kilometer run with a steady pace. Then she did 15 minutes of core activation training on the lawn, including planks and bird-dog exercises. After finishing, she walked slowly home, feeling slightly warm.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Hung Hom South Road Rest Garden

name: Family breakfast and preparation of pre-race supplies
description: After her morning run, she showered and changed into loungewear, then sat around the dining table with her husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, daughter Zhang Yuxin, and mother Chen Meiling to enjoy plain congee and turnip cake. After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei carefully packed energy gels, salt tablets, and bottled water into her running waist pack in the kitchen, getting ready for tomorrow’s race.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Husband picked up the Cantonese embroidery and they admired it together, then called father
description: Yu Xiaowei forwarded the pickup information from the framing shop to her husband Zhang Weiming, who then walked to Yixuan Picture Framing on To Kwa Wan Road to pick up the framed Cantonese embroidery piece 'A Daughter's World: Autumn'. He returned with it about 45 minutes later, and the two unpacked it together, seeing the warm and touching embroidery set off by the gold frame. This prompted Yu Xiaowei to summon the courage to call her father Yu Guoqiang. On the phone, her father, brusque yet concerned, told her not to push herself too hard during tomorrow's run. The long-standing knot in her heart finally loosened, and after a brief chat they agreed to meet at the finish line tomorrow.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Completed Cantonese embroidery and accompanied the children.
description: After hanging up, feeling lighthearted, Yu Xiaowei finishes the last few maple leaf stitches on the embroidery piece Daughter's World: Autumn, hangs it on the wall of the yoga area in the study, takes a photo, and posts it on Moments. Then she accompanies her daughter Zhang Yuxin in painting with watercolors, and helps her son Zhang Zixuan check his math homework, patiently explaining the division mistakes until he understands.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking her child to the community playground
description: The children couldn't sit still, so Yu Xiaowei took them downstairs to the playground at Whampoa Garden Estate. She sat on a bench watching her son and daughter go down the slide and swing on the swings, snapping photos of their smiling faces with her phone. When they were tired, they bought Vitasoy at the convenience store and slowly walked home while sipping it.
location: Fat Kwong Street Playground, 5 Chatham Road North, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Light lunch and midday rest
description: Mother Chen Meiling prepared steamed grass carp, garlic stir-fried choy sum, and steamed rice. The whole family had lunch together. Yu Xiaowei ate extra fish and vegetables to store up energy for tomorrow. After the meal, she felt sleepy and went back to the bedroom for a half-hour nap.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing competition gear
description: Refreshed after her nap, Yu Xiaowei sat on the floor and neatly placed all her gear into the running backpack: a pink running T-shirt, black shorts, running shoes, race bib, energy gels, and salt tablets. She carefully pinned on the race bib and checked the batteries on her sports watch and phone.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon housework and preparation.
description: Seeing her mother preparing the ingredients for wontons in the kitchen, Yu Xiaowei proactively helped trim the baby bok choy. As they worked, the mother and daughter talked about calling her father. Her mother revealed that her father was actually very caring, and Yu Xiaowei felt warmer inside and moved even more briskly.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompany my daughter in drawing and help my son with his homework.
description: Daughter Zhang Yuxin wanted to draw Mommy running. Yu Xiaowei helped her draw a pink little person with simple stick figures, and the two kept laughing. Son Zhang Zixuan was watching an English cartoon on his tablet, and Yu Xiaowei sat beside him reminding him to watch his viewing distance and posture.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family walk along the waterfront promenade
description: To relax, Zhang Weiming suggested the family take a walk along the Hung Hom Promenade. The evening sea breeze was pleasant, and the family strolled slowly along the path, taking in the Central skyline and sunset glow. Their daughter picked up seashells, their son chased a corgi, and Zhang Weiming held Yu Xiaowei's hand and said the whole family would wait for her at the finish line tomorrow, making her feel especially happy.
location: Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Dinner: Mom's wonton noodles made with love
description: Mother cooked shrimp wonton noodles with blanched choy sum and white cut chicken. Yu Xiaowei ate a big bowl and even drank all the soup. At the table, she proactively served chicken to her father Yu Guoqiang; her father silently accepted, and the family atmosphere noticeably eased.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Hot bath to relax muscles
description: After dinner, she rested for half an hour, then ran a hot bath, added lavender essential oil, soaked in the hot water, and massaged her calf and thigh muscles with bath salts, letting her tense body completely relax.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family movie night.
description: After a bath and changing into pajamas, the whole family gathered in the living room to watch the animated movie "The Cat's Fantastic Journey" on the projector. The children laughed heartily, and the parents were also grinning from ear to ear. Yu Xiaowei leaned on Zhang Weiming's shoulder, enjoying the peaceful happiness.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Final equipment check and fascia gun massage
description: After the movie ended, Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom and checked her race gear bag again, making sure the race bib, energy gels, salt tablets, and water bottle were all there. Then she took out a massage gun and carefully loosened the front and back of her calves and her thighs, about two minutes for each part.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Write in a gratitude journal, do a body scan meditation, and say goodnight to family.
description: Yu Xiaowei wrote a gratitude journal in the study, recording the happiness of calling her father, finishing the embroidery piece, and being together with the whole family. Then she put on her earphones and did a 15-minute body scan meditation to settle her thoughts. After meditating, she went to the children's room, kissed them on the foreheads, and said goodnight. Then she returned to the master bedroom and had a brief exchange with her husband, who was already in bed, feeling supported and warm.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to bed on time to recharge
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off all electronic devices, set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning, took deep breaths in bed, and fell into a deep sleep with anticipation for the race and gratitude for her family.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wake-up and preparation before the race
description: At 4 a.m., Yu Xiaowei woke up to the sound of her alarm. She first drank a glass of warm water, changed into a running singlet and shorts, and did 15 minutes of dynamic stretching in the living room, focusing on her hip, knee, and ankle joints. She then ate a banana and a slice of whole wheat bread for energy, and carefully checked the salt tablets, energy gels, phone, and Octopus card in her waist pack to make sure all gear was in place, getting both her body and equipment ready for the upcoming full marathon.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Setting out for the starting point
description: At exactly 5:00, her husband Zhang Weiming opened the door for Yu Xiaowei. After lightly kissing her husband, she picked up her bag and left. At the entrance of the residential complex, she hailed a taxi via a mobile app and rode to the Kowloon Toll Plaza of the Western Harbour Crossing. The ride took about 40 minutes. Streetlights gradually faded in the morning light along the way. She was full of anticipation, her heart racing, making final mental preparations for the Hong Kong street marathon.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, West Kowloon Highway, southwestbound, Western Harbour Crossing Toll Plaza

name: Gathering at the starting point and meeting up with running friends.
description: Arrived at the starting point around 5:40, where the crowd was buzzing. Yu Xiaowei met her close friend Shen Peiwen at the assembly point. The two hugged excitedly and checked each other's bibs and gear. Shen Peiwen said excitedly, 'Finally, this day is here!' Xiaowei replied, 'Let's cross the finish line together!' They did their final warm-up among the crowd, waiting for the starting gun, the atmosphere warm and tense.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, West Kowloon Highway southwestbound, Western Harbour Crossing toll plaza start area.

name: Hong Kong Street Marathon Full Marathon Race
description: At 6:00 sharp, the 2025 Hong Kong Street Marathon started with the starting gun. Yu Xiaowei moved forward steadily with the crowd, maintaining a stable pace for the first 5 kilometers. After running side by side with Shen Peiwen through the Western Harbour Tunnel, sunlight fell on the Central waterfront, and she passed the halfway point smoothly. After 25 kilometers she entered Sham Shui Po, and the sun grew harsher. At the 30-kilometer mark, a severe cramp in the back of her thigh forced her to slow down; she leaned on a railing to take in electrolytes and stretch. She then adopted a run-walk strategy. In the final 10 kilometers, with tenacious willpower and supported by the sight of her family, she persevered and finally crossed the finish line at Victoria Park at 11:28:47, completing her first marathon. Volunteers immediately came forward to help her to the recovery area.
location: Full marathon route from the Western Harbour Crossing toll plaza, via the Western Harbour Crossing and Hong Kong Island, to Victoria Park.

name: Post-race recovery and family reunion.
description: After crossing the finish line, Yu Xiaowei slumped in the recovery area. Volunteers handed her water and a towel, and she felt full of pride. A moment later, her family arrived: her husband Zhang Weiming hurried over with a towel and water; her son Xuanxuan waved a small flag and shouted, "Mom is amazing!"; her daughter Xinxin ran over and hugged her tightly; and her father Yu Guoqiang also showed up unexpectedly, with approval in his eyes. Zhang Weiming handed her a pineapple bun and hot milk tea, and the family took a happy group photo in front of the finish-line backdrop, capturing that moment of glory.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Causeway Road, Victoria Park finish area.

name: Return home from the finish point.
description: After a brief stop at the finish line, the family took a taxi back to their home in Whampoa Garden. On the way, Yu Xiaowei leaned on her husband's shoulder while the children chattered about their cheering experience. The ride took about 25 minutes, and they arrived at the estate around 12:40.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going home to rest and recharge
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei first took a cold shower at a comfortable temperature to relieve the burning sensation in her muscles, then did 15 minutes of static stretching in the living room, focusing on her cramped calves and hamstrings. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had prepared steaming hot shrimp wonton noodles. Xiaowei ate heartily, and her energy gradually recovered.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Deep Rest and Physical Recovery
description: After eating wonton noodles, Yu Xiaowei sat down on the sofa, drank some warm water, and used a massage gun to gently relax her leg muscles. Around 2:30 p.m., she leaned back on the sofa, covered with a thin blanket, and let her body recover naturally in a half-awake, deep rest.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon family time.
description: Around 3 p.m., her daughter Xinxin woke Yu Xiaowei up, and they looked through the finish-line photos and videos together, reliving the exciting moment. Her son Xuanxuan brought over a watercolor painting of 'Mom Won First Place.' Xiaowei's spirits improved, and she suggested going to the waterfront promenade downstairs for a walk to stretch their legs.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family seaside walk
description: In the early evening, the family of four changed into casual clothes and strolled slowly along the Whampoa Waterfront Promenade. The setting sun turned Victoria Harbour golden. Xiaowei's legs were still sore, but walking with her family felt comfortable. Her husband walked ahead holding the two children's hands. They sat down on a bench and watched cargo ships pass slowly by, feeling extremely content.
location: Whampoa Waterfront Promenade, Hoi Bun Road, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: After returning home from the walk, her mother Chen Meiling had prepared a light and nutritious dinner: steamed sea bass, blanched choy sum, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and winter melon and barley lean pork soup. The whole family sat around the table, and her father Yu Guoqiang took the initiative to put food in Xiaowei's bowl and said, “You’ve worked hard.” The warm and harmonious atmosphere at the table brought this special day to a perfect close.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-race reflections and interaction with the running group.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei opened her phone in the study and entered the Hong Kong Street Marathon running group. She selected a finish-line photo of herself wearing the finisher's medal, surrounded by family, and wrote: A full marathon is like life; only after breaking down do you realize you can keep going. Thanks to my family for their support, and thanks to myself for not giving up! #HongKongStreetMarathon2025 #FirstMarathonFinish. After the message was sent, running buddy Shen Peiwen replied immediately, shared a photo of them hugging at the starting line, and left a message encouraging her to keep it up at the Standard Chartered Marathon in December. The group interaction was lively.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime skincare and meditation
description: Back in the bedroom, Yu Xiaowei used a foam roller to carefully relax her calves, thighs, and gluteal muscles, relieving deep soreness. Then she drank a glass of warm honey milk and lay in bed doing a 10-minute body-scan meditation, feeling her body's feedback from her toes to the top of her head, letting her mood return to calm.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparations
description: After meditation, Yu Xiaowei briefly wrote about her feelings in her diary and marked in the calendar the plan to visit client Mrs. Zou tomorrow. Her husband Zhang Weiming returned to the bedroom, gently hugged her, and said, "Proud of you." Xiaowei smiled and kissed him, turned off the light at 22:00, and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling and unforgettable day.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and body check
description: Woke up naturally, feeling the sunlight through the curtains, with calmness and fatigue intertwined after the full marathon. In bed, she did gentle ankle and wrist exercises, focusing on massaging the gastrocnemius muscle of her right leg, and confirmed there was no stabbing pain, only normal muscle soreness. She sent a message to her husband Weiming, thanking him for taking the children so she could rest more.
location: Master bedroom, Block G, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Drove to Kowloon Tsai Park
description: She changed into compression tights and running shoes, checked her earphones, and drove from the basement garage to Kowloon Tsai Park, taking Prince Edward Road West to Inverness Road. The parking lot is at the park entrance.
location: Along the route from the basement car park of Whampoa Garden residential estate to Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Recovery jog
description: Jogged for 30 minutes at a pace of 7:00/km in Kowloon Tsai Park, feeling the smoothness in my joints. Passing the tree-lined jogging trail, I adjusted my breathing and monitored the reaction of my right gastrocnemius muscle; there was no discomfort.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park running track, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City

name: Stretching and yoga relaxation.
description: On the lawn of Kowloon Tsai Park, she did 15 minutes of static stretching, focusing on the hamstrings and calves and feeling the muscles lengthen. Then she laid out the yoga mat she had brought and did 10 minutes of yin yoga for relaxation, focusing on opening the hips and back. Listening to the birdsong, she felt at peace.
location: Lawn at Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City

name: Drove home.
description: Drove from Kowloon Tsai Park back to the Whampoa Garden home.
location: Along the route from Kowloon Tsai Park to Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Recovering at home and chatting with family
description: After returning home, she soaked her legs in cold water of about 15°C in the bathtub up to her calves for 10 minutes to promote muscle recovery. After drying off, she briefly chatted with her mother, who was watering flowers in the living room, asked about her sleep, and told her she would not be home for lunch. Then she checked the cat bowl and refilled the cat food for Zhaocai.
location: Bathroom and living room, Block G, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Eye yoga practice
description: Sitting at the desk, complete a 15-minute eye yoga session, including eye rolling, near-far focusing, and gentle pressure on the temples, to relieve fatigue from early morning driving and screen use.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block G, study room

name: Online work and emotional processing.
description: She opened her laptop and confirmed several emails about client background checks for cross-border business in the work group chat. She briefly scrolled through the high school classmates group and saw He Junjie and Zhou Minyi discussing the year-end gathering, feeling a pang of bitterness. At that moment, a private message from He Junjie popped up asking about her relationship with Mandy. She stared at the screen for a long time, finally replied, “Just busy,” then closed the group chat and decided to put the feeling aside for now.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block G, study room

name: Walk to Whampoa New World.
description: Put on a sun hat, walk downstairs, cross the residential garden, and walk about 5 minutes to reach Whampoa Xintiandi shopping mall.
location: Along the route from Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Wonder World, No. 6 Tak Hong Street.

name: Had tea and a chat with close friends.
description: At the Baoyuan Restaurant in Whampoa New World, she ordered a pineapple bun with butter and hot milk tea, and excitedly shared with her best friend Lin Jiaxin her experience in yesterday's full marathon and the touching moments of her family picking her up and dropping her off. Jiaxin also shared her progress on the insurance exam. They chatted for half an hour — short but fulfilling. Finally, after paying the bill, Yu Xiaowei hugged her friend and said goodbye.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 6 Tak Hong Street, 2/F, Whampoa Wonderland, Po Yuen Restaurant

name: Walk home and pick up takeout lunch.
description: Walking home, she ordered a takeout double-roast meat rice at New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant (7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom) on the way.
location: From Whampoa Wonderland, 6 Tak Hong Street, to Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, passing the New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese restaurant at 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom

name: Midday client relationship maintenance
description: While eating takeout, she edited a Moments post, attaching a photo of yesterday's full marathon finisher medal and a family group photo. The text focused on "gratitude for companionship" and "new starting point." Then she selected three key clients (including a Mr. Zhang who had asked about high-end medical insurance last month) and sent a personalized greeting via WhatsApp: "I just finished a full marathon and deeply realized the importance of persistence and protection. Your policy review is coming up. How about tea sometime?"
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block G, study room

name: Short break and leg massage
description: After lunch, she rested for 15 minutes on the living room sofa while massaging and relaxing her calves.
location: Living room, Block G, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Eye yoga and organizing client reports
description: First complete a 15-minute eye yoga session to thoroughly relieve eye fatigue. Then open the company system, pull up the annual physical examination reports of three clients, and use sticky notes to record the indicators that need attention and the additional coverage that needs updating, in preparation for next week's client meetings.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block G, study room

name: Emotional meditation and handling the classmates group chat
description: She opened her phone again; the classmate group chat was still discussing it. She resisted checking the private messages and instead wrote two lines in her notebook: "Boundaries protect you, they don't cut you off from the world." Then she opened the meditation app and did a 15-minute guided meditation, focusing on her breath, accepting and letting go of her fixation on the Zhou Minyi incident.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Block G, study room

name: Parent-child interaction and help with household chores
description: After her husband picked up the children and brought them home, she sat with her daughter Zhang Yuxin in the living room, drawing a cat and a medal with crayons, and listened to her daughter talk about funny things at kindergarten. Then she checked her son Zhang Zixuan's math homework and patiently explained how to solve a word problem. After that, she went into the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling trim and wash vegetables to prepare dinner.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Block G, living room and kitchen

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Yu Xiaowei shared details of how her legs cramped during the full marathon but she kept going. Zixuan and Xinxin listened, fascinated. Weiming suggested going to the country park for a barbecue on the weekend to celebrate Mom finishing the race, and the children cheered in response. During the meal, Chen Meiling talked about the new trainees in the Cantonese embroidery class at the community center, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Restaurant, Block G, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's seaside stroll
description: After dinner, the two went out for a walk. Weiming held her arm and asked in detail how she was feeling physically, and shared his progress in his apprenticeship after changing careers. They strolled slowly along the waterfront promenade, discussing the details of the weekend family activity—the shopping list for the barbecue at Pak Tam Chung. Yu Xiaowei suggested they could also bring Wanjun (Zhou Minyi's daughter) along to ease the relationship, but Weiming squeezed her hand and said to take it slow and not force herself. She finally nodded in agreement.
location: Whampoa Garden Waterfront Promenade, 20 Tak Fung Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening meditation and eye yoga
description: After washing up, I changed into comfortable pajamas. First, I completed a 10-minute eye yoga session. Then I sat cross-legged on the bed and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation on the theme of Releasing and Accepting, imagining that the bitterness of today's peer relationship issues was being breathed out of my body. After the meditation, I confirmed my phone alarm (06:30 tomorrow morning) and mentally prepared for a normal commute the next day.
location: Master bedroom, Block G, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime reading
description: She picked up the book on Cantonese embroidery stitches from the bedside and flipped through a few pages of the chapter on expressing flower layering. The drowsiness from her body soon made her put down the book, turn off the light, and fall asleep, ending this fulfilling and peaceful day.
location: Master bedroom, Block G, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally after the alarm went off and did a 2-minute waking stretch in bed. After washing up, changed into exercise clothes, drank a glass of warm lightly salted water, and weighed herself, recording it in her phone's memo: 53.3 kg.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare the children's breakfast and school arrangements
description: Her mother had prepared white congee and fried eggs. Yu Xiaowei helped her son and daughter eat breakfast, checked their backpacks, water bottles, and homework, and told her son to wait at the classroom door after school.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the children to school
description: Yu Xiaowei drove her private car to first take her son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and walked him to the school gate. Then she drove 5 minutes to Kowloon City Kindergarten and handed her daughter over to the teacher.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Kowloon Tong, Tin Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School; and Ma Tau Wai, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City Kindergarten

name: Went to Kowloon Tsai Park for a recovery jog and yoga.
description: Drive about 10 minutes from the kindergarten to Kowloon Tsai Park and relax by listening to the radio. Upon arrival, do 5 minutes of dynamic stretching on the grass, then jog 5.5 km for 40 minutes at an easy pace of 7:15/km, paying attention to the condition of the quadriceps in the right leg. After the run, do 15 minutes of Sun Salutation yoga in the shade, focusing on opening the hips and stretching the back of the thighs.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Driving home and freshening up and changing clothes to prepare for the commute
description: Drove about 15 minutes back to home in Whampoa Garden. After a quick shower, changed into a professional suit (white shirt, dark blue skirt, and black blazer), put on light makeup, organized the commuter bag, and made sure phone, power bank, client materials, work badge, business card holder, and other items were all in place.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Walked from home to Whampoa MTR Station, took the MTR (Kwun Tong Line, transferring to Tsuen Wan Line, then to Island Line) to Wan Chai Station, about 40 minutes in total. On the train, she read the financial section of the South China Morning Post on her phone and browsed U.S. stock and Asian market updates.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region MTR (Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station)

name: Morning office work.
description: Arrived at the Immigration Tower / AIA Financial Centre office and exchanged greetings with colleague Su Lishan. Processed 15 client emails, including two participating policy inquiries. Called client Mrs. Chen to schedule a policy review on Thursday afternoon. Sorted a list of 10 clients and added notes in the CRM system.
location: Office at Immigration Tower / AIA Financial Centre, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and eye yoga.
description: Went alone to Rong Ji Noodle and Tea Restaurant near the office, ordered shrimp wonton noodles and iced lemon tea. After the meal, closed eyes and did a 15-minute eye yoga practice, including looking into the distance, eye rolling, and acupressure, to relax the eyes.
location: Wing Kee Noodle and Tea Restaurant, Jaffe Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Afternoon work, team communication, and file organization
description: Back at the office, she greeted Wang Qiming, a client from Shenzhen, via WeChat and sent him Greater Bay Area medical insurance information. In her notebook, she listed a preliminary plan for the family weekend barbecue (ingredients, tools, transportation). Afterwards, she went to Director Liang Zhenhua's office to briefly report on client follow-up progress and her training recovery status, and received encouragement for the sales push. Returning to her desk, she processed two new policy applications (critical illness and savings), checked the information, and submitted them. Before leaving work, she completed her task list, tidied her desk, and confirmed tomorrow's memo.
location: Office at Immigration Tower / AIA Financial Centre, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute back home
description: Walked to Wan Chai MTR Station and took the MTR back to Whampoa Station. Along the way, listened to the CFP investment planning audio course through earphones, focusing on reviewing the concepts and calculation logic of the efficient frontier and the Capital Asset Pricing Model.
location: MTR, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station)

name: Picking up the child from school and on the way home
description: First pick up the daughter at Kowloon City Kindergarten, then drive to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School to pick up the son. The children shared what happened at school; the daughter showed a dolphin drawing, and the son complained that the math problems were difficult. On the way, they bought fresh Chinese broccoli at the street market.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, No. 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong

name: Arrived home and interacted with family.
description: After arriving home, her mother was in the kitchen preparing dinner. Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter change out of her school uniform, guided her son through his after-school homework, changed into home clothes, and discussed the menu with her mother.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the table enjoying dinner, which included steamed sea bass and garlic Chinese broccoli. Yu Xiaowei brought up the weekend barbecue plan and discussed the division of labor with her husband: he would handle the meat and charcoal, while she would handle the sauces, vegetables, and utensils. The children excitedly asked to bring marshmallows.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening family time and leisure
description: After the meal, she helped her mother clear the dining table, then accompanied her daughter to draw with crayons in the living room, creating a doodle of the whole family having a barbecue. Her husband accompanied their son through his math homework. Her mother brought up the exhibition of works from the Cantonese embroidery class, and Yu Xiaowei said she would attend and display her kapok embroidery.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening review: sorting through the CFP investment planning framework
description: After settling the children, she entered the study and used XMind mind-mapping software on her laptop to systematically organize the knowledge framework of the CFP investment planning module, covering sub-modules such as risk and return, asset allocation, and portfolio management, and marking common mistakes. During the session she took a short break to drink water and stretch her shoulders and neck.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep recovery: fascia gun massage and cold water immersion
description: In the bathroom, first use a massage gun to deeply massage the right thigh's quadriceps and gastrocnemius for 15 minutes to relieve soreness. Then soak the feet and calves in cold water for 10 minutes to speed up recovery after the marathon.
location: Bathroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Changed into pajamas, exchanged goodnights with her husband. Set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, and wrote "CFP investment framework has been sorted out; need to strengthen calculation questions" in the notebook as a close to the day. After feeling fulfilled and calm, she turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: Woken up by the 6:40 alarm. Because it was the Chung Yeung Festival, she planned to take the whole family hiking, and she felt expectant. Did 5 minutes of stretching in bed, then washed up, changed into a light sports T-shirt and trousers, weighed 53.2 kg, styled her short hair with a little hair gel, and checked the emergency medicine. Then she and her husband woke the children together. The daughter rubbed her eyes and asked where they were going; she smiled and said they were going to climb Victoria Peak for the festival. In the kitchen, she helped her mother bring breakfast to the table: plain congee, fried eggs, char siu bao, and blanched lettuce. Her father was already sitting at the table, in good spirits. While serving him porridge, he proactively asked whether she had checked the hiking poles. She smiled and nodded, feeling warmth in her heart. The family sat around the table having breakfast together in a warm atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing hiking supplies and driving to Victoria Peak
description: After breakfast, she began packing the hiking backpack, putting in 4 bottles of water, individually packaged crackers and chocolate, sunscreen, wet wipes, band-aids, and mosquito repellent. She also checked the first aid kit and stuffed in a garbage bag. She reminded her father to bring his trekking poles, and her mother helped her daughter and son put on light jackets. After her husband checked the car's condition and fuel level, the whole family set off from Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District, driving through the Hung Hom Cross-Harbour Tunnel, along Gloucester Road and Peak Road toward Victoria Peak. On the way, her son asked what they could see from the top, and her daughter hummed a nursery rhyme while turning sideways to chat with her father about the newspaper he had been reading recently. The atmosphere was relaxed. Her father pointed out the window and said, “The weather is really nice today, perfect for hiking,” while secretly thinking about when to bring up the topic of financial planning.
location: Along the route from Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District through the Cross-Harbour Tunnel to Victoria Peak in Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Climb Victoria Peak (Lugard Road section)
description: After parking at the starting point of Lugard Road, we officially began the hike. I walked in front with my father, while my mother, husband, and children followed behind. The slope was gentle and the air in the woods was fresh. My father said with emotion, "It's been a long time since I walked this trail; the last time was when I brought you and your younger brother." Taking the opportunity, I slowed down and used the climb as a metaphor for financial planning, tentatively bringing up the idea of investing and managing money. But my father did not respond, keeping his eyes on the path. So I stopped at the right point, did not press further, and continued enjoying the hike.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Central and Western District, Lugard Road

name: Reached the summit of Victoria Peak; father and daughter broke the ice
description: At the Peak Tower observation deck, overlooking Victoria Harbour, my husband suggested taking photos. First we took a family photo, then he prepared to take one of my father alone. Just as I was handing water to the children, my father suddenly turned around and said clearly and firmly, "I'm old, and I want to leave the money to you. But I don't trust those products; what I trust is you, Xiaowei." My head buzzed, and tears immediately welled up. I stepped forward and hugged him tightly. His shoulders felt much thinner than in my memory, and I choked up and couldn't speak. My mother and the children also gathered around. It was a warm and touching scene, and ten years of estrangement dissolved at that moment.
location: The Peak Tower Observation Deck, 128 Peak Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leisure and family time at Peak Galleria
description: After her emotions calmed down, she walked to the Peak Galleria. She bought ice-cream cones for the children and sat on a bench to rest. Her husband chatted with her father about the Peak Trail route, holding his hand and feeling a closeness that had been long absent. She noticed a Cantonese embroidery handicraft stall in the plaza. Her mother stopped to look, and she accompanied her, discussing stitching techniques and color combinations, and remembering that she would be learning new stitching techniques from Teacher Wu next week. The family enjoyed a relaxed Chung Yeung Festival family time on the Peak.
location: Peak Galleria, 118 Peak Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Enjoying lunch on the mountaintop
description: Considering that she still had to prepare a family dinner after going down the mountain, she decided to have a simple meal at Peak View Restaurant in The Peak Galleria. They ordered an assorted roast meats platter, wonton noodles, and seasonal vegetables, and chatted while eating. Her father took the initiative to ask about the details of her work and even asked her to bring some product brochures home to look at. She readily agreed and promised to put together a sound plan best suited to him. The meal had a harmonious atmosphere, laying the foundation for later financial planning communication.
location: Peak Lookout Restaurant, 1/F, Peak Galleria, 118 Peak Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Going down the mountain, shopping at the market, and returning home
description: After lunch, drove down the hill. Her husband first took her mother and the children straight home, while she went with her father to the To Kwa Wan market to buy ingredients for dinner. They bought fresh shrimp, pork ribs, and roast goose, and her father specially picked a fresh grass carp. After shopping, they drove back to Whampoa Garden. On the way, her father was in a good mood and hummed a Cantonese opera tune; looking at him, she felt grateful and motivated. It was about a 10-minute drive home.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from Peak Galleria on Victoria Peak via To Kwa Wan Market at 165 Ma Tau Wai Road, Kowloon City District, back to Whampoa Garden

name: Lunch break and organizing hiking photos
description: After arriving home, she changed out of her sweat-soaked workout clothes and rested on the sofa for 15 minutes. Then she took out her phone, picked the best photos from today's mountain hike, especially the candid shot of her father tearing up as he said, "I believe in you" at the summit. After a quick edit, she posted a WeChat Moments message: "Climbing high on Double Ninth Festival, hearts together. The biggest gain this year is finally walking into my father's heart. #ThereIsAKindOfTrustCalledBlood", recording this extraordinary day.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling Work and Studying
description: Entered the study, turned on the computer, and handled work: replied to 3 client emails, answering routine questions such as policy effective dates and dividend withdrawal; organized the materials needed for tomorrow afternoon's policy review with client Mrs. Chan, and printed the latest policy cash value table; sent a WhatsApp greeting to Mr. Wang in Shenzhen, wishing him a healthy Chung Yeung Festival. Then opened the CFP investment planning question bank and completed 10 calculation questions using the Pomodoro Technique to prepare for the professional exam.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepared and cooked the Double Ninth Festival family dinner
description: I went into the kitchen with my mother and got busy. Mother was in charge of making lotus root and pork rib soup and soy sauce chicken, while I handled washing and cutting vegetables, preparing garlic choy sum and fresh shrimp, and getting shredded ginger and scallion pieces for the steamed fish. In the living room, my husband was helping our son with math homework, and my daughter was drawing today's mountain climbing scene on paper. After Mother finished the soup and chicken, it was my turn: I skillfully made blanched shrimp, steamed grass carp, stir-fried choy sum with garlic, and arranged a roast goose platter — four dishes and a soup, all delicious in color, aroma, and taste. The children helped set the table, my husband opened a bottle of cola, and the whole family worked together to get ready for the family feast.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A warm Double Ninth Festival family dinner.
description: The family dinner officially began, and everyone talked about the day's hike; the children rushed to describe the view from the mountaintop. She picked up a cup of tea, walked over to her father, and said sincerely: “Dad, thank you for what you said today. I offer this cup of tea to you, and thank you for your trust in me.” Her father also raised his teacup, his eyes slightly red, and replied: “We're one family—no need to stand on ceremony. Just do your best.” Everyone at the table was deeply moved, and the meal felt especially warm; at that moment, their bond grew even deeper.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Father and daughter had a long talk in the study about estate planning.
description: After the meal, she took her father aside to a separate conversation in the study. Her father took out an old notebook that detailed the family's cash, fixed deposits, and two properties, and expressed his wishes for inheritance, hoping to reduce the future tax burden on the children when assets are passed on. After listening carefully, she promised to handle it conscientiously, and used her phone to help her father organize an initial plan, suggesting that he first consider planning with an insurance trust. This was an important financial heart-to-heart between father and daughter.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize CFP materials and career planning
description: First, she helped her daughter finish the homework drawing of 'the family climbing a mountain' and pasted the artwork on the refrigerator; then she checked her son's math homework and corrected two calculation mistakes; she cleared the dishes with her husband, while her mother packed the leftover roast goose into the refrigerator. Afterwards, in the bedroom, she shared every detail of today's ice-breaking with her father. Her husband was happy for her and suggested that tomorrow, as soon as she gets to work, she should find Liang Zhenhua to consult on the legal framework and product suitability of estate planning. She wrote down this plan.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening relaxation, review, and physical recovery
description: While the family was resting, she looked through the hiking photos on her phone and sent a few to her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng to share the joy. In her Notes app, she organized the key points of the asset planning discussion with her father from that evening. Then she took out the CFP textbook and completed the remaining 2 calculation problems (12 in total for the day). After that, she took a shower, used a fascia gun to massage the sore muscles in her right leg from the hike for about 10 minutes, soaked her feet and calves in cold water to relieve fatigue, and finally did 15 minutes of eye yoga to relax her eyes.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Write in the gratitude journal and go to bed.
description: In my gratitude journal I wrote: "2025.10.29, Chung Yeung Festival. Today my father said to me, 'I trust you.' I had waited ten years for those three words. In the future, I want to carry this trust forward." I set the alarm for 6:30 the next day. After turning off the light, the scenes from the day still replayed in my mind, and I fell into a deep sleep filled with happiness and gratitude.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and preparation.
description: At 6:15 a.m., the phone alarm went off on time. She got out of bed quietly, went to the living room first and weighed herself on the electronic scale. Seeing the number steady at 53.4 kg, she felt satisfied with her recovery after the full marathon. She drank a glass of warm water, changed into running gear, and prepared for her morning run.
location: Flat A, 15/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Resume jogging and stretching
description: Walked five minutes to Kowloon Tsai Park. Started the planned 45-minute recovery jog, maintaining a pace of 6:45/km, focusing on steady breathing and relaxing muscles. After the run, used the foam roller she brought to carefully release her calves on the lawn, then did 10 minutes of yoga stretching focused on the hips and backs of the thighs, feeling that the soreness in her right leg had basically disappeared.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going home for a shower and a simple meal
description: Walked home from the park. Took a quick shower and changed into a business suit. By then her mother was already up and had prepared breakfast (unsweetened soy milk, whole wheat bread, and boiled eggs). While eating breakfast, she briefly discussed the birthday celebration arrangements with her mother and asked her to help keep an eye on the preparation of items at home.
location: Flat A, 15/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family time and fasting wrap-up
description: Her husband and the children got up one after another. Everyone sat around the dining table, and she gently reminded her son and daughter that they would surprise Dad together in the evening. She kissed her daughter who had just woken up and patted her husband on the shoulder, saying, Happy birthday, dear. During the meal, she and her husband briefly reviewed the results of two months of the 16:8 intermittent fasting method, and they decided to continue this healthy habit for the long term.
location: Flat A, 15/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute (home to office)
description: After saying goodbye to my family, I walked seven minutes to MTR Whampoa Station. During the ride, I put on my earphones and used a mobile app to quickly review the core formula flashcards for the CFP exam chapter on “Portfolio Management and Performance Evaluation,” making sure fragmented time was used efficiently.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, from MTR Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station (Kwun Tong Line to Tsuen Wan Line to Island Line)

name: Morning office meeting and handling tasks
description: After arriving at the office, she first handled a few client emails left over from last night. At exactly 9 o'clock, the department held its routine morning meeting. Director Liang Zhenhua briefly reviewed yesterday's performance and communicated the latest market developments; she focused on taking notes on the key points.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Organizing materials and preparing for client meeting
description: After the morning meeting, I returned to my desk. First, I double-checked the policy review materials for the 2 p.m. client, Mrs. Chen, to make sure all data, value-added services, and recommended plans were ready. Then I entered new client information into the system and handled the preliminary review of two claims documents.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Called to consult about estate planning.
description: Using the landline at my workstation, I called Li Guodong, Senior Wealth Management Manager at HSBC. After a polite greeting, I got straight to the point, briefly explaining my father's wish to plan the inheritance of his savings, and raised a few preliminary questions about trusts and tax-exempt savings insurance. Li Guodong gave framework-level advice and promised to compile a set of materials and email them to me. The call lasted about 20 minutes and was very efficient.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Consult supervisor and take notes.
description: She walked with her notebook to the director's office. Seeing that Liang Zhenhua was free, she knocked and entered. She briefly recounted her father's asset situation and succession needs, and asked how, under the legal framework of an insurance trust, to design a plan that would both protect her father's wishes and take into account tax optimization. Liang Zhenhua pointed out several key risk points and compliance paths, and recommended a law firm partner for further consultation. She took careful notes and expressed her deep gratitude to Brother Hua for his guidance.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Replying to WeChat and integrating plan ideas
description: Returning to her seat, she saw that Li Guodong had sent a concise mind map via WhatsApp. She quickly saved it, integrated Liang Zhenhua's suggestions with Li Guodong's initial ideas, and began sketching a preliminary proposal framework on scratch paper with a pencil, writing down the combined approach of "trust + insurance". Then she replied to Li Guodong to confirm the meeting on the afternoon of next Wednesday (November 5) at HSBC's headquarters in Central.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch, confirming the private room for the dinner, ordering dishes, and returning to the office.
description: At 12:00, she had a simple lunch with her colleague Su Lishan at the Hua Sao Cafe downstairs, chatting about newly launched insurance products and market trends. After the meal, around 12:40, she took the MTR alone to Prince Edward Road West and arrived at Yuan Kee Chiu Chow Da Leng, where she confirmed the private room for 7 p.m. with the owner and ordered the dishes (two large chilled crabs, a platter of braised meats, and a bowl of oyster porridge). After confirming, she took the MTR back to the Wan Chai office around 13:45 and arrived at 14:00. During the trip, she opened the family group chat, saw the photo of her child posted by her mother, gave it a like, and replied with a heart.

participant.name: Restaurant owner
participant.relation: Yuan Ji Teochew cold dish shop owner

location: First had lunch at Hua Sao Cafe, 38 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; then went to Yuan Kee Chiu Chow Cold Dishes, 88 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District; then returned to the Wan Chai office.

name: Conducting a policy review for client Mrs. Chen
description: Mrs. Chen arrived as scheduled. Yu Xiaowei warmly welcomed her into the reception room and served tea. Referring to the review report prepared in advance, she analyzed in detail the coverage, dividends, and potential gaps in Mrs. Chen's existing policies. Taking into account her children's upcoming study-abroad plans, she recommended a flexible U.S. dollar savings plan as a supplement to education funds. The entire meeting was professional and meticulous. Mrs. Chen expressed great satisfaction and agreed to come next week to sign the new policy.
location: Meeting room at the AIA Insurance office, 19/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handled work paperwork and CFP study.
description: After seeing off Mrs. Chan, she returned to her desk and handled several backlogged paperwork tasks, including claims follow-up and policy updates. Then, using half an hour, she took out her CFP sprint notes and quickly reviewed the key charts and calculation formulas in the "Personal Risk and Insurance Planning" chapter to strengthen her memory.
location: AIA Insurance office, 19th Floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute (from office to cake shop to pick up a cake)
description: At 4:30 p.m., she left work on time. On the commute, she sent a message to her mother in advance to confirm that the family was ready. She took the MTR to Whampoa Station, then walked to Caesar Bakery inside the Whampoa New World shopping mall to pick up the custom cake ordered yesterday. The cake box bore the emblem of her husband's favorite football team, a carefully chosen design.
location: Kaiser Cake Shop, Wonder World Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned home to pick up the gift and the hand-drawn birthday card, then picked up the family
description: After picking up the cake, she walked home (about 3 minutes). As soon as she entered, her daughter rushed up and reported, "Mommy, we made cards with Grandma! Daddy isn't back yet!" She smiled mysteriously and temporarily hid the cake in the kitchen. She took out the gift box she had hidden in advance (a new fitness band and running shoes), and asked the children to bring out the birthday cards they had drawn, checked them, and wrapped them. At that moment, her husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, saw the warm scene, and his eyes were full of anticipation.
location: Flat A, 15/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to a Chaozhou restaurant to celebrate a birthday
description: Arm in arm with her husband, the children hopping and skipping ahead, they walked with her parents to Yuanji Chiu Chow cold platter. On the way, her husband asked why she was so happy today, and she smiled and said, "Because today is a good day."
location: Walk from Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Yuen Kee Chiu Chow Cold Dishes at No. 88 Prince Edward Road West

name: Birthday dinner at a Chaozhou restaurant.
description: The atmosphere in the private room was warm, and the pre-ordered frozen crab, marinated cold platter, and oyster congee were already on the table. During the meal, the children presented their father with a hand-drawn birthday card and sang the birthday song. She took out the gift box and said softly to her husband, "Happy birthday, Weiming. I hope we can run toward health and a new life together." Zhang Weiming looked at the gift, his eyes slightly red, and held my hand tightly. When making a wish, he said, "I hope our family will always be this complete and healthy." Father Yu Guoqiang also showed a gratified smile and clinked glasses with his son-in-law.
location: Private room at Yuen Kee Chiu Chow Cold Dishes, 88 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-meal activities and returning home.
description: At the end of the dinner, I used my phone to capture the moment of my husband making a wish and the whole family raising glasses, sent it to the family group (including my younger brother Yu Xiaofeng), with the message: 'Birthday surprise accomplished! Happy birthday to the strongest support of our family, we love you!' On the way home, my father Yu Guoqiang said to me privately, 'You arranged everything very well today. Dad trusts you.' Holding my father's arm, a warm feeling surged in my heart.
location: Walk from Yuen Kee Chiu Chow cold dishes, No. 88 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, back to Flat A, 15/F, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden.

name: Family bedtime moments and CFP exam sprint study.
description: After getting home, she settled the children into bed with her husband, gave them goodnight kisses, and then went back to the study. She turned on the desk lamp and spent 30 minutes reviewing the difficult parts of the CFP sprint notes (related to portfolio theory and insurance law). She felt her thinking was clearer and her confidence had grown.
location: Flat A, 15/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meditation, gratitude journaling, and falling asleep.
description: At 10:30 p.m., she changed into her pajamas and did a 15-minute mindfulness meditation beside the bed, with the theme “Gratitude and Acceptance”. Then, in her gratitude journal on the nightstand, she wrote: “Today, I prepared a surprise for my husband, earned my father's trust, and completed my work smoothly. My family is safe and life is fulfilling. I am very content.” Finally, she set the alarm for 6:15 tomorrow morning, turned off the light, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom, Flat A, 15/F, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up, jogging, and yoga stretching.
description: At 6:15 a.m. the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowei took a deep breath to check the condition of her right leg. After confirming there was no soreness, she got up and weighed herself: 53.2 kg. She changed into a sports bra and shorts, then walked to Kowloon Tsai Park for an easy run at a pace of 6:30/km, covering about 4.6 km in 30 minutes while paying attention to feedback from her right leg throughout. Returning home, she laid out a yoga mat in the living room and completed a 25-minute Sun Salutation yoga stretch, focusing on relaxing the backs of her legs and her hips.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park (13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District) and the living room at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Shower, change clothes, and family breakfast.
description: After exercising, she quickly took a hot shower and changed into a home T-shirt and shorts. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was already busy in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowei helped set the table with toasted bread, fried eggs, and fruit, then woke up her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin, and braided her daughter's hair into two pigtails. At 7:50, the whole family sat down to eat breakfast. Following the 16:8 fasting method, Yu Xiaowei had a light wonton noodle soup as her brunch. She and her husband, Zhang Weiming, agreed to discuss finances in the evening. The children excitedly talked about the school craft class and storytelling contest, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the child to school and returning home to prepare for review
description: Yu Xiaowei drove to first take her son Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, driving north on Princess Margaret Road for about 8 minutes, and watched her son walk happily through the school gate; then she drove east along Argyle Street for about 5 minutes to take her daughter Xinxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten, personally handing her to the homeroom teacher. After returning home, she poured herself some warm water, tidied up the study, took out her exam admission slip, ID card, and financial calculator to check the information, brewed some chrysanthemum goji tea, and prepared to start her CFP review.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School (1 Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon City District), Kowloon City Kindergarten (206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District), and Whampoa Garden residential estate

name: Final review before the CFP exam.
description: In her study, Yu Xiaowei focused on organizing her notes and mind maps for the key CFP chapters, especially tax planning and retirement planning. She took a break every 45 minutes, and at 10:30 paused for 10 minutes to do eye yoga, rotating her eyeballs up, down, left, and right, then closing her eyes and looking into the distance to relieve the fatigue of prolonged reading.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Work communications and handling of matters
description: After wrapping up her review, Yu Xiaowei contacted her client Mrs. Chen via WhatsApp to confirm the meeting at Starbucks next Thursday at 10 a.m., and marked it on her calendar. Then she pulled out her notebook, organized the core issues in her father's estate planning and the new questions that came up after her call with lawyer Li Guodong, and prepared a checklist for next week's meeting with HSBC.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and rest
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowei and her mother shared tomato and egg noodle soup, which was in line with Yu Xiaowei's diet plan. During the meal, they talked about the community Cantonese embroidery class's work display next week, and her mother showed the red kapok blossom picture of good news she was embroidering. Yu Xiaowei said she looked forward to it. After lunch, she voluntarily washed the dishes and then watched TV news with her mother in the living room for a while.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon review and forced relaxation.
description: In the afternoon, she continued reviewing. Yu Xiaowei confirmed that tomorrow's exam venue was the Kowloon Bay International Trade and Exhibition Centre, planned the driving route on a map, and saved a screenshot. She did a few calculation problems to stay sharp. Strictly following the plan, she forced herself to stop reviewing at 14:30, went to the balcony, made chrysanthemum tea, looked out at Lion Rock, and took deep breaths to relax. Before 3 p.m., she completed the second eye yoga session, allowing her brain to completely detach from the tense exam-preparation state.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, study and balcony

name: Daily necessities shopping and downloading a bookkeeping app
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to Whampoa Square, bought soy sauce and kitchen paper towels at ParknShop, and chose egg tarts at a dessert shop on the first floor as an after-school snack for the children. Then, in the mall's seating area, she downloaded and registered the "MoneyLover" expense tracking app on her phone, created a family ledger named "Xiaowei and Mingzai's Home", and set up default categories such as "Dining Out" and "Household Supplies".
location: Wonder World Shopping Centre, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying the children and helping with housework.
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowei gave the egg tarts to the children who had just returned from school, and they were very happy. She accompanied her daughter Xinxin in painting watercolors in the living room, correcting her brush grip; then she went to the kitchen to help her mother peel garlic, wash vegetables, and cut tomatoes, listening to her mother chatter about neighborhood trivialities as they worked.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Confirm evening arrangements and tidy up the study
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the study, neatly put away the review materials, and sent a WeChat message to her husband Zhang Weiming to confirm that they would discuss financial matters after dinner. Her husband quickly replied with agreement. She wiped the desk clean, opened the Excel file, and prepared the data for organizing the monthly household income and expenses.
location: Study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner time
description: Husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, and the family sat together to enjoy white cut chicken, stir-fried choy sum, and steamed egg custard prepared by mother. During the meal, the children eagerly shared funny stories from school, and daughter Xinxin imitated her teacher's mannerisms, making the whole family laugh. Yu Xiaowei deliberately avoided topics of exams and finances, fully immersing herself in the warm family atmosphere.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family leisure time
description: After dinner, the family watched the animated show 'My Little Pony,' which their daughter loved. Yu Xiaowei leaned on her husband's shoulder, her son and daughter played with LEGO on the carpet, and her mother sat on the sofa mending clothes, occasionally looking up at the TV. The scene was peaceful and tranquil.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organized monthly household income and expenses.
description: In the study, Yu Xiaowei used Excel to summarize in detail all income and expenses for October, including her and her husband's salaries, commissions, food expenses, mortgage, utilities, children's interest classes, installment payments for beauty treatments, and her daughter's dental visit costs. After calculation, she found that the month had overspent by about 3,100 Hong Kong dollars, mainly exceeding the budget on dining out and unexpected medical visits. After a serious discussion, the two reached a consensus: starting next month, the family's dining-out budget would be cut by 20%. Then Yu Xiaowei opened the MoneyLover app in front of her husband, shared the family ledger and invited him to manage it together, and also set monthly budget limits in the app for categories such as 'Dining Out' and 'Entertainment'.

name: Commute to Sham Shui Po Community Centre
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei drove back to Whampoa Garden and parked, walked to Hung Hom Station, took the MTR East Rail line to Mong Kok East Station, transferred to a green minibus, and arrived at the community center on Fat Cheung Street, Cheung Sha Wan Road, Sham Shui Po District at 8:35. On the way, she sent a WeChat message to Teacher Wu Xiuying to let her know she had set off.
location: Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, Fat Cheong Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Attended the community Cantonese embroidery exhibition
description: Yu Xiaowei met Teacher Wu at the entrance to the exhibition hall. Teacher Wu's "Gold and Jade Fill the Hall" painting of lotus and koi remained the center of attention. Yu Xiaowei admired the works of other students and exchanged views with them on the stitching techniques of Cantonese embroidery and Chaozhou embroidery. She was especially fascinated by a starry-sky-themed Guangdong embroidery piece that incorporated modern elements, and discussed with the artist how to use alternating overlapping and random stitches to express the sense of depth in the nebula. Around 10 o'clock, she helped Teacher Wu pack up some of the works and agreed to go to her studio next Tuesday to continue learning new stitching techniques.
location: Exhibition Hall, 3rd Floor, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, Fat Cheong Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to the office
description: After leaving the community center, she walked to Sham Shui Po Station, took the MTR Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. After exiting the station, Yu Xiaowei ordered a cup of unsweetened iced lemon tea to-go at a cha chaan teng on the street corner, then walked quickly to the office at 7 Gloucester Road and swiped her card to enter at 11:00.
location: AIA Financial Centre, Connaught Road Central, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Design the framework for Wang Qiming's renewal plan.
description: After settling into her seat, she pulled up the previous policy data for Wang Qiming Technology Company, carefully analyzed the scale of the R&D and overseas sales teams that the company was expanding, and reassessed the new industry risk factors. Yu Xiaowei began building a renewal framework in Excel and initially designed two plans: one focused on basic protection with increased coverage limits, and the other adding premium outpatient and dental coverage. At the same time, she listed the items requiring client confirmation, such as the new-member list and pre-existing medical condition declarations, in a memo.
location: AIA Financial Centre, Connaught Road Central, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Had wonton noodles with colleagues for lunch and took a walk after the meal.
description: At 11:55, after sorting out her thoughts, Yu Xiaowei tidied her desk and met her colleague Su Lishan at the elevator lobby. The two chatted as they walked; Su Lishan shared amusing anecdotes about her little one just starting Primary One, while Yu Xiaowei talked about what she had seen at the Cantonese embroidery exhibition in the morning. After about a six-minute walk, they arrived at the restaurant. Each ordered a bowl of the signature shrimp wonton noodles, for a total of HK$48. While eating, they exchanged updates on several recent clients. Yu Xiaowei also mentioned that her daughter Xinxin would be going to Guangzhou next month for a children's painting competition. Su Lishan shared her parenting experience and said her younger brother lives in Guangzhou, so she could recommend some family-friendly places. They had a very engaging conversation. After the meal, they didn't go straight upstairs; instead, they strolled along the Cobbold Road footbridge to aid digestion, enjoyed the breeze for a while, and then returned to the office building.
location: Mak's Noodle, Stewart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; AIA Central, Connaught Road Central, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Refine the renewal plan and prepare tomorrow's talking points.
description: Back at her desk, Yu Xiaowei refilled her cup with hot water and continued refining Wang Qiming's renewal plan. After writing a detailed supplementary explanation document, she sent a WeChat message to Guo Junwei, a colleague in the Guangzhou actuarial department, regarding the industry risks of the new team, asking about the actuarial details of group insurance claims data and asking him to help calculate a risk coefficient. While waiting for a reply, she opened Li Guodong's estate planning folder and organized the outline, trust-versus-insurance comparison cases, and other materials needed for tomorrow afternoon's meeting into a key points checklist.
location: AIA Financial Centre, Connaught Road Central, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Finishing up work and leaving early
description: Yu Xiaowei sorted and filed the documents she handled today, sent the final version of Wang Qiming's proposal to her assistant for printing. She shut down her computer and tidied her workstation. At 16:00 she clocked out and left the office, ready to start her evening family time.
location: AIA Financial Centre, Connaught Road Central, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting and shopping
description: Walked to Circle K at Convention Plaza and, as planned, bought a family pack of fresh milk and a pack of strawberry soft candies, her daughter's favorite. Then took the MTR East Rail Line from Wan Chai Station to Hung Hom Station, walked back home to Whampoa Garden, and listened to a few soothing classic Cantonese songs along the way to relax.
location: Convenience store at Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong SAR; Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Family assistance and sharing
description: After arriving home, she changed into loungewear and saw her mother preparing dinner in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowei went over to help pick and wash the vegetables. While picking them, she enthusiastically described in detail the wonderful pieces she had seen at today's Cantonese embroidery exhibition, especially the starry-sky Cantonese embroidery, and said she would try to embroider one for her daughter next time.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening parent-child time
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming picked up their daughter from school and brought her home. As soon as the daughter entered the door, she threw herself into Yu Xiaowei's arms. Yu Xiaowei took out strawberry soft candies, and the daughter cheered with joy. After that, she sat on the living room floor with her daughter, listening to her describe in childish language the clouds she had painted in kindergarten today. Soon her son also came home from school. Yu Xiaowei checked his homework and encouraged him for his progress on the math quiz.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the dining table, enjoying the steamed sea bass, garlic choy sum, and slow-cooked soup made by the mother. At the table, her husband, Zhang Weiming, shared an amusing story about fixing an old water-cooled air conditioner that day; their son excitedly talked about scoring two goals in after-school football practice; and their daughter, not to be outdone, showed off a little flower she had made from plasticine. Yu Xiaowei listened quietly with a contented smile on her face.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Painting with my daughter
description: After dinner, they took a short break. The daughter took out her new sketchbook and asked her mother to draw 'clouds in the sky' with her. Mother and daughter sat side by side at the tea table.
