The daughter first sketched the outlines of clouds in pencil, while Yu Xiaowei helped her pick colored pencils and guided her on how to shade from light to dark to make the clouds look more three-dimensional. Her husband Zhang Weiming captured the warm scene with his phone and casually posted it in the family group chat, earning likes from grandma and aunt.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Checking son's homework and family accounts.
description: Yu Xiaowei first went to the study to check her son's math homework, explaining and reinforcing the word problems on addition and subtraction of fractions in detail. After confirming there were no mistakes, she took out the ledger and went over the family expenses of the past two days with her husband Zhang Weiming, and as usual recorded today's transportation, lunch, and shopping expenses in the MoneyLover app.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Write a gratitude journal.
description: The children were looked after by grandma in the living room. Yu Xiaowei quietly returned to the bedroom and sat on the edge of the bed. She opened her gratitude journal and, in neat handwriting, recorded three small things that made her happy today: First, she successfully attended the Cantonese embroidery exhibition with Teacher Wu and felt her craft had gained new inspiration; second, the wonton noodles at noon were very authentic, and she had a pleasant chat with Su Lishan; third, her daughter Xinxin looked focused and serious while drawing tonight. After writing, she felt calm and fulfilled inside.
location: Bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep stretching and tomorrow's schedule review
description: Changed into pajamas and did a simple 10-minute pre-sleep stretch on the rug by the bed, focusing on relaxing the shoulders, neck and legs. Lying in bed, she quickly ran through the next day's plan in her mind: the afternoon meeting with Li Guodong about estate planning, and Friday's policy signing with Mrs. Chan. After confirming the plan was clear, she turned off the bedside lamp.
location: Bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Reading and falling asleep
description: Although she felt a little sleepy, she still picked up the Cantonese embroidery stitch book recommended by Teacher Wu from the bedside table and flipped through a few pages of new stitch diagrams. At 21:50, she closed the book, put down her phone, and fell asleep peacefully in the night.
location: Bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning meditation and family morning.
description: At 6:30 a.m., Yu Xiaowei was awakened by her internal clock, did 10 minutes of morning meditation on her yoga mat by the window, let the morning light settle her thoughts, and checked the weather on her phone to confirm it was clear. She greeted her mother, Chen Meiling, then woke up her son, Zhang Zixuan, and daughter, Zhang Yuxin, helped Xuanxuan check his schoolbag and reminded him to bring his math workbook, and braided Xinxin's hair. In the kitchen, the aroma of her mother frying eggs and toasting bread filled the air. Xiaowei made Hong Kong-style milk tea and had breakfast with the family, listening to her husband, Zhang Weiming, talk about his plan to go to the New Territories today to repair the central air conditioning. At 7:40, Weiming drove Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. Xiaowei told Xuanxuan to focus in class, then checked her handbag for her iPad, client information folder, and power bank before heading out to work.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to work
description: At 7:50, Yu Xiaowei, dressed in a smart business suit, left home and walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon Tong Station, transferred to the East Rail Line toward Admiralty, then walked to Wan Chai Station. During the commute, she listened to the podcast Insurance New Era through earphones to learn about tax incentive policy adjustments, and used the Todoist app to confirm the order of today's tasks.
location: Along the MTR route from Whampoa Station to Wan Chai Station (Kowloon City District and Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

name: Pre-meeting preparation and email handling
description: At 8:35, she arrived at the AIA insurance office in the Immigration Tower at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai. She turned on her computer, launched the video conferencing software, adjusted the camera and microphone, and prepared the PDF of the group high-end medical insurance renewal proposal for the 10:00 meeting. Then, using the time before the meeting, she reviewed client Wang Qiming's company background information in the CRM system, added notes about his business expansion direction, and quickly skimmed and replied to several routine emails about policy inquiries and next week's appointments.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video conference with client Wang Qiming
description: At 9:45, Yu Xiaowei checked the video connection again and marked key points on the printed proposal summary with a highlighter. At 10:00, she contacted Shenzhen client Wang Qiming via WeChat video. After the usual pleasantries, she shared her screen and explained in detail Plan A (inpatient + outpatient) and Plan B (including special medical services), which were designed for his new department. Wang Qiming was very interested in the upgraded plan and asked detailed questions about Plan B's rate, but said he needed to discuss it with the company's finance department. Both sides agreed to talk again next week to confirm matters in preparation for signing the contract before the end of the year.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-meeting follow-up and work reporting
description: After the video conference, Yu Xiaowei immediately entered the meeting summary into the CRM system, recording Wang Qiming's core needs, objections, and follow-up action items. She then sent Wang Qiming a follow-up email with the group high-end medical insurance proposal PDF attached and a table comparing the plans included. At 11:45, she reported the communication results to her superior Liang Zhenhua (Hua Ge), bringing the meeting minutes, received his approval, and took the opportunity to ask about details on the trust threshold in estate planning interviews, gaining practical advice.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan went to the New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese restaurant on the 2nd floor of Shui On Center on Harbour Road near the company. They ordered pork soup dumplings and dan dan noodles and chatted in a quiet environment. Su Lishan confided that the new colleague was hard to manage. Yu Xiaowei patiently shared her experience of breaking complex products into easy-to-understand modules to enlighten her. The relaxed atmosphere temporarily relieved her work stress.
location: New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant, 2/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work and heading to a client meeting
description: After returning to the office at 1 p.m., Yu Xiaowei replied to two client emails asking about policy premium payments and organized the materials for the long-standing clients she would visit next Monday. She then rechecked the map for her 2 p.m. meeting with Li Guodong. At 1:45, she packed her briefcase and walked from Gloucester Road to the Renaissance Harbour View Hotel on Harbour Road, arriving about 15 minutes later. She found a quiet booth in the hotel cafe and waited for the client, using the opportunity to calm her mind and silently review the core estate planning framework she planned to discuss.
location: 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel, 1 Harbour Road

name: Meet with client Li Guodong to discuss estate planning
description: At exactly 2 p.m., Li Guodong arrived on time at the café of the Renaissance Harbour View Hotel. Based on materials prepared in advance, Yu Xiaowei analyzed his asset situation and family structure and proposed an initial planning framework combining large-sum life insurance and a trust. Li Guodong raised questions about taxation and asset isolation, and Yu Xiaowei gave professional answers to all of them. The meeting had a good atmosphere; Li Guodong said he would seriously consider it and asked for a detailed written proposal.
location: Café, Renaissance Hong Kong Harbour View Hotel, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned to the office and compiled the interview notes
description: After the meeting ended, Yu Xiaowei shook hands with Li Guodong and said goodbye, then left the hotel and returned to the office at 7 Gloucester Road. While her memory was still fresh, she immediately entered the key points of the meeting, the client's special concern about asset isolation, and the follow-up action items for preparing the written proposal into the CRM system, and updated the client profile.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare for Friday's information session.
description: Before 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowei opened the PPT for Friday's online presentation, incorporated her afternoon thoughts on the new product data, and adjusted the charts on several key slides to make them more persuasive. She then exported the list of clients to be invited from the CRM system and prepared to send the invitations the next day. At this point, all core tasks of the workday were completed.
location: AIA Insurance office, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute and package pickup
description: At 4:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei tidied her desk and left work ten minutes early. She took the MTR from Wan Chai Station back to Kowloon, and transferred to the Kwun Tong Line at Kowloon Tong Station to Whampoa Station. After exiting the station, she walked around to the smart locker at No. 6 Tak Hong Street, Whampoa New World Mall, entered the pickup code, and retrieved a parcel that her husband had accepted on her behalf — containing a simplified Chinese edition of a Cantonese embroidery stitch book.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 6 Tak Hong Street, The Whampoa shopping mall, and along the MTR.

name: Parent-child drawing with her daughter
description: At 5:15, she returned home to Whampoa Garden, where her mother had already picked up her daughter Xinxin from school. Yu Xiaowei changed into loungewear and drew with crayons with Xinxin on the living room floor. Xinxin drew a bride wearing a veil and said it was "what Mom looked like when she got married." Yu Xiaowei praised her imagination and colored it with her.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Yu Xiaowei helped her mother Chen Meiling prepare dinner, making steamed fish and stir-fried choy sum that evening. At 6:15, her husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, and the family had dinner together. At the table, their son Xuanxuan excitedly shared the joy of scoring a goal in the PE class football match, while Weiming talked about his successful repair of the client company's central air conditioning that day. Two dishes and a soup, warm and harmonious.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped son with his homework
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei came to her son Xuanxuan's desk. While checking his math homework, she found several problems that had been calculated incorrectly due to carelessness. She patiently guided him to reread the questions and recalculate using vertical calculations on scratch paper. After confirming there were no mistakes, she also helped him preview tomorrow's Chinese lesson "Autumn Rain" and praised him for doing well today.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Household tidying and playing with the cat
description: After tutoring, Yu Xiaowei tidied up the living room, putting scattered toys and books back in place. Seeing the British Shorthair blue cat "Nuomi" lounging lazily by the sofa, she squatted down and played with it using a feather wand, feeling relaxed.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Changing clothes and rest preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, changed into loose, comfortable home workout clothes, laid out the yoga mat, and checked her phone's network connection, preparing to video call her running partner Shen Peiwen.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video stretching session with running friends
description: At 8:10 p.m., Yu Xiaowei video-called her running buddy Shen Peiwen via WeChat. The two guided each other through exercises such as seated forward bends and leg stretches, and shared recovery insights after the full marathon. Yu Xiaowei talked about how her right leg had fully recovered after yesterday's Ashtanga class, and Shen Peiwen also shared recovery methods. They encouraged each other and agreed to go running together at Kowloon Tsai Park this weekend.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Writing in a diary, keeping accounts, and reading
description: After stretching, Yu Xiaowei went to the study. First, she used her diary to record today's three gratitudes: a pleasant lunch with Shanshan, accompanying Xuanxuan to correct their homework and getting a smiley face, and Wang Qiming's breakthrough progress on the policy renewal project. Then she opened the MoneyLover expense-tracking app to enter today's commuting, lunch, and online shopping package expenses. After that, she quickly planned tomorrow's work priorities—starting to draft the framework of the written proposal for Li Guodong. Finally, she took out the newly arrived Cantonese embroidery stitch book Tradition and Innovation, flipped through the starry-sky chapter, studied gradient silk thread and cross-stitch techniques, and envisioned how to apply them in her next piece, fully immersed.
location: Study room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and eye yoga
description: At about 10 p.m., Yu Xiaowei put down her book, took a hot shower in the bathroom, and changed into pajamas. While brushing her teeth, she did a set of simple eye yoga exercises to relieve the day's eye strain.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bathroom and bedroom

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning and checked her phone's Do Not Disturb mode. After getting into bed, she briefly reviewed the day's work achievements, felt satisfied with the smooth progress on the renewal and estate planning proposals, and closed her eyes with a sense of accomplishment, ready to fall asleep.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation and heading to the fitness center
description: At 6 o'clock in the morning, the phone alarm went off right on time. Yu Xiaowei got up quietly, opened the curtains, and it was already light outside. After washing up briefly, she changed into yoga clothes and drank a glass of warm water. Then she brought her yoga mat and water bottle, put on lightweight running shoes, and headed out. The morning at Whampoa Garden was very quiet. She walked through the estate garden, along Oi King Street to Hung Lai Road, and arrived at the familiar Whampoa Fitness Centre at 6:33.
location: Starting from Room B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, walk to Whampoa Fitness Center, 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Kowloon City District.

name: Community Ashtanga morning class
description: The morning class started on time. Coach Zhao particularly emphasized the hip-opening sequence today, guiding everyone to try deeper twists in preparation for half-marathon training. Yu Xiaowei practiced with great focus. During the transition into crow pose, she asked the coach how to transmit hip strength to the core to help with powering through the latter part of the half marathon. The coach patiently demonstrated and pointed out the detail that her shoulders tended to tense up. After the entire class, Yu Xiaowei felt her body completely opened up and was full of energy.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Yoga Room

name: Returning home to shower and change clothes
description: After the yoga class ended, Yu Xiaowei walked home. As she entered, she greeted her mother Chen Meiling, who was busy in the kitchen, then quickly went into the bathroom for a hot shower to wash off the sweat. She changed into dry work attire—a light blue shirt paired with dark gray trousers—and applied simple commuting makeup.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family morning preparation and breakfast
description: Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen and helped her mother carry the cooked plain congee, fried eggs, and BBQ pork buns to the table. She first went to her daughter Zhang Yuxin’s room and gently woke her, reminding her to practice hard at school today in preparation for tomorrow’s competition in Guangzhou. Then she went to wake her son Zhang Zixuan, who was still lingering in bed. As the family sat down at the table one by one, she took out her phone and sent her husband Zhang Weiming a WeChat message reminding him to buy the daughter’s favorite chocolate cookies after work. Her husband quickly replied with an OK emoji. The whole family sat around the table for breakfast. The daughter excitedly talked about the new spin she would perform tomorrow, while the son complained that football training was too tiring. At 8:40, her husband drove their son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, while Yu Xiaowei got ready to take their daughter.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei drove the family car along Whampoa Road toward Ma Tau Wai. She arrived at the kindergarten gate at 8:53, parked the car, took her daughter's hand, and handed her to the teacher. She watched her daughter skip into the campus before leaving with peace of mind.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute to the office in Wan Chai
description: Yu Xiaowei drove home from near the school and parked, then walked to Mong Kok East MTR station. She took the East Rail line to Admiralty station and then transferred to the Island Line. The car was quite crowded. Standing by the door, she took out her phone and re-checked the details of the policy change documents she needed to process today. At 9:32 the train arrived at Wan Chai station.
location: Starting from Kowloon City Kindergarten, via MTR Mong Kok East Station and Admiralty Station to Wan Chai Station, finally arriving at Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District.

name: Visit a long-time client to process a policy change
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the office and met with her long-time client Uncle Chen in Meeting Room A. Uncle Chen is a retired architect who needed to change the beneficiary of a savings insurance policy he had purchased earlier. Yu Xiaowei patiently helped him fill out the forms and explained the rights after the change. After the paperwork was done, she also asked about Uncle Chen's recent health and reminded him that he could get a free policy check-up before the end of the year.
location: Meeting Room A, AIA Insurance Office, 20/F, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Rest and go to the café.
description: After seeing off Uncle Chen, Yu Xiaowei returned to her desk, made a cup of coffee to perk herself up, quickly organized Uncle Chen's materials, and then pulled up the information of prospective client Mrs. Wang from the client system to prepare for the meeting. At 10:45, she set off from the office, walked across the footbridge, and followed Harbour Road for 5 minutes to reach the café at Shui On Centre, where she chose a quiet window seat and sat down to wait for Mrs. Wang.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road to Shui On Centre Cafe, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District

name: Visiting prospective clients to introduce savings plans
description: Yu Xiaowei ordered a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea and waited for Mrs. Wang to arrive. Mrs. Wang is a full-time homemaker in her 40s with some spare cash who wanted to do conservative wealth management. Yu Xiaowei took out her tablet and explained in detail a new AIA multi-currency savings plan, comparing expected returns and flexibility across different currencies. Mrs. Wang was very interested and said she needed to discuss it with her husband before deciding; they agreed to follow up the next week.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and return to the office
description: After saying goodbye to Mrs. Wang, Yu Xiaowei left Shui On Centre and walked to her usual cha chaan teng, "New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant". She ordered a bowl of shrimp wonton noodles and a plate of lettuce with oyster sauce. While eating alone, she quickly browsed news on her phone and texted her mother to ask if she should bring anything home for lunch. Her mother said no. After finishing lunch, she walked back to her office in the Immigration Tower.
location: New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant, 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (after lunch, returned to Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District)

name: Handle office paperwork and phone follow-ups.
description: After returning to her desk, Yu Xiaowei began organizing the materials from the morning visits to Uncle Chen and Mrs. Wang, entering them into the customer management system separately and marking the next follow-up dates. Then she called three clients—Mrs. Chen, Mr. Zhang, and Miss Li—to confirm meeting times for next Wednesday or Thursday one by one, and made notes in her calendar.
location: AIA Insurance office, 20th floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon office work and a brief rest
description: After two hours of continuous work, Yu Xiaowei felt tired. She went to the break area, ate a few cookies a colleague had left on the table, stretched her neck and shoulders, and looked out at the busy streets of Wan Chai while taking deep breaths to regain her energy. Then she sat back down at her desk and began preparing materials for her lesson with Teacher Wu Xiuying next Tuesday, writing down the difficult point of “flat gold embroidery with gold and silver threads” from “The Essence of Cantonese Embroidery Stitches”. At the same time, she contacted Guo Junwei, a colleague in Guangzhou, through the internal messaging software to briefly confirm the calculation method for the cash value of a new critical illness product.
location: AIA Insurance office, 20th floor, Immigration Tower, 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuted back to Whampoa after work.
description: Yu Xiaowei packed up 15 minutes early and clocked out. On the way to the MTR station, she deliberately turned into "Happy Bakery", a shop on Johnston Road in Wan Chai that had been there for years, and bought the last two freshly baked crispy pineapple buns with butter, carefully putting them in a paper bag and thinking that her son and daughter would love them. Then she took the MTR Island Line and transferred to the East Rail Line, returning to Whampoa Garden.
location: From the Immigration Tower at 7 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, via Happy Bakery on Johnston Road in Wan Chai, MTR Wan Chai Station, Admiralty Station, and Mong Kok East Station, return to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District.

name: Return home and interact with family
description: When she got home, her daughter had already finished school and was watching TV in the living room with her maternal grandmother. Yu Xiaowei put the pineapple bun on the dining table and happily told her daughter that she had bought the bread she loved. Her daughter immediately ran over and hugged her. Yu Xiaowei picked her up and kissed her little cheek. Her mother then told her that dinner was almost ready.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped with dinner and had family chat.
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into home clothes and went into the kitchen to help her mother, peeling garlic and setting out chopsticks and bowls. Her husband Zhang Weiming and son Zhang Zixuan also came home one after another. Weiming indeed brought back a box of chocolate cookies, and their daughter cheered when she saw them. Dinner was her mother's steamed grass carp, garlic choy sum, and radish and beef brisket casserole. The family sat around the table as her son shared funny stories about the school football match, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family packed the daughter's ballet gear.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei and her husband dragged their daughter's suitcase to the middle of the living room, and a "packing battle" officially began. Her husband Zhang Weiming brought a thermos and that box of chocolate cookies from the kitchen and stuffed them into the side pocket of the suitcase; her son Zhang Zixuan squatted on the floor carefully checking his sister's dance shoes and, after confirming there was no wear, put them into a dedicated shoe bag; her mother Chen Meiling sat on the sofa knitting while repeatedly telling Yuxin not to be nervous on stage and to follow the director's instructions. Excitedly, the daughter showed off a newly learned spin in the middle of the living room. Yu Xiaowei quickly took out her phone to record a video and sent it to the family group chat. The whole family kept laughing.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping her son with homework
description: After packing the suitcase, Yu Xiaowei went to the study to accompany her son Zhang Zixuan as he finished the rest of his math homework. Her son was a bit careless with two-digit subtraction, so she patiently guided him to go through each problem and taught him how to verify his calculations. After he finished the homework and she signed it, Yu Xiaowei praised her son for his progress.
location: Study, Flat B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Chatting with mother
description: The children went to wash up one by one, and the living room became quiet. Yu Xiaowei sat down next to her mother, eating a reheated pineapple bun with butter she had bought earlier while chatting about the day’s work and mentioning that she was looking forward to her daughter’s competition tomorrow. Her mother, in turn, shared a cutting technique she had learned from a neighbor at the flower bed downstairs.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Read a new book on Cantonese embroidery.
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the study and opened the “Detailed Explanation of Cantonese Embroidery Stitches” received yesterday, carefully studying the “gold and silver thread flat gold embroidery” technique she planned to ask Teacher Wu Xiuying about next week. She made a few pencil marks in the book and tried the most basic backstitch on a small sample cloth stretched on an embroidery hoop, feeling that she had gained a lot.
location: Study, Flat B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Yu Xiaowei closed her book, took out her gratitude journal and wrote down three good things today: after the morning yoga class, her right leg was completely fine and her body felt relaxed; on the way home from work she bought the last pineapple bun with butter, and its aroma brightened her mood; in the evening the whole family packed Xinxin's luggage together, and laughter filled the living room. After writing, she felt calm and content. Then she opened the MoneyLover expense-tracking app and entered today's expenses: HK$58 for lunch and HK$12 for the pineapple bun with butter. She got up, went to the bathroom to wash her face and brush her teeth, and carefully did her eye care routine. Back in the bedroom, she changed into pajamas and did 5 minutes of pre-sleep stretching on the bed. Then she turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light, checked her phone to confirm the 6:00 a.m. alarm had been set, and turned on Do Not Disturb mode. With a slight smile on her lips, she silently wished her daughter good luck in tomorrow's competition, closed her eyes, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Unit B, Building 4, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Yu Xiaowei got up quietly, careful not to wake her family. She went to the living room, opened her daughter's suitcase, and quickly but carefully checked the list: dance costume, pointe shoes, spare tights, children's cosmetics, hairnet, U-shaped pillow, water bottle, and her own change of clothes and exercise gear. She felt reassured once everything was confirmed. Then she went into the kitchen and helped her mother Chen Meiling fry fried eggs and sausages and toast bread, and the family sat down together for breakfast. During breakfast, she told her daughter Zhang Yuxin that they would take the high-speed rail to Guangzhou together in the afternoon, and her daughter nodded excitedly. Her husband Zhang Weiming was a bit quiet, so Yu Xiaowei gently touched his leg to reassure him; he smiled back.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take son to school
description: After breakfast, her husband Zhang Weiming was responsible for taking their daughter to kindergarten, while Yu Xiaowei drove their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. In the car, her son excitedly talked about playing football in today's PE class; she reminded him to pay attention to safety and promised to video call in the evening. After about 13 minutes, they arrived at the school gate. She watched her son run into the school with his backpack, feeling reluctant but looking forward to some alone time with her daughter.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School

name: Commute to the office in Wan Chai
description: Yu Xiaowei parked the car back in the Whampoa Garden parking lot, walked to MTR Whampoa Station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, and then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station; the whole journey took about 37 minutes. On the way, she used her phone to confirm the high-speed rail ticket departing from West Kowloon Station at 17:20 and the hotel reservation near Guangzhou South Station, and sent her husband a WeChat message agreeing to meet at the community gate at 4:30 to pick up their daughter and take a taxi together to West Kowloon Station.
location: Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai MTR Station and the area along the railway line

name: Morning office work and weekly work report.
description: After arriving at the AIA office in the Immigration Tower, Yu Xiaowei made a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea. First, she handled three client policy renewal emails and replied with confirmations; then she focused on writing this week's work report, recording the completed policy signings, clients in progress, and referral leads, and submitted it to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua via company email, copying the team. After that, she contacted her colleague Su Lishan through the company messaging software, agreed to discuss Mrs. Wang's claims case next Tuesday afternoon, and asked Su Lishan to prepare the materials in advance.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 7 Gloucester Road, Immigration Tower, AIA office

name: Met with client Mrs. Chen and signed the insurance policy.
description: The client Mrs. Chen arrived at the small meeting room in the office as scheduled. Yu Xiaowei warmly received her and prepared pu'er tea and snacks. She explained the recommended Abundant Future Prosperous Family plan in detail and patiently answered questions about the dividend fulfillment ratio and premium financing. After confirming all the terms, Mrs. Chen readily signed the new policy and praised Yu Xiaowei for being reliable.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 7 Gloucester Road, Immigration Tower, small meeting room at the AIA office.

name: Chatting with colleagues over lunch
description: Yu Xiaowei and her colleague Su Lishan walked 6 minutes to Zhongji Kitchen at 225 Hennessy Road for a meal. They ordered tomato baked pork chop rice and iced lemon tea, and chatted while eating. Yu Xiaowei shared that her daughter was going to Guangzhou tonight to participate in a ballet competition, and Su Lishan expressed envy; Yu Xiaowei also asked with concern about the progress of the newcomer He Junwen that Su Lishan was mentoring, and learned that he was gradually getting the hang of it.
location: Zhongji Kitchen, 225 Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon office chores
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei returned to the office. She first opened her schedule to confirm the client appointments and meeting times for next week, sent a weekend greeting email to a prospective client, and then methodically tidied her desk, putting client materials and Essential Guide to Cantonese Embroidery Stitches into her tote bag. Afterward, she handled WeChat inquiries from two clients, explained the Jia Ai Bei Zhi early-stage critical illness terms in detail, and made a note to schedule the policy review for next Wednesday.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 7 Gloucester Road, Immigration Tower, AIA office

name: Leave work early and commute home
description: At 2:30 pm, Yu Xiaowei packed up early, said goodbye to her deskmate colleague, and left the office. She walked to Wan Chai MTR Station, transferred at Admiralty and Mong Kok, and returned to her home near Whampoa Station at around 15:10, taking about 34 minutes in total.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, MTR Whampoa Station and along the line

name: After returning home, prepare for the trip
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother, who was folding clothes, and told her that she would take Xinxin to Guangzhou tonight. Then she went into her daughter's room, opened the competition bag, and did a final check for her daughter's competition: checking the dance costume, pointe shoes, spare tights, makeup, hairnet, etc., and put children's fever patches and band-aids into the carry-on backpack. She confirmed the high-speed rail tickets and hotel reservations again and saved screenshots. Then she organized her own backpack, putting in a change of clothes, skincare samples, a power bank, a Kindle, and 'A Detailed Study of Cantonese Embroidery Stitches.' She also prepared plenty of cat food and water for Bailey the cat, and reminded her husband to refill the food in the evening.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to West Kowloon Station and wait for the train
description: Yu Xiaowei met up with her husband and daughter at the entrance of the residential community, and the three took a taxi to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station. In the car, her daughter excitedly showed off her newly learned ballet steps while Yu Xiaowei recorded her on her phone. They arrived at West Kowloon Station about 11 minutes later. Her husband saw them to the departure hall entrance on B3 level, hugged them goodbye, and told his daughter to do her best at the competition. The mother and daughter then passed through the gate and mainland port formalities smoothly and went to the waiting hall for train G6502.
location: Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, Austin Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: High-speed rail journey
description: High-speed train G6502 departed from West Kowloon Station. Yu Xiaowei adjusted her daughter's seat so she could enjoy the scenery along the way. She called home and video-chatted with her son Zhang Zixuan. Learning that he had scored two goals in PE class, she cheered loudly and promised to bring toys home. Her daughter grabbed the phone and chatted with her brother, filling the carriage with laughter. This journey became precious mother-daughter time alone.
location: G6502 train (Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Guangzhou South Station)

name: Arrived in Guangzhou and checked in.
description: At 18:30 the train arrived at Guangzhou South Railway Station on time. Yu Xiaowei held her daughter's hand, followed the signs to the metro entrance, but in the end chose to take a taxi. Ten minutes later they arrived at the Atour Hotel at Vanke Center, Guangzhou South Station. After checking in, she told her husband they were safe, and had her daughter say goodnight to Dad on her phone watch.
location: Atour Hotel, Vanke Center, Guangzhou South Railway Station, No. 230 Sanfang Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Shared dinner with her daughter
description: Yu Xiaowei took her daughter to the 'Dian Dou De' tea restaurant near the hotel for dinner. She ordered shrimp wonton noodles and egg tarts for her daughter, who ate with relish, sauce smeared on her little face. While wiping her daughter's mouth, she listened to her talk about amusing things at kindergarten. Watching her daughter's contented look, her fatigue vanished.
location: “Dian Dou De” tea restaurant near Guangzhou South Railway Station, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Relaxing at the hotel and writing a gratitude journal.
description: Back in the hotel room, Yu Xiaowei changed into loose sportswear, spread her yoga mat on the carpet by the bed, and did a 25-minute pre-sleep yoga stretch, focusing on relaxing the hip flexors, shoulders, and neck. Her daughter watched quietly from the side. After stretching, she sat on the edge of the bed and wrote in a gratitude journal on her phone, recording the recognition she received at work, her mother's support, and the small moments of her daughter being well-behaved and happy, marveling at the inner strength that comes from recording beautiful moments.
location: Room at Atour Hotel, Vanke Center, Guangzhou South Railway Station, 230 Sanfang Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter, blow-dried her hair, and dressed her in cartoon pajamas. Her daughter snuggled in her arms as Yu Xiaowei softly told the story "The Little Swan Bravely Competes." Her daughter whispered, asking if she could dance well in the competition. Yu Xiaowei kissed her forehead and encouraged her, saying that as long as she enjoyed herself, she was the best little swan. After her daughter fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei tiptoed to wash up, set the alarm for 7:00 a.m. the next morning, confirmed the competition check-in time, read a bit of "Refined Study of Cantonese Embroidery Stitches," then turned off the light and went to bed.
location: Room at Atour Hotel, Vanke Center, Guangzhou South Railway Station, 230 Sanfang Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Early morning preparations and packing.
description: Yu Xiaowei was woken by the alarm clock and got out of bed quietly, careful not to wake her still-sleeping son and husband. She quickly washed up and changed into comfortable casual clothes, then carefully checked the backpack she had prepared the night before: her daughter's competition dance costume, ballet shoes, hair accessories, makeup, her own portable embroidery kit, power bank, and cookies and snacks, making sure nothing was left behind.
location: A certain unit in Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Take a taxi to West Kowloon Station
description: At 7:15 I woke up my daughter, and the two of us had a quick breakfast of some biscuits and milk. At 7:25 I called an Uber at the entrance of the residential compound, and we arrived at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station 11 minutes later. After arriving, I used the Home Return Permit at the self-service machines in the ticket hall on the first floor to collect the two pre-booked high-speed rail tickets (Train G6512, 08:00-09:20). I took my daughter through security and the mainland border checkpoint, and we found the waiting hall smoothly.
location: From Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station, 1 Austin Road, Yau Tsim Mong District.

name: Taking the high-speed rail to Guangzhou
description: The train departed on time. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin sat by the window, excitedly flipping through the ballet magazine she had brought. Yu Xiaowei put on her earphones, opened the CFP follow-up study plan PDF on her phone, and quietly reviewed the key points of asset allocation. Occasionally she turned to answer her daughter's questions about the scenery outside the window. The carriage was quiet and comfortable.
location: Inside the G6512 high-speed train carriage, from Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Guangzhou South Station.

name: Arrived at Guangzhou South Station and checked into the hotel
description: Arrived at Guangzhou South Railway Station on time at 9:20. After leaving the station, she ordered a Didi car at the P5 parking lot. After about a 35-minute drive, they arrived at Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel at 10:00. During check-in, her daughter played on the carousel in the kids' area near the front desk, and the young front desk attendant gave her a small panda plush toy. After entering the room on the 35th floor, the mother and daughter first looked around curiously, and Zhang Yuxin jumped onto the big bed.
location: From Guangzhou South Railway Station, Nanzhan North Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province to Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, No. 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Daughter's pre-race preparation
description: First, let Zhang Yuxin drink some water and use the bathroom. Then Yu Xiaowei took out all the makeup tools and carefully combed her daughter's hair into a smooth ballet bun, securing it with hairspray. Next, she powdered her face, shaped her eyebrows, and applied light pink lipstick and blush. Zhang Yuxin closed her eyes cooperatively and behaved very well. Once everything was ready, she helped her change into a snow-white ballet dress and ballet shoes, and let her do a few simple barre exercises by the window in the room to warm up her body.
location: 35th-floor room at Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Lunch at Tao Tao Ju
description: At 12:00, the mother and daughter walked to Tao Tao Ju next to the hotel. They ordered the shrimp dumplings, dry-fried beef ho fun, and a bowl of wonton noodles that Zhang Yuxin loved. Yu Xiaowei herself had a bowl of congee and a few pieces of turnip cake. While eating, Yu Xiaowei kept encouraging her daughter, telling her that enjoying the stage and dancing as her most confident self was the greatest success.
location: Tao Tao Ju (Tianhe Road Branch), inside Grandbuy Department Store, 228 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province.

name: Participated in the 2025 Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Children's Ballet Open Competition
description: At 13:15, took a taxi to Guangzhou Opera House and picked up the competition number in the underground passage. Backstage, there were little girls everywhere wearing colorful dance dresses, and the atmosphere was tense and excited. Yu Xiaowei helped Zhang Yuxin make final adjustments to her dress and dance shoes, and had her do a few stretches in an open corner. When Zhang Yuxin went on stage, Yu Xiaowei stood behind the side-stage curtain and watched with bated breath. Her daughter's performance was smooth and elegant, especially the final spin, which ended with a stable hold. In the end, Zhang Yuxin won the Best Expressiveness Encouragement Award, and mother and daughter happily took a photo together at the theater entrance holding the certificate and trophy.

participant.name: Many young race participants and their parents.

location: Guangzhou Opera House, 1 Zhujiang West Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong.

name: Post-match celebration and sharing
description: After the competition ended, Yu Xiaowei took some commemorative photos of Zhang Yuxin outside the theater at Huacheng Square, with the Canton Tower as the backdrop, and then took a taxi back to the hotel. In the car, Yu Xiaowei immediately made a video call to her close friend Lin Jiaxin, showing her daughter's certificate and trophy through the screen. The two chatted excitedly for a while, and Lin Jiaxin said that when they returned to Hong Kong, she would treat them to a big meal to celebrate.
location: In the car returning from Guangzhou Opera House to Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel.

name: Hotel rest and Cantonese embroidery time.
description: Back in the room, Yu Xiaowei had Zhang Yuxin wash her face and change into comfortable casual clothes. Yu Xiaowei herself leaned back in the armchair by the window, took out a small Cantonese embroidery hoop from her carry-on embroidery bag, and embroidered carefully for half an hour, finishing an exquisite kapok petal, feeling very calm. Zhang Yuxin quietly watched the Cantonese version of the animated series "Peppa Pig" on her iPad nearby.
location: Room, Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Dessert and a stroll along the Pearl River
description: She left at 17:45, walked 10 minutes to Bin Ma's Sweet Soup in Huacheng Plaza, and bought two portions of the signature double-skin milk. Then the mother and daughter strolled slowly along Huacheng Square toward Haixinsha Park. The evening glow fell on Canton Tower and Jinzhong Building, and the gentle breeze was refreshing.
location: Bin Ma Sweet Soup, Huacheng Square, Xiancun Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province; then walk to Haixinsha Park

name: Pearl River night cruise and mother-daughter heart-to-heart
description: At 18:55 they arrived at Haixinsha Pier and boarded the cruise ship with e-tickets. They chose a spot on the open top deck. The lights of Canton Tower, the West Tower, and the Central Axis buildings on both banks were brilliant, reflected in the river. A light drizzle began to fall, and the mother and daughter stood at the railing under transparent umbrellas, admiring the view. Zhang Yuxin, sipping double-skin milk, said seriously, "Mom, I want to be a ballet teacher when I grow up." Yu Xiaowei's heart softened, and she hugged her tightly and said, "As long as you want to, Mom will support you." The two took many photos together in the night, leaving precious memories.
location: Boarded at Haixinsha Pier, Haizhu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province; open-air top deck of the Pearl River night cruise ship.

name: Return to the hotel and video call with family
description: Got off the boat at 20:30 and took a taxi about 15 minutes back to the hotel. As soon as they entered, she had Zhang Yuxin take a shower first. Yu Xiaowei then took out her phone and made a video call to her mother, reporting that they were safe and excitedly showing off Zhang Yuxin's certificate and trophy. Her mother on the other end of the screen said with a chuckle, "The green radish and carrot pork bone soup is ready, come back and have some!"
location: Took a taxi from Haixinsha Pier back to Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Write in a gratitude journal
description: Yu Xiaowei packed her luggage, laid out the clothes for the next day, and also took a hot shower. Leaning against the headboard, she opened the gratitude journal app and began recording today's touching moments: 1. Zhang Yuxin looking confident on stage and winning the Best Expression Award; 2. Lin Jiaxin's laughter in the video and her mother's reminders during the video call; 3. Her daughter's dream of becoming a ballet teacher, mentioned during the Pearl River night cruise; 4. The kapok flower she had embroidered herself. Her heart was filled with warmth and gratitude.
location: Room, Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Soothe her daughter to sleep
description: After Zhang Yuxin took a bath, she changed into cute pajamas and lay down on her small bed. Yu Xiaowei read her the Cantonese audio story "Mulan" that she had downloaded earlier. In less than ten minutes, she fell into a deep sleep with even breathing. Yu Xiaowei also lay down, set the alarm to get up early the next day, savored in her heart the full and happy day, and fell asleep with expectations for the future.
location: Room, Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Check out of the hotel, have breakfast, and head to Guangzhou South Railway Station.
description: Woke up at the hotel, woke up her daughter Zhang Yuxin, packed the luggage, and carefully checked the items to make sure she did not forget her gratitude diary, award certificate, and dance costume. After checking out, the front desk gave them a small teddy bear. Then they had breakfast at the hotel buffet. Yu Xiaowei ordered rice porridge, rice rolls, and fried eggs, while her daughter had fresh orange juice and shrimp dumplings. As they ate, they recalled the joy of the Pearl River night cruise. After the meal, they took a taxi from the hotel entrance to Guangzhou South Railway Station. The traffic was smooth along the way. Yu Xiaowei confirmed the high-speed rail schedule and seats again in the car, and her daughter leaned against her, feeling a little sleepy.
location: Sheraton Guangzhou Hotel, 208 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

name: Returning to Hong Kong by high-speed rail
description: Boarded the G6513 high-speed train at Guangzhou South Railway Station and returned to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station. Her daughter watched cartoons on an iPad, while Yu Xiaowei sat by the window scrolling through client information on her phone, thinking about the important clients she needed to contact this week and the year-end renewal matters, preparing for work. The train arrived at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station on time.
location: Guangdong Province, Guangzhou, Panyu District, South Station North Road (Guangzhou South Railway Station) to Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Yau Tsim Mong District, Austin Road West (Hong Kong West Kowloon Station)

name: Clear customs and return home for lunch with the family
description: After clearing customs smoothly at West Kowloon Station, she took a taxi back home to Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City. As soon as she opened the door, she smelled the aroma of food. Her mother Chen Meiling had prepared shrimp wonton noodles and Chinese greens, and her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng was also home. The family sat around the table; as Yu Xiaowei ate, she shared in detail how her daughter's competition went that day. Her mother listened with fascination, and her brother recorded a video from the side.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shared competition experiences and award certificates
description: After lunch they moved to the living room. Their daughter proudly took out the "Best Expressiveness" certificate and competition photos to show her grandmother and uncle. Yu Xiaowei used her phone to play the video of her daughter's stage performance. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was full of admiration and asked in detail about the judges' feedback. The daughter once again shared her dream of becoming a ballet teacher, and the family basked in a warm atmosphere.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize luggage and gifts and chat with mother.
description: Returned to the bedroom to organize the luggage, sorted the dirty clothes, hung up her daughter's dance costume, and took out the gifts for family members: a silk scarf for her mother, Pu'er tea for her father, a Canton enamel stationery set for her younger brother, and Cantonese cured meat for her son, arranging them one by one. Afterwards, she sat on the living room sofa with her mother, drinking tea and chatting, showing photos of the Pearl River night view and Canton Tower in Guangzhou, and sharing her inspiration for the new Cantonese embroidery work Winter conceived at the hotel. During this time, she also replied to a few work group messages and confirmed Tuesday's client appointment.
location: Living room of the home at Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child bonding and midday rest
description: The daughter began to yawn, and Yu Xiaowei arranged for her to take a nap in the children's room. After her daughter fell asleep, she went to the master bedroom for a half-hour nap to recover from travel fatigue. When she woke up feeling better, she walked to the children's room and, seeing her daughter sleeping soundly, sat down at her small desk and used her phone to plan next week's Cantonese embroidery study schedule. She also sent a WeChat message to her embroidery teacher Wu Xiuying to share new inspiration from Guangzhou.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing dinner, trying embroidery for the first time, and welcoming the family
description: Mother was preparing dinner in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowei went in to help with the garlic and vegetables. Afterwards, she used the free time to sit at the embroidery worktable, took out white silk thread and cool-colored embroidery fabric, sketched a snowflake outline with a pencil, and tried a small patch of seed stitch to feel the calm of creation. Soon she heard the door open, and her husband Zhang Weiming and son Zhang Zixuan came back. Her husband asked with concern, and her son excitedly shared fun school stories and showed his English quiz paper. Yu Xiaowei praised him.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and travel sharing.
description: Father Yu Guoqiang also came home. The whole family, rarely so complete, sat around the dining table together, enjoying dishes mother had prepared: white cut chicken, steamed grouper, garlic stir-fried broccoli, and more. The daughter excitedly recounted the Guangzhou trip again and cast the competition video to the TV. Everyone watched together, sharing the joy.
location: Dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped son with his homework
description: After dinner, accompanied her son back to the children's room to do homework, checked his English sentence-making and math assignments, pointed out careless mistakes and patiently explained difficult points. Her son complained that the math problems were a bit hard, so Yu Xiaowei tutored him one by one. Her daughter was playing with building blocks in the living room, occasionally coming over to talk.
location: Children's room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying daughter through her bedtime routine and bedtime story
description: Called her daughter to take a bath, helped her wash and blow-dry her hair, and then lay down together on the small bed. Her daughter chose the picture book Angelina Ballerina. After Yu Xiaowei finished reading the story, her daughter hugged her and said today was the happiest day because everyone saw her award certificate. Yu Xiaowei kissed her daughter on the forehead, said goodnight, and turned off the light before leaving.
location: Children's room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening chores and preparations
description: After the children quieted down, she tidied up the toys in the living room and organized the documents and commuter bag needed for the next day. She went to the balcony, put the dirty clothes in the washing machine, and saw the school uniforms hanging out to dry, feeling the calm of returning to daily routine.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Gratitude journal review and continued writing
description: Sitting at the desk in the master bedroom, you opened the gratitude journal you had been using for more than two weeks and quickly reviewed the past week’s entries. You found that you no longer frequently suffered from insomnia and felt calmer inside. Under that day’s date, you wrote down your mood: “The excitement of Guangzhou, the comfort of coming home. Thank you for Mom’s soup, thank you for Xinxin’s reward, thank you for my own perseverance.” Then on the flyleaf of the notebook, you wrote the word “perseverance” to encourage yourself.
location: At the desk in the master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery creation concept
description: At the embroidery worktable, she turned on the desk lamp, took out the cool-toned fabric she had previously tried stitching on, and selected several spools of silk thread in different shades of white and silver-gray. She arranged them on the fabric, thinking about how to express the sparkle of the river after snow and the hazy outline of Canton Tower in the snow, and noted stitch combinations on draft paper. Her creative idea became increasingly clear.
location: Embroidery worktable in the study at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: She put down her embroidery hoop, went back to the bedroom, and washed up. Her husband was already asleep. Yu Xiaowei quietly got into bed, opened the curtains to let the moonlight in, reviewed the fulfillment of the day, and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Woke up in the morning and helped the children get ready for the day.
description: The phone alarm went off at 6 o'clock sharp. It was gloomy outside the window, and the weather forecast said it would be overcast. Yu Xiaowei got up quickly, washed up briefly, and changed into dark blue yoga clothes. Then she gently pushed open her daughter Zhang Yuxin's door, softly called her to get up, took her to the bathroom to wash up, squeezed pink strawberry-flavored toothpaste onto her toothbrush, watched her brush her teeth, then helped her wash her face. The whole process went smoothly.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Attend community Ashtanga morning class
description: Yu Xiaowei took her yoga mat and walked 5 minutes to Whampoa Fitness Center for a community Ashtanga morning class. The instructor specifically emphasized strength poses. She focused on engaging her core muscles and felt a sour ache in her abdomen when transitioning between Boat Pose and Four-Limbed Staff Pose. Surrounded by familiar community neighbors, the one-hour practice fully stretched her body and lifted her spirits.
location: 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Breakfast and taking daughter to school
description: After yoga class, Yu Xiaowei hurried home, took a warm shower, and changed into business attire. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already cooked rice porridge, scrambled eggs, and fried sausages. Her husband, Zhang Weiming, filled a bowl of porridge for her, and the family sat down together to eat breakfast. While eating, Yu Xiaowei had her daughter Xinxin sit in front of her, braided her hair into a plait, and tied it with a pink bow hair tie. After breakfast, she helped Xinxin put on her schoolbag, took her hand, and walked to Kowloon City Kindergarten. Along the way, Xinxin pointed excitedly at a patterned cat. When they reached the kindergarten gate, Yu Xiaowei squatted down to tidy her collar, kissed her on the forehead, and watched her wave to the teacher and walk into the classroom.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai.

name: Commute to company
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei walked about eight minutes to Kowloon Tong station, took the East Rail line to East Tsim Sha Tsui station, then transferred to the Island line to Wan Chai. On the train, she received a WeChat message from her running buddy Mr. Chen, who asked of his own accord about a family medical protection plan. She made a preliminary arrangement with him to meet in detail at a Wan Chai café on Saturday morning and said she could send him a product introduction first. The whole commute took about 55 minutes.
location: Along the MTR line from Kowloon City to AIA Building, Wan Chai, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning office work.
description: After arriving at the AIA Building office, Yu Xiaowei first handled 5 urgent emails, then began preparing the PPT for the 2 PM monthly review meeting, incorporating October team data, personal performance highlights, and the potential case of fellow runner Mr. Chen. During this time, she also sent a WeChat greeting to General Manager Wang, a client in Shenzhen, tactfully reminding him about next month's policy renewal, and began drafting a backup plan document for flexible installment payments.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: Su Lishan invited Yu Xiaowei to eat at Tsui Wah Restaurant downstairs from the office, wanting to talk about the new hire He Junwen. Yu Xiaowei ordered shrimp wonton noodles, and Su Lishan ordered curry beef brisket rice. Su Lishan shared her experience last year of helping a bottom-performing new hire pass probation, with the core being 'goal decomposition' and 'high-frequency feedback.' She suggested that when coaching He Junwen one-on-one next week, Yu Xiaowei should first help him set an extremely small goal he can finish this week—for example, completing three effective phone calls per day—to build his confidence. Yu Xiaowei was very inspired.
location: Tsui Wah Restaurant (Lockhart Road), Lockhart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Noon break and pre-meeting preparation
description: After finishing lunch and returning to her desk, Yu Xiaowei went to the pantry to brew a cup of coffee and sat quietly at her seat for 5 minutes to organize her thoughts. Then she went to the print room, printed 10 copies of the 'Weekly Task List' template, and checked the projector equipment to make sure the meeting materials were in order.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Host the team's monthly sales review meeting.
description: The 2 p.m. meeting started on time. Yu Xiaowei reviewed the team's overall performance in October with a 5-page PPT, specifically commending Su Lishan for her big-client conversion. She then shared the case of Mr. Chen, a running buddy, emphasizing the model of “health management + insurance protection based on trust” and encouraging everyone to develop high-net-worth contacts such as running and fitness circles. Regarding He Junwen's insufficient execution, she announced the adoption of a “weekly task checklist” system, requiring each member to submit a template every week listing 3 core sales actions and 1 knowledge learning plan; she would follow up every Monday. Director Liang Zhenhua nodded in approval and stressed the importance of discipline. The meeting ended with anticipation for the new system.
location: Meeting Room A, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work: sorting out the Shenzhen client win-back plan.
description: Right after the meeting, Yu Xiaowei returned to her desk, opened the Shenzhen churned-customer Excel spreadsheet, re-sorted it by churn reason and potential value, and filtered out the three customers most likely to win back (including the finance director of Mr. Wang's company). In her notebook, she wrote down initial outreach scripts and reactivation plans for each of the three customers, and matched them with her business-trip calendar, planning to visit them during next month's trip.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Work wrap-up and replying to messages
description: Yu Xiaowei tidied up the documents on her desk, then browsed and replied to the unread work group messages from the afternoon. She sent He Junwen a private message, encouraging him to start with 3 phone calls next week and to come to her anytime if he had questions. Before leaving work, she turned off her computer and packed her commute bag and the materials printed in the afternoon.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting home
description: Yu Xiaowei walked out of the AIA Building and merged into the evening crowd in Wan Chai, taking the MTR back to Kowloon City along the same route. The carriage was crowded; she stood in a corner scrolling through her phone. Seeing a WeChat message from her mother saying dinner had char siu and that her son Xuanxuan had scored 90 on his English test, she felt a warm feeling in her heart.
location: Along the MTR line from Wan Chai to Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family evening time: dinner, walk, and casual chat.
description: As soon as she entered the house, the rich aroma of roast pork greeted her. The whole family sat around the table enjoying a hearty dinner cooked by her mother, Chen Meiling, which included roast pork, stir-fried choy sum, and steamed egg custard. At the table, her son Zhang Zixuan excitedly shared his English test results, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin showed the drawing she had done in the afternoon. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming smiled at each other and praised the children. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother clear the dishes, then accompanied Xuanxuan in the living room to finish two English assignments and checked his sentence building. After 8 o'clock, she went to Xinxin's room, read a story from Different Carmela, and coaxed her to sleep. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming went downstairs together and took a 20-minute walk along the quiet path in the neighborhood, chatting about work and funny things the children had done, enjoying their rare time as a couple. After the walk, she chatted in the kitchen with her mother, who was wiping the stove. Her mother asked about the afternoon meeting and complained that the newly opened herbal tea shop downstairs didn't taste authentic. The two smiled and chatted about everyday life.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal time at night: writing a gratitude journal and embroidery practice
description: Yu Xiaowei made a cup of hot tea, sat down at the desk in her bedroom, and opened her black leather gratitude journal to write in depth. She recorded in detail the shock and self-blame she felt when she discovered that her father Yu Guoqiang's fund investment had lost 47%, as well as the suppressed feeling of being the eldest daughter who had kept it hidden and borne it alone. She wrote: I always thought being strong meant silently absorbing everything, but today I want to try to forgive myself — for not discovering the risk in time and for choosing to stay silent. When she finished writing, her eyes were moist and a heavy weight had been lifted from her heart. Then she moved to the embroidery table by the window, took out white silk thread, and practiced a new snowflake stitch on the fabric, first stitching the center point and then using long and short stitches radiating outward to imitate the six-pointed radial structure of a snowflake. Her finger movements were slow and quiet, and her mind gradually calmed as the thread found its way.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washed up before bed and talked with her husband
description: Yu Xiaowei put down the needlework and went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing her teeth, she savored the emotional flow she had felt when writing her diary. After getting into bed, she turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, turned toward her husband Zhang Weiming and quietly told him about her father's investment losses and the diary she had written today. Zhang Weiming said seriously, 'Xiaowei, you can't carry this alone. I'll come with you this weekend. Let's ask Dad to come over and have a proper talk. We can move 100,000 from the demand deposit account for emergency use. Don't be afraid.' Yu Xiaowei felt a warm surge in her heart, nodded, and felt completely at ease.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: After saying goodnight to her husband, Yu Xiaowei closed her eyes and reviewed the day's experiences: the sweat of yoga, the decisiveness at the meeting, the conversation at lunch, the release of journaling, the stillness of embroidery, and her husband's support. She felt a strange sense of calm and relief. The stress was still there, but it was no longer a lonely mountain she had to carry alone. Her consciousness slowly faded, and she fell soundly asleep in the warm blanket.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off at 6:30. Yu Xiaowei felt well rested and that her sleep quality was good. She washed up and did her skincare routine first, thinking about the client she would meet today and the need to look energetic. She changed into an off-white silk blouse and navy blue wide-leg trousers, adjusted her scarf, and felt sharp and comfortable. Before going downstairs, she sent the stitching sketch for the “hexagonal snowflake” in the Cantonese embroidery piece “Winter” that she had conceived last night from her phone to her tablet, planning to study it in detail during her lunch break.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and getting the daughter ready
description: Mother Chen Meiling was busy in the kitchen; breakfast included shrimp dumplings, century egg and lean pork congee, and flower rolls. Yu Xiaowei helped set out bowls and chopsticks and called the children to get up. She helped her daughter Zhang Yuxin braid her hair; her daughter yawned and said she dreamed she could jump higher than her ballet teacher. Her son Zhang Zixuan washed up on his own and then recited English vocabulary. The family sat around the table for breakfast in a warm atmosphere. Yu Xiaowei noticed that her husband Zhang Weiming seemed distracted and gently touched his arm to hint that they would talk about her father's investment at night.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: Husband Zhang Weiming left first to take their son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. Yu Xiaowei put a thin jacket on her daughter, put on her little backpack, and walked her to Kowloon City Kindergarten. On the way, the daughter excitedly described the rabbit she had made from clay and wanted to teach her mother how to make one. Yu Xiaowei listened patiently and shared that she would be working hard today.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commuting to the office and handling work messages
description: After dropping off her daughter, Yu Xiaowei walked to Sung Wong Toi Station, took the MTR Tuen Ma Line to East Tsim Sha Tsui Station, then walked to transfer to the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, and finally switched to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station, taking about 38 minutes in total. On the train, she browsed insurance industry news on her phone, replied to client WhatsApp messages, including fellow runner Mr. Chen's questions about family medical insurance details, and agreed to discuss them in depth over the weekend. She also sent a message in the family group chat saying she would buy cherries her father loved that evening.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, along the MTR Tuen Ma Line, Tsuen Wan Line, and Island Line

name: Arrive at the office and prepare for work
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, and first went to the convenience store downstairs to buy hot lemon tea. Back at her desk, she turned on her computer, logged into the CRM system, and checked her to-do list. She reorganized the weekly task list assigned to new hire He Junwen, highlighting key points and potential difficulties. At that moment, she heard Director Liang Zhenhua next door handling a customer complaint phone call.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Handle client renewal inquiries and proactive follow-up
description: At 9 o'clock she started work on time. Yu Xiaowei first handled five policy renewal calls, explaining the premium adjustments and newly added coverage items in detail, and all the clients were satisfied. She then proactively called three potential clients. The first was a yoga teacher referred by a friend; based on her profession, Yu Xiaowei introduced a plan that included medical coverage for occupational diseases, and the prospect was very interested and agreed to meet next week. Yu Xiaowei recorded in detail each client's level of interest and follow-up milestones.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Mentor new hire He Junwen
description: Yu Xiaowei saw He Junwen staring at the screen in confusion, so she took him to the pantry. She spent 20 minutes sorting through client profiles, teaching him to match product types according to clients' different life stages, and shared the case of successfully responding to fellow runner Mr. Chen's consultation yesterday, emphasizing the importance of listening to clients' real needs. He Junwen suddenly saw the light and said he would try the new approach.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch break yoga stretching and preparation
