description: Yu Xiaowei took out her yoga mat. Her colleague Su Lishan came over and asked about it, so she invited her to join. The two laid out their mats in the corner of the office. Yu Xiaowei led exercises for shoulder-and-neck relaxation, spinal twists, and the Cat-Cow pose; the 15-minute stretch loosened their shoulders. They corrected each other's postures with nonstop laughter. Su Lishan said that after stretching she could make ten more calls in the afternoon, and Yu Xiaowei promised they would do it together every lunchtime.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch and Cantonese embroidery ideas
description: Yu Xiaowei went alone to the coffee shop at Shui On Centre near the office and ordered a Caesar salad and an American coffee. While eating, she carefully studied the sketch of the Cantonese embroidery piece "Winter" on her tablet, thinking about how to use the "snowflake stitch" to express the layers of snow. She traced the direction of the embroidery thread with her finger on the screen, feeling focused and satisfied.
location: Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, Hennessy Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing follow-up records and paperwork
description: Back in the office, Yu Xiaowei was fully focused on her afternoon work. Based on the morning phone call records, she organized customer follow-up records in Excel, noting objections and follow-up suggestions. She processed miscellaneous paperwork and updated the product comparison table. She worked efficiently and basically finished by 16:00.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Handled miscellaneous paperwork and planned the next day's work
description: Using the time before leaving work, Yu Xiaowei wrote an email to director Liang Zhenhua reporting on the mentoring of new staff and the results of the morning's client follow-ups. She tidied her desk and wrote down tomorrow's to-do items in her notebook, including clients to follow up with and appointment times.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Commute home and purchase items.
description: After work, Yu Xiaowei walked to the Wellcome supermarket on Johnston Road and bought fresh milk, apples, oranges, and a box of cherries, thinking her father would like them. She then walked to Wan Chai MTR station, took the Island Line to Admiralty, transferred to the Tsuen Wan Line to Mong Kok, then transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station and went home.
location: Wellcome Supermarket, Carfield Building, 18 Johnston Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go home to help mother prepare dinner
description: When she got home, her mother Chen Meiling was steaming sea fish. Yu Xiaowei put down her things, washed the cherries and put them in a fruit bowl, then helped set out bowls and chopsticks and serve soup. Her father Yu Guoqiang came out of his room to read the newspaper. She greeted him and told him she had bought fruit.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband, Zhang Weiming, picked up their son and daughter, and the whole family of six sat together for dinner, with steamed fish, char siu, garlic broccoli, and tomato egg drop soup. Their son shared skills from his football lesson, and their daughter showed the rainbow flower picture she had drawn at kindergarten. Yu Xiaowei noticed her father eating more cherries, felt glad, and exchanged a look with her husband.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Help son with homework
description: After dinner, her son Zhang Zixuan voluntarily took his math homework to the study. Yu Xiaowei quickly checked it and found that one word problem was muddled in its approach. She guided her son to read the problem again and draw a line-segment diagram to analyze it. In the end, her son solved it correctly on his own and jumped up with joy. Yu Xiaowei encouraged him that using his brain gives a greater sense of accomplishment.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Doing crafts with her daughter
description: Yu Xiaowei came to the living room, where her daughter Zhang Yuxin had already taken out the clay. She sat on the carpet with her daughter, shaping a rabbit and a bowl together. Her daughter said it was a fruit bowl for "Rabbit Mom." This simple mother-child time made Yu Xiaowei feel extremely relaxed and happy.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Spending time with my husband watching TV
description: The children went off to play on their own. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming sat on the sofa to watch the news. She shared funny stories about mentoring the new team member, and then they talked about her father's investments and mood. Her husband said her father seemed to be in a better mood and that they could have a good talk over the weekend. Yu Xiaowei leaned on his shoulder and thanked him, feeling very reassured.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Write gratitude journal and prepare for bed
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, took out her notebook, and wrote down today's three good things: a client's trust, relieving stress through yoga with colleagues, and her father's worried look fading as he ate cherries. After that, she took a warm shower, picked out a mint-green knit top and off-white casual trousers to wear tomorrow, and checked her commuter bag to make sure the power bank and earphones were fully charged.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Yue embroidery concept planning, light stretching, and a heart-to-heart talk between husband and wife.
description: Before turning off the light, Yu Xiaowei leaned against the headboard and watched Teacher Wu Xiuying's embroidery tutorial videos on her tablet, using a stylus to sketch the snowflake stitch on the sketch while doing neck stretches and shoulder rolls. After her husband turned off the light and got into bed, the two chatted for a bit in the dark. Her husband said he planned to have a proper talk with his father over the weekend, and Yu Xiaowei replied that the family would get through it together. After a few intimate words, they said good night to each other.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: After they exchanged goodnights and the room grew quiet, Yu Xiaowei listened to the occasional sound of cars outside the window and her husband's steady breathing. Feeling the fatigue of the day melt away, she slowly drifted off to sleep, looking forward to tomorrow.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Early wake-up preparation and morning run.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowei got up quietly so as not to wake her husband Zhang Weiming, quickly washed up, and changed into a sports top. At 6:50 she went downstairs and ran 3 km along the Whampoa Garden estate and the nearby waterfront promenade, pacing a bit more slowly because she was worried about her mother's health. At 7:10 she returned home and took a shower. She saw her mother Chen Meiling already busy in the kitchen, so she went over to help with the bowls and chopsticks and asked about her mother's waist. Her mother said it was fine. Afterwards, she woke up her daughter Zhang Yuxin and helped tie her hair.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, and the community waterfront promenade.

name: Family breakfast and emergency response to mother's acute back injury
description: While the whole family was sitting together eating breakfast, her mother stood up to get soy sauce and suddenly suffered an acute lower back strain. Yu Xiaowei immediately supported her and assessed the injury, asked her husband Zhang Weiming to take the children to school, and asked her father Yu Guoqiang to get a hot towel. After helping her mother lie down on the sofa, Yu Xiaowei soothed her to relax while calling her supervisor Hua Ge to ask for leave and booking an emergency appointment at 9:00 a.m. at the Yan Chai Chinese Medicine Tuina Clinic.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her mother to a traditional Chinese medicine massage clinic.
description: Yu Xiaowei helped her mother change into loose clothing, brought a lumbar cushion and the medical insurance card, and carefully helped her downstairs. At the entrance of Whampoa Garden, she hailed a taxi and headed to Wuhu Street in Hung Hom. On the way, her mother frowned in pain. Yu Xiaowei held her hand tightly, soothed her with light topics, told her she would take her out for tea once she felt better, said her husband would make tomato and potato soup, and kept reminding her to relax.
location: No. 53-59 Wuhu Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Yan Chai Chinese Medicine Tuina Clinic)

name: Accompanied my mother to Renji Traditional Chinese Medicine Tuina Clinic for treatment
description: After arriving at the Yan Chai Traditional Chinese Medicine Tuina Clinic, the TCM practitioner diagnosed an acute lumbar muscle strain with no bone injury, and then performed about 40 minutes of tuina and acupoint massage before applying a hot herbal pack. Yu Xiaowei stayed with her the whole time, handed her water, and watched her mother's condition. Her mother's furrowed brow gradually relaxed. The practitioner explained the follow-up care and hot compress methods and prescribed a topical ointment.
location: 53-59 Wuhu Street, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Yan Chai Chinese Medicine Tuina Clinic, next to Beijing Tongrentang)

name: Return home, get Mother settled, and do a quick lunch handover
description: Yu Xiaowei carefully helped her mother take a taxi home, settled her on the living room sofa, placed a soft pillow under her lower back, poured warm water, and put the ointment within reach. After that, she quickly cooked a bowl of wonton noodles as lunch. When her father Yu Guoqiang came back from playing chess in the park, Yu Xiaowei told him about her mother's condition, handed over the care responsibility to him, and then got ready for work.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the company and start work.
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into formal attire, took her briefcase, and walked from Whampoa Garden to Whampoa MTR station. She took the Kwun Tong line, transferred to the East Rail line, then to the Island line, and arrived at Wan Chai station. The whole trip took about 60 minutes. On the way, she replied to client messages on her phone and browsed financial news. After arriving at the office in the AIA Building, she made a cup of coffee in the pantry to refresh herself, then turned on her computer, dealt with a few non-urgent emails that had piled up in the morning, and quickly got into work mode.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon: handled backlog work, client communication, and team exchanges
description: Starting at 12:45, Yu Xiaowei focused on the most important work: first she returned the call of long-time client Mrs. Chen Meiling, explained the best vehicle insurance renewal plan and coverage upgrade points, successfully confirmed the renewal, and agreed to sign documents tomorrow morning. Then she replied to running friend Mr. Chen and confirmed a 2 p.m. Saturday meeting at the Shui On Centre café to discuss the insurance plan. Colleague Su Lishan came over to ask about her mother's condition, and Yu Xiaowei said it was no longer serious. Afterward she carefully reviewed the client classification table from new joiner He Junwen, used comments to give detailed revision suggestions, and sent it back. At 3 p.m., while drinking water in the rest area, she discussed next week's product training meeting with several colleagues, shared key points from the last training, and reminded them to pay attention to the new regulatory rules. Then she returned to her workstation, entered the customer follow-up records into the system, compiled the material pack for Saturday's meeting, and sent an email to her supervisor Brother Hua to report in detail the reason for the morning leave, her mother's treatment, and the afternoon work progress, promising to arrive early tomorrow.
location: Office and lounge area, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After work, went shopping at the supermarket and returned home

Holding an umbrella, she walked seven minutes to the Wellcome supermarket on Johnston Road in Wan Chai to buy fresh Chinese yam, carrots, chestnuts, lean meat, choy sum, and tomatoes for making soup for her mother, who had injured her lower back. She then carried her shopping bags from Wan Chai Station, took the Island Line, transferred to the East Rail Line, and then to the Kwun Tong Line, returning to Whampoa. By the time she arrived home, the rain was falling densely. When she opened the door, she was damp all over with the warm, bustling aura of everyday life.
location: Wellcome supermarket, 194-204 Johnston Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare and enjoy a family dinner
description: After Yu Xiaowei came in, her husband Zhang Weiming had already picked up their son and returned home; he smiled and took the shopping bags from her. Yu Xiaowei changed into home clothes, went into the kitchen, and took over making the soup and washing the vegetables, while her husband went to the living room to keep her mother company. Dinner was Chinese yam and chestnut lean pork soup, steamed chicken with fresh shiitake mushrooms, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato scrambled eggs. The family sat around the table. Her mother could only sit down slowly but had a good appetite and drank two bowls of soup. Her son shared that he had scored 90 on his English quiz; her daughter showed off the family portrait she had drawn; her father told amusing stories about playing chess with his chess friends in the afternoon. The home was full of laughter and warmth.

name: Accompanying children with homework help and games
description: After the meal, her husband voluntarily did the dishes. Yu Xiaowei sat on the living room carpet with the children. First she checked her son's math homework and found that he was stuck on a word problem, so she guided him to draw a line-segment diagram, and he soon understood. Then her daughter pulled Yu Xiaowei into playing house. She built a "little hospital" with blocks and said she was a doctor who was going to treat Grandma.
location: Living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening Yoga and Cantonese Embroidery Time
description: After the children went off to play by themselves, Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in a corner of the living room and did 10 minutes of simple yoga stretches, focusing on relaxing her shoulders, neck, and lower back. After stretching, she sat down at the embroidery table in the study, took out her embroidery hoop, and used light gray thread to outline the snowflake pattern she had embroidered before, making the shape clearer. Her husband Zhang Weiming sat beside her and chatted about what he had encountered at the construction site. Rain pattered outside the window, while the room was quiet and serene.

It had already lost about 30%, with the amount reaching HK$100,000. My heart sank when I heard this; I felt self-blame and worry. After hanging up, I went back to the master bedroom feeling low, told my husband what had happened, and my eyes turned slightly red. My husband put down his book, took my hand, and comforted me. We agreed that I would talk to my father alone this week, first to understand the details and calm him down, then to decide whether to use the family emergency fund.

The whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast. Her father Yu Guoqiang had already gone out to the park for a walk; her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin were both there. During the meal, Yu Xiaowei reminded her son Xuanxuan to remember to bring back the math quiz for her signature, and her daughter Xinxin showed a picture she had drawn in kindergarten, saying she wanted to give it to her grandmother. While drinking congee, Yu Xiaowei used her phone's memo app to organize the key questions to ask her brother: product name, purchase channel, investment amount, loss ratio, lock-up period, and contract details.

She also wrote down her worry: “Seeing Dad so happy today, I can't bear to shatter his peace. But a short-term pain is better than a long-term one, and I hope he can understand my intention. I thought giving him pocket money was enough, but I forgot that he may need the feeling of being needed even more.” After writing, tears fell, but she felt much more relaxed. Then she did a 5-minute mindful meditation, focusing on her breath. Next, she washed her face with warm water and did 5 minutes of eye yoga exercises (eye rolling, near-far focusing, etc.). location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping children with homework and family time
description: After dinner, she helped her son Zixuan finish his math homework, patiently explaining how to approach multiplication word problems and correcting careless calculation errors. Then she accompanied her daughter Xinxin in her room, reading animal picture books with her and making cute expressions and voices to amuse her. In the living room, her husband was repairing the toy car their son had broken.
location: Home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal time: write in a gratitude journal and engage in deep reflection
description: After the two children fell asleep, she took a shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, and sat alone at the desk in her bedroom. She took out her gratitude journal and browsed through the entries from the past half month or more. From the half marathon struggle, to the worry over her father's investment crisis, to Jiaxin's declaration of independence, she felt stronger inside. She picked up her pen and wrote down today's reflections and drew a small sun symbol.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, No. 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sharing with her husband and saying goodnight
description: Back in bed, leaning against the shoulder of her husband, who was taking off his wristband and lying down, she softly shared her dazed happiness about Jiaxin becoming a financial advisor, and the plan to have tea with her father on Saturday to sound him out. Her husband put his arm around her shoulder to comfort her, affirmed that she had handled it very well, and told her not to overthink and to sleep early. The two smiled at each other, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: Home bedroom, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: Although a trace of unease about her father's investment losses and the future remained, she also felt some burden lifted. She ran through Saturday's arrangements in her mind, closed her eyes, and gradually fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning routine and family matters
description: After getting up, Yu Xiaowei did 5 minutes of eye yoga, helped her mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast (rice porridge, fried eggs, stir-fried vegetables), tied her daughter Zhang Yuxin's hair and checked her schoolbag, and left breakfast for her husband Zhang Weiming.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Took her daughter to school and commuted.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked her daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter shared that she wanted to give the kapok flower she had picked up to her teacher. After watching her daughter enter the school, she walked to Mong Kok East Station, buying water at a convenience store along the way. She took the MTR from Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station, and on the train she browsed financial news and Hong Kong stock trends to prepare for work. Finally, she walked to AIA Building and officially began her workday.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Team morning meeting and new-hire coaching
description: Yu Xiaowei chaired the team morning meeting in the conference room on the 16th floor of the AIA Building and shared the weekly performance overview. After the meeting, she stayed behind to give one-on-one coaching to the new hire He Junwen in the small meeting room. In response to his messy client visit records, she taught the follow-up technique of 'a small greeting every three days, a major return visit once a week,' helped to go through his client list, selected five potential clients to focus on visiting next Monday, and asked him to submit a visit outline before the weekend.
location: Meeting Room, 16/F, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Handling client emails and paperwork
description: After returning to her workstation, Yu Xiaowei logged into the internal system to pull up the group medical insurance renewal data for client Wang Qiming's company. Combining the details of the international department's inpatient direct billing service provided by colleague Guo Junwei, she carefully drafted a reply email recommending an upgrade plan, and scheduled a trip to Shenzhen in the second week of December for an in-person signing. Afterwards, she processed the entry of multiple new policies and routine emails.
location: Workstation, 16th floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Lunch
description: Yu Xiaowei went by herself to the Man Wah Cafe near her office for a quick lunch, ordering a regular set meal (signature ham macaroni, scrambled egg toast, and hot lemon tea) to build up energy for the afternoon.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Wan Chai Road, Min Hua Cafe

name: Buying protective gear for mother-in-law and sending it out
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to the Lee Gardens area in Causeway Bay and carefully selected a pair of thick wool knee pads and ten wind-dispelling and circulation-activating medicated patches in the medical supplies section of Yue Hwa Chinese Products Emporium. After paying, she went to the nearby Causeway Bay Post Office (Windsor House branch) and sent the items by express parcel to her mother-in-law's residence in Kwun Tong, including a handwritten note to express her care.
location: Causeway Bay Post Office, 311 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Returned to the office and handled team matters
description: Yu Xiaowei walked back to AIA Building. On the way, she bought two bottles of low-sugar Vitasoy at Wellcome supermarket and put them in the office refrigerator. Back at her desk, she began sorting the team's expense reimbursement receipts for the month and submitted them to the finance system. She then prepared information packs for several high-net-worth clients she needed to visit next Monday, including the latest market analysis reports and family policy review checklists.
location: Workstation, 16th floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Afternoon communication and weekend preparations
description: Yu Xiaowei contacted He Junwen via WeChat to ask about the preparation of the weekend visit outline, and shared an industry article about referral techniques. Afterward, she filed the documents needed for next Monday and set up an automatic email reply. She checked the weekend plan memo on her phone to confirm the time for having tea with her father at the teahouse tomorrow afternoon and dinner with her husband at a Mong Kok café tomorrow evening, and sent a message to her best friend Lin Jiaxin to confirm the place for Saturday’s celebration plan.
location: Workstation, 16th floor, AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Commute home
description: Yu Xiaowei left work on time, walked from AIA Tower to Wan Chai Station, and took the MTR to Mong Kok East Station. On the train she called her mother to ask about dinner arrangements and learned that her mother had already made soup. After arriving at Mong Kok East Station, she walked home.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Spending time with family and assisting with meal preparation
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowei changed into home clothes and went to the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling trim vegetables and prepare dinner. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin showed off a painting she had made at kindergarten; Yu Xiaowei praised her and sat with her on the carpet to build LEGO.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: During dinner, her mother Chen Meiling made dried-vegetable pork bone soup, stir-fried choy sum in oyster sauce, and onion pork chops. The whole family was present, including her husband Zhang Weiming, her father Yu Guoqiang, her son Zhang Zixuan, and her daughter Zhang Yuxin. At the table, her son excitedly announced that he would play football on the weekend; her daughter wanted to learn how to make clay flowers from her grandmother; her husband mentioned helping his father-in-law check the air conditioner. Yu Xiaowei enjoyed the warm and happy family time.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Couple's evening run.
description: After resting for half an hour after the meal, Yu Xiaowei changed into running shoes and suggested going out for a jog. Her husband Zhang Weiming brought his Huawei band and set off together. The two jogged south from home along the Prince Edward Road West sidewalk, turned back near Waterloo Road, with a pace of about 6:40 per kilometer. During the run they talked about weekend plans and their son's exams. Zhang Weiming showed that his step count had exceeded 15,000, and Yu Xiaowei encouraged him to keep it up.
location: Streets near Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Family leisure time after an evening run
description: After returning home from her run, Yu Xiaowei and her husband stretched in the living room. Her son Zhang Zixuan showed the volcano model he made in science class and performed a "volcano eruption" experiment for the whole family, drawing cheers. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin sat beside her grandmother learning to wind yarn into a ball. Yu Xiaowei sat on the carpet, took a family photo, sent it to her close friends' group chat, and remarked that family is the best refuge.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Parent-child reading and putting the kids to bed
description: After helping her daughter Zhang Yuxin brush her teeth and wash her face, Yu Xiaowei lay down with her on the bed and read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You. After finishing the book, her daughter obediently closed her eyes to sleep, and she gently patted her daughter's back until her breathing became steady.
location: Daughter's bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Gratitude journal and bedtime preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the master bedroom, sat at the dressing table, and wrote in her gratitude journal, recording three good things today: He Junwen accepted the guidance, her mother-in-law called to thank her after receiving the knee pads, and she enjoyed her first night run with her husband. Then she organized the gifts to bring to tomorrow's dim sum gathering and the materials for Monday's visit, briefly talked with her husband about the plans for tomorrow, applied a face mask, dimmed the lights, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Morning meditation and family breakfast
description: Sunlight streamed into the bedroom. After waking up, Yu Xiaowei did some simple stretching on the edge of the bed, followed by 5 minutes of mindfulness meditation and writing in her gratitude journal, recording last night's first night run with her husband and today's clear weather. After washing up, she went to the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling set out bowls and dishes, and refill the cat A Fu's food and water. Then she went upstairs and gently woke up her 8-year-old son Xuanxuan and 5-year-old daughter Xinxin, helping Xinxin get over her reluctance to get out of bed. The family sat together for breakfast, which included her mother's plain rice porridge and BBQ pork buns, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Master bedroom, kitchen, and living room at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Take my son to his soccer interest class.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked with her son Zhang Zixuan for about 17 minutes to Kowloon City Sports Ground. It was sunny and warm that day. After Xuanxuan changed into his jersey and cleats, he did warm-ups, group exercises, and dribbling drills under the coach's guidance. Yu Xiaowei sat on a bench on the sidelines watching her son train, clapping to encourage him and observing his mood and state. She stayed on the sidelines for half an hour, then left early to head to Festival Walk.
location: Kowloon City Sports Ground, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Take a taxi to Festival Walk
description: Yu Xiaowei took a taxi from the entrance of Kowloon City Sports Ground to Festival Walk in Kowloon Tong. The ride took about 15 minutes and was smooth all the way.
location: In a taxi from Kowloon City Sports Ground, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong to Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong

name: Taking her daughter to a bookstore to choose picture books
description: After arriving at Festival Walk, Yu Xiaowei met up with her mother Chen Meiling and daughter Zhang Yuxin. In the children's section of The Commercial Press, Xinxin eagerly flipped through four or five picture books and finally chose Dinosaur Encyclopedia and a Frozen storybook. Yu Xiaowei sat on a low stool reading with her daughter, and also browsed An Introduction to Meridian Health and Mindful Parenting for about twenty minutes. At the checkout, she bought Xinxin a box of coloring pens, and her daughter happily took her hand and left.
location: The Commercial Press inside Festival Walk, 80 Tat Chee Avenue, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong

name: On the way back, buy fruit and lunch for the whole family.
description: Yu Xiaowei took her daughter on the MTR (from Kowloon Tong Station to Mong Kok East Station) and then walked home. Passing the Chan Kee Fruit stall on Prince Edward Road West, she bought Sunkist oranges, green grapes, and strawberries as after-dinner fruit. When they got home, her mother had already prepared blanched shrimp, stir-fried choy sum, steamed fish, and lotus root and pork rib soup. After Xuanxuan came back from the sports ground, he kept saying he was hungry, while Xinxin excitedly showed off her new picture book. At lunch, the whole family sat together. Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming talked about her father's investment issue and agreed to discuss it again on the weekend. Her mother put food on the children's plates. The atmosphere was lively and warm.
location: Street-side fruit shops along Prince Edward Road West, and a Chinese restaurant at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Lunch break and housework preparations
description: After helping to clear the dishes following the meal, Xuanxuan played with LEGO and Xinxin lay down to look at a new picture book. Yu Xiaowei did not force a nap and only told them to get along well. She herself lay on the living room sofa with her eyes closed and rested for half an hour, mentally planning the afternoon embroidery and the evening dinner for two with Mingzai. After resting, she got up to check Xuanxuan's schoolbag and uniform, trimmed the loose threads at the worn knees of the trousers and sewed a few stitches, tidied Xinxin's coat and underwear, picked out clothes for hand washing, confirmed that the cat Ah Fu had enough food and water, and finally picked out a navy blue knitted dress and a white shirt for going out in the evening.
location: Living room and bedrooms at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery on the balcony and helping prepare dinner
description: Yu Xiaowei set up the embroidery frame on the balcony and continued embroidering the 'Gold and Jade Fill the Hall' piece, listening to Danny Chan's nostalgic classics. Stitch by stitch, she completed the scales of the koi fish and part of the green leaves. Sunlight streamed through the plants, cozy and peaceful. After about 50 minutes, she put away the frame and went to the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables and chop scallions, preparing ingredients for dinner. She told her mother that she and Mingzai would be going out for dinner in the evening and that the food was already prepared. Then she checked on the children: Xuanxuan was doing a puzzle, and Xinxin was watching TV. She reminded them to listen to their grandmother.
location: Balcony and kitchen at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong.

name: Getting changed and driving to the restaurant in Mong Kok.
description: Yu Xiaowei went back to the bedroom and changed into a navy blue knit dress and a white shirt, applied light makeup and lipstick. Her husband Zhang Weiming also came out of the study, changing into a dark blue polo shirt and casual dress trousers. The two confirmed the children's homework and dinner arrangements in the living room, and her mother joked that they hadn't been on a date in a long time. Then Ming drove the silver sedan, with Yu Xiaowei in the passenger seat, along Prince Edward Road West and onto Nathan Road toward Mong Kok, chatting and discussing the dinner menu on the way, a drive of about 20 minutes.
location: Along the route from home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to 43 Dundas Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong.

name: Romantic dinner and deep conversation as a couple
description: The two of them enjoyed dinner at a window booth in the nostalgic Hong Kong-style Western restaurant "Bingshi Shiguang" on Dundas Street in Mong Kok, ordering black pepper beef tenderloin, baked pork chop rice, borscht, and red wine. Old songs were playing, and the atmosphere was warm. After clinking glasses, the conversation opened up: Yu Xiaowei shared how she felt about setting a new personal best in the half marathon, and Ming Zai mentioned being treated by a generous customer during his repair work. She told him seriously about her father's investment losses and planned to invite her father for morning tea over the weekend to talk things through. Ming Zai expressed support but advised her not to rush. They also browsed their phones for flights and hotels for the family trip to Japan over Christmas, initially narrowing down the options to Tokyo or Osaka. Ming Zai proudly mentioned that he walked 15,000 steps a day, and Yu Xiaowei smiled and praised him. The rare intimacy warmed their hearts, and the meal lasted two and a half hours.
location: Bing Sutt Time, a retro Hong Kong-style Western restaurant, at 43 Dundas Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong

name: Return home to check on the children and talk with my mother
description: At 20:40, after paying the bill, Ming drove along Nathan Road back to Prince Edward Road West. Cantonese oldies played in the car, and Yu Xiaowei leaned back in her seat watching the neon night scenery, feeling relaxed. They arrived home at 21:15. Her mother was knitting on the sofa and quietly told her the two children were already asleep. Yu Xiaowei gently opened the door to check: Xuanxuan was hugging Pikachu, and Xinxin was curled up in bed, sleeping soundly. She closed the door and thanked her mother for her efforts. Her mother asked whether the dinner had been enjoyable, and after chatting for a while, they each went to rest.
location: Drove from 43 Dundas Street, Mong Kok, Hong Kong, back to the home at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, and then to the home's living room and children's bedroom.

name: Bedtime meditation, gratitude journaling, and communication with her husband
description: After changing into loungewear and washing up, Yu Xiaowei sat by the bedside and wrote in her gratitude journal, recording her son's progress in soccer, the bookstore time with the children, her progress in Cantonese embroidery, and the romantic dinner, filling half a page. She then sat cross-legged and did a 5-minute meditation to release stress. Ming washed up and leaned against the headboard looking at his phone. He naturally put his arm around Yu Xiaowei as she leaned over, and they continued the topic left over from dinner: how to communicate with her father about investing, choosing between Tokyo and Osaka for the Japan trip, and whether the whole family would go to dim sum tomorrow. They also discussed travel dates. After scrolling on their phones for a while, drowsiness set in. Ming said goodnight, and the two adjusted their sleeping positions and quickly fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning family preparation and parent-child watercolor painting
description: After waking up naturally in the early morning, Yu Xiaowei did 5 minutes of stretching in bed. She then went to the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling prepare breakfast, which included century egg and lean pork congee, stir-fried rice noodles, and fried eggs. She woke up her 5-year-old daughter Zhang Yuxin and helped her wash up, then the whole family sat around and had breakfast. During the meal, Xinxin shared a fun story about dreaming of dolphins at Ocean Park. After breakfast, they cleared the dishes, spread newspapers on the living room coffee table, and conceived and painted a watercolor painting with Xinxin titled "Our Family's Balcony Garden". While painting, Xinxin accidentally knocked over the blue paint tray. Yu Xiaowei patiently guided her and turned the accident into a creative blue river, and they completed the painting together.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home)

name: Morning personal errands and going-out preparations
description: After Xinxin played on her own, Yu Xiaowei went into the study and weighed 53.3 kg on the body-fat scale. Then she carefully checked her running gear: Nike running shoes, water bottle, armband, quick-dry towel, and a small silk pouch containing a Cantonese embroidery bracelet. After confirming everything was in order, she confirmed the 3 p.m. meeting place with her friend Shen Peiwen via WeChat and received a positive reply. Then she changed into casual outdoor clothes, briefed her husband Zhang Weiming—who was watching soccer with their son Xuanxuan in the living room—on the children's lunch and afternoon arrangements, and with his understanding and support, put on her tote bag with running gear and car keys and got ready to leave.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home study and living room)

name: Heart-to-heart talk with her father at a teahouse
description: Yu Xiaowei walked about 11 minutes to Star Restaurant, at the intersection of Prince Edward Road West and Junction Road, where her father Yu Guoqiang, who was already waiting, joined her. They ordered a pot of Pu'er tea and dim sum including shrimp dumplings, siu mai, and chicken feet, chatting while eating. In a relaxed atmosphere, she gently but firmly helped her father resolve his lingering frustration over the earlier investment losses, said that the family's health and happiness were the most important things, and proactively offered that she and her husband could provide financial support if necessary. This dissolved her father's self-blame, and the father-daughter bond was deeply repaired.
location: Star Restaurant, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (at the junction of Prince Edward Road West and Junction Road).

name: Returned home to pick up equipment and headed to the seaside promenade.
description: After saying goodbye to her father, Yu Xiaowei walked home, quickly changed into a pink sports top, black leggings, and her best-fitting Nike running shoes, and checked again the water bottle, armband, quick-dry towel, Cantonese embroidery bracelet, and other items in her backpack. She then said a quick goodbye to her husband, who was about to take their son out. Afterward, she took a taxi along Waterloo Road and Salisbury Road for about 20 minutes, arrived at the entrance to the Victoria Harbour waterfront promenade near the Avenue of Stars in Tsim Sha Tsui, got out, and walked to the agreed meeting point.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home) and along Salisbury Road in Tsim Sha Tsui

name: Farewell run and goodbye with a close friend along the waterfront promenade.
description: At 14:00, she met Shen Peiwen at the waterfront promenade. The two hugged, did simple stretching warm-ups, and chatted facing the sea view while hydrating, building anticipation for the jog. At 14:45, they started jogging 10 kilometers along the promenade toward Hung Hom at a pace of 5:40 per kilometer. The first half was run in focused silence. When they stopped for water at the turnaround point, Yu Xiaowei said with emotion that they had run this road many times, and Peiwen's eyes glistened with tears. On the way back, they talked and shared their anxiety about parting. After the run, they returned to a bench to rest, facing the sunset. Peiwen frankly admitted her confusion about the new city, while Xiaowei poured out her reluctance to part. At 16:15, Xiaowei took out a Cantonese embroidered bracelet from a dark blue silk pouch, embroidered with the characters for peace and ginkgo leaves, and put it on Peiwen as a protective charm, symbolizing companionship. Under the brilliant evening clouds, the two took a group photo with their phones and agreed to meet again at the Shanghai Marathon next year.
location: Victoria Harbour waterfront promenade in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong (from the entrance of the Avenue of Stars to the Hung Hom section)

name: Online sharing on the way home and showering/tidying up after returning home
description: After saying goodbye to Shen Peiwen at the corridor exit, Yu Xiaowei took a taxi back to Kowloon City. On the way, she first sent the group photo just taken to the 'Three Besties' group chat with the caption 'Seeing off Peiwen, let's meet again at next year's Shanghai Marathon!', then posted it to the 'AIA Running Club' group and received good wishes. After arriving home, she showered, changed into comfortable loungewear, put the items from her running backpack back in place, and wiped down her sports watch. By then, her mother Chen Meiling was already in the kitchen preparing dinner.
location: On the way from Tsim Sha Tsui to 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City, and at home

name: Family dinner and evening family time
description: The family sat around and enjoyed the steamed fish, stir-fried vegetables, and stewed soup prepared by her mother. Yu Xiaowei talked about how reluctant she was to see off her close friend that afternoon. Her husband Zhang Weiming comforted her, saying high-speed rail is convenient and they can meet often. The children, meanwhile, asked whether mom enjoyed her run and whether she saw dolphins. After the meal, they watched the news together. Then Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter Xinxin finish the kindergarten handmade collage homework, while her son Xuanxuan played Ludo with his dad. Around 20:00, she settled the two children into washing up and going to bed, and read an excerpt from The Little Prince as a bedtime story.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home)

name: Journaling and meditation in the study
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei went to the study, opened her diary, and first placed the ginkgo leaf bookmark Shen Peiwen had given her between the pages. Then she recorded her feelings for the day: 'I gave Peiwen the bracelet embroidered with ginkgo leaves, and with it a part of my youthful memories. But I believe even more that friendship does not fade with distance. Just as tomorrow I plan to take my embroidery to Sham Shui Po to see Teacher Wu, some things only become more precious with time. I’m grateful that Dad was willing to open up today, grateful for the wonderful meal Mom made, and grateful for the children’s smiles.' After writing, she put on her earphones and completed a 15-minute mindfulness meditation to let her emotions settle.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home study room)

name: Couple's late-night talk: sharing and planning
description: After changing into her pajamas, Yu Xiaowei gave her husband a detailed account of how she had resolved the misunderstanding with her father during lunch. Zhang Weiming also felt relieved after hearing it. The two then talked about a Christmas family trip to Japan. Yu Xiaowei mentioned that the travel agency had several five-day, four-night family tours. They agreed to set aside time next week to study the itinerary and budget together and finalize the travel plan.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home master bedroom)

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After the chat ended, Yu Xiaowei felt sleepy. She lightly kissed her husband beside her, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell peacefully asleep, with satisfaction at the day's successful end and confident anticipation of taking the children to school tomorrow and bringing her embroidery to Sham Shui Po.
location: 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong (home master bedroom)

name: Morning preparation and early yoga class
description: After the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei washed up, changed into her yoga clothes, and weighed herself at 53.4 kg, satisfied with her weekend diet control. Passing by her daughter Xinxin's room, she heard her breathing steadily and felt a little reassured. Then she walked to Whampoa Fitness Centre for the morning yoga class themed 'Shoulders, Neck and Breathing.' Flowing through poses such as Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog with Ujjayi breathing, she effectively relieved the stiffness in her shoulders and neck caused by prolonged desk work. After class, she asked about the start date of the advanced therapeutic yoga class and planned to sign up next week to maintain a regular practice.
location: 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast and morning household chores.
description: After yoga class, she walked home, wiped off her sweat, then helped her husband Ming Zai and her mother prepare breakfast, including fried eggs, toast, and pouring milk. She woke her son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin, handed the children over to Ming Zai, and reminded him to let Xinxin drink more warm water today and watch for any coughing. She quickly finished her breakfast, changed into her work suit, and packed her commuter bag.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to work and preparing work on the way
description: Left home 5 minutes later than usual. After saying goodbye to Mingzai, she walked to Mong Kok East Station, took the East Rail line toward Admiralty, and changed to the Island line at Admiralty Station to go to Wan Chai. On the train, she used the fragmented time to check the day's work priorities again in her phone notes, opened the company information for client Mr. Liao to confirm the details of the tax incentives, and edited the email draft she had prepared to send to two potential business owners in Shenzhen. After arriving at Wan Chai Station, she walked to AIA Building.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai District, Wan Chai Station and AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road

name: Morning office preparation and team meeting
description: Upon arriving at the AIA Building office, she put down her bag, turned on her computer, and made a cup of green tea. She sorted through the paperwork left over from last Friday and printed the team performance progress chart. Seeing her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng's good-morning greeting, she replied with a smiley face and did not mention Father's documents. Then she attended the Monday team meeting in the conference room. Director Liang Zhenhua reviewed the performance from the past weekend. When Yu Xiaowei spoke, she publicly praised He Junwen's visit plan submitted last Friday for its clear logic and thorough client analysis, gave him a company afternoon-tea voucher, and told the team that an internal sharing session on successful cases led by Su Lishan would be held this Friday afternoon.
location: Meeting Room A, XX/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Contact corporate clients and follow up on business
description: Immediately after the morning meeting, she devoted herself to client follow-up work. She called Mr. Liao at a local trading company; he said he was still considering. Yu Xiaowei said she understood, told him she had re-sent the optimized comparison proposal by email, highlighted that signing before the end of the year would qualify for an 8% tax benefit, and proactively offered to visit next week to explain in detail. She then formally sent the introductory emails about the two selected Shenzhen business owners through her company email, attaching her personal business card and contact information.
location: Office area, XX/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch and walk with colleagues
description: Had lunch with colleague Su Lishan at the café in Shui On Centre, ordering arugula salad and a hot latte. While eating and chatting, Su Lishan shared funny stories about taking her son camping at the country park over the weekend. Yu Xiaowei proactively asked about her PPT preparation for Friday's sharing session and suggested focusing on how to address the pain points of corporate executives' needs. After the meal, the two walked back to the office along Gloucester Road. Passing by a flower shop, she saw freshly arrived balloon flowers, hesitated for a moment, and decided not to buy them, thinking she could buy a bouquet and put it in the meeting room for the sharing session.

A sticky note read: 'Xiaowei, all my materials are here. Sorry for the trouble.' Yu Xiaowei's nose prickled. She took a deep breath, carefully sorted the documents with paper clips by category, put them in her briefcase, and decided to take them home in the evening to deal with.

Yu Xiaowei hugged her son and daughter, crouched down, and checked Xinxin's forehead temperature. It was 36.7, so no fever, but she reminded her again to drink warm water. Then the family of five sat down to dinner. Xuanxuan shared a funny story about learning jump rope in PE class. Yu Xiaowei briefly talked about praising a colleague and following up with clients. Her mother said she looked well. After dinner, she helped clear the dishes.

Then she lay on the bed, used a heated eye mask to warm her eyes for 10 minutes, and did a simple set of eye exercises to relieve the day's eye fatigue.
location: Master bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Dad is willing to trust me, and I will do my best to help him; 4. My husband's support is my strongest pillar. After writing, she turned off the desk lamp, glanced at her sleeping husband, and went to bed with the lights off.

Yu Xiaowei systematically asked about Mr. Chen and his family's occupations, health, and other conditions and took notes. Based on their annual household income of HK$1.2 million and their conservative preference, she recommended a package including HK$1 million term life insurance, HK$500,000 critical illness insurance each, high-limit supplementary medical insurance, and an education endowment insurance plan. She explained the terms in detail. Mr. Chen was very satisfied and signed the insurance application letter on the spot. Afterwards, the two moved to the pantry, drank black tea and shared feelings. Mr. Chen marveled at the drama of going 'from knocking on doors to signing policies' and praised Yu Xiaowei for 'treating clients as human beings,' which made her rediscover her original professional intention.

After reviewing the terms, Lawyer Chen pointed out that the risk disclosure in the contract was ambiguous and the sales process could be misleading. He advised collecting complete bank statements and the risk disclosure statement, giving first priority to the bank's internal complaint channel, and outlined key talking points. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes and said she would contact them again if a formal legal opinion was needed.

After a moment of silence, her father took out a file folder from his bedroom drawer containing bank account statements, purchase receipts, and the original risk disclosure statement. Yu Xiaowei photographed each one with her phone as backup, comforted her father, and promised to communicate with the bank, urging him not to blame himself too much.

description: At 18:45, after settling the children, Yu Xiaowei went into the study and made a WeChat video call to her close friend Huang Wenhui in Shenzhen. She told her in detail about the day's complaint process. Huang Wenhui analyzed that an internal complaint to the bank was the first step, and that if there was no satisfactory reply, she could complain to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. She also reminded her to keep the case number and all documents. Her friend's reassurance relaxed her tense mood. The two chatted for half an hour and reminded each other to watch for weather changes.
location: Study, Prince Mansion, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Rest and training preparation
description: After hanging up the video call, Yu Xiaowei sat on the living room sofa, drank half a glass of warm water, and relaxed for 15 minutes. She then returned to the bedroom, changed into a workout top and leggings, prepared her yoga mat and resistance band, and opened the Keep fitness app.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, living room and bedroom

name: Evening core and lower body strength training
description: At 19:55, Yu Xiaowei started the "Core and Lower Body" course training in the living room on time, strictly completing 3 sets of planks, 15 single-leg squats on each side, and 15 elastic band side steps on each side. Sweat dripped, but she strived to make every movement standard. After training, she did a 5-minute full-body stretch, feeling her heart rate gradually calm down and her body full of strength.
location: Living room, Prince Building, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shower and trial embroidery of the finalized Cantonese embroidery piece “Winter”
description: After training, she showered immediately, changed into loungewear at 20:40, and walked into the study. Yu Xiaowei opened the embroidery frame, took out silver, gray-blue, and champagne gold silk threads, and compared them repeatedly under the light. She decided to outline the main trunk of the withered branches in silver gray, and lightly dot the smallest twigs with champagne gold, to create a shimmering effect in frost and snow. She tried a few stitches, and the plane tree on the embroidery cloth seemed to come to life.
location: Study, Prince Mansion, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and gratitude journal
description: At 21:10, she put down her needlework and returned to the bedroom. Yu Xiaowei took out her diary and seriously wrote down the day's gratitude: thanking her best friend Wenhui for helping her see a clear course of action on her father's matter, thanking her work for progressing smoothly and for the interaction with newcomer He Junwen that showed the team's growth, and thanking her body for the strength and resilience it showed in yoga and strength training. She also wished the bank would give a fair answer.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, bedroom

name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation
description: At 9:40 p.m., Yu Xiaowei turned off the main light, switched on the aromatherapy lamp by the bedside, and sat cross-legged on the bed. Using the Tide app, she played a 15-minute 'body scan' meditation audio, following the guidance to slowly scan her attention from head to toe, feeling each part relax, especially the tense neck, shoulders, and back from the day.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, bedroom

name: Tidy up belongings and go to bed.
description: After the meditation, Yu Xiaowei quietly lay down, hung up the outfit she would wear the next day, and confirmed that her phone alarm was set for 6 o'clock. Her husband Zhang Weiming was already asleep, breathing evenly. She turned off the bedside lamp, closed her eyes calmly in the dark, silently reviewed the day's work, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, bedroom

name: Morning recovery run.
description: At 6 a.m., Yu Xiaowei put on her neon green running shoes, walked 15 minutes from home to Kowloon Tsai Park, and completed an easy 6 km run at a pace of 5:50 per kilometer. The morning breeze carried the scent of grass and trees. She adjusted her breathing and focused on her steps. After the run, she stretched for 10 minutes on a park bench, recorded the data on her phone, and shared it with her running group.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shower, Cantonese embroidery review, and breakfast and commute preparation
description: Arriving home at 7:00, she quickly showered and changed into loungewear. Yu Xiaowei sat upright at the craft table in her study, took out the embroidery piece Daughter's World Autumn completed last night, picked up the gradient silver thread sent by He Meiling, and used the rolling needle technique to refine the veins of a plane tree leaf. Satisfied, she took a photo and sent it to Teacher Wu Xiuying. Then her mother had already prepared breakfast. While eating, she checked her phone and received a voice message from Teacher Wu praising her work and suggesting she begin creating Winter and recommending her to participate in the Hong Kong Traditional Crafts Exhibition. She replied with thanks and promised to start the sketch. Afterward, she changed into a gray professional suit, checked the items in her briefcase, and prepared for her commute.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to company

Su Lishan passed by and greeted her, and they confirmed the afternoon sharing session was at 13:00.

She categorized the three Shenzhen clients: for the price-comparison churn type, promote referral commissions; for the service-dissatisfied type, appease them and offer complimentary health management services; for the unmet-needs type, add an analysis of family protection gaps. She photographed the plan framework and sent it to Director Liang Zhenhua for review.

Yu Xiaowei noted the suggestions and added extra incentive terms.
location: 8th Floor, AIA Financial Center, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: Call renewal customer Mr. Li to confirm the payment card number; contact dissatisfied customer Mrs. Liu to explain the reason for the claims delay and give her a free physical examination voucher; call unmet-need customer Mr. Chen to arrange a meeting time for next Tuesday afternoon. After each call, record a summary in the CRM system.
location: 8th Floor, AIA Financial Center, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

While eating, they chatted about the speaking pace for the sharing session. Yu Xiaowei shared a case of handling a client's policy renewal and encouraged Su Lishan to relax.

name: Organize materials for the afternoon sharing session.

location: 8th Floor, AIA Financial Center, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Participated in Su Lishan's internal sharing session.
description: Arrived early at the 16th-floor meeting room to help Su Lishan set up the PPT. During the sharing session, Su Lishan shared a new perspective on policy review. Yu Xiaowei took careful notes and shared her own case of handling client policy renewals during the interactive segment. After the meeting, she praised Su Lishan in person.
location: Meeting room, 16/F, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Contact my younger brother to arrange a dinner in Shenzhen

Yu Xiaofeng readily agreed and even offered to introduce the project manager of the Insurance Technology Park to help with the cross-border business.

She reported the case number obtained from the complaint filed with the bank the previous day. Lawyer Chen advised that if the bank did not give a substantive reply within 3 working days, she should immediately submit a written application to the Financial Dispute Resolution Centre, and reminded her to keep the original risk disclosure form with a defective signature. Yu Xiaowei scanned the documents in chronological order, encrypted them, and uploaded them to the cloud.
location: Small meeting room, 8th Floor, AIA Financial Centre, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handle the day's wrap-up tasks.

Check the email to confirm all messages have been handled, then turn off the computer and tidy the desk.
location: 8th Floor, AIA Financial Center, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute

The carriage was crowded, so I put on earphones and listened to a podcast about client communication. Arrived at Prince Edward Station at 18:50.
