location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Prince Edward Road West, ParknShop (Prince Edward Road West Store)

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: After arriving home, her mother was preparing dinner. Yu Xiaowei put the pudding in the refrigerator. The family sat around the table; she shared the news of Teacher Wu's praise. Her mother praised her, and her son Xuanxuan was rewarded with pudding. When the conversation turned to the Shenzhen client plan, her husband Zhang Weiming supported it but reminded her to pay attention to rest. After dinner, she helped her daughter with a simple drawing while her son read a storybook.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family meeting to finalize the emergency fund plan
description: She closed the study door with her husband, spread out the family ledger, and after calculating, decided to set aside 50,000 Hong Kong dollars from the liquid emergency reserve to help her father repay part of the principal he had lost. Her husband wrote a sub-item 'father's emergency' in the ledger and suggested eating out less next month so the saved money could be deposited into this account. The two of them signed to confirm.
location: Study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Writing a gratitude journal and meditating
description: At the desk, write in a gratitude journal, thanking Teacher Wu for her recognition, Director Liang for his guidance, her husband for his support, her mother for dinner, and her children for their smiles. Then turn off the lights, sit cross-legged on the yoga mat, and use a meditation app to guide her breathing and relax her body and mind.
location: Study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Massage gun relaxation and stretching
description: Changed into sports shorts, sat on the edge of the bed, used a massage gun to relax the leg muscles, from the quadriceps to the calf gastrocnemius, then rolled the sole of the foot with a tennis ball, completed the back-of-leg stretches, showered, and applied body lotion.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Snuggled with her husband, chatted, and fell asleep
description: After washing up, the two sat side by side at the head of the bed, fingers interlocked. Yu Xiaowei expressed gratitude for her husband's support in reducing her pocket money, and Zhang Weiming comforted her. After chatting for 5 minutes, they turned off the lights. Yu Xiaowei prayed in a low voice and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Woke up in the early morning and did family morning chores.
description: At 8:00, Yu Xiaowei got up on time, habitually stepped on the scale, and saw the number 52.9 kg. Then she sat quietly on the balcony for 10 minutes, enjoying the early winter sunlight, and silently reviewed the key points of today's conversation with her father. After changing into home clothes, she gently woke the children and, with her husband Zhang Weiming, helped make the beds for her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin. At 8:30, she went downstairs again to help her mother Chen Meiling carry the quilts to be aired onto the balcony, and prepared the drying rack for later.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning family walk in the park
description: At 8:45, Yu Xiaowei and her family of four changed into casual sportswear and set off from their home on Prince Edward Road West. They walked past Fuk Lo Tsun Road and several quiet side streets and arrived at Kowloon Tsai Park at 9:10. The park was sunny. Zhang Zixuan and Zhang Yuxin chased each other on the lawn, while Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming strolled along the jogging trail, enjoying the warm sunshine. While keeping an eye on the children's safety, she softly recounted the key points of her afternoon conversation with her father to her husband, confirming that they had reached a consensus on the communication plan. About half an hour later, the family of four walked home chatting and laughing.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Hanging out the bedding and morning stretching
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei and her mother Chen Meiling took the sheets and quilts to the balcony to air them, chatting about family matters as they hung them out. She told her mother that she would meet her father in the afternoon, and her mother looked pleased and advised her, “Speak slowly, don’t rush.” After airing them, she did a simple 15-minute morning stretch on the living room mat to relax the leg muscles and shoulders that were slightly tight from yesterday’s morning run.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Visit Teacher Wu for advice on Cantonese embroidery
description: At 10:50, Yu Xiaowei left home, walked to Prince Edward MTR station, took the Kwun Tong Line to Sham Shui Po station, and arrived about 15 minutes later at 11:10 at Wu Xiuying's Cantonese embroidery studio on the 2nd floor of 174 Apliu Street. She laid out the fabric piece Daughter's World: Autumn completed yesterday for Teacher Wu to see in person, and the teacher highly praised her work. Teacher Wu also took out her treasured embroidery patterns from the Republican period, providing inspiration for the withered branches background of Winter. Yu Xiaowei earnestly asked about the specific matching techniques for champagne gold and silver gray silk thread, as well as the exhibition process. During the conversation, she quickly replied to Lawyer Chen on WeChat. When she left at 12:00, Teacher Wu gave her the pre-prepared champagne gold and gray-blue silk threads.
location: Teacher Wu's Yue Embroidery Studio, 2/F, 174 Apliu Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Supermarket shopping and restocking daily necessities.
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR Kwun Tong Line from Sham Shui Po Station to Whampoa Station, a ride of about 25 minutes, and entered the Jusco supermarket at Whampoa New World at 12:30. Following the family shopping list, she replenished daily necessities and ingredients such as toilet paper, dishwashing liquid, lettuce, tomatoes, and eggs. She also specially selected Japanese Shine Muscat grapes and Australian peaches to bring to her father in the afternoon. In addition, she bought a bag of plain potato chips and chocolate bars for the children as cheer-up snacks for tonight's financial review. She checked out at 13:00.
location: Wonder World Shopping Centre, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home for lunch and midday rest
description: Yu Xiaowei took a taxi from Whampoa back to her home on Prince Edward Road West. The ride took about 15 minutes, and she arrived home at 13:15. Her mother, Chen Meiling, had already cooked tomato and egg noodles, and she quickly finished lunch. After the meal, she informed her husband, Zhang Weiming, of the afternoon itinerary and asked her mother to coax their daughter Zhang Yuxin to take a nap. She then returned to the bedroom, changed into a dark blue knit top and gray wide-leg trousers, to prepare her outfit for the meeting with her father in the afternoon, and packed the purchased fruit and complaint documents into her carrying bag.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting ready to go out and heading to the cha chaan teng.
description: 13:30, Yu Xiaowei sat at the dressing table and touched up her makeup, took a deep breath in the mirror, and silently repeated her talking points. She confirmed her phone had enough battery and backed up the bank statements, complaint receipts, and other documents scanned last night on her watch. At 13:45, she hugged her husband Zhang Weiming and left, hailed a taxi downstairs, and told the driver to go to 18 Fuk Lo Tsun Road. The ride took about 12 minutes. On the way, she opened the memo app on her phone and quickly reviewed the family remedy plan and lawyer's advice she had organized last night to make sure everything was foolproof.
location: En route from Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to 18 Fuk Lo Tsun Road

name: Reconciled with my father at a cha chaan teng
description: At 14:00, Yu Xiaowei arrived on time at the time-honored cha chaan teng in Kowloon City, where her father Yu Guoqiang was already waiting in a corner booth. She smiled and took her seat and, as usual, ordered a pineapple bun with butter, hot milk tea, and a plate of gai lan with oyster sauce. The two of them first talked about how the grandchildren were doing, and the atmosphere gradually eased. Then she gently took her father's hand and calmly explained that she had lodged a complaint with the bank, that the family emergency fund could cover part of the loss, and that she planned to move the remaining funds into low-risk wealth management products. At first her father was silent, his eyes reddening. In the end, he opened up about his true feelings, relented, and agreed to her plan, promising to come to her home the next afternoon for a detailed discussion. By 16:00, both father and daughter felt greatly relieved, and they stayed another quarter of an hour chatting about family matters.
location: Ground floor shop, 18 Fuk Lo Tsun Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return trip and a brief rest.
description: Yu Xiaowei took a taxi home around 16:15 and arrived at 16:30. She drank a glass of warm water and felt a wave of relaxation. At that moment, her husband, Zhang Weiming, was about to go out to pick up their daughter Zhang Yuxin from her interest class. The two briefly exchanged a few words. Yu Xiaowei said, “It's done — she agreed to come over tomorrow to talk.” Weiming gave her hand a squeeze with a gratified look.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sketch creation and socializing for the Guangdong embroidery piece Winter
description: Yu Xiaowei walked into the study, put on her headphones to listen to a nostalgic Cantonese song playlist, and placed the new silk threads Teacher Wu had given her on the desk. She opened her sketchbook and began drawing the preliminary sketches for "Winter," using a pencil to outline a few withered branches bent by snow, and noted, "try interweaving gray-blue, light silver, and champagne gold." During a break from the creative work, she shared a photo of the finished "Daughter's World Autumn" on WeChat Moments with the caption, "Harvest in autumn, store in winter; every stitch is a moment of time." Afterwards, she sent a private message to her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng and sent the good news of today's reconciliation with her father to Lin Jiaxin and Huang Wenhui in the besties' group chat.
location: Study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped prepare dinner and had family dinner
description: After her husband Zhang Weiming picked up their daughter, Yu Xiaowei went to the kitchen to help her mother Chen Meiling. She stir-fried lettuce with shrimp and minced garlic using the lettuce and shrimp bought from the supermarket, and helped her mother reheat the pre-simmered lotus root and pork rib soup. Then the family of six sat around the table for dinner. Her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin chattered about what they had seen and heard that day, and the table was full of laughter.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child companionship and sharing household responsibilities.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei took the initiative to clear the table and let her mother Chen Meiling rest. She first checked her son Zhang Zixuan's weekend math homework and helped him correct a wrong problem; then she accompanied her daughter Zhang Yuxin in making a little rabbit out of colored paper and scissors, and listened to her talk about interesting things at kindergarten. In the meantime, she took a moment to share the good news from today's meeting with her father, and her mother was also very happy.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Monthly couple's financial review and budget planning
description: After getting the children ready for bed and letting her mother watch TV and rest, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming closed the study door and began their monthly financial review. She opened the bookkeeping app, while Weiming took out all the November receipts. After checking, they found that dining-out expenses had been reduced by HK$820 compared to October, and the monthly savings rate had recovered to 85% of the target level. Together they planned the Christmas gift budget and agreed to add another HK$2,000 in time deposits in December to get closer to the annual goal of saving HK$50,000. After the review, they each wrote their thoughts for the day in their gratitude journals.
location: Study, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening me-time and bedtime ritual.
description: After finishing the review at 21:00, Yu Xiaowei changed into comfortable pajamas. She took out new embroidery thread and the sketched draft, sat at the head of the bed, and tried embroidering a short section of silver-gray withered branches. At 21:20, she made a video call to her close friend Lin Jiakai, briefly sharing the day's results. After hanging up, she went into the bathroom to take a shower, enjoying the relaxing feeling of hot water flowing over her body. After showering, she used a massage gun to carefully relax her calves and back, then started a 10-minute mindfulness meditation at 22:15. At 22:25, she opened her gratitude journal and wrote down the three most important things to be grateful for that day: her father had let go of his grudge, the family finances were back on track, and her family had given her warm support.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night chat with husband and bedtime.
description: Weiming was already lying in bed. Yu Xiaowei turned off the light, snuggled up to him, and quietly discussed with him the details of her father's visit to their home tomorrow afternoon for a detailed talk. After reaching an agreement, they said goodnight and, feeling relieved and at peace, soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning preparation and morning rituals
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up to the vibration of her wristband and weighed herself on the scale at 52.7 kg. She first drank a glass of warm water, then walked to the small balcony, and facing the fresh northeast wind of late autumn, did 5 minutes of morning yoga stretching and deep breathing, feeling the tranquility of the early morning and gradually becoming refreshed.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Rechecked asset restructuring documents.

Plan 1 was to transfer the remaining funds into AIA Guaranteed Return Savings Insurance, with the policy held by her on behalf of the client; Plan 2 was to convert them to a bank fixed deposit, with her subsidizing an additional HK$500 each month. After confirming everything was correct, she neatly placed the documents in a light blue folder and put it in the center of the coffee table.
location: Home living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assisting mother with breakfast and morning household chores
description: Yu Xiaowei walked into the kitchen, helped her mother Chen Meiling bring the steamed barbecue pork buns, rice noodle rolls, and cooked congee to the table, and at the same time divided the strawberries and blueberries washed last night into the children's dedicated small bowls. Her husband Zhang Weiming was packing a schoolbag for their son Xuanxuan, and their daughter Xinxin had just woken up. Yu Xiaowei smiled and hugged her.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home in Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Eating breakfast with family
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Yu Xiaowei served food to her son Xuanxuan while reminding him to wear sports shoes when going to Tai Lam in the afternoon. Her husband Zhang Weiming suggested driving in the afternoon, and she nodded in agreement. After the meal, she checked her son's weekend English reading homework, found a spelling mistake, and gently corrected it.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, home dining room

On the way home, she bought a copy of Sing Tao Daily at the entrance of the residential complex. After arriving home, she looked through the photo album with her daughter Xinxin and pointed out the family photo taken at Tai Lam Country Park last year.
location: Basketball court of Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (walked there and back from 328 Prince Edward Road West)

name: Preparing to welcome her father
description: Yu Xiaowei tidied up the coffee table and confirmed the location of the blue folder containing the asset restructuring papers. She boiled a pot of hot water and prepared to brew Tieguanyin, her father's favorite tea. When she heard the doorbell ring, she took a deep breath and hurried to the door to open it.
location: The living room and entryway of her home in Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Discuss the asset restructuring plan with her father
description: Her father, Yu Guoqiang, wearing a neat jacket, walked about 10 minutes from nearby to their home. Yu Xiaowei asked him to sit on the sofa and poured hot tea. She first calmed him down, holding his hand and saying, "Dad, let's get this settled today." Then she opened the folder and clearly and patiently explained the two plans one by one. After a few seconds of silence, her father pointed to Plan One and nodded in agreement, promising that from now on he would discuss all investment decisions with his daughter first. Yu Xiaowei put away her father's written authorization, and the heavy weight in her heart finally lifted.
location: Home living room, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

Yu Xiaowei asked her husband to help wash and cut vegetables in the kitchen, while she sliced the beef shank that her mother had braised last night, and took the steamed grouper out of the refrigerator to clean it, getting ready for lunch.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, home living room and kitchen

name: The family enjoys a home-cooked lunch.

Her father proactively picked fish for his grandson Xuanxuan, and her mother teased with a smile that her father was in a good mood today. Yu Xiaowei watched this warm scene and felt the recent stress melt away.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, home dining room

She told the children to bring their water bottles and snacks, and reminded her husband to bring the DSLR camera. The family of five (her father did not join them; he had arranged to play chess with an old friend in the afternoon and left on his own) got into the car and drove along Princess Margaret Road, West Kowloon Highway, and Tuen Mun Road to Tai Lam Country Park.

The children ran and played in the fallen leaves, and the mother walked slowly with the support of her husband Zhang Weiming. Yu Xiaowei took a family photo with her phone, and also photographed the interesting twigs and uniquely shaped fallen leaves the children had picked up, gathering inspiration for the composition of the Cantonese embroidery piece “Winter.”

name: Drive back home.

Finally, she took out her gratitude journal and wrote: “Today I helped Dad take the first step, and the whole family went hiking together. It feels more solid when we are together. The responsibility is heavy, but I can handle it.”

location: The kitchen and bedroom of the home at Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description: The phone alarm went off at 6:00 sharp. Yu Xiaowei did a few simple stretches in bed to wake up her sleeping muscles. location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Prince Building, home bathroom and bedroom

She went upstairs to wake up her daughter Xinxin, helped her tie her little braids, and quickly checked her son Xuanxuan's math homework from last night. The second was to Auntie Liang, who is retired and lives alone; Yu Xiaowei patiently explained the policy changes and value-added services and arranged to deliver the statement to her home tomorrow afternoon. After the meal, she returned to the office and rested with her eyes closed on the sofa in the break area for 15 minutes, while thinking about the basic composition of tonight's painting 'Winter' and imagining the mood of old branches covered in snow.

location: Home bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, master bedroom

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: Set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, put the phone on the nightstand, and turned off the desk lamp. Thinking back on tomorrow's work plan and the items for Saturday's sharing class, she felt everything was in order and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, master bedroom

name: Morning routine and family breakfast.
description: After the alarm clock rings, get up on time, open the curtains to see dry and pleasant weather, and after washing up, pat your face with cold water to wake up. Take out the festive red coat to wear at tomorrow's birthday banquet from the wardrobe and hang it up, count a stack of brand-new HK$1,000 notes from the desk drawer twice to confirm they are correct, then put them back. Next, lay out a yoga mat in the living room and do 10 minutes of Sun Salutation and neck and shoulder stretching. Then go to the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family: take eggs, milk, and barbecued pork buns from the fridge, steam the buns, fry four eggs, heat the milk, and cut a plate of apples, moving briskly. At 7:10, wake up son Xuanxuan and daughter Xinxin in turn, help your daughter tie her braids, and urge your son to check his schoolbag and homework. At 7:25, the whole family sits around for breakfast, helping your daughter break apart the bun while reminding your son to come home early after school because tomorrow is grandpa's birthday and he needs to help; husband Mingzai reminds everyone to check the birthday banquet details tonight. After breakfast, your husband takes the children to school first. Yu Xiaowei clears the dishes, changes into a white shirt and dark blue half skirt, checks her bag to confirm she has brought client Mrs. Chen's policy documents, proposal files, power bank, and folding umbrella, and tidies her appearance in front of the hallway mirror.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Ka Lok Yuen

name: Commute to Tsuen Wan.
description: Wearing flat loafers, she walked about 10 minutes from home on Prince Edward Road West to Prince Edward MTR Station, then took the Tsuen Wan Line to Tsuen Wan Station, a total journey of about 40 minutes. On the train, she used her phone to review the children's education annuity plan she had explained today to her client, Mrs. Chan, and jotted down key questions in her memo.
location: MTR Tsuen Wan Line, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Prince Edward Station to Tsuen Wan Station)

name: Met with client Mrs. Chen to explain the plan.
description: Arrived at Tsuen Wan Station at 8:50, walked to Pacific Coffee on the 2nd floor of Nina Place, chose a quiet window seat, ordered two lattes, and waited. At exactly 9:00, Mrs. Chen arrived on time. Yu Xiaowei explained the renewal terms of the family comprehensive insurance in detail, focusing on the newly launched children's education annuity plan, and demonstrated cash flow projections for different insurance plans on an iPad. Mrs. Chen showed strong interest, said she needed to discuss it with her husband, and agreed to confirm early the next week. The meeting ended smoothly at 10:15.
location: Pacific Coffee shop on the 2nd floor of Nina Tower, 8 Yeung Uk Road, Tsuen Wan District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Browsing around Tsuen Wan Plaza and buying navel oranges
description: After the meeting, she did not leave immediately but wandered around the adjoining Tsuen Wan Plaza. Remembering that she could eat fruit at home after tomorrow's birthday banquet, she walked into the 'Fresh Fruit Shop' and selected a box of golden Jiangxi navel oranges. She asked the shop to keep them for her and planned to pick them up on the way after work.
location: Tsuen Wan Plaza and nearby Fresh Fruit Shop, Tsuen Wan District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the office in Wan Chai
description: After leaving the fruit shop, she entered the MTR station again, took the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty Station, transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station, walked a few minutes after getting out, and returned to AIA Building at 11:35.
location: MTR in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Tsuen Wan Line, transfer to Island Line to Wan Chai Station)

name: Return to the office to organize and file documents
description: Returned to her workstation on the 12th floor of AIA Building. After drinking some water, she briefly tidied her desk, filed away the materials from the morning meeting with Mrs. Chen, and prepared for the afternoon's work.
location: Office, 12th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Working lunch and catching up with colleagues
description: Invited colleague Su Lishan to lunch at the café in Shui On Centre near the office; each ordered a sandwich and a salad and ate quickly. During the meal, Su Lishan talked about a difficult client, and Yu Xiaowei shared her morning meeting experience and encouraged her, while also handling a few work emails on her phone.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing work notes during the lunch break
description: After saying goodbye to Su Lishan, she returned to her work station and, during the lunch break, entered the key points of the morning communication with Mrs. Chen into the customer relationship management system and marked the next follow-up plan. Then she brewed a cup of black tea to prepare for the afternoon's work.
location: Office, 12th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon work: sending the proposal and searching for procurement materials
description: Work officially began in the afternoon. First, she sent the completed supplementary retirement plan proposal for the client Miss Li via encrypted email, with a voice message asking her to check it. Then she started sourcing materials for next month's client appreciation event, searching various suppliers online, comparing prices and minimum order quantities for gifts such as customized insulated cups, branded notebooks, and power banks, and organizing the information into an Excel spreadsheet to submit to the director. In between, she also handled a client inquiry about the claims process.
location: Office, 12th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to Kowloon City
description: At 16:30, shut down the computer, packed up personal belongings, and carefully checked the birthday card to make sure it was correct before putting it away. Set out from the office, took the Island Line from Wan Chai Station to Admiralty Station, transferred to the Kwun Tong Line to Lok Fu Station, then walked or took a short bus to Kowloon City Plaza.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, MTR (Wan Chai Station to Lok Fu Station).

name: Pick out a cashmere scarf for Father's birthday.
description: Walked straight into the Hengyuanxiang store on the first floor of Kowloon City Plaza, patiently touched different textures and compared colors in front of the cashmere scarf rack, and finally chose a navy plaid cashmere scarf. It felt soft and thick, and the color and style suited my father's steady temperament. I asked the clerk to wrap it in an exquisite gift box and include a card handwritten with blessings and thanks.
location: Hengyuanxiang Store, 1/F, Kowloon City Plaza, 128 Carpenter Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Return home to get fruit and show her father's gift.
description: Carrying the gift, she walked about 10 minutes, first stopping at the fruit shop near Prince Edward Road West to pick up the navel oranges she had ordered that morning, then walked another 5 minutes and arrived home at 18:15. After entering, she first showed the newly bought scarf to her father, who was reading the newspaper. He tried it on, liked it very much, and grinned from ear to ear. Her mother also came over to help put the navel oranges in the fridge.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Ka Lok Yuen

name: Family dinner
description: At 6:30, her mother had already prepared dinner, and Yu Xiaowei helped serve rice and dishes. The whole family sat around and had dinner together. The dishes included steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce and stir-fried choy sum with sliced pork, which her mother had specially made. During the meal, everyone talked about tomorrow's birthday banquet, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Review birthday banquet details and parent-child time
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Mingzai sat on the living room sofa, took out their phones and notepads, and did a final check of the next evening's private-room seating arrangement at the restaurant, the ten-person menu, and the cake delivery time, confirming that everything was correct. Afterward, she checked her son Xuanxuan's math homework and played with blocks with her daughter Xinxin for a while.
location: Living room and study at home, Jia Le Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Preparing the red envelope for the birthday banquet and final confirmation
description: Returning to the study, she neatly put the new banknotes she had prepared earlier into a small, beautifully embroidered cloth pouch with the character fu, wrote the birthday greeting card once more, and placed it with the gift bag for her father, making sure everything was ready to just pick up and head out the next day.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Happy Garden, home study

name: Parent-child bedtime moments.
description: At 9 o'clock, she began urging the two children to wash up and change into pajamas. First, she told her daughter two bedtime stories; then she went to her son's room to chat with him about school and reminded him to be polite and celebrate happily tomorrow. She did not leave the room until the children had settled down and fallen asleep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Jiale Garden, children's room at home

name: Write in a gratitude journal and prepare tomorrow's outfit
description: Back in the living room, she opened her phone and wrote a few lines of gratitude journal, recording the day's smooth progress and inner peace. Then she hung out the maroon coat and black trousers she would wear to tomorrow's birthday banquet, and packed everything she needed to take out the next day.
location: Master bedroom and study at home, Jialeyuan, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep stretching and communication with spouse
description: After changing into her pajamas, she did a few simple stretches on the bed to relax her legs, tired from the commute. Her husband Mingzai used a massage gun on his shoulders and neck beside her. The two chatted for a while about the next day's birthday banquet arrangements and confirmed their respective tasks.
location: Master bedroom in the home at Jialeyuan, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Picked up her phone, set an alarm for 6:15 a.m. the next morning, turned off the bedside lamp, and soon fell asleep looking forward to celebrating her father's birthday the next day.
location: Master bedroom in the home at Jialeyuan, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Waking up and morning recovery run
description: She woke up naturally before the alarm, with the sky faintly light outside the window. After a quick wash-up, she changed into workout gear and went downstairs to warm up. With a slightly nervous but expectant feeling, she jogged 4 kilometers along familiar street routes at a pace of 6:00 per kilometer, with her heart rate steady at around 130. At 18 degrees Celsius, with the autumn breeze on her face, running felt comfortable. As she ran, she mentally went through the birthday banquet procedure and confirmed that items such as scarves and red envelopes were all prepared.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate and surrounding streets, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Went home to wash up and tidy her appearance.
description: Back home, took a warm shower to wash off the sweat from the morning run. Changed into loungewear, blow-dried my hair, and did a simple skincare routine. Gave myself encouragement in the mirror: 'Everything will go smoothly today.' Checked the maroon knit dress prepared for the birthday banquet to make sure it was neatly ironed.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family Collaboration and Morning Warmth
description: She left the bedroom and helped her husband Lin Weiqiang wake up their 8-year-old son Xuanxuan and 5-year-old daughter Xinxin. The morning was a little busy but orderly: she checked Xuanxuan's schoolbag and homework and helped Xinxin fix her pigtails. Together with her daughter, she said "Happy Birthday" to grandpa and reminded her to behave well in the evening. Her mother Li Xiulan had already prepared a simple breakfast (plain congee, scrambled eggs, and char siu bao), and the family ate quickly.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assist with school drop-off and commute to work
description: Downstairs, she divided tasks with her husband. He drove the two children to school (first taking their son to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, then their daughter to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten), while she walked to Prince Edward Road West MTR station. On the way, she checked the reservation for tonight's birthday banquet private room on her phone. She took the Kwun Tong line to Mong Kok station, transferred to the Tsuen Wan line across the harbor to Admiralty station, then switched to the Island line to Wan Chai station. The total commute took about 45 minutes. On the way, she browsed financial news and several clients' updates on her phone.
location: From Prince Edward Road West MTR Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Wan Chai MTR Station, Wan Chai District

name: Arriving at work and preparing for the morning meeting
description: Arrived at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai. Bought a cup of hot unsweetened soy milk at the convenience store downstairs, then took the elevator to the office. Opened my computer and quickly scanned through my emails. At 8:30 the team started the morning meeting on time. Liang Zhenhua (Brother Hua) briefly summarized yesterday's performance and reminded everyone of the points to note for the year-end sprint. At the meeting, I gave him an advance heads-up: "Brother Hua, today is my dad's birthday. I'll leave half an hour early this afternoon; all the work on my hands is being handled." He nodded to show understanding.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Efficient work in the morning
description: After the morning meeting, I entered an efficient working state. The first task was to approve the monthly team attendance sheet, checking the attendance records and leave requests of the 7 team members one by one, then signing it and submitting it to the system after confirming that everything was correct. Next, I focused on handling the last group insurance endorsement, carefully checking the client list, coverage amounts, and terms, and after confirming with a colleague from the underwriting department by phone, I completed the final issuance. During this time, Su Lishan came over to chat and asked how the preparations for the evening birthday banquet were going. I happily told her that we would be going to Fengcheng Restaurant tonight.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch chat and relaxation
description: At noon, Shanshan and I went to the café on the 1st floor of Shui On Centre near the office for lunch. We ordered curry beef brisket rice and iced lemon tea. Besides tonight's birthday banquet, we also discussed the progress of two major clients we are following up on before the end of the year. Shanshan joked, “Your father is really blessed to have a daughter like you.” I smiled and replied, “Yes, the most important thing is that he's happy.” After lunch, we browsed around the convenience store next door to help digest.
location: Café on the 1st floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon wrap-up work and client follow-up.
description: Back in the office, I handled a few client emails. One client, Mrs. Chen (Chen Meiling), replied, thanking me for my visit the day before yesterday and mentioning that she was very interested in the recommended savings plan. I replied that we could discuss the plan further next week. After that, I filed and organized my current work documents and prepared a brief agenda for Monday morning's team meeting, making sure there was nothing missing before I took leave. During that time, I submitted a request for early departure through the company system and received online approval from Liang Zhenhua.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tidying up in advance and preparing to depart
description: Seeing that it was almost 4:30, I cleaned up my desk early and put the files I needed to bring home tonight (notes on family financial planning) into my handbag. I checked my phone again and confirmed that my mother (Mom) had arrived at Fung Shing Restaurant and ordered the dishes, and I reminded her to remember the leopard coral grouper and crispy roast pork. I texted my husband to tell him I was ready to leave.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Left work early and walked to the metro station
description: At 16:00, I turned off my computer on time, grabbed my bag, briefly said goodbye to a few colleagues who were still working overtime, and said, “I'm heading off now.” Took the elevator downstairs, walked 5 minutes to Exit A of Wan Chai MTR station, ready to head home.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Exit A, Wan Chai MTR Station.

name: Commuting home and changing clothes in preparation
description: Avoiding the evening rush hour, the subway car was not too crowded. On the train, I browsed the community messages of the Cantonese embroidery studio on my phone and replied to a few messages. After arriving at Prince Edward Road West Station, I walked home for about 7 minutes. Once home, I quickly changed into the carefully selected maroon knit dress and put on a pearl necklace. I placed the prepared dark gray cashmere scarf and a red envelope with the character 'Fu' containing HK$8,888 into my large handbag.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pick up the children and set off for the birthday banquet
description: Pressed for time, I walked to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin (around 17:00), then took a taxi to the primary school gate to wait for Xuanxuan to finish school (around 17:30). After picking up the children, we walked slowly along the street. I cheered them on: 'Tonight we need to say happy birthday to Grandpa, and sing the birthday song too. Grandpa will be very happy.' The children excitedly said yes. From the primary school, it's only a few minutes' walk to Fung Shing Restaurant.
location: From Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Fung Shing Restaurant on Hau Wong Road

name: Family birthday banquet and warm moments
description: Arrived at the Peony Room on the third floor of Fung Shing Restaurant. My husband had already arrived from his maintenance job and was sitting with my father, drinking tea. My mother had also ordered the dishes. I walked over and sat down beside my father, took the scarf and red envelope out of my bag. I stood up, knelt respectfully in front of him, and personally tied the soft cashmere scarf around his neck, then pressed the red envelope into his hand. Holding his slightly rough hand, I said earnestly, 'Dad, happy birthday. Don't worry about the investment matter; I'll sort it out for you before the New Year, rest assured.' Father's eyes reddened slightly, and he patted the back of my hand and nodded. During the meal, Xuanxuan and Xinxin sang the birthday song for their grandfather. With a table full of dishes (coral grouper, crispy roast pork, shrimp dumplings, roast goose, etc.), the atmosphere was wonderfully lively. Everyone raised their glasses to toast my father's birthday, and the gloom over the family completely dispelled that night.
location: Peony Room, 3rd Floor, Fung Shing Restaurant, Hau Wong Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After the dinner and driving family members home
description: The birthday banquet ended amid laughter and joy. My husband drove, and I sat in the back seat with my parents and the children. My father said softly to me, "Money is just a worldly possession; the most important thing is that the whole family stays together. From now on, you keep an eye on the money matters for me." I leaned on his shoulder and promised him I would go with him to the bank next week to handle the wealth management transfer procedures. When we got home, my mother took the children to wash up, while I sat with my father in the living room and had a few more cups of tea.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening tidying up and parent-child time
description: She briefly tidied up the leftover food and items brought back from tonight’s birthday banquet. Then she went to the children’s room and read a bedtime story to Xinxin, who had already changed into her pajamas, soothing her to sleep. Her son Xuanxuan was quietly discussing the English alphabet with his dad nearby. Looking at their sleeping faces, the fatigue of the day disappeared.
location: Children's room at home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Sharing with her husband and preparing for bed.
description: I chatted briefly with my husband, and he said, "Today was a great success, Dad was very happy." I nodded. After that, I washed up, took off my jewelry, and put on a hydrating mask. Lying in bed, I thought back on everything—from the nervousness of the morning run to the perfect dinner party—and finally felt a weight off my chest. Although the birthday feast was rich and my weight might fluctuate a little, I felt immensely satisfied.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bedroom in the family home

name: Falling asleep
description: I turned off the lights and adjusted the air conditioner temperature. In a warm, relieved, and slightly contented tiredness, I drifted off to sleep. Tomorrow would be another weekend to rest a little, but tonight, I slept especially soundly.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, bedroom in the family home

name: Wake up and make simple preparations.
description: Since her father's birthday banquet the previous evening had gone well, she felt relaxed and woke up naturally on a sunny Saturday. She changed into neon-green running shoes and a fitted workout set, drank a few sips of warm water, and prepared for her morning run.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home, master bedroom

name: Jog to Kowloon Tsai Park
description: Starting from home, she jogged east along Prince Edward Road West for about 2.5 kilometers to Kowloon Tsai Park at a pace of about 6:00, taking about 15 minutes. Her heart rate rose to around 120, serving as a warm-up for the morning run.
location: Along the route from Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, to Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Weekend long slow run
description: Completed an 8 km run on the jogging trail in Kowloon Tsai Park at a 5:50 pace, taking about 50 minutes, with heart rate kept in the aerobic zone at 140-150. After the run, stretched for 10 minutes to relax the front and back of the thighs and the calves.
location: Jogging Trail, Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Walk to Maxim's Cakes
description: Walked along Junction Road for about 12 minutes to Maxim's Cakes at Lok Fu Plaza, passing the market and smelling the aroma of breakfast, and prepared to buy breakfast.
location: Along the route walking from Kowloon Tsai Park to Lok Fu Plaza.

name: Breakfast grocery shopping
description: At Maxim's Cakes, she bought four freshly baked pineapple buns, a loaf of wheat bread, and two cartons of fresh milk, and got an egg tart for her mother. Then she walked about 12 minutes home.
location: Shop 5, LOF, MTR Lok Fu Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Maxim's Cakes (Lok Fu Plaza store)

name: Walk home
description: Walked back from Lok Fu Plaza to Whampoa Garden, greeted the community security guard, and carried breakfast home.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Enjoying a warm breakfast with family
description: Her mother had already cooked white congee, and the children had just been woken up. Yu Xiaowei put the bread and milk she had bought on the dining table. The whole family sat around having breakfast, listening to the children talk about their cleaning plans. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Whole family pitched in for a thorough cleaning
description: After breakfast, the family started a big cleaning. Yu Xiaowei took down and washed the old curtains in the living room and dining room and wiped the window frames; her husband Zhang Weiming cleaned the windows with an extendable window cleaner; her son Zhang Zixuan cleared out the shoe cabinet and discarded old shoes; her daughter Zhang Yuxin and her grandmother sorted out clothes for the season and put them into storage boxes. Finally, the whole family brought the Christmas tree and decoration boxes out of the storage room.
location: Various rooms and storage rooms at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Light lunch and a short rest
description: Mother made Chinese yam and lean pork soup and cooked wonton noodles. The family had lunch while watching the midday news. Yu Xiaowei used her phone to note the list of items needed for the park in the afternoon: a football, a picnic mat, snacks, a water bottle, and a business card holder.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch break and itinerary confirmation
description: Took a 30-minute nap on the living room sofa. After waking up, sent a WhatsApp message to the mother of her son's classmate Zhao Zicong, confirming the meeting at 2 p.m. on the big lawn at Kowloon Tsai Park, and reminding her to bring water and a change of clothes. Then brainstormed entry points for the topic of "childhood sports injuries" and selling points for accident insurance.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Heading to the park
description: Bringing a soccer ball, a picnic mat, and a backpack with a filled water bottle, I walked with my son to the large lawn at Kowloon Tsai Park, telling him to take care of his classmates and pay attention to safety.
location: Along the route from Whampoa Garden to Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Park accompaniment and client development.
description: Arrived at the park lawn 15 minutes early; the children were playing football. Yu Xiaowei chatted with Zhao Zicong's mother on a bench, and the conversation naturally turned to sports injuries. She shared an accident insurance claim case, which sparked the other's interest. She also got to know the neighbor Mrs. Zhao. Both mothers showed a need for children's accident insurance, left their contact information, and agreed to work out a detailed plan next week.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park Lawn, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Walk home
description: Packed up the picnic mat and football, and walked back to Whampoa Garden with her son. Her son excitedly talked about the goal he scored, and Yu Xiaowei smiled and responded, mentally planning to record the new client information.
location: Along the walk from Kowloon Tsai Park back to Whampoa Garden

name: Return home and tidy up with the children.
description: After arriving home, she had her son take a bath and change clothes, and she washed and hung out the sports bottle and picnic mat. Then, in the living room, she recorded the contact information of two prospective clients in the client follow-up table and added the note "Children's accident insurance — focus on sports risks."
location: Bathroom and living room of the home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner time
description: Her husband helped bring out the dishes and set the table. Dinner included steamed dace, stir-fried choy sum, and baked pork chop rice. The children vied to talk about scoring goals in soccer, her husband shared tips on cleaning windows, and Yu Xiaowei casually mentioned that she had a nice chat with a few mothers in the afternoon.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assisted with tidying up and evening preparations
description: Checked whether her son's dirty socks were in the laundry basket and helped her daughter put away the crayons and drawing paper. Then she returned to the master bedroom, took out the embroidery hoop, fabric and silver-gray embroidery thread, placed them on the small table by the window, and prepared for Cantonese embroidery creation.
location: Children's room and living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Focus on the Cantonese embroidery work 'Winter'.
description: She transferred the snow scene sketch onto the embroidery fabric, tightened the embroidery hoop, and selected fine silver-gray silk thread. Using the flat stitch method, she patiently embroidered the outline of the first six-pointed snowflake. In two hours, she finished only a fingernail-sized area, but she was satisfied with the luster of the silk thread and the evenness of the stitches.
location: At the dressing table in the master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-night heart-to-heart with her husband
description: Husband Zhang Weiming brought back pan-fried stuffed three treasures and black sesame paste sweet soup. The two of them snuggled on the sofa sharing a late-night snack. They talked about her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng coming back to Hong Kong for the Spring Festival, and her husband suggested that his family stay in the study. Yu Xiaowei agreed and planned to tidy it up tomorrow.
location: Hong Kong SAR, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, sofa in the living room at home.

name: Personal washing and evening notes
description: After washing up, she weighed herself and recorded 53.0 kg, wrote down the day's exercise and client follow-up points in her phone memo, and browsed a few pages of a book on etiquette and communication skills.
location: Home bathroom and master bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Turned off the main bedroom light and left the bedside lamp on, checked tomorrow's to-do items, and confirmed that on Monday she would accompany her father to the bank to handle the wealth management product conversion. She then turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home, master bedroom

name: Morning home routine
description: At 5:45 a.m., Yu Xiaowei woke up filled with anticipation. After taking deep breaths in bed, she spread out the yoga mat at the foot of the bed and did a 10-minute gentle sun salutation and neck-shoulder stretch, then drank the warm water from her thermos. Then she washed up, changed into loungewear, and went to the kitchen to have a simple breakfast with her mother Chen Meiling: Hong Kong-style milk tea and pineapple bun. Afterwards, in the study, she sorted and put away client files, making room for her younger brother to come back during the Spring Festival. Then she opened the large canvas bag prepared for the afternoon sharing class, checked one by one the 12 practice cloths, small embroidery frames, silk threads, and the embroidered works "Peony Painting" and "Spring", and put in a thermos bottle and throat lozenges. Leaving the study, she interacted with her husband Zhang Weiming, son Zhang Zixuan, and daughter Zhang Yuxin in the living room: she reminded Xuanxuan to arrange his weekend homework, hugged Xinxin who had just woken up and said she would be an "embroidery teacher" in the afternoon, and when her husband asked if she needed a ride, she politely declined, saying she would first go shopping at the street market and then walk to the community center.
location: Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Buy dinner ingredients at Kowloon City Market
description: Yu Xiaowei changed into going-out clothes, picked up a reusable shopping bag, and walked about 17 minutes from home to Kowloon City Market. She wove through the bustling stalls and selected a Qingyuan chicken, a few fresh pomfrets, a bunch of choi sum, and seasonal fruit. At the checkout, she noticed an insurance flyer next to a stall and recalled the child accident insurance her neighbor had mentioned last night. She jotted down the lead in her phone memo and planned to follow up next week.
location: Kowloon City Market, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meet He Meiling for breakfast and head to the community center
description: Yu Xiaowei carried the ingredients to the 3rd floor of the Kowloon City Market Cooked Food Centre, where she met up with her embroidery friend He Meiling, who had come from Shenzhen. The two sat in their usual spot and ordered pan-fried stuffed three treasures and boat congee. While eating, they discussed the division of work for the afternoon sharing class: Yu Xiaowei would be in charge of the lecture and demonstration, and He Meiling would help distribute materials and guide the participants. After breakfast, they first stored the ingredients in the refrigerator of the small kitchen in the community center, then walked together to the activity room on the third floor of the Kowloon City Community Centre at 102 Junction Road, exchanging potential problems along the way.
location: Cooked Food Centre, Kowloon City Market, 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Set up the venue for the Cantonese embroidery sharing class
description: Yu Xiaowei and He Meiling arrived at the activity room on the third floor of Kowloon City Community Centre and began setting up the venue. They arranged 12 long tables in a U shape. He Meiling placed an embroidery kit and a pack of tissues at each seat, and Yu Xiaowei fixed embroidered pieces such as the "Peony Painting" onto the wall with residue-free tape to create a small exhibition. They turned on the projector, adjusted the display, and played clips from a documentary on the history of Cantonese embroidery on a loop. The room was filled with an artistic atmosphere.
location: Activity room, 3rd floor, Kowloon City Community Centre, 102 Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Return home to rest, lunch, and pre-class preparation
description: After finishing the arrangements, Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to He Meiling and walked home. After arriving home, she put the ingredients she had bought in the morning into the refrigerator. Her mother Chen Meiling had already cooked noodles, and Yu Xiaowei took a few bites. Her daughter Zhang Yuxin ran over and asked if she could go in the afternoon; Yu Xiaowei agreed to let her go with her grandmother to be a little teaching assistant. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's weekend homework and patiently explained math problems. Then she went back to the bedroom, changed into a comfortable cotton-linen shirt, put on light makeup, gave herself an encouraging smile in the mirror, picked up her big canvas tote bag, and prepared to leave.
location: Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Arriving early for setup and pre-class check-in and chatting
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the classroom 15 minutes early, checked the projector and PPT again, and placed her thermos and throat lozenges beside the podium. When an early student arrived, she warmly guided her to a seat and asked about her reasons for wanting to learn Cantonese embroidery. Then the other students gradually arrived, including seniors and parents with children. Her embroidery friend He Meiling helped guide sign-ins. Yu Xiaowei felt excited when she saw her mentor, Teacher Wu Xiuying, sitting quietly in the back row. Before class, she chatted with the older students about their childhood memories of watching elders embroider, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Activity room, 3rd floor, Kowloon City Community Centre, 102 Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Host an introductory Cantonese embroidery sharing class
description: The sharing class officially began. Yu Xiaowei vividly explained, in Cantonese, the hundred-year history of Cantonese embroidery and the cultural background of Lingnan, accompanied by projected photos and real objects. She demonstrated the difference between the even stitch and the layered stitch, walked off the podium, and taught participants hands-on how to split a silk thread into two strands, and provided snowflake pattern drafts for practice. The class was filled with laughter and cheerful voices; participants included silver-haired elderly women, young parents, and children. The children also quietly threaded needles and stitched. Family members (her husband Zhang Weiming, children, and mother Chen Meiling) came to support her, creating a warm scene.
location: Activity room, 3rd floor, Kowloon City Community Centre, 102 Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Received the studio key and registered for the crafts exhibition.
description: At the end of the class, Yu Xiaowei invited Teacher Wu Xiuying to the stage. Teacher Wu said with emotion, “Xiaowei, I have seen your skill and enthusiasm.” She then took a brass key from her pocket and handed it to Yu Xiaowei in front of everyone: “This key is the access key to my old studio in Sham Shui Po. From now on, it will be your creative base.” The audience broke into thunderous applause. Yu Xiaowei's eyes welled up, and she accepted it with a choked voice. Teacher Wu then handed her the registration form for the March 2026 Traditional Crafts Exhibition and urged her to complete the “Winter” series as soon as possible. Yu Xiaowei solemnly filled in her name and made a promise.
location: Activity room, 3rd floor, Kowloon City Community Centre, 102 Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: After-class discussion and venue cleanup
description: After class, the students gathered around to congratulate Yu Xiaowei and take photos. Yu Xiaowei briefly talked with Teacher Wu Xiuying and He Meiling about future creative plans. Her family came over; her husband gave her a thumbs up, and the children looked proud. After the guests dispersed, Yu Xiaowei and He Meiling cleaned up the venue together and packed up the embroidery pieces. He Meiling reminded her not to forget to post on Moments tonight to celebrate.
location: Activity room, 3rd floor, Kowloon City Community Centre, 102 Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Walk home and take a rest upon arrival.
description: The family walked out of the community center as the sun was setting. Xuanxuan and Xinxin were chasing each other and playing in front, and her husband Weiming took Yu Xiaowei's hand and softly praised her. They walked back to their home at Whampoa Garden, where her mother Chen Meiling had already prepared the ingredients for dinner. Yu Xiaowei changed into slippers and sat down on the sofa. Her daughter Xinxin climbed onto her lap and said, 'Mommy is an embroidery superhero.' Yu Xiaowei kissed her forehead. Her son ran back to his room to do homework.
location: Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the streets along the way

name: Family celebration dinner
description: Yu Xiaowei prepared dinner with her mother. She made her signature ginger-and-scallion chicken and steamed pomfret. Her father Yu Guoqiang was full of praise, talked about his younger days learning a craft, and encouraged Xiaowei to work hard now that she had a studio. At the table, everyone raised their glasses to celebrate the success of today's sharing class and the acquisition of the studio. The atmosphere was especially warm.
location: Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tutoring children and family chores
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei checked her son Zhang Zixuan's Chinese sentence-making homework, and drew a simple drawing titled Mom's Embroidery Class with her daughter Zhang Yuxin, guiding her to draw the snowflake patterns from class with crayons. Her husband Zhang Weiming helped clear the dishes and prepared bath water for their daughter.
location: Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Edit and publish a social media post
description: After the children quieted down, Yu Xiaowei returned to her study, opened her phone, and selected today's nine-grid photos: a panoramic view of the classroom, a close-up of Teacher Wu handing over the key, the solemn moment of filling out the registration form, and a family group photo. She did some light color adjustment with a photo editing app and posted them on Instagram and WeChat Moments, with a caption thanking Teacher Wu for her trust and expressing her determination to carry forward Cantonese embroidery, with the goal of the 2026 craft exhibition.
location: Study, Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Creating the embroidery work 'Winter'
description: Likes and blessings kept coming on Moments, but Yu Xiaowei did not get caught up in them. She took out her embroidery piece Winter, threaded a silver-gray silk thread, and under the light, using stitching given a new sense of purpose, focused on embroidering the first snowflake. She felt her stitches were especially steady, as if the silk thread connected to the future. This hour left her calm and full of strength.
location: Study, Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's late-night conversation and future planning
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the bedroom, where her husband Zhang Weiming was leaning against the headboard reading a book. She lay down beside him and talked about what Teacher Wu had told her today, especially the urgency of finishing "Winter" before March. She mentioned that next Tuesday she would accompany her father to the bank to handle a wealth management product conversion, and her husband said he would leave work early to pick up the children. The two also discussed arrangements for her younger brother's return during the Spring Festival. Yu Xiaowei felt satisfied with the day.
location: Bedroom, Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Washing up, meditating, and going to sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei was still reluctant to end the day, but she got up to wash up and apply moisturizer. Lying under the covers, she replayed the moment she received the key in her mind and smiled. She had taken more than 10,000 steps today, and although she had no systematic training, she felt full of energy. She closed her eyes and did five minutes of meditation to calm her mood, then softly said to herself, 'Good night, Xiaowei, you did very well.' She fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Block 9, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning refreshment and morning preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowei spent 5 minutes in bed doing Cat-Cow and Child's Pose stretches to relieve the tightness in her neck and shoulders. After washing up quickly, she changed into business casual and went to the kitchen. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was preparing breakfast for the children. Yu Xiaowei made herself a cup of instant coffee, ate two slices of whole wheat toast, and chatted with her mother about last night's embroidery progress; they decided to tackle the withered tree texture that evening. Her mother reminded her to call her father to confirm tomorrow's bank appointment.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Taking the children to school
description: Yu Xiaowei first drove her son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, reminding him along the way to drink plenty of water during PE class. After watching him walk into the school at the gate, she walked 10 minutes to Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten to drop off her daughter Zhang Yuxin. She said goodbye to her daughter, and the teacher welcomed her into the classroom. She left only after watching her daughter skip happily inside.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Commute
description: Walked from the kindergarten to Mong Kok East Station, passing a bakery and buying a tuna bun and mineral water for a morning snack. Took the East Rail line from Mong Kok East Station to Admiralty, then transferred to the Island line to Wan Chai. The carriage was crowded, so Yu Xiaowei stood and scrolled on her phone, replying to client messages on WeChat and browsing financial news.
location: The MTR route from Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station, and the stretch along Prince Edward Road West, Hong Kong

name: Department morning meeting
description: Arrived at the AIA Building office, greeted colleague Su Lishan, and attended the departmental morning meeting. Supervisor Liang Zhenhua summarized last week's performance and announced that there would be internal training on the new critical illness product at 3 p.m., requiring all staff to attend. As she listened, Yu Xiaowei noted down the list of clients she needed to call that morning.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Client Care Call
description: Returned to my desk, poured a glass of water, and started customer care calls. First called several older long-term clients, reminding them about the sudden temperature drop, to keep warm and watch for slippery roads, and updating them on the accident insurance claims process. The remaining calls focused on checking on clients' health and reminding them that they could book a free policy review before the end of the year. The calls were patient and professional, about 3-5 minutes each.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bank appointment and document preparation.
description: After hanging up the client call, Yu Xiaowei called the Kowloon City branch of the bank her father usually visits to confirm the appointment at 3 p.m. the next day to accompany her father through the fixed-term wealth management conversion. She received a confirmation text message. Then she ate the bread she had bought in the morning as a mid-morning snack. Afterward, she began organizing client files, printed her father's ID document, policy documents, and related wealth management product information, put them into a folder, and also prepared profile materials for several clients she could visit on the way tomorrow, reviewing their policy statuses.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and midday break
description: Had lunch with colleague Su Lishan at Shun Hing Roast Meat Cha Chaan Teng near the office. Yu Xiaowei ordered char siu and soy sauce chicken double-topped rice with iced lemon tea, while Su Lishan ordered stir-fried beef ho fun. As they ate, they chatted about their embroidery progress and tips for dealing with difficult clients. After the meal, they took a slow walk in the park near the office to digest, then bought a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea at the coffee shop in Shui On Centre, and returned to the office to rest for 20 minutes with their heads on the desk, recharging for the afternoon.
location: Shun Hing Roast Meat Cha Chaan Teng, Lockhart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; and Shui On Centre near Gloucester Road.

name: New critical illness product training
description: At 2 p.m., arrived at the training room on time. The product specialist gave a detailed breakdown of the upcoming new critical illness product, focusing on the newly added multiple cancer payouts, cardiovascular disease coverage, and premium adjustment policies. Yu Xiaowei recorded the whole session on her phone and took notes on key selling points and comparative analysis with similar market products, then participated in a case simulation exercise.
location: Training room, 14th floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Post-meeting organization and client follow-up.
description: After the training, she returned to her desk, organized her notes into electronic form, selected several existing clients who fit the scope of the new critical illness coverage, marked them as “potential consultation targets”, and wrote down initial communication ideas. Then she dealt with two work emails replying to client questions.
location: Office workstation, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After-work commute
description: After packing the bank folder and handbag she would need tomorrow, she took the MTR from Wan Chai Station, transferred at Admiralty Station, and rode to Mong Kok East Station. The train was crowded, so Yu Xiaowei stood, thinking about the color scheme and stitches for her evening embroidery.
location: Hong Kong MTR route from Wan Chai Station to Mong Kok East Station

name: Family dinner
description: After returning home, she changed into loungewear, first checked her son Xuanxuan's math homework, and patiently explained the mistake in a word problem. Then she accompanied her daughter Xinxin to play with LEGO in the living room. At 7 p.m. the whole family had dinner together; her mother had made steamed grass carp and garlic broccoli. During the meal, her father proactively brought up the 3 p.m. bank appointment tomorrow, and Yu Xiaowei told him it had been booked; her husband Zhang Weiming shared details of their son's weekend football match victory.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child interaction and household chores.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei cleared the dishes and put them in the dishwasher. Then she accompanied her daughter Xinxin to paint a watercolor picture called Winter Tree; she likes to use blue and white. At the same time, she urged her son Xuanxuan to pack his schoolbag for the next day and check the materials needed for art class.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Embroidery Time
description: After the children washed up, her husband and mother put them to bed. Yu Xiaowei went to the study, set up the LED eye-protecting lamp, spread out the embroidery frame, and focused on tackling the snow-bent withered tree trunk in the upper right corner of the 'Winter' embroidery piece. She tried splitting dark brown and dark grey silk threads into different numbers of strands, and finally settled on using two thick strands together with one thin strand, using the overlapping stitch method to embroider layer by layer the rough texture of the trunk and the curve formed by the weight of the snow. After more than two hours, a third of the tree trunk was completed, and the layering and three-dimensional effect were better than expected.
location: Study room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: A tender moment between the couple.
description: It was 10:15. Her husband Zhang Weiming walked into the study carrying a cup of warm chrysanthemum honey and sat quietly beside her. Yu Xiaowei put down her embroidery needle, leaned on his shoulder, and the two talked softly. Her husband mentioned that their son had scored a goal in today's soccer match. Yu Xiaowei smiled in response, feeling that their son's physical fitness had improved again. Her husband told her not to stay up too late and to go to rest first.
location: Study room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She carefully covered the embroidery frame with embroidery cloth, turned off the desk lamp, and tidied the study. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing her teeth, she looked at her slightly tired reflection in the mirror and, thinking about the important family matters she had to deal with tomorrow, decided to go to bed early.
