She changed into pajamas and lay in bed, set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow, and briefly ran through tomorrow's schedule in her mind: work in the morning, and accompany her father to the bank in the afternoon. Although her body was tired, seeing the progress on her embroidery made her feel grounded, and she soon fell asleep.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up meditation and getting ready
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up naturally at 6 a.m. Feeling slight stomach discomfort, she skipped yoga and did 15 minutes of abdominal breathing meditation in bed to calm her thoughts and prepare for her performance review day. Then from 6:15 to 6:50, she took a quick warm shower to refresh herself, changed into a dark blue professional suit and low-heeled leather shoes, put on light makeup, and checked her briefcase for the laptop, a backup USB drive with the performance review PPT, a business card holder, and a power bank. At the same time, she sent a message to her husband Zhang Weiming to confirm the division of school drop-off duties.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the children to school.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming took the children to school together. They first took their daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Kindergarten. Yu Xiaowei got out of the car and walked with her to the school gate, watched her say good morning to the teacher, and told her to listen carefully in class. Then they took their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. From the car, she watched him walk into the school gate and reminded him to bring his science class materials.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District, and Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, 1 Tin Fu Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District

name: Commute and breakfast
description: After dropping off the children, her husband let Yu Xiaowei off on Mong Kok Road. She first ordered a takeaway pineapple bun and iced lemon tea at Dafa Restaurant, then took the MTR East Rail Line from Mong Kok East Station to Admiralty Station, and transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she ate breakfast while silently rehearsing her debriefing speech, especially the candid statement about the Shenzhen business mistake.
location: Da Fa Restaurant (27 Man Yue Street, Kowloon City District) and MTR Journey

name: Morning meeting preparation and final review before the performance report.
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at the AIA Building office at 8:20 a.m. She first drank a glass of warm water in the pantry to calm herself. After attending the department's routine morning meeting, she returned to her desk, opened the PPT for final enrichment and checking, focusing her energy on analyzing the conversion data of the 'Employee Loyalty Program' and the cost-benefit comparison for expanding into the Shenzhen market. At 9:45, she tidied herself up in advance, took a deep breath, and headed to Liang Zhenhua's office with her laptop and notebook.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Year-end performance review, decision-making, and communication of strategic adjustments
description: Yu Xiaowei entered Liang Zhenhua's office on time for her year-end performance review. Using a PPT, she presented the team's annual results: achieved 112% of the annual target, but ranked fourth in the region. She proactively listed three shortcomings in the Shenzhen business layout and the risk of internal client attrition. Liang Zhenhua affirmed her execution ability, but pointed out that promotion to regional manager would require observing more sustained, in-depth performance, and was expected to be delayed until June or July next year. After the review, Yu Xiaowei sat alone in the small meeting room to calmly analyze the situation. She decided to suspend Shenzhen business expansion, pull all resources back to Hong Kong, and deeply cultivate the mid-to-high-end market. She then sent a long message to Shenzhen client Wang Qiming explaining the adjustment and apologizing, and met with team newcomer Lu Weijie in the company break area to convey the adjusted direction of business focus.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch with colleague Su Lishan.
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowei had lunch with her good partner Su Lishan at Xingyue Tea Restaurant near the company. She ordered a shrimp wonton noodle soup and a hot milk tea. During the meal, she only vaguely mentioned, "Brother Hua wants us to settle down and reflect a bit more," and revealed that she would refocus on the local market. Su Lishan expressed understanding and shared updates on several local clients she was handling.
location: Star Moon Cafe, 241 Lockhart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Communicated with new team members and handled emails.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei returned to the office and found new hire Lu Weijie in the break area. She briefly conveyed the business focus adjustment: all client development resources should shift toward Hong Kong locals, while follow-up leads in Shenzhen should be put on hold. She also asked him to organize his existing list of potential Hong Kong clients and prepare a visit plan. After that, she went back to her desk and spent half an hour quickly clearing the backlog of routine emails.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Assisted father with banking matters and shopping at Kowloon City Market
description: At 2:10 PM, Yu Xiaowei left the company, took the MTR to Mong Kok East Station, and walked to the Bank of Communications Kowloon Branch. She assisted her father Yu Guoqiang in communicating with the wealth management manager in the VIP room and completed the signing of the wealth management product conversion documents. After finishing, she parted with her father at the MTR station entrance and walked to Kowloon City Market, where she bought her mother's favorite crispy roast pork belly and the children's favorite honey-glazed char siu at Yongxing Roast Meat Shop, and also picked fresh choy sum at the vegetable stall. She deliberately went during the after-3 PM period to avoid the crowds.
location: Bank of Communications (Hong Kong) (Kowloon Branch), No. 318 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and Kowloon City Market Cooked Food Centre, No. 100 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District

name: Time at home to rest and help the children with their studies.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked home carrying roast meat and vegetables in one hand, handed the dinner ingredients to her mother Chen Meiling, chatted briefly with her, and said she wanted stir-fried greens for dinner. Then she went to her room, changed into comfortable loungewear, and put away the paperwork completed at the bank. Afterward, she went to the study to help her son Zhang Zixuan finish his math homework, listening to him excitedly talk about the school football team tryouts and encouraging him to go for it. Then she sat with her daughter Zhang Yuxin while she drew 'the roast goose we had for dinner' with colored pens, enjoying quiet parent-child time. She occasionally replied to work WeChat messages, but tried to stay focused on her children.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: At 6 p.m., her mother had already cut and plated the roasted pork and char siu, stir-fried choy sum, and made tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the table together. Yu Xiaowei was in a relaxed mood, proactively put food on her father's plate, and said nothing about work setbacks, instead listening attentively as the children shared funny school stories. Her husband also told an amusing story about repairing an air conditioner that day.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening relaxation and a phone call to check on Father
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowei proactively cleared the dishes and took them to the kitchen. When she was done, she called her father Yu Guoqiang to ask about his health. Her father happily said that he had won another game of Chinese chess against Uncle Chen downstairs. Afterward, the children and her husband watched cartoons in the living room. She went to the study, played music on her phone, took out the embroidery piece 'Winter,' and quietly stitched a few strokes of the withered tree's branches. Her mind had become completely calm.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening parent-child time, couple time, and getting ready for bed
description: At 8:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei read picture books with her daughter and, together with her husband, coaxed her to sleep. At 9 o'clock she chatted with her son, listened to him talk about the school football team, and tucked him in. Afterwards, she drank milk and talked with her husband in the living room, mentioning her work decision lightly; her husband understood and supported it. Then Yu Xiaowei washed up, changed into her pajamas, adjusted her to-do items on her phone, crossed off 'Shenzhen follow-up', added 'Next Monday: organize the list of local high-end clients', and went to bed at 22:30.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Wake-up and skincare routine
description: At 6:20 a.m. the alarm went off. When Yu Xiaowei got up, she felt the light red patches on her right cheek and elbow were still slightly itchy, and the rash was obvious. She washed her face with warm water, stopped using her usual exfoliating facial cleanser, and switched to Cetaphil moisturizing cream, applying it carefully. She decided to drink more water today, and if it had not improved by evening, she would book an appointment with a dermatologist next week.
location: Home bathroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take the children to school.
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming had prepared breakfast, and the two quickly divided the tasks. Yu Xiaowei walked their son Zhang Zixuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. On the way, she reminded her son to remember to hand in his science model homework, and they agreed that grandma would pick him up after school. After sending off her son, she walked about 10 minutes more to take her daughter Zhang Yuxin to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, and agreed with her daughter that grandma would pick her up tonight and mom would be home later.
location: From 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Tim Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong, and then to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai.

name: Commuting to work
description: It takes about 5 minutes to walk from the kindergarten to Mong Kok East Station, about 25 minutes by MTR to Wan Chai Station, and then about 8 minutes on foot to AIA Building. On the train, she put on earphones, browsed financial news, and planned today's key tasks.
location: MTR from Mong Kok East Station to Wan Chai Station, finally arriving at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District

name: Arrival at work and preparation before the morning meeting.
description: She arrived at the office at 8:25. First she checked the agenda for the regional morning meeting she needed to attend in the afternoon, then opened her computer to check emails and whether there were any newly approved cases in the system, while also reconfirming the financial operation procedures to be handled today.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Department morning meeting and year-end bonus credited
description: Attended the department morning meeting, centered on reviewing each team's last-quarter performance and new-quarter goals. She listened carefully to Regional Director Liang Zhenhua's remarks, and after the report, she became more determined in her idea to suspend the Shenzhen business and focus on the local market. During a break in the morning meeting, she took out her phone and happened to receive a bank notification: the year-end bonus of 50,000 yuan and December salary of 8,000 yuan had arrived. She quickly took a screenshot and saved it. Looking at her account balance, she felt somewhat comforted and prepared for the next financial move.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, 10th-floor meeting room and workstation, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road

name: Emergency reserve transfer and final balance payment
description: She opened the banking app and first transferred 20,000 yuan to the family emergency reserve account, bringing the balance from 80,000 to 100,000 and reaching the goal she had always aimed for. Then she paid the final 10,000 yuan to the merchant from whom she had bought the massage chair in May, and confirmed that the merchant had sent the electronic receipt to her email.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family finance sync
description: In the bookkeeping app, she recorded income and expenses in detail and noted that 5,000 yuan for her daughter's ballet class renewal and 3,000 yuan for her son's football class needed to be set aside. She then sent a voice message to her husband Zhang Weiming via WeChat, clearly informing him of the day's fund allocation and reminding him that an insurance part-time commission would be credited at the end of the month, so there was no need to worry about household expenses.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Drafted team client reporting and follow-up guidelines.
description: She threw herself into work, first studying the template given by Liang Zhenhua the day before yesterday, then, based on the realities of the local Hong Kong market, began writing a three-page 'Team Client Registration and Follow-up Guidelines'. Core clauses included reporting new clients to the team's shared client pool within 24 hours, updating follow-up logs before every Friday, and cross-team secondment requiring approval from both supervisors. Around 11 o'clock in the middle of the session, she got up to get water in the pantry and did a few deep breaths by the glass window to relax her shoulders and neck.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Wrapping up work and preparing lunch.
description: Saved the document and sent a draft to her own email as a backup. Colleague Su Lishan messaged asking what to eat for lunch, and she replied, 'The usual place? My treat, I want to talk about something.' Then she tidied her desk, grabbed her coat, and got ready to leave.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: The two sat down in a corner of Shun Hing Roast Meats Cha Chaan Teng and ordered char siu and soy sauce chicken rice and iced lemon tea. Yu Xiaowei quietly shared with Su Lishan her idea of pausing the Shenzhen business and focusing on the local market. Shanshan agreed and reminded her that there was a high-end client appreciation event in the local area next week that would need her help. The two chatted while eating, in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Shun Hing Roast Meat Tea Restaurant, 5 Anton Street, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Refine and finalize team standards.
description: After lunch, she returned to her workstation and used the focused time after the lunch break to continue improving the document. She added details such as 'violation handling' and 'procedures for receiving out-of-town clients', and polished some clauses with clearer language. At 15:30, after confirming that the content was correct, she sent the final version to Liang Zhenhua and copied the team email, waiting for approval.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Follow up with clients and organize files
description: Started dealing with the backlog: made callbacks to two long-standing local clients to confirm their policy renewal reminders for next month; created a new Excel spreadsheet in the system to organize the list of local high-end clients, planning to start moving forward with it next Monday.
location: Workstation, 10th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Prepare and purchase sharing items before the end of the workday
description: After tidying up her workstation, she went to the convenience store in Exhibition Plaza downstairs and bought two boxes of premium handmade cookies and several packs of flower tea, planning to take them to the studio to share tonight. Then she sent a WeChat message to her husband, telling him that she was going to Teacher Wu's place tonight and might not be back until 11, and asked him to put the children to bed first. Her husband replied instantly, "Got it. Take care on the road."
location: Convenience store, Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to Sham Shui Po
description: She took the MTR from Wan Chai Station and arrived at Sham Shui Po Station about 25 minutes later. There were not many people in the carriage, so she sat by the window, closed her eyes to rest, and relaxed her nerves, which had been tense from working long hours.
location: MTR Wan Chai Station to Sham Shui Po Station

name: Buying pastries and arriving at Ms. Wu's studio
description: After getting off the station, I walked about 5 minutes, detoured to the Baoshifu Bakery at the intersection, and bought two boxes of seaweed pork floss mini cakes. Then I walked about 8 minutes to Teacher Wu Xiuying’s studio on Lai Chi Kok Road. The door was not tightly shut, with warm light and a faint smell of embroidery thread seeping out.
location: Bao Shifu Bakery, Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, then to Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio, Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District

name: Pre-class preparation and small talk
description: Pushing the door open, Teacher Wu was organizing embroidery threads. She greeted her with a smile and placed the pastries on the table. The two exchanged brief pleasantries. When Teacher Wu heard that she had a red rash on her face, she said with concern, "Your skin is delicate in winter; use more lanolin ointment." Calmly, Teacher Wu took out an embroidery hoop embroidered with withered tree branches and prepared for tonight's theme—snowflakes.
location: Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio, Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Learning the snowflake stitch technique.
description: Teacher Wu sat down in front of the embroidery frame and began to teach the "snowflake spreading stitch method": lay white silk thread in irregular, very short stitches, then use light blue thread to cover it unevenly from above, creating a fluffy snowflake effect. She took serious notes, immediately removed the old thread to try it, and Teacher Wu guided her hand by hand to adjust the stitch spacing and force. Gradually she got the feel of it.
location: Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio, Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Practicing new stitching techniques late at night
description: Teacher Wu went to the next room for tea, leaving her to practice on her own. She practiced intently in a corner of the embroidery cloth, over and over, gradually becoming more skilled and her stitches more even. She was so focused that she forgot the time; when she looked up at the clock, it was already 22:30. Finally, she embroidered a sparkling three-dimensional snowflake about 2 cm in diameter and couldn't help smiling. Teacher Wu came over, patted her shoulder with satisfaction, and said, “Xiaowei, you've got it!” As she packed up her tools, her fingers trembled slightly from holding the needle for so long, but she felt deeply satisfied.
location: Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio, Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home
description: Said goodbye to Teacher Wu and said she would come again next time to continue learning. Walked to Sham Shui Po MTR Station, took the MTR back to Kowloon City, and arrived home at 22:45. The living room lights were already off; only the small night light in the bedroom was still on.
location: From Teacher Wu Xiuying's studio on Lai Chi Kok Road, Sham Shui Po District, to Whampoa Garden residential estate at 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: She washed up quietly and noticed the spots on her face seemed to have faded a little. Lying in bed, though her body was tired, her mind was full of the image of snowflakes blooming tonight, and she felt happy. She softly said goodnight to her sleeping husband, set her alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, and fell asleep with a satisfied smile.
location: At home, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off. The sky was overcast with rain. After getting up, Yu Xiaowei washed up, checked her rash, applied Cetaphil moisturizer, and did some simple stretching. Then she woke her daughter Zhang Yuxin and helped her change into her school uniform, and urged her son Zhang Zixuan to get up and check his school bag. Mother had already prepared breakfast, and the family ate white congee, fried eggs, and char siu bao together. She reminded her son to wear his school jacket and helped her daughter finish her milk, getting everything ready for the day ahead.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take son to school
description: Yu Xiaowei held an umbrella and held the hand of her son Zhang Zixuan, who was wearing a raincoat, as they walked to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School. On the way, in the light rain, the road was slippery, and she reminded her son to be careful. At the school gate, she watched him put on his mask properly, greet a teacher, and enter the school before she left reassured.
location: Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, 1-3 Oxford Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Take her daughter to kindergarten.
description: After dropping off her son, Yu Xiaowei hurried home to pick up her daughter Zhang Yuxin, and the mother and daughter walked to Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten sharing one transparent umbrella. She adjusted her daughter's collar, talked with the teacher about how her daughter had been in a good mood while drawing the night before, and then watched her daughter go into the kindergarten.
location: Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organize father's documents and call the bank to confirm the appointment
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Yu Xiaowei dried off the rain, walked into her father's study, took out the bound fund holdings list and a copy of her father's identity document, checked the date and signature on the list, and put them into a document folder. Then she called the bank manager Li Guodong, confirmed the meeting at 10:00 a.m. tomorrow in the VIP room of the Mong Kok branch, reminded him that she would bring documents for both parents, and noted the reminder on her phone.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute to the office and morning preparation
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her backpack and walked with an umbrella to Mong Kok East Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Kowloon Tong, and transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the way, she used the mobile banking app to confirm tomorrow's meeting address. After exiting the station, she bought water at the convenience store downstairs from the office, went upstairs to brew hot tea to ward off the cold, dealt with clients' year-end policy review emails, and marked to-dos in the calendar.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Department morning meeting
description: Yu Xiaowei attended the weekly Thursday team morning meeting. Her supervisor Hua Ge reviewed last week's performance and announced the new incentive plan. After the meeting, she agreed with Su Lishan and new colleague Li Xiaoming to discuss the client reporting process in the small meeting room at 10:30.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, No. 138 Gloucester Road, AIA Building, meeting room

name: Revise the draft of the customer registration process
description: After returning to her desk, Yu Xiaowei pulled up the draft of the "Team Client Reporting and Follow-up Guidelines" she had sent to her supervisor the day before. Based on the latest updates from the morning meeting, she made final refinements to the cross-team client information synchronization clause, outlined the meeting agenda, and printed three hard copies of the materials.
location: Workstation at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Team meeting finalizing client protection procedures
description: Yu Xiaowei chaired a small three-person meeting and presented the process draft. Su Lishan suggested refining the penalty rules for violations, and Li Xiaoming added a cross-team referral reward mechanism. After discussion, she revised and confirmed the draft on the spot with a red pen, took a photo, sent it to the group, and announced it was finalized.
location: Small Meeting Room 2, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organized meeting minutes
description: Back at her desk, Yu Xiaowei organized the meeting discussion and finalized content into formal electronic minutes, clarified the execution date and division of responsibilities, and planned to send it to her supervisor for review before tomorrow's morning meeting.
location: Workstation at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan walked to Po Wah Cafe at Shui On Centre, ordered curry beef brisket rice and iced lemon tea. As they ate and chatted, the conversation moved from the meeting to the claims case Su Lishan was handling, and Yu Xiaowei gave handling suggestions.
location: Baohua Restaurant, 1st Floor, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare materials for client meeting
description: Back in the office, Yu Xiaowei pulled up the files of the afternoon's newlywed couple and focused on reviewing the clause on honest disclosure regarding breast lobular hyperplasia. She marked key pages in the "Jia Yu Zhi Zhi Bao" plan document and rehearsed possible questions the client might ask.
location: Workstation at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meeting with newlywed clients.
description: A young couple arrived as scheduled. Yu Xiaowei warmly received them. After exchanging pleasantries about their newlywed life, she got down to business and explained in detail the concept of critical illness insurance and the coverage of the Jia Yu Zhi Zhi Bao policy. Regarding the woman's breast lobular hyperplasia, she took out the prepared documents and carefully explained the application and underwriting process. The clients expressed their thanks and agreed to a medical examination next week.
location: Small meeting room, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Entering client information and handling administrative affairs.
description: After the client left, Yu Xiaowei updated the meeting record in the CRM system, created a new client file, scanned the signed insurance application draft, and marked “follow up on medical exam results next week” on her to-do list. In between, she handled the backlog of administrative tasks.
location: Workstation at AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Left work early to go home and spend time with family.
description: Yu Xiaowei knocked off early, said goodbye to her colleagues, and walked with an umbrella to Wan Chai MTR station, then took the MTR to commute home, about 6,000 steps, listening to instrumental music to relax on the way. After arriving home, she changed into loungewear and chatted with her mother, who was preparing ingredients in the kitchen, and learned that there was her favorite cured meat glutinous rice. She then sat in the living room to help her daughter finish a watercolor painting, and the mother and daughter laughed happily.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying children in learning and play
description: After her son came home from school, Yu Xiaowei checked his homework, pointed out math errors and explained them. Then she read two picture books with her daughter, "The Very Hungry Caterpillar" and "Guess How Much I Love You," encouraging her to describe the pictures. After that, she played the board game Monopoly with her son for 15 minutes, and the mother and son laughed and joked endlessly over building hotels.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family sat around the table, enjoying glutinous rice with cured meat, stir-fried choy sum, and lotus root and pork rib soup. Yu Xiaowei shared with her husband the achievement of finalizing the team process, praised her son's performance in the football match, and her mother and husband also chatted about amusing daytime events. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening skincare and gratitude meditation.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After meditating, she applied another layer of moisturizer to her cheeks and elbows, set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning, set aside time for bank preparations, placed the folder by the door, and charged her phone.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off the bedside lamp and wrapped the blanket tightly around herself. There was an occasional sound of rain outside the window. Her weight had risen slightly to 53 kg, but she was recovering well both physically and mentally. Thinking about the bank trip the next day, she soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Prince Building, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 06:10. After getting up, Yu Xiaowei laid out her yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did a set of Sun Salutation yoga to wake up her body. Then she washed up briefly, applied moisturizer, and put on a dark gray suit jacket with an apricot knit top and low-heeled black leather shoes. When she walked into the kitchen, her mother Chen Meiling was already cooking plain congee and stir-frying greens. Yu Xiaowei helped fry eggs and bring out side dishes. The children came out sleepy-eyed, and she urged them to brush their teeth and wash their faces. The family sat around the dining table, and Yu Xiaowei reminded her son Xuanxuan to bring his math homework. Breakfast was simple and warm.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Took the children to school and bought breakfast on the way.
description: Husband Zhang Weiming had already left. Yu Xiaowei took the two children downstairs, first walking her son Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, reminding him to behave well at the morning assembly. Then holding her daughter Xinxin's hand, she walked along Argyle Street to take her to Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten. On the way, she bought a pineapple bun with butter and Hong Kong-style milk tea from a nearby bakery as her own breakfast.
location: Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: MTR commute and hosting the morning meeting
description: After dropping off the kids, Yu Xiaowei took the East Rail line from Kowloon Tong Station toward Admiralty, browsing the PPT “Team Client Reporting and Follow-up Procedures” on her tablet on the way. She transferred to the Tsuen Wan line at Admiralty and went to Wan Chai Station, then walked about 8 minutes to the AIA Building. In the pantry she ran into her colleague Su Lishan, handed her the printed process sheet, exchanged a few words, and they walked together to the small meeting room. During the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowei officially announced that the new rules had taken effect, stressed zero tolerance for order-stealing, Su Lishan was the first to support, newcomer Li Xiaoming reviewed the key procedures, and everyone applauded in approval.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to Mong Kok and inform father
description: After the morning meeting ended smoothly, Yu Xiaowei quickly packed up her materials and took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Mong Kok. On the train, she sent her father Yu Guoqiang a WhatsApp voice message saying she would arrive in Mong Kok around 9:40 and agreed to meet at the entrance of HSBC.
location: Mong Kok Station, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Meeting and talking with father at the bank
description: Yu Xiaowei met her father at the entrance of the HSBC branch in Mong Kok. He was wearing a neat jacket and looked a little nervous. She took his arm and comforted him in a soft voice. After they sat down in the waiting area, she took out the prepared documents and briefly explained the fund transfer process to him again.
location: HSBC Bank Mong Kok Branch, Mong Kok Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying her father to handle the wealth management switch and authorization.
description: HSBC manager Li Guodong received them in the VIP room and explained the details and fees of fund conversion in detail. Yu Xiaowei went through the items with her father one by one. Her father finally signed the Fund Conversion Application Form, converting 165,000 units of high-risk funds into money market funds, and newly opened a half-year fixed deposit of 50,000 yuan. He also signed an authorization letter allowing Yu Xiaowei to access his account. The entire process was professional and smooth.
location: VIP Room, HSBC Mong Kok Branch, Mong Kok Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing bank documents and saying goodbye.
description: After the procedures were completed, Yu Xiaowei carefully organized the bank receipt, power of attorney, and other documents into a document folder, exchanged pleasantries and thanked Manager Li Guodong, then walked out of the bank with her father.
location: HSBC Bank Mong Kok Branch, Mong Kok Road, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Had lunch with her father at a teahouse.
description: Yu Xiaowei took her father to the nearby London Restaurant for morning tea, ordering shrimp dumplings, siu mai, barbecue pork buns, and other dim sum. Her father was in a relaxed mood and voluntarily said that in the future he would ask her first before making major purchases. She smiled and served him food; the atmosphere was rarely so harmonious.
location: London Restaurant, Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: See father off and return to Kowloon City
description: After yum cha, Yu Xiaowei accompanied her father on a walk back to Mong Kok MTR station. At the ticket gate, she told him to be careful on the way, and after watching him enter the station, she turned and boarded a train in the opposite direction back to Kowloon City, getting off at Whampoa Station.
location: Mong Kok Station, Yau Tsim Mong District, to Whampoa Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Archiving documents, notifying mother, and handling work at noon
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei scanned and archived important documents such as bank receipts in the study and locked the originals in a drawer. She then used WeChat voice messages to report the morning's situation to her mother, Chen Meiling, who replied with relief. She poured a glass of warm water and rested on the sofa for 15 minutes, replied to two clients' insurance inquiries, and organized the high-end client Excel spreadsheet, listing the local long-standing clients to revisit next week.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going out to buy charity sale supplies
description: After checking her tool kit, Yu Xiaowei found it was missing the spray adhesive for fixing embroidery pieces, so she walked to Wellcome Supermarket (Yonggui Building branch) near Whampoa Garden to buy spray adhesive, and also bought mineral water, biscuits, and small snacks to refuel on the day of the charity sale.
location: Wellcome Supermarket, Yonggui Building, Huguang Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping children with homework and parent-child interaction.
description: After returning home, her son Xuanxuan had already finished school. Yu Xiaowei helped him with his math homework, focusing on fraction word problems until he fully understood them. Then her daughter Xinxin took out a watercolor pad, and Yu Xiaowei painted a picture of a little fish swimming among water plants with her. Her daughter happily showed it off.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and evening chores
description: Mother made pork bone soup with green and red radish, and Yu Xiaowei helped set the table. After her husband Zhang Weiming came home from work, the whole family sat down for dinner and shared their day's experiences. Her husband praised her for handling her father's financial matters. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter and read her bedtime stories, while her husband checked their son's homework and reminded him to brush his teeth and wash up. After the children were settled, the couple briefly talked in the living room about her father's performance at the bank.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Fully preparing works for the Cantonese embroidery charity sale
description: After the family members had gone back to their rooms one by one, Yu Xiaowei cleaned the dining table, spread a soft cloth over it, and took out three Cantonese embroidery works: "Peonies", "A Daughter's World of Spring", and "Twin Lotus Flowers". She dusted them with a soft brush and used spray adhesive to secure the loose threads at the back. Then, through a video call with her embroidery friend He Meiling, she carefully checked the price tag for each piece (ranging from HK$800 to HK$3,000), confirmed the payment QR code and the assembly method of the newly purchased portable display stand, until everything was verified.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening personal care, bedtime preparation, and going to sleep
description: After finishing work, Yu Xiaowei washed up briefly and applied a gentle moisturizer. Lying in bed, she reviewed the day's three good things: her father accepted prudent financial management, the team's new rules were implemented, and the embroidered pieces for the charity sale were ready. She felt grounded. She set her alarm for 6:30 the next morning, wrote a simple route plan for the next day in her diary, did 5 minutes of stretching in bed, then put down her phone, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The alarm went off right at 6:30, and the sunlight outside the window was just right; the morning air at 16°C was fresh. After getting up, she first did a 10-minute Sun Salutation stretch on the yoga mat in the bedroom to wake up her shoulders and neck, which were slightly stiff from preparing materials the night before. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking in the mirror, she noticed the reddish patch on her cheek caused by staying up late and stress, so she carefully applied a layer of moisturizer, silently telling herself, “Today is a big day; I have to be full of energy.”
location: In the bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family time and taking the children to school.
description: Woke up her son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin. Her husband Zhang Weiming was already in his work clothes, heating milk and bread in the kitchen. She helped her daughter Xinxin braid her favorite pigtails, then crouched down and said to her, "Mommy is going to be an embroidery superhero today, selling the beautiful embroidery Grandma taught me. I'll show you the photos when I get home tonight." Xinxin clapped happily. Her husband Zhang Weiming was responsible for taking the children to school today. He drove Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School first, then took a detour to take Xinxin to kindergarten. She waved goodbye to the children at the door.
location: Home at Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; then to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School, Kowloon City District, and Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten, 206 Argyle Street, Ma Tau Wai, Kowloon City District.

name: Commuting to the charity sale venue
description: She put on a dark blue Chinese-style button-knot jacket, slung an eco-friendly bag full of embroidery pieces and materials, and went out. She walked 5 minutes to MTR Mong Kok East Station, took the East Rail line to Kowloon Tong Station, transferred to the Kwun Tong line to Prince Edward Station, then switched to the Tsuen Wan line to Sham Shui Po Station. The whole trip took about 25 minutes. On the train, she sent He Meiling a voice message: "Meiling, I'm on the train, I'll arrive right at 8! The weather is amazing today!"
location: MTR route from 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, Fat Cheong Street, Sham Shui Po District.

name: Setting up the charity bazaar booth and preparing for the opening.
description: She arrived on time at the ground-floor lobby of Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre on Fat Tseung Street, Sham Shui Po District. He Meiling and Ms. Wu Xiuying were already there. The three worked together seamlessly: Yu and He Meiling hung up the banner for the 'Yue Embroidery Charity Sale,' moved four folding tables into an L-shaped display area, and Ms. Wu guided them in arranging the exhibited works by theme—flowers, figures, and animals—and placing the delicate creation description cards, made the night before, beside each piece. They specially framed the 'Peony Painting' and put it in the most prominent spot near the entrance, with a handwritten note about the number of silk thread layers next to it. After the display was set up, she checked the payment QR code, about 500 HKD in change, transparent tape, spray bottle, and everything else, confirming all was ready. Ms. Wu sprayed a light mist of water over a few silk-thread works to make the threads glisten under the light. Standing in the middle of the lobby, she took a deep breath, feeling the warm and friendly atmosphere of the community center—expectant and a little nervous.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: Morning charity sale explanation and interaction
description: The charity sale officially started in the morning, with viewing opened early. She took on the role of main presenter and warmly introduced the history of Yue embroidery to the neighbors as they came in. Starting with the eight characteristics of Yue embroidery—'flat, neat, fine, dense, even, smooth, harmonious, and lustrous'—she pointed to the feathers of the white dove in "Spring in My Daughter's World" and explained how to use the layering stitch to create a gradient effect. A well-dressed middle-school teacher lingered for a long time, drawn in by the vivid explanation, and took the initiative to ask whether she could invite her to give a lecture for Culture Week at her school. The two added each other on WeChat.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: Midday refueling and adjustment
description: The flow of customers slowed. She sat with He Meiling on the cardboard boxes behind the stall, taking out the two pineapple buns and a bottle of water they had brought in the morning. While munching on a pineapple bun, she looked at her phone and replied to several customer messages. He Meiling shared the funny story of having just sold a painting of Twin Lotus Flowers to a young couple, and both of them laughed. She drank a few sips of water, felt a little dry in the mouth, but her spirits remained high.
location: Rest area, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, Fat Cheong Street, Sham Shui Po District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon charity sale continues steadily.
description: She continued explaining to new visitors at the booth. A mother and her child were very interested in a small “Magpie on a Plum Branch” piece, so she threaded a needle on the spot and demonstrated how to embroider a tiny plum blossom petal with slanted stitches. The little girl was mesmerized. Seizing the moment, she encouraged her to learn the traditional craft, and the mother happily bought the piece.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: Peak crowds and interactive warm-up for the Peony Painting
description: In the afternoon, the visitor flow reached its peak. An elderly man, simply dressed and with an elegant demeanor (Uncle Chen), stopped in front of the Peony Painting and gazed at it for a long time. She took the initiative to step forward and explained softly, "For this peony, just the color of the petals alone uses more than ten different shades of red silk thread, embroidered layer upon layer to give it a three-dimensional feel." Uncle Chen nodded, did not comment immediately, and continued to examine it closely. He lightly traced his finger across the painting, his gaze deep.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: An elderly overseas Chinese buys the Peony Painting.
description: Uncle Chan stood in front of the “Peony Painting” for a full half hour. Then he took off his reading glasses and asked with reddened eyes, “How much is this painting?” She told him the price on the tag was HK$3,500. He was silent for a moment, then said in a low voice, “Young lady, when I look at it, I think of my grandmother... She used to have one like it, but it got lost later... I’ll give you HK$5,000.” The whole room fell silent at once, then burst into thunderous applause. Teacher Wu Xiuying came over, held her hand tightly, and said in an excited, trembling voice, “Xiaowei, you’ve given these threads a soul! This is how craftsmanship warms from one generation to the next! I remember you!” Excitedly, she bowed deeply and used her mobile phone to take a photo of Uncle Chan with the “Peony Painting” together.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: Closing out sales and preparing to pack up the stall.
description: The news that the Peony Painting had sold spread like wildfire and attracted more curious visitors. A few more small pieces were successfully sold, including "Twin Lotus Flowers" and "Magpie on a Plum Branch." After 4 p.m., the crowd gradually thinned, so they began preparing to close the stall with He Meiling and Teacher Wu, carefully packing up the unsold works.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: Closing up, tallying, and reviewing
description: At exactly 5 o'clock, she and He Meiling began counting the cash and checking the scan code records. Coins and banknotes were piled into small stacks on the cardboard boxes, and the two of them counted meticulously. The final total was HK$28,500. She immediately took a photo of the number with her phone and sent it to her best friend Huang Wenhui and the foundation's publicity officer. Teacher Wu packed up her tools and left first. Sitting on the cardboard boxes with He Meiling, she drank the free chrysanthemum tea provided by the community center and reviewed the day's gains and losses: which presentation worked best, what could be improved next time, and they initially agreed to do it again next year.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Fat Cheong Street, Cheung Sha Wan Community Centre, first-floor lobby

name: Tidying up at home and shopping at the street market
description: Carried the remaining works and materials home separately with He Meiling. Carrying bags of all sizes, walked five minutes to the famous Pei Ho Street Market in Sham Shui Po District, stopped at a familiar vegetable stall, and bought fresh choy sum, tomatoes, and a few apples, thinking about making a nourishing soup for the family the next day (Sunday) with green radish, carrots, and pork bones. Then dragged her tired but satisfied body back to Kowloon City by MTR.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sham Shui Po District, Pei Ho Street Market and along the way

name: Arriving home and spending time with family.
description: As soon as she entered the house, her daughter Xinxin immediately hugged her. Her mother Chen Meiling was preparing dinner in the kitchen. She first shared the day's successes with her mother, especially Uncle Chen buying 'Peony Painting' and Teacher Wu's inscription; her mother beamed with joy. Then she checked her son Xuanxuan's homework and accompanied Xinxin for a while with colored pencils, drawing the 'mother who can embroider' from Xinxin's imagination.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Father Yu Guoqiang came back from playing chess in the park downstairs, and the whole family sat around the dining table together. As they ate, he vividly recounted the day's experiences, mentioning Teacher Wu Xiuying's saying, “Only when a craft has warmth can it be passed down.” His son Xuanxuan said admiringly, “Mom is amazing,” and his daughter Xinxin clenched her little fist and said, “I want to learn embroidery too.”
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal affairs handling and insurance work
description: After dinner, she helped clear the dishes into the kitchen, then went into the study and opened her laptop. She carefully entered, item by item, today's charity sale income, expense details (such as printing and material costs, about HK$50), and the final donation amount into a dedicated Excel spreadsheet for charity activities. At the same time, she replied to a secondary school teacher's follow-up WeChat messages about the cultural week lecture at "Alliance Primary School, Kowloon Tong" and handled two client insurance inquiries.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Evening self-care
description: At the end of the day, her step count exceeded 14,000 steps. She drew a hot bath, added a few drops of soothing essential oil, and soaked for 20 minutes. Then she applied a moisturizing mask, and the tightness on her face eased considerably. Lying in bed, she did a few simple leg stretches to relieve the soreness.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Couple time and plans for tomorrow
description: After changing into loungewear, she came to the living room, and her husband Zhang Weiming handed her a cup of warm honey water. The two sat side by side on the sofa, listening to him once again tell the story of the old overseas Chinese. After discussing, they decided that tomorrow, Sunday, they wouldn't take the kids far; they would just go to the nearby Kowloon Tsai Park, let the children run on the lawn, and they could also jog a few laps to recover their strength.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening Gratitude and Reading
description: After getting into bed, she did not turn off the light right away and began a 10-minute gratitude meditation. Images of the day came to mind one by one: Uncle Chen's moist eyes, Teacher Wu's excitement, and the smiling faces of Xuanxuan and Xinxin. Her heart was filled with warmth and strength. After the meditation, she picked up 'Life Is Worth Living' from the bedside and read two chapters, feeling increasingly sleepy.
location: In the bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparations
description: She turned off the light and quietly said to herself: “Today, really great.” Thinking that tomorrow there was still a whole day to spend with family and regain energy, she fell asleep quickly with a smile.
location: In the bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. Yu Xiaowei got up, drank a glass of warm water, then went to the bathroom to wash up. She specially checked the red rash on her left arm and applied moisturizer, then changed into running shoes and quick-dry clothes. Walking out of the bedroom, her husband Zhang Weiming was preparing breakfast for the children in the kitchen. She kissed her still-sleepy daughter Zhang Yuxin and said she was going for a run. After a brief exchange with her family, she took her phone and keys and walked to Kowloon Tsai Park. Walking along Prince Edward Road West and Junction Road for about 10 minutes, the morning air was fresh and the city was just waking up.
location: At home and the surrounding roads of Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run, post-run stretching, and training planning.
description: After arriving at Kowloon Tsai Park, Yu Xiaowei set a 10 km goal on her Garmin watch at a pace of 5:30 and began a recovery morning run along the jogging trail. She kept her heart rate between 145 and 155 bpm. There were already many morning exercisers in the park, and she occasionally nodded to familiar running buddies. She completed the 10 km in about 55 minutes and switched to brisk walking to cool down. Then she walked to a lawn, spread out her yoga mat, and did 15 combined stretching moves, including Cat-Cow, Downward Dog, and Pigeon Pose, focusing on stretching the back of her thighs and the iliotibial band. After stretching, she sat on a bench and used the memo app on her phone to outline a training plan for the 2026 Standard Chartered Full Marathon, noting several key phases: a base phase starting December 29 with three 10K pace runs per week, a build phase adding interval runs and LSD, and a taper phase simulating race pace.
location: Jogging trail and lawn, Kowloon Tsai Park, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Convenience store shopping and shower care on the way home.
description: After finishing the training, Yu Xiaowei walked home from Kowloon Tsai Park. Passing the 7-Eleven on Junction Road, she bought a Schweppes lemon soda and collected member points, drinking it as she walked. After arriving home, she took a comfortable hot shower, then sat at the dressing mirror and carefully applied body lotion, putting extra ointment on the red rash on her left arm. She felt fresh all over.
location: 7-Eleven convenience store on Junction Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and home at Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District.

name: Workout data synchronization and social sharing
description: After changing into loungewear, Yu Xiaowei went to the study, opened the Garmin Connect app, and synced her running data. She carefully checked metrics such as split pace, cadence (180 spm), and vertical oscillation, and wrote in the notes field: "A long-awaited 10K; my feet still remember the way, and my form is recovering." Then she sent a screenshot of the data to two running groups. Her running buddy Shen Peiwen immediately replied with a thumbs-up emoji, saying, "Sister Xiaowei, you've still got it!" She shyly replied with an emoji.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Prepared brunch with her mother
description: Yu Xiaowei came to the kitchen, where her mother Chen Meiling was busy together with her daughter Zhang Yuxin. She tied on an apron and helped pick vegetables while chatting with her mother about the success of yesterday's charity sale. Her mother praised her, 'Well done, A Wei. This skill is a way of accumulating virtue.' She washed the lettuce and cut the tomatoes. Her mother cooked white congee, served with fried eggs, fermented tofu, and fried dough sticks. The family enjoyed a simple brunch in a warm atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Charity sale debrief phone call
description: After brunch, Yu Xiaowei returned to her study and reviewed yesterday's embroidery charity sale with He Meiling over a WeChat voice call. They discussed booth arrangement, visitor flow, and payment procedures, and preliminarily decided that next year they could add a semi-finished embroidery experience area to attract young people.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family leisure and checking son's homework.
description: In the afternoon, her son Zhang Zixuan was building with LEGO on the coffee table, while her daughter Zhang Yuxin hugged the Frozen picture book and looked at Yu Xiaowei expectantly. She asked her husband Zhang Weiming to play the DVD, and held her daughter on the sofa watching Frozen. Her daughter repeatedly sang along to "Let It Go", and she gently corrected her pronunciation. After the DVD ended, her daughter fell asleep in her mother's arms, so Yu Xiaowei checked her son's math homework. She found that two problems had the right approach but careless calculations, and patiently circled them for him to redo.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Afternoon embroidery creation
description: After the family went to take their afternoon nap, the living room fell quiet. Yu Xiaowei walked into the study, took out her Cantonese embroidery work “Winter” in progress, and stitched snowflakes one by one under the desk lamp. As the needle and thread moved, she savored what Teacher Wu had said yesterday: “Only when a craft has warmth can it be passed down.” After more than an hour of embroidery, she felt especially peaceful inside.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family outing for dinner and a walk
description: At 4 p.m., Yu Xiaowei got the whole family ready to go out. She changed into an off-white knit top and jeans, the children also put on jackets, and her husband Zhang Weiming put on his bucket hat. The family walked about 15 minutes to the Yue Wei Xuan Restaurant on Kai Tak Road and sat down at a table for four by the window. Zhang Weiming, knowing the place well, ordered pho with rare and well-done beef, shrimp spring rolls, and a Vietnamese baguette, and specially ordered a salted lemon 7-Up for her, saying, 'You just ran today, so replenish some salt.' The steaming beef pho arrived, and the family of four shared it. Their son especially liked the spring rolls, and their daughter slowly sipped the soup. After the meal, instead of going straight home, the family took a slow stroll along Kai Tak Road to help digestion. Their daughter held her father's hand and sang a newly learned nursery rhyme while their son hopped around beside them, until they walked back to their home in Whampoa Garden.
location: Yue Wei Xuan on Kai Tak Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and the surrounding streets

name: Going home to rest and spend time with father
description: When she got home, her father Yu Guoqiang was watching the Tung Wah Charity Show in the living room. Yu Xiaowei poured her father a cup of tea and chatted with him for a while. The adults rested on the sofa while the children played on the carpet.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing charity sale photos and drafting a lecture outline
description: After she relaxed, Yu Xiaowei returned to the study, opened her phone's photo album, and selected 9 wonderful photos from yesterday's charity sale, including the display photo of "Peony Painting," a group photo with Uncle Chen, a candid shot of Teacher Wu giving guidance, and a panorama of the charity sale venue. She edited the WeChat Moments post: "The warmest charity sale in winter, grateful to every person brought together by fate. Cantonese embroidery, the power of warmth." and tapped send. Then she opened her notes and created a new note titled "Ideas for next week's middle school lecture," typing keywords: "Origin of Cantonese embroidery," "Hong Kong stories in every stitch," "Reasons for perseverance," leaving room for next week's outline.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Bathing the child, telling stories, and putting them to sleep
description: Before 8 p.m., Yu Xiaowei bathed her daughter and son and changed them into pajamas. She sat by her daughter's bed reading the picture book The Little Prince, while her son Zhang Zixuan read Monsters in the Forbidden City in bed by himself. After she finished one chapter, her daughter's eyelids began to droop. She then went over to turn off her son's light and say goodnight, and only when both rooms were quiet did she gently close the door.
location: Children's room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Chatting with my husband in the living room
description: After putting the children to sleep, Yu Xiaowei went to the living room. Her husband Zhang Weiming was making tea. She took a cup of pu-erh and sat down on the sofa. They talked about how their run felt today, how their daughter sang, and mentioned that next time they could try another dish at Yueweixuan. Zhang Weiming suddenly mentioned that he planned to take his father to Wong Tai Sin Temple on his next day off, because his father had been having back pain recently. She felt warmth in her heart, sensing that her husband loved this family in his quiet way.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening skincare, gratitude meditation, and going to sleep
description: Back in the bedroom, Yu Xiaowei did her full evening skincare routine: she applied medicine to the red patch on her left arm again, put on eye cream, and applied a soothing hydrating mask. Then, by the bedside, she used an app to guide her through 15 minutes of gratitude meditation, silently thanking her body for breathing, her family for their company, and yesterday's warm encounter. After the meditation, she wrote down tomorrow's to-do list in her notebook: organize the high-end client list for Monday morning's meeting and send it to Brother Hua, reply to the WeChat message about the secondary school teachers' lecture and discuss the outline, and confirm with her husband in the evening the time to take her father to Wong Tai Sin. She closed the notebook, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of fulfillment.
location: In the bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning wake-up and skin care
description: The alarm went off. After waking, she subconsciously felt her left arm with the back of her hand; the red rash was still slightly raised, but smoother to the touch than yesterday. She carefully applied repair cream and patted it in until absorbed. She checked her phone and confirmed that today's weather would be sunny turning cloudy, with no need to carry extra rain gear. She took a deep breath to make room in her mind for today's two important matters — the donation and the confrontation.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Wake the children and prepare family breakfast
description: First went to wake Xuanxuan and Xinxin. Xuanxuan was lying in bed, so she gently patted the quilt and said, "Get up, you have to hand in homework today." Xinxin sat up on her own and rubbed her eyes; she helped her tie two pigtails. Her husband Mingzai was on the early shift today and had already left first. Her mother was busy in the kitchen, steaming turnip cake and cooking plain congee. She hastily ate two pieces of turnip cake and drank half a cup of Hong Kong-style milk tea to store up energy for the day's rush.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Dropping off kids at school and buying breakfast
description: She took the two children out holding their hands. First, she walked Xuanxuan to Kowloon Tong Government Primary School and reminded him to hand in his science homework. Then she walked Xinxin to Kowloon City Baptist Kindergarten, and Xinxin sweetly said bye-bye, Mommy. On the way back, she stopped by the New Shanghai Kitchen Hong Kong-style cafe downstairs and got a hot pineapple bun and a cup of silk-stocking milk tea to go, as breakfast for the commute.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 10 Tin Fuk Road, Kowloon Tong, Kowloon Tong Government Primary School; 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten; 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant

name: Returned home to confirm and then commuted out.
description: Back home, the first thing she did was check the donation envelope in the inner pocket of her tote bag. The cash was intact. She took a deep breath and put the bag on properly. She sent He Meiling a WeChat message: "Went to the foundation this morning, got it all done and took a photo for you guys." She immediately replied with a thumbs-up and a hug emoji. Then she walked to MTR Kowloon Tong Station, swiped her card and entered the gate.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China; MTR Kowloon Tong Station

name: Planning and reaching out during the commute
description: In the carriage she found a corner seat and took out her phone. First she opened her notes app and quickly sorted out today's work to-dos, then replied to a WeChat message from a client who had asked about high-end medical insurance yesterday. Next, she opened the MTR app and planned the fastest walking route from MTR Central Station to 3 Garden Road, Central. Finally, she sent a message to Shanshan: “I'll go to Central first this morning to run some personal errands, and I'll be back at the office by noon—we can still have lunch together?”
location: On an MTR train from Kowloon Tong Station to Central Station, Hong Kong

name: Central Foundation donation
description: Arrived at the office and stated the purpose of the visit to the receptionist. Miss Li from the finance department verified the appointment, took an envelope from her bag, and counted the cash in front of her — 28,500 Hong Kong dollars in total. On the designated donation form, she solemnly wrote down the names of Yu Xiaowei, He Meiling, and Wu Xiuying. Miss Li issued a thank-you certificate embossed with the foundation's seal and took a simple handover photo. After everything was done, she felt a weighty, profound joy.
location: Office of the Children's Cancer Foundation, 3 Garden Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Sharing donation results in the group.
description: Walking out of the foundation, she sat on a high stool by the window at the Starbucks next door and ordered a medium hot latte. She sent the thank-you certificate and lively photos from yesterday's charity sale to the three-person Cantonese embroidery group. Teacher Wu immediately sent a voice message over 60 seconds, saying excitedly, "Great, great, great! I'm so proud of you!" He Meiling then sent several crying emoticons in a row, saying, "I couldn't sleep last night; thinking about the charity sale scene made me really emotional." Xiaowei smiled and replied, "It's all settled. We did great!"
location: Starbucks, Citibank Plaza, 3 Garden Road, Central and Western District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Morning work: return to the company, organize client lists, and prepare
description: After finishing coffee, she took the MTR from Admiralty Station and transferred to Wan Chai. Ten minutes later, she arrived at AIA Building, swiped in, and entered the office. Returning to her desk, she turned on the computer and, while archiving photos of the donation certificate, began handling the top priority of the day: compiling a list of local high-end potential clients, adding notes to each one, and preparing for follow-up. During this period, she also replied to the secondary school teacher who had previously invited her to give a lecture and confirmed the initial intention to cooperate. She then focused on completing the high-end client list, printed it out, put it into a folder, and double-checked the materials for next week's client meeting to make sure everything was flawless.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: Shanshan sent a message, inviting me to the usual Shun Hing Roast Meat Tea Restaurant downstairs. I ordered the signature char siu with fried egg rice, while Shanshan ordered the curry beef brisket rice. She briefly mentioned going to the foundation to handle some matters in the morning, but didn't go into detail. We chatted about little gossip in the team and the pressure of the year-end performance sprint. The lunch atmosphere was relaxed, temporarily forgetting the afternoon's worries.
location: Shun Hing Roast Meat Tea Restaurant, Lockhart Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China

name: Afternoon work and preparation to go out
description: Back at her desk, she continued with her desk work and reviewed the newly released insurance product materials. At 2 p.m., she checked the time and saw there was still one hour before her meeting with Zhou Minyi. She packed her bag in advance and sent Zhou Minyi a confirmation message: “I’ll wait for you at Pacific Coffee on Prince Edward Road West at 3 p.m., thanks.” Then she took a deep breath and left the office 15 minutes early.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Commuting to the café
description: Took the MTR from Wan Chai Station, transferred at Mong Kok East Station, then walked to Prince Edward Road West. I deliberately slowed down and composed myself. Pushing open the door of Pacific Coffee, I found that Zhou Minyi had not arrived yet, so I ordered two cups of hot milk tea that she liked, found a relatively quiet corner seat, and sat down to wait.
location: Along the way from MTR Wan Chai Station to Pacific Coffee on Prince Edward Road West, Hong Kong

name: Meeting Zhou Minyi, Confrontation, and Farewell
description: After Zhou Minyi sat down, she cut straight to the point: 'Annie, regarding Wang Qiming's group insurance last month, did your team have any contact with it?' Her face turned pale, and she immediately explained that the client had asked several companies to compare prices, and that she had only provided standard rates according to procedure, without deliberately snatching the deal. The atmosphere grew tense; Zhou Minyi stared into her eyes, trying to find a flaw in her defense. Finally, she said, 'I don't want to pursue anything. I just want to hear it from you in person.' The two fell into a brief silence. Seeing that she could not get any more out of her, she felt mentally drained and had no intention of lingering. She stood up to leave, and Zhou Minyi also rose, saying softly, 'Xiaowei, I didn't mean it.' She stopped in her tracks but did not turn around, only quietly replying, 'I know.' She looked out the window until she had walked far out of sight. This 15-year friendship seemed to quietly draw to a close in her heart. She picked up her bag and felt a wave of exhaustion.
location: Pacific Coffee, 232 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Processing emotions on the way home
description: Leaving the café, she put on her earphones and played some soothing instrumental music at random, trying to calm herself down. On the MTR carriage back to Kowloon Tong, she let her mind go completely blank and only snapped back to reality when the announcement called the station. She set Zhou Minyi's WeChat chat to Do Not Disturb, deciding to keep only surface courtesy from now on.
location: On the MTR train from Prince Edward Station to Kowloon Tong Station, Hong Kong

name: Leave work early to go home and spend time with family
description: I got home earlier than usual, and only my mother and my daughter Xinxin were there. Xinxin rushed over as soon as she saw me and handed me a Christmas card she had just drawn, with a family and a little cat on it and 'Mom, I love you' written crookedly. My nose felt a little sour, and I hugged her tightly; it instantly healed the disappointment of the afternoon. I colored a few small flowers on the card with her. My mother went into the kitchen to start cooking dinner, and I helped her pick vegetables on the side.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Family dinner
description: Mingzai came home from work, and Xuanxuan had also been picked up. The whole family sat around the table for dinner. On the table were mother's signature dishes: steamed fish, ginger and scallion chicken, and stir-fried choy sum. He tried hard to look normal and chatted about family matters with everyone, listening to Xuanxuan talk about interesting things at school. He had little appetite at dinner, but he forced himself to eat so as not to worry the family.
location: Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Tutoring schoolwork and checking homework
description: After dinner, I began to carefully check Xuanxuan's math and English homework. He had solved a chickens-and-rabbits-in-the-same-cage word problem incorrectly. I patiently guided him to analyze it step by step with drawings until he suddenly understood. After checking all the homework, I praised him for the neatly written parts and encouraged him to keep working hard tomorrow.
location: Study room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening skincare routine and yoga stretching
description: After taking care of the children, she returned to the room and changed into a sports vest.
