She spread the yoga mat on the bedroom floor and followed the prompts on her phone app for 15 minutes of gentle stretching, focusing on relaxing her shoulders, neck, and lower back, which were sore from today's emotional tension. Then she went into the bathroom and took a thorough shower, carefully cleaning the skin on her left arm with warm water, then applied a thin layer of repair cream.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening organization and reflection
description: After drying her hair, she took out her notebook and wrote down tomorrow's to-dos: 1. Follow up on the medical claim for client XX; 2. Confirm the implementation feedback on team standards; 3. Reply with the specific details of the secondary school teacher's lecture. Then she turned to today's plan page and drew a simple full stop next to "Meet Zhou Minyi." She let out a soft sigh and told herself: I have done my part today, both for the common good and for my own personal commitments; everything has been properly accounted for.
location: Living room and study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Relaxing alone with her husband.
description: Her husband Mingzai finished dealing with his own matters and sat on the living room sofa reading financial news on his phone. She walked over with a glass of warm water, sat quietly beside him, and gently rested her head on his shoulder. The two of them did not talk; they simply enjoyed this peaceful family moment. This companionship felt reassuring and steady.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Back in her room, she set the alarm for the next morning and did one last check of her phone notifications. Lying in bed, she thought back on the day: she had fulfilled a commitment with Teacher Wu and He Meiling, and also said goodbye to a draining relationship. Though it was sad, there was more relief at looking forward. She closed her eyes and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Gentle morning stretching and care routine.
description: After the alarm went off, because the red patches on her right cheek and elbow were obvious and she hadn't slept well due to nighttime itching, she gave up high-intensity exercise and did 15 minutes of gentle stretching and mindful breathing in the master bedroom, starting a healing day by breathing in calmness and breathing out anxiety. Then she got up, gently washed her face and arms with warm water, applied the repair cream the doctor had previously prescribed, changed into an off-white knit top and a dark blue skirt, placed her work laptop and document bag by the door, checked her face and elbow in the mirror, and decided she must make an appointment with the doctor today.

location: From Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, via Whampoa Station, Mong Kok Station, Admiralty Station, and Wan Chai Station

name: Team meeting and insurance policy processing
description: Arrived at the AIA Building office, attended the team weekly meeting, reported the progress on corporate client follow-ups to regional sales director Liang Zhenhua, and received his approval. After the meeting, she handled urgent emails, prepared renewal reminders for two policies due for renewal, and contacted Guangzhou colleague Guo Junwei on the internal line to confirm details of the group medical insurance product.
location: Room 1802, 18/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: At noon, took a client call and exchanged with colleagues.
description: Had lunch with her partner Su Lishan at the café in Shui On Centre. While waiting, she called the head of the restaurant chain, Mr. Li, and the head of the IT startup, Mr. Lin, in turn, and arranged to discuss insurance plans in detail with them on Monday morning and afternoon respectively. After the calls, she entered the information into her phone's memo app. During the meal, she exchanged parenting and work insights with Su Lishan.
location: Shui On Centre Cafe, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong

name: Develop a client follow-up action table and plan.
description: Back at the office, she used the afternoon to create a weekly follow-up action plan for clients to increase coverage, screened 5 potential existing clients, and scheduled next week's contact plan. During this time, she contacted Guo Junwei again to confirm a special offer plan and drafted frameworks for two group insurance proposals.
location: Room 1802, 18/F, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong

name: End-of-day wrap-up and night run confirmation.
description: Before leaving work, send the follow-up action form to supervisor Liang Zhenhua for filing, then call husband Zhang Weiming to confirm the night run plan along Ho Man Tin Street to Kowloon Tsai Park. At 17:30, leave the office and walk to Wan Chai MTR Station.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong to Wan Chai MTR Station

name: After-work commute
description: Took the MTR from Wan Chai back to Whampoa, resting with eyes closed and listening to music on the way, arriving at Whampoa Station around 18:30.
location: From Wan Chai District to Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, via Wan Chai Station, Admiralty Station, Mong Kok Station, and Whampoa Station.

name: Grocery shopping on the way
description: After exiting the station, walked to ParknShop inside Whampoa Wonderland Mall. Based on the children's favorite snack list, bought milk pudding, cheese sticks, matcha cookies, and fruit, and saved money using membership points. Then walked about 8 minutes home.
location: ParknShop, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Go home, freshen up, and change.
description: After arriving home, she handed the shopping bags to her husband, greeted her mother in the kitchen, then changed out of her work clothes, put on loungewear, and changed into running gear.
location: Living room and bedroom, Unit A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Sharing family travel dreams
description: Pulled to the sofa area by the children, the couple listened as their son showed his hand-drawn travel route map for Japan, while their daughter held a tablet and excitedly pointed at Disney photos. The whole family looked forward to the upcoming trip together, and the couple became even more determined to work hard for the family trip.
location: Living room, Flat A, 6/F, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Light dinner
description: The family had a simple dinner. Because she was going running, Yu Xiaowei only had a little soup and some vegetables. Her mother praised the younger generation for paying attention to staying in shape.
location: Restaurant, Flat A, 6/F, Tower 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Couple's night run, 5 kilometers
description: The couple went out and jogged along Ho Man Tin streets to the outskirts of Kowloon Tsai Park, completing the 5-kilometer goal at a pace of about 6 minutes per kilometer, chatting about family and work while running. In the park's stretching area, they ran into their neighbor Zhang Haoming and exchanged a few pleasantries.
location: Ho Man Tin Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong, to Kowloon Tsai Park

name: Go home for stretching and parent-child activities.
description: After returning home, she did 10 minutes of deep stretching, then took a bath and applied a face mask. After that, she helped her son solve difficult math problems, and then played with building blocks with her daughter until she fell asleep.
location: Living room, bathroom and children's room, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Cantonese embroidery practice and exchange with embroidery friends
description: Continuing to embroider the snowy background of the Yue embroidery work "Winter" under the desk lamp in the study, after about 20 minutes she took a photo and posted it to the embroidery friends' group, sharing needle-laying tips with Shenzhen embroidery friend He Meiling, and received praise and responses from the group.
location: Study room, Flat A, 6th Floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Gratitude journal and mindfulness meditation
description: Wrote a gratitude journal by the bedside, recording the day's work progress, her husband's support, and the children's happiness. Then she turned off the light and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation to relax her body and mind.
location: Master bedroom, Flat A, 6th floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Bedtime conversation between husband and wife
description: Lying side by side in bed with her husband, she quietly shared her idea of using her work commission to supplement the travel budget. Her husband held her hand and gave her warm encouragement.
location: Master bedroom, Flat A, 6th floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Preparing for sleep
description: After saying goodnight to each other, she set the alarm and fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to sleeping in on Saturday and taking the kids to the park.
location: Master bedroom, Flat A, 6th floor, Block 7, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Woke up at 6:30 in the morning, did 15 minutes of flow yoga and 5 minutes of sitting meditation in front of the bedroom window, focusing on leg stretches and calming her mind in anticipation of her daughter's performance. Afterward, she washed her face and did her skincare routine, applied hydrating serum and lip balm, and checked the Cantonese embroidered handkerchief. She gently woke her son and daughter and had breakfast with her husband, mother, and children. On the table were white congee, scrambled eggs, and pan-fried dumplings. During the meal, she formally confirmed with her husband that starting next Monday he would take their daughter to kindergarten first and then their son to the government primary school in the morning. Her son patted his chest and said he would help take care of his little sister.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Cantonese embroidery and household chores
description: After breakfast, her husband took the children to the living room to watch TV. She went to the study to continue the finishing touches on her Cantonese embroidery "Winter," using fine, dense stitches to work on the details of withered grass on the snow. She embroidered for about 40 minutes. After that, she tidied up the picture books scattered on the sofa by the children and checked the math homework her son needed to hand in next Monday, making sure nothing was missing.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going out for shopping and a healthy start.
description: After changing into casual clothes and grabbing a reusable shopping bag, she left at 9 a.m. on foot for Whampoa Plaza. At ParknShop she bought multivitamin tablets and fruits including kiwi, blueberries, and oranges. At checkout, she opened the newly installed diet-tracking app on her phone, entered her first "healthy shopping" list, and wrote in the notes section, "Starting today, milk tea will be reduced to three times a week." She paid with her membership card, spending about 280 Hong Kong dollars in total. Then she walked home.
location: ParknShop, The Whampoa Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Late-morning rest and performance preparation
description: After returning home, put the fruit and vitamins away and drink a glass of warm water. Then take out your daughter's white little swan tulle performance dress, sparkling hair accessories, and dance shoes, carefully check that they are clean and in good condition, and neatly place them in the dedicated performance bag to leave nothing to chance.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family lunch.
description: After a short rest, she and her husband took the two children and walked to the New Shanghai Kitchen Café. She ordered the signature wonton noodles, her husband had baked pork chop rice, and the children shared a kids' meal. During a break in the meal, she went next door to the bakery and bought two fresh pineapple buns with butter, planning to bring them home for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: New Shanghai Kitchen Chinese Restaurant, 7 Tak Fung Street, Hung Hom, Hong Kong

name: Lunch break and pre-performance preparation
description: After lunch, she returned home and let her daughter rest for half an hour in the living room. At about 13:00, she woke her up, helped her put on the base layer for her performance costume, carefully used hair gel to fix her curly hair, and put on a sparkling crystal headband. The daughter was overjoyed looking at herself in the mirror.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to kindergarten to watch daughter's ballet performance
description: After the family of four got ready, they walked to the taxi stand at Whampoa Station and took a cab to Kowloon City. The ride took about 15 minutes; the daughter hummed a ballet tune in the car while the son kept the beat. After arriving at the auditorium of Kowloon City Baptist Church Kindergarten, they found seats in the front row. The performance started on time. When she saw her daughter in a swan dress earnestly tiptoeing and spinning on stage, her eyes grew hot. She quickly took out her Cantonese embroidery handkerchief to dab her eyes, while raising her phone to snap continuous shots of her daughter's absorbed performance. After the show, she rushed near the backstage, hugged her daughter tightly after she had changed out of her costume, and pulled her into many photos with teachers and classmates.
location: Kowloon City Kindergarten Hall, 206 Argyle Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: After returning home, worked out the budget for the Japan trip.
description: After the performance, they took a taxi home, and her daughter fell asleep leaning against her mother on the way. After getting home, she settled her daughter into the small bed in the bedroom, then went to the study and opened her laptop. She first logged into online banking to check the month's household expenses, then opened several travel agency websites and flight and hotel comparison platforms, crossed out the four-star hotel option she had previously liked, compared the prices, locations, and reviews of several three-star hotels in detail, and noted the round-trip fares of budget airlines. Finally, she created a new Excel spreadsheet and organized the cost-saving options, such as downgrading accommodation and reducing the shopping budget, into a clear A/B plan to discuss with her husband in the evening.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Custom-ordering a Christmas gift for her husband
description: After completing the budget calculation, she switched to an online shopping platform and searched for a custom pour-over coffee kettle. After browsing several shops, she chose a Japanese-style gooseneck kettle and carefully filled in the engraving details: on one side, engrave ZW; on the other, engrave 2010.05.20. After confirming the engraving position, font, and color, she placed the order and selected the gift wrapping service. The whole process was quiet and secretive, looking forward to the surprise when her husband received it.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Hearing the sound of her mother bustling in the kitchen, she closed her laptop and went in to help. Her mother was making pork bone soup with green and red radishes, and she took over washing and cutting the vegetables. As the mother and daughter worked, they chatted about the amusing moments from her daughter's performance that afternoon. She smiled and said her daughter seemed a little nervous on stage but bravely finished the performance, and her mother listened with a beaming smile.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and evening chat
description: The family sat around the dining table, and her father had also returned from the park. Dinner included Cantonese home-style dishes such as green radish and carrot pork bone soup, steamed crucian carp, and stir-fried choy sum with garlic. Everyone chatted while eating about the daughter's performance that day. After the meal, her father even took out his phone and asked his daughter to perform a piece for him alone, making the whole family laugh heartily.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying the children and checking their homework.
description: After dinner, she first accompanied her son to his room, checked his Chinese and English weekend homework, and corrected several wrong characters. Then she went to her daughter's room and read her the picture book story The Little Princess. As she listened, she fell asleep, with a contented smile on her little face.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening couple time: balcony conversation and watching a documentary
description: After the children were all asleep, she brewed two cups of pu'er tea and brought them to the balcony, sitting on rattan chairs with her husband to enjoy the evening breeze. She first shared how moved she was by the performance that afternoon, then took out the Japan trip budget she had made on her phone and explained in detail the thinking behind the scaled-down plan: lowering accommodation standards and reducing shopping expenses. Her husband thought the plan was practical and added that they could bring more luggage allowance themselves. The two reached an agreement. Afterward, they returned to the living room, snuggled on the sofa and watched the 'Mountains' episode of Planet Earth II. The scenery was magnificent and the music melodious, and they enjoyed the peace and relaxation of the weekend.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening washing up, gratitude journal, and bedtime
description: After the documentary ended, she washed up, applied hydrating serum and night cream. Then she sat on the edge of the bed, took out her diary, and wrote down today's gratitude: grateful for her daughter's courageous growth once again, grateful for her husband's understanding and support, and grateful that she herself had taken the first step toward a healthy life. Then she did five minutes of mindful breathing to completely calm her mind and body. She turned off the desk lamp, they said goodnight to each other, and she soon fell asleep.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's morning run
description: On a Sunday morning, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming set off from home and jogged along Prince Edward Road West to Kowloon Tsai Park. The winter sunlight filtered through the treetops and fell on the running path. They maintained a 6:30 pace and ran a steady 5 kilometers. On the third lap, Yu Xiaowei felt her skin breathing in the breeze and felt especially happy. She said to Weiming, "The weather is really nice today, and my skin feels a bit more hydrated." Weiming smiled and said, "That's because the diet adjustment you started yesterday is working." After the run, they bought water from the park's vending machine and rested for a while.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family breakfast.
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowei took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was already busy in the kitchen, having cooked plain congee and steamed BBQ pork buns and siu mai. Yu Xiaowei woke the two children. Her son Xuanxuan rubbed his eyes and said, "Smells great!" while her daughter Xinxin went straight to the dining table. The family sat around the table together. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, read the newspaper while drinking congee, and they talked about the weather on today's winter solstice. Yu Xiaowei put buns on the children's plates and reminded them that they would all make dumplings together later.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Selecting and buying a massage chair
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei and her husband Zhang Weiming drove to Sha Tin Plaza. Considering her mother-in-law Chen Meiling's knee problems, she had shortlisted several brands online, including OSIM and Panasonic. At Fortress on the third floor of Sha Tin Plaza, they carefully compared the heat functions and zero-gravity modes of multiple massage chairs. In the end, Yu Xiaowei chose a fully featured OSIM uAngel Pro, paid directly with her credit card, and scheduled delivery to her home at 2 p.m. The salesperson also gave her a bottle of aromatherapy essential oil as a gift.
location: Shatin Plaza, 21-27 Sha Tin Centre Street, Sha Tin District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returning home from shopping
description: After leaving the appliance store, Yu Xiaowei and her husband stopped by the underground market at Sha Tin Plaza to shop. She bought fresh Chinese chives, pork, fresh shrimp, and ready-made dumpling wrappers, because her mother said the flour left at home might not be enough. Zhang Weiming bought a box of Lindt chocolates and some fruit as a surprise for the children. Then the couple drove back to their home at Whampoa Garden in Kowloon City District and carried the ingredients into the kitchen.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Sha Tin District, 21-27 Sha Tin Centre Street, Sha Tin Plaza, basement market

name: Design an insurance plan.
description: With some time still before the massage chair delivery, Yu Xiaowei went into the study, opened her laptop, and began working on Mr. Zhang's corporate group accident insurance plan. She pulled up the company's latest group insurance template and, based on information gathered during last week's face-to-face meeting about the renovation company's employee size and work risks, carefully designed the coverage amounts and liability clauses. She set a plan of HK$1,000,000 for accidental death/disability and HK$100,000 for accidental medical expenses, and added daily hospitalization allowance and 24-hour global emergency rescue services. After checking it repeatedly three times, she saved the plan as a PDF, ready to bring to the signing next week.
location: Study Room, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother had already prepared the chive, pork, and shrimp filling, and the aroma filled the air. She deftly made a pot of dumplings for lunch. Yu Xiaowei asked her husband to call her father, who was reading the newspaper in the living room, to come and eat. The family sat around the dining table, enjoying the steaming dumplings and the pork bone soup with green radish and carrot that her mother had made. During the meal, her son Xuanxuan excitedly said he had learned to make dumplings and wanted to show off for his grandparents, while her daughter Xinxin imitated ballet moves by spinning on her chair. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei told the children to go rest, and she took a 15-minute nap on the sofa.
location: Restaurant, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Making dumplings with the whole family.
description: Mother brought the kneaded dough and prepared filling to the coffee table in the living room, and a lively dumpling-making contest began. Yu Xiaowei handed the rolling pin to her son: "Come, let Mom teach you how to roll out the wrapper." Then she personally taught her daughter how to put the filling in the center of the wrapper and pinch the edges tightly. Her husband and father watched from the side, giving advice with smiles, and occasionally took out their phones to take photos. While making dumplings, Yu Xiaowei chatted with her mother about her daughter's ballet performance last night, and her mother listened with great interest. When her daughter made her first dumpling — crooked in shape but adorable — the whole family applauded. Her father smiled so hard his mouth could not close, and tears glistened at the corners of his eyes. This family happiness made the warmth of the winter solstice flow in everyone's hearts.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Massage chair delivery and installation
description: Just as everyone was enthusiastically wrapping dumplings, the doorbell rang. The delivery worker delivered the massage chair on time. Her husband and the installation technician carefully moved it into the living room and placed it by the window. The technician skillfully plugged it in and ran a function test. Yu Xiaowei watched closely, confirmed that all functions were working properly, and noted down the after-sales phone number.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tried out the massage chair
description: The massage chair was installed, and the whole family's joyful trial session began. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was the first to try it. She sat down, selected the “Joint Care” mode under voice guidance, and enjoyed it for 20 minutes with her eyes closed. When it ended, she let out a long sigh of relief and praised, “Ah, my knees feel much looser here. It really works, the money is well spent!” Her husband joked, “Mom, this chair understands you better than I do!” Her father, Yu Guoqiang, also tried it and praised the zero-gravity mode for relaxing his lower back. The two children treated the massage chair as a novel toy, laughing and fooling around on it, full of joy and laughter.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Prepare dinner
description: After trying out the massage chair, the children continued watching cartoons in the living room. Yu Xiaowei and her mother cleaned up the “battlefield” of dumpling-making together, neatly arranging the leftover dumplings on trays dusted with dry flour—some to be cooked that night, some to be frozen for next week. Her mother then went to the kitchen to prepare cold dishes and dipping sauce, adding minced garlic, black vinegar, and sesame oil. Yu Xiaowei helped chop some scallions in the kitchen, chatting with her mother and listening to her tell stories about the Winter Solstice when she was young.
location: Living room and kitchen of Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Winter Solstice dinner.
description: Outside the window, the city lights were just coming on; inside, it was warm and cozy. When the water boiled, Yu Xiaowei put the dumplings in while her husband prepared the dipping sauce. Soon, three plates of steaming dumplings were served — golden-ingot-shaped ones made by her mother, an "ugly duckling" by her daughter, and thick-skinned dumplings rolled by her son. Everyone raised their cups of pu'er tea and said in unison, "Happy Winter Solstice!" At the dinner table, Yu Xiaowei especially chatted with her father about the old Hong Kong banknotes he collected, while her husband talked about the funny story of buying the massage chair today. Laughter, along with the aroma of dumplings, made this winter night especially warm.
location: Restaurant, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Father sorting old Hong Kong dollars
description: After dinner, her father Yu Guoqiang took out an iron box from the wardrobe in the bedroom, containing old Hong Kong dollar banknotes he had treasured for years. He carefully spread the banknotes on the coffee table, selected a few well-preserved old HSBC 10-yuan and 100-yuan banknotes, and gently wiped off dust with a tissue. While sorting them, he said, "These are ones I saved when I was little. In the future, I'll show them to the children, so they can see what Hong Kong used to look like." Then he took out an envelope and wrote, "A keepsake for the children — Grandpa." He then asked Yu Xiaowei to mail it back to his friend Sister Wenhui in Shenzhen. Her husband Zhang Weiming suggested nearby that a courier bag would better protect the banknotes.
location: Living room, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Doing Cantonese embroidery
description: After her father finished sorting the banknotes, Yu Xiaowei went to the balcony, sat in the rattan chair, and took out her embroidery hoop and white silk thread. She continued embroidering the last few snowflakes under the eaves in her Cantonese embroidery piece “Winter.” The needle and thread moved through her fingers, tracing the falling snowflakes’ paths. Her daughter Xinxin carried a small stool over and sat beside her, quietly watching her embroider and occasionally asking a few questions. Yu Xiaowei answered patiently, enjoying this warm mother-daughter time. She took a close-up of a section of the embroidery and posted it to the Wumen Embroidery Friends group with the caption: “The snowflakes are almost frozen, just waiting for spring to melt them.” Her embroidery friend He Meiling in Shenzhen quickly replied: “So pretty! Looking forward to the finished piece!”
location: Balcony, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Spending time with her child
description: Yu Xiaowei put down her embroidery hoop and returned to the living room. Her son Xuanxuan ran over to ask her about fraction addition and subtraction in his math homework. She used apples from home and cut them with him to demonstrate, and he finally understood. Her daughter Xinxin then pulled her over to read the newly bought picture book "Sofia the First". After she finished reading the story in an exaggerated voice, Xinxin fell asleep contentedly in her arms. Yu Xiaowei gently carried her daughter to bed and tucked her in, then went to her son's room and reminded him that he still had a diary entry about the Winter Solstice to write. Xuanxuan smiled sheepishly and obediently took out his notebook and began to write.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, children's room and study

name: Time for the couple.
description: The children were asleep, and her parents had gone back to their room to rest. Yu Xiaowei brought two cups of warm water to the balcony, where her husband Zhang Weiming was sitting on a chair looking at his phone. She sat down beside him and shared the day’s embroidery progress, while he told her about the new plan to take the children to school the next morning. They chatted about work for a while. Yu Xiaowei mentioned that she needed to step up client follow-up next week, and her husband said the air-conditioner peak season was approaching, so he might have to work overtime next week. After a simple and genuine conversation, they smiled at each other. Yu Xiaowei leaned on her husband’s shoulder, feeling the tranquility of the winter night.
location: Balcony, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening personal care.
description: Back in the bedroom, Yu Xiaowei carefully completed her evening skincare routine: she used a hydrating mist as a base, applied repairing lip balm, and patted on night cream. After washing up, she sat on the edge of the bed, opened her handwritten Gratitude Journal, and wrote down three things she was grateful for today: 1. She had a great time making dumplings with her family on the Winter Solstice; 2. Her mother's smile when trying the massage chair; 3. She successfully finalized Mr. Zhang's proposal. Then she turned off the light, put on noise-canceling headphones, and followed the guided instructions for five minutes of mindful breathing.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Going to bed
description: After finishing her mindfulness practice, Yu Xiaowei took off her earphones and saw that her husband had already turned off the lights and lain down. She said softly, “See you tomorrow.” Her husband responded and reached out to hold her hand. She adjusted into a comfortable sleeping position, listening to the occasional cries of night birds in the distance outside the window, and soon fell into a deep sleep. The day had been fulfilling, warm, and real, just as she had expected.
location: Bedroom, Whampoa Garden residential estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning strength training and skincare
description: At 6:10 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowei washed up briefly, changed into sportswear, laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom, and followed a mobile app for full-body core and lower-body strength training, including planks, squats, resistance band side leg raises, and glute bridges. She also added shoulder circles to relieve the soreness in her neck and shoulders from making dumplings the day before. After training, she took a shower and did basic skincare with moisturizing spray and essence, feeling her skin was in good condition. When she left the bathroom and met her father Yu Guoqiang, who was making tea, she specifically reminded him to wrap the old Hong Kong dollar notes in shockproof packaging before mailing them, to prevent damage from rough courier handling.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China (bedroom and bathroom at home)

name: Family breakfast and handover before heading out
description: The family gathered in the dining room for breakfast. Mother Chen Meiling had cooked white congee and served it with last night's pineapple buns. At the table, Yu Xiaowei confirmed with her husband Zhang Weiming his evening refrigeration course schedule (7 to 10 p.m.), and they agreed that he would handle the evening pick-ups and drop-offs while she took on all childcare duties. Her son Xuanxuan mentioned that the school would have a Christmas party next week; Xiaowei promised to help him prepare for the gift exchange over the weekend. Her mother smiled and said she could help with the crafts, and her daughter Xinxin clapped happily. After breakfast, Xiaowei checked her commuter bag to confirm the signed contract documents, business cards, and calculator. Her husband helped Xinxin put on her backpack, Xuanxuan tied his own red scarf, and the family said goodbye at the elevator. Her husband drove the two children to school, and her mother later went to the market to buy groceries.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (home dining room and living room)

name: Subway commute
description: Yu Xiaowei walked from home to Whampoa MTR Station, took the Kwun Tong line, transferred to the Tsuen Wan line at Mong Kok Station, then to Admiralty Station, and changed to the Island line to Wan Chai Station, taking about 45 minutes in total. On the MTR, she put on earphones to listen to financial news and pay attention to the opening trend of Hong Kong stocks, while mentally rehearsing the key points for the contract signing conversation with her client Mr. Zhang today.
location: Along the MTR Kwun Tong Line, Tsuen Wan Line, and Island Line (from Huangpu Station to Wan Chai Station), Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China.

name: Company morning preparation
description: After arriving at the AIA Building office on Gloucester Road in Wan Chai, Yu Xiaowei first went to the pantry and brewed a cup of monk fruit tea. Back at her desk, she quickly scanned and replied to over a dozen work emails, including a group insurance rate update from Guangzhou actuarial colleague Guo Junwei. She then turned the year-end report she had drafted into a document, uploaded it to the company's internal system, and successfully booked a meeting with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua at 9:30 tomorrow morning.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Go to the client's company to sign the contract.
description: After handling company matters, Yu Xiaowei packed her briefcase and left early, taking the MTR back to Kowloon City District. She boarded at Wan Chai station, transferred, and got off at Kowloon Tong station, then walked about 10 minutes to reach her client Mr. Zhang's company at Changhua Commercial Building, 108 Nga Tsin Wai Road.
location: Cheung Wah Commercial Building, 108 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China (en route from MTR Wan Chai Station to Kowloon Tong Station).

name: Successfully signed Mr. Zhang's corporate group insurance
description: In the meeting room on the 15th floor of Changhua Commercial Building, Yu Xiaowei met with client Mr. Zhang and his finance manager. She explained in detail the group accident insurance plan tailored to the characteristics of his catering business, including key terms such as accidental death/disability coverage of HK$1,000,000, accidental medical coverage of HK$100,000 (including outpatient claims), and occupational disease protection. Mr. Zhang was very satisfied with the plan, signed the application form on the spot, and handed over the first premium check. The two sides shook hands to celebrate the successful cooperation.
location: Meeting room, 15/F, Cheung Wah Commercial Building, 108 Nga Tsin Wai Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Return commute and phone calls
description: After signing the contract successfully, Yu Xiaowei was in a good mood and walked to Kowloon Tong Station to take the MTR back to Wan Chai. On the way, she called Mr. Li, the owner of a restaurant in Kwun Tong, and had a brief 15-minute conversation. Mr. Li confirmed the number of restaurant employees and the main type of business. Based on the occupational injury risks of kitchen, front-of-house, and dishwashing work, Xiaowei preliminarily sketched out the key points of a group insurance plan in her mind, and agreed to send the specific plan to him tomorrow afternoon.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China, along the MTR from Kowloon Tong Station to Wan Chai Station

name: Finishing up morning work
description: Back at the AIA Building office, Yu Xiaowei put the final polish on the work review feedback report she had organized in the morning, focusing on summarizing the results and reflections from suspending cross-border business over the past year, and printed it out as a reference for tomorrow's meeting. At the same time, she formally submitted a meeting request to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua for 9:30 the next morning through the company system and noted the key topics. Around noon, she got up to stretch, went to the rest area to look out over Victoria Harbour, replied to two WeChat inquiries from clients, and confirmed on the family budgeting app on her phone that yesterday's Winter Solstice expenses had been recorded.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Lunch with colleague Su Lishan.
description: Yu Xiaowei and her partner Su Lishan met for lunch at the cafe in Shui On Centre. Xiaowei ordered a Caesar salad with grilled chicken breast, and Su Lishan ordered avocado salmon Eggs Benedict. As they ate and chatted, Xiaowei shared the joy of signing the contract that morning and confided the pressure of having to handle evening childcare on her own after her husband enrolled in night school. Su Lishan completely related and shared her experience of using an online learning app to balance work and childcare, and also recommended a part-time hourly helper with a good reputation. The two agreed to try a new parent-child baking course together next week.
location: Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Midday walk and bank transfer
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei and Su Lishan took a walk along Harbour Road to aid digestion and stopped by the bank near Convention Plaza. Xiaowei used the mobile banking app to transfer the 3,000 yuan commission she had received in the morning from her salary card to the dedicated "Japan travel savings account," and updated the accounting app with "Travel fund +3000." Watching the account balance increase, she felt even more anticipation for the family trip to Japan.
location: Bank near Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Design a group insurance plan.
description: After the walk, Yu Xiaowei returned to the company and focused on completing the detailed design of Mr. Li's group insurance plan in Kwun Tong. She listed occupational injury protection (such as kitchen burns, falls on the floor, and cuts while chopping vegetables) as the highest-priority coverage item and highlighted it. After completing it, she saved the file and printed a paper copy for backup. Then she entered all of the day's client data and uploaded contracts in the company system.
location: Office, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Afternoon tea and work wrap-up
description: At 3:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowei declined a colleague's invitation to get milk tea and instead went to the pantry to make herself a second cup of monk fruit tea with a small piece of biscuit. Using the break, she quickly checked the food stored at home and made a list in her phone memo of what to replenish at ParknShop: fresh toast, Chilean cherries, fresh shrimp dumplings, and her mother's skim milk plus lettuce and cherry tomatoes for salads.
location: Pantry, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Leaving work early and grocery shopping
description: After finishing all her work, Yu Xiaowei left work on time at 4:00 p.m., took the MTR from Wan Chai Station to Whampoa Station, and walked 3 minutes to ParknShop in Whampoa New World shopping mall. She quickly bought Hokkaido toast, Chilean cherries, and Wan Chai Ferry shrimp dumplings according to her list, and also picked up skim milk, lettuce, and cherry tomatoes. At checkout, she presented her membership card for points and used an electronic coupon to save 12 yuan. Then she walked 3 minutes home carrying her shopping bags. When she got home, her mother was watching cartoons with her daughter and her father was reading the newspaper on the balcony. She put the items into the fridge by category, washed the cherries and placed them in a fruit bowl, and changed into loose loungewear.
location: Home in Whampoa Garden Residential Estate and ParknShop Supermarket, Whampoa New World Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Take over parenting and family handover
description: Yu Xiaowei called her mother Chen Meiling to tell her that she would be taking care of the children alone tonight. Her mother reminded her not to be too nervous and to keep the children warm. After the call, she checked her son Xuanxuan's schoolbag, confirmed his math homework and Youdao dictionary pen, and helped her daughter Xinxin take out her favorite little bunny plush. Before 6 p.m., her husband Zhang Weiming came home, changed quickly, and told Xiaowei that he had already bathed the kids. Xiaowei hugged him and wished him a smooth class. After kissing the children goodbye, he left for night school. Xiaowei told the children, "Now Mommy is tonight's commander."
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (home living room)

name: Dinner and post-dinner family time
description: Yu Xiaowei prepared a simple dinner: she boiled the fresh shrimp dumplings she had bought in the afternoon and served them with cucumber salad and cherries. Her daughter Xinxin ate the dumplings with a spoon by herself, while her son Xuanxuan told funny stories from school as he ate. After the meal, Xiaowei called her mother and had the two children say goodnight to their grandmother. She then cleared the table and let the children play freely in the living room. Xinxin played with her little kitchen toy set, and Xuanxuan read an extracurricular book while leaning over the coffee table.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (home dining room and living room)

name: Helped her son with his math homework
description: Yu Xiaowei took her son Xuanxuan to the study. His math homework was 'multiplying three-digit numbers by two-digit numbers.' She sat beside him, patiently explaining the key points of carrying, and used a timer to help him concentrate. After Xuanxuan successfully solved the last word problem, Xiaowei happily praised him. Xuanxuan asked to watch 20 minutes of Animal World; Xiaowei agreed but insisted he watch it in the living room, and then began helping her younger sister wash up.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

name: Evening childcare and household chores.
description: Yu Xiaowei ran bath water for her daughter Xinxin and helped her wash her hair and body. Xinxin played with bubbles and hummed a Christmas song she had learned at school. After the bath, she changed Xinxin into her long-necked giraffe pajamas, blow-dried her hair, took her to her room, and sat by the headboard, vividly reading the picture book "Little Rabbit Learns to Spend Money" bought that afternoon at the Commercial Press. Xinxin said she also wanted to save money to buy a small cake tomorrow. After turning off the lights and coaxing her daughter to sleep, Xiaowei returned to the living room, where Xuanxuan had already turned off his tablet and was ready for bed. She reminded her son to brush his teeth and wash his face, and checked his backpack to make sure the school uniform and art class supplies were all there. Xuanxuan slipped her a card he had drawn with the words "Mom, you've worked hard," which warmed her heart. After settling her son into bed, Xiaowei washed the dishes in the kitchen and tidied the living room.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (home bathroom, daughter's room, son's room, and living room)

name: Evening solitude and plans for tomorrow.
description: After the children fell asleep, the house became quiet. Yu Xiaowei spread out her yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of yin yoga with soothing light music, focusing on stretching her hips, shoulders, and neck to relieve the day's fatigue. Then she took out her gratitude journal and wrote about today's successful contract signing, the mutual support between her and her husband, and the children's obedience and thoughtfulness. Next, she did her nighttime skincare routine, applying eye cream and night cream, and put the printed work report and Mr. Li's proposal draft on the bedside table to take tomorrow. She also listed tomorrow's to-dos in her phone memo: a 9:30 face-to-face meeting with her supervisor Liang Zhenhua, sending Mr. Li's proposal, and following up on Mr. Zhang's policy underwriting status.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (living room and bedroom at home)

name: Talking with husband and going to bed
description: Hearing the soft sound of the front door, her husband Zhang Weiming returned from class, changed into pajamas, and tiptoed into the bedroom. The two leaned against the headboard. Her husband shared what he had learned in tonight's new energy theory class and found it very interesting, while Xiaowei told him about the children's funny moments that evening and all the work she had completed. They chatted for about ten minutes and remarked that although they were both busy, it was all worth it for their family goals. After saying goodnight, Xiaowei set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, turned off the light, did a simple mindful breathing exercise, and gradually drifted into sleep in peace and contentment.
location: Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China (home bedroom)

name: Community Ashtanga morning class
description: Took a gentle flow yoga class at the fitness center, practicing poses such as Extended Side Angle and Warrior II, feeling the return of body stretch and strength. Then sat cross-legged and meditated for 20 minutes, regulating breathing and focusing thoughts on today's meetings and to-do items.
location: 60 meters southeast of the intersection of Hung Luen Road and Oi King Street, Whampoa Fitness Centre, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family morning time
description: After returning home, I did a quick wash and skincare routine, then woke up my son Zhang Zixuan and daughter Zhang Yuxin and helped them get dressed and wash up. I prepared breakfast (toast, milk, fried eggs) together with my mother Chen Meiling. During the meal, I reminded my father Yu Guoqiang to send Hong Kong dollars to Sister Wenhui. He promised to take care of it today.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to work
description: Put on her business suit, took her work review materials and a folding umbrella, and walked to Kowloon Tong MTR Station. Took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, then transferred to the Island Line to Wan Chai Station. On the train, she reviewed the key points of her work report, especially the reflections on the Shenzhen business mistake and response strategies.
location: Kowloon Tong MTR Station, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning office work.
description: Arrived at the AIA Building office in Wan Chai, brewed coffee, read emails to confirm the group insurance policy had taken effect, and organized her thoughts for the work report. She then discussed the promotion criteria with regional director Liang Zhenhua, frankly reported on her work over the past six months, proactively analyzed the mistakes in the Shenzhen business, and used the successfully signed group insurance policy for Mr. Zhang as an example to demonstrate her ability to take action. Liang Zhenhua gave her three key indicators for participating in the regional manager selection in mid-next year: annual premium growth of 15%, a key-client renewal rate of 95%, and recruiting two core team members. After the discussion, she organized the meeting minutes and sent a thank-you email. Next, she designed a group accident insurance plan for Mr. Li's restaurant in Kwun Tong, focusing on strengthening the occupational injury protection clauses, estimated the premium using actuarial software, and printed and marked a draft plan. She then called Mr. Li to confirm the job grades and number of restaurant employees, adjusted the medical benefit reimbursement ratio, and ensured the plan was competitive.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch and a call with a close friend
description: She walked with her colleague Su Lishan to the café at Shui On Centre, ordered a pineapple bun with butter and Hong Kong-style milk tea, and shared her insights from the meeting. Su Lishan was very encouraging and also brought up fun stories about her son's Christmas party. After lunch, she walked with an umbrella to the convenience store at Convention Plaza to buy hot lemon honey, and on the way called her best friend Lin Jiaxin to congratulate her on passing the onboarding training. They agreed to meet at a café in Mong Kok at 3 p.m. on Saturday for a detailed chat.
location: Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai

name: Afternoon office work.
description: After returning to the office, she contacted her father on WeChat to confirm the delivery of HKD. Her father sent a photo showing that it had been shipped with shock-proof packaging. She then sent the adjusted group accident insurance plan to Mr. Li by email, with a voice message, and agreed to discuss the contract details on the first working day after New Year's Day. She wrote in the journal: January 5, Mr. Li meeting. Then she formulated the work plan for the first quarter of 2026: target high-net-worth clients in Kowloon City and the Eastern District, plan a small high-end salon every two weeks (topics include tax planning and cross-border asset allocation), and create a renewal client review table to screen policies about to expire. Finally, she tidied her desk, archived files, wrote down the next day's to-do items (follow up with Mr. Li to confirm the plan, screen the Eastern District high-end client list, and book a weekend yoga class), turned off her computer, and got ready to leave.
location: AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute home and do some shopping
description: Left the office and took the MTR home (took the Island Line from Wan Chai Station to Admiralty Station, transferred to the East Rail line to Mong Kok East Station, then transferred to a bus to Hung Hom Station). Along the way, she got off at Whampoa Station, walked to the ParknShop at Wonder World, and bought pork ribs, corn, carrots, broccoli, and cherries, saving 12 yuan with a mobile coupon.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Wan Chai Station

name: Preparing dinner and parent-child interaction
description: After changing into home clothes, she went into the kitchen, blanched the pork ribs and skimmed off the foam, then put them in a stew pot to make corn and pork rib soup. She washed and cut broccoli and carrots, placing them in a fresh-keeping box for later. Then she joined her daughter Zhang Yuxin in the living room playing with building blocks to build a castle, while her mother Chen Meiling collected clothes on the balcony. Soon her husband Zhang Weiming came home from work. Learning that he needed to rush to the first class of the evening school course "Refrigeration and New Energy Technology", she helped straighten his collar and encouraged him. Afterwards she prepared dinner with her mother: her mother steamed grouper, Yu Xiaowei stir-fried broccoli and ladled out the soup, and four dishes and a soup were set on the table.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and cleanup
description: The family of four sat around the table for dinner. Zhang Zixuan excitedly talked about the plan for the school Christmas party gift exchange, and Zhang Yuxin hummed a tune from her dance class while sipping soup. The atmosphere was warm and cheerful. After dinner, Yu Xiaowei cleared the dishes, her mother Chen Meiling packed the leftovers into containers, and Yu Xiaowei told her mother to rest early.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening tutoring and settling the children.
description: First, I checked my son Zhang Zixuan's math homework, corrected fraction calculation errors, and tutored English word dictation, focusing on hard-to-spell words like "Wednesday" and "December". Then I ran bath water for my daughter Zhang Yuxin, told her the story "The Little Rabbit Learns to Save Money" and put her to bed. Finally, I checked on my son, who had already washed up, reassured his worries about math difficulty, tucked him in, and turned off the light.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening personal activities and going to bed
description: In the master bedroom bathroom, she washed up and did her skincare routine, applying hydrating toner and face cream. Then she checked the classroom photos and messages her husband Zhang Weiming had sent from evening school and replied with encouragement. She wrote a gratitude journal, recording her reflections on today's communication, project progress, and family collaboration, then did 5 minutes of mindful breathing to relax. Finally, she checked the next day's weather, took out a clean suit and hung it up, set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and turned off the lights at 22:30 to go to bed.
location: Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: Yu Xiaowei woke up to the alarm clock and felt some tightness in her shoulders, so she did a few slow cat-cow stretches in bed to feel her spine move. Then she got out of bed, stepped onto the scale, which showed 52.9 kg, 0.1 kg less than yesterday, and recorded the weight change.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Preparing breakfast and taking care of the children
description: After washing up briefly, Yu Xiaowei walked into the kitchen. Her mother, Chen Meiling, was already cooking millet porridge and frying fried eggs. She took over and cut apples and oranges into a fruit platter. She then went to wake the children. Her son, Zhang Zixuan, put on his school uniform by himself, while her daughter, Zhang Yuxin, acted coquettishly and asked for help. Yu Xiaowei hummed a Christmas song as she tied the bow on the back of her dress. The whole family had breakfast together. Yu Xiaowei reminded Zixuan of the notes for the school Christmas party and told the children they would decorate the Christmas tree together in the evening.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organized the client list and sent holiday greetings.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei returned to the study, quickly skimmed the handwritten client list, and decided to focus on urgent matters and sending holiday greetings in the morning. She took out the gift box of Cantonese embroidered coasters she had made herself, planning to give it to her colleague Su Lishan at noon. Then, using the customer relationship management app on her phone, she sent personalized Christmas greetings via WeChat to the long-standing clients who had made purchases last year, along with tips for soothing the throat in winter.
location: Home study, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Subway commute
description: Yu Xiaowei put on her camel coat, picked up her commuter bag, and headed out. She walked five minutes to Whampoa Station and took the Kwun Tong Line to Wan Chai. In the carriage, she continued sending greeting WeChat messages and checked client replies. The commute took about 40 minutes, and she arrived smoothly at Wan Chai Station.
location: MTR train car from Whampoa Station in Kowloon City District to Wan Chai Station in Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Worked in the morning.
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived at her office on the 20th floor of the AIA Building and first brewed a cup of hot black tea. She handled 3 urgent emails, including a reply from Mr. Lin of an IT startup, who was satisfied with the proposal and said he would sign after New Year's Day; she made a note and set a follow-up reminder. She then contacted her colleague Guo Junwei, an actuary in Guangzhou, via the internal line to confirm details of accidental medical coverage in the group insurance plan. At 10:30, her supervisor Liang Zhenhua passed by, and she proactively reported client progress, receiving recognition and Christmas wishes.
location: Office on the 20th floor of AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Lunch with colleagues and gift exchange
description: At exactly 12:00, Su Lishan came to meet Yu Xiaowei, and the two walked to the café at Shui On Centre. Yu Xiaowei ordered chicken cutlet with soft scrambled egg rice and iced lemon tea, while Su Lishan ordered Thai boat noodles. Over the meal, Yu Xiaowei gave Su Lishan a gift box of Cantonese embroidery coasters, and Su Lishan gave her a hand-woven wool scarf in return. They chatted about parenting anecdotes as they ate, in a warm atmosphere. After the meal, they went to the convenience store at Convention Plaza to buy lattes and then walked along Harbour Road Garden for 15 minutes, talking about year-end work and plans for the coming year.
location: Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai; the convenience store at Convention Plaza, 1 Harbour Road, Wan Chai District; and Harbour Road Garden

name: Afternoon work and year-end file organization
description: Back at the office, Yu Xiaowei focused on organizing year-end client files. She filed the electronic records into three categories: renewal due, health review, and potential additional coverage, and updated follow-up notes. She set system reminders for the 5 clients whose policies renew next month to ensure nothing was missed before the Spring Festival.
location: Office on the 20th floor of AIA Building, 1 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leaving work early and shopping on the way
description: Yu Xiaowei decided to leave work 15 minutes early so she could get home before the children finished school. She left the office at 15:30, walked to Wan Chai Station, and took the MTR back to Whampoa. After exiting the station, she went into the basement ParknShop supermarket in the Whampoa New World shopping mall. Listening to Christmas music, she bought cherries, tiramisu ice cream, caramel popcorn, and the ginger her mother had asked for, saving 18 yuan with her membership card and electronic coupons.
location: ParknShop, G/F, Whampoa Square, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home to rest and freshen up.
description: Yu Xiaowei carried two large bags of groceries home and heard the calico cat 'Mimi' meowing at the entrance. She put the things in the kitchen, greeted her mother who was preparing dinner, then went back to the master bedroom, changed out of her work suit, put on a loose knit sweater and loungewear pants, and felt relaxed.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden home, entrance hall, kitchen, and master bedroom

name: Helped with dinner preparation and parent-child interaction.
description: After changing clothes, Yu Xiaowei went into the kitchen to help her mother make pork bone soup with carrots and radishes, handling the vegetable picking and washing and chatting about what she had seen at the supermarket. She then went to the living room to draw with her daughter Zhang Yuxin, who excitedly sang a Christmas carol she had just learned.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family Christmas Eve dinner.
description: At 6 p.m., her son Zhang Zixuan was brought home by his father Zhang Weiming, and her husband Zhang Weiming arrived home as well. The whole family sat down to dinner. The mother had prepared home-style dishes such as pork bone soup with carrots and radishes, blanched shrimp, stir-fried choy sum, and fresh shrimp dumplings. As they ate and chatted, Yu Xiaowei asked her son about the funny stories from the school Christmas party. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family decorates the Christmas tree and takes a group photo
description: After dinner, the whole family decorated the Christmas tree together. Her husband Zhang Weiming set up the 1.5-meter artificial tree, and the children brought out ornaments such as string lights and colorful baubles. Zixuan wrapped the string lights around the tree, Yuxin hung the baubles, and Yu Xiaowei sorted out the ribbons and adjusted the layout. The calico cat 'Mimi' curiously pawed at the light wires, drawing laughter from everyone. Mother hung up the gingerbread men she had made, and Zixuan placed the star on top of the tree. After the lights were turned on, Yu Xiaowei set up her phone to take a family photo and also took individual pictures of everyone, sharing them in the family group chat. Afterwards, they all sat around drinking tea, enjoying tiramisu ice cream and caramel popcorn, and admiring the Christmas tree, with the cat curled up at their feet. The atmosphere was peaceful and heartwarming.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video visit with mother-in-law
description: Yu Xiaowei made a WeChat video call to her mother-in-law who lives in Kwun Tong. Her mother-in-law showed the turnip cakes she had made, and the children excitedly showed her the Christmas tree. Everyone wished each other a Merry Christmas Eve. Yu Xiaowei and her husband briefly greeted the elderly woman, reminded her to keep warm in the cold weather, and promised to bring the children to visit after New Year's Day. The call lasted about 15 minutes and the atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Play with the children, tell stories, and put them to sleep.
description: After the video call, Yu Xiaowei played LEGO with Yuxin and looked at the Christmas drawing she had made. Then she took out the picture book "The Little Polar Bear's Christmas" and told Yuxin and Zixuan a story about sharing and courage. When the story ended, her husband Zhang Weiming settled their son into bed and checked his homework, while Yu Xiaowei helped her daughter change into pajamas and brush her teeth, sat by the bed humming Christmas songs until her daughter fell asleep.
location: Living room and son's and daughter's rooms at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Tidying up and washing up
description: After the children fell asleep, Yu Xiaowei returned to the living room, cleaned up the shredded decorative paper and snack wrappers, and took the tea set back to the kitchen. Then she went into the master bedroom, did her evening washing and skincare routine, carefully applying hydrating toner and lotion. Looking at her satisfied reflection in the mirror, she took a deep breath.
location: Living room and master bathroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening meditation, gratitude journal, and going to bed
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off the light, sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated for 10 minutes, focusing on her breath, letting go of the day's busyness, and feeling grateful in her heart for her family's health and togetherness, her mother-in-law's care, her colleagues' support, and her own growth. After meditation, she turned on the bedside lamp, wrote the warm moments of Christmas Eve in her gratitude journal, checked tomorrow's weather, hung up her clothes, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: Master bedroom at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning strength training and stretching.
description: Yu Xiaowei unrolled her yoga mat in the living room and first did 15 minutes of strength training, including 3 sets of 60-second planks and 3 sets of 20 squats, feeling her muscles awaken. Then she did 10 minutes of yoga stretching, focusing on Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog poses to stretch her spine. After exercising, she felt relaxed and full of energy.
location: Living room, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family Christmas breakfast and waking up the family.
description: After exercising, Yu Xiaowei walked into the kitchen and saw her mother Chen Meiling taking the homemade gingerbread baked last night out of the oven. The rich fragrance of ginger filled the whole house. She helped plate the gingerbread and made hot milk. Then she went upstairs and gently woke the children who were still lying in bed, telling them Santa Claus had come and the gifts were all under the tree. The children jumped out of bed excitedly and ran to the living room, and her husband Zhang Weiming also got up when he heard the commotion. The family enjoyed the mother's special homemade gingerbread, hot milk, fried eggs, and toasted bread in the dining room. The children decorated gingerbread men with colorful icing and talked about gifts while eating. The breakfast atmosphere was warm and lively.
location: Kitchen and dining room, 3rd Floor, Tower 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The couple exchanged Christmas gifts
description: While the children were taken care of by their grandmother in the living room, Yu Xiaowei and her husband went back to the bedroom and closed the door. She took out a carefully prepared pour-over coffee pot engraved with “ZW” and “2010.05.20” (their wedding anniversary) and handed it to him. He touched the engraving, pleasantly surprised. Her husband then took out a hidden gift box from the top shelf of the wardrobe. Inside was a compact fascia massage gun, with a handwritten card that read: “To my hardest-working wife, walking together will make it easier. Merry Christmas.” Her heart warmed, and she gave him a tight hug.
location: Master bedroom, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child time for unwrapping gifts and playing
description: The family sat around the Christmas tree piled with gifts. When her son Xuanxuan opened his, it was the LEGO Technic set he had been longing for, and he couldn't put it down. Her daughter Xinxin received a beautiful ballet dress set and immediately put it on, twirling happily. Yu Xiaowei unwrapped the massage gun from her husband, tried it, and felt her shoulders and neck relax quite a bit. The children excitedly played with their new toys, and the living room was filled with laughter.
location: Living room, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Tidying up the living room and preparing lunch ingredients
description: After the gifts were opened, Yu Xiaowei and her husband cleaned up the wrapping paper and ribbons together and put the toys away in categories. Then she went into the kitchen and began washing the choy sum and pork ribs her mother had bought that morning, preparing for lunch. Her husband also helped peel garlic and slice ginger, and the couple worked together in the kitchen with tacit coordination.
location: Living room and kitchen, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video call with Grandma in Kwun Tong to send good wishes.
description: Yu Xiaowei made a video call on her phone to her mother-in-law Li Shufen, who lives in Kwun Tong. When the call connected, her mother-in-law saw her wearing home clothes and beaming, with the Christmas tree and the children running around behind her, and grinned from ear to ear. She had Xuanxuan and Xinxin say hello to their grandmother and show off their new gifts. Her mother-in-law urged everyone to drink more soup in the cold weather and praised her for taking good care of the family and the children. Yu Xiaowei felt a warmth in her heart.
location: Living room, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Helping mother prepare Christmas lunch
description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother worked efficiently together in the kitchen to prepare a hearty Christmas lunch. She washed and cut vegetables and cleaned the crucian carp, while her mother did the cooking, making her signature white-cut chicken, lettuce with oyster sauce, and steamed crucian carp. Her husband slipped into the kitchen to steal a piece of chicken, and she laughingly shooed him out. The clatter of spatulas and woks mixed with their laughter, filling the kitchen with a festive atmosphere.
location: Kitchen, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family Christmas Lunch
description: Lunch was very sumptuous, with white cut chicken, steamed crucian carp, lettuce with oyster sauce, and the children's favorite sweet corn and diced pork soup. After the meal, the mother brought out the homemade gingerbread left over from the morning as dessert. Xuanxuan excitedly talked about the spaceship he was going to build with LEGO, while Xinxin, wearing her new ballet skirt, twirled around the dining table. Everyone chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: The restaurant on 3/F, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei felt a bit drowsy. She and her mother rested on the sofa in the living room. The cat “A-Ju” jumped onto her lap and curled up. While gently stroking the cat, she casually scrolled through WeChat Moments to see clients' likes and comments on last night's family Christmas photo, and briefly replied with a few “Merry Christmas.” Against the background murmur of the children watching TV in low voices, she dozed off and recovered some energy.
location: Living room, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Received the treasured package sent by my father
description: A doorbell rang, and her husband brought in a courier box. Seeing that the sender was her father, Yu Guoqiang, Yu Xiaowei felt a tightness in her chest. She opened the package. Inside was an old iron box, and when she opened it, there was a stack of old Hong Kong banknotes carefully placed in transparent protective sleeves (such as HSBC lion-head notes, Mercantile Bank notes, etc.), with a note beside them: 'Little girl, Dad knows you have a kind heart. These were kept for you as your dowry; now they are for you as a keepsake. Merry Christmas.' Looking at these banknotes that carried childhood memories, she thought of her father's increasingly furrowed brow due to recent investment losses. Touched and guilty at once, her nose tingled. Her husband came over, gently patted her shoulder, and said nothing.
location: Entryway, Block 5, 3rd Floor, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Outdoor parent-child activity.
description: Having composed herself, Yu Xiaowei suggested taking the children downstairs to get some exercise. The family of four changed into light clothes and walked to the play area in the residential complex. The warm winter sun felt very comfortable on their skin. Xuanxuan and several kids from the neighborhood excitedly played on the slide and climbing frame, while she and her husband accompanied Xinxin on the swing and seesaw. The children's laughter gradually dispelled the gloom from her heart.
location: Children's play area, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family leisure and client relationship maintenance
description: Back home, the children were playing with new toys in the living room and watching the Christmas-themed animated film The Polar Express. Yu Xiaowei sat beside her husband, leaning against him, took out her phone, and began replying seriously to clients' Christmas greetings on WeChat. Based on her memory of client profiles, she sent voice greetings individually to a few key clients (such as Mr. Li from Kwun Tong and running buddy Chen Zhiqiang), and also noted in her memo that she needed to arrange meetings with them in early January next year to discuss group insurance or policy renewals.
location: Living room, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
