name: Check wallet and tomorrow's itinerary
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to the study, checked the cash and Octopus card in her wallet, and confirmed the balance was sufficient. Then she took out her planner, quickly glanced at the next day's schedule, and found that the breakfast ingredients at home (toast, milk, eggs) were running low, so she decided to go down to The Whampoa shopping mall after dinner to restock.
location: Study, 3rd Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was leftovers from lunch, plus a pot of steaming hot chicken soup cooked by mother. After an afternoon of outdoor activities, the children had good appetites. At the table, they talked about the amusing things that happened in the garden that afternoon, and the package of old Hong Kong dollars from her father also became a topic of conversation. Yu Xiaowei said casually, 'Dad left it to me as a memento,' not wanting the atmosphere to become heavy.
location: The restaurant on 3/F, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Nighttime parent-child time
description: The husband was responsible for bathing the energetic Xinxin, changing her into pajamas, and telling her the story of The Little Princess to help her fall asleep. Meanwhile, Yu Xiaowei checked Xuanxuan's homework in her son's room, found he had made a mistake in one of the math word problems, and patiently guided him to read the problem again and corrected it. After that, she chatted with him for a while about the design of his new LEGO spaceship and praised his creativity.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom, 3rd Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Couple's night talk: sharing and support
description: The children were all asleep. Yu Xiaowei and her husband returned to the bedroom and closed the door. She again took out the old Hong Kong dollars her father had sent and showed them to him, sharing how moved and guilty she felt. Her husband comforted her, “Let’s call him more often, even just to chat. At the New Year, let’s find a chance to discuss it with Xiaofeng and see what we can do to help Dad.” She nodded and decided to contact her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng at the New Year to work out a solution together.
location: Master bedroom, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Go to the supermarket to shop
description: After talking with her husband, Yu Xiaowei put on a light jacket and walked alone to The Whampoa shopping mall near her residential community. In the supermarket, she skillfully picked fresh toast, a large carton of milk, eggs, and several packs of instant cereal, and also grabbed a pack of strawberry yogurt that her daughter loved. After paying, she walked home.
location: Supermarket at Whampoa New World Mall, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal relaxation and organization
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowei put the groceries into the kitchen refrigerator. Then she enjoyed a quiet moment alone in the bathroom, washing away the fatigue of the day with warm water and doing a meticulous moisturizing skincare routine. After that, she went into the study, lit a scented candle, took out her diary, and wrote down her gratitude for the day: her family's health, her husband's thoughtfulness, her father's deep love, and her children's innocent smiling faces. She wrote in particular, “That stack of banknotes is very old, but the affection runs deep. I hope I can help Dad share his worries in the new year.”
location: Bathroom and study, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Immersive Cantonese embroidery
description: It was still early, and Yu Xiaowei felt calm. She walked over to the embroidery frame, turned on the desk lamp, and took out her nearly finished Cantonese embroidery piece “Winter.” On Christmas Eve she had completed the background fill stitches for the snowy scene. Tonight she decided to stitch a few falling snowflakes. With fine, dense stitches and silver silk thread, she became absorbed in the work stitch by stitch, forgetting the day's sentimentality and feeling the peace and focus that crafts bring.
location: Study, 3rd Floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: After finishing the embroidery, Yu Xiaowei packed up the embroidery frame and silk threads. She returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, put on an eye mask and earplugs, and lay in bed for a 10-minute bedtime meditation, guiding herself to relax every part of her body and clear her mind. Afterward, she quietly said "good night" to her husband beside her and turned off the bedside lamp at 11:00 p.m. Through the window came the occasional sound of distant church bells, and the room fell into darkness and silence. She went to sleep peacefully, drawing a perfect end to this special Christmas.
location: Master bedroom, 3rd floor, Block 5, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning run 6 kilometers.
description: Yu Xiaowei set off from home as dawn was breaking, jogged along Prince Edward Road West to Kowloon Tsai Park, and completed a 6 km morning run on the jogging trail, maintaining a pace of 5:50/km. The morning felt pleasant, and she enjoyed the rhythm of running while planning the key points for her afternoon chat with her best friend Jiaxin.
location: Kowloon Tsai Park, 13 Inverness Road, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Visiting a new bakery
description: After the morning run, Yu Xiaowei made a detour to the newly opened Wheat Time Bakery on Prince Edward Road West. Attracted by the buttery and wheat aromas inside, she bought the signature egg tarts and whole-wheat toast, planning to bring back a breakfast surprise for her family. From chatting with the staff, she learned how particular the shop is about its ingredients.
location: Maitian Shiguang Bakery, Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Shower and skincare
description: Yu Xiaowei walked home with breakfast. She first drank warm water to rehydrate, then took a shower to wash off the sweat. After that, she tried the newly purchased serum for sensitive skin and observed the condition of her skin, feeling fresh and hydrated.
location: Hong Kong SAR, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home master bedroom bathroom

name: Family breakfast time
description: After changing into her loungewear, Yu Xiaowei went to the dining room and placed steaming hot egg tarts and bread on the table. The children were excited. The family sat down to eat breakfast. Her daughter shared the wish she had made under the Christmas tree, her son complained about holiday homework, her mother teased, and her father read the newspaper. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Home companionship and housework
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowei helped her mother clear the dishes, then joined her daughter in designing a dress for a doll while her son played with LEGO beside them. Afterward, she returned to the study to organize embroidery pieces and threads and checked client inquiries. Around noon, she prepared lunch ingredients with her mother.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home: living room, children's room, study

name: Preparing and having lunch
description: Yu Xiaowei and her mother were busy in the kitchen. Her mother took charge of stir-fried choy sum, while she prepared the ingredients for steamed fish and made tomato pork rib soup. They sat down for the meal at 12:00; the children helped set out bowls and chopsticks, and the whole family enjoyed a simple home-style lunch. After the meal, Yu Xiaowei washed the dishes on her own.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Midday rest and preparation for departure
description: After washing the dishes, Yu Xiaowei returned to her room to rest and quickly replied on her phone to a client's inquiry about policy dividends. Then she changed into an off-white knit top and jeans, touched up her light makeup, grabbed her handbag, and prepared to head to Mong Kok.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home, master bedroom

name: Commuting to Mong Kok.
description: Yu Xiaowei walked to Whampoa Station and took the Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok Station, a ride of about 15 minutes. On the way, she browsed financial news on her phone to have more topics for the afternoon meeting with Jiaxin.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, MTR Whampoa Station to Mong Kok Station (Kwun Tong Line)

name: Had an in-depth conversation with her best friend Lin Jiaxin.
description: Yu Xiaowei arrived early at the Pause It Café, ordered a hot latte, and waited for Jiaxin. When her best friend arrived, she sincerely congratulated Jiaxin on passing the onboarding review and frankly mentioned the possible co-opetition relationship between them regarding client resources in the future, emphasizing that she treasured their friendship. Jiaxin responded readily, saying they could share resources and achieve a win-win. Afterward, the two chatted about family and children, rediscovering the unreserved intimacy of their school days.
location: Pause It (Mong Kok) Cafe, Nelson Street, Mong Kok, Yau Tsim Mong District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Returned from Mong Kok and did some shopping on the way back.
description: After saying goodbye to Jiaxin, Yu Xiaowei walked to Mong Kok East Station, took the East Rail line to Hung Hom, then switched to the Kwun Tong line to Whampoa Station. After exiting, she went to the ParknShop at Wonder World to buy daily necessities such as laundry detergent and tissue paper, and also bought cheese sticks and fruit gummies for the children, saving 22 Hong Kong dollars with an e-coupon.
location: MTR Mong Kok Station, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, via East Rail Line and Kwun Tong Line to Whampoa Station; and ParknShop on the ground floor of The Whampoa Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District.

name: Go home and put things away.
description: Yu Xiaowei sorted and organized the purchased items, putting daily necessities in the storage room and snacks in the living room cabinet, and took the remaining egg tart to her father, who was reading the newspaper. He accepted it with a smile.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home entrance and living room

name: Accompanying father and chatting about everyday matters.
description: Yu Xiaowei accompanied her father for tea on the balcony, listening to him talk about the local specialties sent by a friend from Shenzhen and the value of the old Hong Kong dollars in his collection. She listened patiently and asked whether he would like to visit his old friend in Shenzhen at the end of the year. Her father said there was no hurry, but he clearly missed his friend.
location: Balcony and living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Mother had made signature dishes such as white-cut chicken and steamed grouper, and the whole family sat around to enjoy them. Yu Xiaowei shared with her husband what happened that afternoon when she met Jiaxin. Weiming praised her handling, and talked about how he felt about studying financial management at night school, while the children excitedly discussed which movie to watch in the evening.
location: Home dining room, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family watched a comedy film
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowei put on the comedy film 'Table for Six 2'. The whole family curled up on the sofa eating snacks while watching. The children laughed so hard they nearly fell over, and her parents were also amused by the Hong Kong-style humor. The living room was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Living room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Parent-child bedtime moments.
description: After the movie ended, Yu Xiaowei took the children to wash up. She bathed her daughter first and read the new picture book “The Little Penguin Doesn’t Want to Go to School”; her daughter asked many questions about school. Then she went to her son’s room and listened as he excitedly described the LEGO soccer field and penalty shootout he had built that afternoon. She kissed her son on the forehead and said goodnight.
location: Children's room at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Finishing up the Cantonese embroidery 'Winter'.
description: Yu Xiaowei returned to her room and, under the desk lamp, focused on completing the last few snowflakes of the Cantonese embroidery piece "Winter". After the final stitch was made, she looked at the work with a sense of accomplishment, took a high-definition photo, sent it to the embroidery friends group for Teacher Wu to see, and received praise from the group members.
location: Master bedroom desk at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Personal evening ritual
description: After finishing the embroidery, Yu Xiaowei felt happy and at ease. She took out her gratitude journal and recorded the warm moments of the day: Jiaxin's understanding, the family's laughter, and the sense of accomplishment from completing the embroidery. Then she put on her headphones and did a 10-minute mindfulness meditation to completely relax her body.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home, master bedroom

name: Couple's nighttime chat and bedtime preparations
description: After washing up, her husband Zhang Weiming got into bed. The couple chatted, discussed plans to accompany their son in choosing a party gift and taking their daughter to an interest class over the weekend, gave each other shoulder massages, and agreed to sleep in tomorrow before saying goodnight.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Whampoa Garden, home, master bedroom

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Yu Xiaowei turned off the bedside lamp, closed her eyes in peace and contentment, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Master bedroom bed at home, Whampoa Garden, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: The phone alarm went off right at 06:45. Because the physical exam today required fasting, she drank a glass of warm water after getting up, then stepped on the electronic scale — 52.7 kg, the same as yesterday, which satisfied her. The sky outside the window was gloomy. She did 5 minutes of simple stretching on the bed to relieve tension in her shoulders and neck.
location: Master bedroom, 12th floor, Tower 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping with family morning tasks
description: After a quick wash, she came into the living room. Her mother Chen Meiling had already started preparing breakfast in the kitchen (tomato and egg macaroni). She helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, then went to wake up 8-year-old son Xuanxuan and 5-year-old daughter Xinxin, gently reminding them that they had football class today. She helped the children wash up and told them to put on their sportswear.
location: Tower 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Getting ready to go out and preparing for the health checkup
description: Returning to the bedroom, she changed into a comfortable gray hoodie and black joggers and put on her backpack. She checked her belongings: ID card, Octopus card, phone, power bank, and put a piece of candy in the compartment in case of low blood sugar after the medical checkup. Her husband Zhang Weiming also got up at this point; he had the day off and was responsible for taking the kids to soccer class. The two quickly confirmed the timeline: Weiming would take the kids out before 8:30, and Xiaowei could head to the medical checkup at ease.
location: Tower 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commuting to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital
description: After saying goodbye to her family, she left the house at 07:45. Walked about 5 minutes to MTR Whampoa Station (Exit C), took the Kwun Tong Line to Yau Ma Tei Station, transferred to the Island Line to Causeway Bay Station (Exit A). After exiting, walked about 8 minutes along Caroline Hill Road, arriving at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital at 08:35. The entire trip was by public transport, taking about 50 minutes.
location: From Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, to Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, Wan Chai District (via MTR).

name: Check-in and waiting for the physical examination
description: Checked in at the self-service kiosk in the main lobby on the first floor of Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, then was guided to the Health Assessment Center in Li Shu Pui Block. Changed into a loose examination gown and disposable slippers, and sat down in the quiet waiting area. Through the floor-to-ceiling windows, she saw several runners on the track of Happy Valley Park outside, running against the morning breeze. She felt envious and thought that once her body was back in shape, she must resume her three-times-a-week morning runs and yoga training as soon as possible.
location: Health Screening Centre, Li Shu Pui Block, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Annual health checkup
description: When the nurse called my name, the physical examination officially began. In order, I had blood drawn (three tubes), height and weight measured, blood pressure, electrocardiogram, vision and color vision tests, and an internal medicine examination. The entire process went smoothly, and the medical staff were professional and patient. While waiting for the results of some items, I sat on a chair in the corridor and used my phone's memo to note down a few questions to ask the doctor: about the occasional bloating lately, and the slight discomfort in my knee after running.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Wan Chai District, Happy Valley, 2 Village Road, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital Health Assessment Centre

name: Review the report with Dr. Zhou Wenbin
description: Called into the consultation room, Dr. Zhou flipped through the printed report with a somewhat serious expression. He pointed out that cortisol levels were high, indicating long-term stress, and there were also early signs of excessive stomach acid. The doctor then turned to last year's skin allergy consultation record and said earnestly that the body's signals are connected: high cortisol, excessive stomach acid, and the earlier skin barrier damage all pointed to the same problem — pushing herself too hard. Dr. Zhou praised her exercise habits, but advised reducing caffeine intake and ensuring at least 7 hours of sleep.
location: Consultation room, Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, 2 Village Road, Happy Valley, Wan Chai District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Draft a health improvement checklist and purchase healthy ingredients on the return trip.
description: Walking out of the consultation room, she felt a bit heavy, but more than that, a resolve to change. Sitting on the chair in the corridor, she opened her phone's notes app and carefully wrote out an improvement list: milk tea reduced to twice a week; dinner moved to before 7 p.m.; morning runs or yoga three times a week; in bed by 11 p.m.; and giving up the afternoon sugar-free latte, with a phone reminder set for each item. She then left the hospital and took the Island Line back the same way. After getting off at Whampoa Station, she walked directly to the Whampoa mall, pushed a shopping cart straight to the underground ParknShop International, and precisely bought according to the list: whole wheat bread, instant oats, fresh spinach, broccoli, cherries, avocado, and a tub of sugar-free yogurt. At the self-checkout area, she scanned her membership code with the mobile app, skillfully used two electronic coupons, and saved 18.9 Hong Kong dollars.
location: ParknShop, The Whampoa Shopping Mall, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Return home and have a light lunch
description: Walked home carrying two large shopping bags, about a 5-minute walk. When she got home, her mother had already eaten; she had saved her a light tomato and egg drop soup and a small plate of blanched choy sum. After changing into loungewear, she gave her mother a brief update on the physical examination results over lunch, saying the doctor had advised a lighter diet. Her mother nodded repeatedly and said she would adjust the dinner menu to use less oil and salt.
location: Tower 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Organizing workout gear
description: After lunch and a 15-minute rest, she went to the study, opened her sports backpack, and checked the wear on her running shoe soles (they were in good condition and could last another 200 kilometers). She took out the yoga mat and laid it on the floor, and confirmed that the quick-dry sports bra and shorts she planned to change into tomorrow had been washed. She neatly placed all the gear in a corner of the study and set a 7 a.m. morning-run alarm on her phone, ready to start a new round of training the next day.
location: Study room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Leisure and family time
description: Her son was still at football class and hadn't returned home, and her daughter Xinxin woke up from her nap. She turned on the speaker and played her favorite Norah Jones light music, played with animal building blocks with Xinxin on the living room carpet, then checked the "Cantonese Embroidery Elegant Gathering" WeChat group. Her embroidery friend He Meiling was sharing a pattern titled Lychees Ripe and Cicadas Singing, and she briefly replied with a few words of praise and encouragement. Thinking of the embroidery piece Winter she had just finished last night, she felt at ease.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Phone call with husband about picking up the children
description: She figured the football class was almost over and called her husband Weiming. Weiming said the class had ended and he was taking the two children to eat at the New Shanghai Kitchen restaurant, and they would go home after they finished eating. She told him to be careful on the way, and calmly shared her checkup results, especially the cortisol and stomach acid issues, hoping to get support from the family when he came back. Weiming was very concerned and said that after he got home, the whole family would have a good talk in the evening.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Helping mother prepare dinner and family communication
description: At 3:30 p.m., Weiming came back with the two children, and the kids watched cartoons in the living room. She prepared dinner with her mother in the kitchen, suggesting that tonight's meal should be light. She specifically asked her mother to steam a sea bass and make garlic broccoli, and set dinner time at 18:30. The mother and daughter chatted while trimming snow peas, in a warm atmosphere. Her husband Weiming also came in to help take out the trash.
location: Kitchen and living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Checked weekend homework with her son.
description: After watching an episode of a cartoon with her daughter, she called her son Xuanxuan to the study to check his weekend math homework. Xuanxuan had completed most of it. She circled several wrong problems about comparing fractions, patiently explained the approach, and encouraged him to correct them on his own. Xuanxuan nodded to show he understood. She kissed her son on the forehead and let him go back to play.
location: Study room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: Dinner started on time at 18:00. On the table were steamed sea bass, blanched prawns, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg drop soup. At the table, I formally explained the contents of the physical examination report in detail to everyone, saying that I wanted to adjust the whole family's lifestyle, especially dinner time and flavors. My husband Weiming was the first to support: "Okay, I'll urge you to go to bed early from now on." My mother also said with a smile: "Just in time, we can all eat healthier together. I'll use less oil and salt starting tomorrow." My son Xuanxuan said: "Then I won't eat potato chips after dinner anymore!"
location: Restaurant, Block 3, Whampoa Garden, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening parent-child and household chores time.
description: After dinner, she cleared the table and her husband helped with the dishes. She spent some time doing finger painting with her daughter Xinxin, pressing paint into flowers and butterflies. Then she checked her son Xuanxuan's corrected math homework and confirmed that he had fully mastered it. After that, she gave her daughter Xinxin a warm bath, dried her body, and helped her into a cute dinosaur pajama set.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, Block 3, Whampoa Garden residential estate, living room and children's room

name: In-depth family communication: implementing the health plan.
description: The children were playing with toys in the study. She sat down on the living room sofa with her husband Weiming and her mother, took out the Health Improvement Plan from her phone's memo, explained it item by item, and asked for support. Her mother promised to try to have dinner ready before 7 o'clock in the future and increase the proportion of whole grains. Weiming volunteered to take away her phone before 11 PM every day and take over some childcare tasks (such as telling bedtime stories). The three reached a tacit understanding and consensus.
location: Living room, Block 3, Whampoa Garden Residential Estate, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening personal tidying, health diary, and relaxing stretches

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and review.
description: In the bedroom, she first used the massage chair for 15 minutes of full-body relaxation, with the intensity set to level 3, focusing on the leg muscles. Then she did a gentle full-body stretch on the floor. After that, she sat on the edge of the bed and opened her health diary to record her weight (52.5 kg), exercise, food intake, and mood, then did five minutes of mindful breathing to clear her mind. Finally, she prepared the clothes and commute bag for the next day.
location: Bedroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Evening reading and bedtime
description: Her husband Zhang Weiming also entered the bedroom. Yu Xiaowei leaned against the headboard and read a few pages of Sales Is Playing with Emotional Intelligence in preparation for next year's promotion. When she felt sleepy, she put down the book, exchanged goodnights with her husband, and turned off the lights on time to go to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home in Whampoa Garden residential estate, Hung Hom, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Morning yoga
description: After being woken by the alarm clock, Yu Xiaowei completed 15 minutes of morning relaxation and stretching on the mat in the yoga corner of her bedroom, with deep breathing, feeling the changes in her body and gathering energy for the new year.
location: Yoga corner in the bedroom, home, Jia Le Yuan, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong SAR

name: Early morning family collaboration
description: Husband Zhang Weiming brewed coffee, and mother Chen Meiling prepared sandwich lunches for the children. Since it was a school holiday, the children Xuanxuan and Xinxin stayed home and helped set the table. The family briefly discussed tonight's New Year's Eve plans, confirming that Zhang Weiming would take the children to the park in the afternoon and Yu Xiaowei would go straight home after work. Yu Xiaowei refilled the cat Aju's food.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Commute and personal reflection
description: Yu Xiaowei said goodbye to her husband at the corner of Prince Edward Road West, walked to Lok Fu Station, took the MTR Kwun Tong Line to Mong Kok East Station, then transferred to the East Rail Line to Exhibition Centre Station. On the train, she used her phone memo to go through the day's to-do list and browsed a financial news briefing to prepare for the new year's work.
location: From 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, to AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, via Lok Fu MTR Station (inside the MTR train).

name: Company wrap-up and pre-New Year preparations
description: After arriving at the office, Yu Xiaowei brewed her own goji berry and chrysanthemum tea, focused on handling the last batch of pre-holiday emails, checked each customer policy document that needed filing one by one, and took time to review the background information of Mr. Wang, the client with an appointment on January 5, noting key points for communication. Her desk was neat and tidy. During this time, her colleague Su Lishan made an appointment to have lunch together.
location: Office, 8th Floor, AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Team lunch and experience sharing.
description: Yu Xiaowei had lunch with colleague Su Lishan and two young team members at a cha chaan teng. While eating curry beef brisket rice, she proactively shared her 'three-step eye care method' for improving dry eyes: adjusting screen brightness and color temperature, doing eye exercises on a schedule, and using artificial tears. Su Lishan said she would try it.
location: Sun Chiu Kee Restaurant, downstairs of the AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Deepening client relationships and saying goodbye before the New Year.
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowei met Mr. Wang, a high-net-worth client working nearby, at the café in Shui On Centre. She gave him early New Year greetings and briefly asked for his initial thoughts on the investment proposal discussed before the meeting on January 5, paving the way for follow-up after the holiday. Before parting, she gave him a carefully wrapped, hand-embroidered Cantonese embroidery bookmark of a ginkgo leaf as a small New Year gift. Mr. Wang said he liked it very much.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Shui On Centre Café, Shop 103, 1/F, Shui On Centre, 6-8 Harbour Road, Wan Chai.

name: Return to the office and leave work early
description: Yu Xiaowei walked back to the office. In the corridor, she briefly said goodbye to her supervisor Liang Zhenhua, telling him she needed to leave early to handle family matters. Brother Hua smiled and wished her a happy New Year. Then Yu Xiaowei packed up her personal belongings and prepared to head to Whampoa Wonder World.
location: AIA Building, 138 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

name: Family shopping.
description: Yu Xiaowei took the MTR to Whampoa Station, walked to the home goods store at Whampoa Wonderland shopping mall, and chose two transparent storage boxes of suitable sizes, planning to use them to sort Cantonese embroidery threads by color. While paying, she thought of the embroidery area she would organize in the evening and felt full of anticipation.
location: Wonder World Shopping Centre, 6 Tak Hong Street, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Refreshing the space and taking stock of creations
description: After arriving home and changing into loungewear, Yu Xiaowei patiently disassembled and washed her yoga mat and wiped the corner areas with a special cleaner; then she wiped down the Cantonese embroidery tools one by one, neatly stored the scattered embroidery threads into a newly bought box according to the color spectrum classification method her teacher taught, and carefully unfolded several embroidery pieces from the past six months, taking photos with her phone to archive them. She felt fulfilled by the progress she had made.
location: Jialeyuan home, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region - Cantonese embroidery area in the living room, yoga corner in the bedroom

name: Warm family New Year's Eve preparations
description: After Zhang Weiming brought the children home from the park, Yu Xiaowei and her mother prepared dinner together. The children excitedly shared stories about the park; Xinxin helped wash the greens, and Xuanxuan set out the bowls and chopsticks. Her father, Yu Guoqiang, also came home a little earlier today and read the newspaper in the living room. Zhang Weiming turned the TV to the live New Year's Eve gala channel as background audio, and the family chatted while they worked, with laughter all around.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Family reunion dinner
description: The reunion dinner began, with dishes that were the specialties of her mother and Chen Meiling: soy sauce chicken, steamed fish, and blanched choy sum. The family raised their glasses to toast the New Year. Yu Xiaowei noticed that her father did not talk much, but his expression became much gentler when he watched the grandchildren. After the meal, her father went to the balcony to smoke, and Yu Xiaowei decided to discuss her father's check-up with her younger brother later.
location: Dining room at home, Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Accompanying the children and telling bedtime stories to put them to sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming watched part of the New Year's Eve concert with the children while their favorite singers performed, then put them to bed. Yu Xiaowei told Xinxin a story from The Little Prince, promised Xuanxuan she would take him cycling at Kowloon Tsai Park tomorrow, kissed their foreheads, and said goodnight to each other.
location: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Kowloon City District, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Jiale Garden, children's room at home

name: Couple's New Year's Eve balcony reflection.
description: After the children were asleep and the elders had returned to their rooms, Yu Xiaowei and Zhang Weiming took warm milk to the quiet little balcony and used an iPad to browse the family album, reviewing this year full of changes: his career change, her career ups and downs, her father's health, the children's growth... The two thanked each other, shared the difficulties, and felt calm and steadfast at heart.
location: Balcony of the home at Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Write down New Year's goals
description: From the distance came the sound of sporadic celebrations, and the New Year countdown began on TV. The moment the bell rang, Yu Xiaowei opened WeChat on her phone and solemnly sent herself a message: Finish a full marathon, hold a Cantonese embroidery exhibition, and take the family to Japan. Be less sad. After writing it, she let out a long sigh, as if drawing a close to the past year.
location: Balcony of the home at Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Video call with younger brother Yu Xiaofeng
description: Yu Xiaowei had a video call with her younger brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen. After exchanging New Year greetings, she steered the conversation to their father, describing his silence at the dinner table, and both expressed concern. After discussing, they decided that when her brother returned to Hong Kong during the Spring Festival, he would be more proactive in accompanying their father for a comprehensive medical checkup and encourage him to take part in more community activities. The call ended with their shared understanding of "we should care about him more." The sibling bond warmed Yu Xiaowei's heart.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, Jialeyuan, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Handling social messages
description: After ending the video call, Yu Xiaowei pulled up an old photo taken at Teacher Wu's Sweet Soup Shop on her phone, opened Moments, wrote "There are sweet and bitter times; keep running next year" and posted it. Running buddy Shen Peiwen liked it and left an encouraging emoji. Scrolling down, she saw a New Year greeting from Zhou Minyi. Yu Xiaowei's thumb paused for a moment, but she eventually swiped past it, calmly maintaining the boundary she had established.
location: Living room at home, Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

name: Bedtime preparation and peaceful sleep
description: Yu Xiaowei washed up briefly, changed into her pajamas, and her husband Zhang Weiming had already gone to sleep. She put her phone on silent and turned off the desk lamp. In the darkness, she thought back over the day: the joy of sharing, the warmth of family, the certainty of her goals, and her worries for her loved ones... All the uncertainties and regrets faded, leaving only anticipation for the new year. With this hope and resolve, she slowly drifted into sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Ka Lok Yuen, 328 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon City District, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
